target_text: ka abram dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, wee! èu ne, dhèu èmu uru. aa nèngu, dhèu èmu limuri. de èu ne dhu mèd'u paredha. de èu neo tao ne tasamia, èèna ètu èu na! ka sarai mulai tao sakaa hua dènge hagar, hèia na rai.

source_text: and an angel of the lord came to her by a fountain of water in the waste land, by the fountain on the way to shur.
target_text: na rai d'ai d'ara mamoo. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga ca dhèu, rage ne dètu dènge madha èi, ètu j'ara la'e asa sur.

source_text: and he said, hagar, sarai's servant, where have you come from and where are you going? and she said, i am running away from sarai, my master's wife.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne hagar, ènu sarai. nga tao ka èu ètu ne'e? èu mai nèti mia, aa lamu mia? hèia hagar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a rai nèti d'ara èmu lamatua ja'a.

source_text: and the angel said to her, go back, and put yourself under her authority.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pamako ne, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! be'a risi, èu lèpa hari asa adhe-aai sarai, lamatua èu. masi ka na tao èu tasamia èèna ka, sèmi la.

source_text: and the angel of the lord said, your seed will be greatly increased so that it may not be numbered.
target_text: baku madha'u. bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu pa'ae-ae, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: and the angel of the lord said, see, you are with child and will give birth to a son, to whom you will give the name ishmael, because the ears of the lord were open to your sorrow.
target_text: èu dhu dènge babia. nèbhu heka, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èèna na mu pangare ne ismael dhu sasoa na ‘lamatua tadèngi', lula lamatua tadèngi le lii roma iisi èu.

source_text: and he will be like a mountain ass among men; his hand will be against every man and every man's hand against him, and he will keep his place against all his brothers.
target_text: ropa ana ne kapai, na mamuri pakaj'èu nèti a'ari na. lula nèngu ne, sama sèmi jara hui dhu d'èi boe nanene lii paredha. sad'i dhèu cee èèna ka, na sisu. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i lab'a ne kahèi.

source_text: and to the lord who was talking with her she gave this name, you are a god who is seen; for she said, have i not even here in the waste land had a vision of god and am still living?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hagar ngee ka ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le lamatua, dhu ladhe-leru aa madhenge ja'a. hèia na hia ngara mi lamatua, lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ja'a.

source_text: so that fountain was named, fountain of life and vision: it is between kadesh and bered.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu pangare madha èi na, beer lahai roi, dhu sasoa na madha èi nèti nèngu dhu mamuri, dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. era na, ètu talora aae nèti rae kades dènge rae beret. madha èi ne, abhu era toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and hagar gave birth to a child, the son of abram, to whom abram gave the name of ishmael.
target_text: èle èèna ka, hagar lèpa hari. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. abram pangare ne ismael.

source_text: abram was eighty-six years old when hagar gave birth to ishmael.
target_text: lod'o hagar nare iisi ismael, umur abram aru nguru èna tèu kèna.

source_text: when abram was ninety-nine years old, the lord came to him, and said, i am god, ruler of all; go in my ways and be upright in all things,
target_text: ropa umur abram d'ai ceo nguru ceo tèu, lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne. ka na peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. èu hud'i madhutu taruu dad'èi ja'a, dènge j'ara mamuri èu hud'i mola.

source_text: and i will make an agreement between you and me, and your offspring will be greatly increased.
target_text: ja'a neo pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. aa ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and abram went down on his face on the earth, and the lord god went on talking with him, and said,
target_text: hèia abram patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: as for me, my agreement is made with you, and you will be the father of nations without end. no longer will your name be abram, but abraham, for i have made you the father of a number of nations.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu sèmi ne'e ka: èèna na, èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. nèti èèna ka, èu pake ia ka ngara èu abram dhu sasoa na ‘ama dhu dhèu tadhe', te ngaa abraham dhu sasoa na ‘bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae'.

source_text: i will make you very fertile, so that nations will come from you and kings will be your offspring.
target_text: ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu ae-ae. ja'a paj'aj'i si suku ae-ae. aa ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae nèti rèngu sèra.

source_text: and i will make between me and you and your seed after you through all generations, an eternal agreement to be a god to you and to your seed after you.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu, aa dènge ana-èpu èu sèra. lii pajaji ne ma'ète boe toke taa-taa, lula ja'a ne'e ka ama lamatua nèti èu dènge ana-èpu mu.

source_text: and to you and to your seed after you, i will give the land in which you are living, all the land of canaan for an eternal heritage; and i will be their god.
target_text: rai kana'an ne aa'i-aa'i, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. ne'e ne, èu dhoka pea manubha di ètu ne'e. te ngaa èèna na, j'aj'i mi unu ana-èpu èu toke taa-taa. aa ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu sèra kahèi.

source_text: and god said to abraham, on your side, you are to keep the agreement, you and your seed after you through all generations. and this is the agreement which you are to keep with me, you and your seed after you: every male among you is to undergo circumcision.
target_text: te ngaa èu dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, hud'i kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji ne, dènge d'ara kateme ku. dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ra, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: in the flesh of your private parts you are to undergo it, as a mark of the agreement between me and you. every male among you, from one generation to another, is to undergo circumcision when he is eight days old, with every servant whose birth takes place in your house, or for whom you gave money to someone of another country, and not of your seed. he who comes to birth in your house and he who is made yours for a price, all are to undergo circumcision; so that my agreement may be marked in your flesh, an agreement for all time.
target_text: ne'e ne, mone aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna, mulai nèti umur aru lod'o. a'ari èu, dhèu-dhèu sab'a èu, dènge ènu dhu èu hèli more nèti rai leo, aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i suna si. suna na j'aj'i tadha mi ngi'u miu, dhu pa'èki èdhi taa-taa.

source_text: and any male who does not undergo circumcision will be cut off from his people: my agreement has been broken by him.
target_text: mone mia dhu suna boe, rèngu sèra maso boe ètu d'ara lii pajaji ja'a ne, aa rèngu sèra j'aj'i boe dhèu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: and god said, as for sarai, your wife, from now her name will be not sarai, but sarah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu paroa ia ka ngara dhèu èmu mu sarai, te ngaa sara.

source_text: and i will give her a blessing so that you will have a son by her: truly my blessing will be on her, and she will be the mother of nations: kings of peoples will be her offspring.
target_text: èèna na ja'a hia mamèngi ae-ae mi sara, sèna ka nara iisi hia èu, ana mone ca dhèu. tare'a! bèli-camèd'a, sara j'aj'i bèi nèti suku ae-ae. aa èèna na, ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae-ae nèti ana-èpu nèngu.

source_text: then abraham went down on his face, and laughing, said in his heart, may a man a hundred years old have a child? will sarah, at ninety years old, give birth?
target_text: hèia abraham patitu kètu urutuu ka pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. te ngaa na mari ètu d'ara. na pangee, na, mone heka bhora dhu cangasu tèu sama sèmi ja'a ne, bisa abhu ana era? aa sara dhu heka gagoo-gagehu ne, dhu ceo nguru tèu kèna, nara iisi hari sa mia?

source_text: and abraham said to god, if only ishmael's life might be your care!
target_text: ka na peka dènge lamatua, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka laa, ismael ka dhu abhu pusaka ja'a èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: and god said, not so; but sarah, your wife, will have a son, and you will give him the name isaac, and i will make my agreement with him for ever and with his seed after him.
target_text: te ngaa aku ama lamatua na, aad'o sèmi èèna! bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu mu sara, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. pangare ne isak. lii jaji ja'a ne, lèke mi nèngu dènge ana-èpu na toke mia-mia.

source_text: as for ishmael, i have given ear to your prayer: truly i have given him my blessing and i will make him fertile and give him great increase; he will be the father of twelve chiefs, and i will make him a great nation.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi le ngaa dhu èu manèngi kahèi, hia ismael. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia berkat mi nèngu kahèi, aa hia ana-èpu na tabha ae. bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu ismael ne, j'aj'i mi canguru dua kapala suku. aa ana-èpu na suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: but my agreement will be with isaac, to whom sarah will give birth a year from this time.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, lii pajaji ja'a ne, lèke dhoka mi ana mu isak di. tèu mai ni, hèru sèmi ne'e kahèi, sara nara iisi le.

source_text: and having said these words, god went up from abraham.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, ka ama lamatua tèke eele abraham.

source_text: and abraham took ishmael, his son, and all whose birth had taken place in his house, and all his servants whom he had made his for a price, every male of his house, and on that very day he gave them circumcision in the flesh of their private parts as god had said to him. abraham was ninety-nine years old when he underwent circumcision. and ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he underwent circumcision. abraham and ishmael, his son, underwent circumcision on that very day. and all the men of his house, those whose birth had taken place in the house and those whom he had got for money from men of other lands, underwent circumcision with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, abraham tao dènge ka, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ka na suna. na suna ana na, ismael, dènge dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge ne. lod'o èèna, umur abraham ceo nguru ceo tèu le, aa ismael canguru tèlu tèu.

source_text: now the lord came to him by the holy tree of mamre, when he was seated in the doorway of his tent in the middle of the day;
target_text: ca tèka, abraham pea padètu dènge aj'u aae canau ètu mamre. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu ètu era èèna. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o èèna, sagoro ae titu kèna, ka abraham madhèdi ètu hèb'a paleo na, sèna ka abhu ngèlu g'oro ciki.

source_text: and lifting up his eyes, he saw three men before him; and seeing them, he went quickly to them from the door of the tent, and went down on his face to the earth;
target_text: ropa abraham boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi dhèu tèlu dhu titu kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna. hèia na rai la'e soru nare si. ropa na d'ai madha si, na patitu kètu urutuu na,

source_text: and said, my lord, if now i have grace in your eyes, do not go away from your servant:
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama si. mai dhuli ku ho minu èi ciki.

source_text: let me get water for washing your feet, and take your rest under the tree:
target_text: ama si ae ciki mi mamaho ne'e. ho ana-ana iiki rèti èi, sèna ka rasa haga miu.

source_text: and let me get a bit of bread to keep up your strength, and after that you may go on your way: for this is why you have come to your servant. and they said, let it be so.
target_text: pe ja'a laku lalau nganga'a-nginu ho ama si mi'a ciki, sèna ka ako kadhii ciki, heka lami taruu kèna. te ja'a karej'e bisa lalau ama si. ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ooo. ji'i dhuli.

source_text: then abraham went quickly into the tent, and said to sarah, get three measures of meal straight away and make cakes.
target_text: hèia abraham pamèri sa d'ara paleo, la'e peka dènge sara, aku nèngu na, mèri! more tarigu dhu be'a risi, ca saku, ho tao roti!

source_text: and running to the herd, he took a young ox, soft and fat, and gave it to the servant and he quickly made it ready;
target_text: ka rai la'e hari asa era sapi na, hèia kèpe ana sapi kabèb'u ci'u. ka na pua dhèu sab'a na sa, pare.

source_text: and he took butter and milk and the young ox which he had made ready and put it before them, waiting by them under the tree while they took food.
target_text: hèia la'e nare susu, keju dènge sisi dhu heka nasu èèna, nèti hia tamu sèra ra'a. abraham titu taruu ètu mamaho aj'u, ho na lalau si.

source_text: and they said to him, where is sarah your wife? and he said, she is in the tent.
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, dhèu èmu mu sara, ka mia? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, nuka d'ara paleo èèna.

source_text: and he said, i will certainly come back to you in the spring, and sarah your wife will have a son. and his words came to the ears of sarah who was at the back of the tent-door.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se padhai lii, aku nèngu na, pe d'ai tèu mai nèi, ja'a lèpa hari mai. lod'o èèna, dhèu èmu èu sara nare iisi le ana mone ca dhèu. ropa rèngu padhai lii èèna, sara nanene nèti kabodho babèdho.

source_text: now abraham and sarah were very old, and sarah was past the time for giving birth.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abraham dènge sara dhu heka bhoro le, ngaa hari sara dhu abhu heka hèru.

source_text: and sarah, laughing to herself, said, now that i am used up am i still to have pleasure, my husband himself being old?
target_text: ropa sara tadèngi padhue-padhai rèngu se, ka na mari kèmu. na pangee na, ja'a dhu heka roto-roto sèmi ne'e ne, aa dhèu èmu ja'a dhu roe nia heka. tasamia ji'i bisa tao sèmi ana ngèru dhu leo-èmu hiu, ho abhu ana?

source_text: and the lord said, why was sarah laughing and saying, is it possible for me, being old, to give birth to a child?
target_text: ka lamatua peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka sara mari? ele boe na ngee na, lii padhai ja'a ne j'aj'i boe, lula nèngu heka le.

source_text: is there any wonder which the lord is not able to do? at the time i said, in the spring, i will come back to you, and sarah will have a child.
target_text: ja'a ne, lamatua! abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ja'a bisa boe tao. sanèd'e paie. tèu mai, ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, sara dhu nara iisi le, ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: then sarah said, i was not laughing; for she was full of fear. and he said, no, but you were laughing.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, sara j'aj'i madha'u. ka na pasili, aku nèngu na, ja'a mari boe, nga! te ngaa lamatua b'ala, na, deo na, èu mari, nga.

source_text: and the men went on from there in the direction of sodom; and abraham went with them on their way.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu tèlu se pakèd'i neo lasi asa kota sodom. ka abraham lere si d'ai talora j'ara. nèti era èèna, ladhe rèdhi kota sodom.

source_text: and the lord said, am i to keep back from abraham the knowledge of what i do;
target_text: ka lamatua ngee ètu d'ara na, hua iia ja'a peka dènge abraham, ja'a neo palaho kota sodom.

source_text: seeing that abraham will certainly become a great and strong nation, and his name will be used by all the nations of the earth as a blessing?
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, ana-èpu na asa tabha ae, aa suku dhu kapai. aa nèngu ne, èèna na, j'aj'i berkat mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for i have made him mine so that he may give orders to his children and those of his line after him, to keep the ways of the lord, to do what is good and right: so that the lord may do to abraham as he has said.
target_text: ja'a hag'e kore le nèngu, ho na nori ana-èpu na dènge dhèu leo, sèna ka madhutu taruu j'ara lamatua, ho ra mamuri dènge mola. ladhe rèngu mamuri sèmi èèna, ja'a tao aa'i lii dhu ja'a pajaji dènge abraham.

source_text: and the lord said, because the outcry against sodom and gomorrah is very great, and their sin is very evil,
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a tadèngi le, lii roma iisi dhèu ae, peka na, dhèu kota sodom dènge gomora bhabhelu ra seli-kolane.

source_text: i will go down now, and see if their acts are as bad as they seem from the outcry which has come to me; and if they are not, i will see.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a puru madha ku mai, sèna ka kèdhi unu ku, ngaa dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, pe ja'a ke'a unu ku.

source_text: and the men, turning from that place, went on to sodom: but abraham was still waiting before the lord.
target_text: ropa lamatua padhai lii era dènge abraham, dhèu dua se lasi taruu sa kota sodom.

source_text: and abraham came near, and said, will you let destruction come on the upright with the sinners?
target_text: hèia abraham la'e padètu dènge lamatua, ka na pamako na, peka na, tasamia? ama neo pamadhe aa'i dhèu-dhèu be'a pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu bhelu, do?

source_text: if by chance there are fifty upright men in the town, will you give the place to destruction and not have mercy on it because of the fifty upright men?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a ètu d'ara kota èèna, ama pamadhe si hèi? do, ama palaho heka kota sèra, lula rèngu se'e, do?

source_text: let such a thing be far from you, to put the upright to death with the sinner: will not the judge of all the earth do right?
target_text: ama baku tao sèmi èèna! mage dhoka, dhèu be'a sèra madhe hèi, lula ama neo pamadhe dhèu bhelu sèra. ama ka dhu pama'ète lii ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. de ama ku unu mu dhu me'a j'ara èèna adil boe.

source_text: and the lord said, if there are fifty upright men in the town, i will have mercy on it because of them.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu be'a lèmi nguru dhèu ètu kota sodom, ja'a huku boe kota èèna, lula rèngu.

source_text: and abraham answering said, truly, i who am only dust, have undertaken to put my thoughts before the lord:
target_text: hèia abraham padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a manèngi abho, lula ja'a neo padhai lii hari ciki. ja'a ne dhoka dhèu goa di, dhu ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: if by chance there are five less than fifty upright men, will you give up all the town to destruction because of these five? and he said, i will not give it to destruction if there are forty-five.
target_text: sèmi d'ai boe dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka èpa nguru lèmi di, tasamia? kura dhoka dhèu lèmi di, na ama neo palaho eele kota èèna, do? ka lamatua b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a abhu dhèu be'a èpa nguru lèmi, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: and again he said to him, by chance there may be forty there. and he said, i will not do it if there are forty.
target_text: ka abraham pamako hari, na, sèmi abhu dhoka èpa nguru dhèu be'a di, tasamia, ama? ka na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu èpa nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and he said, let not the lord be angry with me if i say, what if there are thirty there? and he said, i will not do it if there are thirty.
target_text: abraham pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ama baku nasa. te abhu dhoka tèlu nguru dhèu be'a di, na tasamia? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu tèlu nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and he said, see now, i have undertaken to put my thoughts before the lord: what if there are twenty there? and he said, i will have mercy because of the twenty.
target_text: hèia abraham peka hari, ama mage nasa ladhe ja'a karèi hari ciki. sèmi abhu dhoka dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, na tasamia? ka na dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, sèmi abhu dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, ja'a palaho eele boe kota èèna.

source_text: and he said, o let not the lord be angry and i will say only one word more: by chance there may be ten there. and he said, i will have mercy because of the ten.
target_text: ka abraham katange lii padhai na, aa na karèi, peka na, ama! ja'a padhai lii hari ca tèka, te ngaa baku nasa dènge ja'a. tasamia, ladhe abhu dhoka canguru dhèu di dhu be'a? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu canguru dhèu dhu be'a ètu era èèna, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: and the lord went on his way when his talk with abraham was ended, and abraham went back to his place.
target_text: padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, lamatua la'e dènge ka, aa abraham lèpa kahèi.

source_text: and at nightfall the two angels came to sodom; and lot was seated at the way into the town: and when he saw them he got up and came before them, falling down on his face to the earth.
target_text: ètu d'ara lamatua dhu padhue-padhai era dènge abraham, ana pajuu na dhèu dua, lasi le asa kota sodom. d'ai nèi, lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka lot dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe kota. ropa nèdhi dhèu dua se, la'e soru nare si. ka na patitu kètu urutuu, aa pacud'u kètu ètu madha ra.

source_text: and he said, my masters, come now into your servant's house and take your rest there for the night, and let your feet be washed; and early in the morning you may go on your way. and they said, not so, but we will take our night's rest in the street.
target_text: ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, mai lati dhuli ku èmu ja'a la. sèna ka ama si rase haga, aa j'unu ètu èmu ja'a. pe bèli mad'ae, heka ama si kako hari kèna. ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, makasi. te ngaa repo ia ka. hud'i laa ji'i j'unu ètu d'ara lapa.

source_text: but he made his request more strongly, so they went with him into his house; and he got food ready for them, and made unleavened bread, of which they took.
target_text: te ngaa lot pamako si loe boe, ka lasi manubha asa èmu na. ka lot si tunu roti, lalau mei, ka ra'a-rinu pa'èci.

source_text: but before they had gone to bed, the men of the town, all the men of sodom, came round the house, young and old, from every part of the town;
target_text: dhu dua ra lasi mèka j'unu, cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone sodom aa'i-aa'i, ana mone ngèru toke d'ai mone heka, mai reo rare èmu lot.

source_text: and crying out to lot, they said, where are the men who came to your house this night? send them out to us, so that we may take our pleasure with them.
target_text: dhèu se'e pa'oo-parodha, peka mi lot, aku rèngu na, he, lot! mone dua deo sa, ètu mia? bhabhodho si mai, sèna ka ji'i j'unu dènge ra!

source_text: and lot went out to them in the doorway, shutting the door after him.
target_text: hèia lot li'u la'e, ka na bèdho hari èmu.

source_text: and he said, my brothers, do not this evil.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! baku miu tao bhelu mi tamu ja'a se.

source_text: see now, i have two unmarried daughters; i will send them out to you so that you may do to them whatever seems good to you: only do nothing to these men, for this is why they have come under the shade of my roof.
target_text: mi nanene ku ja'a laa! ana bhèni ja'a, dhèu dua. dua ra dhu pa'èci mèka dènge dhèu mone. ja'a hia miu. mere, ho mi tao tasamia èèna ka, sad'i madhutu dad'èi miu. sad'i miu baku tao karehe mi tamu ja'a dhèu dua se. lula madhutu ad'a èdhi, ja'a ka dhu hud'i j'aga si.

source_text: and they said, give way there. this one man, they said, came here from a strange country, and will he now be our judge? now we will do worse to you than to them; and pushing violently against lot, they came near to get the door broken in.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu sodom se pa'oo ma'ète boe, aku rèngu na, èu ne, baku patabha! te èu ne, dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai ji'i ne! de èu dènge boe hak ho kai ji'i. hua iia, èu pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e. te, ladhe lamu boe, ji'i tao èu bia risi nèti dhèu dua se'e! ka ra tule eele lot, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra rai lasi j'èje babèdho èmu.

source_text: but the men put out their hands and took lot into the house to them, shutting the door again.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dua se soro kacui-aai ra, ère pamaso lot, ka ra patèke èmu nèti d'ara.

source_text: but the men who were outside the door they made blind, all of them, small and great, so that they were tired out with looking for the door.
target_text: dua ra tao pabèdhu ana madha dhèu sodom aa'i-aa'i ra, ka rèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ra gogo tenge babèdho, te ngaa abhu boe.

source_text: then the men said to lot, are there any others of your family here? sons-in-law or sons or daughters, take them all out of this place; for we are about to send destruction on this place, because a great outcry against them has come to the ears of the lord; and the lord has sent us to put an end to the town.
target_text: hèia tamu dhèu dua se, peka dènge lot, aku rèngu na, lamatua ne'a le, bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu sodom se. nèti èèna ka, na paleha ji'i dua mi mai, sèna ka palaho eele kota ne. de èu dhu dènge a'ari leo dhu ètu d'ara kota ne, do aad'o? ladhe dènge ana mone, do ana bhèni, do dhèu èmu ana èu, do, sad'i cee èèna ka, lamu more si, ho rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne lai-lai!

source_text: and lot went out and said to his sons-in-law, who were married to his daughters, come, let us go out of this place, for the lord is about to send destruction on the town. but his sons-in-law did not take him seriously.
target_text: hèia lot la'e paraga dènge ana mone dhèu dua, dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni na. ka na peka, dua mi nanene paie! rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne, te lamatua neo palaho eele ne! te ngaa ra pangee na, lot padhai lii paleko di.

source_text: and when morning came, the angels did all in their power to make lot go, saying, get up quickly and take your wife and your two daughters who are here, and go, for fear that you come to destruction in the punishment of the town.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae era, ana pajuu lamatua dhèu dua se, pakaseti lot si, ho lasi karohe asa era kaj'èu. ra peka na, lami ka! ère mèti dhèu èmu mu, dènge ana bhèni èu dhèu dua sèra, ho rai ka. tèke eele kota ne'e! mage dhoka miu madhe aa'i palere-lere dènge kota ne.

source_text: but while he was waiting, the men took him and his wife and his daughters by the hand, for the lord had mercy on them, and put them outside the town.
target_text: te ngaa lot neka-neka era, masi ka lamatua neo hia ne mamuri. nèti èèna ka, tamu dhèu dua se nuni lot, dhèu èmu na, dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua sèra, rèti asa li'u kota.

source_text: and when they had put them out, he said, go for your life, without looking back or waiting in the lowland; go quickly to the mountain or you will come to destruction.
target_text: hèia ca dhèu nèti tamu dhèu dua sèra paredha si, peka na, rai palasa, sèna ka abhu sod'a! mage mi kabib'a kabodho! baku ae ètu d'ara mamoo! rai taruu, asa ledhe nèi, sèna ka miu baku madhe!

source_text: and lot said to them, not so, o my lord;
target_text: te ngaa lot peka, aku nèngu na, iraa ee! baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: see now, your servant has had grace in your eyes and great is your mercy in keeping my life from destruction, but i am not able to get as far as the mountain before evil overtakes me and death;
target_text: mema ama si pamamuri le ji'i se. te ngaa ledhe nèi kaj'èu bia nèti ne'e! mage dhoka ji'i d'ai mèka nèi, j'aj'èra dhu magee nare le ji'i èèna, ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: this town, now, is near, and it is a little one: o, let me go there is it not a little one? so that my life may be safe.
target_text: ama ladhe ku laa. rae iiki cue dhu kaj'èu boe nèti era ne'e. rae nèi dhu kolongara aad'o. ladhe ama d'èi, ji'i la'a pasoru iisi asa nèi!

source_text: and he said, see, i have given you your request in this one thing more: i will not send destruction on this town.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! lami ka! te èèna na, ja'a palaho boe rae nèi.

source_text: go there quickly, for i am not able to do anything till you have come there. for this reason, the town was named zoar.
target_text: de rai karohe ka, lami asa nèi! te ja'a tao mèka ngaa-ngaa, ladhe miu d'ai mèka era nèi. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu pangare rae ne soar, dhu sasoa na ‘ana iiki-iiki'.

source_text: the sun was up when lot came to zoar.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea, lot si d'ai soar.

source_text: then the lord sent fire and flaming smoke raining down from heaven on sodom and gomorrah.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, lamatua sadutu ai dènge èi nasu nèti dedha-liru asa sodom dènge gomora.

source_text: and he sent destruction on those towns, with all the lowland and all the people of those towns and every green thing in the land.
target_text: lamatua pakèpu-ladhu ai kota dènge rae aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara rai èèna, dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu èèna, nuka: dhèu, badha-manu, dènge ana aaj'u.

source_text: but lot's wife, looking back, became a pillar of salt.
target_text: lod'o rèngu rai, dhèu èmu lot kabib'a kabodho. cag'ag'a laa, na j'aj'i agarii masi.

source_text: and abraham got up early in the morning and went to the place where he had been talking with the lord:
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhu mad'ae aae era, abraham la'e asa era dhu med'a na, na pamako lamatua.

source_text: and looking in the direction of sodom and gomorrah and the lowland, he saw the smoke of the land going up like the smoke of an oven.
target_text: hèia na ladhe sa haha asa sodom dènge gomora, aa asa d'ara mamoo èèna. na ladhe la'a na, sèb'u poka-poka sèna, dhu ca'e asa dedha-liru. aa ai na'e aa'i le ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so it came about that when god sent destruction on the towns of the lowland, he kept his word to abraham, and sent lot safely away when he put an end to the towns where he was living.
target_text: ama lamatua patalale lot si nèti hahuku èèna, ropa na pakèpu-ladhu ai kota-kota sèra, lula na ngee nèdhi lii pajaji na dènge abraham.

source_text: then lot went up out of zoar to the mountain, and was living there with his two daughters, for fear kept him from living in zoar: and he and his daughters made their living-place in a hole in the rock.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lot madha'u pea taruu ètu rae soar. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge ana bhèni na dhèu dua sèra, lasi asa ledhe ka ra pea ètu d'ara loe cue.

source_text: and the older daughter said to her sister, our father is old, and there is no man to be a husband to us in the natural way:
target_text: ca lod'o, ana bhèni uru èèna, peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, ètu era ne'e ne, abhu boe dhèu mone ca dhèu sa, dhu bisa leo dènge èdhi se. aa ama èdhi asa heka, de ladhe èèna na, na bisa heka abhu ana.

source_text: come, let us give our father much wine, and we will go into his bed, so that we may have offspring by our father,
target_text: de be'a risi, ti hia ne ninu mahu, sèna ka èdhi dua ti j'unu dènge ne, ho ti abhu kolo hia ama èdhi.

source_text: and that night they made their father take much wine; and the older daughter went into his bed; and he had no knowledge of when she went in or when she went away.
target_text: ka ropa d'ai mèda, dua ra hia ama ra ninu èi anggor toke mahu. hèia ana bhèni uru èèna, la'e j'unu dènge ama na. lula ama na dhu mahu ae, ka ne'a boe nèngu dhu j'unu dènge ana na.

source_text: and on the day after, the older daughter said to the younger, last night i was with my father; let us make him take much wine this night again, and do you go to him, so that we may have offspring by our father.
target_text: hèia asa bèli èèna, a'a na peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, mèda deo na, ja'a j'unu le dènge ama èdhi. de mèda ne'e, èu kèna. èdhi hia ne hari ninu mahu, ho lamu j'unu dènge ne. sèna ka èdhi dua ti abhu ana, ho hia ana-èpu mi ama èdhi.

source_text: and that night again they made their father take much wine; and the younger daughter went into his bed; and he had no knowledge of when she went in or when she went away.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda na, dua ra hia hari ama ra ninu mahu. ka ana bhèni limuri ne, la'e ka j'unu dènge ama na. te ngaa, lula ama ra dhu mahu titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ne'a boe ngaa dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ana bhèni na.

source_text: and so the two daughters of lot were with child by their father.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, dua ra dènge babia nèti ama d'èlu rèngu.

source_text: and the older daughter had a son, and she gave him the name moab: he is the father of the moabites to this day.
target_text: hèia ana bhèni uru èèna nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na pangare na moab dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti ama'. ana ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu moab.

source_text: and the younger had a son and gave him the name ben-ammi: from him come the children of ammon to this day.
target_text: ka ana bhèni limuri ne, nara iisi ana mone èci kahèi. na pangare na ben ami dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti dhèu ja'a'. ana ne ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu amon.

source_text: and abraham went on his way from there to the land of the south, and was living between kadesh and shur, in gerar.
target_text: èle èèna, ka abraham nèti mamre, pidha asa rai negeb, dhu ètu re balèu, ka na pea ètu talora rae kades, dènge rae syur. te ngaa na pea nèbhu boe, ka pidha hari asa rae gerar.

source_text: and abraham said of sarah, his wife, she is my sister: and abimelech, king of gerar, sent and took sarah.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, sara ne, ana hèni ja'a. nèti èèna ka, abimelek dhèu aae gerar, pua dhèu lasi lii d'ai sara. ka nèti ne mai asa d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: but god came to abimelech in a dream in the night, and said to him, truly you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man's wife.
target_text: d'ara ca mèda sa, ama lamatua pad'elo iisi na dènge dhèu aae ètu d'ara nii. na peka, mamadhe èu ne dètu kèna! lula èu more dhèu èmu dhèu.

source_text: now abimelech had not come near her; and he said, lord, will you put to death an upright nation? did he not say to me himself, she is my sister? and she herself said, he is my brother: with an upright heart and clean hands have i done this.
target_text: hèia abimelek dhaa, peka na, lamatua! ja'a dhae pa'èci mèka dènge bhèni na. aa ja'a sasala aad'o. abraham unu na ka dhu peka, bhèni na, ana hèni nèngu! aa bhèni na dhaa sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia dhèu lasi lii d'ai ne, dènge d'ara mola. de lamatua baku pad'ui ja'a sasala!

source_text: and god said to him in the dream, i see that you have done this with an upright heart, and i have kept you from sinning against me: for this reason i did not let you come near her.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, tare'a. mema ja'a ke'a d'ara èu mola. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ka dhu taha èu, ho baku pa'èci dènge ne. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èu tao boe sala mi ja'a hèi.

source_text: so now, give the man back his wife, for he is a prophet, and let him say a prayer for you, so your life may be safe: but if you do not give her back, be certain that death will come to you and all your house.
target_text: de èu mèti hari ka bhèni ne, lèpa sa dhèu èmu na. mone na ka dhu nèti lii padhue-padhai ja'a. de lamu manèngi ne, sèna ka na sabaj'a hia èu, ho èu baku madhe. sanèd'e paie! ladhe èu hia boe bhèni na lèpa, èu dènge kabarai èu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: so abimelech got up early in the morning and sent for all his servants and gave them word of these things, and they were full of fear.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu aae pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i, ka na lolo lii nii na. hèia aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u.

source_text: then abimelech sent for abraham, and said, what have you done to us? what wrong have i done you that you have put on me and on my kingdom so great a sin? you have done to me things which are not to be done.
target_text: ka dhèu aae paroa abraham. na karèi, aku nèngu na, ja'a tao sala ngaa mi èu, ka èu neo paj'èra ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a? èu ne ele-ho'a ka dènge tao madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and abimelech said to abraham, why did you do this thing?
target_text: ngangee èu tasamia ka, mu tao sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and abraham said, because it seemed to me that there was no fear of god in this place, and that they might put me to death because of my wife.
target_text: ka abraham dhaa, peka na, ama dhèu aae! ja'a pangee na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, kabarai ne dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. de ele boe cahag'e neo pamadhe ja'a, sèna ka parame rare dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and, in fact, she is my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:
target_text: mema ja'a dhu peka tare'a, nèngu ne, ana hèni ja'a. lula ji'i dua mi ca ama, te ngaa ina baka-leo. nèti èèna ka, ji'i dua mi paleo.

source_text: and when god sent me wandering from my father's house, i said to her, let this be the sign of your love for me; wherever we go, say of me, he is my brother.
target_text: ka ropa ama lamatua pua ji'i ho tèke eele era paleo-palu'u ji'i, lod'o èèna ja'a peka dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, aku ja'a na, ‘ladhe èdhi lati asa era leo, ho dhèu karèi èu, dhu èdhi se dhèu èmu-kamali, ladhe èu dhu sue ja'a, na dhaa la, peka na èdhi se, dua ti pa'a'ari. '

source_text: then abimelech gave to abraham sheep and oxen and men-servants and women-servants, and gave him back his wife sarah. and abimelech said, see, all my land is before you; take whatever place seems good to you. and he said to sarah, see, i have given to your brother a thousand bits of silver so that your wrong may be put right; now your honour is clear in the eyes of all.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pangèd'u hari sara la'e asa abraham. ka na peka dènge sara, èèna na, ja'a hia ana mone mu doi iia ca riho, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha ja'a tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi èu. ho hud'i sène, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a! hèia dhèu aae peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, kabarai ja'a ne, dhu bhoke tèke hia èu. èu neo pea mi era mia èèna ka, ja'a hia èu. ka abimelek hia abraham sapi, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. na hia kahèi ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: then abraham made prayer to god, and god made abimelech well again, and his wife and his women-servants, so that they had children. for the lord had kept all the women of the house of abimelech from having children, because of sarah, abraham's wife.
target_text: uru èèna, lula abimelek nare dhèu èmu abraham, ka lamatua hutu eele era ana nèti bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu aae èèna. te ngaa ropa abimelek hia sara lèpa hari sa dhèu èmu na, ka abraham sabaj'a ho lamatua bhoke hari era ana nèti bhèni se. ka ra abhu hari ana.

source_text: and the lord came to sarah as he had said and did to her as he had undertaken. and sarah became with child, and gave abraham a son when he was old, at the time named by god. and abraham gave to his son, to whom sarah had given birth, the name isaac. and when his son isaac was eight days old, abraham made him undergo circumcision, as god had said to him. now abraham was a hundred years old when the birth of isaac took place. and sarah said, god has given me cause for laughing, and everyone who has news of it will be laughing with me. and she said, who would have said to abraham that sarah would have a child at her breast? for see, i have given him a son now when he is old.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua hia sara mèngi-nale madhutu lii pajaji na. lod'o sara dènge babia, abraham dhu heka le. ropa sara nara iisi, umur abraham d'ai cangasu tèu kèna. lod'o sara d'ai hèru, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka abraham pangare ne, isak dhu sasoa na ‘na mari'. sara peka hèi, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua tao ja'a mari, lula ja'a karej'e. dhèu ae ka dhu pangee na, ja'a ètu d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne, abhu heka ana. masi ka dhèu èmu ja'a heka bhoro le, te ja'a bisa kora iisi ana hia ne. èèna na, ladhe dhèu tadèngi j'ara ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mari kahèi dènge ja'a ne. ropa isak d'ai aru lod'o, abraham suna ne, madhutu paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and when the child was old enough to be taken from the breast, abraham made a great feast.
target_text: isak kapai ka noo-noo. ropa oe d'ai lod'o luri susu, abraham tao tatao aae.

source_text: and sarah saw the son of hagar the egyptian playing with isaac. so she said to abraham, send away that woman and her son: for the son of that woman is not to have a part in the heritage with my son isaac.
target_text: ca tèke, sara ladhe nèdhi ismael, ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri abraham, padadisi dènge isak. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, sara peka dènge dhèu èmu na, bège eele ènu masir nèi dènge ana na! te, ja'a ko'o boe ana ènu èèna unu pusaka, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka. dhoka ana ja'a isak di, dhu abhu sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and this was a great grief to abraham because of his son.
target_text: ropa abraham tadèngi lii padhai sara ne, ka d'ara na ako be'a boe, lula ismael ne, ana d'èlu na kahèi.

source_text: but god said, let it not be a grief to you because of the boy and hagar his mother; give ear to whatever sarah says to you, because it is from isaac that your seed will take its name.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua lii dènge abraham, peka na, abraham! èu baku ngee pa'ae dhèu èmu limuri èu, dènge ana na. madhutu la dad'èi sara ne, lula bèli-camèd'a, èu abhu ana-èpu dhu ja'a moa tèke èèna, nèti isak ne'e ka.

source_text: and i will make a nation of the son of your servant-woman, because he is your seed.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a hia kahèi mèngi-nale mi ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri mu, lula nèngu ne, ana d'èlu èu kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu na j'aj'i suku èci kahèi.

source_text: and early in the morning abraham got up, and gave hagar some bread and a water-skin, and put the boy on her back, and sent her away: and she went, wandering in the waste land of beer-sheba.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, abraham tao gee j'ara hia hagar, aa na kadhoe èi d'ara babo'i cue mi kabela-kao na. hèia na patabuli ka bhèni ne dènge ana na ismael, ho lasi. ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo dhu dètu dènge beer-syeba.

source_text: and when all the water in the skin was used up, she put the child down under a tree.
target_text: ropa èle èi rinu ra, hagar tèke eele ana na ètu d'ara mamaho aj'u iiki ca kapua.

source_text: and she went some distance away, about an arrow flight, and seating herself on the earth, she gave way to bitter weeping, saying, let me not see the death of my child.
target_text: ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, d'ara ja'a la'e boe, ladhe ja'a kèdhi mamadhe ana ja'a. ka na madhèdi ako kaj'èu nèti ana na, pe d'ai lèmi nguru meter sa. ka na tangi dènge lii roma iisi.

source_text: and the boy's cry came to the ears of god; and the angel of god said to hagar from heaven, hagar, why are you weeping? have no fear, for the child's cry has come to the ears of god.
target_text: lula ama lamatua dhu tadèngi lii tangi ismael, ka ana pajuu na mai nèti sorga, ka paroa hagar, aku nèngu na, hagar! nga tao ka, èu j'èra ae sèmi ne'e ne? baku madha'u ia ka, te lamatua tadèngi le lii tangi ana èu.

source_text: come, take your child in your arms, for i will make of him a great nation.
target_text: de kèd'i lamu more ana nèi. pa'èra d'ara na, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu na, suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: then god made her eyes open, and she saw a water-spring, and she got water in the skin and gave the boy a drink.
target_text: ka ama lamatua pasaraa musi madha na. cag'ag'a laa nèdhi dènge, èi ca madha ètu era èèna. hèia la'e soli èi asa d'ara babo'i, ka na panginu ana na ismael.

source_text: and god was with the boy, and he became tall and strong, and he became a bowman, living in the waste land. and while he was in the waste land of paran, his mother got him a wife from the land of egypt.
target_text: ka ismael dènge ina na hagar pea dènge ka ètu d'ara mamoo paran. ismael asa na kapai, aa ne'a mèu kataki. ka ina na paleo ne dènge ana bhèni masir ca dhèu. se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ismael.

source_text: now at that time, abimelech and phicol, the captain of his army, said to abraham, i see that god is with you in all you do.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai pangad'o dènge abraham. hèia dhèu aae padhai lii, ka na peka, abraham! ji'i se nge'a ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èu. nèti èèna ka, sad'i èu ad'u ngaa sa èci, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: now, then, give me your oath, in the name of god, that you will not be false to me or to my sons after me, but that as i have been good to you, so you will be to me and to this land where you have been living.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka èu subha ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, dhu peka na, èu bisa boe kapod'e-kabèli ja'a, dènge ana-èpu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. sèmi dhu ja'a tao le be'a mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao be'a kahèi mi ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a.

source_text: and abraham said, i will give you my oath.
target_text: ka aku abraham na, ooo! ja'a subha.

source_text: but abraham made a protest to abimelech because of a water-hole which abimelech's servants had taken by force.
target_text: te ngaa èle èèna ka, abraham lapor dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu ama dhèu aae parame rare èi ja'a ca madha.

source_text: but abimelech said, i have no idea who has done this thing; you never gave me word of it, and i had no knowledge of it till this day.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka, waa! ja'a heka tadèngi kèna j'ara ne'e ne. tasamia ka karèi nèti ca hari ni, èu peka boe dènge ja'a? ja'a dhae ke'a mèka, ne'e ne tatao cee ka ne.

source_text: and abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to abimelech, and the two of them made an agreement together. and abraham put seven young lambs of the flock on one side by themselves.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham dènge abimelek pa'èki lii pajaji. ka abraham hia abimelek sapi dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. èle èèna ka, abraham hag'e nare hari kahib'i-kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u.

source_text: then abimelech said, what are these seven lambs which you have put on one side?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tao sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he said, take these seven lambs from me as a witness that i have made this water-hole.
target_text: ka abraham peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. sèmi la kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u se, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha dhu ama peka le na, ja'a ka dhu kèi èi na.

source_text: so he gave that place the name beer-sheba, because there the two of them had given their oaths.
target_text: lula dua ra dhu pa'èki le soo-subha ètu èèna, ka era na ra pangare na beer-syeba dhu sasoa na, ‘madha èi soo-subha'.

source_text: so they made an agreement at beer-sheba, and abimelech and phicol, the captain of his army, went back to the land of the philistines.
target_text: ropa pasubha èle, ka dhèu aae dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na lèpa ka, asa era rèngu, rai dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and abraham, after planting a holy tree in beer-sheba, gave worship to the name of the lord, the eternal god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham sèle aj'u tamareska ca kapua ètu beer syeba. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, aj'u ne pasanèd'e abraham, lula ètu era èèna ka, nèngu mangaj'i lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and abraham went on living in the land of the philistines as in a strange country.
target_text: ka abraham pea dènge ka ètu talora dhèu pilistin sèmi dhèu tao mai.

source_text: now after these things, god put abraham to the test, and said to him, abraham; and he said, here am i.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia lamatua sèku neo ne'a d'ara abraham. neo ne'a abraham madhutu lamatua, do aad'o. ka lamatua paroa ne, aku nèngu na, abraham! hèia na dhaa, peka na, ooo, lamatua.

source_text: and he said to him, take your son, your dearly loved only son isaac, and go to the land of moriah and give him as a burned offering on one of the mountains of which i will give you knowledge.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, mu nanene paie-iie! more ana pasue èu mone mesa na. mèti ne asa rai moria, ho tao ne j'aj'i korban tunu hia ja'a. pe d'ai nèi, ja'a heka paj'uj'u era dhu ètu ledhe èci.

source_text: and abraham got up early in the morning, and made ready his ass, and took with him two of his young men and isaac, his son, and after the wood for the burned offering had been cut, he went on his way to the place of which god had given him word.
target_text: d'ai bèli mad'ae aae na, abraham sèg'i aj'u sèna ka tao kadhèna. na èki, ka na hue asa dedha keled'ei. ka dua ra dènge isak, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na dhèu dua, pakèd'i asa era dhu lamatua peka dènge ne.

source_text: and on the third day, abraham, lifting up his eyes, saw the place a long way off.
target_text: ra kako taruu, ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, abraham nèdhi le era èèna nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: then he said to his young men, keep here with the ass; and i and the boy will go on and give worship and come back again to you.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu dua sèra, aku nèngu na, dua mi mate taha mi ne'e dènge keled'ei ne. ja'a dènge ana ja'a la'a asa dedha nèi, ho mangaj'i ama lamatua. ladhe èle na, ji'i lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and abraham put the wood for the burned offering on his son's back, and he himself took the fire and the knife in his hand, and the two of them went on together.
target_text: ka abraham nare kadhèna dhu neo tunu korban, ka na tao mi kabela-kao isak. aa nèngu nèd'u tud'i, dènge suu ai. ropa dua ra palere lasi,

source_text: then isaac said to abraham, my father; and he said, here am i, my son. and he said, we have wood and fire here, but where is the lamb for the burned offering?
target_text: hèia isak paroa ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, ana? hèia isak karèi, aku nèngu na, èdhi neo lati tunu korban. de ai dènge kadhèna ka se'e le. te ngaa ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èdhi pake j'aj'i korban, ka mia?

source_text: and abraham said, god himself will give the lamb for the burned offering: so they went on together.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abraham na, pe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu hia ana kalèbho, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban. ka dua ra ca'e lasi taruu.

source_text: and they came to the place of which god had given him knowledge; and there abraham made the altar and put the wood in place on it, and having made tight the bands round isaac his son, he put him on the wood on the altar.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai era dhu lamatua peka èèna, ka abraham pudhi hadhu ho tao mei korban. hèia na paloko kadhèna ètu dedha mei korban ne. ka kèpe ana na isak, èki patarenga ne ètu dedha kadhèna.

source_text: and stretching out his hand, abraham took the knife to put his son to death.
target_text: ka nare tud'i, ho neo kèj'i pamadhe ana na.

source_text: but the voice of the angel of the lord came from heaven, saying, abraham, abraham: and he said, here am i.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua lii nèti dedha-liru, peka na, abraham! mata ku! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, lamatua?

source_text: and he said, let not your hand be stretched out against the boy to do anything to him; for now i am certain that the fear of god is in your heart, because you have not kept back your son, your only son, from me.
target_text: ka na peka hari, na, baku pamadhe ana èèna! baku tao ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu. ja'a ke'a le, èu ne tare'a-re'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula èu dènge d'ara kateme hia ana èu ca dhèu mesa èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban hia ne.

source_text: and lifting up his eyes, abraham saw a sheep fixed by its horns in the brushwood: and abraham took the sheep and made a burned offering of it in place of his son.
target_text: hèia abraham ladhe nèdhi kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u, dhu tadhu na pakai nare dadana aaj'u dhu karoki. ka na la'e kèpe nare, ho tunu j'aj'i mi korban hia ama lamatua, gati ana na.

source_text: and abraham gave that place the name yahweh-yireh: as it is said to this day, in the mountain the lord is seen.
target_text: ka abraham pangare era èèna, na, ‘lamatua sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu. ' nèti èèna ka, d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu peka na, ètu ledhe lamatua èèna, na sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu.

source_text: and the voice of the angel of the lord came to abraham a second time from heaven,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua lii hari nèti dedha-liru, peka na,

source_text: saying, i have taken an oath by my name, says the lord, because you have done this and have not kept back from me your dearly loved only son,
target_text: lamatua unu na, peka, ‘ja'a subha dènge kolongara ja'a mesa ku, sèmi ne'e: èu sadia le hia ja'a ana mu ca dhèu mone mesa na ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: that i will certainly give you my blessing, and your seed will be increased like the stars of heaven and the sand by the seaside; your seed will take the land of those who are against them;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pala-bagi èu dènge ana-èpu èu mèngi-nale ae-ae. èèna na, ra bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu ige rare boe, sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa salae ètu sebhe dhasi. ana-èpu èu sèra, èèna na, segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra.

source_text: and your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth, because you have done what i gave you orders to do.
target_text: nèti ana-èpu èu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale lula èu madhutu le lii paredha ja'a. '

source_text: then abraham went back to his young men and they went together to beer-sheba, the place where abraham was living.
target_text: èle hèia, abraham dènge isak, lèpa hari asa era dhu dhèu sab'a na sèra. ka lasi palere asa beer-syeba. d'ai nèi, abraham si pea dènge ka.

source_text: after these things, abraham had news that milcah, the wife of his brother nahor, had given birth to children;
target_text: ca lod'o, abraham tadèngi na, dhèu èmu ari na nahor, dhu ngara na milka, nara iisi ana na.

source_text: uz the oldest, and buz his brother, and kemuel, the father of aram,
target_text: ana uru, ngara na us. ari na, bus. èle ka, nara iisi hari kemuel dhu j'aj'i ama aram.

source_text: and chesed and hazo and pildash and jidlaph and bethuel.
target_text: ka na abhu hari kesed, haso, pildas, yidlaf, dènge betuel.

source_text: bethuel was the father of rebekah: these eight were the children of milcah and nahor, abraham's brother.
target_text: betuel èèna, ama nèti ribka.

source_text: and his servant reumah gave birth to tebah and gaham and tahash and maacah.
target_text: nahor abhu ana kahèi nèti bhèni piara na, ngara na reuma. ana reuma, nuka: teba, gaham, tahas, dènge maaka.

source_text: now the years of sarah's life were a hundred and twenty-seven. and sarah's death took place in kiriath-arba, that is, hebron, in the land of canaan: and abraham went into his house, weeping and sorrowing for sarah.
target_text: lod'o sara madhe, umur na ca ngasu dua nguru pidhu tèu le. lod'o na madhe èèna, abraham si pea ètu rae kiryat-arba nuka hebron, ètu rai kana'an. ka abraham beke aa tangi dhèu èmu na dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and abraham came from his dead and said to the children of heth,
target_text: hèia abraham kèd'i la'e paraga dènge dhèu-dhèu het. ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na,

source_text: i am living among you as one from a strange country: give me some land here as my property, so that i may put my dead to rest.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu tao mai ètu talora miu se. ja'a dhu dènge boe rai ca kasib'i sa, sèna ka padhane dhèu èmu ja'a. de ladhe miu sue ja'a, ja'a hèli kore rai miu d'ai ca kasib'i sa, ho tao era padhane ne.

source_text: and in answer the children of heth said to abraham,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na,

source_text: my lord, truly you are a great chief among us; take the best of our resting-places for your dead; not one of us will keep back from you a place where you may put your dead to rest.
target_text: sèmi ne'e, ama! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ji'i se tadhe le ama, dhu sama sèmi ca dhèu, dhèu heka dhu ji'i pakab'ua. de sad'i ama d'èi rai mia dhu be'a, dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi ama. ji'i se dhoka ngo'o di; dhèu èci sa dhu magee boe.

source_text: and abraham got up and gave honour to the children of heth, the people of that land.
target_text: hèia abraham pacud'u iisi ho hia hormat mi lamatua rai, dhèu het sèra.

source_text: and he said to them, if you will let me put my dead to rest here, make a request for me to ephron, the son of zohar,
target_text: ka na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe miu sèmi lii ja'a na, ja'a manèngi ho peka dènge ana mone sohar, dhu ngara na efron.

source_text: that he will give me the hollow in the rock named machpelah, which is his property at the end of his field; let him give it to me for its full price as a resting-place for my dead among you.
target_text: peka dènge ne, ladhe na d'èi, na pahia dènge ja'a loe na, makpela, dhu ètu karasa oka na. na manèngi ca ngaa èèna ka, ja'a tihe. ja'a neo tihe pama'ète kab'ua na, ètu madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka rai èèna j'aj'i unu ja'a. ja'a neo tao era èèna, j'aj'i mi ro'a dhèu madhe ji'i.

source_text: now ephron was seated among the children of heth: and ephron the hittite gave abraham his answer in the hearing of the children of heth, and of all those who came into his town, saying,
target_text: lod'o èèna, efron madhèdi ètu era èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu-dhèu het sèra. ka na tadèngi kahèi lii padhai lii abraham deo na. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na b'ala abraham ètu madha dhèu heka aa'i-aa'i ra ètu sèra, aku nèngu na,

source_text: no, my lord, i will give you the field with the hollow in the rock; before all the children of my people will i give it to you for a resting-place for your dead.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna, ama! sèmi ne'e ka laa! oka dènge loe makpela èèna, ja'a hia iia ama. sèna ka mu padhane dhèu èmu èu mi èèna. ja'a pangèd'u rai èèna mi ama, ètu madha dhèu-dhèu ja'a se. sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i sakasii!

source_text: and abraham went down on his face before the people of the land.
target_text: ka abraham pacud'u kètu hari mi dhèu het se.

source_text: and abraham said to ephron, in the hearing of the people of the land, if only you will give ear to me, i will give you the price of the field; take it, and let me put my dead to rest there.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge efron, aku nèngu na, sèmi èèna oo, be'a kahèi. te ngaa miu nanene lii ja'a, la ma. ja'a neo hèli pama'ète rai na, sèna ka j'aj'i era padhane dhèu-dhèu ja'a.

source_text: so ephron said to abraham, my lord, give ear to me: the value of the land is four hundred shekels; what is that between me and you? so put your dead to rest there.
target_text: hèia, aku efron na, rai èèna, kab'ua na, dhoka èpa ngasu doi pudhi di. guna ngaa èdhi dua ti padhue kab'ua rai ciki oo'e èèna, dhu sasoa na aad'o. de lamu ka, ho mèti dhèu madhe na, sèna ka padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and abraham took note of the price fixed by ephron in the hearing of the children of heth, and gave him four hundred shekels in current money.
target_text: ka abraham d'èi kahèi dènge kab'ua na sange èèna, madhutu sèmi lii efron. hèia ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, na ige nare doi pudhi èpa ngasu, tihe kab'ua rai èèna mi efron.

source_text: so ephron's field at machpelah near mamre, with the hollow in the rock and all the trees in the field and round it, became the property of abraham before the eyes of the children of heth and of all who came into the town. then abraham put sarah his wife to rest in the hollow rock in the field of machpelah near mamre, that is, hebron in the land of canaan.
target_text: de dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, abraham abhu dènge rai ne nèti efron, j'aj'i mi unu na. rai na nuka ètu makpela, padètu dènge mamre nuka hebron. na hèli pama'ète rai ne dènge oka na, dènge loe na, aa dènge aj'u aa'i-aa'i ra. dhèu-dhèu heka nèti suku het, aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, rai èèna dènge isi aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i le unu abraham. èle èèna ka, abraham la'e padhane sara ètu d'ara loe èèna, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and the field and the hollow rock were handed over to abraham as his property by the children of heth.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhu uru èèna oka dènge loe na unu dhèu het, limuri ne j'aj'i le rai unu abraham. ka na tao j'aj'i mi era udhu rui ra.

source_text: now abraham was old and far on in years: and the lord had given him everything in full measure.
target_text: tèu-tèu mamuri abraham madhera titu kèna. lamatua ladhe-leru ne dènge be'a, aa hia ne mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: and abraham said to his chief servant, the manager of all his property, come now, put your hand under my leg: and take an oath by the lord, the god of heaven and the god of the earth, that you will not get a wife for my son isaac from the daughters of the canaanites among whom i am living;
target_text: abraham dhu dènge dhèu èci dhu na lèka ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na. ca lod'o, abraham paroa nare, ka peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mu pasa dhilu èu paie-iie! ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu subha madhe dènge kolongara lamatua. nèngu ka, ama lamatua dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. dhu peka na, èu bisa boe more ana bhèni nèti dhèu kana'an, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a isak.

source_text: but that you will go into my country and to my relations and get a wife there for my son isaac.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i lamu ku asa rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa a'ari ja'a. ho tenge ètu rèngu sèi, ana bhèni ca dhèu, ho mu paleo dènge ana ja'a ne.

source_text: and the servant said, if by chance the woman will not come with me into this land, am i to take your son back again to the land from which you came?
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne karèi abraham, aku nèngu na, be'a, ama! te ngaa, sèmi ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, na tasamia? ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i ja'a kèti ana ama ku, ho hia ne leo-èmu ètu nèi, do tasamia?

source_text: and abraham said, take care that you do not let my son go back to that land.
target_text: hèia, aku abraham na, èu nanene paie! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, mage èu mèti ana ja'a ne, asa nèi kahèi!

source_text: the lord god of heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my birth, and made an oath to me, saying, to your seed i will give this land: he will send his angel before you and give you a wife for my son in that land.
target_text: mu sanèd'e, te lamatua dhu nèd'u koasa ètu dedha-liru, ka dhu lere ja'a nèti rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa dedha-rai ne'e ne. aa dhu na pa'èki le lii pajaji dènge ja'a, dhu peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne aa'i-aa'i mi ana-èpu èu. ' de èu baku madha'u. sad'i lamu. te èèna na, lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu paraga dènge ana bhèni, dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: and if the woman will not come with you, then you are free from this oath; only do not take my son back there.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, lii soo-subha ne lèke boe èu. masi ka tasamia na, èu bisa boe mèti ana ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: and the servant put his hand under abraham's leg, and gave him his oath about this thing.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne, ded'e subha dènge abraham, ka na peka, èèna na, nèngu tao madhutu dad'èi abraham aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the servant took ten of his master's camels, and all sorts of good things of his master's, and went to mesopotamia, to the town of nahor.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna pili nare badha onta canguru ngi'u. hèia na hua rupa-rupa mèdha dhu kab'ua asa dedha onta se. hèia la'e ka asa kota nahor, ètu rai mesopotamia.

source_text: and he made the camels take their rest outside the town by the water-spring in the evening, at the time when the women came to get water.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka mone ne d'ai kota èèna. hèia na ae kabhèsu dènge onta sèra ètu sebhe kota èèna, dètu dènge madha èi èci. na ae èèna d'ara lod'o nihia le, ropa ana bhèni-ana bhèni kota èèna mai rara èi ètu madha èi èèna.

source_text: and he said, o lord, the god of my master abraham, let me do well in what i have undertaken this day, and give your mercy to my master abraham.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne sabaj'a, peka na, lamatua, èu ka dhu j'aj'i ama lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a, abraham. bhoke j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka kakako ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. pad'elo sasue èu mi lamatua ja'a, aa baku bhèlu lii pajaji ne dènge ja'a. de hia la ja'a paraga dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: see, i am waiting here by the water-spring; and the daughters of the town are coming out to get water:
target_text: lamatua, ja'a ka titu ètu karasa madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti kota ne, mai rara èi ètu ne'e.

source_text: now, may the girl to whom i say, let down your vessel and give me a drink, and who says in answer, here is a drink for you and let me give water to your camels: may she be the one marked out by you for your servant isaac: so may i be certain that you have been good to my master abraham.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge ana bhèni èci, peka na, ‘ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu hia ja'a kinu. ' ho ladhe na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama, minu la! aa, pe ja'a hia dènge onta ama, rinu hèi! ' j'ara ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, ana bhèni ne ka dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u, j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu isak! dènge tadha sèmi ne'e, ja'a ke'a na lamatua pad'elo le babe'a mi abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna.

source_text: and even before his words were ended, rebekah, the daughter of bethuel, the son of milcah, who was the wife of nahor, abraham's brother, came out with her water-vessel on her arm. she was a very beautiful girl, a virgin, who had never been touched by a man: and she went down to the spring to get water in her vessel.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a nare mèka, ana bhèni ca dhèu mai. ngara na ribka. nèngu ne, èpu nèti ari abraham, nuka nahor, dènge dhèu èmu na, milka. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ribka ne, bhèni iia nia boe, aa pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge mone. d'ai era èèna, puru asa d'ara èi la'e, ka na isi èru èi na. nèbhu boe, ka ca'e mai sa dedha.

source_text: and the servant came running to her and said, give me a little water from your vessel.
target_text: ropa nare dedha, ka dhèu sab'a abraham èèna, la'e padètu dènge ne. hèia na manèngi, peka na, ana. hia ku ja'a kinu ciki.

source_text: and she said, take a drink, my lord: and quickly letting down her vessel onto her hand, she gave him a drink.
target_text: ka na dhaa, minu la, ama! hèia na papuru ka èru èi na, ka na hia dhèu ne ninu.

source_text: and having done so, she said, i will get water for your camels till they have had enough.
target_text: ropa ninu èle, ka ana bhèni ne peka na, pe ja'a laku dhui hari èi, sèna ka hia onta ama se, rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and after putting the water from her vessel into the animals' drinking-place, she went quickly back to the spring and got water for all the camels.
target_text: ka la'e bhori èi dhu risi, asa d'ara karab'a badha. hèia na ca'e-la'e mai pèri-pèri hari, dhui èi, ho hia onta se rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and the man, looking at her, said nothing, waiting to see if the lord had given his journey a good outcome.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a abraham, titu ka mau-mau, na taru kira ka ana bhèni ne sab'a. ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ele boe nèngu èèna ka ne'e, dhu lamatua paj'uj'u.

source_text: and when the camels had had enough, the man took a gold nose-ring, half a shekel in weight, and two ornaments for her arms of ten shekels weight of gold;
target_text: onta se rinu toke bècu. hèia dhèu ne nare kadheli sahènga, dènge kanau ca pasa. mèdha se dhu tao nèti hualaa. ka na pasa mi sahènga dènge pasaluu mi ai kariu dènge g'ana ana bhèni ne.

source_text: and said to her, whose daughter are you? is there room in your father's house for us?
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ne karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ama mu, ngara na cee? ladhe mo'o, na ja'a manubha taha ètu èmu ama mu.

source_text: and she said to him, i am the daughter of bethuel, the son of milcah, nahor's wife.
target_text: hèia na dhaa, ngara ama ku, na betuel. aa ngara baki ku, nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka.

source_text: and she said, we have a great store of dry grass and cattle-food, and there is room for you.
target_text: ètu èmu ji'i, era j'unu ae, de d'ai miu j'unu. aa j'u'u ae kahèi, ho hia badha miu se ra'a.

source_text: and with bent head the man gave worship to the lord;
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne pahaha iisi ho mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and said, praise be to the lord, the god of my master abraham, who has given a sign that he is good and true to my master, by guiding me straight to the house of my master's family.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, ka ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu kabarai ne'e. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi lamatua ja'a, abraham, aa tao madhutu sama sèmi lii pajaji na dènge ja'a.

source_text: so the girl went running and took the news of these things to her mother's house
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana bhèni ne rai la'e asa èmu, na lolo dènge isi èmu na ngaa dhu j'aj'i le èèna.

source_text: now rebekah had a brother named laban, and he came out quickly to the man at the water-spring. and when he saw the nose-ring and the ornaments on his sister's hands, and when she gave him word of what the man had said to her, then he went out to the man who was waiting with the camels by the water-spring.
target_text: ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. ropa laban ladhe nèdhi mèdha hualaa se, aa na tadèngi lii lolo ana hèni na, ka rai asa li'u la'e. la'e soru dhèu sab'a abraham dhu titu era dènge onta ra ètu madha èi.

source_text: and he said to him, come in, you on whom is the blessing of the lord; why are you waiting outside? for i have made the house ready for you, and a place for the camels.
target_text: hèia laban peka, aku nèngu na, ama! lamatua ka dhu lere miu mai dènge karej'e-karae d'ai ne'e. de baku titu mi li'u ne! mai lati sa èmu ji'i, te ji'i lalau ngare le kama. nganga'a hia badha se, dhu tesa.

source_text: then the man came into the house, and laban took their cords off the camels and gave them dry grass and food, and he gave to him and the men who were with him water for washing their feet.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a abraham ne, madhutu dènge ka laban, lasi èmu betuel. ka laban si papuru mèdha-panyau nèti dedha onta se. èle èèna ka, ra panga'a onta se. rèti èi, hia dhèu sab'a dènge anga na se, ho rase haga.

source_text: and meat was put before him, but he said, i will not take food till i have made my business clear to you. and they said, do so.
target_text: ropa lalau rare nganga'a-nginu ètu dedha mei, dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ji'i neo nga'a ne, te ngaa ja'a lole uuru ku, mamai ja'a ne. ka laban dhaa, peka na, ama, mu padhai lii ngaa, na peka ka laa.

source_text: and he said, i am abraham's servant.
target_text: hèia dhèu èèna peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu sab'a nèti baki miu abraham.

source_text: the lord has given my master every blessing, and he has become great: he has given him flocks and herds and silver and gold, and men-servants and women-servants and camels and asses.
target_text: lamatua hia abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna, mèngi-nale ae titu kèna, ka na kaja-su'i. lamatua pala-bagi ne doi hualaa pudhi dènge hualaa iia; ènu dhèu bhèni dènge dhèu mone, dènge badha-manu ae-ae, sèmi: sapi, onta, keled'ei, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: and when sarah, my master's wife, was old, she gave birth to a son, to whom he has given all he has.
target_text: lod'o lamatua ja'a se, bhèni-mone d'ai heka ku, ka sara nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu aa'i pusaka ama na.

source_text: and my master made me take an oath, saying, do not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the canaanites among whom i am living;
target_text: ka abraham pua ja'a subha, peka na, ‘mage èu more ana bhèni kana'an kahèi, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a, isak.

source_text: but go to my father's house and to my relations for a wife for my son.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i more ana bhèni nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. '

source_text: and i said to my master, what if the woman will not come with me?
target_text: hèia ja'a karèi ne, aku ja'a na, ‘tasamia, ladhe ana bhèni ne, no'o boe madhutu ja'a mai sa ne'e? '

source_text: and he said, the lord, whom i have ever kept before me, will send his angel with you, who will make it possible for you to get a wife for my son from my relations and my father's house;
target_text: ka na peka, ‘lamatua dhu ja'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na paleha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: and you will be free from your oath to me when you come to my people; and if they will not give her to you, you will be free from your oath.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'ari ja'a se'e ro'o boe ana bhèni na mai asa ne'e, lii subha na lèke boe mi dedha èu ne. '

source_text: and i came today to the water-spring, and i said, o lord, the god of my master abraham, if it is your purpose to give a good outcome to my journey,
target_text: ka deo na, ropa ja'a d'ai madha èi èèna, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara, peka na, ‘lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a abraham. bhoke ku j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka mamai ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. ho sèna ka ja'a abhu ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: let it come about that, while i am waiting here by the water-spring, if a girl comes to get water and i say to her, give me a little water from your vessel, and she says,
target_text: lamatua, ja'a titu ètu sebhe madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti d'ara kota ne mai rara èi ètu ne'e. de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a peka dènge ana bhèni èci, aku ja'a na, ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu, ho ja'a kinu èi ciki.

source_text: take a drink, and i will get water for your camels; let her be the woman marked out by the lord for my master's son.
target_text: ho ladhe na dhaa na, oo. minu! aa èle na, ja'a panginu badha ama se kahèi! ladhe j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii ja'a ne, na èèna ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, ana bhèni ne ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nare hia ana lamatua ja'a. '

source_text: and even while i was saying this to myself, rebekah came out with her vessel on her arm; and she went down to the spring to get water; and i said to her, give me a drink.
target_text: ja'a dhu dhae èle mèka manèngi-mangaj'i, te ribka dhu nare le era èèna nèti dènge èru èi na. ropa na ca'e mai nèti d'ara èi, ja'a lii dènge ne, aku ja'a na, ‘ana, ee! hia ku ja'a kinu èi ciki. '

source_text: and straight away she took down her vessel from her arm, and said, take a drink, and i will get water for your camels.
target_text: ka na papuru dènge ka èru èi na, ka na peka, ‘oo. minu! aa pe ja'a panginu onta ama se kahèi. ' hèia ja'a kinu, aa onta ja'a se oo rinu kahèi.

source_text: and questioning her, i said, whose daughter are you? and she said, the daughter of bethuel, the son of nahor, and milcah his wife. then i put the ring on her nose and the ornaments on her hands.
target_text: ka ja'a karèi ne, ‘ama mu, ngara na cee? ' ka na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama ku, ngara na betuel. aa baki ku, ngara na nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka. ' hèia ja'a papake ne kadheli mi sahènga na, dènge pasaluu kanau hualaa ca pasa mi ai kariu dènge ai g'ana na.

source_text: and with bent head i gave worship and praise to the lord, the god of my master abraham, by whom i had been guided in the right way, to get the daughter of my master's brother for his son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a pacud'u kètu ho mangaj'i mi lamatua, ka ja'a peka na, ‘koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu era ne'e ne. aa paraga le kahèi dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak! '

source_text: and now, say if you will do what is good and right for my master or not, in order that it may be clear to me what i have to do.
target_text: de ne'e ne, ladhe ama si neo pad'elo sasue mi lamatua ja'a abraham, na mi peka pamèu dènge ja'a. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, peka la mola-mola dènge ja'a. ho ja'a ke'a, sèna ka tao hari ngaa.

source_text: then laban and bethuel said in answer, this is the lord's doing: it is not for us to say yes or no to you.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii nare, ka laban dènge betuel dhaa, aku rèngu na, ladhe lamatua dhu ad'u nare le madha j'ara ne, ji'i peka lii ngaa hari.

source_text: see, here is rebekah: take her and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as the lord has said.
target_text: ribka ka ne'e ne. more ho mèti, sèna ka na j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana abraham, madhutu sèmi dhu lamatua ator èèna.

source_text: and at these words, abraham's servant went down on his face and gave praise to the lord.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: then he took jewels of silver and jewels of gold and fair robes and gave them to rebekah: and he gave things of value to her mother and her brother.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nare mèdha nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi sèra, dènge mèdha-papake dhu saraga, ka na hia mi ribka. aa na hia kahèi mi ana mone na dènge ina na, mèdha-mèdha dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: then he and the men who were with him had food and drink, and took their rest there that night; and in the morning he got up, and said, let me now go back to my master.
target_text: èle aa'i ka, heka dhèu sab'a ne dènge anga na madhèdi ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra j'unu ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu sab'a ne palangu lii dènge lamatua èmu se, aku nèngu na, hia ka ja'a ho lèpa la asa lamatua ja'a abraham.

source_text: but her brother and her mother said, let the girl be with us a week or ten days, and then she may go.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: and he said, do not keep me; the lord has given a good outcome to my journey; let me now go back to my master.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: and they said, we will send for the girl, and let her make the decision.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: and they sent for rebekah and said to her, are you ready to go with this man? and she said, i am ready.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: so they sent their sister rebekah and her servant with abraham's servant and his men. and they gave rebekah their blessing, saying, o sister, may you be the mother of thousands and ten thousands; and may your seed overcome all those who make war against them.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: so rebekah and her servant-women went with the man, seated on the camels; and so the servant took rebekah and went on his way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: now isaac had come through the waste land to beer-lahai-roi; for he was living in the south.
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: and when the evening was near, he went wandering out into the fields, and lifting up his eyes he saw camels coming.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: and when rebekah, looking up, saw isaac, she got down from her camel,
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.
