source_text: and said to the servant, who is that man coming to us through the field? and the servant said, it is my master: then she took her veil, covering her face with it.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: then the servant gave isaac the story of all he had done.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: and isaac took rebekah into his tent and she became his wife; and in his love for her, isaac was comforted after his father's death.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: and abraham took another wife named keturah.
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: she became the mother of zimran and jokshan and medan and midian and ishbak and shuah.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: and jokshan became the father of sheba and dedan. and from dedan came the asshurim and letushim and leummim.
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: and from midian came ephah and epher and hanoch and abida and eldaah. all these were the offspring of keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: now abraham gave all his property to isaac; but to the sons of his other women he gave offerings, and sent them away, while he was still living, into the east country.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: now the years of abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five. and abraham came to his death, an old man, full of years; and he was put to rest with his people.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: and isaac and ishmael, his sons, put him to rest in the hollow rock of machpelah, in the field of ephron, the son of zohar the hittite, near mamre; the same field which abraham got from the children of heth: there abraham was put to rest with sarah, his wife.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: now after the death of abraham, the blessing of god was with isaac, his son.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: now these are the generations of ishmael, the son of abraham, whose mother was hagar the egyptian, the servant of sarah:
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: these are the names of the sons of ishmael by their generations: ishmael's first son was nebaioth; then kedar and adbeel and mibsam and mishma and dumah and massa, hadad and tema, jetur, naphish, and kedemah: these are the sons of ishmael, and these are their names in their towns and their tent-circles; twelve chiefs with their peoples.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: and the years of ishmael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven: and he came to his end, and was put to rest with his people.
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: and their country was from havilah to shur which is east of egypt: they took their place to the east of all their brothers.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: now these are the generations of abraham's son isaac:
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: isaac was forty years old when he took rebekah, the daughter of bethuel the aramaean of paddan-aram, and the sister of laban the aramaean, to be his wife.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: isaac made prayer to the lord for his wife because she had no children; and the lord gave ear to his prayer, and rebekah became with child.
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: and the children were fighting together inside her, and she said, if it is to be so, why am i like this? so she went to put her question to the lord.
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: and the lord said to her, two nations are in your body, and two peoples will come to birth from you: the one will be stronger than the other, and the older will be the servant of the younger.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: and when the time came for her to give birth, there were two children in her body.
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and the first came out red from head to foot like a robe of hair, and they gave him the name of esau.
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: and after him, his brother came out, gripping esau's foot; and he was named jacob: isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: and the boys came to full growth; and esau became a man of the open country, an expert bowman; but jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: now isaac's love was for esau, because esau's meat was greatly to his taste: but rebekah had more love for jacob.
target_text: isak d'èi na'a sisi badha hui. nèti èèna ka, na sue risi esau. te ngaa ribka sue risi yakob.

source_text: and one day jacob was cooking some soup when esau came in from the fields in great need of food;
target_text: ca lod'o, yakob dhu tao bubur kab'ui, aa esau heka lèpa nèti kasiro badha hui kèna. na lèpa dènge manganga, ka roe titu kèna.

source_text: and esau said to jacob, give me a full meal of that red soup, for i am overcome with need for food: for this reason he was named edom.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ari, ee! hia ku ja'a bubur kab'ui mea ciki ètu d'ara èru èèna, ho ja'a ku'a! te ja'a manganga bia. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare na, edom, dhu sasoa na ‘mea'.

source_text: and jacob said, first of all give me your birthright.
target_text: ka, aku yakob na, be'a a'a. te ngaa pasilu ku dènge hak a'a èèna!

source_text: and esau said, truly, i am at the point of death: what profit is the birthright to me?
target_text: hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, hak a'a ne, ngaa kèna, hud'i nèngu sèna! neo more, na more la. te ja'a manganga bia. sod'e mèti bubur èèna lai-lai mai, te ja'a taha heka.

source_text: and jacob said, first of all give me your oath; and he gave him his oath, handing over his birthright to jacob.
target_text: te ngaa, aku yakob hari na, mata ku a'a! èu subha uuru ku, dhu peka na, èu pangèd'u le hak a'a èèna mi ja'a ne. ka esau ded'e subha sèmi dhu yakob peka.

source_text: then jacob gave him bread and soup; and he took food and drink and went away, caring little for his birthright.
target_text: hèia yakob sod'e dènge ka hia ne bubur kab'ui deo na dènge roti. ropa na'a-ninu nare, ka la'e dènge ka. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, esau pusi boe dènge hak a'a na.

source_text: then came a time of great need in the land, like that which had been before in the days of abraham. and isaac went to abimelech, king of the philistines, at gerar.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara rai èèna, lèke tèu manganga, èci èèna ka dènge tèu abraham mamuri era. ka isak la'e manèngi abimelek, dhèu aae pilistin, sèna ka na pea ètu gerar.

source_text: and the lord came to him in a vision and said, do not go down to egypt; keep in the land of which i will give you knowledge:
target_text: na tao sèmi èèna, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le iisi na mi nèngu, peka na, mage lamu ka asa masir hèi. pea la mi era dhu èèna na ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu.

source_text: keep in this land, and i will be with you and give you my blessing; for to you and to your seed will i give all these lands, giving effect to the oath which i made to your father abraham; i will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and will give them all these lands, and your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth;
target_text: ladhe èu manubha ètu era èèna, ja'a sama-sama dènge èu, aa pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. èèna na, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru. aa ja'a hia kateme rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a tao madhutu lii pajaji dhu ja'a pa'èki le dènge ama mu abraham.

source_text: because abraham gave ear to my voice and kept my words, my rules, my orders, and my laws.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi ne'e ne, lula ama mu madhutu dad'èi ja'a, paredha ja'a, dènge atora ja'a.

source_text: so isaac went on living in gerar;
target_text: ka isak pea taha ètu gerar.

source_text: and when he was questioned by the men of the place about his wife, he said, she is my sister; fearing to say, she is my wife; for, he said, the men of the place may put me to death on account of rebekah; because she is very beautiful.
target_text: ribka ne, bhèni iia titu kèna. ka ropa dhèu ètu gerar ladhe rèdhi ne, ra pakarèi. te ngaa isak peka na, ribka ne, ana hèni ja'a. na madha'u, ladhe na peka na dhèu èmu nèngu, dhèu se pamadhe ne, aa ribka parame rare.

source_text: and when he had been there for some time, abimelech, king of the philistines, looking through a window, saw isaac playing with rebekah his wife.
target_text: isak dhu pea nèbhu le ètu nèi, hèia ca lod'o, dhèu aae nèdhi nèti ro'a jendela na, ladhe laa na isak dènge ribka dhu pa'ango.

source_text: and he said to isaac, it is clear that she is your wife: why then did you say, she is my sister? and isaac said, for fear that i might be put to death because of her.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu lasi paroa isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a dhu ke'a le, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu! te ngaa tasamia ka, èu peka na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu? hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ama! ja'a ne madha'u, ladhe ja'a peka na nèngu ne dhèu èmu ja'a, mage dhoka dhèu pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: then abimelech said, what have you done to us? one of the people might well have had connection with your wife, and the sin would have been ours.
target_text: ka dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, sèmi dhèu ètu se'e j'unu dènge dhèu èmu èu, tatu èu pasala ji'i! tasamia ka, èu ad'u j'ara ne'e mi dedha ji'i se?

source_text: and abimelech gave orders to his people that anyone touching isaac or his wife was to be put to death.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pasanèd'e ana kabarai na, aku nèngu na, miu nanene paie-iie! cee ka dhu bani gagu dhèu ne'e, do dhèu èmu na, èèna na ja'a huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: now isaac, planting seed in that land, got in the same year fruit a hundred times as much, for the blessing of the lord was on him.
target_text: tèu èèna, isak sèle hini ètu dedha rai dhèu se'e. lod'o d'ai puu-g'ètu, ka na abhu isi rai cangasu hari, lula lamatua hia ne mamèngi.

source_text: and his wealth became very great, increasing more and more;
target_text: lula mèdha-panyau na asa ae, ka na kaja titu kèna.

source_text: for he had great wealth of flocks and herds and great numbers of servants; so that the philistines were full of envy.
target_text: badha-manu na sèmi sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho asa tabha ae. dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pilistin tèka d'ara dènge ne.

source_text: now all the water-holes, which his father's servants had made in the days of abraham, had been stopped up with earth by the philistines.
target_text: uru èèna, abraham, ama isak, dhu kèi èi ae-ae. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si dènge rai.

source_text: and abimelech said to isaac, go away from us, for you are stronger than we are.
target_text: ka dhèu aae abimelek peka dènge isak, aku nèngu na, isak! be'a risi èu pakèd'i ka nèti kabarai ne'e. lula koasa èu, risi eele le nèti ji'i se.

source_text: so isaac went away from there, and put up his tents in the valley of gerar, making his living-place there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak pakèd'i nèti era èèna, ka lasi pea hari ètu d'ara mamoo gerar.

source_text: and he made again the water-holes which had been made in the days of abraham his father, and which had been stopped up by the philistines; and he gave them the names which his father had given them.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra kèi hari madha èi dhu uru èèna, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si. ka na pangare madha èi se madhutu ngara dhu ama na pangare.

source_text: now isaac's servants made holes in the valley, and came to a spring of flowing water.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a isak se kèi èi ètu d'ara mamoo gerar, hèi lèke èi madha dhu sabhoka mai.

source_text: but the herdmen of gerar had a fight with isaac's herdmen, for they said, the spring is ours: so he gave the spring the name of esek, because there was a fight about it.
target_text: lula madha èi ne'e ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenge badha nèti gerar, patao dènge dhèu madhenge badha isak. dhèu se peka na, ne'e ne, madha èi ji'i! nèti èèna ka, isak pangare madha èi na esek, dhu sasoa na ‘patao-palaha'.

source_text: then they made another water-hole, and there was a fight about that, so he gave it the name of sitnah.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu isak se, kèi hari èi leo ca madha. te ngaa ra patao-palaha hari, lula èi èèna. nèti èèna ka, isak pangare na sitna, dhu sasoa na ‘palab'a'.

source_text: then he went away from there, and made another water-hole, about which there was no fighting: so he gave it the name of rehoboth, for he said, now the lord has made room for us, and we will have fruit in this land.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tèke eele era èèna, la'e kèi hari èi èci. d'ai ne'e ne, ra patao-palaha heka. ka isak pangare madha èi ne rehobot, dhu sasoa na ‘era taleo'. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, lamatua hia le èdhi pea ètu era taleo. ho ètu era ne'e ne, èdhi asa bèba-kacanga.

source_text: and from there he went on to beer-sheba.
target_text: ka nèti era ne'e, isak si lasi hari era pea asa beer syeba.

source_text: that night the lord came to him in a vision, and said, i am the god of your father abraham: have no fear for i am with you, blessing you, and your seed will be increased because of my servant abraham.
target_text: ka mèda na, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti ama mu abraham. de mage mu madha'u, te ja'a ladhe-leru èu. èèna na, ja'a pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale. aa ana-èpu èu asa bèba-kacanga. ja'a ad'u madha j'ara ne'e, lula lii pajaji ja'a dènge ama mu.

source_text: then he made an altar there, and gave worship to the name of the lord, and he put up his tents there, and there his servants made a water-hole.
target_text: hèia isak pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban ètu èèna. ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. hèia, na pea ètu era èèna, ka dhèu sab'a na kèi hari èi.

source_text: and abimelech had come to him from gerar, with ahuzzath his friend and phicol, the captain of his army.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek mai nèti gerar. angalai na ahusat, dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai dènge ne, ho paraga dènge isak.

source_text: and isaac said to them, why have you come to me, seeing that in your hate for me you sent me away from you?
target_text: ka isak karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! uru èèna, miu se dhu babège eele ja'a nèti kabarai miu. de ne'e ne, miu se mai tao ngaa hari?

source_text: and they said, we saw clearly that the lord was with you: so we said, let there be an oath between us and you, and let us make an agreement with you;
target_text: hèia ra peka na, sèmi ne'e. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua dhu j'aga pa'ère èu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pangee, hua iia èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji dhu peka sèmi ne'e: èu j'oka subha, peka na,

source_text: that you will do us no damage, even as we put no hand on you, and did you nothing but good, and sent you away in peace: and now the blessing of the lord is on you.
target_text: miu se baku tao karehe dènge ji'i, aa ji'i kahèi baku tao karehe dènge miu. mema ji'i se d'ara be'a dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, ca hari ni, miu se lami dènge mera-milu nèti kabarai ji'i ne. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale mi miu.

source_text: then he made a feast for them, and they all had food and drink.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tao pesta, ka ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and early in the morning they took an oath one to the other: then isaac sent them away and they went on their way in peace.
target_text: ka asa bèli mad'ae èèna, rèngu j'oka lii soo-subha. hèia isak patalala si lèpa dènge dame.

source_text: and that day isaac's servants came to him and gave him word of the water-hole which they had made, and said to him, we have come to water.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu sab'a isak mai peka lula-nèti èi dhu rèngu kèi, na, ama! ji'i rage le èi.

source_text: and he gave it the name of shibah: so the name of that town is beer-sheba to this day.
target_text: hèia isak pangare madha èi ne syeba dhu sasoa na ‘subha'. ka ra pangare kota èèna beer syeba, toke sange ne'e.

source_text: and when esau was forty years old, he took as his wives judith, the daughter of beeri the hittite, and basemath, the daughter of elon the hittite:
target_text: ropa umur esau d'ai èpa nguru tèu, na leo dènge bhèni dhèu dua nèti suku het. bhèni èci, ana nèti beeri, ngara na yudit. èci hari, ana elon, ngara na basmat.

source_text: and isaac and rebekah had grief of mind because of them.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, papèd'a d'ara isak dènge ribka.

source_text: now when isaac was old and his eyes had become clouded so that he was not able to see, he sent for esau, his first son, and said to him, my son: and he said, here am i.
target_text: ropa isak manahu asa d'ara heka, nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa, lula musi madha na ahu le. ka na paroa ana uuru èèna, dhu na sue risi èèna, peka na, esau. mai ku sa ne'e! hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama?

source_text: and he said, see now, i am old, and my death may take place at any time:
target_text: ka isak peka hari, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne, ètu d'ara heka le. ke'a boe, pèri lod'o ja'a ne madhe.

source_text: so take your arrows and your bow and go out to the field and get meat for me;
target_text: de more rèka èu, lamu kataki mèti badha hui ci'u hia ja'a.

source_text: and make me food, good to the taste, such as is pleasing to me, and put it before me, so that i may have a meal and give you my blessing before death comes to me.
target_text: mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a, madhutu dad'èi ja'a, ho mèti mai hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia mema èu mèngi-nale. sad'i èu unu le mèngi-nale èèna, ja'a madhe èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: now isaac's words to his son were said in rebekah's hearing. then esau went out to get the meat.
target_text: hèia esau la'e dènge ka, kataki badha hui. te ngaa ribka dhu tadèngi kahèi lii padhai isak deo na.

source_text: and rebekah said to jacob, her son, your father said to your brother esau in my hearing,
target_text: ka ribka la'e peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, yakob! èu nanene ku! deo na, ja'a tadèngi ama mu pua esau sèmi ne'e:

source_text: go and get some roe's meat and make me a good meal, so that i may be full, and give you my blessing before the lord before my death.
target_text: ‘lamu kataki more ku badha hui ci'u, mai mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale ètu katanga madha lamatua. '

source_text: now, my son, do what i say.
target_text: de mu nanene paie-iie! mu madhutu mola-mola lii paredha ja'a ne.

source_text: go to the flock and get me two fat young goats; and i will make of them a meal to your father's taste:
target_text: de lamu ka asa era badha èdhi sèi, ho kèpe more kalèbho èni dhu kabèb'u dua ngi'u. roro ho mèti sisi mai asa ja'a. pe ja'a pananasu madhutu dad'èi ama mu.

source_text: and you will take it to him, so that he may have a good meal and give you his blessing before his death.
target_text: ladhe panasu kore, mèti hia ama mu na'a. ho èle na, na hia èu mèngi-nale, heka na madhe kèna. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, èu ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale èèna. a'a mu abhu boe.

source_text: and jacob said to rebekah, his mother, but esau my brother is covered with hair, while i am smooth:
target_text: te ngaa yakob peka dènge ina na, ina! a'a ku esau, ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge rèu, te ngaa ja'a ne, isi dhu milu aadha-aadha!

source_text: if by chance my father puts his hand on me, it will seem to him that i am tricking him, and he will put a curse on me in place of a blessing.
target_text: mage dhoka ama ku g'ag'e isi ja'a, ladhe na ne'a na ja'a dhu leko-monya na. hèia na dhoo ja'a!

source_text: and his mother said, let the curse be on me, my son: only do as i say, and go and get them for me.
target_text: ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, èu baku cag'ag'a! hud'i laa ina ka dhu ator! ladhe ama mu dhoo èu, pe ina ka pasae! mu mate ia ka, la more ka kahib'i sèra.

source_text: so he went and got them and took them to his mother: and she made a meal to his father's taste.
target_text: ka yakob la'e nare kahib'i dua ngi'u sèra, hèia na roro, ka nèti hia ina na. hèia ribka pananasu madhutu dad'èi isak.

source_text: and rebekah took the fair robes of her oldest son, which were with her in the house, and put them on jacob, her younger son:
target_text: ka ribka la'e nare mèdha-papake esau dhu be'a, ho na papake mi yakob.

source_text: and she put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck:
target_text: hèia na pahutu kahèi kacui-aai dènge ladhe goro yakob, pake ka'uri kahib'i deo sa.

source_text: and she gave into the hand of jacob, her son, the meat and the bread which she had made ready.
target_text: ka na pangèd'u yakob nganga'a dhu pananasu nare deo na, dènge roti dhu tunu nare.

source_text: and he came to his father, and said, my father: and he said, here am i: who are you, my son?
target_text: hèia yakob ded'e nèti nganga'a se'e, hia ama na na'a. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama. ja'a mai hari le. hèia isak dhaa, peka na, hee! èu ne, cee?

source_text: and jacob said, i am esau, your oldest son; i have done as you said: come now, be seated and take of my meat, so that you may give me a blessing.
target_text: ka yakob dhaa, peka na, ja'a, esau ana mone uuru ama ku! ja'a sab'e le, madhutu sèmi dhu ama pua deo na. kèd'i, ho mu'a-minu ka. lula ja'a pananasu kore le sisi badha hui dhu ja'a kèti nèti d'ara j'ami. mu'a, ho èle na, ama pala-bagi ja'a mèngi-nale.

source_text: and isaac said, how is it that you have got it so quickly, my son? and he said, because the lord your god made it come my way.
target_text: hèia isak peka, aku nèngu na, èu ne, bia tai nga! abhu malai titu kèna, badha hui èèna! hèia yakob dhaa, ja'a abhu le, lula lamatua dhu èu mangaj'i èèna, ka dhu tulu ja'a.

source_text: and isaac said, come near so that i may put my hand on you, my son, and see if you are truly my son esau or not.
target_text: ka isak paroa yakob, aku nèngu na, padètu ku asa ne'e mai, sèna ka ja'a g'ag'e sèku èu. èu ne, tare'a ana ja'a esau, do aad'o?

source_text: and jacob went near his father isaac: and he put his hands on him; and he said, the voice is jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of esau.
target_text: hèia yakob la'e padètu-dètu dènge ama na, ka ama na g'ag'e ne. ka isak peka, lii ne, sèmi lii yakob! te ngaa kacui-aai na, kacui-aai esau.

source_text: and he did not make out who he was, because his hands were covered with hair like his brother esau's hands: so he gave him a blessing.
target_text: te ngaa isak dhu tadhe iia boe yakob, lula kacui-aai na rèu sèmi esau. ka ropa na neo hia mèngi-nale mi yakob,

source_text: and he said, are you truly my son esau? and he said, i am.
target_text: na karèi hari era, aku nèngu na, èu ne, tare'a-re'a esau, do? hèia yakob dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a ama. ja'a ne, esau!

source_text: and he said, put it before me and i will take of my son's meat, so that i may give you a blessing. and he put it before him and he took it; and he gave him wine, and he had a drink.
target_text: ka isak peka na, na, j'ole ka sisina mai, sèna ka ja'a ku'a. èle ku, pe ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale. hèia yakob hia sisi dènge èi anggor hia ama na na'a-ninu.

source_text: and his father isaac said to him, come near now, my son, and give me a kiss.
target_text: na'a nare ka, isak lii, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai padètu asa ne'e, ho mu uu ku ja'a laa.

source_text: and he came near and gave him a kiss; and smelling the smell of his clothing, he gave him a blessing, and said, see, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field on which the blessing of the lord has come:
target_text: ka ropa yakob padètu dènge ne, ho uu ne, isak sangèd'u nare hèu mèdha-papake esau. hèia na padhai lii hia mèngi-nale mi yakob, aku nèngu na, hèu ana ja'a tare'a-re'a sèmi hèu j'u'u ètu d'ara pad'a, dhu abhu mamèngi nèti lamatua.

source_text: may god give you the dew of heaven, and the good things of the earth, and grain and wine in full measure:
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua patiri èi paringi nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka oka-tedhe èu j'aj'i mi rai hèu mèngi. hud'i laa na hia èu are dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, dènge hua anggor dhu pènu ako-pènu èru.

source_text: let peoples be your servants, and nations go down before you: be lord over your brothers, and let your mother's sons go down before you: a curse be on everyone by whom you are cursed, and a blessing on those who give you a blessing.
target_text: suku-suku j'aj'i mi ènu èu, aa dhèu-dhèu leo pahaha iisi mi dedha èu. èu j'aj'i mi lamatua nèti a'ari èu. aa rèngu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha èu. dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu, rèngu abhu dhoo kahèi. aa dhèu cee dhu hia mèngi-nale mi èu, rèngu abhu mèngi-nale kahèi.

source_text: and when isaac had come to the end of blessing jacob, and jacob had not long gone away from isaac his father, esau came in from the field.
target_text: ropa isak hia nare mèngi-nale mi yakob, ka heka bhodho li'u la'e tèke eele ama na, cag'ag'a laa esau lèpa nèti kataki badha hui.

source_text: and he made ready a meal, good to the taste, and took it to his father, and said to him, let my father get up and take of his son's meat, so that you may give me a blessing.
target_text: hèia la'e pananasu, ka sod'e nèti hia ama na. ka na parèi ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, kèd'i mu'a. ja'a lalau kore le sisi badha dhu ja'a kataki kore. mu'a more ku, pe hia ja'a berkat.

source_text: and isaac his father said to him, who are you? and he said, i am your oldest son, esau.
target_text: te ngaa isak malaa, ka na karèi, hee! te èu ne, cee hari ne? hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e, esau! ana uuru ama ku.

source_text: and in great fear isaac said, who then is he who got meat and put it before me, and i took it all before you came, and gave him a blessing, and his it will be?
target_text: ka isak cag'ag'a, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, deo na cee ka dhu hia ja'a sisi, ka ja'a ku'a èèna? ka ja'a hia ne mèngi-nale. aa mèngi-nale èèna, bisa heka ère hari.

source_text: and hearing the words of his father, esau gave a great and bitter cry, and said to his father, give a blessing to me, even to me, o my father!
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, esau roe ai ca palèpa, ka na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, aku nèngu na, tasamia ne, ama, ee! bagi hia ja'a berkat hèi ma.

source_text: and he said, your brother came with deceit, and took away your blessing.
target_text: hèia isak peka, ari mu ka monya ja'a, ka parame nare berkat dhu pala èu di.

source_text: and he said, is it because he is named jacob that he has twice taken my place? for he took away my birthright, and now he has taken away my blessing. and he said, have you not kept a blessing for me?
target_text: ka aku esau na, nèngu na leko-monya ja'a dua hari kèna. uru èèna, parame nare hak a'a. ka ne'e ne, parame nare hari berkat dhu madhutu iia-iia na unu ja'a. nèka na, ngara na ‘yakob' te ngaa ele boe ama dhu dènge berkat era, ho hia ja'a. do, aad'o heka? yakob sasoa na ‘kèpe hui tèdhu', te ngaa sasoa dhu leo ‘tuka leko-monya'.

source_text: and isaac answering said, but i have made him your master, and have given him all his brothers for servants; i have made him strong with grain and wine: what then am i to do for you, my son?
target_text: hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu ded'e le nèngu, j'aj'i lamatua èu. aa a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra, j'aj'i mi ènu na. ja'a hia na le, unu are pènu soka-pènu karo, dènge hua anggor pènu ako-pènu èru. de ana, ee! mamèngi tasamia hari, dhu ja'a ne pala-bagi mi èu?

source_text: and esau said to his father, is that the only blessing you have, my father? give a blessing to me, even me! and esau was overcome with weeping.
target_text: masi ka tadèngi nare le sèmi èèna, te ngaa esau loe boe dènge pamako ama na, peka na, mamèngi na dhodhoka èci di, do? tatu ama dènge hari mamèngi dhu leo hia ja'a. masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ne abhu! ka esau tangi hari dènge d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: then isaac his father made answer and said to him, far from the fertile places of the earth, and far from the dew of heaven on high will your living-place be:
target_text: ka isak b'ala ne, peka na, mamuri èu ne, èèna na kaj'èu nèti oka-tedhe dhu hèu mèngi, lula èi paringi patiri boe nèti dedha-liru mai, ho pabasa rai èu.

source_text: by your sword will you get your living and you will be your brother's servant; but when your power is increased his yoke will be broken from off your neck.
target_text: èu ne, mamuri dhoka nèti samala èu di. aa tasa mera mia èèna ka, èu ne j'aj'i ènu ari mu. dhodhoka ladhe bèli-camèd'a, èu bani lab'a ne, èèna na èu heka rai eele nèti d'ara adhe-aai na.

source_text: so esau was full of hate for jacob because of his father's blessing; and he said in his heart, the days of weeping for my father are near; then i will put my brother jacob to death.
target_text: lula j'ara sèmi ne'e ne ka, esau tèke d'ara dènge ari na yakob, lula parame nare mamèngi na. ka esau pangee na, nèbhu heka, ama ku madhe. de hud'i laa, pe d'ai ku lod'o. ladhe èle beke, ja'a pamadhe ne!

source_text: then rebekah, hearing what esau had said, sent for jacob, her younger son, and said to him, it seems that your brother esau is purposing to put you to death. so now, my son, do what i say: go quickly to haran, to my brother laban;
target_text: ropa ribka tadèngi esau dhu neo ad'u j'ara karehe, ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, èu nanene ku lii ne! a'a mu neo b'ala d'ara pèd'a na, de na neo pamadhe èu. de be'a risi, èu ne rai lai-lai asa to'o mu laban, ètu kota haran.

source_text: and be there with him for a little time, till your brother's wrath is turned away;
target_text: lamu asa nèi, pea ako nèbhu, toke èle nanasa a'a mu.

source_text: till the memory of what you have done to him is past and he is no longer angry: then i will send word for you to come back; are the two of you to be taken from me in one day?
target_text: ladhe na bhèlu eele ku tatao èu ne, pe ja'a pua dhèu dhiu paroa èu, sèna ka èu lèpa hari mai. lula ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka ana ja'a dua-dua mi ele parènga d'ara ca lod'o èèna ka.

source_text: then rebekah said to isaac, my life is a weariness to me because of the daughters of heth: if jacob takes a wife from among the daughters of heth, such as these, the women of this land, of what use will my life be to me?
target_text: hèia ribka roma iisi dènge isak, peka na, ja'a ru'a le dènge dhèu èmu esau, dhèu het se! de ladhe yakob todhe nare hari kahèi ana bhèni nèti dhèu het se, hua iia ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: then isaac sent for jacob, and blessing him, said, do not take a wife from among the women of canaan;
target_text: hèia isak paroa nare yakob, ka hia ne mèngi-nale aa holo ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie! èu mage leo ka dènge ana bhèni kana'an hèi.

source_text: but go to paddan-aram, to the house of bethuel, your mother's father, and there get yourself a wife from the daughters of laban, your mother's brother.
target_text: de lamu ka asa padan aram, asa baki mu betuel. lamu madhèdi dènge ana bhèni to'o mu laban ca dhèu.

source_text: and may god, the ruler of all, give you his blessing, giving you fruit and increase, so that you may become an army of peoples.
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele na, hia èu mamèngi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu bèba-kacanga, ho nèti rèngu ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae dhu kapai.

source_text: and may god give you the blessing of abraham, to you and to your seed, so that the land of your wanderings, which god gave to abraham, may be your heritage.
target_text: hud'i laa, lii pajaji ama lamatua dènge abraham èèna, noto mi dedha èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu. sèna ka èu unu rai dhu ama lamatua jaji tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: so isaac sent jacob away: and he went to paddan-aram, to laban, son of bethuel the aramaean, the brother of rebekah, the mother of jacob and esau.
target_text: padhai lii nare, ka isak hia yakob la'e asa padan aram, asa èmu to'o na laban, dènge baki na betuel.

source_text: so when esau saw that isaac had given jacob his blessing, and sent him away to paddan-aram to get a wife for himself there, blessing him and saying to him, do not take a wife from among the women of canaan;
target_text: esau dhu tadèngi le kahèi, dhu peka na isak hia yakob mamèngi, aa kai ne sèna ka baku leo dènge bhèni kana'an. aa na tadèngi hèi, dhu isak hia yakob leo dènge ana bhèni to'o na laban ètu padan aram.

source_text: and that jacob had done as his father and mother said and had gone to paddan-aram;
target_text: ka yakob madhutu lii paredha ina dènge ama na, ka pakèd'i la'e asa padan aram.

source_text: it was clear to esau that his father had no love for the women of canaan,
target_text: aa esau dhu ne'a le kahèi, ama na d'èi boe dhèu èmu na, bhèni kana'an dua sèra.

source_text: so esau went to ishmael and took mahalath, the daughter of abraham's son ishmael, the sister of nebaioth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.
target_text: hèia na la'e asa ama aae na ismael, ka leo hari èmu dènge ana bhèni ismael ca dhèu, ngara na mahalat. mahalat ne, ana mone na ka nebayot.

source_text: so jacob went out from beer-sheba to go to haran.
target_text: ka yakob tèke eele beer syeba, la'e asa haran.

source_text: and coming to a certain place, he made it his resting-place for the night, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones which were there, and putting it under his head he went to sleep in that place.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, yakob d'ai era èci, ka na j'unu ètu era èèna. na neo j'unu, nare hadhu cue, tao lalaka kètu na.

source_text: and he had a dream, and in his dream he saw steps stretching from earth to heaven, and the angels of god were going up and down on them.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, na nii. na ladhe nèdhi langa èci dhu patitu ètu rai, suu na d'ai dedha-liru. ka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ca'e-puru ètu dedha langa èèna.

source_text: and he saw the lord by his side, saying, i am the lord, the god of abraham your father, and the god of isaac: i will give to you and to your seed this land on which you are sleeping.
target_text: ètu d'ara nii na, yakob ladhe nèdhi lamatua dhu titu ètu karasa nèngu, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne lamatua, ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak. èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: your seed will be like the dust of the earth, covering all the land to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south: you and your seed will be a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu ae-ae, sama sèmi ahu rai ne. rèngu se, èèna na, pea palème era-era ètu rai-haha ne. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale.

source_text: and truly, i will be with you, and will keep you wherever you go, guiding you back again to this land; and i will not give you up till i have done what i have said to you.
target_text: mage mu bhèlu! èu ne ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge èu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a lere kèti hari èu mai asa dedha-rai ne'e. ja'a bhera boe èu. aa èèna na, ja'a tao aa'i madhutu sèmi lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob, awaking from his sleep, said, truly, the lord is in this place and i was not conscious of it.
target_text: ropa yakob kèd'i nèti bhèj'i, na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, lamatua dhu ètu era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: and fear came on him, and he said, this is a holy place; this is nothing less than the house of god and the doorway of heaven.
target_text: na madha'u, ka na pangee, na, boo! era ne'e ne pamadha'u ja'a, nga. tatu èmu ama lamatua ètu era ne'e ne! aa era ne'e ne, j'aj'i hèb'a babèdho sorga.

source_text: and early in the morning jacob took the stone which had been under his head, and put it up as a pillar and put oil on it.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, yakob kèd'i le èèna. ka nare hadhu dhu na tao lalaka deo na. hèia na patitu j'aj'i mi tadha. ka na bhori èi mènyi asa dedha hadhu èèna, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he gave that place the name of beth-el, but before that time the town was named luz.
target_text: ka na pangare era ne betel, dhu sasoa na ‘èmu lamatua'. uru èèna, era ne ngara na lus.

source_text: then jacob took an oath, and said, if god will be with me, and keep me safe on my journey, and give me food and clothing to put on,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob ded'e subha, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama lamatua dhu dènge ja'a, aa j'aga ja'a ètu d'ara kakako ja'a ne, aa panga'e dènge papake ja'a,

source_text: so that i come again to my father's house in peace, then i will take the lord to be my god,
target_text: toke ja'a lèpa dènge sod'a, èèna na lamatua j'aj'i mi ama lamatua ja'a.

source_text: and this stone which i have put up for a pillar will be god's house: and of all you give me, i will give a tenth part to you.
target_text: hadhu dhu ja'a patitu ne, j'aj'i mi era sogo-tagu mi ama lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi ja'a, ja'a hia na ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: then jacob went on his journey till he came to the land of the children of the east.
target_text: hèia yakob kako hari ka asa bèka dhimu.

source_text: and there he saw a water-hole in a field, and by the side of it three flocks of sheep, for there they got water for the sheep: and on the mouth of the water-hole there was a great stone.
target_text: ca lod'o, ladhe nèdhi èi ca madha, dètu dènge rae cue. padètu-dètu dènge madha èi èèna, abhu tèlu kaboko kahib'i-kalèbho, dhu mate rinu èi. te ngaa hadhu aae cue dhu ra pasaguru mi hèb'a èi na.

source_text: and all the flocks would come together there, and when the stone had been rolled away, they would give the sheep water, and put the stone back again in its place on the mouth of the water-hole.
target_text: dhu tema le, ladhe kahib'i tesa aa'i-aa'i ra, ana-ana madhenga kahib'i se, lasi bhoke hadhu na, heka ra dhui kèna, panginu kahib'i si. panginu rare na, ra katange hari hadhu na la'e.

source_text: then jacob said to the herdmen, my brothers, where do you come from? and they said, from haran.
target_text: ka yakob kako la'e asa madha dhèu madhenge kahib'i se, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu mia? hèia ra dhaa, ji'i se, nèti rae haran ne'e.

source_text: and he said to them, have you any knowledge of laban, the son of nahor? and they said, we have.
target_text: ka yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu tadhe to'o ja'a, laban, do? nèngu na, ana nahor. ka ra dhaa, ji'i tadhe ne.

source_text: and he said to them, is he well? and they said, he is well, and here is rachel his daughter coming with the sheep.
target_text: hèia yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, na be'a-be'a, sina ma? ka ra peka, oo, na be'a-be'a. ladhe, ana bhèni na ka nèi. ngara na, rahel. nuka eo nèti kahib'i ama na mai sa ne'e, ho hia rinu ètu ne'e. mate ne.

source_text: then jacob said, the sun is still high and it is not time to get the cattle together: get water for the sheep and go and give them their food.
target_text: hèia yakob peka hari, loo nètu era. de be'a risi, badha mia ètu se'e le, panginu ka si. sèna ka lere mèti hari asa d'ara pad'a, ho ra'a hari j'u'u.

source_text: and they said, we are not able to do so till all the flocks have come together and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the water-hole; then we will get water for the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ra peka, we, j'ara na aad'o sèmi èèna! ji'i mate toke tesa aa'i ku, heka ji'i pakeso hadhu ne, heka panginu badha se kèna.

source_text: while he was still talking with them, rachel came with her father's sheep, for she took care of them.
target_text: yakob padhai lii era, rahel d'ai le era èèna dènge kahib'i ama na. nèngu ka dhu biasa ladhe-leru si.

source_text: then when jacob saw rachel, the daughter of laban, his mother's brother, coming with laban's sheep, he came near, and rolling the stone away from the mouth of the hole, he got water for laban's flock.
target_text: ropa yakob nèdhi rahel dènge kahib'i sèra, la'e dènge ka pa'eso eele hadhu dhu saguru hèb'a èi na. ka na panginu badha to'o na sèra.

source_text: and weeping for joy, jacob gave rachel a kiss.
target_text: èle ka, la'e uu rahel, dènge tangi.

source_text: and rachel, hearing from jacob that he was her father's relation and that he was the son of rebekah, went running to give her father news of it.
target_text: ka na lolo dènge rahel, aku nèngu na, ari! ja'a ne, ana nèti ribka, ana hèni ama mu. hèia rahel rai sa èmu la'e, peka dènge ama na.

source_text: and laban, hearing news of jacob, his sister's son, came running, and took jacob in his arms, and kissing him, made him come into his house. and jacob gave him news of everything.
target_text: ropa laban tadèngi lii lolo rahel, dhu peka na yakob ana nèti ana hèni na ribka, ka la'e dènge ka, soru nare yakob. ropa na d'ai, liku nare yakob, ka na uu, hèia gale nèti dènge ka, lasi asa èmu na. ka yakob lolo aa'i-aa'i dènge to'o na.

source_text: and laban said to him, truly, you are my bone and my flesh. and he kept jacob with him for the space of a month.
target_text: hèia laban lii, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! èdhi dua ti dhu pa'a'ari. ropa yakob pea dènge rèngu d'ai ca hèru,

source_text: then laban said to jacob, because you are my brother are you to be my servant for nothing? say now, what is your payment to be?
target_text: laban padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yakob! ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka èu sab'a hia ja'a dènge iia-iia d'ara, lula èdhi se dhu pa'a'ari. de èu neo sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra èu ja'a b'ae ca ngaa?

source_text: now laban had two daughters: the name of the older was leah, and the name of the younger was rachel.
target_text: laban ne, dhu dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua. dhu uru, ngara na lea. aa ari na, ngara na rahel.

source_text: and leah's eyes were clouded, but rachel was fair in face and form.
target_text: lea ne, musi madha na ako ahu. te ngaa rahel, rèhu na bhèni iia, aa ngi'u na saraga bia.

source_text: and jacob was in love with rachel; and he said, i will be your servant seven years for rachel, your younger daughter.
target_text: yakob d'èi risi rahel. ka na peka dènge laban, ladhe to'o ku mo'o, ja'a sab'a hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, sad'i to'o ku hia ja'a madhèdi dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban said, it is better for you to have her than another man: go on living here with me.
target_text: hèia laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! be'a risi, ja'a paleo èu dènge rahel, lula èdhi dua ti dhu a'ari. mage dhoka na madhèdi dènge dhèu leo. de mu pea mi ne'e, sèna ka sab'a hia ja'a.

source_text: and jacob did seven years' work for rachel; and because of his love for her it seemed to him only a very little time.
target_text: ka yakob sab'a hia laban pidhu tèu, sèna ka na bisa madhèdi dènge rahel. lula na d'èi madhe-madhe rahel, nèti èèna ka, pidhu tèu èèna, na pangee nuka sèmi pèri-pèri lod'o di.

source_text: then jacob said to laban, give me my wife so that i may have her, for the days are ended.
target_text: ropa risi nèti pidhu tèu, ka na pasanèd'e laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ja'a sab'a le hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, de paleo ka ja'a dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban got together all the men of the place and gave a feast.
target_text: hèia laban tao tatao, ka na nèru aa'i rae lesa ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and in the evening he took leah, his daughter, and gave her to him, and he went in to her. and laban gave zilpah, his servant-girl, to leah, to be her waiting-woman. and in the morning jacob saw that it was leah: and he said to laban, what have you done to me? was i not working for you so that i might have rachel? why have you been false to me? and laban said, in our country we do not let the younger daughter be married before the older. let the week of the bride-feast come to its end and then we will give you the other in addition, if you will be my servant for another seven years.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda èèna, laban hia boe rahel, te ngaa na pua lea maso asa d'ara paleo yakob. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne. asa bèli èèna, yakob heka ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu leo dènge lea di. hèia yakob la'e patao dènge laban, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, to'o pasèru ja'a sèmi ne'e? ja'a sab'a sèmi ènu pidhu tèu kateme hia mi èu, sèna ka bisa abhu rahel! nga tao ka to'o pasilu dènge lea? ka laban dhaa, baku nasa ku! madhutu ad'a ji'i ètu rai ne'e, ari bisa boe leo uuru èmu nèti a'a. de be'a risi sèmi ne'e! èu mate hari ku pidhu lod'o, d'ai èle tatao ne, heka èu abhu rahel kèna. sad'i èu sab'a hari hia ja'a pidhu tèu. hèia laban pangèd'u dènge ènu bhèni èci, hia mi lea. ngara na silpa.

source_text: and jacob did so; and when the week was ended, laban gave him his daughter rachel for his wife.
target_text: lii padhai laban deo na, yakob d'èi kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èle tatao ne pidhu lod'o, ka laban pamadhèdi hari yakob dènge rahel.

source_text: and laban gave rachel his servant-girl bilhah to be her waiting-woman.
target_text: ka laban hia ènu na dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na bilha, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ènu rahel.

source_text: then jacob took rachel as his wife, and his love for her was greater than his love for leah; and he went on working for laban for another seven years.
target_text: hèia yakob pa'èci ka dènge rahel. na d'èi risi rahel nèti lea. ka yakob sab'a hari hia to'o na pidhu tèu.

source_text: now the lord, seeing that leah was not loved, gave her a child; while rachel had no children.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua ne'a le, yakob sue risi rahel nèti lea. nèti èèna ka, na hia lea nara iisi ana. te ngaa rahel abhu boe ana.

source_text: and leah was with child, and gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name reuben: for she said, the lord has seen my sorrow; now my husband will have love for me.
target_text: hèia lea dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare ne, ruben dhu sasoa na ‘mèdhi si, abhu ana', lula na peka na, lamatua ladhe nèdhi le sasusa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a tao madha-dhilu mi ja'a.

source_text: then she became with child again, and gave birth to a son; and said, because it has come to the lord's ears that i am not loved, he has given me this son in addition: and she gave him the name simeon.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia, hèia nara iisi hari ana mone èci. na pangare ne, simeon dhu sasoa na, ele boe ‘dhèu tadèngi le', lula na peka na, lamatua dhu ne'a na, dhèu èmu ja'a sue boe ja'a. tu d'ai èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana dhèu èci hari.

source_text: and she was with child again, and gave birth to a son; and said, now at last my husband will be united to me, because i have given him three sons: so he was named levi.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea kad'o hari ana èci, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare na lewi, lula na peka na, dènge ana ne'e ne, èle dènge lii langu ja'a. d'ara dhèu èmu ja'a, pa'èki dènge ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone, dhèu tèlu kèna.

source_text: and she was with child again, and gave birth to a son: and she said, this time i will give praise to the lord: so he was named judah; after this she had no more children for a time.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia ca tèka, hèia nara iisi ana mone èci. na pangare na, yahuda dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘koa-kio', lula na peka na, dènge j'ara ne'e ne, ja'a neo koa-kio lamatua! èle ka, lea dènge heka ana.

source_text: now rachel, because she had no children, was full of envy of her sister; and she said to jacob, if you do not give me children i will not go on living.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu abhu mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, nèngu tèke d'ara dènge a'a na. hèia na peka dènge dhèu èmu na, a'a! hia ku ja'a ana laa, ma. ladhe aad'o, be'a risi ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: but jacob was angry with rachel, and said, am i in the place of god, who has kept your body from having fruit?
target_text: te ngaa yakob jèke ne, aku nèngu na, èu ngee na, ja'a ne, lamatua, ho bisa hia èu ana! ?

source_text: then she said, here is my servant bilhah, go in to her, so that she may have a child on my knees, and i may have a family by her.
target_text: ka rahel b'ala na, sèmi ne'e: hua iia èu more bilha, ènu ja'a na. j'unu dènge ne, sèna ka na matana hia ja'a ana.

source_text: so she gave him her servant bilhah as a wife, and jacob went in to her.
target_text: hèia na pangèd'u bilha mi dhèu èmu na. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne.

source_text: and bilhah became with child, and gave birth to a son.
target_text: ka bilha dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: then rachel said, god has been my judge, and has given ear to my voice, and has given me a son; so he was named dan.
target_text: hèia rahel padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua nanene le lii manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu. ama lamatua pama'ète le, lii langu ja'a dènge mola-mola. ka na pangare ana ne, dan dhu sasoa na ‘pama'ète lii'.

source_text: and again bilhah, rachel's servant, was with child, and gave birth to a second son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, bilha dènge hari babia, ka nara iisi ana mone èci.

source_text: and rachel said, i have had a great fight with my sister, and i have overcome her: and she gave the child the name naphtali.
target_text: ka rahel peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a limuri ne pa'uji dènge a'a ku, ka ja'a segi. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana na, naftali dhu sasoa na ‘pa'uji', do ‘pa'ère'.

source_text: when it was clear to leah that she would have no more children for a time, she gave zilpah, her servant, to jacob as a wife.
target_text: ropa lea ne'a na nèngu ne dènge heka ana, ka na paleo ènu na silpa dènge yakob.

source_text: and zilpah, leah's servant, gave birth to a son.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and leah said, it has gone well for me: and she gave him the name gad.
target_text: hèia lea peka na, kalua ja'a, mèngi le. ka na pangare na, gad dhu sasoa na ‘kalua mèngi'.

source_text: and zilpah, leah's servant, gave birth to a second son.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi hari ana mone èci.

source_text: and leah said, happy am i! and all women will give witness to my joy: and she gave him the name asher.
target_text: hèia lea padhai lii, peka na, waa! limuri ne, ja'a heka karej'e kèna! mi laladhe ee, te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na ja'a ne oto bia. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, aser dhu sasoa na ‘karej'e'.

source_text: now at the time of the grain-cutting, reuben saw some love-fruits in the field, and took them to his mother leah. and rachel said to her, let me have some of your son's love-fruits.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge hèru puu-g'ètu are, ruben la'e asa d'ara j'ami. na rage ana aaj'u ca kapua dhu j'aj'i sèmi èi na'i ho hia dhèu bhèni abhu kolo. ka ruben nèti hia ina na lea. ropa rahel nèdhi, ka na peka dènge lea, aku nèngu na, a'a! bagi ku ja'a ciki, èi na'i dhu ruben nèti èèna.

source_text: but leah said to her, is it a small thing that you have taken my husband from me? and now would you take my son's love-fruits? then rachel said, you may have him tonight in exchange for your son's love-fruits.
target_text: te ngaa lea b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne seli-kolane! parame more le dhèu èmu ja'a. te ngaa roca mèka na. mu neo hari unu aj'u èi na'i èèna nèti ana ja'a? me'a heka makae d'ara! te ngaa rahel dhaa, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ladhe ja'a abhu èi na'i na, mèda ne'e èu pa'èci dènge yakob. ka lea d'èi kahèi.

source_text: in the evening, when jacob came in from the field, leah went out to him and said, tonight you are to come to me, for i have given my son's love-fruits as a price for you. and he went in to her that night.
target_text: ka pe d'ai loo nihia sa, yakob lèpa nèti d'ara oka. lea la'e soru nare ne, ka na peka, a'a! mèda ne, èu j'unu dènge ja'a! lula ja'a dhu hèli kore le èu, dènge kab'ua èi na'i ana ja'a! ka mèda na, yakob j'unu dènge lea.

source_text: and god gave ear to her and she became with child, and gave jacob a fifth son.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi-mangaj'i lea. nèti èèna ka, na dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka lèmi.

source_text: then leah said, god has made payment to me for giving my servant-girl to my husband: so she gave her son the name issachar.
target_text: hèia lea pangare ana na, isaskar, dhu sasoa na, ‘b'ae j'aj'èra', lula na peka na, ama lamatua b'ae-baj'a le j'aj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a hia le silpa madhèdi dènge dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and again leah became with child, and she gave jacob a sixth son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea dènge babia hari, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka èna.

source_text: and she said, god has given me a good bride-price; now at last will i have my husband living with me, for i have given him six sons: and she gave him the name zebulun.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua parasee ja'a mèdha dhu be'a. ka limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a hud'i pakab'ua ku ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone dhèu èna. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, sebulon dhu sasoa na ‘pakab'ua'.

source_text: after that she had a daughter, to whom she gave the name dinah.
target_text: ka lea nara iisi hari, te ngaa ana bhèni, ka na pangare na, dina.

source_text: then god gave thought to rachel, and hearing her prayer he made her fertile.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu bhèlu boe rahel, ka sèmi lii manèngi-mangaj'i na. nèti èèna ka, na bhoke era ana na.

source_text: and she was with child, and gave birth to a son: and she said, god has taken away my shame.
target_text: hèia rahel dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, ama lamatua saku eele le d'ara makae ja'a.

source_text: and she gave him the name joseph, saying, may the lord give me another son.
target_text: hèia na pangare ana na yusuf dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘hud'i laa na hia tabha hari', lula aku nèngu na, ja'a manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu hari.

source_text: now after the birth of joseph, jacob said to laban, let me go away to my place and my country.
target_text: lod'o rahel nara iisi yusuf, yakob peka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ladhe mo'o, ja'a neo lèpa asa rai ètu-èsu ja'a.

source_text: give me my wives and my children, for whom i have been your servant, and let me go: for you have knowledge of all the work i have done for you.
target_text: ja'a neo laku dènge ana-dhèu èmu ja'a. to'o, èu dhu me'a le, ja'a ne sab'a tèu-tèu nèti mad'ae d'ai loo nihia. de ja'a b'ae pama'ète le rèngu se. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se, j'aj'i le unu ja'a ka teme aae.

source_text: and laban said, if you will let me say so, do not go away; for i have seen by the signs that the lord has been good to me because of you.
target_text: hèia, aku to'o na, ana, ee! èu nanene ku lii ja'a laa! madhutu lii malare dhu ja'a abhu, lamatua hia ja'a mamèngi lula èu.

source_text: say then what your payment is to be and i will give it.
target_text: de èu neo manèngi ca ngaa, peka, sèna ka ja'a b'ae! sad'i èu baku tèke eele ja'a, te ngaa sab'a taruu hia ja'a.

source_text: then jacob said, you have seen what i have done for you, and how your cattle have done well under my care.
target_text: ka yakob peka, to'o! èu mèdhi unu mu le, sasab'a-la'a ja'a. nèti èèna ka, badha-manu to'o se, bèba-kacanga.

source_text: for before i came you had little, and it has been greatly increased; and the lord has given you a blessing in everything i have done; but when am i to do something for my family?
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhae mai mèka, mèdha-panyau to'o ku ae èèna mèka. te ngaa limuri ne, to'o kaja le. lamatua pala-bagi le to'o ku mamèngi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ka. te d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka ja'a sab'a hia ana-dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and laban said, what am i to give you? and jacob said, do not give me anything; but i will again take up the care of your flock if you will only do this for me:
target_text: hèia laban karèi ne, aku nèngu na, de sèmi èèna na, ja'a b'ae èu tasamia? ka yakob dhaa, peka na, to'o ku, hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa badha-manu to'o ku, ja'a ladhe-leru taruu, sad'i mu tao ku j'ara èci.

source_text: let me go through all your flock today, taking out from among them all the sheep which are marked or coloured or black, and all the marked or coloured goats: these will be my payment.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a laku asa badha-manu to'o sèi, ho hag'e si. mia dhu dènge boe katèd'a aa dènge boe karata, sèra sa unu to'o ku taruu. te ngaa mia dhu dènge katèd'a aa dhu karata, hia mi ja'a. dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi, ja'a kora aa'i si. se'e se, hud'i laa j'aj'i mi bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra ja'a.

source_text: and so you will be able to put my honour to the test in time to come; if you see among my flocks any goats which are not marked or coloured, or any sheep which is not black, you may take me for a thief.
target_text: d'ai lod'o limuri, pe to'o me'a ja'a ne sab'a dènge mola, do aad'o. sad'i lake more, mai ho mu parisa badha-manu ja'a. ladhe mu abhu kahib'i-ka'ia dhu dènge boe katèd'a, aa dhu karata boe, do, kahib'i-kalèbho dhu pudhi, èèna na, dhu me'a le èèna, ja'a mana'u badha-manu to'o.

source_text: and laban said, let it be as you say.
target_text: ka laban d'èi kahèi, aku nèngu na, oo! j'ara na sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: so that day he took all the he-goats which were banded or coloured, and all the she-goats which were marked or coloured or had white marks, and all the black sheep, and gave them into the care of his sons;
target_text: te ngaa ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, laban hag'e dènge badha dhu katèd'a, dhu karata, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi. ka na pangèd'u mi ana na si, ho ladhe-leru.

source_text: and sent them three days' journey away: and jacob took care of the rest of laban's flock.
target_text: hèia eo rèti ka badha se asa era èci dhu kaj'èu na tèlu lod'o kako haga nèti era yakob si. ka yakob madhenge ka badha dhu ata se.

source_text: then jacob took young branches of trees, cutting off the skin so that the white wood was seen in bands.
target_text: èla èèna ka, yakob poro nare dadana aaj'u nèti aj'u tèlu rupa. ka na caci pakarata ka'uri aj'u sèra, tao strep-strep.

source_text: and he put the banded sticks in the drinking-places where the flock came to get water; and they became with young when they came to the water.
target_text: hèia aj'u dhu strep-strep se, na tèke asa d'ara karab'a kahib'i. badha se dhu tema le pa'ango aa paleo ètu era èèna.

source_text: and because of this, the flock gave birth to young which were marked with bands of colour.
target_text: de ladhe badha se paleo ètu madha aj'u strep-strep se, ra matana ana dhu rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata.

source_text: these lambs jacob kept separate; and he put his flock in a place by themselves and not with laban's flock.
target_text: ka ladhe badha laban se neo paleo, yakob patangare si asa kahib'i dhu katèd'a dènge karata sèra. hèia ana dhu ra matana sa rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, badha na asa ae. ka na pacèri eele si nèti badha laban sèra.

source_text: and whenever the stronger ones of the flock became with young, jacob put the sticks in front of them in the drinking-places, so that they might become with young when they saw the sticks.
target_text: ropa badha dhu èra neo paleo, yakob nare kadhèli aj'u dhu strep-strep sèra, tao mi d'ara karab'a ètu madha si.

source_text: but when the flocks were feeble, he did not put the sticks before them; so that the feebler flocks were laban's and the stronger were jacob's.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kahib'i dhu roe dènge malaka-god'a neo paleo, yakob soro tèke si. ka badha dhu roe, sèra unu to'o na laban. aa mia dhu èra, sèra unu nèngu.

source_text: so jacob's wealth was greatly increased; he had great flocks and women-servants and men-servants and camels and asses.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne, yakob j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. ka kahib'i-ka'ia na, kahib'i-kalèbho na, onta na, keled'ei na, dènge ènu na bhèni-mone, udhu sobhu-sobhu.

source_text: now it came to the ears of jacob that laban's sons were saying, jacob has taken away all our father's property, and in this way he has got all this wealth.
target_text: ca tèka, yakob tadèngi lii padhai ana-ana laban se, aku rèngu na, kakaja-sasu'i yakob sèra, lula na kao nare aa'i mèdha-panyau ama èdhi.

source_text: and jacob saw that laban's feeling for him was no longer what it had been before.
target_text: yakob nèdhi kahèi rèhu to'o laban mare heka, aa be'a heka dènge ne, sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: then the lord said to jacob, go back to the land of your fathers, and to your relations, and i will be with you.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge yakob, d'ai le lod'o, ho èu lèpa asa ina dènge ama mu. ja'a palere-lere dènge èu.

source_text: and jacob sent for rachel and leah to come to him in the field among his flock.
target_text: ka yakob hia dhèu lasi paroa rahel dènge lea, sèna ka mai paraga dènge ne ètu era ani badha, ètu d'ara mamoo.

source_text: and he said to them, it is clear to me that your father's feeling is no longer what it was to me; but the god of my father has been with me
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, ja'a ladhe-ladhe na, ama miu na rèhu na mare heka dènge ja'a. aa babe'a na mi ja'a, sèmi heka uru èèna. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ama ku sogo-tagu èèna, palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: and you have seen how i have done all in my power for your father,
target_text: miu dua mi se me'a le, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a j'aj'i kuli ètu ama miu!

source_text: but your father has not kept faith with me, and ten times he has made changes in my payment; but god has kept him from doing me damage.
target_text: te ngaa sèmi èèna, d'ara na la'e kahèi, ka na kapod'e-kabèli taruu ja'a. ka na ub'a rui-j'aj'èra ja'a, canguru hari kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua j'aga pa'èra ja'a.

source_text: if he said, all those in the flock which have marks are to be yours, then all the flock gave birth to marked young; and if he said, all the banded ones are to be yours, then all the flock had banded young.
target_text: lod'o ama miu peka na, ‘badha dhu rèu ra katèd'a sèra j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ho ladhe lod'o badha se matana, ana dhu katèd'a hua-hua. lod'o leo hari, na peka, ‘badha dhu karata sèra, j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ka badha se matana ana karata aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: so god has taken away your father's cattle and has given them to me.
target_text: ama lamatua ad'u sèmi èèna na, sèna ka nare aa'i badha-manu ama miu èèna, ho hia mi ja'a.

source_text: and at the time when the flock were with young, i saw in a dream that all the he-goats which were joined with the she-goats were banded and marked and coloured.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa badha se paleo, ja'a kèdhi ètu d'ara nii, dhu peka na, badha mone aa'i-aa'i dhu paleo, abhu dhu katèd'a aa dhu karata hèi.

source_text: and in my dream the angel of the lord said to me, jacob: and i said, here am i.
target_text: ka ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga paroa ja'a, peka na, ‘yakob! ' hèia ja'a dhaa, ‘tasamia, lamatua? '

source_text: and he said, see how all the he-goats are banded and marked and coloured: for i have seen what laban has done to you.
target_text: ka na lii, ‘ladhe ku laa! badha mone dhu paleo sèra, dhodhoka dhu karata dènge katèd'a di. ja'a ka ad'u sèra sa, lula ja'a dhu kèdhi le, ngaa dhu laban tao mi dedha èu.

source_text: i am the god of beth-el, where you put oil on the pillar and took an oath to me: now then, come out of this land and go back to the country of your birth.
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua, dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu betel èèna. ètu era nèi, èu patitu hadhu, ka mu bhori èi mènyi ètu dedha na, ka èu sogo-tagu ja'a. ka èu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ja'a ètu nèi. de kèd'i ka, tèke eele ka rai ne'e ne, lamu ka asa kabarai ina-ama èu. '

source_text: then rachel and leah said to him in answer, what part or heritage is there for us in our father's house?
target_text: hèia rahel dènge lea b'ala lii na, aku rèngu na, la'a ma! ji'i dènge heka pusaka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama ji'i laban.

source_text: are we not as people from a strange country to him? for he took a price for us and now it is all used up.
target_text: nèbhu nare sange ne'e, mone heka ne tao ji'i sèmi dhèu leo kara sa. na pahie eele le ji'i se. ka na'e aa'i le kab'ua-kadheli ji'i se.

source_text: for the wealth which god has taken from him is ours and our children's; so now, whatever god has said to you, do.
target_text: de mèdha-panyau dhu ama lamatua nare sèra nèti ama ji'i laban, aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu èdhi dènge ana-ana èdhi se. de ladhe aku lamatua tasa mera mia, te'a dhoka madhutu di!

source_text: then jacob put his wives and his sons on camels; and sending on before him all his cattle and his property which he had got together in paddan-aram, he made ready to go to isaac his father in the land of canaan.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob lalau mèdha-panyau na. hèia na paca'e ana-dhèu èmu na asa dedha onta lasi, aa na eo nèti badha-manu na aa'i-aa'i, dènge mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu ètu padan aram, ho lasi asa rai kana'an.

source_text: now laban had gone to see to the cutting of the wool of his sheep; so rachel secretly took the images of the gods of her father's house.
target_text: lod'o èèna, laban dhu la'e g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho na. ka rahel mana'u nare patung mèdha sogo-tagu ama na.

source_text: and jacob went away secretly, without giving news of his flight to laban the aramaean.
target_text: aa yakob si lasi palangu boe lii dènge to'o na.

source_text: so he went away with all he had, and went across the river in the direction of the hill-country of gilead.
target_text: na bau nèti aa'i mèdha-panyau na, ka ra kako pamèri-mèri, lasi re loko efrat, asa ledhe gilead.

source_text: and on the third day laban had news of jacob's flight.
target_text: rarai yakob si èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o ku, heka laban ne'a kèna.

source_text: and taking the men of his family with him, he went after him for seven days and overtook him in the hill-country of gilead.
target_text: hèia laban oru nare ka dhèu-dhèu na, lasi bate yakob si. d'ai pidhu lod'o ku, heka ra paraga dènge si ètu ledhe gilead.

source_text: then god came to laban in a dream by night, and said to him, take care that you say nothing good or bad to jacob.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda èèna, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi laban ètu d'ara nii. na peka na, laban! ladhe èu padhai lii dènge yakob, j'aga paie hèb'a èu na.

source_text: now when laban overtook him, jacob had put up his tent in the hill-country; and laban and his brothers put up their tents in the hill-country of gilead.
target_text: mèda èèna, yakob si dhu patitu paleo ètu ledhe gilead. aa laban si patitu unu ra kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna kahèi.

source_text: and laban said to jacob, why did you go away secretly, taking my daughters away like prisoners of war?
target_text: èle ka, laban mai paraga dènge yakob. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu rai mèti ana bhèni ja'a se, dènge boe lii ugu-ge'e sa hèi? mu tao si sèmi dhèu dhu èu segi ètu d'ara papara-pakèj'i.

source_text: why did you make a secret of your flight, not giving me word of it, so that i might have sent you away with joy and songs, with melody and music?
target_text: èu ne ad'a aad'o, palangu boe sa hèi dènge ja'a! ladhe èu peka dènge ja'a be'a-be'a, ele boe ja'a tao sisi-kau, ho ta'a-tinu boko-boko, ho lere miu dènge lii sod'a, heka ji'i patabuli miu kèna.

source_text: you did not even let me give a kiss to my sons and my daughters. this was a foolish thing to do.
target_text: sasala èu èci hari ka, èu hia boe ja'a uu ana-èpu ja'a hèi. tatao èu ne goa titu kèna!

source_text: it is in my power to do you damage: but the god of your father came to me this night, saying, take care that you say nothing good or bad to jacob.
target_text: carui boe, ladhe ja'a ne neo paj'èra èu! te ngaa malo-malo ka mèda-mèda na, ama lamatua dhu ama mu sogo-tagu èèna, kai ja'a peka na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge èu, ja'a hud'i j'aga paie-iie ku hèb'a ja'a.

source_text: and now, it seems, you are going because your heart's desire is for your father's house; but why have you taken my gods?
target_text: mema, ja'a dhu ke'a le, èu pakèd'i lula èu dhu neo le lèpa. te ngaa tasamia ka, èu mana'u mèti patung mèdha sogo-tagu ja'a?

source_text: and jacob, in answer, said to laban, my fear was that you might take your daughters from me by force.
target_text: hèia yakob b'ala, aku nèngu na, to'o baku nasa ku dènge ja'a! ja'a pakèd'i mau-mau èèna, lula ja'a mage dhoka mo'o boe ja'a kèti ana-ana se!

source_text: as for your gods, if anyone of us has them, let him be put to death: make search before us all for what is yours, and take it. for jacob had no knowledge that rachel had taken them.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhu ne'a nare boe, na dhèu èmu na rahel ka dhu mana'u nèti. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, to'o! mèdha sogo-tagu èèna, mu tenge ne! ladhe mèdhi ètu cee, huku pamadhe ne. parisa aa'i mèu-mèu. ladhe abhu kahèi pusaka to'o dhu leo, more aa'i si. hud'i laa, dhèu se'e se j'aj'i sakasii.

source_text: so laban went into jacob's tent and into leah's tent, and into the tents of the two servant-women, but they were not there; and he came out of leah's tent and went into rachel's.
target_text: hèia laban la'e parisa ka asa d'ara paleo se èci-èci. na la'e uru asa d'ara paleo yakob. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo lea. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo ènu se dua ra. te ngaa abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. paleo rahel limuri tèka.

source_text: now rachel had taken the images, and had put them in the camels' basket, and was seated on them. and laban, searching through all the tent, did not come across them.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu huni le mèdha sogo-tagu sèra ètu d'ara lalaka onta. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha. d'ai d'ara paleo ne, laban tenge paie-iie, te ngaa na rage boe.

source_text: and she said to her father, let not my lord be angry because i do not get up before you, for i am in the common condition of women. and with all his searching, he did not come across the images.
target_text: hèia rahel peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama mage mu nasa kahèi. te ja'a bisa boe titu, lula ja'a abhu hèru. masi ka sèmi èèna, laban tenge taruu, te ngaa abhu boe mèdha sogo-tagu sèra.

source_text: then jacob was angry with laban, and said, what crime or sin have i done that you have come after me with such passion?
target_text: ka yakob nasa, hèia na pajèka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne tao bhelu ngaa mi to'o? ka to'o mai bate ja'a, sèmi dhu ja'a ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa!

source_text: now that you have made search through all my goods, what have you seen which is yours? make it clear now before my people and your people, so that they may be judges between us.
target_text: mèdha-panyau ja'a, to'o ceb'e eele si. de mu abhu ngaa? more ka mai tèke mi madha ne, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti tèdhi. aa hud'i laa, dhèu se'e ka dhu pama'ète mèdha èèna unu cee.

source_text: these twenty years i have been with you; your sheep and your goats have had young without loss, not one of your he-goats have i taken for food.
target_text: dua nguru tèu kèna, ja'a sab'a kuli mi to'o. lod'o ja'a madhenga badha-manu to'o, ci'u sa legu boe. aa ku'a kèdhi boe ci'u sa hèi!

source_text: anything which was wounded by beasts i did not take to you, but myself made up for the loss of it; you made me responsible for whatever was taken by thieves, by day or by night.
target_text: ladhe badha hui-hahi hui, kadhi pamadhe badha to'o ci'u, ja'a peka boe, te ngaa ja'a gati. aa ladhe dhèu mana'u, to'o pua ja'a gati, masi ka ja'a sala boe.

source_text: this was my condition, wasted by heat in the day and by the bitter cold at night; and sleep went from my eyes.
target_text: ladhe re mèu, madha lod'o ai pamango ja'a. aa ladhe mèda, ja'a maringi rig'i-rig'i. ja'a pasaruru boe ciki sa, toke mèu rai, lula madhenge badha-manu to'o.

source_text: these twenty years i have been in your house; i was your servant for fourteen years because of your daughters, and for six years i kept your flock, and ten times was my payment changed.
target_text: mema tare'a, dua nguru tèu èèna! ja'a sab'a canguru èpa tèu, sèna ka abhu ana bhèni to'o, dhèu dua se. ka ja'a sab'a hari èna tèu, sèna ka ja'a unu badha-manu se'e. j'aj'i kuli nèbhu nare sange èèna, te ngaa to'o pakura rui-j'aj'èra ja'a d'ai canguru hari.

source_text: if the god of my father, the god of abraham and the fear of isaac, had not been with me, you would have sent me away with nothing in my hands. but god has seen my troubles and the work of my hands, and this night he kept you back.
target_text: malo-malo ka, dènge ama lamatua, dhu baki ku abraham, dènge ama ku isak, dhu sogo-tagu ne. ladhe na leru boe ja'a ne, ele boe to'o hia ja'a lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu pa'abhe boe musi madha na mi j'aj'èra ja'a, aa na tao madha-dhilu mi sasab'a-la'a ja'a aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, mèda deo na, na mai kai to'o, sèna ka baku lii sakaa dènge ja'a.

source_text: then laban, answering, said, these women are my daughters and these children my children, the flocks and all you see are mine: what now may i do for my daughters and for their children?
target_text: ropa nanene nare lii padhai yakob, ka laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! bhèni dua se, ana ja'a. ana dhu ra matana se, aa'i-aa'i ra èpu ja'a. badha-manu aa'i-aa'i se, unu ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi ètu se'e se, unu ja'a. te ngaa ja'a neo tao si, tasamia? ja'a bisa boe magee si.

source_text: come, let us make an agreement, you and i; and let it be for a witness between us.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji. sèna ka lii pajaji èèna ka dhu èki èdhi dua ti.

source_text: then jacob took a stone and put it up as a pillar.
target_text: hèia yakob nare ka hadhu aae cue, na patitu ètu èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha.

source_text: and jacob said to his people, get stones together; and they did so; and they had a meal there by the stones.
target_text: hèia yakob pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi udhu hadhu. ka ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu era èèna, padètu dènge hadhu sèra.

source_text: and the name laban gave it was jegar-sahadutha: but jacob gave it the name of galeed.
target_text: hèia laban pangare hadhu udhu sèra, yegar sahaduta. te ngaa yakob pangare na, galeed.

source_text: and laban said, these stones are a witness between you and me today. for this reason its name was galeed,
target_text: ka laban padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hadhu udhu se, j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ngara na, galeed.

source_text: and mizpah, for he said, may the lord keep watch on us when we are unable to see one another's doings.
target_text: laban pangare kahèi era èèna, mispa dhu sasoa na ‘era j'aga dhu dedha', lula na peka na, pe èèna na, lamatua ka dhu j'aga èdhi dua ti, ho masi ka dua ti pakaj'èu, baku kako eele lii pajaji ne.

source_text: if you are cruel to my daughters, or if you take other wives in addition to my daughters, then though no man is there to see, god will be the witness between us.
target_text: ladhe èu tao karehe ana ja'a se, do leo-èmu dènge bhèni leo hari, tatu ja'a ke'a boe. te ngaa mu sanèd'e! ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and laban said, see these stones and this pillar which i have put between you and me; they will be witness that i will not go over these stones to you, and you will not go over these stones or this pillar to me, for any evil purpose.
target_text: èu ladhe ku hadhu dhu patitu ne, dènge hadhu dhu udhu se. sanèd'e, hadhu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi too dènge lane. èu bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi ja'a. aa ja'a kahèi bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi èu.

source_text: may the god of abraham and the god of nahor, the god of their father, be our judge. then jacob took an oath by the fear of his father isaac.
target_text: dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji ne, dènge kolongara ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èdhi. nuka ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham dènge baki ja'a nahor. nèngu èèna ka, dhu j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti. ropa nanene nare, hèia yakob j'oka soo-subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, dhu ama na isak sogo-tagu.

source_text: and jacob made an offering on the mountain, and gave orders to his people to take food: so they had a meal and took their rest that night on the mountain.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob roro badha, ho j'aj'i mi korban hia mi lamatua ètu ledhe èèna. hèia na paroa dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai ra'a-rinu pa'èci, ka ra beke d'ai lod'o rea.

source_text: and on his way jacob came face to face with the angels of god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si kako taruu. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga sèra mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and when he saw them he said, this is the army of god: so he gave that place the name of mahanaim.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi si, na lii, aku nèngu na, era ne'e ne, sèmi era ae sordad'u lamatua! nèti èèna ka, era èèna na pangare na, mahanaim dhu sasoa na ‘dua era ae iisi'.

source_text: now jacob sent servants before him to esau, his brother, in the land of seir, the country of edom;
