target_text: ka yakob pua dhèu na pèri-pèri lasi uuru asa rai edom nuka seir, sèna ka lasi peka dènge a'a na esau, ho ne'a mamai na.

source_text: and he gave them orders to say these words to esau: your servant jacob says, till now i have been living with laban:
target_text: hèia yakob peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lami peka dènge a'a ku esau, sèmi ne'e: ‘lamatua esau! ènu mu yakob, hia ji'i ngèti lii karej'e-karae mi a'a na. peka na, karèi nèti ja'a pakèd'i, toke sange ne'e ne, ja'a pea ètu d'ara èmu to'o laban.

source_text: and i have oxen and asses and flocks and men-servants and women-servants: and i have sent to give my lord news of these things so that i may have grace in his eyes.
target_text: limuri ne, ènu lamatua na dènge le unu sapi, keled'ei, rupa-rupa kahib'i, dènge ènu bhèni-mone. ja'a hia uru dhèu se'e dhiu, ho peka dènge a'a ku, mamai ja'a ne. ja'a sanao sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ' èle ka dhèu se lasi.

source_text: when the servants came back they said, we have seen your brother esau and he is coming out to you, and four hundred men with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa hari mai, ra lolo dènge yakob, aku rèngu na, ji'i paraga le dènge a'a mu esau. nuka na mai re limuri nèi, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu dhèu mone, neo mai paraga dènge èu.

source_text: then jacob was in great fear and trouble of mind: and he put all the people and the flocks and the herds and the camels into two groups;
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, sangasa yakob rèbha-rèbha, aa na madha'u ae. ka na hag'e eele dhèu na dènge badha-manu j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: and said, if esau, meeting one group, makes an attack on them, the others will get away safely.
target_text: na pangee, ladhe esau mai, ho na age kaboko dhu uru, na kaboko dhu limuri bisa rai, tenge sod'a.

source_text: then jacob said, o god of my father abraham, the god of my father isaac, the lord who said to me, go back to your country and your family and i will be good to you:
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi-mangaj'i, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! èu j'aj'i lamatua nèti baki ja'a abraham, aa nèti ama ku isak. nanene ku lii manèngi ja'a la! uru èèna, lamatua ka dhu hia ja'a lèpa asa a'ari ja'a, ètu kabarai ne'e. lamatua ka dhu moa tèke, peka na pe lamatua uri pamola j'ara.

source_text: i am less than nothing in comparison with all your mercies and your faith to me your servant; for with only my stick in my hand i went across jordan, and now i have become two armies.
target_text: ja'a ne madhutu mola-mola na, bisa boe abhu sasue dènge mamako lamatua. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pège loko yarden, ja'a kèti dhoka tatea di. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a lèpa kèti dènge dhèu dua nau, aa dènge badha-manu ae.

source_text: be my saviour from the hand of esau, my brother: for my fear is that he will make an attack on me, putting to death mother and child.
target_text: ja'a mangingi, mage dhoka a'a ja'a esau, mai pare pamadhe ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamuri mi ja'a, dènge ana-dhèu èmu-kamali aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: and you said, truly, i will be good to you, and make your seed like the sand of the sea which may not be numbered.
target_text: lamatua dhu jaji tèke, èèna na pala-bagi mi dedha ja'a mamèngi ae-ae, aa hia ana-èpu ja'a bèba-kacanga, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi, dhu dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: then he put up his tent there for the night; and from among his goods he took, as an offering for his brother esau,
target_text: èle ka, yakob si j'unu ètu era èèna. asa bèli èèna, na hag'e badha pèri-pèri ngi'u ho rèti hia a'a na.

source_text: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred females and twenty males from the sheep,
target_text: na pili nare kahib'i rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i mone dua nguru ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho mone dua nguru ngi'u,

source_text: thirty camels with their young ones, forty cows, ten oxen, twenty asses, and ten young asses.
target_text: onta rena tèlu nguru ngi'u dènge ana susu, sapi rena èpa nguru ngi'u, canguru ngi'u sapi mone, keled'ei rena dua nguru ngi'u, dènge canguru ngi'u keled'ei mone.

source_text: these he gave to his servants, every herd by itself, and he said to his servants, go on before me, and let there be a space between one herd and another.
target_text: ka na hag'e ka badha se, èci-èci ka dènge anga na. hèia na papala ka, èci-èci dènge ana madhenge na. ka na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu kako uuru. pe ja'a dhiu. te ngaa mi palaladha ho kaboko èci pakaj'èu nèti kaboko dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and he gave orders to the first, saying, when my brother esau comes to you and says, whose servant are you, and where are you going, and whose are these herds?
target_text: ka na peka dènge kaboko dhu uuru tèka, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'a ku esau paraga dènge èu, aa na karèi, peka na, ‘èu lamu mia? èu ne, ènu nèti cee? badha-manu se, unu cee? '

source_text: then say to him, these are your servant jacob's; they are an offering for my lord, for esau; and he himself is coming after us.
target_text: na mi dhaa, peka na, ‘badha-manu se, unu ènu mu, yakob. na pa'adhu hia a'a na, esau. te ngaa nèngu nuka nèti limuri nèi. '

source_text: and he gave the same orders to the second and the third and to all those who were with the herds, saying, this is what you are to say to esau when you see him; and you are to say further, jacob, your servant, is coming after us. for he said to himself, i will take away his wrath by the offering which i have sent on, and then i will come before him: it may be that i will have grace in his eyes.
target_text: lii sèmi èèna, na peka kahèi dènge dhèu madhenga badha cahag'e sèra hèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe mi paraga dènge a'a ku esau, mi hia ne badha-manu se. aa mi peka dènge ne, ja'a re limuri. lula madhutu a'abhu yakob, na hia badha se aa'i-aa'i mi esau, èèna na esau sèmi nèngu dènge be'a.

source_text: so the servants with the offerings went on in front, and he himself took his rest that night in the tents with his people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na hia uuru rèti badha se. te ngaa mèda èèna, nèngu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and in the night he got up, and taking with him his two wives and the two servant-women and his eleven children, he went over the river jabbok.
target_text: mèda na, yakob kèd'i, ka na pua dhèu èmu na dhèu dua, dènge dhèu èmu piara dhèu dua, dènge ana na dhèu canguru èci sèra, lasi uuru pège asa cabèka loko yabok.

source_text: he took them and sent them over the stream with all he had.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai ca bèka loko, ka na hia aa'i mèdha-panyau na asa nèi.

source_text: then jacob was by himself; and a man was fighting with him till dawn.
target_text: te ngaa yakob pea ka mesa-mesa ètu èèna. hèia dhèu mone èci mai, ka dua ra palèka d'ai oe mèu.

source_text: but when the man saw that he was not able to overcome jacob, he gave him a blow in the hollow part of his leg, so that his leg was damaged.
target_text: ropa mone ne ne'a na nèngu segi boe yakob, ka na kalabhe mi kolo keja yakob, ka gage na tabod'a eele nèti era na.

source_text: and he said to him, let me go now, for the dawn is near. but jacob said, i will not let you go till you have given me your blessing.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii, aku nèngu na, patabuli ja'a, te ciki hari, lod'o rea kèna. te ngaa, aku yakob na, èu hia ja'a mèngi-nale, heka ja'a patabuli èu kèna!

source_text: then he said, what is your name? and he said, jacob.
target_text: ka mone ne karèi ne, ngara èu ne, cee? na dhaa, peka na, yakob.

source_text: and he said, your name will no longer be jacob, but israel: for in your fight with god and with men you have overcome.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii hari, aku nèngu na, èu ngara heka yakob. te ngaa mulai nèti deo ne'e ne, dhèu paroa èu, isra'el, lula èu lab'a le dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, ka èu segi. ngara isra'el sasoa na ‘dhu palèka dènge ama lamatua'.

source_text: then jacob said, what is your name? and he said, what is my name to you? then he gave him a blessing.
target_text: ka yakob karèi ne, èu peka ku ngara èu la. te ngaa mone ne peka na, èu neo me'a ngara ja'a, tao ngaa? hèia na hia mèngi-nale mi yakob ètu era èèna.

source_text: and jacob gave that place the name of peniel, saying, i have seen god face to face, and still i am living.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le ama lamatua madha dènge madha, te ngaa ja'a mamuri era. nèti èèna ka, yakob pangare era èèna, peniel, dhu sasoa na, ‘rèhu lamatua'.

source_text: and while he was going past peniel, the sun came up. and he went with unequal steps because of his damaged leg.
target_text: ropa yakob tèke eele era èèna, lod'o dhu rea le. te ngaa na kako ged'a, lula gage na tabod'a.

source_text: for this reason the children of israel, even today, never take that muscle in the hollow of the leg as food, because the hollow of jacob's leg was touched.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu isra'el ra'a boe sisi isi lasona, lula lamatua kalabhe patabod'a eele gage bèi-baki ra yakob.

source_text: then jacob, lifting up his eyes, saw esau coming with his four hundred men. so he made a division of the children between leah and rachel and the two women-servants.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, yakob ladhe nèdhi esau, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu sèra, mai asa rèngu. ka na papala ana na mi ina ra èci-èci.

source_text: he put the servants and their children in front, leah and her children after them, and rachel and joseph at the back.
target_text: na hia dhèu èmu piara sèra dènge ana ra kako uuru. èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, heka rahel dènge ana na yusuf limuri tèka.

source_text: and he himself, going before them, went down on his face to the earth seven times till he came near his brother.
target_text: te ngaa yakob kako uuru nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa na padètu dènge a'a na, na patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u d'ai rai pidhu hari.

source_text: then esau came running up to him, and folding him in his arms, gave him a kiss: and the two of them were overcome with weeping.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o esau ladhe nèdhi ari na, rai dènge ka, la'e liku nare yakob. dua ra paliku dènge pa'uu. hèia dua ra tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: then esau, lifting up his eyes, saw the women and the children, and said, who are these with you? and he said, the children whom god in his mercy has given to your servant.
target_text: ropa esau nèdhi bhèni dènge ana-ana si, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, se'e se, cee ka se'e? ka yakob peka, rèngu se'e se, dhu ama lamatua pala-bagi hia ja'a, ènu a'a ku ne.

source_text: then the servants and their children came near, and went down on their faces.
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu piara na, dènge ana niki ra lasi pahaha iisi ètu madha esau.

source_text: and leah came near with her children, and then joseph and rachel, and they did the same.
target_text: èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi. dhu lasi limuri, yusuf dènge ina na rahel lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi.

source_text: and he said, what were all those herds which i saw on the way? and jacob said, they were an offering so that i might have grace in my lord's eyes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, esau karèi, aku nèngu na, èu pa'adhu badha pèri nau sèi, èu neo tao ngaa? hèia yakob dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ja'a hia mi a'a ku, sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo.

source_text: but esau said, i have enough; keep what is yours, my brother, for yourself.
target_text: te ngaa esau peka, ja'a dènge mèdha-panyau ae kahèi. de hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and jacob said, not so; but if i have grace in your eyes, take them as a sign of my love, for i have seen your face as one may see the face of god, and you have been pleased with me.
target_text: te ngaa yakob b'ala, peka na, baku, a'a. a'a ku hud'i sèmi la mèdha se, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo. te ropa a'a ku b'ui mari, ka ja'a sèmi dhu kèdhi b'ui mari nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: take my offering then, with my blessing; for god has been very good to me and i have enough: so at his strong request, he took it.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, a'a ku sèmi la mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua aad'o se. lula ama lamatua be'a titu kèna dènge ja'a ne. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a unu ngaa-ngaa se aa'i-aa'i. lula yakob pamako taruu, no'o do no'o boe èèna ka, esau sèmi nare kahèi.

source_text: and he said, let us go on our journey together, and i will go in front.
target_text: hèia esau peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, miu pa'èra ho lati palere. ja'a lere miu.

source_text: but jacob said, my lord may see that the children are only small, and there are young ones in my flocks and herds: one day's over-driving will be the destruction of all the flock.
target_text: te ngaa aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a! a'a ku ladhe mèdhi unu mu. ana mu se, ana iiki ae era. rèngu se dhae èra èèna mèka. aa badha ae ka dhu heka matana. ladhe ta pakaseti si kako pamèri, ètu d'ara ca lod'o, èèna na madhe aa'i si.

source_text: do you, my lord, go on before your servant; i will come on slowly, at the rate at which the cattle and the children are able to go, till i come to my lord at seir.
target_text: de be'a risi, a'a ku si kako uuru. pe ji'i kako mau-mau dhiu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a dhiu ngad'o a'a ku ètu seir.

source_text: and esau said, then keep some of my men with you. and he said, what need is there for that, if my lord is pleased with me?
target_text: hèia esau lii hari, na peka, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele dhèu ja'a se cahag'e, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa, aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a, ee! sad'i ja'a ke'a le, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: so esau, turning back that day, went on his way to seir.
target_text: tadèngi nare, esau pakèd'i ka, tèke eele si, lèpa asa seir.

source_text: and jacob went on to succoth, where he made a house for himself and put up tents for his cattle: for this reason the place was named succoth.
target_text: te ngaa nèti era èèna, yakob la'e asa sukot. d'ai nèi, na tao èmu dènge oka hia badha aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ra pangare na sukot dhu sasoa na ‘èmu pea taha'.

source_text: so jacob came safely from paddan-aram to the town of shechem in the land of canaan, and put up his tents near the town.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, yakob si kako nèti padan aram, lasi d'ai rae sikem ètu rai kana'an dènge sod'a-mole. hèia ra patitu paleo, sèna ka ra pea padètu dènge rae èèna.

source_text: and for a hundred bits of money he got from the children of hamor, the builder of shechem, the field in which he had put up his tents.
target_text: rai dhu yakob patitu paleo ne, hèli nare nèti hemor, ana sikem. kab'ua rai ne, ca ngasu doi iia.

source_text: and there he put up an altar, naming it el, the god of israel.
target_text: ètu era ne, na pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne'e, el-elohe-isra'el, dhu sasoa na ‘ama lamatua nèti isra'el'.

source_text: now dinah, the daughter whom leah had by jacob, went out to see the women of that country.
target_text: ca lod'o, dina, ana bhèni yakob dènge lea, la'e pangad'o dènge bhèni anga-aangalai na ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and when shechem, the son of hamor the hivite who was the chief of that land, saw her, he took her by force and had connection with her.
target_text: dhèu aae kabarai ne, ngara na hemor, nèti suku hewi. ngara ana mone na, sikem. ca tèka, sikem ladhe nèdhi dina, ka rai nèti ne, hèia na tao pakarehe ne.

source_text: then his heart went out in love to dinah, the daughter of jacob, and he said comforting words to her.
target_text: sikem d'èi madhe-madhe dina ne. ka na solo mako, sèna ka dina no'o dènge ne.

source_text: and shechem said to hamor, his father, get me this girl for my wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! lamu karèi dina hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhèdi dènge ne.

source_text: now jacob had word of what shechem had done to his daughter; but his sons were in the fields with the cattle, and jacob said nothing till they came.
target_text: tatao sikem ne, yakob dhu tadèngi le, te ngaa na mau-mau, aa tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te lod'o èèna, ana mone na sèra, ètu d'ara pad'a madhenge badha rèngu. ka na mate si mai ku.

source_text: then hamor, the father of shechem, came out to have a talk with jacob.
target_text: lod'o èèna, hemor, ama sikem, mai padhai lii dènge yakob, ho neo karèi dina hia sikem.

source_text: now the sons of jacob came in from the fields when they had news of it, and they were wounded and very angry because of the shame he had done in israel by having connection with jacob's daughter; and they said, such a thing is not to be done.
target_text: ètu talora dua ra padhue-padhai era, ana-ana yakob lèpa nèti d'ara pad'a. ropa ra tadèngi sikem dhu tao pakarehe le ana hèni ra, ka d'ara ra pèd'a, ka ra nasa bia. ka ra peka, madha j'ara dhu sèmi ne'e ne, lèke boe ètu isra'el. de ji'i se sèmi boe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: but hamor said to them, shechem, my son, is full of desire for your daughter: will you then give her to him for a wife?
target_text: ka hemor pamako yakob, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a sikem d'èi tare'a-re'a ana èu dina. de ja'a manèngi d'ara èu, sèna ka mo'o la, paleo ana bhèni èu dènge ne.

source_text: and let our two peoples be joined together; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
target_text: ladhe mo'o ana-ana èdhi se paleo iisi-aanga ra. ana-ana mone nèti miu, madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni nèti ji'i. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana-ana mone ji'i madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni miu.

source_text: go on living with us, and the country will be open to you; do trade and get property there.
target_text: sèna ka èdhi pea pa'oru pa'èci ètu d'ara rai ne'e. sad'i miu d'èi era mia èèna ka, mi pea la dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. mi d'aga, sèna ka abhu kakaja ètu ne'e.

source_text: and shechem said to her father and her brothers, if you will give ear to my request, whatever you say i will give to you. however great you make the bride-price and payment, i will give it; only let me have the girl for my wife.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama dina dènge a'a na sèra, peka na, miu se, sad'i manèngi ngaa, ja'a dhoka madhutu di. masi ka miu manèngi doi pamèu madha, dènge kab'ua pèri-pèri èèna ka, ja'a hia. sad'i mo'o ja'a leo dènge ana hèni miu.

source_text: but the sons of jacob gave a false answer to shechem and hamor his father, because of what had been done to dinah their sister.
target_text: te ngaa ana-ana yakob se re'a le, sikem dhu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra dina. hèia ra karihu-kahadhu, ka ra bèle, peka mi sikem dènge ama na hemor,

source_text: and they said, it is not possible for us to give our sister to one who is without circumcision, for that would be a cause of shame to us:
target_text: aku rèngu na, ji'i bisa boe hia ana hèni ji'i leo dènge dhèu dhu suna boe. te èèna na, era makae ji'i èèna!

source_text: but on this condition only will we come to an agreement with you: if every male among you becomes like us and undergoes circumcision;
target_text: te ngaa j'ara na sèmi ne'e: miu se, hud'i sama ku sèmi ji'i, mone aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki, dhèu kapai, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: then we will give our daughters to you and take your daughters to us and go on living with you as one people.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu j'ara ne'e, èdhi heka paleo kèna. aa ji'i pea ètu rai ne'e hèi, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but if you will not undergo circumcision as we say, then we will take our daughter and go.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i, aa mo'o boe suna, ji'i ngare hari ana hèni ji'i, ho kèd'i eele rai ne'e.

source_text: and their words were pleasing to hamor and his son shechem.
target_text: hèia hemor dènge ana na sikem ro'o kahèi.

source_text: and without loss of time the young man did as they said, because he had delight in jacob's daughter, and he was the noblest of his father's house.
target_text: te ngaa sikem no'o heka mate, lula d'ara na d'èi ae dina. dhèu isi rai ètu èèna pakab'ua sikem ne titu kèna.

source_text: then hamor and shechem, his son, went to the meeting-place of their town, and said to the men of the town,
target_text: ka hemor dènge sikem lasi asa era pama'ète lii, ètu hèb'a tedhe rae èèna, hèia ra padhue lii ne dènge kabarai sèra. ra peka, aku rèngu na,

source_text: it is the desire of these men to be at peace with us; let them then go on living in this country and doing trade here, for the country is wide open before them; let us take their daughters as wives and let us give them our daughters.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhèu isra'el se, d'èi mamuri mera-milu dènge èdhi. de hud'i laa ta pea pa'èci dènge rèngu ètu dedha-rai ne'e. rai ne taleo, de èdhi bisa pea pa'èci aa'i-aa'i ti. èdhi se bisa leo dènge ana bhèni rèngu. aa rèngu bisa madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èdhi kahèi.

source_text: but these men will make an agreement with us to go on living with us and to become one people, only on the condition that every male among us undergoes circumcision as they have done.
target_text: lii manèngi rèngu dhoka èci di, nèti èdhi se. ra manèngi, èdhi mone se aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna ku, madhutu ad'a rèngu.

source_text: then will not their cattle and their goods and all their beasts be ours? so let us come to an agreement with them so that they may go on living with us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi se pab'ali le dènge rèngu, èèna na badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau ra j'aj'i unu èdhi. de be'a risi èdhi to'o la madhutu dad'èi ra. mai sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti suna! mo'o, sina ma?

source_text: then all the men of the town gave ear to the words of hamor and shechem his son; and every male in the town underwent circumcision.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra sa, sèmi lii padhai lii hemor dènge ana na sikem. hèia dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ètu rai èèna suna palere-lere.

source_text: but on the third day after, before the wounds were well, two of the sons of jacob, simeon and levi, dinah's brothers, took their swords and came into the town by surprise and put all the males to death.
target_text: d'ara lod'o ka tèlu, ropa rèngu dhu suna se, nu'a ra dhu pèd'a era, ka ana mone dina, simeon dènge lewi, rare samala ra, kako mau-mau, lasi asa d'ara kota. ka dua ra pare pamadhe aa'i-aa'i dhèu mone sèra.

source_text: and hamor and his son they put to death with the sword, and they took dinah from shechem's house and went away.
target_text: hemor dènge sikem, ra pare pamadhe kahèi. hèia ra rèti dènge ka dina nèti d'ara èmu sikem, lèpa èmu rèngu.

source_text: and the sons of jacob came on them when they were wounded and made waste the town because of what had been done to their sister;
target_text: aa ana yakob dhu cahag'e sèra, maso asa d'ara kota èèna, ra parama rèti aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èèna. ra nasa, lula dhèu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra ètu èèna.

source_text: they took their flocks and their herds and their asses and everything in their town and in their fields,
target_text: ra parama rèti mèdha-panyau dhèu nèti d'ara èmu ra, dènge eo rèti badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara pad'a.

source_text: and all their wealth and all their little ones and their wives; everything in their houses they took and made them waste.
target_text: rèti aa'i bhèni dènge ana-ana, aa parame rare aa'i mèdha dhu kab'ua nèti kabarai ne.

source_text: and jacob said to simeon and levi, you have made trouble for me and given me a bad name among the people of this country, among the canaanites and the perizzites: and because we are small in number they will come together against me and make war on me; and it will be the end of me and all my people.
target_text: ropa yakob ne'a j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, na peka dènge simeon dènge lewi, miu dua mi se, goa ngaa ka ne'e? miu paj'èra ja'a! èèna na, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu peris dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu dedha rai ne'e, tèka d'ara dènge èdhi se. rèngu se, dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa èdhi se, dhèu ciki di. ladhe rèngu se mai age èdhi, na, ra palaho aa'i èdhi.

source_text: but they said, were we to let him make use of our sister as a loose woman?
target_text: te ngaa ana se dhaa dènge lii nasa, peka na, ama! ama pangee na hud'i laa ji'i soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao ana hèni ji'i ne, bhèni kajeo!

source_text: and god said to jacob, go up now to beth-el and make your living-place there: and put up an altar there to the god who came to you when you were in flight from your brother esau.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua padhai lii dènge yakob, peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu, lod'o èu rai nèti madha a'a mu esau. kèd'i, lamu dènge ka asa betel. ladhe d'ai nèi, mu patitu mei korban hia ja'a. aa pea dènge ka ètu èèna.

source_text: then jacob said to all his people, put away the strange gods which are among you, and make yourselves clean, and put on a change of clothing: and let us go up to beth-el: and there i will make an altar to god, who gave me an answer in the day of my trouble, and was with me wherever i went.
target_text: ka yakob peka dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i, aku nèngu na, aa'i-aa'i ti lati dènge ka asa betel. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ama lamatua ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu èèna. ja'a neo tao mei korban ètu nèi. de mi core eele mèdha sogo-tagu miu. aa mi pamèu iisi mi, ho mi gati mèdha-papake leo, te èdhi neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: then they gave to jacob all the strange gods which they had, and the rings which were in their ears; and jacob put them away under the holy tree at shechem.
target_text: ka ra oru mèdha sogo-tagu, dènge ate-ate ra aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia yakob dhènu mèdha se aa'i-aa'i ra ètu kapua aj'u aae ca kapua dhu padètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: so they went on their journey: and the fear of god was on the towns round about, so that they made no attack on the sons of jacob.
target_text: ropa yakob dènge dhèu na aa'i-aa'i pakèd'i nèti sikem, ama lamatua hia d'ara madha'u mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu padètu dènge rae sikem, ka ra bani boe tao karehe mi yakob si.

source_text: and jacob came to luz in the land of canaan which is the same as beth-el, he and all his people.
target_text: ka yakob si d'ai dènge sod'a ètu betel dhu uru èèna, ngara na lus, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and there he made an altar, naming the place el-beth-el: because it was there he had the vision of god when he was in flight from his brother.
target_text: ètu ne'e, yakob pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne, el betel, sasoa na ‘betel unu ama lamatua', lula uru èèna ama lamatua pad'elo iisi mi yakob ètu era èèna, lod'o nèngu rai nèti madha a'a na.

source_text: and deborah, the servant who had taken care of rebekah from her birth, came to her end, and was put to rest near beth-el, under the holy tree: and they gave it the name of allon-bacuth.
target_text: padètu dènge rae betel, abhu aj'u aae ca kapua, ngara na alon bakut. sasoa na ‘aj'u tangi dhèu madhe'. pake ngara ne, lod'o debora, ina dhu lalau-lalo'o ribka, madhe, ka padhane ètu karasa aj'u èèna.

source_text: now when jacob was on his way from paddan-aram, god came to him again and, blessing him, said,
target_text: lod'o yakob lèpa nèti padan aram, ama lamatua pad'elo hari iisi na, ka hia na berkat.

source_text: jacob is your name, but it will be so no longer; from now your name will be israel; so he was named israel.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge ne, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu ngara heka yakob, te ngaa isra'el.

source_text: and god said to him, i am god, the ruler of all: be fertile, and have increase; a nation, truly a group of nations, will come from you, and kings will be your offspring;
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. de èu matana pa'ae-ae, aa ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, suku-suku mai nèti ana-èpu èu. aa nèti ana-èpu èu sèra, cèu dhèu aae-dhèu aae.

source_text: and the land which i gave to abraham and isaac, i will give to you; and to your seed after you i will give the land.
target_text: rai dhu pangèd'u mi baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak, ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: then god went up from him in the place where he had been talking with him. and jacob put up a pillar in the place where he had been talking with god, and put a drink offering on it, and oil.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua peka nare, yakob patitu dènge hadhu ètu era èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha ho na baku bhèlu eele lii lamatua. ka na bhori èi anggor dènge èi mènyi mi dedha hadhu na, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he gave to the place where god had been talking with him, the name of beth-el.
target_text: era èèna, na pangare ‘betel'.

source_text: so they went on from beth-el; and while they were still some distance from ephrath, the pains of birth came on rachel and she had a hard time.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pakèd'i nèti betel. ropa rèngu kaj'èu èèna mèka nèti rae efrata nuka betlehem èèna, rahel dhu d'ai le lod'o nara iisi na. te ngaa nara iisi carui, hèia na roe titu kèna.

source_text: and when her pain was very great, the woman who was helping her said, have no fear; for now you will have another son.
target_text: ka ropa na pèngu stenga madhe, dhèu ai tadha peka dènge ne, pa'èra d'ara èu, te mora iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu! de baku paroe iisi.

source_text: and in the hour when her life went from her for death came to her, she gave the child the name ben-oni: but his father gave him the name of benjamin.
target_text: lod'o rahel oe ma'ète a'ae, na pangare ana ne, ben-oni, dhu sasoa na ‘ana nèti j'aj'èra ja'a'. ka heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa yakob hia ana ne ngara benyamin, dhu sasoa na ‘ana ai g'ana'.

source_text: so rachel came to her end and was put to rest on the road to ephrath which is beth-lehem.
target_text: ka ra padhane rahel ètu sebhe j'ara dhu la'e asa efrata, dhu limuri ne, ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and jacob put up a pillar on her resting-place; which is named, the pillar of the resting-place of rachel, to this day.
target_text: hèia yakob pudhi lutu bhatu ètu ro'a dhèu èmu na èèna. d'ai sange ne'e, ro'a rahel ne era.

source_text: and israel went journeying on and put up his tents on the other side of the tower of the flock.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob pea boe mi ca era sa. ca tèka, na patitu paleo ètu sebhe manara eder.

source_text: now while they were living in that country, reuben had connection with bilhah, his father's servant-woman: and israel had news of it.
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu era èèna, ruben j'unu dènge bilha, dhèu èmu piara ama na. èèna ka, yakob ne'a j'ara ne'e kahèi. ana mone yakob, canguru dua dhèu.

source_text: now jacob had twelve sons: the sons of leah: reuben, jacob's first son, and simeon and levi and judah and issachar and zebulun;
target_text: ana-ana nèti lea, nuka: ruben ana uuru yakob, simeon, lewi, yahuda, isaskar, dènge sebulon.

source_text: the sons of rachel: joseph and benjamin;
target_text: ana-ana rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: the sons of bilhah, rachel's servant: dan and naphtali;
target_text: ana-ana nèti bilha, ènu rahel: dan dènge naftali.

source_text: the sons of zilpah, leah's servant: gad and asher; these are the sons whom jacob had in paddan-aram.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti silpa, ènu lea, nuka: gad dènge aser. rara iisi ana se ètu padan aram.

source_text: and jacob came to his father isaac at mamre, at kiriath-arba, that is, hebron, where abraham and isaac had been living.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob la'e ngad'o ama na isak asa mamre, dhu dètu dènge kiryat-arba dhu limuri ne, ngara na hebron. uru èèna, baki na abraham pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and isaac was a hundred and eighty years old. then isaac came to his end and was put to rest with his father's people, an old man after a long life: and jacob and esau, his sons, put him in his last resting-place.
target_text: umur isak d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna. ka ana na esau dènge yakob padhane ne.

source_text: now these are the generations of esau, that is to say, edom.
target_text: ne'e ne, ana-èpu esau. ngara esau dhu leo, edom.

source_text: esau's wives were women of canaan: adah, the daughter of elon the hittite, and oholibamah, the daughter of anah, the daughter of zibeon the hivite,
target_text: esau leo dènge ana bhèni kana'an dhèu dua. èci dhèu het, ana bhèni nèti elon, ngara na ada. dhèu èmu na èci hari, dhèu hewi, ngara na oholibama. ama na, ngara na anah, aa baki na sibeon.

source_text: and basemath, ishmael's daughter, the sister of nebaioth.
target_text: esau leo kahèi dènge ana ismael, ngara na basmat. ana mone basmat, ngara na nebayot.

source_text: adah had a son eliphaz; and basemath was the mother of reuel;
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu uuru esau, nara iisi elifas. basmat matana rahuel.

source_text: oholibamah was the mother of jeush, jalam, and korah; these are the sons of esau, whose birth took place in the land of canaan.
target_text: aa oholibama matana yeus, yalam dènge kora. ana esau aa'i-aa'i ra sèra rara iisi si ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all the people of his house, and his beasts and his cattle and all his goods which he had got together in the land of canaan, and went into the land of seir, away from his brother jacob.
target_text: ca tèka, esau pidha asa rai leo cue dhu kaj'èu nèti yakob. la'e nèti aa'i bhèni-ana niki, dhèu-dhèu sab'a, badha-manu, dènge mèdha-panyau na.

source_text: for their wealth was so great that the land was not wide enough for the two of them and all their cattle.
target_text: esau pacèri dènge yakob, lula badha-manu ra dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, era pea rèngu katata ètu rai èèna.

source_text: so esau made his living-place in the hill-country of seir esau is edom.
target_text: hèia esau nuka edom la'e pea ètu ledhe ètu seir.

source_text: and these are the generations of esau, the father of the edomites in the hill-country of seir:
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu esau dhu ra peka na ‘dhèu edom'. rèngu pea ètu era ledhe seir.

source_text: these are the names of esau's sons: eliphaz, the son of esau's wife adah, and reuel, the son of esau's wife basemath. the sons of eliphaz were teman, omar, zepho, gatam, and kenaz. and eliphaz, the son of esau, had connection with a woman named timna, who gave birth to amalek: all these were the children of esau's wife adah. and these are the sons of reuel: nahath, zerah, shammah, and mizzah: they were the children of esau's wife basemath.
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu esau, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na elifas. elifas ne, ana mone na, dhèu lèmi, nuka: teman, omar, sefo, gatam dènge kenas. dhèu èmu piara elifas, ngara na timna. nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na amalek. dhèu èmu esau, basmat, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehuel. rehuel abhu ana mone dhèu èpa, nuka: nahat, sera, syama, dènge misa.

source_text: and these are the sons of esau's wife oholibamah, the daughter of anah, the daughter of zibeon: she was the mother of jeush, jalam, and korah.
target_text: dhèu èmu esau, oholibama, ana nèti anah, aa èpu nèti sibeon, nara iisi ana mone dhèu tèlu, nuka: yeus, yalam, dènge kora.

source_text: these were the chiefs among the sons of esau: the sons of eliphaz, esau's first son: teman, omar, zepho, kenaz, korah, gatam, amalek: all these were chiefs in the land of edom, the offspring of eliphaz, the seed of adah.
target_text: ana-èpu esau se pahag'a lème, ka j'aj'i mi suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku ra. ana-ana elifas, dhu ana uuru nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku teman, suku omar, suku sefo, suku kenas, suku kora, suku gatam dènge suku amalek. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana-èpu nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na ada.

source_text: and these are the sons of esau's son reuel: nahath, zerah, shammah, mizzah: these were the chiefs of reuel in the land of edom, the children of esau's wife basemath.
target_text: ana-ana rehuel, dhu ana nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku nahat, suku sera, suku syama, dènge suku misa. aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu esau dènge dhèu èmu na, basmat.

source_text: and these are the sons of esau's wife oholibamah: jeush, jalam, and korah: these were the chiefs who came from esau's wife oholibamah, daughter of anah.
target_text: ana-ana nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na, oholibama, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku yeus, suku yalam, dènge suku kora.

source_text: these were the sons of esau that is, edom, and these were their chiefs.
target_text: suku se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti ana-èpu esau.

source_text: these are the sons of seir the horite who were living in that country; lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer, and dishan: these are the chiefs of the horites, offspring of seir in the land of edom.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu hori èci, ngara na seir. ana-ana na pahag'a palème rai, ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku na. èle èèna ka, ana-ana na se j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku lotan, suku sobal, suku sibeon, suku anah, suku dison, suku eser, dènge suku disan.

source_text: the children of lotan were hori and hemam; lotan's sister was timna.
target_text: ana lotan nuka: hori dènge heman. ana hèni lotan, nuka timna.

source_text: and these are the children of shobal: alvan, manahath, ebal, shepho, and onam.
target_text: ana-ana sobal, nuka: alwan, manahat, ebal, sefo, dènge onam.

source_text: and these are the children of zibeon: aiah and anah; that same anah who made the discovery of the water-springs in the waste land, when he was looking after the asses of his father zibeon.
target_text: ana-ana nèti sibeon, nuka: aya, dènge anah. anah ne'e ka dhu rage madha èi pana ètu d'ara mamoo, lod'o na madhenga keled'ei ama na.

source_text: and these are the children of anah: dishon and oholibamah his daughter. these are the children of dishon: hemdan, eshban, ithran, and keran.
target_text: ana bhèni nèti anah, nuka oholibama. aa ana mone na, nuka, dison. ana-ana dison, nuka: hemdan, esban, yitran, dènge keran.

source_text: these are the children of ezer: bilhan, zaavan, and akan.
target_text: ana-ana eser, nuka: bilhan, saawan, dènge akan.

source_text: these are the children of dishan: uz and aran.
target_text: ana-ana disan, nuka: us, dènge aran.

source_text: these were the horite chiefs: lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer, and dishan. such were the horite chiefs in their order in the land of seir.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku nèti dhèu hori sèra, nuka: lotan, sobal, sibeon, anah, dison, eser, dènge disan. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se pea ètu rai seir.

source_text: and these are the kings who were ruling in the land of edom before there was any king over the children of israel.
target_text: lod'o dhu kabarai isra'el dènge mèka dhèu aae, te ngaa ètu rai edom dènge le dhèu aae. ngara dhèu aae se, dhutu-dhutu, nuka:

source_text: bela, son of beor, was king in edom, and the name of his chief town was dinhabah.
target_text: ra ded'e bela, ana nèti beor, j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu kota dinhaba.

source_text: at his death, jobab, son of zerah of bozrah, became king in his place.
target_text: ropa bela madhe, ra ded'e yobab ho gati ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na sera, nèti rae bosra.

source_text: and at the death of jobab, husham, from the country of the temanites, became king in his place.
target_text: ropa yobab madhe, ra ded'e husam ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. husam ne, nèti rai dhèu teman.

source_text: and at the death of husham, hadad, son of bedad, who overcame the midianites in the field of moab, became king; his chief town was named avith.
target_text: ropa husam madhe, ra ded'e hadad ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na bedad, nèti rae awit. nèngu ka dhu segi dhèu midian, lod'o ra pamusu ètu moab.

source_text: and at the death of hadad, samlah of masrekah became king.
target_text: ropa hadad madhe, ra ded'e samla ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. nèngu ne, nèti rae masreka.

source_text: and at the death of samlah, shaul of rehoboth by the river became king in his place.
target_text: ropa samla madhe, ra ded'e saul ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. saul èèna, nèti rae rehobot, dhu ètu sebhe loko.

source_text: and at the death of shaul, baal-hanan, son of achbor, became king.
target_text: ropa saul madhe, ra ded'e baal-hanan ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na akbor.

source_text: and at the death of baal-hanan, hadar became king in his place; his chief town was named pau, and his wife's name was mehetabel; she was the daughter of matred, the daughter of me-zahab.
target_text: ropa baal-hanan madhe, ra ded'e hadar ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. hadar ne, nèti rae pau. aa dhèu èmu na, ngara mehetabel. ama mehetabel, ngara na matret. aa baki na, mesahab.

source_text: these are the names of the chiefs of esau in the order of their families and their places: timna, alvah, jetheth, oholibamah, elah, pinon, kenaz, teman, mibzar, magdiel, iram; these are the edomite chiefs, in their places in their heritage; this is esau, the father of the edomites.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku dhu j'aj'i nèti ana-èpu esau, nuka: timna, alwa, yetet, oholibama, ela, pinon, kenas, teman, mibsar, magdiel, dènge iram. rèngu se èci-èci pangare rai ra madhutu ngara rèngu unu ra. de aa'i-aa'i se'e, lii lolo nèti ana-èpu esau, dhèu edom èèna.

source_text: now jacob was living in the land where his father had made a place for himself, in the land of canaan.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lole nèti yakob si. ca tèka ka, yakob la'e pea hari asa rai kana'an. èèna, era pea ama na isak nèti uru ka.

source_text: these are the generations of jacob: joseph, a boy seventeen years old, was looking after the flock, together with his brothers, the sons of bilhah and zilpah, his father's wives; and joseph gave their father a bad account of them.
target_text: tèu èèna, ana yakob èci, nèti dhèu èmu na rahel, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne'e, ropa umur na d'ai canguru pidhu tèu, nèngu dènge a'a na si, tema le j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho rèngu. a'a na sèra, ana nèti ina leo hari, ngara na bilha dènge silpa. te ngaa yusuf ne'e tuka tenge lii mi dedha a'a na si, ho la'e pana'e ama na.

source_text: now the love which israel had for joseph was greater than his love for all his other children, because he got him when he was an old man: and he had a long coat made for him.
target_text: lod'o dhu rara iisi yusuf na, ama na dhu heka le. nèti èèna ka, na sue yusuf ne risi eele nèti ana-ana na leo sèra. ca lod'o ka, yakob j'au kodho madhera èci dhu saraga bia hia yusuf.

source_text: and because his brothers saw that joseph was dearer to his father than all the others, they were full of hate for him, and would not say a kind word to him.
target_text: ropa a'a na si ladhe-ladhe la'a na ama na sue risi yusuf, hèia ra mulai tèka d'ara dènge ne, ro'o boe padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: now joseph had a dream, and he gave his brothers an account of it, which made their hate greater than ever. and he said to them, let me give you the story of my dream. we were in the field, getting the grain stems together, and my grain kept upright, and yours came round and went down on the earth before mine.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka yusuf nii. kèd'i nèti bhèj'i ka, na lolo dènge a'a na si lii nii deo na, aku nèngu na, we! mi nanene ku la! ja'a nii, na èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èki are ètu d'ara oka. kabèdhi laa, are dhu ja'a èki titu dhoo-dhoo. te ngaa are miu, oke mere are ja'a deo na, ka pacud'u mi unu ja'a. ra nanene rare sèmi èèna, hèia a'a na se'e tabha nasa hari dènge ne.

source_text: and his brothers said to him, are you to be our king? will you have authority over us? and because of his dream and his words, their hate for him became greater than ever.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, we! èu ngee na, èu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai kèna, ho neo paredha ji'i, do? taga na lolo lii nii ne'e, hèia asa ra nasa dènge ne.

source_text: then he had another dream, and gave his brothers an account of it, saying, i have had another dream: the sun and the moon and eleven stars gave honour to me.
target_text: nèbhu boe, yusuf nii hari ca tèka. na lolo hari dènge a'a na si, aku nèngu na, we! ja'a nii hari, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a kèdhi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu canguru èci. aa'i-aa'i sèra, pahaha iisi mi ja'a.

source_text: and he gave word of it to his father and his brothers; but his father protesting said, what sort of a dream is this? am i and your mother and your brothers to go down on our faces to the earth before you?
target_text: hèia yusuf lolo hari lii nii deo na dènge ama na, aa dènge a'a na sèra. ka ama na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, lii nii ngaa, kèna! èu ngee na, ja'a dènge ina mu, dènge a'ari èu sèra, mai uu kabaj'èla èu, do? èu nia ae le èèna, nga!

source_text: and his brothers were full of envy; but his father kept his words in mind.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, a'a na sèra tèka d'ara bia dènge ne. te ngaa ama na pangee taruu lii nii èèna ètu d'ara na.

source_text: now his brothers went to keep watch over their father's flock in shechem.
target_text: ca tèka ka, a'a yusuf sèra rèti kahib'i-kalèbho ama na, asa era j'u'u dètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and israel said to joseph, are not your brothers with the flock in shechem? come, i will send you to them. and he said to him, here am i.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ama na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, a'a mu si j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho dètu dènge sikem. de èu pa'èra, ho lamu ladhe ku si la. ka yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku, ama.

source_text: and he said to him, go now, and see if your brothers are well and how the flock is; then come back and give me word. so he sent him out of the valley of hebron, and he came to shechem.
target_text: hèia ama na peka hari, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ladhe a'a mu si, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho èdhi. ladhe ra samia na, mai peka dènge ja'a. ka yusuf pakèd'i ka nèti d'ara pad'a hebron, la'e taruu d'ai sikem.

source_text: and a man saw him wandering in the country, and said to him, what are you looking for?
target_text: d'ai nèi, na tenge a'a na si, palème d'ara pad'a èèna. na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ka dhèu èèna karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu tenge ngaa?

source_text: and he said, i am looking for my brothers; please give me word of where they are keeping their flock.
target_text: yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a tenge a'a ja'a. rèngu eo kahib'i-kalèbho dètu ètu era ne'e. de ama, èu paraga dènge si, do aad'o?

source_text: and the man said, they have gone away from here, for they said in my hearing, let us go to dothan. so joseph went after them and came up with them at dothan.
target_text: hèia, dhèu deo na peka, aku nèngu na, ra aad'o heka ètu ne'e. te ja'a tadèngi, ra peka na lasi padètu dènge rae dotan. hèia yusuf la'e taruu, ka paraga dènge si ètu rae dotan.

source_text: but they saw him when he was a long way off, and before he came near them they made a secret design against him to put him to death;
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi yusuf nèti kaj'èu, ra padhue rare lii èci neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: saying to one another, see, here comes this dreamer.
target_text: èci peka dènge èci, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku la! mone eele tuka nii na, nuka mai nèi!

source_text: let us now put him to death and put his body into one of these holes, and we will say, an evil beast has put him to death: then we will see what becomes of his dreams.
target_text: de mai ho ti pamadhe ne. ho èèna na, ti core eele ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna. ladhe d'ai èmu na, ti peka dènge ama peka na, badha hui ra'e ne. ho èèna na, ti ladhe sèku, lii nii na sèra sa mia!

source_text: but reuben, hearing these words, got him out of their hands, saying, let us not take his life.
target_text: ropa nanene èèna, hèia a'a na ruben tenge j'ara ho patabuli eele yusuf. hèia na kai ari na si, aku nèngu na, we! èdhi baku pamadhe ne!

source_text: do not put him to a violent death, but let him be placed in one of the holes; this he said to keep him safe from their hands, with the purpose of taking him back to his father again.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi kèpe ne, ti tao asa d'ara madha èi madhe nèi. ètu èèna, era dhu dhèu aad'o, de èci sa rèdhi boe ne. sad'i baku pasuti raa na. na peka sèmi èèna, lula na tenge j'ara ho patalale yusuf, ho hia na lèpa hari èmu.

source_text: so when joseph came to his brothers, they took off his long coat which he had on;
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai madha a'a na si, ra kèpe ne, ka ra rèbhi eele kodho dhu saraga aae ètu ua na.

source_text: and they took him and put him in the hole: now the hole had no water in it.
target_text: ka ra nuni pa'oro ne, hèia ra tule ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna.

source_text: then seating themselves, they took their meal: and looking up, they saw a travelling band of ishmaelites, coming from gilead on their way to egypt, with spices and perfumes on their camels.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa, lasi ra'a-rinu. ètu talora ra'a-rinu, kabèdhi la ra ladhe rèdhi dhèu canau mai re èèna. dhèu sèra kako rèti dènge badha onta ra, hue dènge mèdha d'aga, sèmi raa aj'u hèu mèngi, bubhu-bubhu dènge èi na'i rupa-rupa. dhèu sèra sa, dhèu ismael, dhu mai nèti rae gilead neo lasi kaj'èu d'ai masir.

source_text: and judah said to his brothers, what profit is there in putting our brother to death and covering up his blood?
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yahuda peka dènge a'ari na sèra, aku nèngu na, ee! be'a risi sèmi ne'e. èdhi baku pamadhe ne. a'oto na ngaa? tasa mera mia èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe pahuni raa na.

source_text: let us give him to these ishmaelites for a price, and let us not put violent hands on him, for he is our brother, our flesh. and his brothers gave ear to him.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi pahie ne dènge dhèu ismael sèi. èdhi tao ne samia èèna ka oo, nèngu ne'e ari d'èlu èdhi. nèti èèna ka, baku èdhi pamadhe ne! aa'i-aa'i ra d'èi kahèi dènge lii yahuda èèna.

source_text: and some traders from midian went by; so pulling joseph up out of the hole, they gave him to the ishmaelites for twenty bits of silver, and they took him to egypt.
target_text: ropa dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai era èèna, hèia a'a yusuf sèra lasi ère rare ne, nèti d'ara madha èi madhe deo na. ka ra pahie ne mi dhèu ismael sèra dènge kab'ua dua nguru bua doi pudhi. ka dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf asa rai masir.

source_text: now when reuben came back to the hole, joseph was not there; and giving signs of grief,
target_text: lod'o ra pahie yusuf ne, ruben ne'a boe. ropa na la'e patigi sa d'ara madha èi madhe na, capa na kabèdhi, ladhe la'a na yusuf aad'o heka ètu d'ara. nèti èèna ka, na ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, lula d'ara na pèd'a ae titu kèna.

source_text: he went back to his brothers, and said, the child is gone; what am i to do?
target_text: hèia na la'e sa ari na si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ari èdhi aad'o heka ètu era èèna! ja'a tao samia hari?

source_text: then they took joseph's coat, and put on it some of the blood from a young goat which they had put to death,
target_text: hèia ra roro kahib'i ci'u, ka rare kodho yusuf dhu saraga aae èèna, cèb'u sa d'ara raa kahib'i deo na.

source_text: and they took the coat to their father, and said, we came across this; is it your son's coat or not?
target_text: hèia ra lèpa ka rèti dènge kodho deo na, pad'elo dènge ama na, ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i pili ngare kodho ne'e. ama ku ladhe sèku la. tao-tao ne'e kodho ari ji'i yusuf.

source_text: and he saw that it was, and said, it is my son's coat; an evil beast has put him to death; without doubt joseph has come to a cruel end.
target_text: ropa nèdhi kodho deo na, yakob tadhe dènge. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ne'e kodho ana ja'a. èle boe badha hui ra'e ana ja'a. ira iiii! ana ja'a madhe le!

source_text: then jacob, giving signs of grief, put on haircloth, and went on weeping for his son day after day.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yakob ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, ka na pake karo, taga nèti d'ara na susa titu kèna. na tangi lii ooi-ooi sène nare lod'o nèbhu aae.

source_text: and all his sons and all his daughters came to give him comfort, but he would not be comforted, saying with weeping, i will go down to the underworld to my son. so great was his father's sorrow for him.
target_text: ana na, ana mone dènge ana bhèni sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mai padhai lii pakarej'e d'ara ama ra, te ngaa tao rare boe ne. aku nèngu na, aad'o! sasusa ja'a ne bisa d'ai madhe kèti. te ja'a bisa boe bhèlu ana èci ne'e. mema d'ara yakob j'èra taruu, lula na ngee nèdhi ana na yusuf dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: and in egypt the men of midian gave him for a price to potiphar, a captain of high position in pharaoh's house.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu yakob ètu d'ara susa era, dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai le masir. d'ai nèi, ka lasi pahie eele yusuf dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa j'aga nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: now at that time, judah went away from his brothers and became the friend of a man of adullam named hirah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yahuda tèke eele a'ari na, ka la'e pea dènge angalai na èci, ngara na hira, ètu rae adulam.

source_text: and there he saw the daughter of a certain man of canaan named shua, and took her as his wife.
target_text: ètu èèna, dhèu mone èci, dhèu kana'an, ngara na sua. yahuda d'èi ana bhèni na èci, ka nare j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. dhèu èmu yahuda ne'e nara iisi ana mone pagod'o-pagod'o dhèu pèri-pèri.

source_text: and she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name er.
target_text: ana uuru èèna, ngara na er.

source_text: and again she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name onan.
target_text: ana ka dua, ngara na onan.

source_text: then she had another son, to whom she gave the name shelah; she was at chezib when the birth took place.
target_text: aa ana ka tèlu, ngara na sela. lod'o ina na nara iisi sela na, yahuda si pidha le asa rae kesib.

source_text: and judah took a wife for his first son er, and her name was tamar.
target_text: ropa ana mone uuru, dhu ngara na er èèna kapai, ka ama na la'e tenge dhèu hia ne. ngara ana bhèni na tamar. ka dua ra j'aj'i paleo èmu.

source_text: now er, judah's first son, did evil in the eyes of the lord, so that he put him to death.
target_text: lula er ne, bhelu-katub'a, ka ama lamatua huku pamadhe ne. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge boe kolo.

source_text: then judah said to onan, go in to your brother's wife and do what it is right for a husband's brother to do; make her your wife and get offspring for your brother.
target_text: hèia yahuda paroe nare ana mone ka dua na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, onan! a'a mu er madhe, dènge boe ana. madhutu ad'a èdhi na, èu hud'i leo hari ku dènge dhèu èmu a'a mu ne. sèna ka èu bisa hia kolo hia a'a mu.

source_text: but onan, seeing that the offspring would not be his, went in to his brother's wife, but let his seed go on to the earth, so that he might not get offspring for his brother.
target_text: mema onan ne'a le ad'a sèmi ne'e. te ngaa na no'o boe hia kolo mi a'a na er. nèti èèna ka, ladhe rèngu j'unu pa'èci, na pasuti eele hua hini nèngu asa li'u, sèna ka tamar baku dènge babia.

source_text: and what he did was evil in the eyes of the lord, so that he put him to death, like his brother.
target_text: taga tatao onan sèmi ne'e ka, lamatua nasa bia dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, lamatua huku pamadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: then judah said to tamar, his daughter-in-law, go back to your father's house and keep yourself as a widow till my son shelah becomes a man: for he had in his mind the thought that death might come to him as it had come to his brothers. so tamar went back to her father's house.
target_text: ropa yahuda nèdhi ana mone na dua sèra dhu leo dènge tamar madhe sèmi èèna, hèia yahuda madha'u. ka na pangee mage dhoka ana mone ka tèlu èèna, leo hari dènge tamar na madhe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, la'e peka dènge tamar, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa hari asa d'ara adhe-aai ina dènge ama mu. ladhe ana ja'a sela kapai, na èu lèpa hari mai ho leo dènge ne. hèia tamar lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and after a time, bath-shua, judah's wife, came to her end; and after judah was comforted for her loss, he went to timnah, where they were cutting the wool of his sheep, and his friend hirah of adullam went with him.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu hèia, dhèu èmu yahuda madhe. na j'èra toke d'ai pa'èle lod'o sasusa na. ka na la'e gale nare angalai na hira, ka lasi asa rae timna. ètu èèna, dhèu rame-rame g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ho pahia.

source_text: and when tamar had news that her father-in-law was going up to timnah to the wool-cutting,
target_text: dhèu lolo dènge tamar, peka na, to'o mu la'e leru dhèu g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho ètu rae timna.

source_text: she took off her widow's clothing, and covering herself with her veil, she took her seat near enaim on the road to timnah; for she saw that shelah was now a man, but she had not been made his wife.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana limuri yahuda, ngara na sela, kapai le. te ngaa tamar ne'a le, na, to'o na no'o boe paleo sela dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, tamar tenge j'ara neo katèju hak nèngu. na bhoke eele mèdha-papake bhèni balu ètu ngi'u na, ka na silu mèdha-papake dhu be'a. na pake salalu pahutu kètu dènge rèhu na. ka la'e madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe sebhe j'ara rae enaim, dhu biasa dhèu kako re èèna lasi rae timna.

source_text: when judah saw her he took her to be a loose woman of the town, because her face was covered.
target_text: ropa yahuda kako re èèna, na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci madhèdi ètu èèna. na neo laa na dhèu bhèni kajeo, te tamar dhu lalau iisi dènge mèdha-papake saraga, aa pahutu rèhu na kahèi.

source_text: and turning to her by the roadside, he said to her, let me come in to you; for he had no idea that she was his daughter-in-law. and she said, what will you give me as my price?
target_text: yahuda ne'a nare boe na dhèu bhèni na, dhèu èmu ana na dhu madhe sèra. hèia na kako la'e padètu dènge bhèni deo na ka, na peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ee! sèmi ja'a dènge èu na, èu manèngi ca ngaa? hèia tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, èèna nèti d'ara d'èi ama.

source_text: and he said, i will give you a young goat from the flock. and she said, what will you give me as a sign till you send it?
target_text: aku yahuda na, sa mia! sèmi ja'a hia èu kahib'i ci'u? hèia tamar dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, bisa ama. sad'i ama hia ku ja'a mèdha èci ho ja'a kèd'u. pe pèri lod'o ho ama pa'adhu kahib'i èèna mai oo, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: and he said, what would you have? and she said, your ring and its cord and the stick in your hand. so he gave them to her and went in to her, and she became with child by him. then she got up and went away and took off her veil and put on her widow's clothing.
target_text: hèia yahuda karèi hari, aku nèngu na, de ja'a tèka mèdha ngaa mi èu? tamar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama tèke eele cap, dènge dhari dhu ama inu, dènge tatea dhu ama kèpe èèna hèi. nanene nare ka, yahuda hia mèdha sèra la'e. hèia dua ra lasi bhèj'i ka. èle èèna ka, tamar lèpa la'e èmu. d'ai èmu ka, na bhoke mèdha-papake saraga dènge salalu, ka gati dènge mèdha-papake bhèni balu. nèti èèna ka, tamar dènge babia.

source_text: then judah sent his friend hirah with the young goat, to get back the things which he had given as a sign to the woman: but she was not there.
target_text: nèbhu boe hèia, yahuda manèngi tolong angalai na hira, aku nèngu na, èu mèti kahib'i ne'e hia dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu ètu enaim èèna, ho mèti hari mèdha ja'a dhu ètu nèngu sèra. lod'o hira la'e d'ai nèi, na karèi palème, te ngaa paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna.

source_text: and he put questions to the men of the place, saying, where is the loose woman who was in enaim by the wayside? and they said, there was no such woman there.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, eee! miu mèdhi dhèu bhèni kajeo dhu biasa madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe èèna, do? na ètu mia, ee? dhèu sèra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ètu ne'e bhèni kajeo aad'o!

source_text: so he went back to judah, and said, i have not seen her, and the men of the place say that there is no such woman there.
target_text: hèia hira lèpa hari peka dènge yahuda, aku nèngu na, ja'a paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna. ja'a tenge palème, te ngaa dhèu ètu sèra peka aku rèngu na, ètu rae èèna bhèni kajeo aad'o.

source_text: and judah said, let her keep the things, so that we may not be shamed; i sent the young goat, but you did not see the woman.
target_text: yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, hud'i ka la, nèngu abhu mèdha sèra! sad'i dhèu baku pamakae èdhi! ja'a neo b'ae, te ngaa èdhi paraga boe dènge bhèni èèna na.

source_text: now about three months after this, word came to judah that tamar, his daughter-in-law, had been acting like a loose woman and was with child. and judah said, take her out and let her be burned.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu hèru hèia, dhèu lasi lolo dènge yahuda, peka na, dhèu èmu ana èu na tao ngi'u na sèmi dhèu bhèni kajeo. ka na dènge babia le. nanene nare èèna hèia, yahuda nasa bia. hèia na pua dhèu, aku nèngu na, lami nuni pa'oro ne mai, ho labhu asa d'ara ai la'e!

source_text: and while she was being taken out, she sent word to her father-in-law, saying, the man whose property these things are, is the father of my child: say then, whose are this ring and this cord and this stick?
target_text: ka dhèu lasi ka nuni rèti tamar mai. te ngaa na pad'elo cap dènge tatea èèna. ka na pua dhèu lasi peka dènge to'o na, aku nèngu na, parisa ku mèdha se'e. dhèu dhu unu cap dènge tatea ne'e ka dhu ad'u-ue tatao ne'e, ka ja'a dènge babia ne.

source_text: then judah said openly that they were his, and said, she is more upright than i am, for i did not give her to shelah my son. and he had no more connection with her.
target_text: ropa nèdhi mèdha se'e, yahuda tadhe dènge, na mèdha sèra unu nèngu. hèia na padhai lii dènge ka, aku nèngu na, mema dhèu bhèni ne'e sala boe. ja'a ka dhu sala. madhutu iia na, ja'a ka dhu paleo bhèni ne'e dènge ana ja'a sela. te ngaa ja'a ka ko'o boe. karèi nèti èèna ka, yahuda pa'èci heka dènge tamar.

source_text: and when the time came for her to give birth, it was clear that there were two children in her body.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka tamar nara iisi ana dhèu dua.

source_text: and while she was in the act of giving birth, one of them put out his hand; and the woman who was with her put a red thread round his hand, saying, this one came out first.
target_text: lod'o tamar nara iisi na, kabèdhi laa ana èci pacèu uuru kacui-aai èci sa li'u mai. ka dhèu ai tadha dhu panara iisi na nare loa hèngu mea, ka èki mi kanau riti na. bhèni na peka, aku nèngu na, ana uuru ka ne'e.

source_text: but then he took his hand back again, and his brother came first to birth: and the woman said, what an opening you have made for yourself! so he was named perez.
target_text: te ngaa ana èèna ère hari kacui-aai na sa d'ara. hèia, ana èci na kalua uuru hari. nèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, bhèni ai tadha èèna peka, aku nèngu na, waa! èu èra titu kèna! nèti èèna ka, èu paseti ho kalua uuru sa li'u. bhèni na pangare ne, peres, dhu sasoa na, ‘paseti sa li'u'.

source_text: and then his brother came out, with the red thread round his hand, and he was named zerah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhu èki dènge loa hèngu mea deo na kalua. ra pangare ne sera sasoa na ‘mea gèu-gèu'.

source_text: now joseph was taken down to egypt; and potiphar the egyptian, a captain of high position in pharaoh's house, got him for a price from the ishmaelites who had taken him there. and the lord was with joseph, and he did well; and he was living in the house of his master the egyptian.
target_text: dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf d'ai masir, hèia ra pahie eele ne dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa sordad'u dhu j'aga ètu dhèu aae masir. yusuf j'aj'i ènu ètu èmu potifar. ètu èèna, lamatua dènge yusuf, ka sasab'a ngaa dhu na tao, nèti babe'a hua-hua.

source_text: and his master saw that the lord was with him, making everything he did go well.
target_text: dhèu kapai ne'e ladhe-ladhe na, sasab'a yusuf nèti babe'a hua, ka na ngee ètu d'ara na, lamatua tare'a-re'a dènge yusuf.

source_text: and having a high opinion of joseph as his servant, he made him the overseer of his house and gave him control over all he had.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, komedhaa ne'e d'èi yusuf, ka na lèka ne. hèia na ded'e ne j'aj'i madho ètu èmu na. aa, na hia ne paredha d'ara èmu nèngu, sèmi èèna kahèi, mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and from the time when he made him overseer and gave him control of all his property, the blessing of the lord was with the egyptian, because of joseph; the blessing of the lord was on all he had, in the house and in the field.
target_text: lula yusuf pea ètu èèna, ka lamatua hia mamuri hua iia mi lamatua èmu, dhèu masir èèna. isi èmu na, mèdha-panyau na, oka-tedhe na, aa sasab'a-la'a na, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: and he gave joseph control of all his property, keeping no account of anything, but only the food which was put before him. now joseph was very beautiful in form and face.
target_text: lula potifar ladhe-ladhe la'a na yusuf sab'a dènge be'a, ka na pangee heka ngaa-ngaa, dhoka na'a-ninu di. yusuf ne, mone iia.

source_text: and after a time, his master's wife, looking on joseph with desire, said to him, be my lover.
target_text: na pea ètu èèna nèbhu mèka. te ngaa dhèu èmu potifar na, d'èi yusuf. ka na mai pamako ne ho dua ra j'unu pa'èci.

source_text: but he would not, and said to her, you see that my master keeps no account of what i do in his house, and has put all his property in my control;
target_text: te ngaa yusuf no'o boe. ka na peka sèmi ne'e ka, baku ina ee! ja'a ne, ènu potifar, dhu na pangèd'u le koasa ho ja'a tao ai-hèb'a mi sasab'a nèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: so that no one has more authority in this house than i have; he has kept nothing back from me but you, because you are his wife; how then may i do this great wrong, sinning against god?
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu koasa risi nèti ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara èmu ne'e, na saraka mi kacui-aai ja'a. dhodhoka ina ku di, aad'o. tasamia ka, ja'a bisa tao j'ara karehe ne'e. èèna lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and day after day she went on requesting joseph to come to her and be her lover, but he would not give ear to her.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu èmu potifar ne pakaseti taruu bèli-bèli. te ngaa yusuf ne tao boe madha-dhilu dènge ne.

source_text: now one day he went into the house to do his work; and not one of the men of the house was inside.
target_text: ca tèka, yusuf kako la'e asa d'ara èmu, ho sab'a sasab'a nèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu leo aad'o èci sa ètu èmu.

source_text: and pulling at his coat, she said, come to my bed; but slipping out of his coat, he went running away.
target_text: ka dhèu èmu potifar na raga mai ka, na kèpe kodho yusuf, ka na ère ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, mai! ata dhodhoka èdhi dua ti. de mai ho ti j'unu. te ngaa yusuf d'èi boe. ka na parui, hèia kodho na bhoke eele nèti ua na, ka na rai asa li'u. aa kodho deo na ètu kacui-aai bhèni èèna era.

source_text: and when she saw that he had got away, letting her keep his coat,
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu potifar ladhe laa, na, yusuf rai li'u le la'e, aa kodho na tèke eele,

source_text: she sent for the men of her house and said to them, see, he has let a hebrew come here and make sport of us; he came to my bed, and i gave a loud cry; and hearing it he went running out without his coat.
target_text: hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a sèra, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, we! miu mai ladhe ku laa! deo na, ana mone dhèu ibrani na, maso sa d'ara kama ja'a. na neo pamakae ja'a. malo ka ja'a pa'oo, ka na rai, tèke eele kodho na ètu ja'a ne. dhèu èmu ja'a ne, nèti dhèu bhelu asa d'ara èmu, ho hia èdhi ta'e makae!

source_text: and she kept his coat by her, till his master came back.
target_text: bhèni na kèpe pa'ère kodho èèna, toke d'ai dhèu èmu na lèpa.

source_text: then she gave him the same story, saying, the hebrew servant whom you have taken into our house came in to make sport of me;
target_text: ropa dhèu èmu na nare d'ara èmu, na lolo peka na, a'a! dhèu ibrani dhu mèti mai sa èmu ne'e, deo na maso asa d'ara kama ja'a, neo pakarehe ja'a!

source_text: and when i gave a loud cry he went running out without his coat.
target_text: malo ka ja'a pa'oo, paroa ana sab'a se'e. hèia na rai tèke eele kodho na, ka ne'e.

source_text: and hearing his wife's account of what his servant had done, he became very angry.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu èmu na, potifar nasa bia.

source_text: and joseph's master took him and put him in prison, in the place where the king's prisoners were kept in chains, and he was there in the prison-house.
target_text: hèia na paredha ka dhèu lasi kèpe yusuf. ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho dhèu aae.

source_text: but the lord was with joseph, and was good to him, and made the keeper of the prison his friend.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua bhèlu boe yusuf. nèti èèna ka, lamatua ladhe-leru ne taruu, ka kapala ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, sue yusuf ae titu kèna.

source_text: and the keeper of the prison put all the prisoners under joseph's control, and he was responsible for whatever was done there.
target_text: na lèka yusuf, ka hia ne j'aj'i madho ho laladhe ana bèdho sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. aa, hia na lalau sasab'a ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and the keeper of the prison gave no attention to anything which was under his care, because the lord was with him; and the lord made everything he did go well.
target_text: lula lèka ne, ka kapala èmu bèdho na, tao heka ai-hèb'a mi ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho èèna. lamatua ladhe-leru taruu yusuf, nèti èèna ka, sasab'a ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho na kako dènge be'a.

source_text: now after these things the chief servant who had the care of the wine, and the chief bread-maker in pharaoh's house, did something against pharaoh's orders; and pharaoh was angry with his two servants, with the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker; and he put them in prison under the care of the captain of the army, in the same prison where joseph himself was shut up.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu dua, dhu uru na j'aj'i kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae masir. èci lalau dhua èi dhèu aae. aa èci hari lalau roti dhèu aae. dua ra tao pasala dhèu aae. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aae nasa, ka na pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. dua ra pea ètu era èci dènge yusuf.

source_text: and the captain put them in joseph's care, and he did what was needed for them; and they were kept in prison for some time.
target_text: kapala èmu bèdho na, paredha yusuf lalau dhèu dua se'e. ra ètu d'ara bèdho na, ele boe ca tèu do dua tèu le.

source_text: and these two had a dream on the same night; the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker of the king of egypt, who were in prison, the two of them had dreams with a special sense.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, dua ra nii. ca dhèu ka dènge nii na. aa, lii nii dua sèra, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: and in the morning when joseph came to them he saw that they were looking sad.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yusuf ladhe na dua ra rèhu susa.

source_text: and he said to the servants of pharaoh who were in prison with him, why are you looking so sad?
target_text: ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka mad'ae ne'e, miu dua mi roe-roe?

source_text: then they said to him, we have had a dream, and no one is able to give us the sense. and joseph said, does not the sense of dreams come from god? what was your dream?
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mèda deo na, ji'i nii. te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe sasoa na samia! hèia yusuf peka dènge dua ra, aku nèngu na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, èci sa re'a boe sasoa nii, dhodhoka ama lamatua di. de miu lolo ku laa. pe èèna ho ja'a karèi sasoa nèti lamatua.

source_text: then the chief wine-servant gave joseph an account of his dream, and said, in my dream i saw a vine before me;
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae èèna, lolo uuru peka na, ètu d'ara nii, ja'a ladhe kèdhi aj'u anggor ca kapua.

source_text: and on the vine were three branches; and it seemed as if it put out buds and flowers, and from them came grapes ready for cutting.
target_text: aj'u anggor ne dadana nèngu tèlu di. aj'u na muri mai ka dènge rèu, hela, dènge hua giru-gari dhu madhasa.

source_text: and pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and i took the grapes and crushing them into pharaoh's cup, gave the cup into pharaoh's hand.
target_text: aa ja'a kèd'u galaa dhu dhèu aae biasa pake ninu. ja'a puu hua anggor, ka pacèli èi sa d'ara galaa deo na. hèia kèti asa dhèu aae, hia na ninu.

source_text: then joseph said, this is the sense of your dream: the three branches are three days;
target_text: tadèngi nare hèia, yusuf peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e ka, ama, ee. sasoa nii na sèmi ne'e ka: dadana tèlu, sasoa na di tèlu lod'o ka.

source_text: after three days pharaoh will give you honour, and put you back into your place, and you will give him his cup as you did before, when you were his wine-servant.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, dhèu aae kalua eele ama nèti d'ara bèdho ne'e. ho na hia hari, ama lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae sèmi uru na.

source_text: but keep me in mind when things go well for you, and be good to me and say a good word for me to pharaoh and get me out of this prison:
target_text: ladhe ama abhu babe'a sèmi èèna, baku bhèlu ja'a, ee? ladhe ama sue ja'a, peka dènge dhèu aae kalua eele ja'a nèti era ne'e.

source_text: for truly i was taken by force from the land of the hebrews; and i have done nothing for which i might be put in prison.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: now when the chief bread-maker saw that the first dream had a good sense, he said to joseph, i had a dream; and in my dream there were three baskets of white bread on my head;
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: and in the top basket were all sorts of cooked meats for pharaoh; and the birds were taking them out of the baskets on my head.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: then joseph said, this is the sense of your dream: the three baskets are three days;
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: after three days pharaoh will take you out of prison, hanging you on a tree, so that your flesh will be food for birds.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: now the third day was pharaoh's birthday, and he gave a feast for all his servants; and he gave honour to the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker among the others.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and he put the chief wine-servant back in his old place; and he gave the cup into pharaoh's hand.
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: but the chief bread-maker was put to death by hanging, as joseph had said.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: but the wine-servant did not keep joseph in mind or give a thought to him.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: now after two years had gone by, pharaoh had a dream; and in his dream he was by the side of the nile;
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and out of the nile came seven cows, good-looking and fat, and their food was the river-grass.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and after them seven other cows came out of the nile, poor-looking and thin; and they were by the side of the other cows.
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: and the seven thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows. then pharaoh came out of his sleep.
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: but he went to sleep again and had a second dream, in which he saw seven heads of grain, full and good, all on one stem.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: and after them came up seven other heads, thin and wasted by the east wind.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: and the seven thin heads made a meal of the good heads. and when pharaoh was awake he saw it was a dream.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: and in the morning his spirit was troubled; and he sent for all the wise men of egypt and all the holy men, and put his dream before them, but no one was able to give him the sense of it.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: then the chief wine-servant said to pharaoh, the memory of my sin comes back to me now;
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: pharaoh had been angry with his servants, and had put me in prison in the house of the captain of the army, together with the chief bread-maker;
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: and we had a dream on the same night, the two of us, and the dreams had a special sense.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: and there was with us a young hebrew, the captain's servant, and when we put our dreams before him, he gave us the sense of them.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: and it came about as he said: i was put back in my place, and the bread-maker was put to death by hanging.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.
