source_text: then pharaoh sent for joseph, and they took him quickly out of prison; and when his hair had been cut and his dress changed, he came before pharaoh.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said to joseph, i have had a dream, and no one is able to give me the sense of it; now it has come to my ears that you are able to give the sense of a dream when it is put before you.
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: then joseph said, without god there will be no answer of peace for pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: then pharaoh said, in my dream i was by the side of the nile:
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and out of the nile came seven cows, fat and good-looking, and their food was the river-grass;
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: then after them came seven other cows, very thin and poor-looking, worse than any i ever saw in the land of egypt;
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and the thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows who came up first;
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: and even with the fat cows inside them they seemed as bad as before. and so i came out of my sleep.
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: and again in a dream i saw seven heads of grain, full and good, coming up on one stem:
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: and then i saw seven other heads, dry, thin, and wasted by the east wind, coming up after them:
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: and the seven thin heads made a meal of the seven good heads; and i put this dream before the wise men, but not one of them was able to give me the sense of it.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: then joseph said, these two dreams have the same sense: god has made clear to pharaoh what he is about to do.
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: the seven fat cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years: the two have the same sense.
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: the seven thin and poor-looking cows who came up after them are seven years; and the seven heads of grain, dry and wasted by the east wind, are seven years when there will be no food.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: as i said to pharaoh before, god has made clear to him what he is about to do.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: seven years are coming in which there will be great wealth of grain in egypt;
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: and after that will come seven years when there will not be enough food; and the memory of the good years will go from men's minds; and the land will be made waste by the bad years; and men will have no memory of the good time because of the need which will come after, for it will be very bitter.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: and this dream came to pharaoh twice, because this thing is certain, and god will quickly make it come about.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: and now let pharaoh make search for a man of wisdom and good sense, and put him in authority over the land of egypt.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: let pharaoh do this, and let him put overseers over the land of egypt to put in store a fifth part of the produce of the land in the good years.
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: and let them get together all the food in those good years and make a store of grain under pharaoh's control for the use of the towns, and let them keep it.
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: and let that food be kept in store for the land till the seven bad years which are to come in egypt; so that the land may not come to destruction through need of food.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: and this seemed good to pharaoh and to all his servants.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: then pharaoh said to his servants, where may we get such a man as this, a man in whom is the spirit of god?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: and pharaoh said to joseph, seeing that god has made all this clear to you, there is no other man of such wisdom and good sense as you:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: you, then, are to be over my house, and all my people will be ruled by your word: only as king will i be greater than you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: and pharaoh said to joseph, see, i have put you over all the land of egypt. then pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on joseph's hand, and he had him clothed with the best linen, and put a chain of gold round his neck;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: and he made him take his seat in the second of his carriages; and they went before him crying, make way! so he made him ruler over all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: then pharaoh said to joseph, i am pharaoh; and without your order no man may do anything in all the land of egypt.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and pharaoh gave joseph the name of zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him asenath, the daughter of poti-phera, the priest of on, to be his wife. so joseph went through all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: now joseph was thirty years old when he came before pharaoh, king of egypt. and joseph went out from before the face of pharaoh and went through all the land of egypt.
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: now in the seven good years the earth gave fruit in masses.
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and joseph got together all the food of those seven years, and made a store of food in the towns: the produce of the fields round every town was stored up in the town.
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: so he got together a store of grain like the sand of the sea; so great a store that after a time he gave up measuring it, for it might not be measured.
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: and before the time of need, joseph had two sons, to whom asenath, the daughter of poti-phera, priest of on, gave birth.
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and to the first he gave the name manasseh, for he said, god has taken away from me all memory of my hard life and of my father's house.
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: and to the second he gave the name ephraim, for he said, god has given me fruit in the land of my sorrow.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: and so the seven good years in egypt came to an end.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: then came the first of the seven years of need as joseph had said: and in every other land they were short of food; but in the land of egypt there was bread.
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: and when all the land of egypt was in need of food, the people came crying to pharaoh for bread; and pharaoh said to the people, go to joseph, and whatever he says to you, do it.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: and everywhere on the earth they were short of food; then joseph, opening all his store-houses, gave the people of egypt grain for money; so great was the need of food in the land of egypt.
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: and all lands sent to egypt, to joseph, to get grain, for the need was great over all the earth.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: now jacob, hearing that there was grain in egypt, said to his sons, why are you looking at one another?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: and he said, i have had news that there is grain in egypt: go down there and get grain for us, so that life and not death may be ours.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: so joseph's ten brothers went down to get grain from egypt.
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: but jacob did not send benjamin, joseph's brother, with them, for fear, as he said, that some evil might come to him.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and the sons of israel came with all the others to get grain: for they were very short of food in the land of canaan.
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: now joseph was ruler over all the land, and it was he who gave out the grain to all the people of the land; and joseph's brothers came before him and went down on their faces to the earth.
target_text: tèu èèna, yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, yusuf ka dhu pahia. nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.

source_text: and when joseph saw his brothers, it was clear to him who they were, but he made himself strange to them, and talking roughly to them, said, where do you come from? and they said, from the land of canaan, to get food. now though joseph saw that these were his brothers, they had no idea who he was.
target_text: ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. te ngaa yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu masir. nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, ee! miu se nèti mia? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i se nèti kana'an. ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.

source_text: then the memory of his dreams about them came back to joseph, and he said to them, you have come secretly to see how poor the land is.
target_text: hèia yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, ja'a lèka boe! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. miu mai tenge rahasia rai masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!

source_text: and they said to him, not so, my lord: your servants have come with money to get food.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, aad'o, ama! ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. leo nèti èèna, aad'o.

source_text: we are all one man's sons, we are true men; we have not come with any secret purpose.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: and he said to them, no, but you have come to see how poor the land is.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf jèka si dènge lii mèdhu hari, peka na, he! omo koso! baku kapod'e-kabèli ja'a. miu se'e tare'a-re'a dhèu bhelu. miu mai tenge rahasia rai ne'e!

source_text: then they said, we your servants are twelve brothers, sons of one man in the land of canaan; the youngest of us is now with our father, and one is dead.
target_text: ka ra peka, aad'o ama! ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. ji'i mai nèti rai kana'an. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: and joseph said, it is as i said; you have come with some secret purpose;
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.

source_text: but in this way will you be put to the test: by the life of pharaoh, you will not go away from this place till your youngest brother comes here.
target_text: na! karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. ja'a subha ee! ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!

source_text: send one of your number to get your brother, and the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are true; if not, by the life of pharaoh, your purpose is certainly secret.
target_text: de hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

source_text: so he put them in prison for three days.
target_text: ka yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and on the third day joseph said to them, do this, if you would keep your lives: for i am a god-fearing man:
target_text: d'ai lod'o ka tèlu, yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge lamatua. aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi na taruu. sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.

source_text: if you are true men, let one of you be kept in prison, while you go and take grain for the needs of your families;
target_text: ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. j'ara na sèmi ne'e: ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.

source_text: and come back to me with your youngest brother, so that your words may be seen to be true, and you will not be put to death. this is what you are to do.
target_text: d'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they said to one another, truly, we did wrong to our brother, for we saw his grief of mind, and we did not give ear to his prayers; that is why this trouble has come on us.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, waa! ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and reuben said to them, did i not say to you, do the child no wrong? but you gave no attention; so now, punishment has come on us for his blood.
target_text: hèia ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, we! ari-ari ja'a, ee! uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi yusuf èèna.

source_text: they were not conscious that the sense of their words was clear to joseph, for he had been talking to them through one who had knowledge of their language.
target_text: rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. lod'o yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii ibrani.

source_text: and turning away from them, he was overcome with weeping; then he went on talking to them again and took simeon and put chains on him before their eyes.
target_text: tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. ka na pua dhèu èki simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: then joseph gave orders for their bags to be made full of grain, and for every man's money to be put back into his bag, and for food to be given them for the journey: which was done.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu yusuf paredha.

source_text: then they put the bags of grain on their asses and went away.
target_text: èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: now at their night's resting-place one of them, opening his bag to give his ass some food, saw his money in the mouth of the bag.
target_text: ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

source_text: and he said to his brothers, my money has been given back: it is in my bag; then their hearts became full of fear, and turning to one another they said, what is this which god has done to us?
target_text: capa na cag'ag'a! hèia na paroa a'a na si, peka na, irii! miu mai ladhe ku laa! madhe èdhi kèna. ra tao hari doi ja'a asa d'ara karo ne. ladhe rèdhi èèna ka, ra ele ngangee, aa madha'u bia. ka ra papeka ka, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua tao èdhi samia ka ne?

source_text: so when they came to jacob their father, in the land of canaan, they gave him an account of all their experiences, saying,
target_text: hèia ra kako taruu ka, lasi d'ai kana'an. d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, ngaa dhu rèngu paraga ètu rai masir.

source_text: the man who is the ruler of the country was rough with us and put us in prison, saying that we had come with a secret evil purpose.
target_text: ra lolo, peka na, ama, ee! ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, bhelu titu kèna. na jèka taruu ji'i. na peka na ji'i la'a j'aj'i mata-mata ho neo pa'ele iie rai masir.

source_text: and we said to him, we are true men, we have no evil designs;
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa, peka na, ‘aad'o! ji'i se'e padhai lii mola-mola. ji'i mata-mata boe.

source_text: we are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is dead, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of canaan.
target_text: ji'i se'e, dhèu be'a-be'a. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi, j'aj'i nèti ca ama, dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa èci madhe le. aa ari dhu limuri èèna, dènge ama ji'i ètu kana'an. '

source_text: and the ruler of the land said, in this way i may be certain that you are true men; let one of you be kept here with me, while you go and take grain for the needs of your families;
target_text: na peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo kèdhi, na, miu se'e dhèu be'a, do aad'o! miu èci, pea mi ne'e. aa leo lèpa mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, sèna ka ra baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and come back to me with your youngest brother: then i will be certain that you are true men, and i will give your brother back to you and let you do trade in the land.
target_text: hud'i miu mèti ku ari miu èèna mai sa ne'e, heka ja'a ke'a kèna, tare'a-re'a miu se'e dhèu be'a, mata-mata boe. èèna na, heka ja'a patabuli dhèu miu dhu ja'a taha ne. aa dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a heka ko'o kèna, miu kako palème dedha rai ne'e. '

source_text: and when they took the grain out of their bags, it was seen that every man's parcel of money was in his bag; and when they and their father saw the money, they were full of fear.
target_text: lolo èle hèia, heka ra bhoke karo-karo rèngu dhu pènu dènge are sèra. te ngaa ra cag'ag'a ladhe la'a na doi rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu hèb'a karo. rèdhi sèmi èèna, yakob dènge ana-ana na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and jacob their father said to them, you have taken my children from me: joseph is gone and simeon is gone, and now you would take benjamin away; all these things have come on me.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge si, peka na, miu se, pa'ele le ana-ana ja'a. yusuf aad'o heka. sèmi èèna kahèi, simeon. ne'e miu neo mèti hari benyamin kèna? miu se'e, tare'a-re'a neo paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and reuben said, put my two sons to death if i do not come back to you with him; let him be in my care and i will give him safely back to you.
target_text: hèia ruben peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! pangèd'u laa benyamin asa ja'a mai. ja'a tago kore. ja'a jaji kèna mi ama ku, èèna ja'a kèti hari na mai. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na ja'a hia ana ja'a, mone dhèu dua sèra ho ama pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: and he said, i will not let my son go down with you; for his brother is dead and he is all i have: if evil overtakes him on the journey, then through you will my grey head go down to the underworld in sorrow.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhaa hari, peka na, bisa boe! miu bisa boe mèti benyamin. te a'a na yusuf, madhe le. ne'e, di nèngu ka mesa na. ladhe na abhu calaka ètu j'ara, miu tabha babia mi ja'a, toke madhe kèti.

source_text: now the land was in bitter need of food.
target_text: tèu èèna, ètu rai kana'an asa tabha manganga.

source_text: and when the grain which they had got in egypt was all used up, their father said to them, go again and get us a little food.
target_text: isi èmu yakob ra'a aa'i le nganga'a dhu ca hari na, ana na si lasi hèli ètu masir. ka na padhai lii dènge ana na si, be'a risi lami hari hèli nganga'a asa rai masir.

source_text: and judah said to him, the man said to us with an oath, you are not to come before me again without your brother.
target_text: te ngaa yahuda b'ala, peka na, ama, ca hari na ai g'ana dhèu aae masir dhu pasanèd'e le ji'i, aku nèngu na, ji'i bisa boe pad'elo rèhu mi nèngu, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri, benyamin èèna.

source_text: if you will let our brother go with us, we will go down and get food:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku hud'i laa hia ji'i ngèti benyamin. heka ji'i bisa la'a hèli nganga'a hia ama ku kèna.

source_text: but if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said to us, you are not to come before me if your brother is not with you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama patabuli boe nèngu, ji'i oo la'a boe kahèi. lula dhèu masir na peka le sèmi èèna.

source_text: and israel said, why were you so cruel to me as to say to him that you had a brother?
target_text: hèia yakob jèke si, peka na, nga tao ka miu lolo dènge dhèu èèna, peka na, miu dènge ari èci era? miu tenge j'ara ho paj'èra tabha ja'a!

source_text: and they said, the man put a number of questions to us about ourselves and our family, saying, is your father still living? have you another brother? and we had to give him answers; how were we to have any idea that he would say, come back with your brother?
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, baku nasa ama, ee! te lula dhèu ne, karèi taruu-taruu neo ne'a a'ari èdhi. na karèi peka na, ‘tasamia? ama mi era, do? miu dènge hari ari dhèu mone dhu leo, do? ' sèmi èèna na, ji'i dhaa tasamia hari? pakaseti ka ji'i dhaa ka laa, dènge mola-mola. te pe, cee ne'a na pua ji'i ngèti hari ari ji'i sa nèi?

source_text: then judah said to israel, his father, send the boy with me, and let us be up and going, so that we and you and our little ones may not come to destruction. put him into my care and make me responsible for him: if i do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.
target_text: ka yahuda padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama hud'i patabuli ku benyamin la'e dènge ji'i. ja'a jaji mema, ladhe j'aj'i ngaa-ngaa mi ngi'u ari ji'i ne'e, ja'a ka dhu gati ne. ladhe ja'a kèti heka nèngu mai asa d'ara kacui-aai ama ku dènge mamuri, hud'i laa sasala na ama ku pasae mi dedha ja'a toke madhe. nèti èèna ka, ama ku hia la, ho ji'i sama-sama la'a dènge ne, te ji'i neo pakèd'i kèna. de karohe mai lati ka, sèna ka cahag'e baku madhe manganga.

source_text: truly, if we had not let the time go by, we might have come back again by now.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èdhi mate boe panèbhu sèmi ne'e, na, èdhi lati-mai dua hari le.

source_text: then their father israel said to them, if it has to be so, then do this: take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels to give the man, perfumes and honey and spices and nuts:
target_text: hèia ama ra padhai lii, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, miu nanene! lami mere isi rai èdhi dhu be'a risi, sèmi: dhua nasu oni, bubhu-bubhu, raa aj'u hèu mèngi, èi na'i salap, kanari dènge kab'ui dhu leo sèra. ho sèna ka mèti hia ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna. aa peka dènge ne, ne'e ne tadha mata.

source_text: and take twice as much money with you; that is to say, take back the money which was put in your bags, for it may have been an error;
target_text: aa miu mèti doi risi eele nèti ca hari ni, sèna ka miu bisa hia hari doi kab'ua are uru sèra la'a, dhu miu mèdhi ètu d'ara karo miu sèra. tao-tao dhèu sèra re'a boe, ka tèka sala.

source_text: and take your brother and go back to the man:
target_text: miu mèti ari mu. de èèna na lèpa hari lai-lai!

source_text: and may god, the ruler of all, give you mercy before the man, so that he may give you back your other brother and benjamin. if my children are to be taken from me; there is no help for it.
target_text: ja'a sanao-maena, sèna ka, ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi eele èèna, sab'a mi d'ara ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, sèna ka na sue miu. aa na hia hari benyamin dènge simeon lèpa palere dènge miu. te, ladhe ana ja'a se ele, hud'i laa ja'a pasae j'aj'èra ne'e taruu.

source_text: so they took what their father said for the man, and twice as much money in their hands, and benjamin, and went on their journey to egypt, and came before joseph.
target_text: hèia lasi pakaboko tadha mata sèra dènge doi, ka lasi asa masir. rèti kahèi dènge benyamin. d'ai nèi ka lasi paraga dènge yusuf.

source_text: and when joseph saw benjamin, he said to his chief servant, take these men into my house, and make ready a meal, for they will take food with me in the middle of the day.
target_text: ropa yusuf nèdhi benyamin dènge a'a na si, na pua kapala urusan na, aku nèngu na, lere mèti dhèu se'e sa èmu ja'a! ho èèna na, pare sapi ci'u, mi pananasu nganga'a dhu be'a. sèna ka lod'o nètu none, ra'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: and the servant did as joseph said, and took the men into joseph's house.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna, tao sama sèmi lii paredha yusuf èèna. na lere nèti dhèu sèra asa èmu yusuf.

source_text: now the men were full of fear because they had been taken into joseph's house and they said, it is because of the money which was put back in our bags the first time; he is looking for something against us, so that he may come down on us and take us and our asses for his use.
target_text: ropa ra kako lasi èmu èèna, a'a na sèra madha'u bia. ètu talora j'ara, ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! nga tao ka na pua rèti èdhi sa ne'e? mage dhoka na neo pasusa èdhi. lula doi dhu ra tao hari asa d'ara karo èdhi ca hari na. ra sangaja rèti èdhi sa ne'e, sèna ka ra kèpa èdhi j'aj'i ènu nèngu. ho èèna na, ra parama rara keled'ei èdhi sèra.

source_text: so they went up to joseph's chief servant at the door of the house,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa ra dètu èmu yusuf na, ra padhai lii dènge kapala urusan èèna, peka na,

source_text: and said, o my lord, we only came down the first time to get food;
target_text: ama! baku nasa dènge ji'i, te ca hari na dhu ji'i mai hèli nganga'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: and when we came to our night's resting-place, on opening our bags we saw that every man's money was in the mouth of his bag, all our money in full weight: and we have it with us to give it back; as well as more money, with which to get food: we have no idea who put our money in our bags.
target_text: ropa ji'i lèpa d'ai talora j'ara, ji'i ae ngara iisi, ho bhèj'i ciki. hèia ji'i bhoke karo ho neo panga'a badha. ladhe la'a na, doi bab'ae ji'i èci-èci ka ètu d'ara karo sèra. ji'i nge'a boe cee ka dhu tao la'a! nèti èèna ka, ji'i ngèti hari doi sèra ka se'e. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama ku baku nasa. aa ji'i ngèti doi ka risi kahèi, neo hèli hari nganga'a.

source_text: then the servant said, peace be with you: have no fear: your god, even the god of your father, has put wealth in your bags for you: i had your money. then he let simeon come out to them.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna dhaa, aku nèngu na, mau-mau, baku madha'u! ele boe lamatua miu èèna ka dhu hia miu berkat ètu d'ara karo sèra. ca hari na, ja'a sèmi le doi miu aa'i-aa'i. miu pakèlu boe! d'ai èmu ka, na patalale simeon pa'èci dènge rèngu.

source_text: and the servant took them into joseph's house, and gave them water for washing their feet; and he gave their asses food.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa d'ara èmu yusuf. hèia kapala urusan èèna hia èi ho ra rase haga ra. aa na ani keled'ei si hèi.

source_text: and they got ready the things for joseph before he came in the middle of the day: for word was given to them that they were to have a meal there.
target_text: ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ladhe èèna na, lod'o nètu miu mi'a dènge ai g'ana dhèu aae. d'ara ra tatae yusuf lèpa, rèngu lalau paie tadha mata ra sèra.

source_text: and when joseph came in, they gave him the things which they had for him, and went down to the earth before him.
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai èmu, aa'i-aa'i ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. ka ra j'ole tadha mata sa hia ne.

source_text: and he said, how are you? is your father well, the old man of whom you were talking to me? is he still living?
target_text: hèia yusuf karèi si, peka na, tasamia? miu be'a-be'a, do? tasamia dènge ama miu dhu heka èèna? na be'a-be'a, do?

source_text: and they said, your servant, our father, is well, he is still living. and they went down on their faces before him.
target_text: ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ènu ama dhu heka na, dhu ama matana ji'i, be'a-be'a. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi hari mi yusuf.

source_text: then, lifting up his eyes, he saw benjamin, his brother, his mother's son, and he said, is this your youngest brother of whom you gave me word? and he said, god be good to you, my son.
target_text: hèia yusuf ladhe palème, ka nèdhi ari na benyamin. rèngu dua ra se, ina-ama èci. hèia, aku nèngu na, ooo! ne'e ne ka ari miu dhu limuri, dhu ca hari na miu lolo èèna, do? ka na lii dènge benyamin, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a sanao, sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: then joseph's heart went out to his brother, and he went quickly into his room, for he was overcome with weeping.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi benyamin ne, d'ara yusuf karej'e bia, lula na sue ari na ae titu kèna. na taha nare heka d'ara na. ka na kako eele si la'e sa d'ara kama na. ka na tangi ngob'i-ngob'i ètu èèna.

source_text: then, after washing his face, he came out, and controlling his feelings said, put food before us.
target_text: tangi nare hèia, la'e riu katanga madha na. èle èèna ka, na pa'èra d'ara na, ka la'e hari paraga dènge si. hèia na pua dhèu sab'a sèra lasi lalau nganga'a.

source_text: and they put a meal ready for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the egyptians who were with him by themselves; because the egyptians may not take food with the hebrews, for that would make them unclean.
target_text: ra lalau nganga'a hia yusuf mei leo. aa a'ari na sèra ra'a mei leo. dhèu sab'a dhèu masir sèra, ra'a ètu mei rèngu mesa ra. lula dhèu masir sèra madenge ladhe madhèdi ra'a pa'èci dènge dhèu ibrani.

source_text: and they were all given their seats before him in order of birth, from the oldest to the youngest: so that they were looking at one another in wonder.
target_text: kapala urusan èèna ator sèna ka a'ari yusuf sèra, madhèdi patangara dènge yusuf. na ator hia si madhèdi mulai nèti a'a uru, padhutu-dhutu toke ari ra dhu limuri. ropa ra ladhe rèdhi j'ara madhèdi sèmi èèna, ra malaa.

source_text: and joseph sent food to them from his table, but he sent five times as much to benjamin as to any of the others. and they took wine freely with him.
target_text: yusuf pua dhèu sab'a sèra, bagi nganga'a nèti mei nèngu, hia a'ari na sèra. aa'i-aa'i ra abhu nganga'a dhu ae sama. dhoka benyamin di abhu ae risi a'a na si lèmi hari. ka ra'a-rinu d'ai bècu.

source_text: then he gave orders to the servant who was over his house, saying, put as much food into the men's bags as will go into them, and put every man's money in the mouth of his bag;
target_text: ra'a-rinu rara hèia, yusuf paholo dènge kapala urusan na, aku nèngu na, ssst! èu lamu isi are asa d'ara karo dhèu sèi, papènu d'ai hèb'a. èle èèna na, èu tao hari doi ra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci.

source_text: and put my cup, my silver cup, in the youngest one's bag, with his money. so he did as joseph said.
target_text: aa more moo hualaa pudhi ja'a èèna, ho tao asa d'ara hèb'a karo ari ra dhu limuri èèna. ka na la'e tao madhutu lii paredha yusuf.

source_text: and at dawn the men, with their asses, were sent away.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara cika lii sa, yusuf hia si lèpa. rèti nganga'a dènge keled'ei rèngu.

source_text: and when they had gone only a little way out of the town, joseph said to the servant who was over his house, go after them; and when you overtake them, say to them, why have you done evil in reward for good?
target_text: ra lasi dhae kaj'èu mèka nèti d'ara kota, ka yusuf paredha kapala urusan, peka na, èu karohe lamu magèla si. ladhe paraga dènge si, èu peka sèmi ne'e: ‘nga tao ka miu pake d'ara aapa sèmi èèna mi ai g'ana dhèu aae? miu b'ala babe'a na dènge tatao karehe sèmi ne'e!

source_text: is not this the cup from which my lord takes wine and by which he gets knowledge of the future? truly, you have done evil.
target_text: nga tao ka, miu mana'u mèti moo hualaa pudhi na? miu me'a boe, do? mèdha èèna na, na pake boe ho dhoka ninu di! te ngaa biasa na pake ho ne'a tasamia dènge mamuri dhèu. èèna, mèdha sogo-tagu! tatao miu ne, mema seli-kolane! '

source_text: so he overtook them and said these words to them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kapala urusan èèna la'e magèle si toke abhu. ropa na raga si, hèia na peka sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf moa èèna.

source_text: and they said to him, why does my lord say such words as these? far be it from your servants to do such a thing:
target_text: ka ra bari ne, aku rèngu na, ama peka ngaa èèna? ji'i subha. ji'i se'e bisa boe tao karehe sèmi èèna!

source_text: see, the money which was in the mouth of our bags we gave back to you when we came again from canaan: how then might we take silver or gold from your lord's house?
target_text: ama, èu me'a era, si ma? doi-doi ca hari sa, dhu ètu d'ara karo ji'i sèra, ji'i hia hari le sa ama, to? tasamia ka ji'i bisa mana'u hualaa iia do hualaa pudhi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kapai èèna! bisa boe!

source_text: if it comes to light that any of your servants has done this, let him be put to death, and we will be your lord's servants.
target_text: ama parisa la! ladhe abhu mèdha èèna ètu d'ara karo cee, na huku pamadhe ne! aa hud'i laa, ji'i dhu leo se'e, j'aj'i ènu èu.

source_text: and he said, let it be as you say: he in whose bag it is seen will become my servant; and you will not be responsible.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan na dhaa, peka na, aad'o! sèmi ne'e. ladhe abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na dhoka nèngu di j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo lèpa.

source_text: then every man quickly got his bag down and undid it.
target_text: ra papuru ka karo sèra. ka ra bhoke dènge.

source_text: and he made a search, starting with the oldest and ending with the youngest; and the cup was in benjamin's bag.
target_text: hèia kapala urusan èèna parisa karo sèra èci-èci, mulai nèti karo unu a'a na, toke d'ai ari limuri tèka. ka nèdhi moo èèna, ètu d'ara karo benyamin.

source_text: then in bitter grief they put the bags on the asses again and went back to the town.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna hèia, d'ara a'a na sèra j'èra ma'ète mae-mae sène. hèia ra paca'e hari ka karo deo sa asa dedha keled'ei, ka ra lèpa hari asa d'ara kota.

source_text: so judah and his brothers came to joseph's house; and he was still there: and they went down on their faces before him.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai èmu yusuf, na ètu èmu era. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na.

source_text: and joseph said, what is this thing which you have done? had you no thought that such a man as i would have power to see what is secret?
target_text: yusuf jèka si, aku nèngu na, he! nga tao ka miu tao ne'e mi ja'a! miu me'a boe, ja'a ne dhèu kapai ètu ne'e. ja'a pake na'i dhu bisa ke'a tatao dhèu, dhu dhèu leo re'a boe!

source_text: and judah said, what are we to say to my lord? how may we put ourselves right in his eyes? god has made clear the sin of your servants: now we are in your hands, we and the man in whose bag your cup was seen.
target_text: hèia yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, irii! te ama lamatua pasabhoka kèna sasala èdhi. pe ji'i peka lii mia hari, ama? ji'i sili iisi sa mia hari? ladhe ama neo taha ari ji'i ne'e, na be'a risi, taha ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. more ji'i aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ènu ama ka laa.

source_text: then he said, far be it from me to do so: but the man who had my cup will be my servant; and you may go back to your father in peace.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na nèngu di dhu j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo, lèpa hari dènge mera-milu sa ama miu!

source_text: then judah came near him, and said, let your servant say a word in my lord's ears, and let not your wrath be burning against your servant: for you are in the place of pharaoh to us.
target_text: hèia yahuda la'e padètu asa madha yusuf, ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama wakil! ja'a ke'a koasa ama sama sèmi koasa dhèu aae! uru nèti èèna, ja'a manèngi ama baku nasa dènge ja'a. ja'a neo padhai lii ciki dènge ama.

source_text: my lord said to his servants, have you a father or a brother?
target_text: med'a na, ama karèi le ji'i, peka na, ‘ama miu, dènge ari miu dhu èci na, era do? '

source_text: and we said to my lord, we have an old father and a young child, whom he had when he was old; his brother is dead and he is the only son of his mother, and is very dear to his father.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa peka na, ‘ama ji'i heka d'ai seli le. aa ari ji'i dhu limuri èci. lod'o nara iisi ari ji'i ne'e, ama ji'i na heka le. ari ji'i dhu limuri ne'e dènge a'a d'èlu na èci, te ngaa na aad'o heka. ina ra madhe le. ka di nèngu ka mesa na. nèti èèna ka, ama ji'i ne sue ne titu kèna! '

source_text: and you said to your servants, let him come down to me with you, so that i may see him.
target_text: ka ama pua ho ji'i ngèti ari ji'i na mai, sèna ka ama nèdhi ne.

source_text: and we said to my lord, his father will not let him go; for if he went away his father would come to his death.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa na, ‘ana èèna, bisa boe tèke eele ama na mesa na. ladhe na tèke eele, na ama ji'i na tatu madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: but you said to your servants, if your youngest brother does not come with you, you will not see my face again.
target_text: hèia ama dhaa na, ‘ladhe miu mèti boe ari miu na, baku mi pad'elo hari rèhu mi sa ne'e. '

source_text: and when we went back to your servant, our father, we gave him an account of my lord's words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ji'i lèpa. d'ai nèi ka, ji'i lolo lii dhu mu moa sèra dènge ama ji'i.

source_text: and our father said, go again and get us a little food.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, nganga'a ji'i èla. hèia ama ji'i pua hari ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa masir ne'e.

source_text: and we said, only if our youngest brother goes with us will we go down; for we may not see the man's face again if our youngest brother is not with us.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i dhaa na, ‘ama, ee! ji'i la'a heka sa nèi. te ai g'ana dhèu aae na dhu moa le, aku nèngu na, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri na, bisa heka ji'i pad'elo rèhu sa nèi. de ladhe ari ji'i la'e hèi, na heka ji'i la'a kèna. '

source_text: and our father said to us, you have knowledge that my wife gave me two sons;
target_text: ama ji'i peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘miu me'a kahèi, si ma? dhèu èmu ja'a rahel èèna, ana na dhoka dua di.

source_text: the one went away from me, and i said, truly he has come to a violent death; and from that time i have not seen him,
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: if now you take this one from me, and some evil comes to him, you will make my grey head go down in sorrow to the underworld.
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: if then i go back to your servant, my father, without the boy, because his life and the boy's life are one, when he sees that the boy is not with us, he will come to his death, and our father's grey head will go down in sorrow to the underworld.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: for i made myself responsible for the boy to my father, saying, if i do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: so now let me be my lord's servant here in place of the boy, and let him go back with his brothers.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for how may i go back to my father without the boy, and see the evil which will come on my father?
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: then joseph, unable to keep back his feelings before those who were with him, gave orders for everyone to be sent away, and no one was present when he made clear to his brothers who he was.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and so loud was his weeping, that it came to the ears of the egyptians and all pharaoh's house.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: and joseph said to his brothers, i am joseph: is my father still living? but his brothers were not able to give him an answer for they were troubled before him.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: then joseph said to his brothers, come near to me. and they came near, and he said, i am joseph your brother, whom you sent into egypt.
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: now do not be troubled or angry with yourselves for sending me away, because god sent me before you to be the saviour of your lives.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for these two years have been years of need, and there are still five more years to come in which there will be no ploughing or cutting of grain.
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: god sent me before you to keep you and yours living on earth so that you might become a great nation.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: so now it was not you who sent me here, but god: and he has made me as a father to pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of egypt.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: now go quickly to my father, and say to him, your son joseph says, god has made me ruler over all the land of egypt: come down to me straight away:
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: the land of goshen will be your living-place, and you will be near me; you and your children and your children's children, and your flocks and herds and all you have:
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and there i will take care of you, so that you and your family may not be in need, for there are still five bad years to come.
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: now truly, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother benjamin see, that it is my mouth which says these things to you.
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: give my father word of all my glory in egypt and of all you have seen; and come back quickly with my father.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: then, weeping, he took benjamin in his arms, and benjamin himself was weeping on joseph's neck.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: then he gave a kiss to all his brothers, weeping over them; and after that his brothers had no fear of talking to him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and news of these things went through pharaoh's house, and it was said that joseph's brothers were come; and it seemed good to pharaoh and his servants.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said to joseph, say to your brothers, put your goods on your beasts and go back to the land of canaan;
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: and get your father and your families and come back to me: and i will give you all the good things of egypt, and the fat of the land will be your food.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: and say to them, this you are to do: take carts from the land of egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and get your father and come back.
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: and take no thought for your goods, for the best of all the land of egypt is yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and the children of israel did as he said; and joseph gave them carts as had been ordered by pharaoh, and food for their journey.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: to every one of them he gave three changes of clothing; but to benjamin he gave three hundred bits of silver and five changes of clothing.
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and to his father he sent ten asses with good things from egypt on their backs, and ten she-asses with grain and bread and food for his father on the journey.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: and he sent his brothers on their way, and said to them, see that you have no argument on the road.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: so they went up from egypt and came to the land of canaan, to their father jacob.
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and they said to him, joseph is living, and is ruler over all the land of egypt. and at this word jacob was quite overcome, for he had no faith in it.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: and they gave him an account of everything joseph had said to them; and when he saw the carts which joseph had sent for them, his spirit came back to him:
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and israel said, it is enough: joseph my son is still living; i will go and see him before my death.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: and israel went on his journey with all he had, and came to beer-sheba, where he made offerings to the god of his father isaac.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: and god said to israel in a night-vision, jacob, jacob. and he said, here am i.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: and he said, i am god, the god of your father: go down to egypt without fear, for i will make a great nation of you there:
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i will go down with you to egypt, and i will see that you come back again, and at your death joseph will put his hands on your eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: then jacob went on from beer-sheba; and the sons of jacob took their father and their little ones and their wives in the carts which pharaoh had sent for them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and they took their cattle and all the goods which they had got in the land of canaan, and came to egypt, even jacob and all his seed: his sons and his sons' sons, his daughters and his daughters' sons and all his family he took with him into egypt.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: and these are the names of the children of israel who came into egypt, even jacob and all his sons: reuben, jacob's oldest son;
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: and the sons of reuben: hanoch and pallu and hezron and carmi;
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: and the sons of simeon: jemuel and jamin and ohad and jachin and zohar and shaul, the son of a woman of canaan;
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: and the sons of levi: gershon, kohath, and merari;
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: and the sons of judah: er and onan and shelah and perez and zerah: but er and onan had come to their death in the land of canaan; and the sons of perez were hezron and hamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: and the sons of issachar: tola and puah and job and shimron;
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: and the sons of zebulun: sered and elon and jahleel;
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: all these, together with his daughter dinah, were the children of leah, whom jacob had by her in paddan-aram; they were thirty-three in number.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: and the sons of gad: ziphion and haggi, shuni and ezbon, eri and arodi and areli;
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: and the sons of asher: jimnah and ishvah and ishvi and beriah, and sarah, their sister; and the sons of beriah: heber and malchiel.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these are the children of zilpah, whom laban gave to his daughter leah, and jacob had these sixteen children by her.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: the sons of jacob's wife rachel: joseph and benjamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and joseph had manasseh and ephraim in the land of egypt, by asenath, the daughter of poti-phera, priest of on.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and the sons of benjamin were belah and becher and ashbel, gera and naaman, ehi and rosh, muppim and huppim and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: all these were the children of rachel whom jacob had by her, fourteen persons.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: and the son of dan was hushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: and the sons of naphtali: jahzeel and guni and jezer and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these were the children of bilhah, whom laban gave to his daughter rachel, seven persons.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: all the persons who came with jacob into egypt, the offspring of his body, were sixty-six, without taking into account the wives of jacob's sons.
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: and the sons of joseph whom he had in egypt were two. seventy persons of the family of jacob came into egypt.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: now he had sent judah before him to goshen, to get word from joseph; and so they came to the land of goshen.
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: and joseph got his carriage ready and went to goshen for the meeting with his father; and when he came before him, he put his arms round his neck, weeping.
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and israel said to joseph, now that i have seen you living again, i am ready for death.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and joseph said to his brothers and to his father's people, i will go and give the news to pharaoh, and say to him, my brothers and my father's people, from the land of canaan, have come to me;
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and these men are keepers of sheep and owners of cattle, and have with them their flocks and their herds and all they have.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: now when pharaoh sends for you and says, what is your business?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: you are to say, your servants have been keepers of cattle from our early days up to now, like our fathers; in this way you will be able to have the land of goshen for yourselves; because keepers of sheep are unclean in the eyes of the egyptians.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: then joseph went to pharaoh, and said, my father and my brothers with their flocks and their herds and all they have, are come from canaan, and are now in the land of goshen. and he took five of his brothers to pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said to them, what is your business? and they said, your servants are keepers of sheep, as our fathers were before us.
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: and they said to pharaoh, we have come to make a living in this land, because we have no grass for our flocks in the land of canaan; so now let your servants make a place for themselves in the land of goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said to joseph, let them have the land of goshen; and if there are any able men among them, put them over my cattle.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: and jacob and his sons came to joseph in egypt, and when word of it came to the ears of pharaoh, king of egypt, he said to joseph, your father and brothers have come to you; all the land of egypt is before you; let your father and your brothers have the best of the land for their resting-place.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: then joseph made his father jacob come before pharaoh, and jacob gave him his blessing.
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said to him, how old are you?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and jacob said, the years of my wanderings have been a hundred and thirty; small in number and full of sorrow have been the years of my life, and less than the years of the wanderings of my fathers.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and jacob gave pharaoh his blessing, and went out from before him.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and joseph made a place for his father and his brothers, and gave them a heritage in the land of egypt, in the best of the land, the land of rameses, as pharaoh had given orders.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and joseph took care of his father and his brothers and all his father's people, giving them food for the needs of their families.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: now there was no food to be had in all the land, so that all egypt and canaan were wasted from need of food.
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and all the money in egypt and in the land of canaan which had been given for grain, came into the hands of joseph: and he put it in pharaoh's house.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and when all the money in egypt and canaan was gone, the egyptians came to joseph, and said, give us bread; would you have us come to destruction before your eyes? for we have no more money.
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: and joseph said, give me your cattle; i will give you grain in exchange for your cattle if your money is all gone.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: so they took their cattle to joseph and he gave them bread in exchange for their horses and flocks and herds and asses, so all that year he gave them food in exchange for their cattle.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: and when that year was ended, they came to him in the second year, and said, we may not keep it from our lord's knowledge that all our money is gone, and all the herds of cattle are my lord's; there is nothing more to give my lord but our bodies and our land;
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: are we to come to destruction before your eyes, we and our land? take us and our land and give us bread; and we and our land will be servants to pharaoh; and give us seed so that we may have life and the land may not become waste.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: so joseph got all the land in egypt for pharaoh; for every egyptian gave up his land in exchange for food, because of their great need; so all the land became pharaoh's.
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: and as for the people, he made servants of them, town by town, from one end of egypt to the other.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: only he did not take the land of the priests, for the priests had their food given them by pharaoh, and having what pharaoh gave them, they had no need to give up their land.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: then joseph said to the people, i have made you and your land this day the property of pharaoh; here is seed for you to put in your fields.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: and when the grain is cut, you are to give a fifth part to pharaoh, and four parts will be yours for seed and food, and for your families and your little ones.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: and they said to him, truly you have kept us from death; may we have grace in your eyes, and we will be pharaoh's servants.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: then joseph made a law which is in force to this day, that pharaoh was to have the fifth part; only the land of the priests did not become his.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: and so israel was living among the egyptians in the land of goshen; and they got property there, and became very great in numbers and in wealth.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: and jacob was living in the land of goshen for seventeen years; so the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: and the time of his death came near, and he sent for his son joseph and said to him, if now i am dear to you, put your hand under my leg and take an oath that you will not put me to rest in egypt;
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: but when i go to my fathers, you are to take me out of egypt and put me to rest in their last resting-place. and he said, i will do so.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: and he said, take an oath to me; and he took an oath to him: and israel gave worship on the bed's head.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: now after these things, word came to joseph that his father was ill: and he took with him his sons manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: and when they said to jacob, your son joseph is coming to see you: then israel, getting all his strength together, had himself lifted up in his bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: and jacob said to joseph, god, the ruler of all, came to me in a vision at luz in the land of canaan, and gave me his blessing,
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and said to me, truly, i will make you fertile and give you increase and will make of you a great family of nations: and i will give this land to your seed after you to be their heritage for ever.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now your two sons who came to birth in egypt before i came to you here, are mine; ephraim and manasseh will be mine, in the same way as reuben and simeon are.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: and any other offspring which you have after them, will be yours, and will be named after their brothers in their heritage.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and as for me, when i came from paddan, death overtook rachel on the way, when we were still some distance from ephrath; and i put her to rest there on the road to ephrath, which is beth-lehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: then israel, looking at joseph's sons, said, who are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: and joseph said to his father, they are my sons, whom god has given me in this land. and he said, let them come near me, and i will give them a blessing.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: now because israel was old, his eyes were no longer clear, and he was not able to see. so he made them come near to him, and he gave them a kiss, folding them in his arms.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and israel said to joseph, i had no hope of seeing your face again, but god in his mercy has let me see you and your children.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: then joseph took them from between his knees, and went down on his face to the earth.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: then taking ephraim with his right hand, joseph put him at israel's left side, and with his left hand he put manasseh at israel's right side, placing them near him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.
