source_text: and israel, stretching out his right hand, put it on the head of ephraim, the younger, and his left hand on the head of manasseh, crossing his hands on purpose, for manasseh was the older.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: and he gave joseph a blessing, saying, may the god to whom my fathers, abraham and isaac, gave worship, the god who has taken care of me all my life till this day,
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the angel who has been my saviour from all evil, send his blessing on these children: and let my name and the name of my fathers, abraham and isaac, be given to them; and let them become a great nation in the earth.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: now when joseph saw that his father had put his right hand on the head of ephraim, it did not seem right to him; and lifting his father's hand he would have put it on the head of manasseh.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: and joseph said to his father, not so, my father, for this is the older; put your right hand on his head.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: but his father would not, saying, i am doing it on purpose, my son; he will certainly become a nation and a great one; but his younger brother will be greater than he, and his seed will become a great family of nations.
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: so he gave them his blessing that day, saying, you will be the sign of blessing in israel, for they will say, may god make you like ephraim and manasseh; and he put ephraim before manasseh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. ' dènge j'ara ne'e, yakob ale uuru ngara efraim nèti ngara a'a na manase.

source_text: then israel said to joseph, now my death is near; but god will be with you, guiding you back to the land of your fathers.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ana, ee! ja'a nèbhu heka madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua dènge miu, ho èèna na nèti hari miu asa era pea-palu'u bèi-baki miu.

source_text: and i have given you more than your brothers, even shechem as your heritage, which i took from the amorites with my sword and my bow.
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu risi eele nèti a'ari èu. aa ja'a hia tabha èu, ledhe ètu rai kana'an èèna, dhu uru na ja'a kore nèti dhèu amori, lod'o ja'a segi rèngu ètu d'ara pamusu.

source_text: and jacob sent for his sons, and said, come together, all of you, so that i may give you news of your fate in future times.
target_text: hèia yakob pua ana na aa'i-aa'i ra pakaboko. ropa ra kaboko aa'i, na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a aa'i-aa'i! mai padètu dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara mamuri mi èci-èci lod'o limuri.

source_text: come near, o sons of jacob, and give ear to the words of israel your father.
target_text: ka na peka mema dènge ana-ana na si, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, ana-ana yakob! mai titu lingu mere ja'a. mi nanene, ama miu isra'el ne, neo padhai lii.

source_text: reuben, you are my oldest son, the first-fruit of my strength, first in pride and first in power:
target_text: ruben! èu ne, ana ja'a dhu uru tèka! èu ne'e tatea ja'a, dènge ai g'ana ja'a. dhèu pakab'ua risi èu.

source_text: but because you were uncontrolled, the first place will not be yours; for you went up to your father's bed, even his bride-bed, and made it unclean.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara èu èra boe, sama sèmi rii dhasi dhu la'e-mai la'e-mai. cag'ag'a laa, èu lamu j'unu dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, ka pakaj'alu era j'unu ama èu. tatao èu èèna ka, pamanahu eele kolongara ca dhèu a'a.

source_text: simeon and levi are brothers; deceit and force are their secret designs.
target_text: simeon dènge lewi! miu dua mi ca rupa. miu dua mi, malai titu kèna ded'e samala, ho paj'èra dhèu.

source_text: take no part in their secrets, o my soul; keep far away, o my heart, from their meetings; for in their wrath they put men to death, and for their pleasure even oxen were wounded.
target_text: ladhe miu pare pama'ète kalua haga sapi, ho ra kapod'e reo-reo ètu era, na lèke dad'èi miu kèna. aa bhabhelu miu hari, ladhe miu kadhi ngutu, na mi pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pahae boe lii padhai lii miu. aa ja'a d'èi boe tao madha-dhilu mi lii langu miu.

source_text: a curse on their passion for it was bitter; and on their wrath for it was cruel. i will let their heritage in jacob be broken up, driving them from their places in israel.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo bhelu-katub'a miu ne, te seli-kolane nga! dènge nanasa miu dhu dènge boe sasue ciki sa hèi. ladhe èèna na, miu pasae unu mi, bhelu-katub'a miu sèra. ho èèna na, lamatua ceb'e ana-èpu miu, asa g'ana asa kariu. ka ra paceb'a asa mia-mia, ètu dedha rai isra'el.

source_text: to you, judah, will your brothers give praise: your hand will be on the neck of your haters; your father's sons will go down to the earth before you.
target_text: yahuda! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘koa-kio'. a'ari èu èèna na ra koa èu, aa ra pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua èu. èu ne, j'èli musu èu, toke ra bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: judah is a young lion; like a lion full of meat you have become great, my son; now he takes his rest like a lion stretched out and like an old lion; by whom will his sleep be broken?
target_text: èu ne, sama sèmi singa ngèru dhu èra, ho tenge nganga'a unu mu. aa èu ne, sama sèmi singa mone, dhu tèku iisi neo bhèj'i; èci sa bani boe pagagai dènge èu. èu kahèi sèmi singa rena, dhu madhenge ana; èci sa bani boe gagu. èci èèna ka dènge èu. dhèu èci sa bani boe padadisi, aa bani boe tao macam-macam mi dedha èu.

source_text: the rod of authority will not be taken from judah, and he will not be without a law-giver, till he comes who has the right to it, and the peoples will put themselves under his rule.
target_text: èèna na èu mèd'u paredha. ana-èpu èu oo rèd'u paredha padhutu-dhutu, toke abhu èci dhu hak nèngu risi eele nèti cahag'e, ho nèd'u paredha na. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, pahaha iisi ho nanene lii paredha nèngu hèi.

source_text: knotting his ass's cord to the vine, and his young ass to the best vine; washing his robe in wine, and his clothing in the blood of grapes:
target_text: èèna na, èu ne mamuri dènge karej'e-karae. èu neo ngaa, na abhu. èu neo tao ngaa, na j'aj'i! aa ladhe èèna na, badha-manu, dènge isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu, asa ae d'ai ceb'e lebhe eele hèi.

source_text: his eyes will be dark with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
target_text: nganga'a-nginu èu, dhu be'a hua, aa dhu èle boe.

source_text: the resting-place of zebulun will be by the sea, and he will be a harbour for ships; the edge of his land will be by zidon.

source_text: may dan be a snake in the way, a horned snake by the road, biting the horse's foot so that the horseman has a fall.

source_text: asher's bread is fat; he gives delicate food for kings.
target_text: aser! ladhe èèna isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu be'a risi, d'ai èu tao koki dhu be'a bia, ka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai hèli ètu èu.

source_text: naphtali is a roe let loose, giving fair young ones.
target_text: naftali! èu ne sama sèmi rusa hui, dhu dhèu èci sa ator rare boe èu. ana-ana matana èu, bhèni iia dènge mone iia.

source_text: joseph is a young ox, whose steps are turned to the fountain;
target_text: yusuf! èu ne, sama sèmi aj'u loro dhu dètu dènge madha èi. dadana na loro asa tembok dhu dedha aae.

source_text: he was troubled by the archers; they sent out their arrows against him, cruelly wounding him:
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu tèka d'ara dènge èu, sama èci èèna ka, dènge musu dhu neo kataki èu.

source_text: but their bows were broken by a strong one, and the cords of their arms were cut by the strength of jacob, by the name of the stone of israel:
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ja'a mangaj'i na, bera-bera dènge èu. ho na pa'èra ai èu, ka èu kataki si hari, masi ka nèti kaj'èu èèna ka. èu segi si, lula ama lamatua dhu tolong èu. mema koasa na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i era sarai ja'a, lula nèngu na ka dhu madhenge ja'a.

source_text: even by the god of your father, who will be your help, and by the ruler of all, who will make you full with blessings from heaven on high, blessings of the deep stretched out under the earth, blessings of the breasts and of the fertile body:
target_text: aa nèngu madhenge èu kahèi. dènge na pala-bagi hia èu mèngi-nale nèti dedha-liru, nèti rai-haha, dènge berkat ho matana ana ae-ae dhu ngi'u èra.

source_text: blessings of sons, old and young, to the father: blessings of the oldest mountains and the fruit of the eternal hills: let them come on the head of joseph, on the crown of him who was separate from his brothers.
target_text: ledhe-ledhe ra ele boe. aa mamèngi-nale dhu ja'a peka mi èu ne, dedha risi nèti ledhe aa'i-aa'i ra. sèna ka hud'i laa berkat se aa'i-aa'i sabhori asa èu, lula èu ne risi nèti a'ari èu se aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: benjamin is a wolf, searching for meat: in the morning he takes his food, and in the evening he makes division of what he has taken.
target_text: benyamin! babani èu sama sèmi busa hui dhu manganga. mad'ae aae era, na kèd'i le èèna, ho bata-magèla badha hui, ho j'aj'i mi nganga'a na. aa, ladhe d'ai ka mèda, la'e papala dhu sisa hia mi ana-ana nèngu. babe'a ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: these are the twelve tribes of israel: and these are the words their father said to them, blessing them; to every one he gave his blessing.
target_text: sange ne'e ka, yakob peka dènge ana-ana na, tasa mera mia mamuri rèngu pala lod'o limuri, èci-èci ka dènge ana-èpu rèngu. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e ka, j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and he gave orders to them, saying, put me to rest with my people and with my fathers, in the hollow of the rock in the field of ephron the hittite, in the rock in the field of machpelah, near mamre in the land of canaan, which abraham got from ephron the hittite, to be his resting-place.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob manèngi sèna ka ana-ana na pajaji mema, peka na, nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe. ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, na miu hud'i padhane ku ja'a asa d'ara ro'a baki ku abraham. ro'a ne, ètu d'ara loe padètu dènge rae makpela, dènge mamre ètu rai kana'an. uru na baki abraham ka dhu hèli loe dènge oka na, ho j'aj'i mi era ro'a nèngu. na hèli pama'ète nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron.

source_text: there abraham and sarah his wife were put to rest, and there they put isaac and rebekah his wife, and there i put leah to rest.
target_text: ètu era èèna, ra padhane baki èdhi abraham dènge bèi èdhi sara; ama ja'a isak dènge ina ku ribka ètu èèna kahèi. de èèna na, miu hud'i padhane ja'a mi era èèna, ètu sebhe ro'a dhèu èmu ja'a lea.

source_text: in the rock in the field which was got for a price from the people of heth.
target_text: de mage mi bhèlu, padhane ja'a ètu d'ara loe dhu baki abraham ku hèli nare èèna.

source_text: and when jacob had come to the end of these words to his sons, stretching himself on his bed, he gave up his spirit, and went the way of his people.

source_text: and joseph put his head down on his father's face, weeping and kissing him.

source_text: and joseph gave orders to his servants who had the necessary knowledge, to make his father's body ready, folding it in linen with spices, and they did so.

source_text: and the forty days needed for making the body ready went by: and there was weeping for him among the egyptians for seventy days.
target_text: sasab'a tuka lalau ngi'u aae ama na, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, madhutu j'ara sasab'a rèngu. dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i madhutu tangi kahèi mamadhe yakob ne'e. ra beke pidhu nguru lod'o, tao sèmi dhèu kapai rèngu madhe.

source_text: and when the days of weeping for him were past, joseph said to the servants of pharaoh, if now you have love for me, say these words to pharaoh:
target_text: èle beke pidhu nguru lod'o, hèia yusuf peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, mi nanene! mèti ku lii ja'a ne asa dhèu aae, peka sèmi ne'e:

source_text: my father made me take an oath, saying, when i am dead, put me to rest in the place i have made ready for myself in the land of canaan. so now let me go and put my father in his last resting-place, and i will come back again.
target_text: ‘lod'o ama ku oe madhe, na moa sèna ka ja'a laku padhane ne asa rai kana'an. de ja'a manèngi ho ama dhèu aae hia ja'a ijin laku padhane ama ku. ladhe èle na, ja'a lèpa hari mai. '

source_text: and pharaoh said, go up and put your father to rest, as you gave your oath to him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dhu moa le mi ama mu sèmi èèna na, lamu ho padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: so joseph went up to put his father in his last resting-place; and with him went all the servants of pharaoh, and the chief men of his house and all the chiefs of the land of egypt,
target_text: ka yusuf pakèd'i ka, la'e padhane ama na. dhèu ae madhutu lasi dènge ne kahèi. sèmi kapala urusan nèti dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i nèti masir.

source_text: and all the family of joseph, and his brothers and his father's people: only their little ones and their flocks and herds they did not take with them from the land of goshen.
target_text: a'ari yusuf dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi padhane yakob. dhu ata ètu gosen dhoka dhèu èmu ra, ana iiki, dènge badha-manu ra di.

source_text: and carriages went up with him and horsemen, a great army.
target_text: sordad'u ae madhutu kahèi. cahag'e ca'e kareta, aa cahag'e hari ca'e jara. taga dhèu dhu madhutu na, ae d'ai seli, nèti èèna ka, rombongan dhu rèti dhèu madhe ne, madhera titu kèna.

source_text: and they came to the grain-floor of atad on the other side of jordan, and there they gave the last honours to jacob, with great and bitter sorrow, weeping for their father for seven days.
target_text: rèngu lasi, ka ra pège loko yarden ètu era èci, ngara na atad. era ne'e, dhèu biasa mai j'èli are. d'ai era ne'e, yusuf si tangi mamadhe ama na. aa ra beke hari pidhu mèda.

source_text: and when the people of the land, the people of canaan, at the grain-floor of atad, saw their grief, they said, great is the grief of the egyptians: so the place was named abel-mizraim, on the other side of jordan.
target_text: ropa dhèu kana'an ètu sèra, ladhe na ra j'èra ae titu kèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! miu laladhe ku laa! babeke mamadhe dhèu masir se, ra susa bia nga! j'ara tatangi rèngu sèmi nèi ni ka. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare era èèna, ngara na abel-misraim. sasoa na, ‘sasusa dhèu masir'.

source_text: so his sons did as he had given them orders to do:
target_text: hèia ana-ana yakob se, tao madhutu sèmi lii moa rèngu uru na.

source_text: for they took him into the land of canaan and put him to rest in the hollow rock in the field of machpelah, which abraham got with the field, for a resting-place, from ephron the hittite at mamre.

source_text: and when his father had been put to rest, joseph and his brothers and all who had gone with him, went back to egypt.

source_text: so they sent word to joseph, saying, your father, before his death, gave us orders, saying,

source_text: you are to say to joseph, let the wrongdoing of your brothers be overlooked, and the evil they did to you: now, if it is your pleasure, let the sin of the servants of your father's god have forgiveness. and at these words, joseph was overcome with weeping.
target_text: ho padhai lii dènge ama wakil, peka na, ‘yusuf hud'i bhabhèlu eele ka sasala a'a na si. lula uru na ra paj'èra ne. ' ji'i nge'a kahèi ama èdhi ne, karèi nèti uru ka mai, na mangaj'i dhoka mi ama lamatua di. ji'i kahèi j'aj'i ana pajuu lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai manèngi abho, lula uru na ji'i paj'èra le, ama wakil. ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia yusuf tangi.

source_text: then his brothers went, and falling at his feet, said, truly, we are your servants.
target_text: èle èèna ka, a'a na si mai unu ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, hud'i laa ama tao ji'i j'aj'i ènu ama.

source_text: and joseph said, have no fear: am i in the place of god?
target_text: te ngaa yusuf padhai lii dènge ra, miu se a'a ja'a! miu baku madha'u ia ka! dhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak hia huku mi dhèu. te ja'a ne, aad'o.

source_text: as for you, it was in your mind to do me evil, but god has given a happy outcome, the salvation of numbers of people, as you see today.
target_text: mema tare'a, uru na miu mere lii èci, ho neo paj'èra ja'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu ub'a eele tatao miu dhu karehe èèna, j'aj'i mi babe'a. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu ne'e, sèna ka dhèu ae abhu mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: so now, have no fear: for i will take care of you and your little ones. so he gave them comfort with kind words.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! baku madha'u ia ka. ja'a pamoa dènge miu se, èèna na, ladhe-leru miu, dènge ana-èpu miu aa'i-aa'i ra. dènge lii padhai lii sèmi ne'e ne, yusuf pa'èra hari d'ara a'a na si.

source_text: now joseph and all his father's family went on living in egypt: and the years of joseph's life were a hundred and ten.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pea taruu ètu rai masir, dènge a'ari na si, aa'i-aa'i ra. nèngu mamuri d'ai cangasu canguru tèu.

source_text: and joseph saw ephraim's children of the third generation: and the children of machir, the son of manasseh, came to birth on joseph's knees.
target_text: nèngu d'ai hari nèdhi ana-èpu efraim kahèi. aa na leru èpu manase, nuka ana-ana nèti makir.

source_text: then joseph said to his brothers, the time of my death has come; but god will keep you in mind and take you out of this land into the land which he gave by his oath to abraham and isaac and jacob.
target_text: yusuf peka mi a'a na si, aku nèngu na, a'a ku si ee! ja'a rasa na mamadhe ja'a dètu le! te ngaa ja'a parcaya, ama lamatua tatu ladhe-leru miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu ka dhu lere miu kalua nèti rai ne'e. nèngu kahèi dhu nèti hari miu lèpa asa rai dhu na padhadha le pake lii subha, ho hia mi baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge ama èdhi yakob.

source_text: then joseph made the children of israel take an oath, saying, god will certainly give effect to his word, and you are to take my bones away from here.
target_text: ka yusuf manèngi mi a'ari na si, sèna ka ra subha, peka na, miu hud'i jaji ku mi dedha ja'a. ladhe lod'o d'ai ama lamatua nèti hari miu asa rai kana'an, miu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: so joseph came to his death, being a hundred and ten years old: and they made his body ready, and he was put in a chest in egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf madhe ètu masir, dènge umur nèngu cangasu canguru tèu. hèia ra tao bubhu mi ngi'u aae na. ka ra tao asa d'ara kopa.

source_text: the book of the generations of jesus christ, the son of david, the son of abraham. the son of abraham was isaac; and the son of isaac was jacob; and the sons of jacob were judah and his brothers;
target_text: sasuri ne, lole j'ara mamuri nèti yesus kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua padhadha mema ho neo pua mai. yesus ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud dènge abraham. karèi nèti abraham toke dhèu aae daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki. kabhia na sèmi ne'e: abraham matana isak, isak matana yakob, yakob matana yahuda dènge a'ari na,

target_text: ram matana aminadab, aminadab matana nahason, nahason matana salmon,

target_text: salmon matana boas ina na, ngara na rahab boas matana obet ina na, ngara na rut, obet matana isai,

target_text: isai matana daud.

source_text: and the son of solomon was rehoboam; and the son of rehoboam was abijah; and the son of abijah was asa; and the son of asa was jehoshaphat; and the son of jehoshaphat was joram; and the son of joram was uzziah; and the son of uzziah was jotham; and the son of jotham was ahaz; and the son of ahaz was hezekiah; and the son of hezekiah was manasseh; and the son of manasseh was amon; and the son of amon was josiah; and the sons of josiah were jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the taking away to babylon.
target_text: nèti daud toke lod'o dhu ra babège suku isra'el asa babel, abhu hari canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: daud matana soleman ina na, uru èèna dhèu èmu uria. soleman matana rehabeam, rehabeam matana abia, abia matana asaf, asaf matana yosafat, yosafat matana yoram, yoram matana usia, usia matana yotam, yotam matana ahas, ahas matana heskia, heskia matana manase, manase matana amos, amos matana yosias, yosias matana yekonya dènge ari na, lod'o babège si asa babel.

source_text: and after the taking away to babylon, jechoniah had a son shealtiel; and shealtiel had zerubbabel; and zerubbabel had abiud; and abiud had eliakim; and eliakim had azor; and azor had zadok; and zadok had achim; and achim had eliud; and eliud had eleazar; and eleazar had matthan; and matthan had jacob; and the son of jacob was joseph the husband of mary, who gave birth to jesus, whose name is christ.

source_text: so all the generations from abraham to david are fourteen generations; and from david to the taking away to babylon, fourteen generations; and from the taking away to babylon to the coming of christ, fourteen generations.
target_text: de karèi nèti abraham toke daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; nèti daud toke lod'o ra babège si asa babel abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; aa nèti lod'o ra babège si asa babel d'ai maria nara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki.

source_text: now the birth of jesus christ was in this way: when his mother mary was going to be married to joseph, before they came together the discovery was made that she was with child by the holy spirit.
target_text: lii lolo maria nara iisi yesus sèmi ne'e ka: maria dhu tunanga le dènge yusuf. dua ra pa'èci rèdhi mèka sama sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali, te ngaa te'a boe na, maria dhu dènge le babia nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and joseph, her husband, being an upright man, and not desiring to make her a public example, had a mind to put her away privately.
target_text: ropa yusuf ne'a, ka na neo pama'ète lii rèngu dua ra. te ngaa na d'èi boe pamakae maria ètu madha dhèu ae, lula nèngu ne ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, na neo pamau eele lii rèngu ne.

source_text: but when he was giving thought to these things, an angel of the lord came to him in a dream, saying, joseph, son of david, have no fear of taking mary as your wife; because that which is in her body is of the holy spirit.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o dhu na pangee era, d'ara ca mèda sa, ka nèngu nii. ètu d'ara nii ne, ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yusuf! èu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. èu mage makae leo dènge maria. te ana dhu na kad'o èèna, j'aj'i nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: and she will give birth to a son; and you will give him the name jesus; for he will give his people salvation from their sins.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a maria nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. aa èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus, te nèngu ka dhu patabuli dhèu unu ama lamatua nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: now all this took place so that the word of the lord by the prophet might come true,
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua dhu peka mema nèti uru ka, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri, peka na,

source_text: see, the virgin will be with child, and will give birth to a son, and they will give him the name immanuel, that is, god with us.
target_text: mi nanene! bèli-camèd'a abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu dhu kalora iisi, te'a boe na, nèngu dhu dènge babia le. èèna na nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka ra pangare ne, imanuel. lii ibrani, ‘imanuel' sasoa na: ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi.

source_text: and joseph did as the angel of the lord had said to him, and took her as his wife;
target_text: ropa nii èle, yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i na. ka na madhutu ka lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na tadèngi ètu d'ara nii deo na. ka nare maria j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: and he had no connection with her till she had given birth to a son; and he gave him the name jesus.
target_text: te ngaa na j'unu pa'èci boe dènge maria, toke maria nara iisi aa'i. nara iisi nare ka, yusuf pangare ana ne, yesus.

source_text: now when the birth of jesus took place in beth-lehem of judaea, in the days of herod the king, there came wise men from the east to jerusalem,
target_text: lod'o rara iisi yesus ètu rae betlehem, ètu propensi yudea, dhèu aae herodes dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri nèti era kaj'èu, mai nèti bèka dhimu asa kota yerusalem. rèngu se, dhu re'a mèu ladhe hua-hètu.

source_text: saying, where is the king of the jews whose birth has now taken place? we have seen his star in the east and have come to give him worship.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai yerusalem dhèu se pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi, dhu heka rara iisi hiu èèna, era na buli mia, ee? ji'i ngèdhi hua-hètu cue ètu bèka dhimu, dhu j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rara iisi le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai neo pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and when it came to the ears of herod the king, he was troubled, and all jerusalem with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia d'ara na susa. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem sèra, d'ara ra susa kahèi.

source_text: and he got together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, questioning them as to where the birth-place of the christ would be.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae herodes paroa nare kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, ka na karèi si, peka na, miu peka sèku dènge ja'a la! kristus, dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke èèna, rara iisi ne ètu mia?

source_text: and they said to him, in beth-lehem of judaea; for so it is said in the writings of the prophet,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ètu rae betlehem, propensi yudea. te ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na mika, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na:

source_text: you beth-lehem, in the land of judah, are not the least among the chiefs of judah: out of you will come a ruler, who will be the keeper of my people israel.
target_text: ‘wee! miu dhèu betlehem ètu propensi yudea sèra. baku pangee na, rae miu ne, ca rae iiki dhu dhèu ige boe. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu kapai ca dhèu cèu mai nèti rae ne'e. èèna na nèngu j'aj'i dhèu madhenga mi dhèu ja'a, dhèu isra'el. '

source_text: then herod sent for the wise men privately, and put questions to them about what time the star had been seen.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae herodes paroa mau-mau dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra. ka na karèi, na, lod'o mia miu ladhe mèdhi hua-hètu ne cèu ètu dedha-liru? hèia ra peka dènge ne.

source_text: and he sent them to beth-lehem and said, go and make certain where the young child is; and when you have seen him, let me have news of it, so that i may come and give him worship.
target_text: èle ka, na hia si lasi asa betlehem. na moa dènge ra, peka na, lami ho tenge palème era, ètu mia ana ne. ladhe miu rage, na, lèpa hari mai sèna ka peka dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo laku pahaha iisi mi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and after hearing the king, they went on their way; and the star which they saw in the east went before them, till it came to rest over the place where the young child was.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai dhèu aae, hèia lasi dènge ka. kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi hari hua-hètu dhu uru èèna rèdhi ètu bèka dhimu. hua-hètu ne cèu ètu madha rèngu, na kako uru nèti rèngu, hèia tèja ètu dedha era ana ne pea.

source_text: and when they saw the star they were full of joy.
target_text: ropa rèdhi, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: and they came into the house, and saw the young child with mary, his mother; and falling down on their faces they gave him worship; and from their store they gave him offerings of gold, perfume, and spices.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe rèdhi ana ne dènge ina na maria. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi mi ana ne. ka dhèu se bhoke mèdha dhu kab'ua rèti hia ana ne. ra hia hualaa, kemenyan dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi.

source_text: and it was made clear to them by god in a dream that they were not to go back to herod; so they went into their country by another way.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka dhèu se abhu nii nèti ama lamatua, peka na, lami ia ka asa dhèu aae herodes. nèti èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa rai rèngu re j'ara leo.

source_text: and when they had gone, an angel of the lord came to joseph in a dream, saying, get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into egypt, and do not go from there till i give you word; for herod will be searching for the young child to put him to death.
target_text: lod'o dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu se lèpa, hèia ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga, mai peka dènge yusuf ètu d'ara nii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! pakèd'i dènge ka d'ara lai-lai ne! mèti ana ne dènge ina na lami asa masir. pea ètu nèi, toke ja'a peka d'ai lod'o mia miu lèpa hari. te dhèu aae herodes tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ana ne!

source_text: so he took the young child and his mother by night, and went into egypt;
target_text: hèia yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka mèda èèna kahèi, nèti dhèu èmu na dènge ana ne, rai lasi asa masir.

source_text: and was there till the death of herod; so that the word of the lord through the prophet might come true, out of egypt have i sent for my son.
target_text: ra pea ètu nèi toke dhèu aae herodes madhe. j'ara èèna, nuka sèmi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na hosea, suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka, na, ja'a paroa hari ana ku, ho lèpa ka nèti masir.

source_text: then herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, was very angry; and he sent out, and put to death all the male children in beth-lehem and in all the parts round about it, from two years old and under, acting on the knowledge which he had got with care from the wise men.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes ne'a nare, na, dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra leko-monya ne, hèia na nasa titu kèna. na paredha sordad'u na sèra, aku nèngu na, lami asa rae betlehem nèi, aa asa rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu èèna. pamadhe aa'i ana mone iiki dhu dua tèu asa haha mai. herodes hia paredha ne, lula na sanèd'e lii lolo nèti dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra. na ige karèi nèti rèngu rèdhi hiu-hiu hua-hètu cèu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: then the word of jeremiah the prophet came true,
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: in ramah there was a sound of weeping and great sorrow, rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted for their loss.
target_text: abhu lii tangi dènge lii roma iisi dhèu nèti kota rama. rahel tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ana-ana na madhe aa'i. na d'èi boe ca dhèu sa mai pamako ne, lula ana-ana na, aad'o heka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: but when herod was dead, an angel of the lord came in a dream to joseph in egypt,
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu aae herodes madhe. lod'o èèna, yusuf si ètu masir era. hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu mai nèti sorga, pad'elo rèhu na mi nèngu ètu d'ara nii.

source_text: saying, get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of israel: because they who were attempting to take the young child's life are dead.
target_text: ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! kèd'i ka! mèti ka ana ne dènge ina na asa isra'el. te dhèu dhu neo pamadhe ana ne, madhe le.

source_text: and he got up, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yusuf kèd'i. èle ka nèti si asa rai isra'el.

source_text: but when it came to his ears that archelaus was ruling over judaea in the place of his father herod, he was in fear of going there; and god having given him news of the danger in a dream, he went out of the way into the country parts of galilee.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf tadèngi na, arkalaus, ana dhèu aae herodes, dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae limuri ne ètu propensi yudea, ka na madha'u la'e asa yudea. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari dènge ne ètu d'ara nii, na, yusuf, èu baku pea ètu yudea. nèti èèna ka, lasi pea asa propensi galilea,

source_text: and he came and was living in a town named nazareth: so that the word of the prophets might come true, he will be named a nazarene.
target_text: ètu rae nasaret. dènge j'ara ne lii padhai ama lamatua lèke tare'a, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri tèke, na bèli-camèd'a dhèu paroa ne, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: and in those days john the baptist came preaching in the waste land of judaea,
target_text: lod'o yesus dhu kapai le, hèia yohanis tuka sarani mulai aj'a-nori dhèu ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: saying, let your hearts be turned from sin; for the kingdom of heaven is near.
target_text: na aj'a peka na, a'ari pasue! miu hud'i mangaku aa tèke eele ku sasala-sasigo miu, ho lèpa asa ama lamatua. te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for this is he of whom isaiah the prophet said, the voice of one crying in the waste land, make ready the way of the lord, make his roads straight.
target_text: uru èèna, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri le lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu dhèu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra sèna ka tao pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mamai ama lamatua! tao pamola j'ara hia ne! '

source_text: now john was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.
target_text: j'ara mamuri yohanis ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. mèdha-papake na tao nèti rèu badha onta. dhari hake na nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a na, kabara dènge dhua nasu oni.

source_text: then jerusalem and all judaea went out to him, and all the people from near jordan;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai neo paraga dènge yohanis. rèngu mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti kabarai propensi yudea aa'i-aa'i, dènge nèti rae-rae dhu dètu loko yarden.

source_text: and they were given baptism by him in the river jordan, saying openly that they had done wrong.
target_text: ra bhoka d'ara ra, aa mangaku sasala-sasigo aa'i-aa'i, èle ka yohanis sarani si ètu d'ara loko yarden.

source_text: but when he saw a number of the pharisees and sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu partei agama saduki, lasi asa era èèna kahèi, manèngi yohanis sarani si. te ngaa ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi si, hèia na jèke si, peka na, heeh! miu se cakaraa mege dhu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua huku mi, lula tatao miu dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra. mage mi pangee na, miu bisa rai nèti hahuku na.

source_text: let your change of heart be seen in your works:
target_text: de be'a risi miu lèpa sa ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala miu sèra. èle na, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sèmi aj'u dhu hua be'a.

source_text: and say not to yourselves, we have abraham for our father; because i say to you that god is able from these stones to make children for abraham.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, miu se abhu mamuri, lula j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. mi sanèd'e lii ja'a, ee! te ama lamatua bisa tao hadhu se j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham kahèi.

source_text: and even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; every tree then which does not give good fruit is cut down, and put into the fire.
target_text: baku pamud'e! te abhu dhu kèpe mema kataka, pa'èra patue aa'i-aa'i aj'u dhu hua be'a boe, sèna ka core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: truly, i give baptism with water to those of you whose hearts are changed; but he who comes after me is greater than i, whose shoes i am not good enough to take up: he will give you baptism with the holy spirit and with fire:
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a sarani miu pake èi, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu se tèke eele sasala-sasala miu. te ngaa pe abhu ca dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a, bèli-camèd'a mai. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi. èèna na, nèngu papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèngu tao miu j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, sama sèmi dhèu pake ai ho bhubhu maruru.

source_text: in whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned up in the fire which will never be put out.
target_text: te nèngu dhu nèd'u kokotai dènge laludhu ètu d'ara, ho neo tatai eele èto na. èle èèna, na bhori laludhu asa d'ara soka. te ngaa èto sèra, na dutu asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe boe.

source_text: then jesus came from galilee to john at the jordan, to be given baptism by him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus puru mai nèti galilea, la'e asa loko yarden. na mai sèna ka manèngi yohanis sarani ne.

source_text: but john would have kept him back, saying, it is i who have need of baptism from you, and do you come to me?
target_text: te ngaa yohanis no'o boe. na pab'ala peka na, tasamia ka ja'a sarani èu? sale ne, sina ma? hud'i èu ku dhu sarani ja'a. te èèna ka dhu ja'a parluu!

source_text: but jesus made answer, saying to him, let it be so now: because so it is right for us to make righteousness complete. then he gave him baptism.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, pangee ia ka. te ngaa doe ne'e, hud'i laa èu di dhu sarani ja'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi nare, ka yohanis b'ala, aku nèngu na, sad'i aku èu hèia yohanis sarani yesus.

source_text: and jesus, having been given baptism, straight away went up from the water; and, the heavens opening, he saw the spirit of god coming down on him as a dove;
target_text: ropa sarani èle, ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara loko. cag'ag'a laa, liru bhoke eele. hèia ladhe nèdhi roh ama lamatua puru mai, nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu mai tèka mi nèngu.

source_text: and a voice came out of heaven, saying, this is my dearly loved son, with whom i am well pleased.
target_text: hèia ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, nèngu ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: then jesus was sent by the spirit into the waste land to be tested by the evil one.
target_text: èle ka, roh ama lamatua nèti yesus asa d'ara mamoo, sèna ka dhèu aae nidhu sèku ne.

source_text: and after going without food for forty days and forty nights, he was in need of it.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, yesus na'a-ninu boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. hèia na manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and the evil one came and said to him, if you are the son of god, give the word for these stones to become bread.
target_text: ropa na manganga sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne, peka na, èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, do? ladhe tare'a, na, paredha hadhu se, ho j'aj'i nganga'a.

source_text: but he made answer and said, it is in the writings, bread is not man's only need, but every word which comes out of the mouth of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, na, dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na: ‘dhèu rai-haha mamuri mesa boe nèti nganga'a di. te ngaa rèngu hud'i nanene ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na kahèi. '

source_text: then the evil one took him to the holy town; and he put him on the highest point of the temple and said to him,
target_text: ka dhèu aae nidhu nèti yesus asa kota yerusalem, kota lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna. èle ka, na nèti yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: if you are the son of god, let yourself go down; for it is in the writings, he will give his angels care over you; and, in their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne, peka, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èu ridhu sèku asa haha nèi. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu nèti sorga, sèna ka j'aga èu. ' aa ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri kahèi, ‘pe ra kanata ai ra, ho sibhe èu, sèna ka ngi'u èu pèd'a boe, aa haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: jesus said to him, again it is in the writings, you may not put the lord your god to the test.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, abhu kahèi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua èu. de èu baku pua ne pake koasa na, sèna ka pad'elo bukti, peka na, nèngu èèna, tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. '

source_text: again, the evil one took him up to a very high mountain, and let him see all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu ne nèti hari yesus asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae. hèia na pad'elo aa'i saraga dènge babe'a negara aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he said to him, all these things will i give you, if you will go down on your face and give me worship.
target_text: ropa na pad'elo nare, hèia dhèu aae nidhu ne peka, aku nèngu na, sad'i èu patitu kètu urutuu, sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ja'a, pe ja'a hia aa'i se'e se mi èu.

source_text: then said jesus to him, away, satan: for it is in the writings, give worship to the lord your god and be his servant only.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, he, nidhu! pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e ne! te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri na, ‘èu hud'i pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, aa èu ne hud'i sab'a ku dhoka hia nèngu di. '

source_text: then the evil one went away from him, and angels came and took care of him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae nidhu tadèngi lii ne, hèia na tèke eele yesus. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai uri ne.

source_text: now when it came to his ears that john had been put in prison, he went away to galilee;
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes pamaso yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara èmu bèdho. ropa yesus tadèngi, hèia na lèpa asa galilea.

source_text: and going away from nazareth, he came and made his living-place in capernaum, which is by the sea, in the country of zebulun and naphtali:
target_text: la'e asa rae na nasaret, èle ka la'e taruu pea ètu rae kapernaum. rae èèna ètu sebhe dano galilea, ètu rai sebulon dènge naftali.

source_text: so that the word of the prophet isaiah might come true,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, na tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: the land of zebulun and the land of naphtali, by the way of the sea, the other side of jordan, galilee of the gentiles,
target_text: rai sebulon dènge rai naftali dhu padètu dènge dano galilea ètu sebhe haa loko yarden. dhèu yahudi boe pea ètu era sèra kahèi.

source_text: the people who were in the dark saw a great light, and to those in the land of the shade of death did the dawn come up.
target_text: rèngu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa limuri ne, rèdhi le saraa. aa saraa ne heo le palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: from that time jesus went about preaching and saying, let your hearts be turned from sin, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus mulai aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i soro kabodho aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, ho mamuri ka dènge mola-mèci! te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa le j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and when he was walking by the sea of galilee, he saw two brothers, simon, whose other name was peter, and andrew, his brother, who were putting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea. na paraga dènge dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari. èci ngara na simon, dhu tema paroa ne, petrus. aa ari na, anderias. dua ra dhu pèku i'a ètu dano galilea, lula dua ra dhèu sab'a dhasi.

source_text: and he said to them, come after me, and i will make you fishers of men.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai ku madhutu ja'a! miu biasa tenge i'a, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo aj'a miu ho j'aj'i tuka tenge dhèu.

source_text: and straight away they let go the nets and went after him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia dua ra tèke eele dènge ka pèku ra, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and going on from there he saw two other brothers, james, the son of zebedee, and john, his brother, in the boat with their father, stitching up their nets; and he said, come.
target_text: èle ka, yesus kako hari ciki, hèia ladhe nèdhi ana sabadeus, dhèu dua. a'a, ngara na yakobis, aa ari na, yohanis. dua ra dhu lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha sama-sama dènge ama ra. hèia yesus paroa dua ra, sèna ka madhutu ne.

source_text: and they went straight from the boat and their father and came after him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ra tèke eele ama dènge koha ra, lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: and jesus went about in all galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom, and making well those who were ill with any disease among the people.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si kako palème propensi galilea, ho na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. na aj'a lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa na peka j'ara-j'ara tasamia, sèna ka dhèu bisa madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti rupa-rupa papèd'a-tarègu.

source_text: and news of him went out through all syria; and they took to him all who were ill with different diseases and pains, those having evil spirits and those who were off their heads, and those who had no power of moving. and he made them well.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, tatao yesus ne dhèu lolo palème toke d'ai propensi siria aa'i-aa'i. hèia dhèu rèti dhèu ra dhu lèke rupa-rupa papèd'a asa yesus. dhèu se rèti kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dhu huj'u kahib'i, dènge dhu karuku. ka na puri-pa'èle aa'i si.

source_text: and there went after him great numbers from galilee and decapolis and jerusalem and judaea and from the other side of jordan.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne. dhèu se mai nèti propensi galilea, aa nèti rai canguru kota, dhu ra peka na, dekapolis. dhèu cahag'e mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti propensi yudea, aa nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden.

source_text: and seeing great masses of people he went up into the mountain; and when he was seated his disciples came to him.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne, hèia na ca'e la'e asa ledhe iiki cue, ka na madhèdi ètu èèna. ana-ana madhutu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, mai padètu sèna ka nanene ne.

source_text: and with these words he gave them teaching, saying,
target_text: hèia na aj'a-nori si, peka na,

source_text: happy are the poor in spirit: for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
target_text: dhèu kasia, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, ka dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: happy are those who are sad: for they will be comforted.
target_text: dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pamaho'o d'ara si.

source_text: happy are the gentle: for the earth will be their heritage.
target_text: dhèu haha oto, lula rèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a sèmi rare mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua moa tèke.

source_text: happy are those whose heart's desire is for righteousness: for they will have their desire.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara kateme dènge ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, nèngu ka dhu hia si ngaa dhu ra neo.

source_text: happy are those who have mercy: for they will be given mercy.
target_text: dhèu dhu pad'elo rasa kasia mi dhèu leo, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, ama lamatua kasia rèngu kahèi.

source_text: happy are the clean in heart: for they will see god.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, rèngu unu ra ladhe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: happy are the peacemakers: for they will be named sons of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu tema padame dhèu, rèngu oto, lula èèna na ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, ‘rèngu se'e ka, ana ja'a. '

source_text: happy are those who are attacked on account of righteousness: for the kingdom of heaven will be theirs.
target_text: dhèu dhu pasae j'aj'èra, lula ra madhutu ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula lamatua mesa na ka, dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: happy are you when men give you a bad name, and are cruel to you, and say all evil things against you falsely, because of me.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo paj'èra miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a, miu oto kahèi. ladhe dhèu padhai kaked'u miu, aa lole pa'ele iie kolongara miu, miu oto kahèi.

source_text: be glad and full of joy; for great is your reward in heaven: for so were the prophets attacked who were before you.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu hud'i pakasee iisi aa pakarej'e d'ara, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le pala dhu ae hia miu ètu sorga. te ngaa sanèd'e! mesa boe miu di dhu dui j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, te lod'o uru sèra dhèu dhu paj'èra le kahèi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: you are the salt of the earth; but if its taste goes from the salt, how will you make it salt again? it is then good for nothing but to be put out and crushed under foot by men.
target_text: ladhe èdhi d'èi sèna ka nganga'a j'aj'i be'a, na, èdhi tao ku masi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, rèngu parluu miu. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, gaguna na, ngaa? dhoka core eele di ètu j'ara, ho dhèu j'èli ne.

source_text: you are the light of the world. a town put on a hill may be seen by all.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi labhu kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa ladhe rèdhi miu dènge be'a. miu hud'i heo lo'a-lo'a ku, nuka sèmi kota ètu kolo ledhe, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ne.

source_text: and a burning light is not put under a vessel, but on its table; so that its rays may be shining on all who are in the house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paheo labhu iiki, ra saguru boe ne dènge èru rai, te ngaa ra padhèdi labhu ne ètu era dedha, ho pasaraa aa'i d'ara èmu.

source_text: even so let your light be shining before men, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your father in heaven.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi èèna. mamuri miu hud'i saraa ku, sèna ka dhèu leo ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu dhu be'a. ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu sèmi èèna, ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ‘ira ii! ama miu ètu sorga, kapai titu kèna, nga! '

source_text: let there be no thought that i have come to put an end to the law or the prophets. i have not come for destruction, but to make complete.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka tao eele atora ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi musa. aa baku pangee na, ja'a pusi-pahae boe dènge ngaa dhu uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke le. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka pamèci j'ara aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi mia dhu ra peka tèke.

source_text: truly i say to you, till heaven and earth come to an end, not the smallest letter or part of a letter will in any way be taken from the law, till all things are done.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, nanene paie-iie! liru dènge rai-haha bisa mèka laho aa'i, ladhe aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mèka madhutu atora ama lamatua. masi ka ca katèd'a èèna ka, bisa boe ele nèti atora se.

source_text: whoever then goes against the smallest of these laws, teaching men to do the same, will be named least in the kingdom of heaven; but he who keeps the laws, teaching others to keep them, will be named great in the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ladhe abhu dhu sisu atora ama lamatua, lula na pangee, na, ‘atora ne, ana iiki-iiki di, de gaguna na aad'o! ' hèia na aj'a sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo, pe ama lamatua ètu sorga, tao ne j'aj'i mi ca dhèu ana iiki. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, hèia na aj'a-nori dhèu leo sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pakab'ua ne.

source_text: for i say to you, if your righteousness is not greater than the righteousness of the scribes and pharisees, you will never go into the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! miu hud'i mamuri mola, risi nèti mese agama dènge dhèu partei agama parisi sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, miu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: you have knowledge that it was said in old times, you may not put to death; and, whoever puts to death will be in danger of being judged:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘baku pamadhe dhèu, te dhèu cee dhu pamadhe dhèu nèngu lèke huku. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be in danger of being judged; and he who says to his brother, raca, will be in danger from the sanhedrin; and whoever says, you foolish one, will be in danger of the hell of fire.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku panasa, te dhèu cee dhu nasa dènge a'ari na, èèna na nèngu lèke huku. dhèu dhu jèke a'ari na, ka peka na, ‘èu bod'o kabao! ' pe nèngu la'e dhaa asa dhèu heka-dhèu heka agama. aa dhèu cee dhu jèke a'ari na, ‘goa, ee! ' nèngu lèke huku ètu ai naraka.

source_text: if then you are making an offering at the altar and there it comes to your mind that your brother has something against you,
target_text: de ladhe èu dhu mèti mèdha persembahan hia ama lamatua, te ngaa èu sanèd'e, na, abhu a'ari dhu nasa era dènge èu,

source_text: while your offering is still before the altar, first go and make peace with your brother, then come and make your offering.
target_text: tèke eele uuru ku mèdha persembahan sèra. hèia lamu padame ku dènge a'ari mu, èle, na heka mai hia persembahan se asa ama lamatua kèna.

source_text: come to an agreement quickly with him who has a cause against you at law, while you are with him on the way, for fear that he may give you up to the judge and the judge may give you to the police and you may be put into prison.
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu neo tao lii langu dènge èu, be'a risi lamu lai-lai ho padame dènge ne. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nèti èu asa hakim. hèia hakim saraka èu sa polisi, ka ra pamaso èu asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: truly i say to you, you will not come out from there till you have made payment of the very last farthing.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e tare'a-re'a mi èu ne! èèna na èu pea taruu ètu d'ara bèdho, toke b'ae aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu-g'ètu èu sèra.

source_text: you have knowledge that it was said, you may not have connection with another man's wife:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘baku bersina. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone whose eyes are turned on a woman with desire has had connection with her in his heart.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo peka na, sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci, hèia d'ara na neo j'unu pa'èci dènge ne, na, dhèu mone ne bersina le dènge bhèni ne ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and if your right eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha g'ana èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge musi madha dua-dua.

source_text: and if your right hand is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.
target_text: aa ladhe èu tao sala dènge kacui-aai g'ana èu, poro eele kacui-aai ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge kacui-aai dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: again, it was said, whoever puts away his wife has to give her a statement in writing for this purpose:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, na, ‘dhèu dhu pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, nèngu hud'i hia ku sasuri pa'ia mi bhèni èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone who puts away his wife for any other cause but the loss of her virtue, makes her false to her husband; and whoever takes her as his wife after she is put away, is no true husband to her.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa bhèni ne tao nèdhi boe j'ara makae, hèia bhèni ne leo hari èmu, na, dhèu èmu uuru èèna ka dhu tao nèngu j'aj'i bersina. aa ladhe abhu dhèu mone dhu leo nare bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na ia eele, na, rèngu dua ra bersina kahèi.

source_text: again, you have knowledge that it was said in old times, do not take false oaths, but give effect to your oaths to the lord:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu na hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe èu pajaji pake lii soo-subha, dhu ale kolongara ama lamatua, na, èu dhu pa'èki le dènge soo-subha èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you, take no oaths at all: not by the heaven, because it is the seat of god;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe èu neo pajaji, na, mage mu j'oka subha. baku subha dènge ngara sorga, lula sorga èèna era pea ama lamatua.

source_text: or by the earth, because it is the resting-place for his foot; or by jerusalem, because it is the town of the great king.
target_text: mage subha pake ngara rai-haha, lula rai-haha ne, era bane haga ama lamatua. aa mage subha pake ngara yerusalem, lula yerusalem èèna, kota nèti dhèu aae kapai.

source_text: you may not take an oath by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.
target_text: baku subha pake ngara kab'a kètu miu. te miu dènge boe koasa ho paredha rèu kètu miu, sèna ka ca loa sa j'aj'i mèdhi do j'aj'i pudhi.

source_text: but let your words be simply, yes or no: and whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo pajaji, dhu peka oo, na, peka la ‘oo' di. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na, peka la, ‘aad'o' di. ladhe miu peka risi nèti èèna, sèra sa j'aj'aj'i nèti nidhu.

source_text: you have knowledge that it was said, an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie musi madha miu, na, pa'ele iie kahèi musi madha na. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakabhui eele ngutu èu, na, pakabhui eele ngutu na kahèi. '

source_text: but i say to you, do not make use of force against an evil man; but to him who gives you a blow on the right side of your face let the left be turned.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, na hud'i laa, na tèb'e hari ripi dhu leo.

source_text: and if any man goes to law with you and takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe from him.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo tenge lii langu dènge èu, ho neo nare kodho èu, na, hia ne kodho pana èu kahèi.

source_text: and whoever makes you go one mile, go with him two.
target_text: ladhe sordad'u ca dhèu laka-seti èu ho pasae mèdha na kako d'ai ca kilometer, na, èu pasae mèti kaj'èu na toke dua kilometer.

source_text: give to him who comes with a request, and keep not your property from him who would for a time make use of it.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo manèngi nare mèdha èu èci, na, hia la. aa ladhe dhèu neo pija mèdha èu, na, hia la.

source_text: you have knowledge that it was said, have love for your neighbour, and hate for him who is against you:
target_text: miu tadèngi le, dhu peka na, ‘sue la a'ari èu, aa nasa la dènge dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu. '

source_text: but i say to you, have love for those who are against you, and make prayer for those who are cruel to you;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: èu hud'i sue ku dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu, aa manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu.

source_text: so that you may be the sons of your father in heaven; for his sun gives light to the evil and to the good, and he sends rain on the upright man and on the sinner.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu pad'elo, na, èu ana ama ètu sorga. lula nèngu ka tao madha lod'o hia dhèu dhu be'a, dènge dhèu dhu bhelu. na papuru èj'i hia dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha na, aa mi dhèu dhu lab'a paredha na kahèi.

source_text: for if you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? do not the tax-farmers the same?
target_text: de ladhe èu sue dhoka dhèu dhu sue èu, èu ngee na ama lamatua hud'i b'ala hia èu mèngi-nale, do? aad'o! te dhèu bhelu kahèi ne'a sue angalai na, dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: and if you say, good day, to your brothers only, what do you do more than others? do not even the gentiles the same?
target_text: de ladhe èu me'a dhoka hia lii maho'o mi angalai èu, na, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, re'a ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: be then complete in righteousness, even as your father in heaven is complete.
target_text: de sanèd'e, ee! ama mu ètu sorga sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. de èu hud'i tao madhutu ku sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: take care not to do your good works before men, to be seen by them; or you will have no reward from your father in heaven.
target_text: yesus aj'a taruu, peka na, sanèd'e! mage mi madhutu atora agama di, sèna ka dhèu pad'iri miu. te ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga b'ala boe rui-j'aj'èra miu.

source_text: when then you give money to the poor, do not make a noise about it, as the false-hearted men do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may have glory from men. truly, i say to you, they have their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu kasia, mage lami palolo asa mia-mia. te ladhe miu se tao sèmi èèna, miu ca ropa dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèmi sèra, d'èi lasi karihu asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu ne maj'èni madhutu atora agama, nga! ' ja'a peka mola-mola kèna! dhèu dhu tema sèmi rare lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu, rèngu se abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when you give money, let not your left hand see what your right hand does:
target_text: de ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, mage mi palolo kahèi!

source_text: so that your giving may be in secret; and your father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne re'a boe. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a ngaa dhu miu tao pahuni. pe nèngu ka dhu b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and when you make your prayers, be not like the false-hearted men, who take pleasure in getting up and saying their prayers in the synagogues and at the street turnings so that they may be seen by men. truly i say to you, they have their reward.
target_text: lod'o miu sabaj'a, miu baku tao nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu se d'èi lasi asa j'ara dhu dhèu ae-ae, aa titu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho dhèu koa-kad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa nanene pabe'a-be'a! dènge rèngu abhu koa sèmi èèna, rèngu sèmi rare le pala ra.

source_text: but when you make your prayer, go into your private room, and, shutting the door, say a prayer to your father in secret, and your father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna. ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i, lami asa d'ara kama ho bèdho babèdho na. èle èèna, heka mi sabaj'a mau-mau hia ama mi ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu leo rèdhi boe, te ngaa ama miu ladhe nèdhi. bèli-camèd'a na b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and in your prayer do not make use of the same words again and again, as the gentiles do: for they have the idea that god will give attention to them because of the number of their words.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka. rèngu pangee, na, ama lamatua d'èi nanene lii manèngi ra dhu madhera lola-lola èèna.

source_text: so be not like them; because your father has knowledge of your needs even before you make your requests to him.
target_text: mage mi madhutu j'ara rèngu sèra! te masi ka miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama mi ètu sorga, te ngaa nèngu dhu ne'a mema le, ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: let this then be your prayer: our father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
target_text: de ladhe sabaj'a, na, madhutu la conto sèmi ne'e: ‘ama ètu sorga! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai èèna.

source_text: let your kingdom come. let your pleasure be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
target_text: hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i! hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu sorga.

source_text: give us this day bread for our needs.
target_text: ama, hia la ji'i nganga'a-nganginu dhu d'ai bèli-bèli.

source_text: and make us free of our debts, as we have made those free who are in debt to us.
target_text: ji'i manèngi, ho ama saku eele aa'i sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu dhu ra tao mi ji'i.

source_text: and let us not be put to the test, but keep us safe from the evil one.
target_text: ama, j'aga la ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku tao bhabhelu. aa pakaj'èu la ji'i nèti koasa nidhu, te ama ka dhèu aae dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa ama ka dhu mèd'u paredha, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. sabaj'a ji'i d'ai sange ne'e ka, ama. amin. '

source_text: for if you let men have forgiveness for their sins, you will have forgiveness from your father in heaven.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, èèna na ama mi ètu sorga saku eele sasala-sasigo miu kahèi.

source_text: but if you do not let men have forgiveness for their sins, you will not have forgiveness from your father for your sins.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, bèli-camèd'a ama mi bhèlu boe sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and when you go without food, be not sad-faced as the false-hearted are. for they go about with changed looks, so that men may see that they are going without food. truly i say to you, they have their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i aa puasa, mage mi tao rèhu susa, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. te ra ad'u-ue j'ara èèna, ho dhèu pad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se'e se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! dènge sèmi rare koa-kad'iri sèmi èèna, na, rèngu abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when you go without food, put oil on your head and make your face clean;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu puasa, lèu pamèu-mèu rèhu mi, aa sageri paie kètu miu!

source_text: so that no one may see that you are going without food, but your father in secret; and your father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu rèdhi miu, re'a boe na, miu dhu puasa. te ngaa ama miu ne'a. pe na pala hia miu mèngi-nale ae-ae.

source_text: make no store of wealth for yourselves on earth, where it may be turned to dust by worms and weather, and where thieves may come in by force and take it away.
target_text: miu baku sab'a taruu, ho dhodhoka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne di. te hub'u dènge rutu pa'ele iie aa'i si. aa dhèu mana'u mai pa'ele iie era tatèka mèdha-panyau, aa mana'u rèti si.

source_text: but make a store for yourselves in heaven, where it will not be turned to dust and where thieves do not come in to take it away:
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi miu maj'èni sab'a, sèna ka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga. te ètu era nèi, abhu boe hub'u dènge rutu dhu pa'ele iie si, aa abhu boe dhèu mana'u, ho mai mana'u rèti.

source_text: for where your wealth is, there will your heart be.
target_text: te ladhe miu tèka mèdha-panyau miu ètu era mia, na, tatu d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the light of the body is the eye; if then your eye is true, all your body will be full of light.
target_text: musi madha dhèu, nuka sèmi labhu dhu pasaraa d'ara ra. ladhe musi madha na mèu, nèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hua iia, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: but if your eye is evil, all your body will be dark. if then the light which is in you is dark, how dark it will be!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe musi madha na ahu, nèngu bisa boe kako madhutu madha j'ara mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu gogo ai lae-lae ètu d'ara maroga. de ladhe saraa ètu d'ara miu j'aj'i maroga, na miu mamuri d'ara maroga kahèi.

source_text: no man is able to be a servant to two masters: for he will have hate for the one and love for the other, or he will keep to one and have no respect for the other. you may not be servants of god and of wealth.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe sab'a hia dua lamatua, lula èèna na nèngu d'èi risi ca dhèu di. bisa kahèi nèngu madhutu lamatua èci, aa pusi-pahae boe dhu leo. nèti èèna ka, èu bisa boe peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua ja'a, ' ladhe èu tao doi-dhari j'aj'i mi lamatua èu.

source_text: so i say to you, take no thought for your life, about food or drink, or about clothing for your body. is not life more than food, and the body more than its clothing?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku bhute pangee, na, ja'a mamuri tasa mera mia, ku'a-kinu ngaa, pake ngaa? miu pangee na, mamuri ne dhoka ta'a-tinu, di? aa ngi'u ne, dhoka pake mèdha-papake, di? aad'o sèmi èèna.

source_text: see the birds of heaven; they do not put seeds in the earth, they do not get in grain, or put it in store-houses; and your father in heaven gives them food. are you not of much more value than they?
target_text: ladhe ku manu-bhui dhu lela ètu talora liru. rèngu bhute rèdhi boe sèla hini, dènge puu-g'ètu, ho tèka nganga'a ètu d'ara soka. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga piara manu-bhui sèra taruu. tatu nèngu kab'oi miu risi eele nèti rèngu. de ngee pabe'a-be'a. te ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and which of you by taking thought is able to make himself a cubit taller?
target_text: ladhe dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho na bhute dènge lalau ngi'u na, nèngu bisa pamadhera hari ngi'u na, do? bisa boe!

source_text: and why are you troubled about clothing? see the flowers of the field, how they come up; they do no work, they make no thread:
target_text: ladhe bisa boe, na, nga tao ka miu bhute dènge pangee hari mèdha-papake? lami ladhe ku hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. rèngu manyèru boe hèngu, aa manènu boe sig'i sa hèi.

source_text: but i say to you that even solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e ku la! mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua risi, saraga na bisa boe segi saraga hela bunga ne.

source_text: but if god gives such clothing to the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is put into the oven, will he not much more give you clothing, o you of little faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua taru kira mi bunga dhu muri dhoka doe ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe na tao sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu papake miu risi eele nèti hela bunga sèra. de tasamia ka miu parcaya pa'èra boe mi nèngu?

source_text: then do not be full of care, saying, what are we to have for food or drink? or, with what may we be clothed?
target_text: de baku mi pangee na, ‘ji'i neo nga'a ngaa? ' do, ‘neo nginu ngaa? ' do, ‘neo pake ngaa? '

source_text: because the gentiles go in search of all these things: for your father in heaven has knowledge that you have need of all these things:
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, rèngu sab'a loe boe ho neo abhu aa'i-aa'i se. te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le, ngaa-ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: but let your first care be for his kingdom and his righteousness; and all these other things will be given to you in addition.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pakako uuru ku sasab'a na, aa hud'i madhutu ku paredha na, heka na hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu.

source_text: then have no care for tomorrow: tomorrow will take care of itself. take the trouble of the day as it comes.
target_text: de baku bhute pangee, na, bèli miu parluu ngaa. te bèli èèna dènge bhabhute unu na. sasusa lod'o doe ne'e, èle ètu doe ne'e kahèi.

source_text: be not judges of others, and you will not be judged.
target_text: miu baku galaa dhèu, sèna ka ama lamatua baku pasala miu kahèi.

source_text: for as you have been judging, so you will be judged, and with your measure will it be measured to you.
target_text: ladhe miu nile dhèu sèmi mia, pe ama lamatua nile miu sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe miu ige sasala dhèu sèmi mia, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ige sasala miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?
target_text: masi ka sasala dhèu ciki oo'e èèna ka, èu bhèlu boe. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu pame'a boe ciki sa. èci èèna ka dènge èu ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai èu, te ngaa abhu agarii aae ca laa dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, dhu èu me'a more boe.

source_text: or how will you say to your brother, let me take out the grain of dust from your eye, when you yourself have a bit of wood in your eye?
target_text: nga tao ka èu bani peka na, ‘angalai! mai ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu'. aa te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, lula agarii aae dhu hutu nare musi madha mu.

source_text: you false one, first take out the bit of wood from your eye, then will you see clearly to take out the grain of dust from your brother's eye.
target_text: heeh! èu ne, mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! tao eele uuru ku agarii nèti musi madha èu, heka ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai mu, sèna ka èu bisa tiu eele ahu ne kèna.

source_text: do not give that which is holy to the dogs, or put your jewels before pigs, for fear that they will be crushed under foot by the pigs whose attack will then be made against you.
target_text: baku aj'a j'ara lamatua dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu d'èi pahahe dhèu. lula dhèu sèra nuka sèmi busa pakadhi, dhu ra kabèli mai kadhi hari miu. rèngu sèra goa sama sèmi hahi kahèi. ladhe dhèu hia ne mutiara dhu kab'ua, na pusi boe! te ne'a dhoka j'èli palaho di.

source_text: make a request, and it will be answered; what you are searching for you will get; give the sign, and the door will be open to you:
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku loe manèngi mi lamatua; te èèna na, na hia. ladhe patangi-tenge; pe na pad'elo j'ara. ladhe kad'eu taruu babèdho; pe na bhoke.

source_text: because to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire, and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu loe boe manèngi mi lamatua, èèna na ra sèmi rare. dhu patangi-tenge, pe ra abhu. dhu kad'eu taruu, pe na bhoke èmu.

source_text: or which of you, if his son makes a request for bread, will give him a stone?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe ana manèngi roti, tatu ama na hia boe ne hadhu, si?

source_text: or if he makes a request for a fish, will give him a snake?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi i'a, ama na hia boe mege, sina ma?

source_text: if you, then, being evil, are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your father in heaven give good things to those who make requests to him?
target_text: ama mi ètu sorga, mema d'ara na hua iia titu kèna! de ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu bhelu-katub'a sèmi miu, me'a hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana miu, ngaa hari ama mi! tatu na bagi hia miu ngaa dhu miu manèngi.

source_text: all those things, then, which you would have men do to you, even so do you to them: because this is the law and the prophets.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu èu neo dhèu leo tao mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi hia nèngu. lula ne'e ne ka, j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka-padhai karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: go in by the narrow door; for wide is the door and open is the way which goes to destruction, and great numbers go in by it.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo maso sorga, nèngu hud'i maso ku re hèb'a kota dhu kob'o. te ngaa mage-mage, oo! abhu kahèi j'ara leo dhu mud'a, aa hèb'a dhu taleo, dhu dhèu ae-ae lasi re èèna. te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu lere dhèu asa naraka, ka ra cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for narrow is the door and hard the road to life, and only a small number make discovery of it.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo maso sorga, hud'i madhutu ku j'ara dhu susa, aa maso re hèb'a dhu kob'o. te, masi ka dhèu ciki di dhu kako re j'ara èèna, te ngaa j'ara dhu kob'o èèna ka, dhu nèti dhèu asa lamatua.

source_text: be on the watch for false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inside they are cruel wolves.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu dhu tema kapod'e-kabèli, dhu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu se dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. te rèngu tao ngi'u ra be'a nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge busa hui dhu mai kadhi kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: by their fruits you will get knowledge of them. do men get grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
target_text: tasamia ho miu bisa tadhe dhèu dhu kapod'e sèmi sèra? ladhe la nèti tatao rèngu. èèna sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi hua, hèia tadhe dènge ana aaj'u ne. hua dhu be'a, mai boe nèti aj'u dhu karehe.

source_text: even so, every good tree gives good fruit; but the bad tree gives evil fruit.
target_text: te aj'u dhu be'a ladhe d'ai hua, hua na be'a kahèi. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe ladhe na hua, hua na karehe kahèi.

source_text: it is not possible for a good tree to give bad fruit, and a bad tree will not give good fruit.
target_text: abhu ètu mia, aj'u dhu be'a, hua na karehe, aa aj'u dhu karehe, hua na be'a?

source_text: every tree which does not give good fruit is cut down and put in the fire.
target_text: aj'u dhu hua na karehe, tatu ra patue eele, ho core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: so by their fruits you will get knowledge of them.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu rèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli sèra. miu tadhe si nèti tatao ra.

source_text: not everyone who says to me, lord, lord, will go into the kingdom of heaven; but he who does the pleasure of my father in heaven.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua! ' te ngaa rèngu dhoka ale ètu hèb'a di. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ètu sorga tule eele si. te dhodhoka dhèu dhu d'èi tao madhutu dad'èi nèngu di, dhu na sèmi nare rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: a great number will say to me on that day, lord, lord, were we not prophets in your name, and did we not by your name send out evil spirits, and by your name do works of power?
