target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: the kingdom of heaven is like a secret store of wealth in a field, which a man came across and put back again; and in his joy he goes and gives all he has, to get that field.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: again, the kingdom of heaven is like a trader searching for beautiful jewels.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: and having come across one jewel of great price, he went and gave all he had in exchange for it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, which was put into the sea and took in every sort of fish:
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: when it was full, they took it up on the sands; and seated there they put the good into vessels, but the bad they put away.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: so will it be in the end of the world: the angels will come and take out the bad from the good,
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and will put them into the fire: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: are all these things now clear to you? they say to him, yes.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: and he said to them, for this reason every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house, who gives out from his store things new and old.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: and when jesus had come to the end of these stories he went away from there.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: and coming into his country, he gave them teaching in their synagogue, so that they were greatly surprised and said, where did this man get this wisdom and these works of power?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: is not this the woodworker's son? is not his mother named mary? and his brothers james and joseph and simon and judas?
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: and his sisters, are they not all with us? from where, then, has he all these things?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: and they were bitter against him. but jesus said to them, a prophet is nowhere without honour but in his country and among his family.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: and the works of power which he did there were small in number because they had no faith.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: at that time news of jesus came to herod the king;
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: and he said to his servants, this is john the baptist; he has come back from the dead, and so these powers are working in him.
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: for herod had taken john and put him in prison because of herodias, his brother philip's wife.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka.

source_text: because john had said to him, it is not right for you to have her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: and he would have put him to death, but for his fear of the people, because in their eyes john was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa herodes dale boe lii kai na, hèia leo nare herodias. madhutu iia-iia na, herodes neo pamadhe yohanis tuka sarani. te ngaa na madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, lula ra parcaya na, yohanis ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, na pua dhèu sab'a na pamaso yohanis asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but when herod's birthday came, the daughter of herodias was dancing before them, and herod was pleased with her.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, hèia herodes tao pesta hari jadi na. lod'o èèna, ana bhèni nèti bhèni aae herodias la'e roge ètu madha tamu se. na roge be'a titu kèna, toke d'ara herodes karej'e bia.

source_text: so he gave her his word with an oath to let her have whatever she might make request for.
target_text: na roge nare, hèia herodes paroa ne, ka na peka, èu neo manèngi hadia ngaa nèti ja'a, na peka la! te èèna na ja'a hia èu. ja'a leko boe-monya boe. aa ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and she, at her mother's suggestion, said, give me here on a plate the head of john the baptist.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu aae peka sèmi èèna, hèia ina na kakèj'i ne. nèti èèna ka, ana ne la'e peka na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu nèti yohanis tuka sarani. tèke ne mi d'ara dula, ho rèti mai asa ne'e hia ja'a.

source_text: and the king was sad; but because of his oaths and because of his guests, he gave the order for it to be given to her;
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ana bhèni ne, hèia d'ara herodes roe dènge. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe ère nare hari lii subha na, te tamu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le. nèti èèna ka, na madhutu dhoka dad'èi ana bhèni ne di.

source_text: and he sent and had john's head cut off in the prison.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu lasi poro rare kètu yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and his head was put on a plate and given to the girl; and she took it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, hèia ra tèke mi d'ara dula ho rèti lasi hia mi ana bhèni ne. ropa ana bhèni ne sèmi nare dula, hèia nèti asa ina na.

source_text: and his disciples came, and took up his body and put it in the earth; and they went and gave jesus news of what had taken place.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se tadèngi, ka mai rare ngi'u aae na, ho lasi padhane. èle ka, lasi peka dènge yesus j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: now when it came to the ears of jesus, he went away from there in a boat, to a waste place by himself: and the people hearing of it, went after him on foot from the towns.
target_text: lod'o yesus tadèngi ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi yohanis, hèia nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna. hèia ra ca'e koha, ho lasi asa era dhu dhèu pea boe, sèna ka ra ae rare ciki. te ngaa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi koha yesus si dhu oro-oro re sebhe dano. ka dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae, kako karohe-karohe re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se d'ai uuru nèti yesus si.

source_text: and he came out and saw a great number of people and he had pity on them, and made well those of them who were ill.
target_text: ropa na puru nèti dedha koha, hèia nèdhi dhèu ae-ae dhu mate le nèngu. ka na rasa kasia mi rèngu. hèia na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and when evening had come, the disciples came to him, saying, this place is waste land, and the time is now past; send the people away so that they may go into the towns and get themselves food.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, hèia ana madhutu na, peka dènge ne, ama! hua iia ama pua dhèu se, sèna ka lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae-rae dhu padètu ètu se'e. te lod'o nihia le! ètu ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but jesus said to them, there is no need for them to go away; give them food yourselves.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, baku! miu ka dhu panga'a si.

source_text: and they say to him, we have here but five cakes of bread and two fishes.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ira ee, ama! ji'i se dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, ho panga'a dhèu ae-ae sèmi ne'e ne. ji'i tao tasamia? te abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua di, aa i'a dua ngi'u di!

source_text: and he said, give them to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, oo! be'a kèna. mèti ku mai!

source_text: and he gave orders for the people to be seated on the grass; and he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing, and made division of the food, and gave it to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi kaboko ètu dedha j'u'u. èle èèna ka, yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. hèia na ladhe asa dedha, ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle ka, na pamae roti se, hèia j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they all took of the food and had enough: and they took up twelve baskets full of broken bits which were not used.
target_text: ka dhèu se ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rara, hèia ana madhutu se pakaboko rare dhu ata, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and those who had food were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone pe d'ai lèmi riho sa, iga mèka dhèu bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and straight away he made the disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, till he had sent the people away.
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a rare, hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na ca'e koha, sèna ka lasi uru asa cabèka dano. te ngaa nèngu ètu èèna era, sena ka pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and after he had sent the people away, he went up into the mountain by himself for prayer: and when evening was come, he was there by himself.
target_text: ropa rèngu lèpa aa'i mèu-mèu, hèia yesus ca'e la'e asa ledhe èci, ho sabaj'a. toke mèda, nèngu mesa na ètu èèna era.

source_text: but the boat was now in the middle of the sea, and was troubled by the waves: for the wind was against them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, koha ana madhutu na d'ai le talora aae dano. te ngaa rèngu tuku d'ai madhe, lula ngèlu nèti madha, aa naha kapai tatèb'e koha ra.

source_text: and in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.
target_text: oe d'ai mèu, hèia yesus la'e madhutu si. te ngaa nèngu dhu kako re dedha èi.

source_text: and when they saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, it is a spirit; and they gave cries of fear.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, ana madhutu se cag'ag'a, hèia ra padhai dènge lii madha'u, aku rèngu na, heeh! nidhu kèna!

source_text: but straight away jesus said to them, take heart; it is i, have no fear.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, peka na, miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne, yesus! mau-mau la!

source_text: and peter, answering, said to him, lord, if it is you, give me the order to come to you on the water.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia petrus peka na, ladhe ama kèna, pua la ja'a kako re dedha èi ne, dhiu asa ama.

source_text: and he said, come. and peter got out of the boat, and walking on the water, went to jesus.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa peka na, mai ka! hèia petrus puru nèti dedha koha, la'e re dedha èi, asa yesus.

source_text: but when he saw the wind he was in fear and, starting to go down, he gave a cry, saying, help, lord.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus rasa na ngèlu aae, hèia na madha'u bia. ka na mulai cène, hèia na pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ira oo, ama, ee! soru ku ja'a la!

source_text: and straight away jesus put out his hand and took a grip of him, and said to him, o man of little faith, why were you in doubt?
target_text: yesus j'ole dènge ka kacui-aai na, ka kèpe nare petrus. hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, petrus, ee! nga tao ka d'ara èu kajari? èu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a, do?

source_text: and when they had got into the boat, the wind went down.
target_text: ka dua ra ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, hèia ngèlu mau dènge.

source_text: and those who were in the boat gave him worship, saying, truly you are the son of god.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na koa-kio padedha-dedha ne, peka na, ira ii! ama ne, mema tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: and when they had gone across, they came to land at gennesaret.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, hèia ra puru lasi asa dedha nebhe nèti rae genesaret.

source_text: and when the men of that place had news of him, they sent into all the country round about, and took to him all who were ill,
target_text: lod'o ra puru èèna, dhèu ae dhu tadhe le. hèia dhèu pa'oo, peka na, wee! yesus mai le! ra rai lasi peka palème, hèia dhèu rèti dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: with the request that they might only put their hands on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.
target_text: ra manèngi sèna ka ra goi lèke kodho yesus. te ra pangee na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a goi lèke suu kodho na, tatu dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i se goi kodho yesus, ka ra èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: then there came to jesus from jerusalem pharisees and scribes, saying,
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu parisi dènge mese agama ca nau mai nèti yerusalem, ho paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: why do your disciples go against the teaching of the fathers? for they take food with unwashed hands.
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi rèngu. lod'o rèngu tadèngi, na, ladhe ana madhutu yesus ra'a-rinu dhu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu ad'a ra, hèia ra nasa. ka rèngu mai ho pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe ai? èèna na, sisu le ad'a bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: and in answer he said to them, why do you, yourselves, go against the word of god on account of the teaching which has been handed down to you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu lab'a paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu ad'a tatao nèti bèi-baki miu di.

source_text: for god said, give honour to your father and mother: and, he who says evil of father or mother will be put to death.
target_text: te ama lamatua paredha, peka na, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa peka hari, na, ‘ladhe ca dhèu padhèd'a aapa ina do ama na, hud'i huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but you say, if a man says to his father or his mother, that by which you might have had profit from me is given to god; there is no need for him to give honour to his father. and you have made the word of god without effect because of your teaching.
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ca dhèu parluu boe pake mèdha-panyau na, sèna ka soru-bara ina-ama na, masi ka rèngu ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ladhe na pamoa le neo hia mèdha ne asa lamatua' te ngaa dènge aj'a sèmi èèna, miu core eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho gati dènge atora unu miu.

source_text: you false ones, well did isaiah say of you,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a dhu peka le, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! èèna na, nuka sèmi yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: these people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
target_text: ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara.

source_text: but their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.
target_text: masi ka rèngu tao sèmi èèna, te ngaa parcuma. ra pusi-pahae boe ja'a, te rèngu sèra pahae dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. '

source_text: and he got the people together and said to them, give ear, and let my words be clear to you:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ètu èèna, ka na aj'a si, peka na, pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu!

source_text: not that which goes into the mouth makes a man unclean, but that which comes out of the mouth.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara hèb'a, pakaj'alu boe dhèu. te ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: then the disciples came and said to him, did you see that the pharisees were troubled when these words came to their ears?
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu na mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama me'a, do? dhèu parisi se d'ara pèd'a ropa tadèngi lii padhai ama.

source_text: but he said in answer, every plant which my father in heaven has not put in the earth, will be taken up by the roots.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga, èèna na core eele dhèu dhu aj'a madhutu boe dad'èi na. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu ko'o eele j'u'u dhu na d'èi boe.

source_text: let them be: they are blind guides. and if a blind man is guiding a blind man, the two will go falling into a hole together.
target_text: de baku pusi-pahae dènge dhèu parisi sèi! te rèngu ca ropa dènge dhèu bèdhu dhu pakako dhèu bèdhu. èèna na ra manahu palere-lere asa d'ara ro'a lasi.

source_text: then peter said to him, make the story clear to us.
target_text: ka petrus lii, peka na, ama, lole ku dènge ji'i la, sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na!

source_text: and he said, are you, like them, still without wisdom?
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, miu me'a mèka kahèi?

source_text: do you not see that whatever goes into the mouth goes on into the stomach, and is sent out as waste?
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e: ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara hèb'a, la'e taruu asa kabake, èle èèna kalua hari la'e asa d'ara kakus.

source_text: but the things which come out of the mouth come from the heart; and they make a man unclean.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu, toke ama lamatua madenge dènge ne, aa d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for out of the heart come evil thoughts, the taking of life, broken faith between the married, unclean desires of the flesh, taking of property, false witness, bitter words:
target_text: te j'ara-j'ara karehe, ae ka dhu mai nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee dhu bhelu, pamadhe dhèu, bersina, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, mana'u, sakasii kapod'e-kabèli, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: these are the things which make a man unclean; but to take food with unwashed hands does not make a man unclean.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara se'e ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu dhoka ra'a j'amo boe ai madhutu ad'a, èèna sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and jesus went away from there into the country of tyre and sidon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tèke eele era ne'e, kako la'e asa kota tirus dènge kota sidon.

source_text: and a woman of canaan came out from those parts, crying and saying, have pity on me, o lord, son of david; my daughter is greatly troubled with an unclean spirit.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu ina ca dhèu dhu j'aj'aj'i na nèti rai ne'e. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe. ropa na tadèngi nare yesus mai le asa ne'e, hèia la'e manèngi, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a, lèke nidhu tao. kasia ku ji'i la! te na j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: but he gave her no answer. and his disciples came and said to him, send her away, for she is crying after us.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, aa dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa ciki sa. hèia ana madhutu na mai peka dènge ne, ama, ina ne pa'oo-parodha loe boe. be'a risi ama babège eele ne nèti ne'e!

source_text: but he made answer and said, i was sent only to the wandering sheep of the house of israel.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, ho soru-bara dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi, lula rèngu kako sala j'ara, nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu re'a heka j'ara. te na pua boe ja'a sèna ka soru-bara dhèu leo.

source_text: but she came and gave him worship, saying, help, lord.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne mai padètu-dètu asa yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu dènge lii manèngi, ama! sue ku ja'a la!

source_text: and he made answer and said, it is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, pantas boe tare nganga'a nèti ana-ana, ka hia mi busa. dènge lii dhu pacele, sasoa na, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu unu na, heka bisa ladhe-leru dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but she said, yes, lord: but even the dogs take the bits from under their masters' table.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, tare'a ama! te ngaa busa dhu mate mema ètu ro'a mei. rèngu ra'a kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe eele nèti d'ara pega ana sèra. sasoa na, ropa ana-ana ra'a, busa kahèi abhu ra'a. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i ladhe-leru dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: then jesus, answering, said to her, o woman, great is your faith: let your desire be done. and her daughter was made well from that hour.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus peka na, ira ii! ina parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a! de lèpa ka, lula ngaa dhu ina manèngi èèna, j'aj'i le! èle èèna ka, na lèpa, ka na ladhe nèdhi ana na dhu èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and jesus went from there and came to the sea of galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and took his seat there.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era ne'e, hèia ra kako madhutu re sebhe dano galilea. ka ra ca'e asa ledhe cue, hèia yesus madhèdi ho aj'a-nori si.

source_text: and there came to him great numbers of people having with them those who were broken in body, or blind, or without voice, or wounded, or ill in any way, and a number of others; they put them down at his feet and he made them well:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae-ae mai asa yesus. ra rèti dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dhèu lii aad'o, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pèd'a leo kahèi. ra pamadhèdi dhèu pèd'a se padètu-dètu dènge haga yesus. ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: so that the people were full of wonder when they saw that those who had no voice were talking, the feeble were made strong, those whose bodies were broken had the power of walking, and the blind were able to see: and they gave glory to the god of israel.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia dhèu ae se malaa. ra papeka na, ira ii! malaa titu kèna, nga! dhèu haga roe cabèka, bisa kako èra hari. dhèu bèdhu, bisa rèdhi. dhèu karuku, bisa kako. aa dhèu lii aad'o, bisa padhai lii! se'e se, tatu tatao ama lamatua. aa lamatua èèna ka, dhu uru-uru sèra bèi-baki èdhi pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and jesus got his disciples together and said, i have pity for the people, because they have now been with me three days and have no food: and i will not send them away without food, or they will have no strength for the journey.
target_text: lalu eele pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae-ae se. abhu dhu mai nèti era kaj'èu, ra pakaboko ètu ne'e tèlu lod'o kèna, toke gee ra èle aa'i le. be'a risi baku hia si lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra bèbha ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and the disciples say to him, how may we get enough bread in a waste place, to give food to such a number of people?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama! era ne'e kaj'èu nèti rae. tatu, èdhi bisa boe panga'a tare dhèu ae-ae sèmi se'e.

source_text: and jesus says to them, how much bread have you? and they said, seven cakes, and some small fishes.
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, roti miu pèri bua? ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, dhoka pidhu di, dènge i'a pèri ngi'u di!

source_text: then he gave an order to the people to be seated on the earth,
target_text: ka yesus pua dhèu se'e madhèdi ètu rai.

source_text: and he took the seven cakes of bread and the fishes; and having given praise, he gave the broken bread to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.
target_text: hèia nare roti pidhu bua dènge i'a sèra, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti se, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they all took food, and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits, seven baskets full.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu. ka ra kaboko rare nganga'a dhu ata, pènu pidhu soe hahake.

source_text: and there were four thousand men who took food, together with women and children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone ele boe d'ai èpa riho dhèu sa. dhae ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki sèra.

source_text: and when he had sent the people away, he got into the boat, and came into the country of magadan.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua dhèu ae-ae sèra lèpa. hèia na ca'e asa dedha koha, ho lasi asa rai magadan.

source_text: and the pharisees and sadducees came and, testing him, made a request to him to give them a sign from heaven.
target_text: ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki, mai paraga dènge yesus. rèngu neo pakarèi dènge ne, sèna ka tenge j'ara neo pamanahu yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi sèmi ne'e ka, ama! tao ku tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, dhu peka na, ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but in answer he said to them, at nightfall you say, the weather will be good, for the sky is red.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, ladhe èdhi tèdhi liru mea ropa lod'o cèna, èdhi te'a, na, ‘bèli èj'i mai boe. '

source_text: and in the morning, the weather will be bad today, for the sky is red and angry. you are able to see the face of heaven, but not the signs of the times.
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o rea, aa liru mèdhi, na èdhi te'a, na, ‘doe ne'e, oe èj'i. ' de ladhe miu bisa patadhe mere tadha ètu liru sèmi sèra, nga tao ka miu bisa boe patadhe mere sasoa nèti tadha-tadha jaman?

source_text: an evil and false generation is searching after a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of jonah. and he went away from them.
target_text: miu dhèu lod'o limuri ne, me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di! miu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a dale boe tao. lula uru èèna, lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa re yunus, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. de èèna d'ai le! ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus tèke eele si.

source_text: and when the disciples came to the other side they had not taken thought to get bread.
target_text: ropa yesus si lasi asa ca bèka dano, hèia ana madhutu na, heka sanèd'e, na, rèngu rèti boe roti tao gee j'ara.

source_text: and jesus said to them, take care to have nothing to do with the leaven of the pharisees and sadducees.
target_text: tadèngi rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia na peka na, miu baku pamud'e dènge ragi dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: and they were reasoning among themselves, saying, we took no bread.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana madhutu na bingu, ka ra peka, na peka ngaa nèi? ele boe ne'a na, èdhi tèti boe roti, sina ma?

source_text: and jesus, seeing it, said, o you of little faith, why are you reasoning among yourselves, because you have no bread?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, wee, miu seli-kolane, nga! nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu parcaya boe ja'a, do?

source_text: do you still not see, or keep in mind the five cakes of bread of the five thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?
target_text: miu dhae me'a iia mèka koasa ja'a, do? te lod'o ja'a pamae lèmi bua roti ho panga'a lèmi riho dhèu sèra, dhu sisa, miu pakaboko mere pèri soe?

source_text: or the seven cakes of bread of the four thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?
target_text: aa tasamia hari dènge roti pidhu bua dhu ja'a panga'a èpa riho dhèu sèra? abhu pèri soe hahake dhu miu pakaboko nèti dhu ra'a risi sèra?

source_text: how is it that you do not see that i was not talking to you about bread, but about keeping away from the leaven of the pharisees and sadducees?
target_text: nga tao ka miu mo'o boe me'a dènge lii padhai ja'a deo na? ja'a padhue-padhai boe lula roti. te ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku pamud'e dènge tatao dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki. te lii aj'a-nori ra bisa ère rare dhèu ae, nuka sèmi ragi dhu tao roti j'aj'i kapai.

source_text: then they saw that it was not the leaven of bread which he had in mind, but the teaching of the pharisees and sadducees.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia heka rèngu re'a kèna, na nèngu peka boe roti. te ngaa na padhue-padhai nèti a'aj'a dhu sale nèti dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: now when jesus had come into the parts of caesarea philippi, he said, questioning his disciples, who do men say that the son of man is?
target_text: èle, hèia yesus si lasi asa rai dhu padètu dènge kota kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, madhutu lii papeka dhèu, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they said, some say, john the baptist; some, elijah; and others, jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, abhu dhu peka na, ama ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu mamuri hari. cahag'e peka na, ele boe ama ne, elia. cahag'e hari ale na, yermia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu leo nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra.

source_text: he says to them, but who do you say that i am?
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari si, ladhe madhutu miu mesa mi, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and simon peter made answer and said, you are the christ, the son of the living god.
target_text: hèia simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo hia mai! aa ama ne, ana ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia!

source_text: and jesus made answer and said to him, a blessing on you, simon bar-jonah: because this knowledge has not come to you from flesh and blood, but from my father in heaven.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii, peka na, simon, ana yunus! èu ne, oto kapai! te nèti boe dhèu rai-haha dhu peka lii ne'e dènge èu. te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga ka peka dènge èu.

source_text: and i say to you that you are peter, and on this rock will my church be based, and the doors of hell will not overcome it.
target_text: nanene, ee! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a pangare èu, ‘petrus'. dhu sasoa na, hadhu. lula parcaya èu, èra sèmi hadhu, èèna na èu j'aj'i era padhèdi nèti dhèu-dhèu ja'a dhu parcaya. masi ka rèngu abhu j'aj'èra toke madhe, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu.

source_text: i will give to you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever is fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.
target_text: ja'a èèna na hia èu hak, sèna ka èu uri dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nuka sèmi èu mèd'u gagoe sorga. te, ngaa dhu èu kai ètu rai-haha, èèna na lamatua kai ètu sorga kahèi. dènge ngaa dhu èu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: then he gave orders to the disciples to give no man word that he was the christ.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka yesus kai si ho rèngu baku peka dènge dhèu, na, nèngu ne, kristus.

source_text: from that time jesus went on to make clear to his disciples how he would have to go up to jerusalem, and undergo much at the hands of those in authority and the chief priests and scribes, and be put to death, and the third day come again from the dead.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku ku asa yerusalem. te ngaa ètu nèi, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and peter, protesting, said to him, be it far from you, lord; it is impossible that this will come about.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia petrus ère nare yesus asa karasa, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! tatu ama lamatua soro tèke boe j'ara ne j'aj'i!

source_text: but he, turning to peter, said, get out of my way, satan: you are a danger to me because your mind is not on the things of god, but on the things of men.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai petrus ne, madhutu boe dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus kabib'a, ka jèke ne, peka na, heh! pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! lii padhai èèna nèti dhèu aae nidhu! èu baku bhabhae ja'a! èu ne dhodhoka pangee madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: then jesus said to his disciples, if any man would come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross, and come after me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, hèia yesus aj'a ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu ku bèli-bèli! nèngu hud'i pa'uru ku dad'èi ama lamatua, aa pabhèlu eele dad'èi nèngu unu na. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu, sama sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, la'e asa era mamadhe na.

source_text: because whoever has a desire to keep his life safe will have it taken from him; but whoever gives up his life because of me, will have it given back to him.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na di, èèna na mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara!

source_text: for what profit has a man, if he gets all the world with the loss of his life? or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ladhe lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ètu mia? masi ka èu pasae mèti aa'i isi rai-haha ne, èu bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu!

source_text: for the son of man will come in the glory of his father with his angels; and then he will give to every man the reward of his works.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai hari dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. lod'o èèna, pe ja'a b'ala mi ca dhèu-ca dhèu madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: truly i say to you, there are some of those here who will not have a taste of death, till they see the son of man coming in his kingdom.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! nèti miu aa'i-aa'i se, bèli-camèd'a abhu cahag'e dhu madhe boe, toke ra rèdhi ja'a, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha.

source_text: and after six days jesus takes with him peter, and james, and john, his brother, and makes them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves.
target_text: èle èna lod'o, ka yesus paroa petrus, yakobis dènge ari na yohanis, sèna ka lasi asa ledhe dhu dedha èci, ho pea mesa ra ètu nèi.

source_text: and he was changed in form before them; and his face was shining like the sun, and his clothing became white as light.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra ladhe na, rupa yesus leko-leo. rèhu na kaha'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o, aa mèdha-papake na j'aj'i pudhi kale'e.

source_text: and moses and elijah came before their eyes, talking with him.
target_text: kaca'a la, rèngu ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge musa dènge elia.

source_text: and peter made answer and said to jesus, lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will let me, i will make here three tents, one for you, and one for moses, and one for elijah.
target_text: hèia petrus bingu, ka na padhai lii leli, aku nèngu na, ama! ji'i karej'e titu kèna ètu era ne'e ne! de be'a risi ji'i patitu paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: while he was still talking, a bright cloud came over them: and a voice out of the cloud, saying, this is my dearly loved son, with whom i am well pleased; give ear to him.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna era, cag'ag'a laa, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare rèngu. hèia rèngu malaa-maloha tadèngi lii èci dhu kalua nèti d'ara ra'i-liru ne, peka na, nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a. nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and at these words the disciples went down on their faces in great fear.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii ne, hèia ana madhutu na madha'u titu kèna, ka ra bèbha sagèb'a ètu rai.

source_text: and jesus came and put his hand on them and said, get up and have no fear.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mai gai si, ka na peka na, mi kèd'i ka, baku madha'u!

source_text: and lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, but jesus only.
target_text: ka ana madhutu se boti kètu ra, te ngaa ra ladhe rèdhi heka dhèu èci sa ètu era èèna, dhoka yesus di.

source_text: and when they were coming down from the mountain, jesus gave them orders, saying, let no man have word of what you have seen, till the son of man has come again from the dead.
target_text: èle ka, ra puru nèti ledhe ne. hèia yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, ngaa dhu heka ladhe mèdhi deo na, mage peka dènge dhèu èci sa kahèi! te ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. èle èèna, ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, heka miu lole dènge dhèu kèna.

source_text: and his disciples, questioning him, said, why then do the scribes say that elijah has to come first?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama ne mema kristus, te ngaa elia ètu mia? te mese agama se aj'a, peka na, elia hud'i mai uuru ku, èle èèna, heka kristus mai kèna. te ngaa madhutu ama, tasamia?

source_text: and in answer he said, elijah truly has to come and put all things right:
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema lèke. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus.

source_text: but i say to you that elijah has come, and they had no knowledge of him, but did to him whatever they were pleased to do; the same will the son of man undergo at their hands.
target_text: nanene paie! elia mai le, te ngaa dhèu tadhe boe ne. rèngu paj'èra ne, madhutu dad'èi ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a rèngu paj'èra ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: then the disciples saw that he was talking to them of john the baptist.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, ana madhutu na heka re'a, na, elia dhu yesus peka ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani.

source_text: and when they came to the people, a man went down on his knees to him, saying,
target_text: èle ka, ropa rèngu lèpa, paraga dènge dhèu ae dhu mate le. hèia ama ca dhèu mai patitu kètu urutuu, ka na manèngi yesus,

source_text: lord have mercy on my son: for he is off his head, and is in great pain; and frequently he goes falling into the fire, and frequently into the water.
target_text: na peka, ama! sue ku ana ja'a la! te nèngu dhu huj'u kahib'i, aa na j'èra titu kèna. ladhe èi papèd'a ne cèu, na bèbhe sa d'ara èi, do d'ara ai. ama sue ku la!

source_text: and i took him to your disciples, and they were not able to make him well.
target_text: ana ne, ja'a kèti le asa ana-ana madhutu ama ku, te ngaa ra tao rare boe ne.

source_text: and jesus, answering, said, o false and foolish generation, how long will i be with you? how long will i put up with you? let him come here to me.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus jèke ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, heh! miu se seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a le miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a mèu boe. aa miu parcaya boe ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ja'a hud'i mate hari ku miu, d'ai pèri lod'o? mèti ana èèna mai!

source_text: and jesus gave orders to the unclean spirit, and it went out of him: and the boy was made well from that hour.
target_text: hèia, rèti ana ne, ka yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana ne'e. ka nidhu rai tèke eele ne, hèia ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: then the disciples came to jesus privately, and said, why were we not able to send it out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ropa yesus mesa na dènge ana madhutu sèra, ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège ngare nidhu deo na?

source_text: and he says to them, because of your little faith: for truly i say to you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, be moved from this place to that; and it will be moved; and nothing will be impossible to you.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, miu babège mere boe, lula miu parcaya boe dènge d'ara kateme. sanèd'e! ladhe miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka sama sèmi lamusi ana iiki-iiki èci, miu bisa paredha ledhe èci, peka na, ‘hee ledhe, hari sa nèi, lamu! ' tatu na hari kahèi. de miu bisa tao ngaa èèna ka, sad'i parcaya dènge d'ara kateme.
te ngaa sanèd'e! nidhu sèmi se'e se, mema bhelu titu kèna. ladhe miu sabaj'a boe aa puasa boe, ho manèngi mi ama lamatua, na, miu babège mere boe nidhu sèmi sèra.

source_text: and while they were going about in galilee, jesus said to them, the son of man will be given up into the hands of men;
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhu pakaboko ètu propensi galilea. na peka dènge rèngu, na, nèbhu heka, te ra neo pahie ja'a asa dhèu leo rai kara.

source_text: and they will put him to death, and the third day he will come again from the dead. and they were very sad.
target_text: hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a ja'a mamuri hari. ropa ana madhutu na sèra tadèngi lii deo na, hèia d'ara ra susa titu kèna.

source_text: and when they had come to capernaum, those who took the temple tax came to peter and said, does not your master make payment of the temple tax?
target_text: lod'o yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa rae kapernaum, hèia dhèu roro bea mai paraga dènge petrus, ka ra karèi ne, na, mese miu b'ae bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i do, aad'o?

source_text: he says, yes. and when he came into the house, jesus said to him, what is your opinion, simon? from whom do the kings of the earth get payment or tax? from their sons or from other people?
target_text: hèia petrus dhaa, na b'ae! ropa petrus lepa, ka yesus karèi dènge ka, aku nèngu na, simon, èu pangee ku la! dhèu aae-dhèu aae ètu rai-haha ne abhu bea nèti cee? nèti ana matana ra, do, nèti dhèu leo?

source_text: and when he said, from other people, jesus said to him, then are the sons free.
target_text: petrus dhaa, na, nèti dhèu leo! ka yesus tuhu lii padhai na, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ana dhèu aae di dhu b'ae boe, si?

source_text: but, so that we may not be a cause of trouble to them, go to the sea, and let down a hook, and take the first fish which comes up; and in his mouth you will see a bit of money: take that, and give it to them for me and you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa hud'i laa, sèna ka dhèu roro bea se baku nasa dènge èdhi. de be'a risi lamu madulu i'a asa d'ara dano. i'a dhu èu abhu uuru èèna, èu bhoke hèb'a na. pe èu abhu doi iia cue. more, ho b'ae bea èdhi dua ti. te doi ne, d'ai le bea èdhi dua ti.

source_text: in that hour the disciples came to jesus, saying, who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus lasi karèi ne, peka na, ama! nèti dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, cee ka dhu kapai risi?

source_text: and he took a little child, and put him in the middle of them,
target_text: hèia yesus paroa nare ana iiki èci, mai patitu asa talora aae rèngu.

source_text: and said, truly, i say to you, if you do not have a change of heart and become like little children, you will not go into the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, nanene paie-iie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, rèngu hud'i ub'a ngangee ra, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: whoever, then, will make himself as low as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: lula dhèu dhu ne'a pahaha iisi sama sèmi ana iiki ne, nèngu èèna ka dhu kapai risi ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and whoever gives honour to one such little child in my name, gives honour to me:
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu haha nuka sèmi ana iiki ne, lula na parcaya ja'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare le ja'a ne.

source_text: but whoever is a cause of trouble to one of these little ones who have faith in me, it would be better for him to have a great stone fixed to his neck, and to come to his end in the deep sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki sèna ka madhutu j'ara dhu sale, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a, na, mata unu na! be'a risi dhèu èki hadhu aae cue, mi ladha goro na, ho pacène ne asa d'ara dhasi marèma.

source_text: a curse is on the earth because of trouble! for it is necessary for trouble to come; but unhappy is that man through whom the trouble comes.
target_text: rai-haha ne mema era dhu pènu dènge dhudhu-sete, lula abhu j'ara ae dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala-sasigo. te ngaa dhèu dhu dui babia risi, nuka dhèu dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho soro dhèu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: and if your hand or your foot is a cause of trouble, let it be cut off and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with the loss of a hand or a foot than, having two hands or two feet, to go into the eternal fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala, pake kacui-aai èu, do, haga èu, na, poro eele ne! te be'a risi èu maso asa d'ara sorga dènge ai cabèka, do, haga calaa. mage dhoka ra core èu asa d'ara ai naraka, dènge ai do haga dhu tesa.

source_text: and if your eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out, and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with one eye than, having two eyes, to go into the hell of fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala, pake musi madha èu, na, cèru eele ne! te be'a risi èu maso asa d'ara sorga dènge musi madha cabèka. mage dhoka ra core èu asa d'ara ai naraka, dènge musi madha dhu tesa.

source_text: let it not seem to you that one of these little ones is of no value; for i say to you that in heaven their angels see at all times the face of my father in heaven.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! baku mi pahaha ana iiki sèmi se'e se. te abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu madhenga si. aa ana pajuu se dhu lasi taruu, peka dènge ama lamatua ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi ana se.

source_text: what would you say now? if a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them has gone wandering away, will he not let the ninety-nine be, and go to the mountains in search of the wandering one? and if he comes across it, truly i say to you, he has more joy over it than over the ninety-nine which have not gone out of the way.
target_text: mi pangee paie-iie, te ja'a hia lii pakasame èci sèmi ne'e ka: abhu dhèu èci dhu kahib'i-kalèbho na, cangasu ngi'u. ca lod'o, ci'u nèti kahib'i-kalèbho se, kako sala j'ara. madhutu ngangee miu, dhèu madhenga ne tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele ceo nguru ceo ngi'u sèra ètu ledhe, ho la'e tenge ci'u dhu ele ne. ladhe na abhu hari, tatu na karej'e, ropa na ladhe nèdhi ci'u ne, risi nèti kahib'i-kalèbho na ceo nguru ceo ngi'u dhu ele boe sèra. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai ho hia mamuri mi dhèu dhu kako sale nèti j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: even so it is not the pleasure of your father in heaven for one of these little ones to come to destruction.
target_text: te, masi ka ana iiki ca dhèu di dhu kako sala j'ara, te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga d'èi boe kahèi.

source_text: and if your brother does wrong to you, go, make clear to him his error between you and him in private: if he gives ear to you, you have got your brother back again.
target_text: yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya tao sale mi èu, na, èu mesa mu lamu paraga dènge ne. ladhe miu dua mi mesa mi, heka èu peka sasala nèngu kèna. ladhe na sèmi nare lii padhai èu, na, miu dua mi pabe'a hari le kèna.

source_text: but if he will not give ear to you, take with you one or two more, that by the lips of two or three witnesses every word may be made certain.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe no'o boe sèmi nare lii padhai èu, lamu paroa more angalai mu ca dhèu do dua dhèu, ho lami paraga dènge ne, sèna ka padhai lii hari. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ètu d'ara lii langu èci, hud'i abhu ku dua-tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi rare lii galaa ra. '

source_text: and if he will not give ear to them, let it come to the hearing of the church: and if he will not give ear to the church, let him be to you as a gentile and a tax-farmer.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe no'o boe nanene lii miu, lami lole dènge juma'at. aa ladhe na d'èi boe nanene lii juma'at kahèi, tao ne nuka sèmi ca dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. ladhe aad'o na, cap ne nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu, conto sèmi dhèu roro bea sèra.

source_text: truly i say to you, whatever things are fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ngaa dhu miu oro ètu rai-haha ne, èèna ka dhu lamatua oro le ètu sorga. aa ngaa dhu miu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, èèna ka lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: again, i say to you, that if two of you are in agreement on earth about anything for which they will make a request, it will be done for them by my father in heaven.
target_text: aa ja'a peka hari, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dua dhu sabaj'a dènge d'ara èci, pe ama ku ètu sorga hia ngaa dhu ra manèngi.

source_text: for where two or three are come together in my name, there am i among them.
target_text: te, ladhe abhu dua, do tèlu dhèu, pakaboko sabaj'a sama-sama, lula rèngu dhèu ja'a, na, ja'a ètu talora aae rèngu kahèi.

source_text: then peter came and said to him, lord, what number of times may my brother do wrong against me, and i give him forgiveness? till seven times?
target_text: èle èèna, ka petrus karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a neo karèi ciki. ladhe a'ari ja'a tao sale pahari-pahari mi ja'a, èèna na d'ai pèri hari ja'a hud'i hia ne abho? d'ai pidhu hari, do?

source_text: jesus says to him, i say not to you, till seven times; but, till seventy times seven.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! èu hud'i abho ne pidhu kali pidhu nguru hari, toke èu ige more heka.

source_text: for this reason the kingdom of heaven is like a king, who went over his accounts with his servants.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua nuka sèmi dhèu aae dhu ige kèlu na ètu pegawi na.

source_text: and at the start, one came to him who was in his debt for ten thousand talents.
target_text: ropa na ige nare, hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa pegawi dhu pakèlu toke riho kehi.

source_text: and because he was not able to make payment, his lord gave orders for him, and his wife, and his sons and daughters, and all he had, to be given for money, and payment to be made.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne b'ae nare boe kèlu na. ka dhèu aae paredha, peka na, ‘lami pahie eele dhèu ne dènge bhèni-ana niki na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ra j'aj'i ènu. aa mèdha-panyau na, pahie aa'i kahèi, ho b'ae kèlu-g'ètu na. '

source_text: so the servant went down on his face and gave him worship, saying, lord, give me time to make payment and i will give you all.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi nare, hèia na pabèbha iisi, ho patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha dhèu aae, ka pamako, aku nèngu na, ‘ira ee! ama dhèu aae hia ja'a tebho d'ai ciki sa! sèna ka ja'a b'ae kèlu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. '

source_text: and the lord of that servant, being moved with pity, let him go, and made him free of the debt.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae rasa kasia dènge ne. ka dhèu aae pabhèlu eele aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu na, ka pua na lèpa.

source_text: but that servant went out, and meeting one of the other servants, who was in debt to him for one hundred pence, he took him by the throat, saying, make payment of your debt.
target_text: te ngaa ropa na d'ai li'u, hèia pegawi ne paraga dènge angalai na dhu pakèlu nèngu doi ciki di. ka na kèpe angalai ne, hèia pacèli ladha goro na, aa na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ‘weh! b'ae ka d'ara lai-lai ne kèlu èu sèra! '

source_text: so that servant went down on his face, requesting him and saying, give me time and i will make payment to you.
target_text: ropa angalai na tadèngi, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu, ka pamako ne, peka na, ‘ira ee! angalai, ee! hia ku ja'a tebho d'ai ciki sa! pe ja'a b'ae kèlu ja'a sèra! '

source_text: and he would not: but went and put him into prison till he had made payment of the debt.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne peka na, ‘bisa boe! ja'a mate heka panèbhu. èu b'ae dènge ka lod'o doe ne'e kahèi! ' èle ka, la'e pamaso angalai na asa d'ara bèdho, toke na b'ae aa'i kèlu na.

source_text: so when the other servants saw what was done they were very sad, and came and gave word to their lord of what had been done.
target_text: ropa pegawi dhu leo ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia d'ara ra susa. ka lasi lolo dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: then his lord sent for him and said, you evil servant; i made you free of all that debt, because of your request to me:
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia dhèu aae ne paroa pegawi dhu ne'a boe manèngi makasi ne. dhèu aae jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ‘heh, dhèu bhelu-katub'a! lula èu ne manèngi sèna ka ja'a sue èu, nèti èèna ka ja'a pabhèlu eele le kèlu èu sèra.

source_text: was it not right for you to have mercy on the other servant, even as i had mercy on you?
target_text: te ngaa, nga tao ka èu kasia boe angalai èu sa hèi, sama sèmi ja'a kasia èu ne? '

source_text: and his lord was very angry, and put him in the hands of those who would give him punishment till he made payment of all the debt.
target_text: ka dhèu aae nasa bia dènge ne, hèia na pua pamaso dhèu ne asa d'ara bèdho, sèna ka ra paj'èra ne, toke na b'ae aa'i kèlu na sèra.

source_text: so will my father in heaven do to you, if you do not everyone, from your hearts, give forgiveness to his brother.
target_text: hèia yesus pa'èle lii pakasame na, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga pa'iga sèmi èèna kahèi mi dedha miu. pe na huku miu, ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala nèti a'ari miu dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: and it came about that after saying these words, jesus went away from galilee, and came into the parts of judaea on the other side of jordan.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare aa'i j'ara sèra, hèia la'e tèke eele galilea asa propensi yudea, ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: and a great number went after him; and he made them well there.
target_text: dhèu ae ka dhu madhutu ne, ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a ètu nèi.

source_text: and certain pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, is it right for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dhu madhutu kahèi, dhu neo pamanahu ne. ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe dhèu mone leo le èmu, bisa ia eele dhèu èmu na, sad'i na abhu j'ara dhu la'e asa pa'ie-pa'ela. sèmi èèna, do?

source_text: and he said in answer, have you not seen in the writings, that he who made them at the first made them male and female, and said,
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, na miu se dhu me'a mèu agama. te ngaa tasamia ka miu me'a boe isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua? te ètu d'ara sasuri nèti lii lolo uru tèka, dhu suri peka na, ‘ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. '

source_text: for this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife; and the two will become one flesh?
target_text: aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, ‘nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ina-ama na, sèna ka la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, te dua ra dhu j'aj'i le èci. '

source_text: so that they are no longer two, but one flesh. then let not that which has been joined by god be parted by man.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe ama lamatua unu na dhu hia dua ra j'aj'i le èci, na, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri si hari!

source_text: they say to him, why then did moses give orders that a husband might give her a statement in writing and be free from her?
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare yesus peka sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi se karèi hari ne, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka musa peka na, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i nèngu tao uuru ku sasuri pa'ia hia dhèu èmu na?

source_text: he says to them, moses, because of your hard hearts, let you put away your wives: but it has not been so from the first.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, musa soro tèke bèi-baki miu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali ra, lula rèngu sèra kètu hadhu èci èèna ka dènge miu! te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, dad'èi na sèmi boe èèna.

source_text: and i say to you, whoever puts away his wife for any other cause than the loss of her virtue, and takes another, is a false husband: and he who takes her as his wife when she is put away, is no true husband to her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, ee! ladhe bhèni ad'u uuru madha j'ara makae, dhèu èmu na bisa ia eele ne. te ngaa ladhe ia eele bhèni ne dhu ad'u boe j'ara makae, hèia dhèu mone na leo hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu ne tao le j'ara makae!

source_text: the disciples say to him, if this is the position of a man in relation to his wife, it is better not to be married.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi baku leo-èmu.

source_text: but he said to them, not all men are able to take in this saying, but only those to whom it is given.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae ka dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii padhai lii ja'a ne. dhodhoka dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare si.

source_text: for there are men who, from birth, were without sex: and there are some who were made so by men: and there are others who have made themselves so for the kingdom of heaven. he who is able to take it, let him take it.
target_text: te abhu dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lula karèi nèti rara iisi ne, nèngu sèmi èèna ka. abhu kahèi dhu leo boe èmu, lula dhèu tao ne sèmi èèna. aa abhu kahèi dhu no'o boe leo-èmu, lula na neo pakako sasab'a ama lamatua di. dhèu dhu re'a mèu a'aj'a ne, hud'i laa nèngu sèmi dènge be'a.

source_text: then some people took little children to him, so that he might put his hands on them in blessing: and the disciples said sharp words to them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu sa'u rèti ana-ana ra asa yesus, sèna ka yesus tao kacui-aai na mi rèngu, aa dènge hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu na kai dhèu se.

source_text: but jesus said, let the little ones come to me, and do not keep them away: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus nasa dènge ana madhutu na, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana se mai asa ja'a! baku bhabhae si! te dhèu dhu sèmi rèngu se'e ka, dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he put his hands on them, and went away.
target_text: èle èèna ka yesus tao kacui-aai na mi ana se, aa na manèngi ho ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale. èle, hèia yesus pakèd'i la'e, tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: and one came to him and said, master, what good thing have i to do, so that i may have eternal life?
target_text: ca tèke, dhèu èci mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! ja'a hud'i tao ku j'ara dhu hua iia tasamia, sèna ka ke'a tare'a, na, ja'a bisa maso sorga? te ja'a neo mamuri taruu sama-sama dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and he said to him, why are you questioning me about what is good? one there is who is good: but if you have a desire to go into life, keep the rules of the law.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka, èu karèi ja'a lula-nèti ngaa dhu hua iia? dhodhoka ama lamatua di, dhu hua iia. te ladhe èu neo mamuri taruu dènge ne, na, mamuri la madhutu paredha na.

source_text: he says to him, which? and jesus said, do not put anyone to death, do not be untrue in married life, do not take what is not yours, do not give false witness,
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari, aku nèngu na, paredha dhu mia èèna? hèia yesus b'ala ne, peka na, baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii dhu kapod'e-kabèli;

source_text: give honour to your father and your mother: and, have love for your neighbour as for yourself.
target_text: pakab'ua ina-ama mu; aa sue ku dhèu èu, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu.

source_text: the young man says to him, all these things have i done: what more is there?
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, na, paredha aa'i-aa'i sèra ja'a tao madhutu le. de, ngaa hari dhu kura?

source_text: jesus said to him, if you have a desire to be complete, go, get money for your property, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come after me.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhèu ne, hèia yesus peka na, ladhe èu neo madhutu aa'i dad'èi ama lamatua, lèpa ho pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau èu, sèna ka papala hia dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa sèra. èle èèna, mai ho madhutu ja'a. te èèna na, ama lamatua pala hia èu mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga.

source_text: but hearing these words the young man went away sorrowing: for he had much property.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare lii yesus, hèia dhèu ne lèpa dènge d'ara pèd'a laho mae-mae, lula nèngu kaja titu kèna.

source_text: and jesus said to his disciples, truly i say to you, it is hard for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: èle èèna, ka yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, lèka la ja'a, te dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga.

source_text: and again i say to you, it is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of god.
target_text: carui èèna, nuka sèmi badha onta dhu kapai, maso la'e asa d'ara oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: and the disciples, hearing this, were greatly surprised, saying, who then may have salvation?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu se tadèngi rare, rèngu malaa, hèia ra dhaa, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa maso sorga?

source_text: and jesus, looking at them, said, with men this is not possible; but with god all things are possible.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe patae si, ka na lii, peka na, ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu tao, mema bisa boe. te ngaa ladhe ama lamatua ka dhu tao, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i!

source_text: then peter said to him, see, we have given up everything and have come after you; what then will we have?
target_text: hèia petrus pasanèd'e, aku nèngu na, ama! ji'i se tèke eele le mèdha-panyau ji'i aa'i-aa'i, ho madhutu ama. de ji'i abhu ngaa?

source_text: and jesus said to them, truly i say to you that in the time when all things are made new, and the son of man is seated in his glory, you who have come after me will be seated on twelve seats, judging the twelve tribes of israel.
target_text: na dhaa, peka na, parcaya la ja'a ne! pe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua tao pahiu aa'i mèu-mèu, ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna. lod'o èèna kahèi, miu dhu madhutu ja'a, madhèdi kahèi ètu dedha kadera paredha canguru dua sèra, sèna ka j'aj'i hakim mi canguru dua suku èdhi dhèu isra'el!

source_text: and everyone who has given up houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or child, or land, for my name, will be given a hundred times as much, and have eternal life.
target_text: dhèu dhu tèke eele èmu na, a'ari na, ina-ama na, ana niki na, aa oka-tedhe na, ho madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a èèna abhu hari cangasu kali. aa d'ai ka lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu kahèi abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but a great number who are first will be last, and some who are last will be first.
target_text: de sanèd'e paie! madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, dhèu ae dhu padedha iisi na, rèngu sèra ka dhu j'aj'i mi ana iiki. te ngaa dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu haha, aa te ngaa madhutu a'abhu lamatua, nèngu ka dhu kapai.

source_text: for the kingdom of heaven is like the master of a house, who went out early in the morning to get workers into his vine-garden.
target_text: èle èèna, ka yesus aj'a peka na, paredha ama lamatua èci èèna ka dènge lii pakasame ne: abhu ca dhèu lamatua oka anggor, dhu kèd'i mad'ae aae d'ara hake èna sa. na la'e tenge dhèu sèna ka sab'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and when he had made an agreement with the workmen for a penny a day, he sent them into his vine-garden.
target_text: na abhu dhèu sab'a, hèia rare lii èci, ho sab'e d'ara ca lod'o, bab'ae na, ca doi iia. dhèu se d'èi kahèi, ka lamatua oka ne pua lasi sab'a.

source_text: and he went out about the third hour, and saw others in the market-place doing nothing;
target_text: pe d'ara hake ceo sa, la'e asa d'ara pasa. ètu era nèi, nèngu paraga dènge dhèu pèri-pèri dhu madhèdi iia d'ara.

source_text: and he said to them, go into the vine-garden with the others, and whatever is right i will give you. and they went to work.
target_text: hèia na lii dènge ra, ‘miu se neo sab'a ètu d'ara oka ja'a, do? pe ja'a b'ae miu madhutu kab'ua dhu lèke. ' ropa tadèngi rare, ro'o kahèi, hèia lasi dènge ka sab'a.

source_text: again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did the same.
target_text: d'ai lod'o titu mera sa, dènge hake tèlu lod'o nihia, lamatua oka ne la'e tenge hari dhèu sab'a.

source_text: and about the eleventh hour he went out and saw others doing nothing; and he says to them, why are you here all the day doing nothing?
target_text: d'ara hake lèmi lod'o nihia sa, la'e hari. na laladhe, na, abhu dhèu dhu titu iia d'ara era. ka na lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ‘nga tao ka karèi nèti mad'ae toke sange ne'e ne, miu se titu iia d'ara, sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa? '

source_text: they say to him, because no man has given us work. he says to them, go in with the rest, into the vine-garden.
target_text: ka dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ‘ama, ee! abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu hia ji'i sasab'a. ' ka lamatua oka ne peka, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, lami sab'a asa d'ara oka ja'a! '

source_text: and when evening came, the lord of the vine-garden said to his manager, let the workers come, and give them their payment, from the last to the first.
target_text: toke d'ai èle jam sab'a, hèia lamatua oka ne pua madho na, peka na, ‘paroa dhèu sab'a se, sèna ka b'ae rui sasab'a ra èci-èci. mulai nèti dhèu sab'a limuri tèka, toke dhèu sab'a uuru. '

source_text: and when those men came who had gone to work at the eleventh hour, they were given every man a penny.
target_text: ka madho ne paroa uuru dhèu dhu sab'a hake lèmi nihia. na b'ae si ca dhèu, ca doi iia.

source_text: then those who came first had the idea that they would get more; and they, like the rest, were given a penny.
target_text: èle ka, na paroa dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, toke dhèu dhu sab'a mulai nèti hake èna mad'ae deo na. dhèu se, pangee na, ele boe rèngu abhu risi nèti dhèu dhu sab'a hake lèmi nihia. re'a boe na, rèngu abhu kahèi ca dhèu, ca doi iia.

source_text: and when they got it, they made a protest against the master of the house,
target_text: ropa ra sèmi rare, hèia ra ka'ugu dènge lamatua oka èèna, aku rèngu na,

source_text: saying, these last have done only one hour's work, and you have made them equal to us, who have undergone the hard work of the day and the burning heat.
target_text: ‘ira, iii! bisa boe sèmi ne'e, ama! rèngu dhu mai limuri tèka, dhoka sab'a ca jam di. te ngaa ji'i dhu karèi mad'ae aae ka, sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae! te ngaa tasamia ka ama b'ae ji'i èci èèna ka dènge rèngu se? '

source_text: but he in answer said to one of them, friend, i do you no wrong: did you not make an agreement with me for a penny?
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne dhaa, na, ‘angalai! ja'a tipu boe èu. lula èu mesa mu mo'o kahèi sab'a ètu d'ara ca lod'o dhu bab'ae na ca doi iia. tare'a si? de ja'a b'ae madhutu sèmi lii pama'ète èdhi dua ti, si?

source_text: take what is yours, and go away; it is my pleasure to give to this last, even as to you.
target_text: de be'a risi more doi j'aj'èra èu ho lèpa ka. ladhe ja'a neo b'ae mi dhèu dhu sab'a limuri tèka nèti èu, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a neo b'ae èu, èèna na madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: have i not the right to do as seems good to me in my house? or is your eye evil, because i am good?
target_text: lula doi-dhari ja'a, ja'a bisa pake madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a. tasamia ka, angalai nasa lula babe'a d'ara ja'a? '

source_text: so the last will be first, and the first last.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. na pala-bagi hia dhèu-dhèu unu na, madhutu dad'èi d'ara na. de dhèu dhu mai limuri tèka, èèna na abhu pala sama sèmi dhèu dhu mai uuru. aa dhèu dhu mai uuru, pe na abhu pala nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mai limuri tèka.

source_text: and when jesus was going up to jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples on one side, and said to them,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai lasi asa yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara na paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rèngu mesa ra di. ka na lii hari, peka na,

source_text: see, we go up to jerusalem; and the son of man will be given into the hands of the chief priests and scribes; and they will give orders for him to be put to death,
target_text: mi nanene paie! ne'e ne, èdhi lati asa yerusalem. te ngaa ètu nèi dhèu pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra huku pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and will give him up to the gentiles to be made sport of and to be whipped and to be put to death on the cross: and the third day he will come back again from the dead.
target_text: hèia ra soro ja'a asa dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. ka ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a, aa ra hake paru isi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra paku pamadhe ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ja'a tare'a-re'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: then the mother of the sons of zebedee came to him with her sons, giving him worship and making a request of him.
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu sabadeus palere-lere dènge ana na, yohanis dènge yakobis, lasi paraga dènge yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu ho neo pamako yesus.

source_text: and he said to her, what is your desire? she says to him, let my two sons be seated, the one at your right hand, and the other at your left, in your kingdom.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, mama neo ngaa? hèia na dhaa, sèmi ne'e, ama! lod'o ama mèd'u paredha, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ana ja'a dhèu dua se rèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ama. ja'a manèngi ho ama hia ca dhèu madhèdi re baboa g'ana, aa ca dhèu re baboa kariu ama.

source_text: but jesus made answer and said, you have no idea what you are requesting. are you able to take of the cup which i am about to take?
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ne, hèia yesus peka yakobis dènge yohanis, na, miu se, me'a boe ngaa dhu miu manèngi. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae. de tasamia? miu pangee na, miu bisa pasae kahèi j'aj'èra se, sama-sama dènge ja'a, do? dua ra dhaa dhu dènge boe pake ngangee, aku rèngu na, oo, bisa, ama!

source_text: they say to him, we are able. he says to them, truly, you will take of my cup: but to be seated at my right hand and at my left is not for me to give, but it is for those for whom my father has made it ready.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ra, mema, èèna na miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi sèmi ja'a. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana do kariu ja'a, ja'a dènge boe hak ho pama'ète. èèna hak ama lamatua. na pama'ète nare le, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: and when it came to the ears of the ten, they were angry with the two brothers.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhèu canguru sèra tadèngi lii manèngi dua ra, hèia ra nasa.

source_text: but jesus said to them, you see that the rulers of the gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.
target_text: te ngaa yesus paroa nare si aa'i-aa'i ra, hèia na peka, sèmi ne'e! miu dhu me'a le, si? dhèu aae-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha, ènyi kabarai ra toke ra bisa boe kalau sa kahèi. aa dhèu kapai kabarai ètu rai-haha ne, dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, hia paredha risi eele, toke kabarai ra abhu boe d'oa kètu ciki sa.

source_text: let it not be so among you: but if anyone has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant;
target_text: te ngaa baku miu tao sèmi èèna! de nèti miu se cee ka dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi ènu, sèna ka lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him take the lowest place:
target_text: aa cee dhu neo j'aj'i kètu, nèngu hud'i tao iisi na nuka sèmi ènu.

source_text: even as the son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.
target_text: nanene! ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu. ja'a mai boe, sèna ka dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka soro ngi'u ja'a kateme iisi, ho sui dhèu ae nèti sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: and when they were going out from jericho, a great number went after him.
target_text: ka yesus si kako taruu. ropa rèngu kalua nèti kota jeriko, dhèu ae dhu madhutu rèngu.

source_text: and two blind men seated by the wayside, when they had the news that jesus was going by, gave a loud cry, saying, lord, son of david, have mercy on us.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara. ropa dua ra tadèngi na, dhèu dhu kako re èèna, nuka yesus nèti nasaret, hèia ra parodha, peka na, ama! ana-èpu daud! ji'i se dhu tatae ama, karèi nèbhu ka! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: and the people gave them orders to be quiet; but they went on crying even louder, lord, son of david, have mercy on us.
target_text: ropa dhèu tadèngi ra parodha sèmi èèna, ka ra kai si, aku rèngu na, hee! miu dua mi baku maruru! te ngaa dua ra asa hino, peka na, ama! ana-èpu daud! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: and jesus, stopping, sent for them, and said, what would you have me do to you?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii paroa ne, hèia na titu, ka karèi si, peka na, miu se neo sèna ka ja'a tao ngaa hia miu?

source_text: they say to him, lord, that our eyes may be open.
target_text: ka dua ra dhaa, na, ama! hia la ji'i se bisa ngèdhi!

source_text: and jesus, being moved with pity, put his fingers on their eyes: and straight away they were able to see, and went after him.
target_text: tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus rasa kasia. ka na g'ag'e musi madha ra, hèia dua ra rèdhi dènge ka. èle ka, dua ra lasi dènge madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when they were near jerusalem, and had come to beth-phage, to the mountain of olives, jesus sent two disciples,
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu, d'ai rae betfage, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. rae ne dhu dètu le dènge kota yerusalem. ètu era ne'e, rèngu ae taha. hèia na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: saying to them, go into the little town in front of you, and straight away you will see an ass with a cord round her neck, and a young one with her; let them loose and come with them to me.
target_text: na paredha si, peka na, dua mi lami asa rae nèi. ladhe miu d'ai nèi, miu ladhe mèdhi keled'ei rena ci'u dènge ana na dhu ra èki ètu era èèna. lami lècu mere ne, ho mèti mai hia ja'a.

source_text: and if anyone says anything to you, you will say, the lord has need of them; and straight away he will send them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti keled'ei dhèu? ' mi dhaa, peka na, ‘lamatua neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, pe na hia hari mai. '

source_text: now this took place so that these words of the prophet might come true,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se hud'i j'aj'i ku sama sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: say to the daughter of zion, see, your king comes to you, gentle and seated on an ass, and on a young ass.
target_text: ‘miu dhèu yerusalem sèra! mai laladhe ku la! te dhèu aae miu mai. na mai dènge pahaha iisi. na mai dhu manya'e keled'ei ngèru. '

source_text: and the disciples went and did as jesus had given them orders,
target_text: ka ana madhutu na lasi ka, aa ra tao madhutu aa'i dhu yesus moa le dènge ra.

source_text: and got the ass and the young one, and put their clothing on them, and he took his seat on it.
target_text: ère rèti keled'ei rena dènge ana na asa yesus. èle ka, ra hèle sig'i-kalolo, hèia yesus manya'e, lasi asa d'ara kota.

source_text: and all the people put their clothing down in the way; and others got branches from the trees, and put them down in the way.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe d'ai d'ara kota, hèia dhèu ae ka dhu hèle sig'i-kalolo dènge salalu ra mi j'ara. abhu kahèi cahag'e lasi pare rèu palam, ho ra tao ètu talora j'ara. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu tao tadha dhu peka na, rèngu soru yesus sama sèmi dhèu kapai.

source_text: and those who went before him, and those who came after, gave loud cries, saying, glory to the son of david: a blessing on him who comes in the name of the lord: glory in the highest.
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu cahag'e dhu kako uuru nèti yesus, aa cahag'e kako re limuri. dhèu se pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ana-èpu daud mai le! hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ama lamatua ka dhu pua dhèu ne'e mai. hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ama lamatua dhu nèd'u mema paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi!

source_text: and when he came into jerusalem, all the town was moved, saying, who is this?
target_text: ropa yesus maso asa yerusalem dènge dhèu dhu pakelu oob'a, hèia isi kabarai aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota kalua mai, ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ira ii! cee ka dhu mai ne?

source_text: and the people said, this is the prophet jesus, from nazareth of galilee.
target_text: dhèu ae se dhaa, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ngara na yesus, dhèu nasaret, nèti propensi galilea.
