source_text: and jesus went into the temple and sent out all who were trading there, overturning the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those trading in doves.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. ètu madha èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ne, dhèu tao nuka sèmi pasa, ho pahia-pahèli koro j'aha dhu dhèu tema pake j'aj'i mèdha korban lod'o sabaj'a. ropa ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus babèga eele si nèti era èèna. na lege eele mei-mei dhu ra pake pasilu doi, aa na paguri eele bagu-bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui.

source_text: and he said to them, it is in the writings, my house is to be named a house of prayer, but you are making it a hole of thieves.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, sèna ka dhèu mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu ne'e. ' dad'èi lamatua sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa miu tao èmu ne, nuka sèmi era kaboko dhèu parapo!

source_text: and the blind and the broken in body came to him in the temple, and he made them well.
target_text: èle, ka dhèu bèdhu dènge dhèu karuku mai sa yesus ètu èmu sabaj'a ama lamatua. ka na puri-pa'èle aa'i si.

source_text: but when the chief priests and the scribes saw the works of power which he did, and the children crying out in the temple, glory to the son of david, they were angry and said to him,
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. ropa rèdhi yesus tao tadha malaa, hèia ra ka'uu-kamuki. risi-risi hari, ropa ra tadèngi ana-ana pa'oo palere-lere ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, dhu peka na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! lula ana-èpu dhèu aae daud mai le!

source_text: have you any idea what these are saying? and jesus said to them, yes: have you not seen in the writings, from the lips of children and babies at the breast you have made your praise complete?
target_text: ka kètu kapai se lii dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, eeh! èu tadèngi lii padhai lii ana-ana se? èèna lèke boe! te ngaa yesus b'ala si, na, oo, ja'a tadèngi. te, nga tao? miu baca mèdhi mèka ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua lula-nèti ana-ana dhu koa-kio ama lamatua, do? te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna dhu suri, na, ‘ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le, ana rara iisi hiu, dènge ana-ana iiki, ho koa-kio ne. '

source_text: and he went away from them, and went out of the town to bethany, and was there for the night.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele kota ne, lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: now in the morning when he was coming back to the town, he had a desire for food.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae na, yesus si lèpa hari asa kota yerusalem. te ngaa ètu talora j'ara, nèngu manganga le.

source_text: and seeing a fig-tree by the wayside, he came to it, and saw nothing on it but leaves only; and he said to it, let there be no fruit from you from this time forward for ever. and straight away the fig-tree became dry and dead.
target_text: na ladhe nèdhi aj'u ca kapua buli sebhe j'ara dhu dhèu tema ra'a hua na. de la'e ka padètu-dètu dènge aj'u ne'e, ho neo ladhe sèku dhu hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ropa d'ai kapua aaj'u ne, na nèdhi boe hua cue sa, lula rèu heka sub'u mai kèna. hèia na peka mi aj'u ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua cue sa, de èèna na èu hua heka! ropa na lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia aj'u ne mango dènge ka.

source_text: and when the disciples saw it they were surprised, saying, how did the fig-tree become dry in so short a time?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, hèia ra malaa. ka ra karèi, peka na, tasamia ka aj'u ne mango?

source_text: and jesus in answer said to them, truly i say to you, if you have faith, without doubting, not only may you do what has been done to the fig-tree, but even if you say to this mountain, be taken up and put into the sea, it will be done.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, na, nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua, aa dènge boe d'ara kajari, miu kahèi bisa tao sama sèmi dhu ja'a tao ne. miu bisa tao risi hari nèti ne'e. sèmi: miu bisa paredha ledhe pidha asa d'ara dhasi la'e. tatu ama lamatua pidha eele kahèi ledhe ne nèti era na, sad'i miu parcaya nèngu tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and all things, whatever you make request for in prayer, having faith, you will get.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu manèngi nèti ama lamatua, èèna na miu abhu, sad'i miu parcaya ne tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and when he had come into the temple, the chief priests and those in authority over the people came to him while he was teaching, and said, by what authority do you do these things? and who gave you this authority?
target_text: d'ai yerusalem, yesus si maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa nèngu aj'a dhèu madha j'ara ama lamatua, hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama sèra, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a, mai karèi yesus, na, med'a na, cee ka dhu pua èu tao maruru ètu era ne'e ne? cee ka dhu hia èu hak?

source_text: and jesus said to them in answer, i will put one question to you, and if you give me the answer, i will say by what authority i do these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a, na, dhèu se dhu neo pamanahu ne. hèia na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john, where did it come from? from heaven or from men? and they were reasoning among themselves, saying, if we say, from heaven; he will say to us, why then did you not have faith in him?
target_text: lii karèi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis tuka sarani, si? cee ka dhu hia ne hak, ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha? ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, waa! nara le èdhi, nga! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu hia hak', pe na b'ala èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but if we say, from men; we are in fear of the people, because all take john to be a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka dhu hia hak', mage dhoka dhèu aa'i-aa'i patao dènge èdhi. lula rèngu parcaya, na, yohanis ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and they made answer and said, we have no idea. then he said to them, and i will not say to you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra dhaa peka na, ji'i nge'a boe. hèia yesus b'ala si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a parluu boe peka na, cee ka dhu hia ja'a hak.

source_text: but how does it seem to you? a man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, son, go and do work today in the vine-garden.
target_text: yesus padhai lii taruu dènge kètu kapai sèra, aku nèngu na, miu pangee sèku dènge lii lolo ne. abhu ca dhèu ama, dènge ana mone na dhèu dua. na peka dènge ana uuru èèna, ‘ana, deo ne'e èu lamu sab'a asa d'ara oka. '

source_text: and he said in answer, i will not: but later, changing his decision, he went.
target_text: te ngaa ana ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘eeh! ja'a laku boe. ' te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, na manyasa, ka la'e.

source_text: and he came to the second and said the same. and he made answer and said, i go, sir: and went not.
target_text: ka ama ra pua ana limuri, peka na, ‘deo ne'e, èu lamu sab'a asa d'ara oka. ' ka ana ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘be'a, ama! pe ja'a laku. ' te ngaa te'a boe na, nèngu dhu la'e boe.

source_text: which of the two did his father's pleasure? they say, the first. jesus said to them, truly i say to you, that tax-farmers and loose women are going into the kingdom of god before you.
target_text: ropa lole nare, hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, peka na, ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: nèti ana dhèu dua se, mia ka dhu tao madhutu lii paredha ama ra? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ana uuru! ka na peka, aku nèngu na, oo. te ngaa nanene paie, te ja'a peka dhu lèke kèna. te dhèu dhu miu cap, na, dhèu dhu laku-laku boe, sama sèmi dhèu roro bea, dènge bhèni kajeo, bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i uuru dhèu unu ama lamatua, nèti miu. te miu dhoka sad'i dhaa di, peka na, 'oo' mi ama lamatua, te ngaa tao boe madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: for john came to you in the way of righteousness, and you had no faith in him, but the tax-farmers and the loose women had faith in him: and you, when you saw it, did not even have regret for your sins, so as to have faith in him.
target_text: uru èèna, yohanis tuka sarani, aj'a le miu j'ara tasamia, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri mola. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ne. aa te ngaa ropa dhèu laku-laku boe sèra, nanene lii a'aj'a nèti yohanis, rèngu tèke eele sasala ra, sèna ka tao madhutu a'aj'a èèna. miu dhu me'a le. te ngaa miu loe boe nèti ad'u-ue sasala-sasigo, ho madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: give ear to another story. a master of a house made a vine garden, and put a wall round it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and made a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.
target_text: yesus lole nare, ka na lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, abhu ca dhèu lamatua rai dhu la'e tao oka, ho sèle anggor ètu dedha rai na ca kasib'i. ka na tao tedhe rai reo. aa na tao bak cue era pacèli èi anggor. dhèu ne patitu kahèi era madhenge dhu dedha aae èci. èle, ka na hia oka ne mi dhèu seb'a, sèna ka d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia la'e ka asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: and when the time for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the workmen, to get the fruit.
target_text: ropa d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, lamatua oka ne pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi asa dhèu seb'a se, sèna ka rare pala nèngu.

source_text: and the workmen made an attack on his servants, giving blows to one, putting another to death, and stoning another.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu seb'a oka se'e, pusi-pahae boe dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua oka ne. abhu dhu lèke game, abhu dhu ra pamadhe, aa abhu dhu lèke pèci dènge hadhu.

source_text: again, he sent other servants more in number than the first: and they did the same to them.
target_text: ka lamatua oka ne pua hari dhèu sab'a na canau, ae risi nèti dhèu sab'a dhu lasi uuru sèra. te ngaa dhèu seb'a oka se tao hari bhabhelu sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu sab'a se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but after that he sent his son to them, saying, they will have respect for my son.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka lamatua oka ne, pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pangee, na, ‘ladhe ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, tatu ra sèmi na dènge be'a, aa ra pakab'ua ne kahèi. '

source_text: but when the workmen saw the son, they said among themselves, this is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death and take his heritage.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu seb'a se ladhe rèdhi ana ne, hèia ra papeka, ‘wee, mi laladhe ku laa! te mone heka nèi hia ana d'èlu na mai. nèngu ne'e ka dhu bèli-camèd'a, unu aa'i mèdha-panyau mone heka ne. de ta pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi unu oka ne. '

source_text: and they took him and, driving him out of the vine-garden, put him to death.
target_text: hèia kèpe rare ana ne, ka ra nuni asa li'u oka, hèia ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: when, then, the lord of the vine-garden comes, what will he do to those workmen?
target_text: ka yesus pa'èle lii lolo na, ka na karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: ladhe lamatua oka ne lèpa mai, madhutu ngangee miu, na tao dhèu seb'a oka se tasa mera mia?

source_text: they say to him, he will put those cruel men to a cruel death, and will let out the vine-garden to other workmen, who will give him the fruit when it is ready.
target_text: hèia kètu kapai yahudi sèra dhaa, peka na, tatu na pamadhe dhèu bhelu se aa'i-aa'i. èle, na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne, dhu èèna na pabagi dènge be'a, ropa d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu.

source_text: jesus says to them, did you never see in the writings, the stone which the builders put on one side, the same has been made the chief stone of the building: this was the lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ele boe miu se baca mèdhi boe, ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu era padhèdi èmu! ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu kabhili nare, aa na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe na be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: for this reason i say to you, the kingdom of god will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation producing the fruits of it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, de miu sanèd'e paie-iie. uru èèna, ama lamatua hag'e nare èdhi dhèu yahudi se, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. te ngaa, lula miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a, èèna na lamatua pili nare dhèu leo rai kara. te dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na, dhu nia j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: any man falling on this stone will be broken, but he on whom it comes down will be crushed to dust.
target_text: ja'a peka paled'a-led'a dènge miu. ja'a ka, hadhu padhèdi èèna. dhèu dhu bèbhe lèke hadhu ne, èèna na nèngu laho kao-kao. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu, èèna na dhèu ne laho kao-kao.

source_text: and when his stories came to the ears of the chief priests and the pharisees, they saw that he was talking of them.
target_text: ropa kètu kapai yahudi dènge dhèu parisi tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia re'a, na, lii ne padhèto dènge rèngu. rèngu se ca ropa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor, aa dènge tuka dhu core eele hadhu era padhèdi èmu.

source_text: and though they had a desire to take him, they were in fear of the people, because in their eyes he was a prophet.
target_text: de ra nasa titu kèna. ka rèngu mulai tenge j'ara ho kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae, dhu peka na yesus ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bani boe tao ngaa-ngaa mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: and jesus, talking to them again in stories, said:
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii hari dènge rèngu pake lii upama, aku nèngu na,

source_text: the kingdom of heaven is like a certain king, who made a feast when his son was married,
target_text: paredha ama lamatua èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu aae ca dhèu dhu tao pesta kab'i ana mone na.

source_text: and sent out his servants to get in the guests to the feast: and they would not come.
target_text: ropa dhèu pananasu rare, hèia na pua dhèu sab'a na, sèna ka lasi peka dhèu-dhèu dhu abhu nèru, ra peka na, ‘mai ka, te d'ai tadha ta'a-tinu kèna. ' te ngaa dhèu dhu abhu nèru se ro'o boe mai.

source_text: again he sent out other servants, with orders to say to the guests, see, i have made ready my feast: my oxen and my fat beasts have been put to death, and all things are ready: come to the feast.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se lèpa, lasi peka dènge dhèu aae. ropa na tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae pua dhèu sab'a na dhu leo hari, aku nèngu na, ‘lami peka hari dènge dhèu sèra ho mai ka, te pesta neo mulai kèna. ja'a para sapi, ka pananasu kore le dhu be'a titu kèna. peka si mai ka, ra'a-rinu, te aa'i-aa'i tesa le. '

source_text: but they gave no attention, and went about their business, one to his farm, another to his trade:
target_text: dhèu sab'a se lasi peka sèmi dhu dhèu aae moa èèna. te ngaa dhèu dhu lèke nèru se, pusi-pahae boe. abhu dhu lasi ladhe oka ra, abhu dhu lasi era sasab'a ra,

source_text: and the rest put violent hands on his servants, and did evil to them, and put them to death.
target_text: aa cahag'e hari ra kèpe rare dhèu sab'a se nèti dhèu aae ne, ho ra game toke madhe.

source_text: but the king was angry; and he sent his armies, and those who had put his servants to death he gave to destruction, burning down their town with fire.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae nasa bia. ka na paredha sordad'u na, lasi pamadhe aa'i dhèu-dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu sab'a na sèra. hèia sordad'u se tunu pakèpu-ladhu ai kota ne toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: then he said to his servants, the feast is ready but the guests were not good enough.
target_text: èle, ka dhèu aae paroa nare dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, ka na peka, ‘pesta kab'i ne tesa aa'i le, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu ja'a nèru, nia boe madhèdi ètu d'ara pesta ja'a.

source_text: go then to the cross-roads, and get all those whom you see to come to the bride-feast.
target_text: de lami ka asa j'ara oka-hoo, sèna ka nèru cee dhu sad'i miu paraga. '

source_text: and those servants went out into the streets, and got together all those whom they came across, bad and good: and the feast was full of guests.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a se lasi asa j'ara oka-hoo. hèia rèti mai dhèu ae-ae dhu ra paraga ètu j'ara, sèna ka ra'a-rinu ètu pesta kab'i ne. dhèu se'e, nuka dhèu dhu be'a dènge dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a, mai papènu ètu era kakab'i ne.

source_text: but when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a guest's robe;
target_text: ka dhèu aae la'e asa era pesta ne ladhe palème tamu sèra. hèia ladhe nèdhi tamu ca dhèu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake pesta.

source_text: and he says to him, friend, how came you in here not having a guest's robe? and he had nothing to say.
target_text: ka dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, ‘hee, angalai! èu nga tao ka mai asa ne'e pake boe mèdha-papake pesta? ' te ngaa dhèu ne loo-loo sène.

source_text: then the king said to the servants, put cords round his hands and feet and put him out into the dark; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, aku nèngu na, ‘uj'u haga dènge ai dhèu ne'e ne, ho core ne asa li'u la'e. hud'i laa na tangi dènge abhu j'èra ètu era dhu maroga kiu-kiu nèi. '

source_text: for out of all to whom the good news has come, only a small number will get salvation.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua paroa dhèu ae, te ngaa dhodhoka dhu ciki di dhu kabhili nare j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: then the pharisees went and had a meeting to see how they might make use of his words to take him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus, hèia dhèu-dhèu parisi rare lii èci ho neo pamanahu aa galaa ne.

source_text: and they sent to him their disciples, with the herodians, saying, master, we see that you are true, and that you are teaching the true way of god, and have no fear of anyone, because you have no respect for a man's position.
target_text: ka dhèu se pua dhèu rèngu palere-lere dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei politik herodes, sèna ka lasi pakarèi dènge yesus. dhèu se koa-kad'iri yesus, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a d'ara ama mola. ama dhu me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa dhu ladhe boe rèhu dhèu. ama dhu tema aj'a-nori lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge boe koe-kapengo.

source_text: give us, then, your opinion of this: is it right to give tax to caesar, or not?
target_text: mamai ji'i ne, neo karèi j'ara èci. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea mi dhèu aae kapai roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but jesus saw their trick and said, oh false ones, why are you attempting to put me in the wrong?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a mema, na, rèngu neo madulu d'ara na, sèna ka nèngu padhai lii lab'a dhèu paredha roma. hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu mema dhèu ho'a tema! tasamia ka miu neo pamanahu ja'a dènge j'ara ne'e?

source_text: let me see the tax money. and they gave him a penny.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue, dhu dhèu pake ho b'ae bea! hèia ra pad'elo doi iia ne mi yesus.

source_text: and he said to them, whose is this image and name on it?
target_text: ka na karèi si, ne'e ne, rèhu cee? aa ne'e ne, ngara cee?

source_text: they say to him, caesar's. then he said to them, give to caesar the things which are caesar's, and to god the things which are god's.
target_text: ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, èèna keser, dhèu aae kapai paredha roma. hèia yesus peka dènge ra, na, ladhe sèmi èèna hia la mi dhèu paredha ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak dhèu paredha. aa hia la mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: and hearing it, they were full of wonder, and went away from him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i malaa, lula ngaa dhu na peka sèra lèke tare'a-re'a. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa boe abhu j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. hèia lasi ka tèke eele yesus.

source_text: on the same day there came to him the sadducees, who say that there is no coming back from the dead: and they put a question to him, saying,
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei saduki. dhèu se'e ka dhu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. lod'o èèna, dhèu se'e kahèi dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. nèti èèna ka, rèngu mai pakarèi dènge ne, peka na,

source_text: master, moses said, if a man, at the time of his death, has no children, let his brother take his wife, and get a family for his brother;
target_text: ama mese! musa dhu suri tèke le atora hia ji'i, dhu peka na: ladhe dhèu mone ca dhèu madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na dhu dènge boe ana, na, ari nèti dhèu mone ne, hud'i leo nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo gati madha a'a na.

source_text: now there were among us seven brothers; and the first was married and at his death, having no seed, gave his wife to his brother;
target_text: mema uru èèna musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: abhu ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. ana partama leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe kolo. hèia ari na leo nare bhèni balu ne.

source_text: in the same way the second and the third, up to the seventh.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dènge boe ana kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ari ka tèlu na; nèngu madhèdi kahèi dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. sèmi èèna ka toke ari na dhu limuri tèka, madhe kahèi.

source_text: and last of all the woman came to her end.
target_text: ka bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: when they come back from the dead, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? because they all had her.
target_text: de dhu ji'i neo karèi, sèmi ne'e ne: bhèni balu ne dhu leo nèdhi dènge mone dhèu pidhu se. bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ropa ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, na, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: but jesus said to them in answer, you are in error, not having knowledge of the writings, or of the power of god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus b'ala si, peka na, ladhe lii pakarèi miu sèmi èèna, miu se sala kapai le! te miu se me'a mere boe isi sasuri ama lamatua. aa me'a boe kahèi koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna.

source_text: for when they come back from the dead there are no husbands and wives, but they are as the angels in heaven.
target_text: dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e! pe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu nèti mamadhe ra, rèngu se paleo heka èmu, sama sèmi ana pajuu na ètu sorga dhu leo boe èmu.

source_text: but about the dead coming back to life, have you no knowledge of what was said to you by god in the writings:
target_text: aa ja'a neo peka kahèi, lula-nèti dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari, do aad'o. ètu d'ara sasuri musa, dhu lole na, aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi bisa te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na,

source_text: i am the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob? god is not the god of the dead but of the living.
target_text: ‘ja'a ne ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu. nuka abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi era mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. ' de èdhi te'a, na, lod'o ama lamatua peka sèmi èèna, baki èdhi se dhu madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu te'a na, samanga rèngu dhu mamuri era, masi ka rèngu dhu madhe nèbhu le. de masi ka madhe, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhodhoka dhèu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dhèu dhu madhe, aad'o, si? !

source_text: and the people hearing it were surprised at his teaching.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus ne, hèia dhèu saduki se re'a heka b'ala. te ngaa dhèu ae se malaa-maloha, ka ra papeka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e ne be'a seli eele, nga!

source_text: but the pharisees, hearing how the mouths of the sadducees had been stopped, came together;
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi, na, yesus segi le dhèu saduki, hèia ra pakaboko ho lasi pakarèi dènge ne.

source_text: and one of them, a teacher of the law, put a question to him, testing him, and saying,
target_text: nèti rèngu se, abhu ca dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu j'ara-j'ara agama, la'e pakarèi dènge yesus, aku nèngu na,

source_text: master, which is the chief rule in the law?
target_text: ama mese! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e ka: atora nèti ad'a dènge agama èdhi, ae d'ai seli. paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu nèti musa, mia ka dhu dedha risi?

source_text: and he said to him, have love for the lord your god with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, paredha dhu dedha risi ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua suri, peka na: ‘ama lamatua èèna, tare'a lamatua miu. de miu se hud'i sue risi ne nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu, tadhe paie ne, dènge sab'a pa'èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: this is the first and greatest rule.
target_text: ne'e ne ka, paredha dhu dedha dènge kapai risi!

source_text: and a second like it is this, have love for your neighbour as for yourself.
target_text: aa abhu paredha ka dua dhu peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu. '

source_text: on these two rules all the law and the prophets are based.
target_text: dua paredha se, nuka kapua nèti atora musa dènge lii aj'a-nori aa'i-aa'i ra nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. dhèu tatu boe madhutu paredha leo, ladhe nèngu madhutu uuru boe dua paredha dhu dedha risi se.

source_text: now while the pharisees were together, jesus put a question to them, saying,
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi dhu pakaboko era ètu èèna, ka yesus karèi si, peka na,

source_text: what is your opinion of the christ? whose son is he? they say to him, the son of david.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ama lamatua dhu padhadha tèke le, ho pua kristus mai, sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu unu na. de madhutu a'abhu miu, na, kristus èèna ana-èpu cee? hèia ra dhaa peka na, nèngu èèna, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud.

source_text: he says to them, how then does david in the spirit give him the name of lord, saying,
target_text: yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka roh mola-mèci èèna peka dènge dhèu aae daud, na, nèngu paroa kristus, ‘lamatua'? te daud suri tèke na,

source_text: the lord said to my lord, be seated at my right hand, till i put under your feet all those who are against you?
target_text: ‘ama lamatua peka mema le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi ètu era hua iia ne, ètu baboa g'ana ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu sèra, pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: if david then gives him the name of lord, how is he his son?
target_text: de nèti lii ne'e ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. de ladhe dhèu peka na, kristus dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka. lula nèngu lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: and no one was able to give him an answer, and so great was their fear of him, that from that day no one put any more questions to him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai yesus, dhèu parisi se nuka sèmi dhèu goa sa, te ca dhèu sa bisa boe dhaa lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, nèti lod'o èèna, rèngu bani heka tenge j'ara ho pakarèi ne.

source_text: then jesus said to the people and to his disciples:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a ana madhutu na dènge dhèu ae leo dhu palere dènge rèngu.

source_text: the scribes and the pharisees have the authority of moses;
target_text: na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra abhu hak ho aj'a-nori atora musa mi dhèu.

source_text: all things, then, which they give you orders to do, these do and keep: but do not take their works as your example, for they say and do not.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i nanene si, aa tao madhutu lii a'aj'a ra. te ngaa mage mi madhutu ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue, lula rèngu mesa ra madhutu boe lii a'aj'a rèngu sèra.

source_text: they make hard laws and put great weights on men's backs; but they themselves will not put a finger to them.
target_text: rèngu laka-seti dhèu sèna ka madhutu atora agama ra dhu pabia dhèu. te ngaa rèngu mesa ra ro'o boe soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka madhutu atora sèra.

source_text: but all their works they do so as to be seen by men: for they make wide their phylacteries, and the edges of their robes,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra ad'u-ue sèra, sèna ka dhèu koa-kad'iri si. nuka sèmi: ètu katanga rèi ra, dhu èki dènge mèdha èci dhu suri lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa ètu lele aai ra kahèi. te ngaa rèngu tao parisi hari, sèna ka dhèu padedha si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu se, dhèu mola! '

source_text: and the things desired by them are the first places at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
target_text: ladhe rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu gareja, do, d'ara pesta rèngu d'èi tenge era dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si.

source_text: and words of respect in the market-places, and to be named by men, teacher.
target_text: ladhe lasi asa d'ara pasa, rèngu d'èi dhèu pakab'ua si. ra tenge j'ara, sèna ka dhèu pahaha iisi mi rèngu, aa d'èi dhèu paroa ra, ‘ama mese, dhu hua iia. '

source_text: but you may not be named teacher: for one is your teacher, and you are all brothers.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madhutu j'ara rèngu se'e! dhèu baku paroa miu ‘ama mese', lula mese miu dhoka ca dhèu di. aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi se'e, pa'a'ari.

source_text: and give no man the name of father on earth: because one is your father, who is in heaven.
target_text: mage j'oka padedha dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, peka na, ‘ama', lula ama miu ètu sorga dhoka èci di.

source_text: and you may not be named guides: because one is your guide, even christ.
target_text: dhèu baku paroa miu kahèi, ‘lamatua', lula ama lamatua miu dhodhoka èci di, nuka ja'a ne, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: but let the greatest among you be your servant.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, mage padedha iisi mi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka dhèu pakab'ua ra. nèti miu se, cee ka dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi ènu, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever makes himself high will be made low, and whoever makes himself low will be made high.
target_text: te dhèu dhu pamone-pabhèni, èèna na lamatua pamanahu ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahaha iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki, bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e padedha ne.

source_text: but a curse is on you, scribes and pharisees, false ones! because you are shutting the kingdom of heaven against men: for you do not go in yourselves, and those who are going in, you keep back.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi se! miu mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere pala miu, lula miu mo'o boe parcaya ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pamoa tèke pua mai. aa dhu bhelu risi hari, miu bhabhae dhèu neo mai asa d'ara rai paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka ra baku parcaya ja'a.

hee, miu mese-mese agama dènge dhèu-dhèu parisi! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! bèli-camèd'a miu pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu, sèna ka parame mere èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, miu pa'abhe bhabhelu miu, dènge j'ara sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu, ho dhèu peka na, miu dhèu d'ara mola. te ngaa èèna na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi mi miu.

source_text: a curse is on you, scribes and pharisees, false ones! for you go about land and sea to get one disciple and, having him, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! bèli-camèd'a miu pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu lami asa mia èèna ka, palème lèu, do, ca'e-puru ledhe, neo tenge dhoka ca dhèu di, sèna ka maso partei agama miu. te ngaa ropa na maso, miu ad'u-ue mamuri na asa bhelu risi, toke na abhu hahuku dhu babia na, dua hari risi nèti miu ètu d'ara naraka.

source_text: a curse is on you, blind guides, who say, whoever takes an oath by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the gold of the temple, he is responsible.
target_text: wee! d'ara miu dhu bèdhu le. nga tao ka limuri ne miu neo pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu leo? pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu aj'a leli, peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu pajaji pake soo-subha dhu ale èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, na, dhèu ne pa'èki boe dènge lii pajaji na èèna. te ngaa ladhe na pajaji pake subha dènge ale mèdha hualaa ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, na, nèngu heka pa'èki dènge lii pajaji na. '

source_text: you foolish ones and blind: which is greater, the gold, or the temple which makes the gold holy?
target_text: miu goa kabao! miu pangee na, ama lamatua pakab'ua risi mèdha hualaa sèra nèti èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i na, do? aad'o! te èmu ne'e ka dhu tao mèdha sèra j'aj'i mola-mèci!

source_text: and, whoever takes an oath by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the offering which is on it, he is responsible.
target_text: miu se aj'a ore-leli kahèi, peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu pajaji pake subha ale mei korban dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhèu ne pa'èki boe dènge lii pajaji na. te ngaa ladhe na pajaji pake subha aa ale mèdha ètu dedha mei korban, na, dhèu ne heka pa'èki dènge lii pajaji na kèna. '

source_text: you blind ones: which is greater, the offering, or the altar which makes the offering holy?
target_text: miu mema bèdhu tare'a-re'a. tatu mei korban ne, kab'ua risi nèti mèdha ètu dedha mei èèna. te mei èèna ka dhu tao mèdha korban rèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci mi ama lamatua.

source_text: he, then, who takes an oath by the altar, takes it by the altar and by all things on it.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu subha ale mei korban ne, na, be'a risi ale mei dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha mei èèna.

source_text: and he who takes an oath by the temple, takes it by the temple and by him whose house it is.
target_text: aa ladhe dhèu subha ale èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, na, be'a risi ale kahèi èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dènge kolongara ama lamatua. te nèngu ka dhu pea ètu talora aae na.

source_text: and he who takes an oath by heaven, takes it by the seat of god, and by him who is seated on it.
target_text: aa ladhe dhèu subha ale sorga, na, èèna èci èèna ka dènge nèngu ale kadera paredha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge kolongara na, te nèngu ka dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu èèna.

source_text: a curse is on you, scribes and pharisees, false ones! for you make men give a tenth of all sorts of sweet-smelling plants, but you give no thought to the more important things of the law, righteousness, and mercy, and faith; but it is right for you to do these, and not to let the others be undone.
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna pa'iga capala nèti canguru pala dhu miu hia lamatua. miu pa'iga aa'i mèu-mèu, toke bubhu nèti d'ara oka, èci sa tèke eele boe. miu ige toke lutu-sela nuka sèmi, rèu d'are, ka'unyi, dènge lasona. te ngaa miu pabhèlu eele atora dhu kab'ua risi nèti ama lamatua! te mamuri miu mola boe. miu sue boe dhèu dhu unu aad'o. aa mamuri miu madhutu boe dad'èi lamatua. be'a risi miu tao madhutu aa'i dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, heka mi pa'ige kèna bubhu-bubhu dhu lutu sèra, dhu miu neo hia mi lamatua.

source_text: you blind guides, who take out a fly from your drink, but make no trouble over a camel.
target_text: d'ara miu bèdhu, te ngaa tasamia ka neo era paj'uj'u j'ara hia dhèu leo? miu tao atora toke lutu, ho pua dhèu madhutu, te ngaa atora dhu kab'ua risi nèti ama lamatua, miu mesa mi pusi-pahae boe. nuka sèmi miu sule eele kikidui dhu ana iiki-iiki nèti èi dhu miu minu, te ngaa badha aae sèmi kabao, miu dhèle kateme!

source_text: a curse is on you, scribes and pharisees, false ones! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the plate, but inside they are full of violent behaviour and uncontrolled desire.
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu rase pega-mago toke mèu kale'e, te ngaa dhoka re li'u di. masi ka re d'ara na dhu kaj'alu titu kèna nèti mana'u miu dènge dèu ngara miu. mamuri miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: you blind pharisee, first make clean the inside of the cup and of the plate, so that the outside may become equally clean.
target_text: wee, dhèu parisi dhu bèdhu, ee! rase uuru ku re d'ara pega-mago miu sèra! dènge sèmi èèna, re li'u na j'aj'i mèu kahèi!

source_text: a curse is on you, scribes and pharisees, false ones! for you are like the resting-places of the dead, which are made white, and seem beautiful on the outside, but inside are full of dead men's bones and of all unclean things.
target_text: wee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula miu ca ropa dènge ro'a dhèu madhe dhu lame dènge èi dama pudhi. dhèu ladhe re li'u na, be'a titu kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara, pènu dènge rui dhèu madhe, aa dhu hèu oone-oone.

source_text: even so you seem to men to be full of righteousness, but inside you are all false and full of wrongdoing.
target_text: miu èci èèna ka! miu d'èi tao iisi mi sèmi dhèu dhu mola-mèci. nèti li'u dhèu rèdhi, na, miu nuka sèmi dhèu d'ara mola. te ngaa ètu d'ara, miu cakaraa dhèu bhelu-katub'a. te miu padhai lii leo, tao leo, aa pabhèlu eele paredha ama lamatua sèra.

source_text: a curse is on you, scribes and pharisees, false ones! because you put up buildings for housing the dead bodies of the prophets, and make fair the last resting-places of good men, and say,
target_text: hee, miu mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra! mema miu dhèu dhu padhai leo, tao leo! pe miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo! miu pakapai ro'a nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa dule pabe'a-be'a ro'a dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: if we had been living in the days of our fathers, we would not have taken part with them in the blood of the prophets.
target_text: te ngaa miu peka na, ‘sèmi ji'i se mamuri tèu èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki ji'i, tatu ji'i madhutu boe pamadhe dhèu dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. '

source_text: so that you are witnesses against yourselves that you are the sons of those who put the prophets to death.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, miu unu mi bhoke rahasia miu, na, miu bhelu èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki miu.

source_text: make full, then, the measure of your fathers.
target_text: de la'a, sina ma. miu tao taruu la bhabhelu toke d'ai èle, madhutu tatao bèi-baki mi!

source_text: you snakes, offspring of snakes, how will you be kept from the punishment of hell?
target_text: miu tare'a-re'a bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge mege dhu dènge raco. miu pangee, na, ama lamatua huku boe miu? aad'o! tatu na pèci miu asa d'ara ai naraka!

source_text: for this reason, i send you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them you will put to death and put on the cross, and to some of them you will give blows in your synagogues, driving them from town to town;
target_text: sanèd'e paie! pe ja'a pua ana madhutu ja'a mai, ho ra aj'a-nori dènge pad'elo miu j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu lèke. te ngaa èèna na miu pamadhe cahag'e, aa cahag'e hari miu paku pamadhe si ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. abhu kahèi dhu miu hake-paru si ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa abhu cahag'e kahèi miu paj'èra si toke ra rai nèti kota èci asa kota leo.

source_text: so that on you may come all the blood of the upright on the earth, from the blood of upright abel to the blood of zachariah, son of barachiah, whom you put to death between the temple and the altar.
target_text: lod'o uru sèra, bèi-baki miu pamadhe habel. masi ka nèngu ne, d'ara dhu mola. bèi-baki miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti lai ana-lai èpu. toke d'ai sakaria, ana nèti barakia. ra pamadhe ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i padètu dènge mei korban. lula miu madhutu bhabhelu bèi-baki mi, nèti èèna ka miu hud'i tago mere raa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara mola se'e.

source_text: truly i say to you, all these things will come on this generation.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a! te miu ana lod'o limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a abhu huku lula j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu dhu bèi-baki miu ad'u-ue karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: o jerusalem, jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who are sent to her! again and again would i have taken your children to myself as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, and you would not!
target_text: hee, miu dhèu yerusalem! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha na dhu mai soru-bara miu. ja'a ke'a boe roca pamako miu, sèna ka lèpa mai asa ja'a ne, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu bhiri-sarobho ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a.

source_text: see, your house is made waste.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua pusi-pahae heka dènge èmu miu. ka bèli-camèd'a, èmu èèna dhèu pea heka ètu d'ara.

source_text: for i say to you, you will not see me from this time till you say, a blessing on him who comes in the name of the lord.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te bèli-camèd'a miu mèdhi heka ja'a toke d'ai lod'o na, miu mangaku, peka na, ‘èdhi manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pala-bagi mamèngi-nale mi dhèu ne'e, lula lamatua ka dhu pua na mai. ' miu mangaku sèmi èèna, heka mèdhi hari ja'a kèna.

source_text: and jesus went out of the temple, and on the way his disciples came to him, pointing out the buildings of the temple.
target_text: ka yesus neo tèke eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa na kalua, ana madhutu na mai paj'uj'u babe'a èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne.

source_text: but he, answering, said to them, see you not all these things? truly i say to you that here there will not be one stone resting on another, which will not be pulled down.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, na, èmu ne, mema saraga. te ngaa nanene, ee! nèbhu heka dhèu mai paguri eele aa'i hadhu se.

source_text: and while he was seated on the mountain of olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, make clear to us, when will these things be? and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?
target_text: hèia yesus la'e madhèdi asa ledhe saitun. ka ana madhutu na mai padhai lii mesa ra dènge ne, peka na, ama! peka hari ku laa, lii padhai ama deo na. j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? mamai hari ama na lod'o mia? aa tadha-tadha na tasamia? tasamia kahèi dènge lod'o èle rai-haha?

source_text: and jesus said to them in answer, take care that you are not tricked.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, j'aga paie mamuri miu, sèna ka dhèu baku kapod'e-kabèli miu.

source_text: for people will come in my name, saying, i am the christ; and a number will be turned from the true way through them.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua padhadha karèi nèti uru ka. ' dènge j'ara ne, rèngu monya dhèu ae.

source_text: and news will come to you of wars and talk of wars: do not be troubled, for these things have to be; but it is still not the end.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi ka, dhèu pamusu, do, tadèngi lii palolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, na, miu baku madha'u kahèi. te j'ara se'e se, hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku, te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha ne dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for nation will be moved against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and men will be without food, and the earth will be shaking in different places;
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku, èèna na pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci pamusu, lab'a negara leo. ètu mia-mia abhu rai opo, aa manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna.

source_text: but all these things are the first of the troubles.
target_text: te ngaa sèra sa, heka tadha partama kèna, dhu peka na, lod'o èle rai-haha dètu ae le. èèna nuka sèmi bhèni dhu mulai kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: then they will be cruel to you, and will put you to death: and you will be hated by all nations because of my name.
target_text: de miu hud'i j'aga paie ku ngi'u miu! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu mai paj'èra dènge pamadhe miu. aa dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, èèna na d'èi boe miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and numbers of people will be turned from the right way, and will give one another up and have hate for one another.
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu soro kabodho dènge ro'o heka madhutu ja'a. rèngu panasa èci dènge èci, aa èci pahie èci.

source_text: and a number of false prophets will come, causing error.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu tema leko-monya se, peka na, rèngu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. ka dhèu ae ka dhu lèka si.

source_text: and because wrongdoing will be increased, the love of most people will become cold.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a bhabhelu dhèu asa tabha, toke dhèu re'a heka pasue èci dènge èci.

source_text: but he who goes through to the end will get salvation.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu toke madhe, tatu ama lamatua pala hia ne mamuri.

source_text: and this good news of the kingdom will be given through all the world for a witness to all nations; and then the end will come.
target_text: te dhèu hud'i palolo pale-lème ku lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, toke suu-suu rai d'ai ro'a kakilu ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu j'ara mamuri lamatua. èle èèna ku, rai-haha ne heka èle kèna.

source_text: when, then, you see in the holy place the unclean thing which makes destruction, of which word was given by daniel the prophet let this be clear to the reader,
target_text: yesus padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, daniel, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. èèna na maso titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, nèngu pahera eele era ne'e. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua soro kabodho tèke eele era ne'e. de ropa miu mèdhi ka sèmi èèna, na mi pajiko paie-iie ka! dhèu cee dhu baca sasuri ne'e hud'i pajiko paie-iie ku!

source_text: then let those who are in judaea go in flight to the mountains:
target_text: te ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dètu ae le. ropa mèdhi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea, rai ka asa ledhe.

source_text: let not him who is on the house-top go down to take anything out of his house:
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kalua nèti d'ara èmu le, na maso ia ka mere mèdha-panyau. te ngaa rai dènge ka, sèna ka baku lèke mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: and let not him who is in the field go back to get his coat.
target_text: dhèu ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka mere mèdha-papake mi. te ngaa rai dènge ka!

source_text: but it will be hard for women who are with child and for those with babies at the breast in those days.
target_text: dhu j'èra risi ka, ina dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu pasusu ana dhu heka rara iisi hiu sèra. te rèngu se bisa boe rai pamèri.

source_text: and say a prayer that your flight may not be in the winter, or on a sabbath.
target_text: de hua iia miu sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra èèna mage lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai, do, lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: because in those days there will be great sorrow, such as there has not been from the start of the world till now, or ever will be.
target_text: te lod'o èèna j'èra titu kèna! karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, dhèu dhae ladhe rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu kapai sèmi èèna na. aa èèna na, dhèu paraga heka dènge j'aj'èra dhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and if those days had not been made short there would have been no salvation for any, but because of the saints those days will be made short.
target_text: te ngaa miu oto kapai, te ama lamatua pab'ab'e lod'o èèna. ladhe aad'o, na, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa taha mamuri. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua sue dhèu unu na dhu hag'e nare sèra, nèti èèna ka na pab'ab'e lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: then if any man says to you, see, here is the christ, or, here; do not put faith in him;
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai ka, miu tadèngi dhèu, peka na, ‘ladhe ku la! kristus ka ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo peka na, ‘kristus ka nèi! ' te ngaa baku miu parcaya!

source_text: for there will come up false christs, and false prophets, who will do great signs and wonders; so that if possible even the saints might be tricked.
target_text: te èèna na, abhu dhèu mai tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa dhèu leo peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu kèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na rèngu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, pake koasa nidhu, sèna ka kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. dhèu se tenge j'ara ho dhèu unu ama lamatua sèra lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: see, i have made it clear to you before it comes about.
target_text: de miu hud'i j'aga paie-iie mamuri miu! lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se, dhae d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e mema le miu!

source_text: if, then, they say to you, see, he is in the waste land; go not out: see, he is in the inner rooms; put no faith in it.
target_text: ladhe dhèu peka dènge miu, na, ‘kristus ètu le d'ara tana lapa nèi! ', na baku lami kahèi. aa ladhe abhu dhu peka na, ‘kristus nuka ètu d'ara èmu! ', na, baku miu parcaya kahèi.

source_text: because as in a thunderstorm the bright light coming from the east is seen even in the west; so will be the coming of the son of man.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ladhe ja'a mai hari asa rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi bela kaha'a nèti dhimu asa haa.

source_text: wherever the dead body is, there will the eagles come together.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, pe miu me'a ja'a ètu era mia. nuka sèmi dhèu re'a na, ladhe dhèu rèdhi manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na ra re'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: but straight away, after the trouble of those days, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light and the stars will come down from heaven and the powers of heaven will be moved:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ho peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe oe èle ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, ‘èèna na, madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, hèru heo heka. hua hètu-hua hètu kabhui nèti dedha-liru, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru patogo èci dènge èci. '

source_text: and then the sign of the son of man will be seen in heaven: and then all the nations of the earth will have sorrow, and they will see the son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha ètu dedha-liru, dhu pad'elo, peka na, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari kèna. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne j'aj'i madha'u toke ra tangi. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge ra'i-liru, heka rèngu ladhe rèdhi koasa dènge dadedha ja'a kèna.

source_text: and he will send out his angels with a great sound of a horn, and they will get his saints together from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
target_text: ka ja'a pake lii tèbhe dhu mèdhu ho pua ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, sèna ka pakaboko rare dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a kabhili kore le, nèti suu-suu rai-haha, nèti haa toke dhimu, nèti badae toke balèu.

source_text: now take an example from the fig-tree: when her branch has become soft and puts out its leaves, you are certain that the summer is near;
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi aj'u ca kapua. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, tadha na, oe dètu hèru hadhu kèna.

source_text: even so, when you see all these things, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi ka d'ai lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi dhu ja'a peka-padhai deo na, èèna tadha, na, mamai ja'a dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: truly i say to you, this generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri loo-limuri ne, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o j'aj'èra se dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii padhai ja'a ne ca lamusi sa bisa boe ele.

source_text: but of that day and hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the son, but the father only.
target_text: ca dhèu sa re'a boe pèri lod'o ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe kahèi. dhodhoka ama ku mesa na dhu ne'a.

source_text: and as were the days of noah, so will be the coming of the son of man.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa ja'a mai hari, nuka sèmi taa uru sèra, lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: because as in those days before the overflowing of the waters, they were feasting and taking wives and getting married, till the day when noah went into the ark,
target_text: èi aae dhae j'aj'i mèka lala, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu ra'a-rinu, aa paleo èmu sèmi biasa. dhèu sèra tao taruu sèmi èèna, toke noh maso asa d'ara kapa aae èèna.

source_text: and they had no care till the waters came and took them all away; so will be the coming of the son of man.
target_text: te ngaa ropa èi aae lala, hae nèti aa'i si, rèngu heka kabèdhi kèna, lula ngaa dhu j'aj'i sèra. èci èèna ka dènge mamai ja'a bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: then two men will be in the field; one is taken, and one let go;
target_text: lod'o èèna, ladhe abhu dhèu dua ètu d'ara oka, cag'ag'a laa ama lamatua ded'e nèti ca dhèu, aa ca dhèu hari tèke eele.

source_text: two women will be crushing grain; one is taken, and one let go.
target_text: ladhe dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, kaca'a la ama lamatua ded'e nèti ca dhèu, aa ca dhèu hari tèke eele.

source_text: be watching, then! for you have no knowledge on what day your lord will come.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i bori pa'èra mema kahèi, te miu me'a boe pèri lod'o lamatua miu lèpa hari mai.

source_text: but be certain of this, that if the master of the house had had knowledge of the time when the thief was coming, he would have been watching, and would not have let his house be broken into.
target_text: pangee paie-iie! ladhe lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema, na, mèda none dhèu mana'u mai, tatu na pasaruru boe musi madha na, sèna ka dhèu mana'u baku maso asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: be ready then; for at a time which you have no thought of the son of man will come.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra mema kahèi. te mamai hari ja'a èèna, dènge sahèka!

source_text: who is the true and wise servant, whom his lord has put over those in his house, to give them their food at the right time?
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi lamatua na. te ladhe lamatua na neo la'e rai kaj'èu, na ded'e dhèu sab'a dhu sèmi èèna ku, ho uri nganga'a-nganginu hia isi èmu na.

source_text: a blessing on that servant, who will be doing so when his lord comes.
target_text: ladhe lamatua na lèpa, ladhe nèdhi dhèu sab'a na dhu sab'e dènge be'a, tatu na karej'e.

source_text: truly, i say to you, he will put him over all he has.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua èmu hia dhèu sab'a ne koasa, sèna ka ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but if that evil servant says in his heart, my lord is a long time in coming;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu sab'a ne, dhèu bhelu, tatu na ngee ètu d'ara na,

source_text: and is cruel to the other servants, taking his pleasure with those who are overcome with wine;
target_text: ‘be'a kèna! lamatua ja'a la'e le, de cee ne'a na pèri lod'o lèpa hari mai! ' nèti ngangee sèmi ne'e ne, hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a leo sèra. aa nèngu madhèdi na'a-ninu mau-mau bera-bera dènge dhèu mahu sèra.

source_text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he is not looking for him, and in an hour of which he has no knowledge,
target_text: te ngaa dhu ne'a nare boe, na, cag'ag'a laa lamatua na lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and will have him cut in two, and will give him a part in the fate of the false ones: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.
target_text: hèia lamatua na capa paj'èra ne, ka core ne asa li'u, sèna ka na pa'èci dènge dhèu padhai lii leo, tao leo sèra. ètu era ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ra j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: then the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins, the friends of the bride, who took their lights, and went out with the purpose of meeting the husband.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus tuhu hari lii lula-nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bori mema-mema ho soru mamai ja'a, nuka sèmi lii pakasame ne. sèmi ne'e: ca tèka dhèu bhèni dhèu canguru dhu kalua re mèda, lasi soru broit dhèu mone, rèti dènge labhu èi mènyi asa èmu angalai ra.

source_text: and five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
target_text: te ngaa nèti rèngu canguru dhèu se, abhu lèmi dhu goa, aa lèmi dhu d'èlu-mèu.

source_text: for the foolish, when they took their lights, took no oil with them.
target_text: lèmi dhu goa se, rèti boe èi mènyi dhu risi.

source_text: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lights.
target_text: te ngaa lèmi dhu d'èlu-mèu se, rèti parisi.

source_text: now the husband was a long time in coming, and they all went to sleep.
target_text: d'ai èmu, broit dhèu mone dhae mai mèka. nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu bhèni se musi madha ra sakaa, hèia ra bhèj'i luu titu kèna.

source_text: but in the middle of the night there is a cry, the husband comes! go out to him.
target_text: re'a rare boe te, d'ai talora mèda sa, hèia tadèngi lii pa'oo, peka na, ‘wee! broit mai le! mai lati soru ne! '

source_text: then all those virgins got up, and made ready their lights.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi, hèia dhèu bhèni se kèd'i ka. ka ra kèpe ka labhu ra èci-èci.

source_text: and the foolish said to the wise, give us of your oil; for our lights are going out.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhèni dhu goa se, peka dènge bhèni aanga ra, aku rèngu na, ‘angalai, ee! bagi hia ji'i èi mènyi miu ciki la, te labhu ji'i di ruru-ruru kèna! '

source_text: but the wise made answer, saying, there may not be enough for us and you; it would be better for you to go to the traders and get oil for yourselves.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhèni dhu d'èlu-mèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, ‘irii! baku nasa, te bisa boe. te èi mènyi ji'i d'ai boe èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti! de be'a risi lami hèli ètu era dhu pahia èi mènyi. '

source_text: and while they went to get oil, the master came; and those who were ready went in with him to the feast: and the door was shut.
target_text: hèia lasi ka hèli èi mènyi. te ngaa ropa rèngu lasi, broit dhu d'ai le. ka dhèu bhèni dhu d'èlu-mèu se, lasi ka asa d'ara pesta, palere-lere dènge broit dènge tamu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa rèngu aa'i-aa'i d'ai d'ara, ka ra bèdho èmu.

source_text: after that the other virgins came, saying, lord, lord, let us in.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni dhèu lèmi dhu goa se, lèpa mai. ka ra paroa peka na, ‘ama! ama! conge ku èmu hia ji'i la! '

source_text: but he made answer and said, truly i say to you, i have no knowledge of you.
target_text: te ngaa ama ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘wee, bisa boe, te miu se cee, ja'a tadhe boe! '

source_text: keep watch, then, because you are not certain of the day or of the hour.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra taruu, te miu me'a boe kahèi, lod'o do hake pèri ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: for it is as when a man, about to take a journey, got his servants together, and gave them his property.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, ropa ja'a tèke eele miu, na, miu hud'i sab'a paie-iie hia ja'a, nuka sèmi lii pakasame ne: abhu lamatua ca dhèu neo pakèd'i la'e asa rai kaj'èu. ropa na pa'èra neo la'e, hèia na paroa nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ka na paredha si, aku nèngu na, ‘miu pake doi ne, tao mi poko. ladhe ja'a lèpa mai, miu pad'elo dènge ja'a, miu abhu leto ca ngaa. '

source_text: and to one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to everyone as he was able; and he went on his journey.
target_text: ka na pabagi doi hualaa mi dhèu sab'a ka èci, lèmi saku, sèna ka pab'unge ne. dhèu sab'a ka dua abhu doi dua saku, aa ka tèlu abhu doi ca saku, madhutu a'èra rèngu èci-èci ra. ka lamatua ne pakèd'i la'e ka.

source_text: straight away he who had been given the five talents went and did trade with them, and made five more.
target_text: ropa sèmi rare doi ne, hèia dhèu sab'a ka èci la'e dènge d'aga. nèbhu boe, na abhu leto doi lèmi saku hari.

source_text: in the same way he who had been given the two got two more.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sab'a ka dua. na abhu leto, doi dua saku hari.

source_text: but he who was given the one went away and put it in a hole in the earth, and kept his lord's money in a secret place.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu dhu abhu doi ca saku deo na, la'e kèi ro'a ka na padhènu doi lamatua na asa d'ara.

source_text: now after a long time the lord of those servants comes, and makes up his account with them.
target_text: nèbhu ae ku, heka lamatua rèngu lèpa. hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a na sèra, ho parisa doi na, dhu na hia si uri.

source_text: and he who had the five talents came with his other five talents, saying, lord, you gave into my care five talents: see, i have got five more.
target_text: dhèu sab'a ka èci, la'e ka saraka doi canguru saku, ka na peka, ‘ama! doi ama ka ne'e. ca hari ni, ama hia ja'a doi lèmi saku. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a abhu leto lèmi saku kahèi. '

source_text: his lord said to him, well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, i will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.
target_text: ropa lamatua na tadèngi, hèia na karej'e. ka na peka, na, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu be'a. èu ne maj'èni, aa d'èi madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a, masi ka ja'a aad'o. lula èu ne bisa uri dhu ciki sèmi ne'e, de èèna na ja'a ded'e èu sèna ka uri j'ara dhu kapai aae hari. pe ja'a tao pesta, sèna ka ta'a-tinu sama-sama. '

source_text: and he who had the two talents came and said, lord, you gave into my care two talents: see, i have got two more.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu sab'a ka dua, la'e saraka mi lamatua na, doi èpa saku, ka na peka na, ‘ama! ca hari ni, ama hia ja'a doi dua saku. te ngaa ladhe ku la, ja'a abhu leto dua saku kahèi. '

source_text: his lord said to him, well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, i will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.
target_text: ka lamatua ne karej'e kahèi, ka na peka na, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu be'a kahèi. èu ca dhèu dhu maj'èni, aa madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a, masi ka ja'a aad'o. lula èu bisa uri dhu ciki sèmi ne'e ne, de èèna na ja'a ded'e èu ho uri dhu kapai hari. pe ja'a tao pesta, sèna ka ta'a-tinu sama-sama. '

source_text: and he who had had the one talent came and said, lord, i had knowledge that you are a hard man, getting in grain where you have not put seed, and making profits for which you have done no work:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu sab'a ka tèlu, la'e peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ke'a na, ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara adhu. te ama more ngaa dhu dhèu leo tao, aa puu more ngaa dhu dhèu leo sèle.

source_text: and i was in fear, and went away, and put your talent in the earth: here is what is yours.
target_text: ka ja'a madha'u, mage doi se ele, hèia ama huku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a huni paie-iie ne. ka se'e, ama! de more hari ka, te doi ama se, kura boe ca ana ma sa! '

source_text: but his lord in answer said to him, you are a bad and unready servant; if you had knowledge that i get in grain where i did not put seed, and make profits for which i have done no work,
target_text: ropa lamatua ne tadèngi nare, hèia na jèke dhèu sab'a ne, aku nèngu na, ‘wee, èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu bhelu aa bai-eed'a! èu dhu me'a, na, ja'a kore ngaa dhu dhèu leo tao, aa puu kore ngaa dhu dhèu leo sèle,

source_text: why, then, did you not put my money in the bank, and at my coming i would have got back what is mine with interest?
target_text: nga tao ka èu lamu boe tèke doi ne mi bank? sèna ka ropa ja'a lèpa, ja'a kore bunga na, masi ka ciki oo'e, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: take away, then, his talent and give it to him who has the ten talents.
target_text: ka lamatua ne pua dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, ‘mere doi nèti nèngu ne, ho hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto lèmi saku èèna.

source_text: for to everyone who has will be given, and he will have more: but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
target_text: te dhèu dhu uri paie-iie ngaa dhu ètu adhe-aai na, èèna na, na abhu ae hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu ro'o boe uri ngaa dhu ètu d'ara adhe-aai na, èèna na rare aa'i nèti nèngu.

source_text: and put out the servant who is of no profit into the outer dark: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.
target_text: kèpe mere dhèu sab'a dhu guna boe ne. nuni pa'oro ne, pèci asa li'u nèi. soro tèke ne, sèna ka na tangi, aa dui nare j'aj'èra ètu era maroga aatu-aatu nèi! '

source_text: but when the son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then will he be seated in his glory:
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a puru mai dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. èle na ja'a madhèdi ètu kadera paredha dhu dedha risi, sèna ka parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and before him all the nations will come together; and they will be parted one from another, as the sheep are parted from the goats by the keeper.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri rèdhi ètu rai-haha, mai asa madha ja'a. pe ja'a hag'e si, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha pacèri kahib'i-kalèbho nèti kahib'i-ka'ia, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: and he will put the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, ja'a hia si re g'ana ja'a. te ngaa dhu leo sèra, ja'a hia si re kariu ja'a.

source_text: then will the king say to those on his right, come, you who have the blessing of my father, into the kingdom made ready for you before the world was:
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a kèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. èèna na dhèu-dhèu ètu g'ana ja'a, ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se'e se, ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama ku. mai lati asa d'ara èmu na, dhu na tao tèke hia miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for i was in need of food, and you gave it to me: i was in need of drink, and you gave it to me: i was wandering, and you took me in;
target_text: ja'a nèru miu, lula uru èèna lod'o ja'a manganga, miu ka dhu panga'a ja'a. aa lod'o ja'a koko kamango, miu ka hia ja'a kinu. ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa miu hia ja'a manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu.

source_text: i had no clothing, and you gave it to me: when i was ill, or in prison, you came to me.
target_text: ja'a dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa miu ka dhu papake ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa miu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho, aa miu ka dhu mai pa'asu-pareo dènge ja'a. '

source_text: then will the upright make answer to him, saying, lord, when did we see you in need of food, and give it to you? or in need of drink, and give it to you?
target_text: ropa dhèu-dhèu ètu sebhe g'ana ja'a se tadèngi lii ja'a ne, ra dhaa peka na, ‘lamatua, ne'e ne tasamia kèna? lamatua peka na, lamatua manganga, ka ji'i panga'a. lamatua koko kamango, ka ji'i hia minu.

source_text: and when did we see you wandering, and take you in? or without clothing, and give it to you?
target_text: lamatua sèmi dhèu leo kara, ka ji'i hia manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lamatua dènge boe mèdha-papake, ka ji'i papake lamatua.

source_text: and when did we see you ill, or in prison, and come to you?
target_text: lamatua pèd'a, ka ji'i lalau-lalo'o lamatua, lamatua ètu d'ara bèdho, ka ji'i dhiu pa'asu-pareo. te ngaa j'ara se'e se, lod'o mia ka dhu ji'i tao mi lamatua? '

source_text: and the king will make answer and say to them, truly i say to you, because you did it to the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.
target_text: pe ja'a dhaa si, peka na, ‘parcaya la ja'a! te lod'o miu tao j'ara se'e se mi dhèu unu ja'a, masi ka tao mi dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, sèra sa miu tao le mi dedha ja'a kahèi! '

source_text: then will he say to those on the left, go from me, you cursed ones, into the eternal fire which is ready for the evil one and his angels:
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sebhe kariu ja'a, ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘hee, dhèu bhelu-katub'a! ama lamatua dhu dhoo le miu. pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! pe ja'a paredha dhèu mai kèpe miu, sèna ka pèci asa d'ara ai naraka dhu heo robhe-robhe. te ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le era j'aj'èra ne, hia mi nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra.

source_text: for i was in need of food, and you gave it not to me; i was in need of drink, and you gave it not to me:
target_text: ja'a babège eele miu, lula lod'o ja'a manganga, miu hia boe ja'a ku'a. aa lod'o ja'a koko kamango, miu hia boe ja'a kinu.

source_text: i was wandering, and you took me not in; without clothing, and you gave me no clothing; ill, and in prison, and you came not to me.
target_text: ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa miu soru boe ja'a asa d'ara èmu mi. ja'a dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa miu papake boe ja'a. lod'o ja'a pèd'a-tarègu, miu lalau-lalo'o boe ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho, te ngaa miu pa'asu-pareo boe ja'a sa kahèi. '

source_text: then will they make answer, saying, lord, when did we see you in need of food or drink, or wandering, or without clothing, or ill, or in prison, and did not take care of you?
target_text: ropa dhèu bhelu-katub'a se tadèngi lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra b'ala, peka na, ‘lamatua ne tasamia kèna? lamatua peka na, lamatua manganga, te ngaa ji'i hia boe mu'a. lamatua koko kamango, te ngaa ji'i hia boe minu. lamatua nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe hia manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lamatua dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ji'i papake boe. lamatua ètu d'ara papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa ji'i lalau-lalo'o boe. lamatua ètu d'ara bèdho, te ngaa ji'i pa'asu-pareo boe. te ngaa j'ara se'e se, ji'i tao mi lamatua lod'o mia? '

source_text: then will he make answer to them, saying, truly i say to you, because you did it not to the least of these, you did it not to me.
target_text: pe ja'a dhaa mi rèngu, peka na, ‘parcaya la ja'a! te lod'o miu soru-bara boe dhèu-dhèu dhu haha ae d'ai seli, èci èèna ka dènge miu soru-bara boe ja'a. '

source_text: and these will go away into eternal punishment; but the upright into eternal life.
target_text: ka dhèu bhelu-katub'a abhu j'aj'èra, toke d'ai mia-mia. te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu d'ara mola, abhu mamuri taa-taa, toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and when jesus had come to the end of all these words, he said to his disciples,
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, hèia na lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: after two days is the passover, and the son of man will be given up to the death of the cross.
target_text: miu me'a le, na, di dua lod'o ka d'ai lod'o babe'a èdhi, nuka pesta paska. lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èle èèna, ra paku pamadhe ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then the chief priests and the rulers of the people came together in the house of the high priest, who was named caiaphas.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dhu pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu kayafas. kayafas ne, nuka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: and they made designs together to take jesus by some trick, and put him to death.
target_text: rèngu se tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka pamadhe ne.

source_text: but they said, not while the feast is going on, for fear of trouble among the people.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu rare lii èci, peka na, mata ku! mage èdhi kèpe ne ètu d'ara lai-lai ne, lula lod'o-lod'o be'a dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae dhu d'èi nèngu, tao maruru.

source_text: now when jesus was in bethany in the house of simon the leper,
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. lod'o dhu d'ai mèka lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi, yesus si ra'a ètu d'ara èmu simon.

source_text: there came to him a woman having a bottle of perfume of great price, and she put the perfume on his head when he was seated at table.
target_text: ropa rèngu ra'a era, bhèni ca dhèu mai paraga dènge yesus. nèngu nèd'u boto cue dhu tao nèti hadhu dhu kab'ua. boto ne dhu isi na, èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna. ka bhèni ne hake pamae katanga boto ne. hèia na pahae mau-mau èi hèu mèngi ne mi kètu yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: but when the disciples saw it they were angry, saying, to what purpose is this waste?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tatao bhèni ne, hèia ra nasa. ka ra paka'uu, aku rèngu na, heh! bhèni ne bhori eele iia d'ara, èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua aae ne. baku na tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: for we might have got much money for this and given it to the poor.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie! sèna ka kab'ua na bagi mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but jesus, seeing it, said to them, why are you troubling the woman? she has done a kind act to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu, hèia na lii peka na, miu se baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e, lula na pahae le èi hèu mèngi ne mi ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: for the poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.
target_text: te dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa pa'èci taruu dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne mamuri nèbhu heka dènge miu.

source_text: for in putting this perfume on my body, she did it to make me ready for my last resting-place.
target_text: aa bhèni dhu pahae èi hèu mèngi mi ngi'u ja'a ne, sèmi ngaa te, nèngu pahèu mèngi mema le ngi'u aae ja'a. te mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka.

source_text: truly i say to you, wherever this good news goes out in all the world, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! sad'i ètu mia èèna ka, ladhe dhèu palolo lii lolo be'a ama lamatua palème rai-haha ne, tatu rèngu papeka kahèi babe'a bhèni ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e ne.

source_text: then one of the twelve, who was named judas iscariot, went to the chief priests and said,
target_text: ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu yesus se, dhu ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o èèna kahèi, kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra, sèna ka neo pahie yesus mi rèngu.

source_text: what will you give me, if i give him up to you? and the price was fixed at thirty bits of silver.
target_text: ropa yudas d'ai dhèu se'e, hèia na karèi, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe ja'a bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa kèpe yesus, miu hia ja'a ngaa? hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie ne dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae. ka ra ige rare tèlu nguru doi iia, aa ra j'ole asa yudas.

source_text: and from that time he was watching for a chance to give him into their hands.
target_text: èle, ka yudas li'u ka la'e, hèia na tenge j'ara ho saraka yesus asa d'ara adhe-aai rèngu.

source_text: now on the first day of unleavened bread the disciples came to jesus, saying, where are we to make ready for you to take the passover meal?
target_text: d'ara tèu mai-tèu mai, abhu lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi dhu nanèbhu na pidhu lod'o. ra pangare lod'o babe'a se, na, ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. ropa pesta èèna neo mulai, ana madhutu yesus se mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! mèda ne'e, èdhi bhoke lod'o babe'a èdhi. de ama neo sèna ka ji'i la'a roro kahib'i-kalèbho, aa lalau era pesta paska ètu mia?

source_text: and he said to them, go into the town to such a man, and say to him, the master says, my time is near: i will keep the passover at your house with my disciples.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, lami asa d'ara kota, pe mi paraga dènge ama ca dhèu. miu peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e, ‘ama! ama mese rasa lod'o mamadhe na nèbhu heka. hèia na manèngi era èci ètu d'ara èmu ama, sèna ka na tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. '

source_text: and the disciples did as jesus had said to them; and they made ready the passover.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ana-ana madhutu na, tao sèmi dhu na peka. ka ra lalau nganga'a kalela paska ètu era èèna.

source_text: now when evening was come, he was seated at table with the twelve disciples;
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda, hèia yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, madhèdi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and while they were taking food, he said, truly i say to you that one of you will be false to me.
target_text: ropa dhu ra'a era, hèia na lii, peka na, mi nanene! ca dhèu nèti miu se, èèna na pahie ja'a asa adhe-aai dhèu leo kara.

source_text: and they were very said, and said to him, one by one, is it i, lord?
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara rèngu roe-bhilu. ka rèngu èci-èci karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: and he made answer and said, he who puts his hand into the plate with me, the same will be false to me.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti na palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahie ja'a.

source_text: the son of man goes, even as the writings say of him: but a curse is on that man through whom the son of man is given up; it would have been well for that man if he had never come into the world.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa mate unu na! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, bèli-camèd'a pasae nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: and judas, who was false to him, made answer and said, is it i, master? he says to him, yes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yudas karèi kahèi, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma? hèia yesus b'ala ne, mema tare'a èu unu mu ka dhu peka lii èèna. de cee hari?

source_text: and when they were taking food, jesus took bread and, after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to the disciples and said, take it; this is my body.
target_text: rèngu dhu ra'a era, hèia yesus ded'e nare roti cue, aa na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a. mere ho mi'e ka!

source_text: and he took a cup and, having given praise, he gave it to them, saying,
target_text: èle ka, yesus nare galaa dhu pènu dènge èi anggor, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. hèia na j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na lii, peka na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, mere ho minu.

source_text: take of it, all of you, for this is my blood of the testament, which is given for men for the forgiveness of sins.
target_text: te èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna. èèna na ja'a madhe, te ngaa raa ja'a suti, sèna ka sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. raa ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua pajaji èèna, mema limuri ne j'aj'i le. de mere ho minu ka!

source_text: but i say to you that from now i will not take of this fruit of the vine, till that day when i take it new with you in my father's kingdom.
target_text: te ngaa nanene paie-iie! mulai nèti mèda ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. pe ja'a dènge ama ku madhèdi ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka ja'a kinu hari kèna dènge miu.
