source_text: and there were women watching from a distance: among them were mary magdalene, and mary, the mother of james the less and of joses, and salome, who went with him when he was in galilee and took care of him; and a number of other women who came up with him to jerusalem.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu lasi asa era èèna kahèi. ra titu nèti kaj'èu, ladhe rèdhi mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. rèngu se ka dhu uru èèna lalau-lalo'o yesus ètu galilea. rèngu sèra, nuka: salome, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yoses, dènge dhèu bhèni leo hari dhu mai asa yerusalem, sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: and when it was evening, because it was the time of getting ready, that is, the day before the sabbath, there came joseph of arimathaea, a responsible man in high honour, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of god; and he went in to pilate without fear, and made a request for the body of jesus.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu èci tenge j'ara ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu èèna, ngara na yusuf, nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne'e kahèi, ca dhèu dhu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi. nèngu dhèu d'ara be'a kahèi. aa nèngu mate nèbhu le paredha ama lamatua mai. lod'o yesus madhe èèna, lèke hari jumat. bèli na, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, yusuf neo papuru eele ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara lod'o hari jumat èèna. ka na pabani iisi na, la'e paraga dènge gubernur pilatus, manèngi ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and pilate was surprised that he was dead; and, sending for the captain, he put a question to see if he had been dead for long.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii manèngi yusuf ne, na malaa. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, eea! nga tao ka, dhèu ne madhe malai sa mia ne! ja'a ngee, na, dhae madhe mèka! hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa komedhaa, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, sa mia? yesus madhe le, do dhae?

source_text: and when he had news of it from the captain, he let joseph have the body.
target_text: komedhaa èèna b'ala, peka na, tare'a, ama! na madhe le karèi deo na. ropa gubernur tadèngi nare lii dhaa èèna, hèia na hia yusuf la'e nare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and he got a linen cloth and, taking him down, put the linen cloth round him, and put him in a place for the dead which had been cut out of a rock; and a stone was rolled against the door.
target_text: hèia yusuf la'e hèli bèla madhera dhu kab'ua èci, ka na la'e asa golgota. d'ai nèi, ka na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. na pahutu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla hiu. tèu èèna, ra heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu d'ara hadhu aae. hèia ra nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus asa d'ara ro'a èèna. ka ra loli rare hadhu kabela dhu kapai èci, ho ra bèdho paie hèb'a ro'a èèna. èle èèna ka, yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: and mary magdalene and mary, the mother of joses, saw where he was put.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari, ina yoses, madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. dua ra rèdhi era dhu ra padhane yesus, ka ra patadhe paie era èèna.

source_text: and when the sabbath was past, mary magdalene and mary, the mother of james, and salome, got spices, so that they might come and put them on him.
target_text: bèli èèna, lèke hari sabtu, nuka lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. ropa lod'o cèna la'e, maria nèti rae magdala, maria dhu leo hari ina yakobis, dènge salome, lasi hèli èi hèu mèngi, sèna ka bèli rèngu bisa lasi pasuti mi ngi'u aae yesus madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and very early after dawn on the first day of the week, they came at the time of the coming up of the sun to the place where the body had been put.
target_text: ropa hari migu mad'ae aae èèna, tèlu ra lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: and they were saying among themselves, who will get the stone rolled away from the door for us? and looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back; and it was of great size.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, tèlu ra padhue, aku rèngu na, waa! d'ai nèi, na, cee ka dhu bisa loli eele hadhu aae èèna nèti hèb'a ro'a? èdhi tèlu ti bisa boe, lula hadhu èèna kapai bia! te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai ro'a èèna, rèdhi hadhu èèna dhu hari eele le nèti hèb'a ro'a.

source_text: and when they went in, they saw a young man seated on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were full of wonder.
target_text: hèia bhèni se maso asa d'ara. rèngu cag'ag'a titu kèna, lula ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, rèdhi ana mone ngèru èci madhèdi ètu sebhe g'ana rèngu, dhu pake mèdha pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: and he said to them, do not be troubled: you are looking for jesus, the nazarene, who has been put to death on the cross; he has come back from the dead; he is not here: see, the place where they put him!
target_text: hèia mone ngèru èèna, peka dènge rèngu, baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a, na, miu mai tenge yesus dhèu nasaret, dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na aad'o heka ètu ne'e, lula na mamuri hari le! mai ho ladhe unu mi, te ngi'u yesus aad'o heka ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na.

source_text: but go, say to his disciples and to peter, he goes before you into galilee: there you will see him, as he said to you.
target_text: de lami ka lai-lai, ho lole dènge petrus si, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le! na la'e uuru le asa galilea. èèna na rèngu paraga dènge yesus ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna na peka mema le dènge rèngu. de lami ka!

source_text: and they went out quickly from the place, because fear and great wonder had come on them: and they said nothing to anyone, because they were full of fear that.
target_text: ropa bhèni se rèdhi heka ngi'u yesus ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na, rèngu cag'ag'a. ka rai asa li'u lasi. hèia rèngu lèpa dènge ka, ra peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa ètu j'ara, lula rèngu madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: now when he came back from the dead early on the first day of the week, he went first to mary magdalene, from whom he had sent out seven evil spirits.
target_text: hari migu mad'ae aae era, yesus pad'elo uuru ngi'u na mi maria nèti magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus babège eele nidhu pidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: she went and gave news of it to those who had been with him, while they were sorrowing and weeping.
target_text: ropa na nèdhi nare yesus, hèia la'e dènge ka, peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu uru èèna madhutu yesus. dhèu sèra pakaboko taruu ètu era èci. rèngu ètu d'ara susa era, taga ra ngee mamadhe yesus.

source_text: and they, when it came to their ears that he was living, and had been seen by her, had no belief in it.
target_text: ka maria peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu susa era? susa ia ka, te yesus mamuri hari le! deo na, ja'a heka paraga dènge ne kèna! te ngaa rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, èu ne, monya! ji'i lèka boe.

source_text: and after these things he was seen in another form by two of them, while they were walking on their way into the country.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae èci. ropa d'ai talora j'ara, yesus pad'elo ngi'u dènge si. te ngaa nèngu ub'a le. nèbhu boe, heka ra tadhe ne.

source_text: and they went away and gave news of it to the rest; and they had no belief in what was said.
target_text: hèia dua ra lèpa hari, lasi peka dènge angalai ra sèra, aku rèngu na, wee! miu nanene ku laa! lai-lai deo na, ji'i paraga le dènge yesus ètu j'ara! te ngaa angalai ra aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, eeh! miu baku monya sèmi èèna!

source_text: and later he was seen by the eleven themselves while they were taking food; and he said sharp words to them because they had no faith and their hearts were hard, and because they had no belief in those who had seen him after he had come back from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paraga dènge ana madhutu na sèra, dhèu canguru èci, ropa ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu. ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, wee! miu kètu hadhu pa'ae sa mia ne! dhèu peka le dènge miu, rèngu rèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha rèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya boe! aku miu na, dhèu sèra monya! de ne'e ne, ja'a unu ku mai. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa ja'a mamuri hari le! de mèdhi le, sina ma!

source_text: and he said to them, go into all the world, and give the good news to everyone.
target_text: de lami ka asa mia-mia palème rai-haha ne. peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lii lolo be'a ja'a ne.

source_text: he who has faith and is given baptism will get salvation; but he who has not faith will be judged.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu parcaya ja'a aa abhu sarani, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri sèna ka na bisa pea taruu dènge ne ètu sorga. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na nèngu abhu huku nèti lamatua, ka lamatua core eele ne asa li'u la'e, ho na pea taruu ètu nèi.

source_text: and these signs will be with those who have faith: in my name they will send out evil spirits; and they will make use of new languages;
target_text: aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a sèra, rèngu tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra re'a, peka na, koasa ra mema mai nèti ama lamatua! conto sèmi, èèna na rèngu bisa babège eele nidhu pake kolongara ja'a. ladhe èèna na, ama lamatua hia si padhai lii pake lii leo dhu rèngu mesa ra dhane rare boe.

source_text: they will take up snakes, and if there is poison in their drink, it will do them no evil; they will put their hands on those who are ill, and they will get well.
target_text: ladhe rèngu kèpe mege dhu dènge raco, do, rinu lèke raco, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ladhe ra tao kacui-aai asa dhèu pèd'a, dhèu èèna èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu na.

source_text: so then the lord jesus, after he had said these words to them, was taken up into heaven and took his seat at the right hand of god.
target_text: ropa padhai lii èle dènge ana madhutu na sèra, hèia ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa sorga. ètu nèi, nèngu j'aj'i ai g'ana ama na, ka rèd'u paredha sama-sama.

source_text: and they went out, preaching everywhere, the lord working with them, and giving witness to the word by the signs which came after. so be it.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ana madhutu na sèra madhutu paredha na. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia, ho lole mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lii lolo be'a yesus. hèia ama lamatua hia si koasa ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu yesus peka le dènge rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae parcaya yesus, taga rèngu re'a le lii lolo be'a èèna, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: as a number of attempts have been made to put together in order an account of those events which took place among us, as they were handed down to us by those who saw them from the first and were preachers of the word, it seemed good to me, having made observation, with great care, of the direction of events in their order, to put the facts in writing for you, most noble theophilus;
target_text: ama teofilus dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lii maho'o nèti ja'a. dhèu ae dhu suri sèku le lii lolo nèti mamuri dènge sasab'a-la'a yesus dhu j'aj'i ètu talora aae ji'i. rèngu suri lii lolo sèra pake lii lolo dhu parai reo nèti ji'i asa ji'i karèi nèti uru ka, dhu ji'i nge'a nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu dètu dènge lamatua yesus, aa nèti dhèu leo dhu ladhe rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. lii lolo se'e, lèke mola-mola dènge mamoa ama lamatua karèi nèti uru kèna. de ja'a parisa kore le toke lutu dènge be'a, j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mulai nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. hèia ja'a pama'ète ho sèna ka suri si paie-iie ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. dènge j'ara ne, ama bisa me'a mèu ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: so that you might have certain knowledge of those things about which you were given teaching.
target_text: aa ama bisa parcaya ngaa dhu dhèu lole sèra, lii dhu monya boe. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i tare'a!

source_text: in the days of herod, king of judaea, there was a certain priest, by name zacharias, of the order of abijah; and he had a wife of the family of aaron, and her name was elisabeth.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i lii lolo ne sèmi ne'e: lod'o dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi yudea, abhu ca dhèu, dhu ngara na sakaria. nèngu ne, ca dhèu ama agama yahudi. aa nèngu kahèi, ca dhèu nèti kaboko ama agama abia. dhèu èmu sakaria, ngara na elisabet, ca dhèu ana-èpu nèti ama agama kahèi. te elisabet ne, ana-èpu nèti harun, a'a musa.

source_text: they were upright in the eyes of god, keeping all the rules and orders of god, and doing no wrong.
target_text: dua ra mamuri mola madhutu paredha dènge atora aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua. aa dhèu pakab'ua si kahèi.

source_text: and they were without children, because elisabeth had never given birth, and they were at that time very old.
target_text: dua ra dhu heka le, te ngaa dhu abhu boe kolo, te era ana nèti elisabet dhu bèdho mèno.

source_text: now it came about that in his turn he was acting as priest before god,
target_text: ca tèka, sakaria dènge dhèu d'ara kaboko abia lèke lod'o rèngu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and as was the way of the priests, he had to go into the temple to see to the burning of perfumes.
target_text: madhutu atora ama agama, hud'i ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu maso asa kama mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, dhèu ne hud'i pasèbu ai pake aj'u hèu mèngi ètu madha ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, sakaria lèke lot.

source_text: and all the people were offering prayers outside, at the time of the burning of perfumes.
target_text: hèia la'e dènge ka asa d'ara. nèngu dhu talora pasèbu ai ètu d'ara kama èèna, dhèu ae-ae dhu sabaj'a ètu madha èmu.

source_text: and he saw an angel of the lord in his place on the right side of the altar.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga titu re bèka g'ana era tunu aj'u hèu mèngi ne.

source_text: and zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear came on him.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, sakaria madha'u titu kèna, ka ne'a heka tao sèmi ngaa.

source_text: but the angel said, have no fear, zacharias, for your prayer has come to the ears of god, and your wife elisabeth will have a son, and his name will be john.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, sakaria! baku madha'u! te ama lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu. de bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu èu nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yohanis.

source_text: and you will be glad and have great delight; and numbers of people will have joy at his birth.
target_text: èèna na dhèu ae karej'e kahèi sama-sama dènge miu, lula miu abhu ana. bèli-camèd'a, ana ne pakarej'e d'ara èu.

source_text: for he will be great in the eyes of the lord; he will not take wine or strong drink; and he will be full of the spirit of god from his birth.
target_text: koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, bera-bera dènge ne, karèi nèti ina na kad'o nèngu era. nèngu ne hud'i luri ninu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. ropa na kapai, ama lamatua pake ne j'aj'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara.

source_text: and through him great numbers of the children of israel will be turned to the lord their god.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a èèna pamako nare dhèu isra'el ae-ae, ho ra lèpa hari asa ama lamatua rèngu.

source_text: and he will go before his face in the spirit and power of elijah, turning the hearts of fathers to their children, and wrongdoers to the way of righteousness; to make ready a people whose hearts have been turned to the lord.
target_text: tatao dènge koasa na nuka sèmi elia, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua karèi uru. nèngu ne mai uuru nèti lamatua èdhi. nèngu ne bisa kabèli d'ara ina-ama, ho sue hari ana-ana ra. aa dhèu dhu rai nèti madha lamatua, na ad'u si ho ra lèpa hari madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti sèmi èèna, nèngu tao dhèu sèna ka sadia d'ara ra sèmi mamai lamatua.

source_text: and zacharias said to the angel, how may i be certain of this? for i am an old man, and my wife is far on in years.
target_text: te ngaa sakaria karèi ana pajuu ne, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, sina ma? ! ja'a dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne! tasamia ja'a bisa ke'a, na, j'ara se bisa j'aj'i?

source_text: and the angel, answering, said, i am gabriel, whose place is before god; i have been sent to say these words to you and to give you this good news.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne gabriel, dhèu pajuu ama lamatua. nèngu ka paleha ja'a mai, sèna ka peka dènge èu lii lolo dhu be'a ne.

source_text: now, see, you will be without voice or language till the day when these things come about, because you had not faith in my words, which will have effect at the right time.
target_text: te ngaa èu mo'o boe lèka lii padhai ja'a ne. de tadha dhu èu manèngi, sèmi ne'e! he'o èu èèna na sakaa, ho èu bisa heka padhai lii, nèti deo ne'e ne, toke miu abhu ana. pe èu mèdhi unu mu. te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: and the people were waiting for zacharias and were surprised because he was in the temple for such a long time.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu li'u sèra, bingu titu kèna, lula sakaria tao bhodho boe.

source_text: and when he came out he was not able to say anything, and they saw that he had seen a vision in the temple; and he was making signs to them without words.
target_text: ropa na kalua mai, nèngu bisa heka padhai lii. ka na hia tadha re kacui-aai na, heka dhèu se'e re'a, na, lamatua hia tanila ropa nèngu ètu d'ara kama mola-mèci èèna.

source_text: and when the days of his work in the temple were ended, he went back to his house.
target_text: ropa èle sasab'a ra, hèia sakaria lèpa asa èmu na.

source_text: after that time, elisabeth, being certain that she was to become a mother, kept herself from men's eyes for five months, saying, the lord has done this to me, for his eyes were on me, to take away my shame in the eyes of men.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka elisabet dènge babia. ka na pea dhoka ètu d'ara èmu toke lèmi hèru. na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio lamatua! lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. ladhe ja'a ne dènge ka kolo, dhèu pamakae heka ja'a.

source_text: now in the sixth month the angel gabriel was sent from god to a town in galilee, named nazareth,
target_text: ropa elisabet dènge babia d'ai èna hèru, hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, la'e asa rae cue ètu propensi galilea, ngara na nasaret. ngara ana pajuu ne, gabriel.

source_text: to a virgin who was to be married to a man named joseph, of the family of david; and the name of the virgin was mary.
target_text: ètu nasaret, abhu ana bhèni ngèru ca dhèu, ngara na maria. nèngu ne dhèu dhu lii d'ai le, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. gabriel la'e paraga dènge maria.

source_text: and the angel came in to her and said, peace be with you, to whom special grace has been given; the lord is with you.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi na mi ana bhèni ne, hèia na lii, peka na, salama, maria, ee! ama lamatua dhu hag'e nare le èu, ho neo ad'u j'ara hua iia èci hia èu. aa nèngu bera-bera dènge èu kahèi.

source_text: but she was greatly troubled at his words, and said to herself, what may be the purpose of these words?
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka maria bingu, lula ne'a boe sasoa nèti lii padhai ana pajuu ne.

source_text: and the angel said to her, have no fear, mary, for you have god's approval.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, maria! baku madha'u. te ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu.

source_text: and see, you will give birth to a son, and his name will be jesus.
target_text: nèbhu heka, èu dènge babia, ho èèna na, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus.

source_text: he will be great, and will be named the son of the most high: and the lord god will give him the kingdom of david, his father:
target_text: nèngu ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai. èèna na lamatua pangare ne, ‘nèngu ne, ana d'èlu ja'a. ' nuka, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. pe ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka nèd'u paredha, nuka sèmi baki na, dhèu aae daud.

source_text: he will have rule over the house of jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there will be no end.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha taa-taa mi dhèu isra'el. te paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and mary said to the angel, how may this be, because i have had no knowledge of a man?
target_text: te ngaa maria karèi gabriel, peka na, ja'a ne j'unu kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone èci sa! tasa mera mia ka ja'a dènge babia?

source_text: and the angel in answer said to her, the holy spirit will come on you, and the power of the most high will come to rest on you, and so that which will come to birth will be named holy, son of god.
target_text: hèia gabriel dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai asa èu. aa koasa nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, èèna na mai sarimu nare èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana dhu bèli-camèd'a èu more iisi èèna, tare'a-re'a mola-mèci, lula nèngu èèna, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: even now elisabeth, who is of your family, is to be a mother, though she is old: and this is the sixth month with her who was without children.
target_text: baku malaa! te a'ari èu ca dhèu, ngara na elisabet, dènge le babia kahèi. dhèu peka na, nèngu èèna bisa heka nara iisi, lula nèngu dhu heka le. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu dènge babia èna hèru kèna.

source_text: for there is nothing which god is not able to do.
target_text: te bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i!

source_text: and mary said: i am the servant of the lord; may it be to me as you say. and the angel went away.
target_text: ka maria dhaa, peka na, be'a. ja'a ne ènu ama lamatua. hud'i laa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii èu èèna ka. ja'a ke'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga ne lèpa, tèke eele maria.

source_text: then mary got up and went quickly into the high lands, to a town of judah; and went into the house of zacharias and took elisabeth in her arms.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia maria pakèd'i nèti nasaret, la'e lai-lai asa rae sakaria, ètu ledhe-ledhe propensi yudea. d'ai nèi, la'e dènge ka asa d'ara èmu sakaria. ka na hia lii maho'o mi elisabet.

source_text: and when the voice of mary came to the ears of elisabeth, the baby made a sudden move inside her; then elisabeth was full of the holy spirit,
target_text: ropa elisabet tadèngi lii maho'o nèti maria, hèia ana ètu d'ara kabake elisabet pasèja. aa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, maso sa elisabet.

source_text: and she said with a loud voice: may blessing be on you among women, and a blessing on the child of your body.
target_text: ka elisabet pa'oo, peka na, maria! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, risi nèti dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne! èèna na dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oke padedha-dedha kahèi ana dhu èu kad'o èèna.

source_text: how is it that the mother of my lord comes to me?
target_text: ra pakab'ua ja'a kahèi, lula ina nèti lamatua ja'a mai pangad'o dènge ja'a.

source_text: for, truly, when the sound of your voice came to my ears, the baby in my body made a sudden move for joy.
target_text: ropa èu mèti lii maho'o mi dedha ja'a, cag'ag'a laa ana dhu ja'a kad'o ne pasèja ètu d'ara kabake ja'a, lula karae.

source_text: happy will she be who had faith that the things which the lord has said to her will be done.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èu, lula èu ne parcaya, peka na, nèngu tao madhutu lii dhu na moa tèke.

source_text: and mary said: my soul gives glory to god;
target_text: maria bhoka hèb'a, peka na, nèti d'ara iiki ja'a, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha lamatua!

source_text: my spirit is glad in god my saviour.
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ama lamatua hia ja'a mamuri!

source_text: for he has had pity on his servant, though she is poor and lowly placed: and from this hour will all generations give witness to the blessing which has come to me.
target_text: nèngu ne tao le madha-dhilu mi ja'a, nuka ana pua-paleha na dhu dènge boe kab'ua ne. karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ngee na, ja'a ne, bhèni dhu kalua mèngi titu kèna,

source_text: for he who is strong has done great things for me; and holy is his name.
target_text: lula lamatua tao j'ara malaa mi dedha ja'a. nèngu ne, dhu koasa dedha risi aa dhu mola-mèci risi.

source_text: his mercy is for all generations in whom is the fear of him.
target_text: ama lamatua loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakab'ua aa dhu pahaha iisi ra mi nèngu, nèti lai ana-lai èpu.

source_text: with his arm he has done acts of power; he has put to flight those who have pride in their hearts.
target_text: na pake koasa na, sèna ka tao pakaco dhèu-dhèu dhu padedha iisi sèra.

source_text: he has put down kings from their seats, lifting up on high the men of low degree.
target_text: na pamanahu dhèu aae-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u koasa, lula ra padedha iisi. te ngaa na j'oka padedha-dedha dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: those who had no food he made full of good things; the men of wealth he sent away with nothing in their hands;
target_text: na panga'a dhèu dhu manganga toke bècu, te ngaa na babège-lalèta dhèu-dhèu kaja ho lasi dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: his help he has given to israel, his servant, so that he might keep in mind his mercy to abraham and his seed for ever,
target_text: na soru-bara dhèu isra'el na, dènge loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi rèngu.

source_text: as he gave his word to our fathers.
target_text: uru èèna, na pa'èki tèke le lii pajaji dènge bèi-baki èdhi, nuka baki abraham dènge ana-èpu na aa'i-aa'i ra. d'ai sange ne'e, lii pajaji èèna pa'èki mèno.

source_text: and mary was with her for about three months and then went back to her house.
target_text: hèia maria pea dènge elisabet toke tèlu hèru, heka lèpa asa èmu na ètu nasaret.

source_text: now it was time for elisabeth to give birth, and she had a son.
target_text: ropa d'ai hèru, ka elisabet nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and it came to the ears of her neighbours and relations that the lord had been very good to her, and they took part in her joy.
target_text: lii ne'e, ra palolo d'ai a'ari na dènge rae lesa, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na, ka na hia elisabet ana mone ca dhèu. hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and on the eighth day they came to see to the circumcision of the child, and they would have given him the name of zacharias, his father's name;
target_text: lod'o ana ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne, madhutu atora dhèu yahudi. ra neo pangare ana ne, sakaria, madhutu ngara ama na.

source_text: but his mother made answer and said, no, his name is john.
target_text: te ngaa ina na b'ala ra, aku nèngu na, aad'o sèmi èèna! ngara na hud'i yohanis ku!

source_text: and they said, not one of your relations has that name.
target_text: te ngaa ra b'ala ne, nga tao ka pili ngara yohanis? nèti a'ari miu, ca dhèu sa dhu ngara dhae, sèmi mèka èèna!

source_text: and they made signs to his father, to say what name was to be given to him.
target_text: ka ra senen ho karèi sakaria, sèna ka neo pangare ana ne ngara na ngaa.

source_text: and he sent for writing materials and put down: his name is john; and they were all surprised.
target_text: hèia sakaria senen ho manèngi lei. ra hia ne lei, ka na suri peka na, ngara na yohanis! ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa titu kèna.

source_text: and straight away his mouth was open and his tongue was free and he gave praise to god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, he'o na dhu sakaa mèno èèna, mako dènge ka. ka na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and fear came on all those who were living round about them: and there was much talk about all these things in all the hill-country of judaea.
target_text: hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pea padètu ètu sèra sa, madha'u dènge malaa. ka lii ne'e mulai ra palolo nèti hèb'a sa hèb'a, toke dhèu-dhèu ètu ledhe-ledhe ètu propensi yudea re'a aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and all who had word of them kept them in their minds and said, what will this child be? for the hand of the lord was with him.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, ra pangee, peka na, tatu koasa nèti lamatua bera-bera dènge ana ne. bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na kapai mai, na j'aj'i dhèu sèmi mia, oo?

source_text: and his father, zacharias, was full of the holy spirit, and with the voice of a prophet said these words:
target_text: èle ka, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa sakaria. ka na padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: praise be to the lord, the god of israel, for he has come to his people and made them free,
target_text: koa-kio ama lamatua dhèu isra'el! te na mai le ho sui nare dhèu unu na, sèna ka rèngu baku j'aj'i sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: lifting up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant david,
target_text: lamatua ded'e le ca dhèu dhu koasa na kapai titu kèna, ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèngu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: as he said, by the mouth of his holy prophets, from the earliest times,
target_text: lamatua moa mema, karèi nèti uru ka, re dhèu dhu maj'èni rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: salvation from those who are against us, and from the hands of those who have hate for us;
target_text: limuri ne na neo patabuli èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, aa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara pèd'a dènge èdhi.

source_text: to do acts of mercy to our fathers and to keep in mind his holy word, the oath which he made to abraham, our father,
target_text: na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi bèi-baki èdhi, lula na sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji na mi rèngu, dhu na pa'èki dènge baki abraham.

source_text: that we, being made free from the fear of those who are against us, might give him worship,
target_text: na patabuli le èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, sèna ka ta pahaha iisi mi nèngu, dhu dènge heka d'ara madha'u.

source_text: in righteousness and holy living before him all our days.
target_text: na patalale le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri mola-mèci dènge be'a taa-taa, ètu katanga madha na.

source_text: and you, child, will be named the prophet of the most high: you will go before the face of the lord, to make ready his ways;
target_text: yohanis, ee! èu ne, ana ja'a. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadhe èu, na, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu dedha risi aa'i. èèna na, lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu, sèna ka ra pakabhèle kacui-aai ra ho soru mamai lamatua.

source_text: to give knowledge of salvation to his people, through the forgiveness of sins,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lamu paj'uj'u j'ara hia mi dhèu unu lamatua, sèna ka re'a, na, ama lamatua hia mamuri mi rèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu saku eele sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: because of the loving mercies of our god, by which the dawn from heaven has come to us, to give light to those in dark places, and in the shade of death, so that our feet may be guided into the way of peace.
target_text: lula d'ara lamatua taleo aa rasa kasia mi dedha èdhi, nèti èèna ka, na hia èdhi taa-tebho dhu hiu, nuka sèmi lod'o hiu nèti saraa dhu hiu. èdhi dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa èdhi dhu pea dènge d'ara madha'u ètu sanabhu mamadhe, lula pabe'a mèka dènge lamatua, bèli-camèd'a abhu saraa ho lere èdhi asa j'ara dhu nèti mera-milu.

source_text: and the child became tall, and strong in spirit; and he was living in the waste land till the day when he came before the eyes of israel.
target_text: ka yohanis asa kapai noo-noo. aa roh lamatua pa'èra ne. na kapai mai, hèia la'e pea ka ètu d'ara mamoo, toke d'ai lod'o na pakako sasab'a mi dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: now it came about in those days that an order went out from caesar augustus that there was to be a numbering of all the world. this was the first numbering, which was made when quirinius was ruler of syria.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara kirenius j'aj'i gubernur ètu siria, dhèu aae kapai agustus, hia paredha, dhu peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu paredha roma, hud'i lèpa asa rae èta-èsu ra ho madhutu sensus! èèna heka hiu-lai kèna, dhèu paredha roma ige ana kabarai na.

source_text: and all men went to be numbered, everyone to his town.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i lèpa asa rai èta-èsu ra, sèna ka madhutu sensus.

source_text: and joseph went up from galilee, out of the town of nazareth, into judaea, to beth-lehem, the town of david, because he was of the house and family of david, to be put on the list with mary, his future wife, who was about to become a mother.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf pea ètu rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea. nèngu dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni ca dhèu, ngara na maria, dhu dènge le babia. yusuf ne, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ka nèngu hud'i lèpa ku asa kota daud, nuka betlehem ètu propensi yudea, sèna ka madhutu sensus. nèti èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa kota betlehem.

source_text: and while they were there, the time came for her to give birth.
target_text: ropa dua ra ètu nèi, maria d'ai lod'o nara iisi.

source_text: and she had her first son; and folding him in linen, she put him to rest in the place where the cattle had their food, because there was no room for them in the house.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, dua ra abhu boe kama ètu d'ara losmen. nèti èèna ka, dua ra maso lasi asa d'ara oka badha. hèia maria nara iisi ana uuru, mone ca dhèu. ka pasig'i ne dènge kaha'i bèla, aa paj'unu ètu d'ara karab'a, era badha ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and in the same country there were keepers of sheep in the fields, watching over their flock by night.
target_text: mèda èèna, abhu ana madhenga badha dhèu pèri-pèri dhu beke madhenge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a ètu li'u kota.

source_text: and an angel of the lord came to them, and the glory of the lord was shining round about them: and fear came on them.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. hèia saraa lamatua rai-reo nare rèngu, ka ra madha'u bia.

source_text: and the angel said, have no fear; for truly, i give you good news of great joy which will be for all the people:
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne peka, baku madha'u! nanene pabe'a-be'a! te ja'a ne mai ho peka lii lolo be'a èci hia miu. cee dhu tadèngi lii ne'e, tatu rèngu karej'e.

source_text: for on this day, in the town of david, a saviour has come to birth, who is christ the lord.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne, sèmi ne'e ka: deo ne'e, ca dhèu ina nara iisi le kristus ètu betlehem, nuka kota dhèu aae daud. kristus ne'e ka dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka. lamatua hia na mai, sèna ka na patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèngu ne'e, èèna na dhèu paroa na, ‘lamatua'!

source_text: and this is the sign to you: you will see a young child folded in linen, in the place where the cattle have their food.
target_text: pe miu tadhe ne sèmi ne'e ka: miu paraga dènge ana rara iisi hiu ca dhèu dhu pahutu dènge sig'i. ra paj'unu ne ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and suddenly there was with the angel a great band of spirits from heaven, giving praise to god, and saying,
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, hèia cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae mai nèti sorga. ka ra pa'èci dènge ne. hèia ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge lii sod'a, peka na,

source_text: glory to god in the highest, and on the earth peace among men with whom he is well pleased.
target_text: ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua! nèngu dhu nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi. ama lamatua neo hia dame dènge mera-milu mi dhèu rai-haha, dhu pakarej'e d'ara na!

source_text: and when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, the keepers of the sheep said to one another, let us go now to beth-lehem, and see this thing which has come about, which the lord has made clear to us.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu se lèpa hari asa sorga. hèia ana madhenga badha se padhai lii, peka na, mai lati ku asa betlehem, ho ladhe ku ana nèi! te lamatua pa'adhu le lii ne hia èdhi.

source_text: and they came quickly, and saw mary and joseph, and the child in the place where the cattle had their food.
target_text: hèia lasi ka lai-lai asa betlehem. ka rèngu paraga maria dènge yusuf. aa ladhe rèdhi kahèi ana dhu heka rara iisi, dhu bhèj'i ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: and when they saw it, they gave them an account of the things which had been said to them about the child.
target_text: ropa rèngu rèdhi ana ne, hèia ra lolo, peka na, deo na ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka le dènge ji'i, lula-nèti ana ne'e ne! ka ra lolo aa'i-aa'i toke èle.

source_text: and all those to whose ears it came were full of wonder at the things said by the keepers of the sheep.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, tadèngi lii lolo ana madhenga badha se.

source_text: but mary kept all these words in her heart, and gave much thought to them.
target_text: te ngaa maria tèke ka ètu d'ara na, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le. aa na pangee mau-mau, ho neo ne'a sasoa na tasa mera mia.

source_text: then the keepers of the sheep went back, giving glory and praise to god for all the things which had come to their ears and which they had seen, as it had been said to them.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhenga badha se lèpa hari asa era kahib'i-kalèbho ra. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. ra manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula dhu rèngu tadèngi aa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra, lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi ngaa dhu ana pajuu ama lamatua peka sèra.

source_text: and when, after eight days, the time came for his circumcision, he was named jesus, the name which the angel had given to him before his birth.
target_text: ropa ana iiki ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne madhutu atora musa. hèia ama dènge ina na pangare ne, ‘yesus'. ngara ne, ngara dhu ana pajuu nèti sorga peka le dènge rèngu, lod'o ina na dènge mèka babia.

source_text: and when the necessary days for making them clean by the law of moses had come to an end, they took him to jerusalem to give him to the lord
target_text: atora èci nèti baki musa peka na, bhèni dhu rara iisi rare, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o hud'i madhutu ku ad'a, pamèu iisi ra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa maso sèmi biasa asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. nèti èèna ka, yusuf dènge maria lasi asa kota yerusalem, sèna ka tao madhutu ad'a. lasi rèti dènge ana iiki èèna asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho saraka ne, sèna ka j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: as it says in the law of the lord, every mother's first male child is to be holy to the lord,
target_text: rèngu madhutu atora lamatua dhu peka na, bhèni dhu nara iisi ana mone uuru, nèngu hud'i saraka ana ne j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: and to make an offering, as it is ordered in the law of the lord, of two doves or other young birds.
target_text: madhutu atora lamatua, ladhe saraka ana èèna mi lamatua, ina-ama hud'i hia ku koro iia ca pasa, do koro j'aha ngèru dua ngi'u. nèti èèna ka, yusuf dènge maria tao madhutu atora èèna.

source_text: and there was then in jerusalem a man whose name was simeon; and he was an upright man, fearing god and waiting for the comfort of israel: and the holy spirit was on him. and he had knowledge, through the holy spirit, that he would not see death till he had seen the lord's christ.
target_text: taa èèna, abhu mone heka ca dhèu ngara na simeon, dhu pea ètu kota yerusalem. nèngu ne dhèu d'ara mola, aa d'èi lamatua. roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge ne, na, nèngu hud'i nèdhi ku kristus, heka na madhe kèna. kristus èèna ka, dhu bèli-camèd'a hia mamuri mi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and full of the spirit he came into the temple; and when the father and mother came in with the child jesus, to do with him what was ordered by the law,
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua lere simeon la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. lod'o èèna kahèi, ina-ama yesus rèti ne, ho saraka j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: then he took him in his arms and gave praise to god and said,
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi ana ne, ka simeon sa'u nare ne, hèia na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, aku nèngu na,

source_text: now you are letting your servant go in peace, o lord, as you have said;
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua tao le madhutu lii pajaji na mi dedha ja'a. de ne'e ne lamatua bisa le patabuli ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhe dènge mera-milu,

source_text: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
target_text: te ja'a kèdhi le dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai, ho patabuli ji'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ji'i!

source_text: which you have made ready before the face of all nations;
target_text: lamatua neo pake ana ne'e, sèna ka hia mamuri mi suku aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: a light of revelation to the gentiles, and the glory of your people israel.
target_text: nèngu nuka sèmi saraa, dhu pakab'ua suku-suku isra'el, dhèu lamatua sèra. nèngu kahèi èci èèna ka dènge saraa, dhu pad'elo j'ara lamatua, pala mi suku-suku leo kahèi.

source_text: and his father and mother were full of wonder at the things which were said about him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yusuf dènge maria malaa lula lii padhai dhu simeon peka lula-nèti ana rèngu ne.

source_text: and simeon gave them his blessing and said to mary, his mother, see, this child will be the cause of the downfall and the lifting up of great numbers of people in israel, and he will be a sign against which hard words will be said;
target_text: èle ka simeon padhai lii hia si mèngi-nale. hèia na peka dènge maria, aku nèngu na, ina yesus! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ae ètu isra'el tule eele ana èu ne. te ngaa tatao rèngu mi dedha nèngu ne, èèna na pamanahu hari rèngu. ana ne'e, bèli-camèd'a pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae kahèi.

source_text: and a sword will go through your heart; so that the secret thoughts of men may come to light.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, lamatua bhoke patalele d'ara dhèu. te ngaa èu, maria, pe mu paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae, nuka sèmi samala dhu lose adhe-usu èu.

source_text: and there was one, anna, a woman prophet, the daughter of phanuel, of the family of asher she was very old, and after seven years of married life she had been a widow for eighty-four years; she was in the temple at all times, worshipping with prayers and going without food, night and day.
target_text: ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu kahèi bhèni heka ca dhèu, ngara na hana. umur na, aru nguru èpa tèu kèna. ngara ama na fanuel, nèti suku aser. na leo-èmu pidhu tèu, ka dhèu èmu na madhe. hana ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèngu loe boe sabaj'a dènge puasa ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua mèda-mèu.

source_text: and coming up at that time, she gave praise to god, talking of him to all those who were waiting for the freeing of jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o simeon padhai lii dènge yusuf dènge maria era, hèia hana mai padètu-dètu. ka nanene si padhai lii, hèia na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka na padhai lii lula-nèti yesus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatae mamai dhèu aae dhu lamatua lii dhu moa tèke neo pua mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and when they had done all the things which were ordered by the law of the lord, they went back to galilee, to nazareth, the town where they were living.
target_text: ropa yusuf dènge maria tao le madhutu atora nèti baki musa ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra lèpa asa rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: and the child became tall and strong and full of wisdom, and the grace of god was on him.
target_text: ka yesus asa kapai, asa èra, asa d'èlu-mèu dènge ne'a madha j'ara ae-ae. aa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi yesus kahèi.

source_text: and every year his father and mother went to jerusalem at the feast of the passover.
target_text: yusuf dènge maria dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lasi asa kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when he was twelve years old, they went up, as their way was, to the feast;
target_text: ca tèka, ropa umur yesus canguru dua tèu, hèia la'e palere dènge ina-ama na asa yerusalem, lasi ra'a kalela paska sèmi biasa.

source_text: and when the days of the feast came to an end and they were going back, the boy jesus was still in jerusalem, but they had no knowledge of it: and in the belief that he was with some of their number, they went a day's journey; and after looking for him among their relations and friends,
target_text: lod'o èle paska, yusuf dènge maria mulai lèpa lasi asa nasaret palere-lere dènge dhèu ae dhu lèpa asa galilea. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe, na, yesus ètu yerusalem era. ra pangee, na, nèngu palere dènge mone aanga-angalai na. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, yusuf dènge maria rèdhi boe ne. ka dua ra mulai patangi-tenge kèna. lasi pakarèi mi a'ari ra, aa mone aanga-angalai ra.

source_text: and seeing that he was not there, they went back to jerusalem, to make search for him.
target_text: lula rage boe ne, hèia dua ra lèpa hari sa yerusalem, lasi tenge ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and after three days they came across him in the temple, seated among the wise men, giving ear to their words and putting questions to them.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra patangi-tenge ne toke tèlu lod'o kateme, heka paraga dènge ne kèna, ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu dhu madhèdi padhue-padhai dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: and all to whose ears it came were full of wonder at his knowledge and the answers which he gave.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene lii dhaa na, malaa-maloha, lula nèngu tare'a-re'a ne'a mèu isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, aa na ne'a dhaa lii karèi dènge mola.

source_text: and when they saw him they were surprised, and his mother said to him, son, why have you done this to us? see, your father and i have been looking for you with sorrow.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna ka, ina-ama na malaa kahèi. hèia ina na lii, aku nèngu na, yesus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ji'i sèmi ne'e? ama mu dènge ja'a patangi-tenge èu heo d'èlu!

source_text: and he said to them, why were you looking for me? was it not clear to you that my right place was in my father's house?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka ina dènge ama paj'èra iisi tenge ja'a? me'a, si? ja'a dènge urusan ètu èmu ama ku.

source_text: and his words seemed strange to them.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu re'a rare boe sasoa lii na.

source_text: and he went down with them and came to nazareth; and did as he was ordered: and his mother kept all these words in her heart.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra lèpa asa nasaret. ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ina dènge ama na. ka ina na tèke aa'i-aa'i se'e ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and jesus was increasing in wisdom and in years, and in grace before god and men.
target_text: hèia yesus asa tabha kapai, asa tabha d'èlu-mèu, asa pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, dènge dhèu rai-haha asa tabha d'èi ne.

source_text: now in the fifteenth year of the rule of tiberius caesar, pontius pilate being ruler of judaea, and herod being king of galilee, his brother philip king of the country of ituraea and trachonitis, and lysanias king of abilene, when annas and caiaphas were high priests, the word of the lord came to john, the son of zacharias, in the waste land.
target_text: taa èèna, tiberius j'aj'i dhèu aae kapai dhu nèd'u paredha ètu roma, canguru lèmi tèu kèna. pontius pilatus j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi yudea. herodes j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi galilea. a'a herodes ka pelipus, j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi iturea dènge propensi trakonitis. aa lisanias j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi abilene. taa èèna kahèi hanas dènge kayafas, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu kota yerusalem. lod'o èèna, yohanis, ana sakaria, dhu pea ètu era kaj'èu nèti rae. ètu era ne'e, lamatua pangèd'u ne lii.

source_text: and he came into all the country round about jordan, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yohanis la'e asa d'ara rae dhu dètu dènge loko yarden, ho peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i ele-ho'a ku, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala sèra. èle èèna, miu sarani uuru ku, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu pabe'a le dènge lamatua.

source_text: as it says in the book of the words of isaiah the prophet, the voice of one crying in the waste land, make ready the way of the lord, make his roads straight.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, baki yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara mamoo, pa'oo, peka na: ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra, sèna ka tao paie-iie j'ara, ho sèmi mamai lamatua! pamola j'ara sèna ka lami soru ne.

source_text: every valley will be lifted up, and all the mountains and hills made low, and the twisted will be made straight, and the rough ways smooth;
target_text: dhènu pamera era kajèlo aa'i-aa'i. tao pamera-mera ledhe aa'i-aa'i. tao pamola j'ara dhu koe-kalèko, tao pamilu j'ara dhu ako kabhuku.

source_text: and all flesh will see the salvation of god.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a, na, ama lamatua neo pakaj'èu dhèu nèti sasala-sasigo ra. '

source_text: so he said to the people who went out to him for baptism: you offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?
target_text: dhèu ae mai nèti mia-mia, manèngi ho yohanis sarani si. te ngaa na jèke si, peka na, miu se dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! miu èci èèna ka mege dhu dènge raco! mage miu pangee na miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti hahuku lamatua, sad'i dhoka ele-ho'a di! aad'o! nèbhu heka lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tare'a-re'a ele boe ho'a.

source_text: make clear by your acts that your hearts have been changed; and do not say to yourselves, we have abraham for our father: for i say to you that god is able from these stones to make children of abraham.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, ‘ja'a ne lèke boe huku, lula ja'a ana-èpu baki abraham. ' abhu ètu mia sèmi èèna? j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham bisa boe tao miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci. lamatua bisa tao hadhu se, sèna ka j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. ja'a peka kèna! pad'elo ètu d'ara mamuri miu, dhu peka na, miu tèke eele le sasala-sasigo miu, aa mai ho madhutu lamatua.

source_text: and even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; and every tree which does not have good fruit will be cut down and put into the fire.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku j'ara be'a. ladhe aad'o, na, hahuku lamatua dhu bia, bèbhe mai lèke miu, nuka sèmi dhèu pake kataka ho patue aj'u nèti amo na. nuka sèmi èèna ka! aj'u dènge boe guna, ladhe hua-hela na nèti boe babe'a! de be'a risi patue ne, aa core eele asa d'ara ai la'e.

source_text: and the people put questions to him, saying, what have we to do?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae karèi yohanis, ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i se tasamia?

source_text: and he made answer and said to them, he who has two coats, let him give to him who has not even one; and he who has food, let him do the same.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dènge kodho dua bèla, hia èci sa dhèu dhu dènge boe kodho. aa ladhe èu dènge nganga'a, bagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe nganga'a.

source_text: then tax-farmers came to him for baptism and said to him, master, what have we to do?
target_text: hèia dhèu roro bea mai manèngi kahèi, sèna ka yohanis sarani si. ka ra karèi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i se hud'i tao sèmi ngaa ku?

source_text: and he said to them, do not make an attempt to get more money than the right amount.
target_text: ka na dhaa, miu se d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. de nèti deo ne'e, miu hud'i sab'a ku dènge mola. baku roro bea risi nèti atora paredha. hud'i laa kabarai b'ae madhutu atora na.

source_text: and men of the army put questions to him, saying, and what have we to do? and he said to them, do no violent acts to any man, and do not take anything without right, and let your payment be enough for you.
target_text: abhu kahèi sordad'u pèri-pèri ètu sèra. ra karèi, na, ji'i se hud'i tao ku sèmi ngaa? hèia yohanis b'ala, peka na, baku parama doi-dhari dhèu madhutu dad'èi miu. aa baku galaa leli dhèu. ladhe sèmi mere gaji, miu hud'i manèngi makasi mi lamatua, aa rasa d'ai le dènge gaji èèna.

source_text: and while the people were waiting, and all men were questioning in their hearts about john, if he was the christ or not,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, dhèu se mulai pagagai aa paka'uu èci dènge èci, peka na, eeh! tao-tao yohanis ne, kristus, dhu lamatua peka karèi nèti uru ka, neo hia mai èèna!

source_text: john made answer, saying to them all, truly, i give you baptism with water, but one is coming who is greater than i, whose shoes i am not good enough to undo: he will give you baptism with the holy spirit, and with fire:
target_text: te ngaa yohanis b'ala si, peka na, nanene paie! bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èci mai dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a ne bisa boe sa hèi. ja'a ne sarani miu dhoka pake èi di, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a na tao risi eele nèti ja'a, te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. aa na pamèu d'ara miu nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai ho tunu maruru.

source_text: in whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned in the fire which will never be put out.
target_text: na huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, tao si cakaraa dhèu sab'a oka, dhu patiri are ho ngèlu tiu eele kètu na. èle ku, heka soli are dhu mèu asa d'ara soka, aa kètu dènge kaj'alu are sèra, tunu pakèpu si. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a kristus huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, dènge j'ara pèci si asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe nèdhi boe.

source_text: and so comforting them with these and other words, he gave the good news to the people;
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e yohanis pasanèd'e dhèu nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara, aa lole dènge ra lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: but herod the king, because john had made a protest on account of herodias, his brother's wife, and other evil things which herod had done, did this most evil thing of all, and had john shut up in prison.
target_text: taa èèna, yohanis padhai lii pahuni heka, j'ara-j'ara dhu herodes ad'u-ue. lii langu herodes nuka sèmi ne'e ka: herodes ne, gubernur ètu propensi galilea. sasala na udhu sèmi kadhèna hèru hadhu sa. sasala na èci ka, parame nare herodias, dhèu èmu ari na, masi ka ari na mamuri era, dhu dhae pa'ia mèka. j'ara mamuri herodes sèmi ne'e, ka yohanis kai dènge madha na, toke herodes nasa dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, herodes kèpe ne, hèia pamaso asa d'ara èmu bèdho.

source_text: now it came about that when all the people had been given baptism, jesus, having had baptism with them, was in prayer, when, the heaven being open,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ra kèpe mèka yohanis ne, nèngu sarani dhèu ae le. aa na sarani yesus kahèi. sarani èle, ka yesus sabaj'a, kabèdhi laa, liru bhoka eele.

source_text: the holy spirit came down in the form of a dove, and a voice came from heaven, saying, you are my dearly loved son, with whom i am well pleased.
target_text: hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai sa yesus. roh ne rupa na sèmi koro j'aha sa. hèia lii nèti dedha-liru peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a. èu ne, loe boe pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and jesus at this time was about thirty years old, being the son as it seemed of joseph, the son of heli,
target_text: lod'o yesus mulai lole dènge dhèu j'ara mamuri lamatua, umur na pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèu sa. dhèu tadhe yesus ne, ana nèti yusuf. bèi-baki yusuf sèmi ne'e: yusuf, ama na, eli.

target_text: ropa yohanis sarani nare yesus, hèia yesus la'e, tèke eele loko yarden. roh ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ne, ka pakako ne asa d'ara mamoo èci.

source_text: for forty days, being tested by the evil one. and he had no food in those days; and when they came to an end, he was in need of food.
target_text: ka yesus pea ètu èèna toke èpa nguru lod'o. ètu era ne'e, na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa, ka na manganga titu kèna. aa dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne.

source_text: and the evil one said to him, if you are the son of god, give orders to this stone to become bread.
target_text: na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ladhe èu ne tare'a ana ama lamatua, èu dènge koasa. de tao hadhu se j'aj'i roti, ho mu'a si.

source_text: and jesus made answer to him, it has been said in the writings, bread is not man's only need.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, peka na, èu hari! me'a boe, do? dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘mamuri dhèu rai-haha, mesa boe dhoka nèti nganga'a-nganginu di! '

source_text: and he took him up and let him see all the kingdoms of the earth in a minute of time. and the evil one said, i will give you authority over all these, and the glory of them, for it has been given to me, and i give it to anyone at my pleasure.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa era èci dhu dedha aae, hèia na paj'uj'u dènge yesus a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. hèia na pamako yesus, na, a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i sèra, ètu d'ara kacui-aai ja'a. de ja'a dènge hak ho pangèd'u mi cee èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ko'o.

source_text: if then you will give worship to me, it will all be yours.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a neo hia mi èu. te ngaa sad'i èu tao ku ca j'ara, heka ja'a hia èu kèna. mud'a iiki-iiki! èu pahaha iisi mi ja'a! dhoka èèna di.

source_text: and jesus in answer said to him, it has been said in the writings, give worship to the lord your god, and be his servant only.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, abhu ètu mia j'ara na sèmi èèna? te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘èu dhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di. aa èu sogo-tagu dhoka mi nèngu di. '

source_text: and he took him to jerusalem and put him on the highest point of the temple and said to him, if you are the son of god, let yourself go down from here; for it is said in the writings,
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa kota yerusalem. d'ai era ne'e, na paca'e yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na peka, ladhe tare'a-re'a èu ne ana ama lamatua, na, ridhu asa haha nèi!

source_text: he will give his angels orders to take care of you:
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho mai j'aga èu.

source_text: and, in their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.
target_text: èèna na ra sibhe èu, sèna ka haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: and jesus made answer and said to him, it is said in the writings, you may not put the lord your god to the test.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii nidhu ne, èu baku karihu kahadhu dènge ja'a ne. lula dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, na, ‘baku sèku ama lamatua. '

source_text: and when all these tests were ended the evil one went away from him for a time.
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu ne tenge j'ara rupa-rupa ho sèku yesus, te ngaa tao nare boe. ka la'e tèke eele yesus, na mate hari lod'o dhu be'a.

source_text: and jesus came back to galilee in the power of the spirit, and the news of him went through all the country round about.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari asa propensi galilea, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci hia ne koasa. nèbhu boe ka dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara rai èèna, mulai tadhe kolongara na.

source_text: and he was teaching in their synagogues and all men gave him praise.
target_text: na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu mia-mia. ka dhèu koa-kio ne, peka na, yesus ne dhu ele madha, nga!

source_text: and he came to nazareth, where he had been as a child, and he went, as his way was, into the synagogue on the sabbath, and got up to give a reading.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mai asa rae na nasaret. lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, dhu ra pangare na ‘sabat', hèia la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèmi dhu tema na tao. ka na kèd'i titu ho neo baca nèti sasuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and the book of the prophet isaiah was given to him and, opening the book, he came on the place where it is said,
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne sasuri nèti baki yesaya. hèia na bhoke tenge ayat, ka na baca, peka na,

source_text: the spirit of the lord is on me, because i am marked out by him to give good news to the poor; he has sent me to make well those who are broken-hearted; to say that the prisoners will be let go, and the blind will see, and to make the wounded free from their chains,
target_text: koasa roh ama lamatua abhu ètu ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na paj'uj'u ja'a, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu aad'o. nèngu pua le ja'a mai, ho lole, na, dhu ana bèdho, èèna na patalala si; dhu bèdhu, èèna na bisa rèdhi hari; dhu lèke ènyi nèti dhèu, èèna na patabuli eele.

source_text: to give knowledge that the year of the lord's good pleasure is come.
target_text: te limuri ne d'ai le lod'o lamatua, sèna ka pala mamuri mi dhèu unu na.

source_text: and shutting the book he gave it back to the servant and took his seat: and the eyes of all in the synagogue were fixed on him.
target_text: baca nare sasuri ne, ka yesus lulu hari, hèia na j'ole asa ama dhu nèd'u kasasi, ka na madhèdi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna ladhe patae ne.

source_text: then he said to them, today this word has come true in your hearing.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, dhu miu tadèngi nèti sasuri ama lamatua deo na, ne'e ne, j'aj'i le!

source_text: and they were all giving witness, with wonder, to the words of grace which came from his mouth: and they said, is not this the son of joseph?
target_text: ka dhèu sèra mulai padhai lii padedha yesus, aku rèngu na, waa! ngaa dhu na padhai lii deo na, be'a titu kèna! te ngaa nèngu ne ana yusuf, si? tasamia ka na bisa sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and he said to them, without doubt you will say to me, let the medical man make himself well: the things which to our knowledge were done at capernaum, do them here in your country.
target_text: hèia yesus lole dènge si, tatu miu tadèngi le lii dhu peka na, ‘wee, dote! puri uuru ku ngi'u èu! ' miu neo pake lii èèna, ho kabèli hari sa ja'a, peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao boe tadha malaa èci hia ji'i ètu ne'e, sèmi dhu èu tao le ètu kota kapernaum nèi? '

source_text: and he said to them, truly i say to you, no prophet is honoured in his country.
target_text: mamola na sèmi ne'e: dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti d'ara rae unu na.

source_text: truly i say to you, there were a number of widows in israel in the days of elijah, when the heaven was shut up for three years and six months and there was no food in the land; but elijah was not sent to one of them, but only to zarephath, in the land of sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi baki elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ca tèka, èj'i mai boe tèlu tèu catenga. taa èèna, abhu bhèni balu ae ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua hia boe elia ho soru-bara si ètu isra'el sèra. lamatua dhoka pua la'e asa ca dhèu bhèni balu ètu rae sarfat, dhu dètu dènge kota sidon. masi ka bhèni ne dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and there were a number of lepers in israel in the time of elisha the prophet, and not one of them was made clean, but only naaman the syrian.
target_text: tare hari conto leo nèti elisa, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. taa èèna, dhèu yahudi ae dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua pa'èle boe si nèti papèd'a ra. ama lamatua dhoka pua elisa la'e puri-pa'èle dhèu kusta èci, ngara na naaman, masi ka nèngu ne dhèu siria, dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and all who were in the synagogue were very angry when these things were said to them.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra nasa titu kèna dènge ne.

source_text: and they got up and took him out of the town to the edge of the mountain on which their town was, so that they might send him down to his death.
target_text: ka ra kèd'i aa'i-aa'i, ra babège eele ne nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna. hèia ra nuni rèti ne asa karasa rae, ho neo tule ne nèti dedha tèbhi ètu èèna, asa haha la'e.

source_text: but he came through them and went on his way.
target_text: te ngaa na kako asa li'u la'e re talora aae rèngu, ka tèke eele si ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he came down to capernaum, a town of galilee; and he was giving them teaching on the sabbath.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus puru la'e asa kota kapernaum ètu sebhe dano galilea. d'ai lod'o-lod'o sabaj'a, na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and they were surprised at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
target_text: dhèu sèra malaa ladhe ra nanene lii padhai na, te ne'a mèu isi lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: and there was a man in the synagogue who had an unclean spirit; and he gave a loud cry and said,
target_text: ca tèka, ropa yesus aj'a-nori ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao, na pa'oo-parodha, peka na,

source_text: let us be! what have we to do with you, jesus of nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? i have knowledge who you are, the holy one of god.
target_text: ee! yesus, dhèu nasaret! èu neo tao ngaa mi ji'i? èu mai sèna ka palaho ji'i, do? ji'i se tadhe èu. èu ne, dhèu mola, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho hia mai.

source_text: and jesus said to him, be quiet, and come out of him. and when the evil spirit had put him down on the earth in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no damage.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, rèno laa! hutu hèb'a èu na! kalua ka nèti dhèu ne'e! cag'ag'a laa, nidhu ded'e kalabhe dhèu ne asa rai, ètu talora aae dhèu sèra. ropa pabèbhe nare, hèia nidhu ne kalua tèke eele aa papèd'a boe isi dhèu ne hèi.

source_text: and wonder came on them all and they said to one another, what are these words? for with authority and power he gives orders to the evil spirits and they come out.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, ka ra peka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e, dènge koasa kapai bia! toke nidhu madhutu paredha na kahèi, ka kalua nèti dhèu!

source_text: and there was much talk about him in all the places round about.
target_text: hèia lii lolo lula-nèti yesus pale-lème rai èèna aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and he got up and went out of the synagogue and went into the house of simon. and simon's wife's mother was very ill with a burning heat; and in answer to their prayers for her
target_text: lod'o rèngu kalua nèti èmu sabaj'a, yesus la'e asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. lod'o èèna, teto na dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro isi pana bia. hèia ra manèngi yesus, peka na, ama! puri-pa'èle ku bhèni heka ne, laa!

source_text: he went near her, and with a sharp word he gave orders to the disease and it went away from her; and straight away she got up and took care of their needs.
target_text: ka yesus la'e titu ètu sebhe koi, ka puri papèd'a bhèni heka ne. cag'ag'a laa, èi papèd'a na ele dènge ka. hèia na kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a hia si ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and at sundown all those who had anyone ill with any sort of disease, took them to him, and he put his hands on every one of them and made them well.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o nihia èèna kahèi, ropa lod'o oe cèna, dhèu lere rèti dhèu pèd'a ae-ae mai asa yesus. èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa. hèia na bane ai mi dhèu pèd'a se'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and evil spirits came out of a number of them, crying out and saying, you are the son of god. but he gave them sharp orders not to say a word, because they had knowledge that he was the christ.
target_text: nèti dhèu pèd'a se abhu kahèi dhu nidhu tao. hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, sèna ka kalua nèti dhèu sèra. ra rai kalua dènge lii taraa, peka na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua! te nidhu se re'a, na, nèngu ne kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. nèti èèna ka, yesus kai si sèna ka bisa boe ra padhai ca hèb'a sa, lula-nèti nèngu.

source_text: and when it was day, he came out and went to a waste place; and great numbers of people came looking for him, and they came to him and would have kept him from going away.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus kèd'i, ka la'e asa era dhu kaliu èci ètu li'u kota. hèia dhèu tenge ne asa mia-mia. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka ra pamako ne, aku rèngu na, ama pea ka dènge ji'i laa! lamu iia ka asa era leo!

source_text: but he said to them, i have to give the good news of the kingdom of god in other towns, because that is why i was sent.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku asa rae-rae leo, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèti paredha ama lamatua. te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai ne, sèna ka pakako sasab'a èèna.

source_text: and he was teaching in the synagogues of galilee.
target_text: hèia na kako nèti rae èci asa rae leo, ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: now it came about that while the people came pushing to be near him, and to have knowledge of the word of god, he was by a wide stretch of water named gennesaret;
target_text: ca tèka, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu sebhe dano galilea. dhèu ae mai sèna ka neo nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. rèngu mai toke ra kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: and he saw two boats by the edge of the water, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
target_text: padètu dènge era èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pamèu pèku ra ètu dedha nebhe. ka yesus nèdhi koha dua bua dhu panahu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he got into one of the boats, the property of simon, and made a request to him to go a little way out from the land. and being seated he gave the people teaching from the boat.
target_text: cue nèti koha se, unu simon. èle ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha ne, ka na manèngi sèna ka simon tob'e asa era marèma ciki. hèia na madhèdi ho aj'a dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and when his talk was ended, he said to simon, go out into deep water, and let down your nets for fish.
target_text: aj'a nare, hèia na padhai lii dènge simon, peka na, simon! padedha hari ku asa d'ara marèma, ho core pèku la'a. te èèna na miu abhu i'a ae.

source_text: and simon, answering, said, master, we were working all night and we took nothing: but at your word i will let down the nets.
target_text: ka simon dhaa, peka na, te ngaa, ama. ji'i sab'a d'ai madhe d'ara camèd'a kateme kèna, te abhu boe ci'u sa hèi! te ngaa lula ama ku peka le sèmi èèna, ja'a madhutu! ja'a papuru sèku.

source_text: and when they had done this, they got such a great number of fish that it seemed as if their nets would be broken;
target_text: hèia ra papuru pèku. ropa ra neo ère paca'e hari, re'a boe na pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a, ka mulai mae.

source_text: and they made signs to their friends in the other boat to come to their help. and they came, and the two boats were so full that they were going down.
target_text: hèia simon rodhe angalai na ètu koha leo sèra, ho mai bara rèngu ère pèku. ka ra da'u i'a tao asa d'ara koha, toke koha dua bua se pènu dènge i'a, ka oe cène.

source_text: but simon, when he saw it, went down at the knees of jesus and said, go away from me, o lord, for i am a sinner. for he was full of wonder and so were all those who were with him, at the number of fish which they had taken; and so were james and john, the sons of zebedee, who were working with simon. and jesus said to simon, have no fear; from this time forward you will be a fisher of men.
target_text: angalai simon se, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, ana nèti sabadeus, ètu era èèna kahèi. rèngu se malaa, lula ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna. ropa simon petrus ladhe nèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia na patitu dènge ka, kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus, hèia na peka, ja'a ne, ca dhèu dhu ue le sasala ae-ae. de be'a risi, lamatua padètu ia ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, simon! pangee ia ka j'ara ne'e, te ja'a neo pake miu se. miu tema le tenge i'a. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a aj'a miu sèna ka tenge dhèu ho madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and when they had got their boats to the land, they gave up everything and went after him.
target_text: èle ka, rèngu nuni dènge ka koha ra asa dedha nebhe. ka lasi tèke eele ka ngaa-ngaa ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it came about that while he was in one of the towns, there was a leper there: and when he saw jesus he went down on his face in prayer to him, saying, lord, if it is your pleasure, you have power to make me clean.
target_text: ètu rae èci, yesus paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pènu dènge èi papèd'a kusta. ropa dhèu ne nèdhi yesus, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u d'ai rai. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sue ku ja'a laa! te ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa puri-pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a. sad'i ama mo'o.

source_text: and he put out his hand to him and said, it is my pleasure; be clean. and straight away his disease went from him.
target_text: ka yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ho g'ag'e ne. aa na peka, ja'a ko'o! èu èle dènge kèna! ropa na padhai lii nare, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge.

source_text: and he gave him orders: say nothing to any man, but let the priest see you and give an offering so that you may be made clean, as the law of moses says, and for a witness to them.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e ne, peka na, baku bhèlu, ee! èu èle le, te ngaa baku peka dènge dhèu èci sa! èu hud'i madhutu uuru ku paredha baki musa. de lamu asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a ne èle tare'a, do dhae. èle èèna na, èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, èu ne èle tare'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: but news of him went out all the more, in every direction, and great numbers of people came together to give hearing to his words and to be made well from their diseases.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai, te ngaa lii lolo nèti koasa na, pale-lème nèti dhèu èci asa èci d'ai mia-mia. ka dhèu mai sèmi tao cèci sa, ho ra nanene na aj'a-nori. hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a ra.

source_text: but he went away by himself to a waste place for prayer.
target_text: te ngaa catèka-catèka, yesus d'èi kahèi patalele iisi, ho la'e manèngi-mangaj'i asa era dhu kaliu.

source_text: and it came about that on one of these days he was teaching; and some pharisees and teachers of the law were seated there, who had come from every town of galilee and judaea and from jerusalem; and the power of the lord was with him, to make those who were ill free from their diseases.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu cue. lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge pèri-pèri mese agama, mai ho nanene lii padhai na. dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae ètu propensi galilea, propensi yudea, dènge kota yerusalem. ama lamatua hia yesus koasa, sèna ka pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: and some men had with them, on a bed, a man who was ill, without power of moving; and they made attempts to get him in and put him before jesus. and because of the mass of people, there was no way to get him in; so they went up on the top of the house and let him down through the roof, on his bed, into the middle in front of jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri ded'e rèti dhèu karuku èci ètu dedha karad'a. rèngu tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka yesus puri-pa'èle ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ne, dhèu sèmi tao cacèci sa, ka rèngu bisa boe pasuki asa d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ra ded'e dhèu ne asa kolo èmu. rare dedha, ka ra bèdi eele rèu èmu, sèna ka tao ro'a, ho dulu dhèu karuku ne dènge karad'a kateme asa haha la'e. ra dulu dhèu ne'e asa talora aae dhèu ae-ae se, lèke mola-mola ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and seeing their faith he said, man, you have forgiveness for your sins.
target_text: ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus ne'a, na, rèngu se parcaya, na, nèngu bisa pa'èle angalai ra nèti karuku na. ka na lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku pamèu le sasala èu.

source_text: and the scribes and pharisees were having an argument, saying, who is this, who has no respect for god? who is able to give forgiveness for sins, but god only?
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka dhèu parisi dènge mese agama sèra, pakarèi, na, eeh! dhoka ama lamatua dhu dènge hak di, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. cee ka nèngu ne, ka na tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua! ne'e ne pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua!

source_text: but jesus, who had knowledge of their thoughts, said to them, why are you reasoning in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a d'ai d'ara rèngu. hèia na peka, nga tao ka miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua?

source_text: which is the simpler: to say, you have forgiveness for your sins; or to say, get up and go? but so that you may see that on earth the son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins, he said to the man who was ill, i say to you, get up, and take up your bed, and go into your house.
target_text: ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a ne dènge hak kahèi, ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe ja'a lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a abho le sasala èu, ' miu mèdhi boe koasa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe nèngu kèd'i dènge ka, na, miu heka mèdhi koasa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ka na piku asa dhèu karuku ne, aa lii, peka na, titu ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and straight away he got up before them, and took up his bed and went away to his house giving praise to god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu ne kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, ka kèpe nare karad'a na. hèia na lèpa ka dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and wonder overcame them all, and they gave glory to god; and they were full of fear, saying, we have seen strange things today.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i se malaa. ka ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, lamatua kapai risi eele! deo ne'e ne, èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi unu ti, tadha malaa dhu kapai!

source_text: and after these things he went out, and saw levi, a tax-farmer, seated at the place where taxes were taken, and said to him, come after me.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe nèdhi dhèu roro bea ca dhèu, dhu madhèdi ètu era roro doi bea. ngara dhèu ne, lewi. ka yesus peka dènge ne, mai ka madhutu ja'a!

source_text: and giving up his business, he got up and went after him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii paroa ne, hèia lewi kèd'i dènge ka, tèke eele aa'i-aa'i sèra, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and levi made a great feast for him in his house: and a great number of tax-farmers and others were seated at table with them.
target_text: èle ka, lewi tao tatao kapai ètu èmu na, ka na nèru yesus. aa na nèru kahèi angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, dènge tamu-tamu dhu leo ho lasi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and the pharisees and their scribes made protests against his disciples, saying, why do you take food and drink with tax-farmers and sinners?
target_text: te ngaa pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge mese-mese agama, ka'uu-kamuki mi ana madhutu yesus, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka miu mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku boe, nuka dhèu roro bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra? dhèu be'a bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa!

source_text: and jesus, answering, said to them, those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge rèngu, peka na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii. te ngaa dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe.

source_text: i have come, not to get the upright, but sinners, so that they may be turned from their sins.
target_text: mamai ja'a ne, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu karehe sèra. te ngaa ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu ngee na, ngi'u ra mola le.

source_text: and they said to him, the disciples of john frequently go without food, and make prayers, and so do the disciples of the pharisees; but your disciples take food and drink.
