target_text: hèia dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge mese-mese agama ka'ugu mi yesus, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, rèngu tema puasa dènge sabaj'a. ana-ana madhutu dhèu parisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka, ana madhutu ama sèra, loe boe dènge ra'a-rinu? rèngu se re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: and jesus said, are you able to make the friends of the newly-married man go without food when he is with them?
target_text: ka na dhaa pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao pesta kab'i, dhèu-dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, bisa boe puasa, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna, dènge rèngu era, tatu rèngu ra'a palere aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but the days will come when he will be taken away from them, and then they will go without food.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu leo rai rèti mone dhu kab'i ne, hèia angalai na susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: and he said to them, in a story, no man takes a bit of cloth from a new coat and puts it on to an old coat, for so the new coat would be damaged and the bit from the new would not go well with the old.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu mèka dhèu dhu rare bèla hiu ca'èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ladhe base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a èèna karuku, na kodho ne asa mae aae.

source_text: and no man puts new wine into old wine-skins, for fear that the skins will be burst by the new wine, and the wine be let out, and the skins come to destruction. but new wine has to be put into new wine-skins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhua dhu heka rèti nèti kapua, dhèu bhori boe asa sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha madhore eele, aa dhua èèna soli soo-soo asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu, hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu. sèmi èèna ka, yesus aj'a si, peka na, lii aj'a na dhu hiu bisa boe pab'ali dènge lii aj'a dhu dhui nèti dhèu parisi.

source_text: and no man, having had old wine, has any desire for new, for he says, the old is better.
target_text: dhèu dhu rinu rèdhi le èi anggor dhui, d'èi boe rinu dhu hiu. te dhu re'a na, ‘èi anggor dhu kee risi nuka èi anggor dhui! '

source_text: now it came about that on the sabbath he was going through the fields of grain, and his disciples took the heads of the grain for food, crushing them in their hands.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, kako re j'ara ètu sebhe oka dhèu. ka ana madhutu na puru are-gandum dhu ètu madha rèngu sèra. hèia ra sarod'e d'ara kacui-aai, ka ra'a.

source_text: but some of the pharisees said, why do you do what it is not right to do on the sabbath?
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus tao sèmi èèna, ka ra kai ne, peka na, tasamia ka ana-ana èu se sisu atora agama èdhi? rèngu sab'a lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a! ladhe ku laa! rèngu puru are-gandum nèi. baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: and jesus said, have you not seen in the writings what david did when he was in need of food, he, and those who were with him; how he went into the house of god and took for food the holy bread, which only the priests may take, and gave it to those who were with him?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia, ee? miu sanèd'e lii lolo baki daud? daud dènge dhèu madhutu na lula manganga ae, ka maso lasi asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia ra'e roti dhu ama agama hia le lamatua. te ngaa roti se'e dhodhoka ama agama di dhu bisa ra'e. dhèu leo bisa boe. ka baki daud si ra'e, te ngaa ca dhèu sa peka boe, na, rèngu sale. miu se, sèmi baca mèdhi boe sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua!

source_text: and he said, the son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
target_text: pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète, na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a.

source_text: and it came about, on another sabbath, that he went into the synagogue and was teaching there. and a man was there whose right hand was dead.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhu leo, yesus la'e aj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci, dhu ai madhe cabèka.

source_text: and the scribes and pharisees were watching him to see if he would make him well on the sabbath, so that they might be able to say something against him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri mese agama, dènge dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. ra tatae, tao-tao na neo puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu j'ara ho galaa ne ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: but he had knowledge of their thoughts; and he said to the man whose hand was dead, get up and come into the middle. and he got up and came forward.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. nèti èèna ka, na paroa dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, aku nèngu na, angalai! mai ku. titu ètu talora aae ne! hèia la'e titu dènge ka ètu talora èèna.

source_text: and jesus said, i put the question to you, is it right to do good on the sabbath or to do evil? to give life or to take it away?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, ja'a karèi ku miu laa. madhutu atora agama èdhi, ngaa dhu èdhi bisa tao ètu lod'o a'ae sasab'a? èdhi tao dhu be'a, do, tao dhu karehe? hia mamuri mi dhèu, do, pa'ele iie mamuri na?

source_text: and looking round on all of them, he said to him, put out your hand. and he did so: and his hand was made well.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe palème rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, peka na, j'ole ai èu mai! ka na soro ai na, hèia èle dènge ka.

source_text: but they were full of wrath, and were talking together about what they might do to jesus.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu kapai se nasa titu kèna. hèia ra peka, na, èdhi tenge hari ku j'ara leo, sèna ka pamanahu ne!

source_text: and it came about in those days that he went out to the mountain for prayer; and he was all night in prayer to god.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, yesus la'e sabaj'a asa ledhe èci. na sabaj'a ètu èèna camèd'a kateme.

source_text: and the day came and, turning to his disciples, he made a selection from among them of twelve, to whom he gave the name of apostles;
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae, yesus paroa ana madhutu na. ka nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, hag'e nare canguru dua dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. dhèu dhu hag'e nare sèra, nuka:

source_text: simon, to whom he gave the name of peter, and andrew, his brother, and james and john and philip and bartholomew
target_text: simon dhu yesus pangare ne, ‘petrus' anderias ari simon, yakobis, yohanis ari yakobis, pelipus, bertolomeos,

source_text: and matthew and thomas and james, the son of alphaeus, and simon, who was named the zealot,
target_text: mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, simon nèti partei politik selot,

source_text: and judas, the son of james, and judas iscariot, he who was false to him.
target_text: yudas ana yakobis, aa yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahia yesus.

source_text: and he came down with them to a level place, and a great band of his disciples, and a very great number of people from all judaea and jerusalem and from the parts of tyre and sidon by the sea, came to give hearing to him, and to be made well from their diseases;
target_text: ropa puru mai nèti ledhe deo na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, ae taha ètu era mera èci. ètu èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu pakaboko. dhèu se mai nèti propensi yudea, nèti kota yerusalem, aa nèti tirus dènge sidon, nuka dua kota ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: and those who were troubled with unclean spirits were made well.
target_text: rèngu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus, aa abhu kahèi dhu neo manèngi sèna ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ka yesus pa'èle si. na pa'èle kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dènge magèle eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: and all the people were desiring to be touched by him, for power came from him and made them all well.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu neo goi ne. te ropa goi lèke ne, dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra, lula abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti nèngu.

source_text: and turning his eyes to his disciples he said, happy are you who are poor: for the kingdom of god is yours.
target_text: èle ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na aj'a si, aku nèngu na, dhèu unu aad'o sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, j'aj'i dhèu aae miu dhu be'a.

source_text: happy are you who are in need of food now: for you will be made full. happy are you who are weeping now; for you will be glad.
target_text: dhèu dhu kabake manganga sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula lamatua ka dhu hia miu bècu-manèsa. dhèu dhu tangi dènge d'ara susa sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na d'ara mi karej'e.

source_text: happy are you, when men have hate for you, and put you away from among them and say angry words to you, turning away in disgust at your name, because of the son of man. be glad in that day, and be lifted up for joy, for your reward in heaven will be great: for their fathers did these same things to the prophets.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ka dhèu dhu abhu susa lula madhutu ja'a, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, do pakarehe kolongara miu, do j'èli marèu miu, do bata eele miu, tao sèmi dhèu bhelu sa, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua bhèlu boe miu ètu sorga. de ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu sèmi èèna, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu! aa karae laa dènge pasoa-pasoka! mage malaa kahèi, lula dhèu dhu paj'èra miu limuri ne, bèi-baki ra dhu uru èèna, paj'èra le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra kahèi. de ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi sèra, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu ae-ae ètu sorga!

source_text: but unhappy are you who have wealth: for you have been comforted now.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula mamuri karej'e miu, dhoka d'ai ne'e di.

source_text: unhappy are you who are full of food now: for you will be in need. unhappy are you who are laughing now: for you will be crying in sorrow.
target_text: dhèu dhu bècu-manèsa! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula hèru manganga madèu dhu seli eele, mai salake nare miu. dhèu dhu kea rae-rae sèra! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula j'aj'èra mai, tao miu tangi ngob'i-ngob'i.

source_text: unhappy are you when all men give you their approval: for so their fathers did to the false prophets.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi dhèu koa-kad'iri! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula uru sèra bèi-baki miu d'èi pad'iri kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu rèti lii leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but i say to you who give ear to me, have love for those who are against you, do good to those who have hate for you,
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! èu hud'i sue ku musu èu, aa tao pabe'a laa mi dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge èu.

source_text: give blessing to those who give you curses, say prayers for those who are cruel to you.
target_text: sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia babe'a mi dhèu dhu dhoo èu. aa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu rupa-rupa.

source_text: if a man gives you a blow on one side of your face, then let the other side be turned to him; from him who takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, soro hari ripi cabèka ho na tèb'e. ladhe dhèu parame rare kodho pana èu, na, hia hari laa kodho èu dhu leo.

source_text: give to everyone who comes with a request, and if a man takes away your property, make no attempt to get it back again.
target_text: ladhe dhèu manèngi mèdha èu èci, hia laa. aa ladhe dhèu ded'e rèti mèdha èu èci, soro tèke sène. mage mu manèngi hari!

source_text: do to others as you would have them do to you.
target_text: èu hud'i tao ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu neo dhèu tao mi ngi'u èu.

source_text: if you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? for even sinners have love for those who have love for them.
target_text: èu d'èi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu èu mesa mu. èèna be'a. te ngaa kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu sue dhèu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is it to you? for even sinners do the same.
target_text: ladhe èu pabe'a dhoka dènge dhèu dhu be'a dènge èu di, kolo-karisi ètu mia? te dhèu bhelu sèra, re'a b'ala babe'a dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and if you let those have the use of your money, from whom you are hoping to get it back, what credit is it to you? even sinners do so to sinners, hoping to get back as much as they gave.
target_text: ladhe èu dhodhoka hia pija mi dhèu dhu bisa pula hari doi èu, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu kahèi re'a hia dhèu leo pija doi, sad'i bèli-camèd'a sèmi aa'i hari dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: but be loving to those who are against you and do them good, and give them your money, not giving up hope, and your reward will be great and you will be the sons of the most high: for he is kind to evil men, and to those who have hard hearts.
target_text: te ngaa dhu lèke ka, sèmi ne'e: sue la musu èu sèra! aa tao la be'a mi rèngu. ngaa dhu ra parluu, hia si pija. baku pangee, na, ra pula hari do aad'o. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na ama lamatua b'ala èu. pe èu j'aj'i ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. lula mamuri èu sama sèmi ama mu, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue j'ara hua iia hia dhèu bhelu. nèngu d'èi kahèi tao j'ara hua iia hia dhèu dhu re'a boe manèngi makasi.

source_text: be full of pity, even as your father is full of pity.
target_text: de èu hud'i pad'elo ku kasia mi dhèu, nuka sèmi ama mu ètu sorga dhu pad'elo kasia na mi èu.

source_text: be not judges of others, and you will not be judged: do not give punishment to others, and you will not get punishment yourselves: make others free, and you will be made free:
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii aj'a na, peka na, baku lee dhèu, sèna ka dhèu baku lee hari èu. baku kahèti leli lii padhai dhèu, te aad'o na dhèu tao hari èu sèmi èèna kahèi. pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku nui sasala èu.

source_text: give, and it will be given to you; good measure, crushed down, full and running over, they will give to you. for in the same measure as you give, it will be given to you again.
target_text: ladhe èu hia dhèu ngaa dhu ra parluu, pe èu abhu hari. te bèli-camèd'a ra hia hari èu pènu ai. èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu isi kab'ui asa d'ara balee a'uku, ka ra karèko ne, aa cèci ne, toke bua lale eele. dhu èu abhu, sama èci èèna ka. ladhe èu hia ciki, èu abhu hari ciki kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èu hia ae, èu abhu hari ae-ae.

source_text: and he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, is it possible for one blind man to be guide to another? will they not go falling together into a hole?
target_text: yesus aj'a pake lii upama kahèi. na lole, peka na, dhèu bèdhu bisa boe pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu bèdhu dhu leo. te aad'o na, dua ra manahu asa d'ara ro'a lasi!

source_text: the disciple is not greater than his master, but everyone whose learning is complete will be like his master.
target_text: ana sakola bisa boe mèu risi nèti mese na! te ngaa ladhe na madhutu dènge be'a lii a'aj'a mese na, nèngu bisa j'aj'i sama sèmi mese na.

source_text: and why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?
target_text: èu pa'èki more sasala dhèu, masi ka ana iiki-iiki èèna ka. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu sèmi pame'a boe sa. èèna, nuka sèmi èu mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu musi madha dhèu. masi ka agarii aae dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, te ngaa èu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa!

source_text: how will you say to your brother, brother, let me take the grain of dust out of your eye, when you yourself do not see the bit of wood in your eye? o false one! first take the wood out of your eye and then you will see clearly to take the dust out of your brother's eye.
target_text: tasamia ka èu bani peka dènge angalai mu, na, ‘mai, ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu. ' te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe ladhe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, te agarii dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu! weeh! èu ne, mema dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! tao eele uru ku agarii nèti d'ara madha èu, heka èu ladhe mèdhi, ho tiu eele ahu ca katèd'a èèna, nèti d'ara madha angalai mu.

source_text: for no good tree gives bad fruit, and no bad tree gives good fruit.
target_text: ka yesus tabha lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu ètu mia, aj'u be'a, ladhe d'ai lod'o hua, hua na karehe. aa abhu boe ladhe aj'u karehe na hua, hua na be'a.

source_text: for every tree is judged by its fruit. men do not get figs from thorns, or grapes from blackberry plants.
target_text: dhèu bisa tadhe ladhe aj'u ca kapua, be'a do aad'o, mai nèti hua na. dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, peka na, ètu mia dhèu puu lolobhangi, do, hua anggor nèti aj'u padhudhu.

source_text: the good man, out of the good store of his heart, gives good things; and the evil man, out of his evil store, gives evil: for out of the full store of the heart come the words of the mouth.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ne'a tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'ara kaj'alu, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a. te nèti lii padhai na, èdhi bisa tadhe babe'a-karehe dhèu.

source_text: why do you say to me, lord, lord, and do not the things which i say?
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, miu se loe boe paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua'. te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a?

source_text: everyone who comes to me and gives ear to my words and does them, i will make clear to you what he is like:
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene lii padhai ja'a, ho na tao madhutu, nèngu ne èci èèna ka

source_text: he is like a man building a house, who went deep and put the base of it on a rock; and when the water came up and the river was driving against that house, it was not moved, because the building was good.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu dhu èra. na kèi ro'a fanderen toke abhu hadhu. hèia na padhèdi fanderen, heka na patitu èmu kèna. ladhe èi aae lala, èmu ne gaged'o boe sa hèi, lula era padhèdi na èra.

source_text: but he who gives hearing, without doing, is like a man building a house on the earth without a base for it; and when the force of the river came against it, straight away it came down; and the destruction of that house was great.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nanene dènge d'ara kajari, aa madhutu boe lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu sad'i j'aj'i di. na tao boe fanderen, te ngaa na patitu èmu na ètu dedha rai ètu sebhe loko. hèia ropa èi aae lala, èmu na guri laho mae-mae!

source_text: after he had come to the end of all his words in the hearing of the people, he went into capernaum.
target_text: ropa aj'a nare, ka yesus lèpa asa kota kapernaum.

source_text: and a certain captain had a servant who was very dear to him; this servant was ill and near to death.
target_text: ca dhèu komedhaa sordad'u roma pea ètu ne'e. abhu dhèu sab'a na èci dhu nèngu parcaya. dhèu sab'a ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: and when news of jesus came to his ears, he sent to him rulers of the jews, requesting that he would come and make his servant well.
target_text: lod'o èèna, komedhaa tadèngi le tatao yesus, hèia na pua dhèu heka yahudi pèri-pèri lasi manèngi yesus mai puri dhèu sab'a ne.

source_text: and they, when they came to jesus, made their request warmly, saying,
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra pamako yesus, sèna ka na la'e palere dènge rèngu. ra manèngi, peka na, dhèu roma ne, dhèu be'a! ama hud'i tolong ne.

source_text: it is right for you to do this for him, because he is a friend to our nation, and himself has put up a synagogue for us.
target_text: te nèngu ka patitu èmu sabaj'a cue hia ji'i, lula na sue èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and jesus went with them. and when he was not far from the house, the man sent friends to him, saying, lord, do not give yourself trouble: for i am not important enough for you to come into my house:
target_text: ka yesus madhutu dènge si. rèngu dhae rare mèka èmu, te ngaa komedhaa ne pua le angalai na la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama roca ia ka mai asa d'ara èmu ja'a, te ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a.

source_text: and i had the feeling that i was not even good enough to come to you: but say the word only, and my servant will be well. for i, myself, am a man under authority, having men under me; and i say to this one, go, and he goes; and to another, come, and he comes; and to my servant, do this, and he does it.
target_text: aa ja'a nia boe kahèi ara dhiu asa katanga madha ama. ja'a ke'a ama dènge koasa. de sad'i ama padhai lii nèti èèna, tatu dhèu sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ja'a ke'a j'ara ne'e ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi ho paredha sordad'u ja'a. ladhe ja'a hia paredha mi sordad'u ja'a, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘mai sa ne'e' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a pua dhèu sab'a ja'a, ‘sab'a ne'e' tatu na sab'a madhutu kahèi. de sad'i ama padhai lii di, dhèu sab'a ja'a ne, èle dènge.

source_text: and when these things were said to jesus, he was surprised, and, turning to the mass of people coming after him, said, i have not seen such great faith, no, not in israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, yesus malaa. ka na kabib'a sa dhèu ae dhu madhutu na sèra, hèia na peka, nia kahèi nga! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a paraga kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and when those who were sent came back to the house they saw that the servant was well.
target_text: de yesus d'ai dhoka era èèna di. hèia angalai komedhaa se lèpa. ropa d'ai èmu komedhaa, ladhe na, dhèu sab'a ne èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and it came about, after a little time, that he went to a town named nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great number of people.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, pakèd'i lasi asa rae èci, ngara na nain. dhèu ae kako palere dènge ne.

source_text: now when he came near the door of the town, a dead man was being taken out, the only son of his mother, who was a widow: and a great number of people from the town were with her.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu dènge hèb'a tedhe maso asa rae ne, ra paraga dènge dhèu ca nau lasi padhane dhèu madhe. dhèu madhe ne, ana mone mesa nèti ca dhèu bhèni balu.

source_text: and when the lord saw her, he had pity on her and said to her, be not sad.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi bhèni balu ne, ka d'ara na roe. hèia na lii dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, ina! tangi ia ka!

source_text: and he came near, and put his hand on the stretcher where the dead man was: and those who were moving it came to a stop. and he said, young man, i say to you, get up.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e padètu-dètu, ka na g'ag'e karad'a dhèu madhe ne. ka dhèu dhu pasae karad'a ne titu taha. hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu madhe, aku nèngu na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and the dead man got up, and words came from his lips. and he gave him to his mother.
target_text: ka ana ne mamuri hari, hèia na kèd'i madhèdi. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae dhu titu reo rare ne. aa yesus peka dènge bhèni balu ne, aku nèngu na, ina! ana mu ka ne'e.

source_text: and fear came on all, and they gave praise to god, saying, a great prophet is among us: and, god has given thought to his people.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra madha'u titu kèna! ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua pua le ca dhèu na dhu kapai risi, dhu nèti lii padhai na hia èdhi! abhu hari dhu leo, peka na, ama lamatua mai le ètu talora aae èdhi, ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na!

source_text: and this story about him went through all judaea and the places round about.
target_text: hèia lii lolo ne, ra palolo d'ai mia-mia ètu propensi yudea dènge era leo kahèi.

source_text: and the disciples of john gave him an account of all these things. then john sent two of his disciples to the lord, saying, are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another? and when the men came to him they said, john the baptist has sent us to you, saying, are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?
target_text: ana madhutu yohanis tadèngi aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu yesus ad'u-ue. ka lasi lole dènge yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. hèia na pua dhèu dua lasi, ho karèi ne, peka na, ama ne tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ji'i mate tae-tae, do? do, ji'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? èle ka ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: at that time, he made a number of people free from their diseases and their pains, and from evil spirits; and to others who were blind he gave back the use of their eyes.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se ètu èèna, yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti papèd'a ra. na bata eele nidhu nèti dhèu. aa na pa'èle dhèu bèdhu, ka rèdhi hari.

source_text: and answering them he said, go back and give news to john of what you have seen, and the things which have come to your ears; the blind now see, those who had no power in their legs are walking, lepers are made clean, those who had no hearing now have their ears open, dead men come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, lèpa ka ho mi peka dènge a'a ku yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi dènge mèdhi unu mi, sèmi dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, ‘dhèu bèdhu rèdhi hari. dhèu karuku, kèd'i ho kako hari. dhèu pèd'a kusta, isi ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, tadèngi hari. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, nanene lii lolo be'a. '

source_text: and a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.
target_text: lami ho peka kahèi dènge a'a ku yohanis, na, ‘dhèu dhu makae boe sèmi rare ja'a, rèngu abhu a'oto. '

source_text: and when the men who were sent by john had gone away, he said to the people, about john, what did you go out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra lula-nèti yohanis, na, lod'o miu lami tenge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a èèna, miu pangee, na, paraga dènge dhèu dhu lalole na sèmi ngaa? tatu miu lami boe ho paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aai-roe èèla, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu lai ngèlu di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a man in soft clothing? see now, those who have beautiful clothing and delicate food are in kings' houses.
target_text: tatu lami boe ho ladhe dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna, era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a prophet? yes, i say to you, and more than a prophet.
target_text: de miu lami tenge dhèu cee ètu nèi? miu pangee na lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, do? tare'a! te nèngu risi nèti ca dhèu nèti padhai lii lamatua.

source_text: this is he of whom it has been said, see, i send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke le, na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: i say to you, among all the sons of women, not one is greater than john: but he who is least in the kingdom of god is greater than he.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis. te ngaa dhèu dhu ana iiki-iiki ètu talora aae dhèu unu ama lamatua, kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and all the people, and the tax-farmers, to whom john had given baptism, when they had knowledge of these things, gave glory to god.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu re'a le, peka na, j'ara lamatua èèna, j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu roro bea sèra. lula rèngu uru èèna abhu sarani aa nanene kahèi lii aj'a-nori nèti yohanis.

source_text: but the pharisees and the teachers of the law were against the purpose of god for themselves, not having had his baptism.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi sèra, ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi boe yohanis sarani si.

source_text: what comparison am i to make of the men of this generation? what are they like?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a pakasame dhèu-dhèu taa limuri se'e dènge ngaa? dhèu sèmi ngaa ka see?

source_text: they are like children who are seated in the market-place, crying out to one another, and saying, we made music for you, but you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow, but you were not sad.
target_text: rèngu se, èci èèna ka dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. ra re'a dhoka pa'oo-parodha dènge ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino, te ngaa miu roge boe dènge karej'e. aa ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for john the baptist came, taking no food or drink, and you say, he has an evil spirit.
target_text: te, yohanis tuka sarani ninu boe èi anggor, aa na d'èi puasa, miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘nèngu ne nidhu tao! '

source_text: the son of man came feasting, and you say, here is a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tema kinu èi anggor dènge ku'a roti. ka miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘dhèu ne, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! aa tema mahu! pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! aa partei èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe! dhu ne'a heka ngi'u na! '

source_text: but wisdom is judged to be right by all her children.
target_text: te ngaa mi patadhe lii ja'a ne! dhèu dhu re'a mèu, tatu rèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and one of the pharisees made a request that he would take a meal with him. and he went into the pharisee's house and took his seat at the table.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota ne, abhu dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na simon. ca lod'o, na nèru yesus si mai ra'a asa èmu nèngu. hèia yesus si lasi madhèdi, ka neo ra'a.

source_text: and there was a woman in the town who was a sinner; and when she had news that he was a guest in the pharisee's house, she took a bottle of perfume,
target_text: lod'o èèna, bhèni kajeo ca dhèu tadèngi kahèi, na, yesus si neo ra'a-rinu ètu èèna. ka na maso la'e, nèd'u dènge èi hèu mèngi ca boto dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and went in and took her place at the back of him, near his feet, weeping, so that his feet were washed with the drops from her eyes, and with her hair she made them dry, and kissing his feet she put the perfume on them.
target_text: na mai padètu dènge yesus re kabodho na. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu haga yesus. na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, toke èi madha na hae lèke haga yesus. ka na seka haga yesus pake rèu kètu na, aa na loe boe uu haga yesus kahèi. èle ka, na pasuti èi hèu mèngi èèna mi haga yesus.

source_text: now when the pharisee in whose house he was saw it, he said to himself, this man, if he was a prophet, would be conscious what sort of woman this is who has put her hands on him, that she is a sinner.
target_text: simon ne'a mèu j'ara mamuri bhèni ne. nèti èèna ka, na pajiko ètu d'ara na, ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha, na, yesus ne, dhèu dhu nèti boe lii padhai ama lamatua! ladhe tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ka dhu pua ne mai, tatu nèngu ne'a, na, bhèni dhu g'ag'e nèngu ne, bhèni kajeo. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, sèmi boe nèngu ne, lula dhèu mola-mèci bisa boe padètu dènge dhèu kaj'alu!

source_text: and jesus, answering, said, simon, i have something to say to you. and he said, master, say on.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu simon ngee. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, simon! sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo peka dènge èu ca j'ara. hèia simon dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama mese, peka laa.

source_text: and he said, two men were in debt to a certain man of business: one had a debt of five hundred pence, and the other of fifty.
target_text: ka yesus core lii, peka na, abhu ca dhèu dhu tema hia dhèu pija doi na. uru èèna, na hia nèdhi dhèu dua pija doi na. dhèu èci, abhu lèmi ngasu doi iia, aa ca dhèu hari lèmi nguru di.

source_text: when they were unable to make payment, he made the two of them free of their debts. which of them, now, will have the greater love for him?
target_text: te ngaa d'ai lod'o pula doi se'e, dua ra bisa boe b'ae rare. ka dhèu dhu hia pija, rasa kasia mi rèngu dua ra. nèti èèna ka, na peka mi dua ra, sèna ka b'ae ia ka kèlu ra sèra. de madhutu èu, nèti dhèu dua se, cee ka dhu sue risi dhèu tema hia dhèu pija doi ne?

source_text: simon, in answer, said, it seems he whose debt was greater. and he said, your decision is right.
target_text: ètu d'ara ciki oo'e na kahèi, simon dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu kèlu na ae risi! ka yesus dhaa, na, mema tare'a!

source_text: and turning to the woman he said to simon, you see this woman? i came into your house; you did not give me water for my feet: but she has been washing my feet with the drops from her eyes, and drying them with her hair.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe bhèni ne, hèia na peka dènge simon, aku nèngu na, èu ladhe sèku bhèni ne. deo na ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu tèke boe èi sèna ka rase haga ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa bhèni ne pabasa haga ja'a dènge èi madha na, ka na seka pake rèu kètu na.

source_text: you did not give me a kiss: but she, from the time when i came in, has gone on kissing my feet.
target_text: aa ropa èu soru ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu uu boe ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa karèi nèti ja'a ètu d'ara èmu èu, bhèni ne loe boe uu haga ja'a.

source_text: you put no oil on my head: but she has put perfume on my feet.
target_text: èu bhèlu eele ad'a dhu palona èi hèu mèngi mi kètu tamu, ropa ja'a mai deo na. te ngaa bhèni ne bhori le èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna mi haga ja'a.

source_text: and so i say to you, she will have forgiveness for her sins which are great in number, because of her great love: but he who has small need of forgiveness gives little love.
target_text: èu nanene paie! sasala bhèni ne, mema ae. te ngaa lamatua saku eele aa'i le, lula na pad'elo le sasue na dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ja'a. te ngaa bagi dhèu dhu rasa na tao boe sasala ae, nèngu ngee na parluu boe abhu abho ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, nèngu ne'a boe sue aa ne'a boe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and he said to her, you have forgiveness for your sins.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge bhèni ne, peka na, ja'a saku eele le sasala èu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: and those who were seated at table with him said to themselves, who is this who even gives forgiveness of sins?
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ra'a palere-lere, paka'uu, aku rèngu na, huuh! na ngee na, nèngu ne cee? ! na bani titu kèna saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! j'ara ne'e ne dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa na, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu!

source_text: and he said to the woman, by your faith you have salvation; go in peace.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu lèka le ja'a, nèti èèna ka lamatua hia le èu mamuri. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: and it came about, after a short time, that he went through town and country giving the good news of the kingdom of god, and with him were the twelve,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae ètu sèra. la'e lolo dènge dhèu dad'èi ama lamatua. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and certain women who had been made free from evil spirits and diseases, mary named magdalene, from whom seven evil spirits had gone out,
target_text: ètu d'ara kaboko rèngu, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu. bhèni se dhu uru èèna abhu rupa-rupa papèd'a, aa cahag'e dhu nidhu tao. te ngaa yesus ka dhu puri-pa'èle aa'i si. nuka sèmi maria nèti rae magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus bata eele pidhu nidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: and joanna, the wife of chuza, herod's chief house-servant, and susanna and a number of others, who gave him of their wealth for his needs.
target_text: abhu kahèi susana, dènge mama yohana. yohana ne, dhèu èmu kusa. kusa ne, kapala urusan nèti èmu dhèu aae herodes. aa abhu ae kahèi bhèni leo dhu lasi palere-lere dènge yesus si. bhèni se pake doi-dhari rèngu mesa ra ho ogo yesus si ètu j'ara.

source_text: and when a great number of people came together, and men from every town went out to him, he gave them teaching in the form of a story:
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu mai nèti rae-rae ho tenge yesus. ropa dhèu ae se pakaboko, hèia na lolo dènge ra pake lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: a man went out to put in seed, and while he was doing it, some was dropped by the wayside and it was crushed under foot, and was taken by the birds of heaven.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu la'e ceb'e hini asa d'ara oka na. hini se cahag'e lèke ètu j'ara. ropa dhèu kako re èèna, j'èli lèke hini se. aa manu-bhui mai ka tutu ra'e aa'i.

source_text: and some went on the rock, and when it came up it became dry and dead because it had no water.
target_text: hini cahag'e, lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini se muri, te ngaa nèbhu boe hèia kamale dhae-dhae, lula èi kura.

source_text: and some went among thorns, and the thorns came up with it and it had no room for growth.
target_text: hini cahag'e hari lèke ètu era aj'u padhudhu. te ngaa ropa hini muri, aj'u padhudhu hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: and some falling on good earth, came up and gave fruit a hundred times as much. and with these words he said in a loud voice, he who has ears, let him give ear.
target_text: aa hini dhu leo lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini se muri dènge sega, toke kapai ka hua. hua ae titu kèna, d'ai cangasu hari. lolo èle ka, yesus pa'èle lii pakasame ne, dènge lii dhu mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu dhu pasa dhilu, na, ngee paie-iie!

source_text: and his disciples put questions to him about the point of the story.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he said, to you is given knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of god; but to the others, they are given in stories, so that seeing, they may not see, and though they give hearing, the sense will not be clear to them.
target_text: na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! lula miu se d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka paled'a, ho miu me'a tasamia lamatua neo paredha dhèu unu na. te ngaa dhèu leo ro'o boe pare'a dènge dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a-nori si pake lii pakasame di. te dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘rèngu se rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi. '

source_text: now this is the point of the story: the seed is the word of god.
target_text: hèia yesus peka sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne, aku nèngu na, hini se, nuka lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: those by the side of the road are those who have given hearing; then the evil one comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not have faith and get salvation.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare nèti d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu parcaya boe lamatua, aa abhu boe mamuri.

source_text: and those on the rock are those who with joy give hearing to the word; but having no root, they have faith for a time, and when the test comes they give up.
target_text: hini dhu lèke dedha hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge d'ara karej'e. te ngaa amo na marèma boe. rèngu parcaya, te ngaa ropa paraga dènge j'aj'èra, rèngu manahu.

source_text: and those which went among thorns are those who have given hearing, and go on their way, but they are overcome by cares and wealth and the pleasures of life, and they give no fruit.
target_text: hini dhu lèke era aj'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu tadèngi, ka ra sèmi rare lii lolo be'a. te ngaa nare nèbhu boe, ka rèngu bhèlu eele lii lolo be'a, lula rèngu bhute dènge laladhe sasab'a-la'a rèngu, mèdha-panyau rèngu, aa dènge neo mamuri karej'e di. nèti èèna ka, parcaya rèngu dènge boe kab'ua ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and those in the good earth are those who, having given ear to the word, keep it with a good and true heart, and in quiet strength give fruit.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka dhèu dhu mamuri mola dènge d'ara hua iia. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, rèngu sèle asa d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu parcaya taa-taa, aa ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: no man, when the light is lighted, puts a cover over it, or puts it under a bed, but he puts it on its table, so that those who come in may see the light.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, abhu ètu mia, dhèu paheo rare labhu iiki, ho èèna na saguru dènge èru rai. aa abhu ètu mia, dhèu tao labhu ètu ro'a koi. te ladhe tao sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe rèdhi heo na. labhu dhu guna, nuka padhèdi ètu era dedha, sèna ka heo na bisa pasaraa dhèu dhu maso mai.

source_text: for nothing is put out of view which will not be made clear, and nothing is secret of which the knowledge will not come to light.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a pasabhoka. aa madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu dhèu re'a boe limuri ne, èèna na dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: so take care how you give hearing, for to him who has will be given, and from him who has not will be taken even what he seems to have.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee paie-iie ku j'ara se'e. dhèu dhu neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa rèngu dhu pusi pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, rèngu asa goa.

source_text: and his mother and his brothers came to him, and they were not able to get near him because of the great number of people.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus bhute dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na mai neo paraga dènge ne. te ngaa ra bisa boe lasi padètu, lula dhèu se, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and someone said to him, your mother and your brothers are outside desiring to see you.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ina dènge ari ama, ètu li'u sèi. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: but he said to them in answer, my mother and my brothers are those who have knowledge of the word of god and do it.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! te ngaa sèmi ne'e. ina dènge a'ari ja'a, nuka rèngu dhu tare'a-re'a d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu.

source_text: now it came about on one of those days that he got into a boat with his disciples; and he said to them, let us go over to the other side of the water: and they put out the boat.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus gale dhèu pajuu-paleha na, aku nèngu na, mai lati ka asa cabèka dano. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia pakèd'i lasi.

source_text: but while they were sailing he went to sleep: and a storm of wind came down on the sea, and the boat became full of water and they were in danger.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano, yesus bhèj'i. nèbhu boe cag'ag'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha tèb'e koha, hèia èi maso sa d'ara, ka oe molo.

source_text: then they came to him and, awaking him out of his sleep, said, master, master, destruction is near. and he, when he was awake, gave orders to the wind and the rolling waves, and the storm came to an end, and all was calm.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se parèi ne, peka na, ama! ama! kèd'i ho tolong ku laa! te èdhi madhe aa'i kèna! ka yesus kèd'i. hèia na kai ngèlu dènge naha, peka na, mau ka! kaca'a laa, ngèlu dènge naha mau dènge ka.

source_text: and he said to them, where is your faith? and fear and wonder overcame them, and they said to one another, who then is this, who gives orders even to the winds and the water and they do what he says?
target_text: hèia na pasanèd'e ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu parcaya mèka ja'a? rèngu madha'u dènge malaa, ka ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, cee ka yesus ne? tasamia ka nèngu bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka ra madhutu dad'èi na?

source_text: and they came to the country of the gerasenes, which is opposite galilee.
target_text: nèbhu boe rèngu d'ai rai garasa, ètu sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and when he had come to the land, there came to him a certain man from the town who had evil spirits; and for a long time he had had no clothing on, and was not living in a house but in the place of the dead. and when he saw jesus, he gave a loud cry and went down on the earth before him and in a loud voice said, what have i to do with you, jesus, son of the most high god? do not be cruel to me. for he gave an order to the evil spirit to come out of the man. for frequently it would take a grip of him: and he was kept under control, and prisoned with chains; but parting the chains in two, he would be sent by the driving of the evil spirit into waste places.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu èci dhu nèbhu ae le, nidhu ae pahuj'u ne. dhèu ne dènge boe èmu, ka na pea ètu era ro'a dhèu madhe. bèli-bèli èèna kako la'e-mai, dhu pake boe mèdha-papake. te nidhu sèra loe boe paredha ne. dhèu dhu èki le pèri-pèri hari dènge rate aa pakanau ne dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na lèku èta si. ka nidhu se laka-seti ne ho la'e asa era dhu kaliu. ropa yesus si puru nèti dedha koha, ka dhèu huj'u ne mai asa yesus. hèia na pa'oo-parodha. ka na pabèbhe iisi, aa na patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga yesus. hèia yesus paredha nidhu sèra, aku nèngu na, ee, nidhu! rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e! hèia dhèu huj'u ne pa'oo, peka na, baku gagu ja'a! te ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele! èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and jesus said to him, what is your name? and he said, legion; for a number of spirits had gone into him.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? hèia nidhu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, legion, te ji'i se ae, sèmi sordad'u riho-riho. na lii sèmi èèna, lula nidhu se ae-ae dhu maso ètu d'ara ngi'u dhèu èèna.

source_text: and they made a request to him that he would not give them an order to go away into the deep.
target_text: nidhu se loe boe pamako yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu lasi asa d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra, nuka era taha koasa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: now there was a great herd of pigs in that place, getting food on the mountain: and the evil spirits made a request to him that he would let them go into the pigs, and he let them.
target_text: te ngaa dhu padètu ètu èèna, hahi canau kateme dhu nyuu rai ètu sebhe ledhe. ka nidhu se manèngi yesus, peka na, pua la ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèi! hèia yesus d'èi kahèi.

source_text: and the evil spirits came out of the man and went into the pigs: and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the water and came to destruction.
target_text: ka nidhu se kalua ka nèti d'ara dhèu mone ne, lasi maso asa hahi. hahi se aa'i-aa'i ra huj'u, ka ra rai paj'ala puru nèti sebhe ledhe ne, hèia caroco asa d'ara dano. aa cène, ka madhe aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and when the men who took care of them saw what had come about, they went quickly and gave news of it in the town and the country.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenge hahi se, rai lasi palème rae-rae ètu sèra, lolo aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: and they went out to see what had taken place, and they came to jesus and saw the man out of whom the evil spirits had gone, seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, at the feet of jesus; and fear came on them.
target_text: ropa dhèu ètu rae se tadèngi lii lolo se, ka lasi ae-ae sèna ka neo rèdhi unu ra tatao dhu j'aj'i le. d'ai era èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi mau-mau padètu ètu haga yesus. nèngu pake le mèdha-papake, aa na huj'u heka. ladhe rèdhi sèmi ne'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i madha'u.

source_text: and those who had seen it gave them an account of how the man who had the evil spirits was made well.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, ra palolo dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu heka mai sèra, tasamia ka dhèu huj'u ne èle nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and all the people of the country of the gerasenes made a request to him to go away from them; for they were in great fear: and he got into a boat and went back.
target_text: ka dhèu garasa aa'i-aa'i ra manèngi yesus ho tèke eele rai rèngu, te rèngu madha'u titu kèna. hèia yesus si ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, sèna ka lèpa hari asa cabèka dano galilea.

source_text: but the man from whom the evil spirits had gone out had a great desire to be with him, but he sent him away, saying,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu deo na dhu nidhu tao, loe boe pamako yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! hud'i laa ja'a madhutu ama kahèi! te ngaa yesus dhaa ne, peka na,

source_text: go back to your house and let them have news of all the great things which god has done for you. and he went away, giving word through all the town of the great things which jesus had done for him.
target_text: sèmi ne'e ku laa! be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa a'ari èu. lamu lolo aa'i dènge ra, na, ama lamatua tao le j'ara dhu be'a hia èu. hèia dhèu ne kako palème d'ara kota ne, na palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, yesus ka dhu pa'èle nèngu.

source_text: and when jesus went back, the people were glad to see him, for they were all waiting for him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano galilea. lod'o rèngu puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae dhu mate mema le yesus. dhèu se mai ae-ae ho soru ne.

source_text: then there came a man named jairus, who was a ruler in the synagogue: and he went down at the feet of jesus, desiring him to come to his house; for he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was near to death. but while he was on his way, the people were pushing to be near him.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu ca dhèu, ngara na yairus. nèngu kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. ana na dhoka ca dhèu di; ana bhèni, umur na canguru dua tèu. ana bhèni ne dhu pèd'a aae, oe madhe. ropa yairus nèdhi yesus mai, hèia la'e patitu kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus. na manèngi ho yesus dhuli èmu na, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ana na. dhaa nare ka, yesus madhutu dènge ne asa èmu na. aa dhèu ae madhutu rèngu. ka rèngu paseti èci dènge èci.

source_text: and a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years, and had given all her money to medical men, and not one of them was able to make her well,
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kako dènge rèngu. bhèni ne dhu lèke papèd'a dhèu bhèni dhu loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna. doi-dhari dènge mèdha-panyau na èle aa'i le, ho b'ae dote-matarii. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa puri-pa'èle ne. papèd'a na asa na hoe.

source_text: came after him and put her hand on the edge of his robe, and straight away the flowing of her blood was stopped.
target_text: ka na ara padètu-dètu asa yesus nèti kabodho. hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus. ropa na gai lèke kodho yesus ne, hèia papèd'a na èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus said, who was touching me? and when they all said, it is not i, peter and those who were with him said, master, the people are pushing round you on every side.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, yesus titu taha. hèia na karèi, peka na, cee ka dhu goi lèke ja'a? te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mangaku. ka petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! dhèu ae-ae ka dhu tao paseti aa patule-pajuku nèti kabodho. sèmi ne'e ne, te'a na cee ka dhu goi lèke ama!

source_text: but jesus said, someone was touching me, for i had the feeling that power had gone out from me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, aad'o! deo na ja'a rasa abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti ngi'u ja'a. de ja'a ke'a, na, ca dhèu dhu sangaja gai ja'a.

source_text: and when the woman saw that she was not able to keep it secret, she came, shaking with fear, and falling down before him she made clear before all the people the reason for her touching him, and how she was made well straight away.
target_text: ropa bhèni ne ne'a, na, nèngu bisa boe pasili, hèia na madha'u titu kèna. isi na rèbha-rèbha, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na lolo mi dhèu ae sèra, nga tao ka nèngu gai yesus. aa na lolo kahèi, na, ropa nèngu gai lèke yesus, nèngu èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and he said to her, daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, ana hèni! èu èle nèti papèd'a, lula èu parcaya ja'a. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: while he was still talking, someone came from the house of the ruler of the synagogue, saying, your daughter is dead; do not go on troubling the master.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge bhèni ne, ca dhèu nèti yairus mai peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ana ama aad'o heka. na madhe le, de paj'èra ia ka ama mese.

source_text: but jesus at these words said to him, have no fear, only have faith, and she will be made well.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii peka dhèu èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge yairus, mau-mau! baku madha'u! parcaya mi ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia mamuri mi ana èu.

source_text: and when he came to the house he did not let any man go in with him, but only peter and john and james, and the father of the girl and her mother. and all the people were weeping and crying for her; but he said, do not be sad, for she is not dead, but sleeping. and they were laughing at him, being certain that she was dead.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai èmu yairus, dhèu ae le. ra tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ae eele ka tangi laa! ana ne madhe boe. dhoka na bhèj'i di! te ngaa dhèu se pahae boe, ra mari pakapengo hèb'a, te rèngu rèdhi unu ra ana ne ma'ète a'ae. hèia yesus manèngi sèna ka ina-ama nèti ana bhèni ne, petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis maso lasi palere-lere dènge ne. dhèu leo sèra, na hia si mate ètu li'u.

source_text: but he, taking her hand, said to her, my child, get up.
target_text: rare d'ara, ka yesus kèpe ai ana ne, hèia na paroa peka na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and her spirit came back to her and she got up straight away: and he gave orders that food was to be given to her.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana ne mamuri hari, ka na kèd'i titu. hèia yesus lii dènge ina ana bhèni ne, na, hia ana ne na'a!

source_text: and her father and mother were full of wonder, but he gave orders to them to say nothing about it to anyone.
target_text: ina-ama ana ne malaa-maloha. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, baku palolo dènge dhèu, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: and getting the twelve together, he gave them power and authority over all evil spirits and over diseases, to make them well.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus pakaboko nare ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra. ka na hia si koasa, ho babège eele nidhu, aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a.

source_text: and he sent them out to be preachers of the kingdom of god, and to make well those who were ill.
target_text: na pua si lasi lole j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua, aa puri-pa'èle papèd'a dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and he said to them, take nothing for your journey, no stick or bag or bread or money, and do not take two coats.
target_text: te ngaa na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie-iie! baku mèti kahèi ngaa-ngaa ètu j'ara. kako dhoka dènge kodho ètu ua di. baku mèti kodho silu. baku mèti kahèi tatea, tas, gee j'ara, do doi-dhari!

source_text: and if you go into a house, let that house be your resting-place till you go away.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka d'ara rae èci, abhu dhèu dhu soru miu, na lami pea dènge ne. mage mi hag'e-hag'e èmu kahèi. pea taruu ètu d'ara èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i, tèke eele rae èèna.

source_text: and if any people will not take you in, when you go away from that town, put off its dust from your feet for a witness against them.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, hèia dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra ro'o boe sèmi miu, aa ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, na, pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. lod'o miu tèke eele rae èèna, tao madhutu ad'a ho caro eele ahu nèti haga miu. aa mi peka dènge ra, ‘miu se ladhe mo'o boe nanene lii ji'i, pe miu sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and they went away, journeying through all the towns, preaching the good news and making people free from diseases in all places.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu se lasi ka asa rae-rae. ra lole dènge dhèu-dhèu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. aa puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a ètu mia-mia.

source_text: now herod the king had news of all these things: and he was in doubt, because it was said by some people that john had come back from the dead;
target_text: ca tèka, rupa-rupa lii lolo lula-nèti yesus ne d'ai le dhèu aae herodes antipas. ropa na tadèngi lii lolo se, hèia na bingu, lula dhèu cahag'e peka na, yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu mamuri hari le.

source_text: and by some, that elijah had come; and by others, that one of the old prophets had come back to life.
target_text: aa cahag'e hari peka na, nèngu ne, baki elia dhu mamuri hari. abhu dhu leo hari, peka na, nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu uru-uru sèra.

source_text: and herod said, i put john to death: but who is this, of whom such stories are given to me? and he had a desire to see him.
target_text: te ngaa herodes sanèd'e era, peka na, ca hari ni, ja'a pua le poro pama'ète kètu yohanis. de na mamuri hari, do? aa ca dhèu ne, cee hari? ka na tenge j'ara, sèna ka patoo madha dènge yesus.

source_text: and the twelve, when they came back, gave him an account of what they had done. and he took them with him and went away from the people to a town named beth-saida.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu dhu yesus pua sèra, lèpa mai pa'èci hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge ne aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu tao. ka yesus si kako mesa-mesa ra asa era èci, dhu padètu dènge rae betsaida, ho ra ae ètu èèna.

source_text: but the people, getting news of it, went after him: and he was pleased to see them, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of god, and made those well who were in need of it.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu re'a rare, na, yesus si neo lasi sa mia, ka ra paki'u re limuri. yesus sèmi si, hèia na pa'èle dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i, aa na peka-padhai dènge ra, j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua nèd'u paredha.

source_text: and the day went on; and the twelve came to him and said, send these people away so that they may go into the towns and the country round about and get resting-places and food for themselves, for we are in a waste place.
target_text: ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, ka canguru dua ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka dènge ne, be'a risi ama pua dhèu se'e lasi asa rae-rae dhu padètu dènge era ne'e, sèna ka ra tenge nganga'a unu ra. aa hud'i laa ra lasi tenge era ho j'unu taha. te era dhu kaj'èu nèti rae sèmi ne'e, tasamia ka rèngu bisa abhu ra'a-rinu?

source_text: but he said, give them food yourselves. and they said, we have only five cakes of bread and two fishes, if we do not go and get food for all these people. for there were about five thousand men. and he said to his disciples, make them be seated in groups, about fifty to a group.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, sèmi ne'e! miu ka dhu panga'a si! hèia ana madhutu se dhaa, peka na, ira ii! ama, ee! tasamia bisa sèmi èèna? dhèu se risi nèti lèmi riho dhèu! èèna dhèu mone di, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana niki! ètu d'ara adhe-aai ji'i, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di. ladhe ama neo sèna ka ji'i panga'e dhèu se'e, tasa mera mia ho ji'i hèli nganga'a ae-ae hia ra? ! ka yesus dhaa, pakaboko si madhèdi lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru dhèu, ca kaboko.

source_text: and they did so, and made them all be seated.
target_text: hèia lasi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: and he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing over them, and when they had been broken, he gave them to the disciples to give to the people.
target_text: ropa dhèu se madhèdi, ka yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. ka na tangara sa dedha, ho na manèngi makasi. èle ka yesus pamae roti dènge i'a sèra. hèia na j'ole sa ana-ana madhutu na, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu sèra.

source_text: and they all took the food and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits which were over, twelve baskets full.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a toke bècu. ka nganga'a dhu risi sèra, kaboko rare pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and it came about that when he was in prayer, by himself, and the disciples were with him, he put a question to them, saying, who do the people say i am?
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e mesa na ho sabaj'a ètu era èci. hèia ana madhutu na mai ka pa'èci dènge ne. sabaj'a nare, ka yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu tadèngi-tadèngi dhèu palolo na ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they, answering, said, john the baptist; but others say elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets has come back.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, cahag'e peka na, yohanis tuka sarani. aa cahag'e peka na, baki elia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra dhu mamuri hari.

source_text: and he said, but who do you say that i am? and peter, answering, said, the christ of god.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari si, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, ja'a ne, cee? ka petrus dhaa, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: but he gave them special orders, not to say this to any man;
target_text: èle ka yesus kai si, sèna ka baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa, peka na, nèngu na, kristus.

source_text: saying, the son of man will undergo much and be put on one side by the rulers and the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and be put to death, and on the third day he will come back to life.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i pasae ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra dhu bia. bèli-camèd'a dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra, ro'o boe sèmi, ladhe peka, na, ja'a ne kristus. aa èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a. mema tare'a-re'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari!

source_text: and he said to them all, if any man has a desire to come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross every day, and come after me.
target_text: èle ka na peka dènge dhèu ae se, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu dènge d'ara kateme ètu lod'o bèli-lod'o bèli. nèngu hud'i core eele ku dad'èi d'ara na. nèngu hud'i madhutu taruu, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whoever has a desire to keep his life will have it taken from him, but whoever gives up his life because of me, will keep it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu unu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pakaj'èu-j'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: for what profit will a man have if he gets all the world, but undergoes loss or destruction himself?
target_text: ladhe dhèu unu aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua tule eele ne, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for if any man has a feeling of shame because of me or of my words, the son of man will have shame because of him when he comes in his glory and the glory of the father and of the holy angels.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. de dhèu dhu makae madhutu ja'a, aa makae sèmi lii aj'a ja'a, ja'a kahèi makae mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua, lod'o ja'a lèpa mai nèti sorga. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana-ana pajuu na nèti sorga.

source_text: but truly i say to you, some of those who are here now will have no taste of death till they see the kingdom of god.
target_text: ja'a peka patare'a dènge miu. abhu pèri-pèri nèti miu ètu se'e se, bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi unu ra lamatua nèd'u paredha, heka ra madhe kèna.

source_text: and about eight days after he had said these things, he took peter and john and james with him and went up into the mountain for prayer.
target_text: èle aru lod'o, ka yesus nèti petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis, lasi ca'e asa ledhe èci, ho neo sabaj'a.

source_text: and while he was in prayer, his face was changed and his clothing became white and shining.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a era, rèhu na j'aj'i leko-leo, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: and two men, moses and elijah, were talking with him;
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu dua cèu mai. dhèu se, nuka baki musa dènge baki elia. ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: who were seen in glory and were talking of his death which was about to take place in jerusalem.
target_text: dua ra ladhe na le'e-le'e hèti-hèti. tèlu ra padhue-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe yesus bèli-camèd'a ètu yerusalem.

source_text: now peter and those who were with him were overcome with sleep: but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men who were with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus dènge angalai na dhèu dua sèra musi madha sakaa titu kèna, ka ra bhèj'i luu. ropa ra kabèdhi, hèia rèdhi yesus titu dènge dhèu dua. aa rèdhi yesus dhu kaha'a kahèi.

source_text: and when they were about to go away from him, peter said to jesus, master, it is good for us to be here; let us make three tents, one for you and one for moses and one for elijah: having no knowledge of what he was saying.
target_text: ropa musa dènge elia neo lèpa, petrus bingu, ne'a heka tao tasamia. ka na padhai lii leli, na peka na, ama! ji'i ètu ne'e, be'a d'ai seli! de hua iia ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia baki musa, aa cue hari hia baki elia.

source_text: and while he said these things, the shade of a cloud came over them, and they were full of fear when they went into the cloud.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus padhai lii era, ra'i-liru puru mai, ka saguru rare rèngu. hèia petrus si madha'u bia.

source_text: and there was a voice from the cloud saying, this is my son, the man of my selection; give ear to him.
target_text: ka ra tadèngi lii nèti d'ara ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, ne'e ne, ana ja'a dhu ja'a hag'e kore le! ladhe na padhai lii, nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and after the voice was gone they saw that jesus was by himself. and they kept quiet, and said nothing at that time to anyone of the things which they had seen.
target_text: ropa lii na èle, petrus si ladhe rèdhi dhoka yesus mesa-mesa na. rèngu tèlu ra, peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa, ngaa dhu rèngu rèdhi le. d'ai nèbhu ku, heka ra palolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and on the day after, when they came down from the mountain, a great band of people came to him.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lod'o yesus dènge petrus si puru mai nèti ledhe, dhèu ae mai paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and a man from among them, crying out, said, master, i make a request to you, give a thought to my son, for he is my only child:
target_text: ka dhèu èci rodhe ne, peka na, ama mese! ladhe ku ana mone ja'a ca dhèu ne laa!

source_text: and see, a spirit takes him, and suddenly he gives a cry, twisted in pain and streaming at the lips, and when it goes away from him at last, he is marked as from blows.
target_text: te abhu nidhu dhu loe boe kèpe ne, ka na pakèce sahèka, aa nyanyoko ne, toke hèb'a na horo karaka. nidhu ne loe boe dhadhedhe ana ne, aa d'èi boe hia ana ne ae nare ciki sa.

source_text: and i made a request to your disciples to send it out of him, but they were not able to do it.
target_text: ja'a manèngi le kahèi ana madhutu ama se ho ra babège eele nidhu ne, te ngaa tao rare boe!

source_text: and jesus said, o generation without faith and false in heart, how long will i have to be with you and put up with you? let your son come here.
target_text: ka yesus jèke si, peka na, eeh! miu se parcaya boe, na, lamatua bisa pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a ra. miu mema dhèu dhu me'a boe mamuri madhutu j'ara mola! de ja'a hud'i tatae hari miu toke pèri lod'o? hèia na peka dènge ama ana ne, mèti ana mu sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and while he was coming, he was pushed violently down and twisted by the evil spirit. but jesus gave sharp orders to the unclean spirit, and made the boy well, and gave him back to his father.
target_text: ropa pakako rèti ana ne asa yesus, hèia nidhu hake pabèbhe, aa rarumu ne. te ngaa yesus paredha nidhu ho kalua tèke eele ana ne, hèia na èle dènge. ka yesus hia ana ne asa ama na la'e.

source_text: and they were full of wonder at the great power of god. but while they were all wondering at all the things which he did, he said to his disciples,
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra dhu ladhe rèdhi koasa yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. ropa dhèu se padhue era tadha malaa dhu yesus tao, nèngu lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: let these words go deep into your ears, for the son of man will be given up into the hands of men.
target_text: miu patadhe paie lii padhai ja'a ne! nèbhu boe dhèu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu leo.

source_text: but this saying was not clear to them and its sense was kept secret from them so that they were not able to see it: and they had fear of questioning him about it.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na se bingu. masi ka rèngu dhane rare boe sasoa na, te ngaa ra madha'u karèi ne, sasoa na ngaa.

source_text: now there was a discussion among them about which of them would be the greatest.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu yesus pasisu lula-nèti rèngu se, cee ka dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu re madha.

source_text: but when jesus saw the reasoning of their hearts, he took a small child and put him by his side,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu rèngu pasisu. ka na paroa nare ana iiki ca dhèu, hèia na patitu ètu karasa na.

source_text: and said to them, whoever gives honour to this child in my name, gives honour to me: and whoever gives honour to me, gives honour to him who sent me: for whoever is least among you all, that man is great.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, nanene paie! dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na ladhe-leru dhèu haha, dhu sama sèmi ana iiki ne, sasoa na nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi. aa na ladhe-leru kahèi ama ku ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu dhèu ae dhu pusi-pahae boe dhèu sèmi se'e se. dhèu se'e, nuka: dhu unu aad'o, dhu susa, dhu laku-laku boe, dhu kalua aapa, aa dènge dhèu haha. de dhèu dhu d'èi lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi se'e se, madhutu ama lamatua, nèngu ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: and john, answering, said, master, we saw a man driving out evil spirits in your name, and we did not let him do it, because he was not one of us.
target_text: hèia yohanis peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! ca lod'o ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu babège eele nidhu, dènge ale kolongara ama. ka ji'i kai ne, sèna ka na ale ia ka ngara ama, lula nèngu ne dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: but jesus said to him, let him do it, for he who is not against you is for you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, baku! te dhèu dhu lab'a boe èdhi, nèngu èèna angalai èdhi.

source_text: and it came about that when the days were near for him to be taken up, his face was turned to go to jerusalem,
target_text: yesus ne'a le lod'o na ca'e asa sorga dètu le. ka na pama'ète nare, ho la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and he sent men before: and they came to a small town of samaria to make ready for him.
target_text: na pua dhèu lasi uuru, sèna ka ra lalau nganga'a-nganginu. ka dhèu lasi uuru se, maso lasi asa d'ara rae cue ètu propensi samaria, ho lalau mema era rèngu manubha.

source_text: but they would not have him there, because he was clearly going to jerusalem.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ètu samaria se, ro'o boe sèmi rare yesus si, lula nèngu neo la'e sogo-tagu ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and when his disciples, james and john, saw this, they said, lord, may we send fire from heaven and put an end to them?
target_text: ropa yakobis dènge yohanis tadèngi lii ne'e, ka ra pamako yesus, aku rèngu na, ama! tasamia na ti manèngi ama lamatua papuru ai mai nèti dedha-liru, ho tunu pakèpu si?

source_text: but turning round he said sharp words to them.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe asa dua ra, hèia na kai si, peka na, baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they went to another small town.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lasi hari asa rae leo.

source_text: and when they were on the way, a certain man said to him, i will come after you wherever you go.
target_text: ropa rèngu kako era, dhèu èci lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama! ama neo asa mia èèna ka, ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu!

source_text: and jesus said to him, foxes have holes and the birds of the air have resting-places, but the son of man has nowhere to put his head.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa pangee ku laa. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dènge era pea-palu'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge badha-manu. busa hui lèpa la'e asa d'ara ro'a na. manu-bhui lasi asa d'ara rèd'a ra. te ngaa ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, dènge boe era pea-palu'u ho pasoru iisi ja'a ne. era lalaka kètu, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and he said to another, come after me. but he said, lord, let me first go and give the last honours to my father.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ca dhèu, ka na peka, mai madhutu ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi, do! te ngaa sèmi ne'e, ama. hud'i ja'a lèpa ku ladhe-leru ina-ama ja'a. ladhe padhane kore ama ku, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: but he said to him, let the dead take care of their dead; it is for you to go and give news of the kingdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, uri dhèu rèngu dhu madhe. te ngaa miu dhu lèka lamatua, sasab'a miu lami peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and another man said, i will come with you, lord, but first let me say a last good-day to those who are at my house.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo dhu peka na, be'a kahèi. ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu. te ngaa hud'i ja'a laku palangu ku lii dènge a'ari ja'a, heka ja'a mai madhutu ama.

source_text: but jesus said, no man, having put his hand to the plough and looking back, is good enough for the kingdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. ladhe dhèu neo pare rai, te ngaa tao hari ngaa-ngaa dhu leo, toke bhèlu sèle, tatu oka na j'aj'i boe. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu pama'ète nare le neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa pangee taruu mamuri na lod'o dhu uru sèra. dhèu sèmi èèna gaguna na aad'o j'aj'i dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: now after these things, the lord made selection of seventy others and sent them before him, two together, into every town and place where he himself was about to come.
target_text: èle èèna, yesus hag'e nare ana madhutu na dhu leo, pidhu nguru dua dhèu. ka na hag'e si, dua-dua dhèu, sèna ka lasi uuru asa era-era dhu nèngu neo la'e.

source_text: and he said to them, there is much grain ready to be cut, but not enough workers: so make prayer to the lord of the grain-fields that he will send workers to get in the grain.
target_text: hèia na pua si, aku nèngu na, abhu dhèu ae dhu nuka sèmi are dhu karara le. ka lamatua oka pua dhèu sab'a na lasi g'ètu are se. de miu hud'i sabaj'a, sèna ka ama lamatua hia tabha dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ho oru rare dhèu-dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. lula dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, ae. te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: go on your way: see, i send you out like lambs among wolves.
target_text: de lami ka! ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu ae. te ngaa sanèd'e sèmi ne'e. miu èci èèna ka dènge ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu lami asa talora aae busa hui dhu bhelu.

source_text: take no bag for money or for food, and no shoes; say no word to any man on the way.
target_text: miu baku mèti doi-dhari, tas tao mèdha-papake, do salapa dhu risi ètu d'ara kakako miu. mage core eele ai lod'o dènge padhai lii iia d'ara dènge dhèu ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and whenever you go into a house, first say, peace be to this house. and if a son of peace is there, your peace will be with him: but if not, it will come back to you again. and keep in that same house, taking what food and drink they give you: for the worker has a right to his reward. do not go from house to house. and into whatever town you go, if they take you in, take whatever food is given to you:
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, miu baku pidha-pidha era pea. ladhe dhèu sèmi rare miu dènge be'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, pea dhoka ètu èèna toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, miu hud'i manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu isi èmu èèna. ladhe lamatua èmu ètu sèra sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, tatu lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi isi èmu èèna. te ngaa ladhe ro'o boe sèmi miu, na, hud'i laa lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu mesa mi. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, do, asa rae èci, ra hia miu nganga'a, mi'a-minu laa dènge karej'e. te ra hia èèna pamèci dènge èi kabhèsu miu dhu hae.

source_text: and make well those in it who are ill and say to them, the kingdom of god is near to you.
target_text: puri-pa'èle dhèu rèngu dhu pèd'a. aa peka-padhai dènge dhèu sèra, na, ‘paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le! '

source_text: but if you go into a town where they will not have you, go out into the streets of it and say,
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi rae dhu dhèu ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu. ladhe ra tao miu sèmi èèna, na, lami titu asa j'ara-j'ara ètu d'ara rae èèna, mi lii dènge ra, peka na,

source_text: even the dust of your town, which is on our feet, we put off as a witness against you; but be certain of this, that the kingdom of god is near.
target_text: ‘nanene paie! miu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara rae ne. ji'i mai le ngèti lii lolo be'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe. de ji'i caro eele ahu rae ne'e nèti haga ji'i, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, pe bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie! paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. '

source_text: i say to you, it will be better in that day for sodom than for that town.
target_text: miu me'a, sina ma, bhabhelu dhèu kota sodom? ja'a pasanèd'e miu! bèli-camèd'a, d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, bia risi nèti dhèu sodom!

source_text: a curse is on you, chorazin! a curse is on you, beth-saida! for if such works of power had been done in tyre and sidon as have been done in you, they would have been turned from their sins, in days gone by, seated in the dust.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mate unu miu dhu pea ètu rae korasin dènge miu ètu rae betsaida! miu dui mere j'aj'èra! ja'a tao tadha-tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya lamatua. ngaa hari miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe ne. ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa se, dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu, lèke ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e dhèu sèra ele-ho'a le, aa ra tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, ho mai madhutu lamatua. aa rèngu tatu pake le mèdha sasusa, dènge tao ahu ètu kètu ra j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra, dhèu yahudi boe. de ra peka boe, na, rèngu dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua.

source_text: but it will be better for tyre and sidon, in the day of judging, than for you.
target_text: tare'a! miu ladhe ku laa! bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku nèti lamatua mi dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and you, capernaum, were you not lifted up to heaven? you will go down to hell.
