target_text: mata unu miu, kabarai kapernaum! miu baku pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua nedhe miu pamaso asa d'ara sorga. aad'o! mola-mèu èi! èèna na lamatua pèci miu asa d'ara naraka lami!

source_text: whoever gives ear to you, gives ear to me; and whoever is against you, is against me; and whoever is against me, is against him who sent me.
target_text: sanèd'e pabe'a-be'a. dhèu dhu nanene lii miu, nuka sèmi rèngu nanene ja'a. aa dhèu dhu pusi boe nanene miu, èci èèna ka ra pahae boe ja'a. aa dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene ja'a, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and the seventy came back with joy, saying, lord, even the evil spirits are under our power in your name.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu pidhu nguru dua sèra lèpa hari mai, d'ara ra karej'e bia. ka ra lole dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ira ii! kakako ji'i ne, be'a bia! ropa ji'i pake kolongara ama ho babège eele nidhu, na, nidhu sèra nanene lii ji'i, hèia ra rai bhalèta.

source_text: and he said, i was watching for satan, falling from heaven like a star.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, mema tare'a! lod'o miu tao sèra sa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ama lamatua pèci eele nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra nèti dedha-liru nèi, nuka sèmi bela dhu kaha'a nèti haa, nèti dhimu!

source_text: see, i have given you power to put your feet on snakes and evil beasts, and over all the strength of him who is against you: and nothing will do you damage.
target_text: sanèd'e! dhèu aae nidhu èèna, musu èdhi. aa nèngu dènge koasa kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pangèd'u le miu koasa, ho palaho koasa na. ladhe miu j'èli lèke kaisao, do karaka rai, miu ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ngaa èci sa bisa boe paj'èra miu.

source_text: do not be glad, however, because you have power over spirits, but because your names are recorded in heaven.
target_text: miu karej'e lula nidhu nanene miu. be'a kahèi, te ngaa sèra sa ana iiki era! dhu be'a risi, d'ara miu karej'e, lula lamatua suri nare le ngara miu, j'aj'i ana kabarai na ètu sorga.

source_text: in that same hour he was full of joy in the holy spirit and said, i give praise to you, o father, lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children: for so, o father, it was pleasing in your eyes.
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci tao d'ara yesus karej'e-karae. hèia na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pa'abhe j'ara-j'ara se'e nèti dhèu dhu tao iisi d'èlu-mèu dènge dhèu lela dedha. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele aa'i-aa'i se hia mi ana iiki-ana iiki dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi. tare'a ama! lula èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things have been given to me by my father: and no one has knowledge of the son, but only the father: and of the father, but only the son, and he to whom the son will make it clear.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene paie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le koasa mi ja'a. dhu tadhe mèu, ja'a ne cee, dhoka ama di. aa dhu tadhe mèu, ama èèna cee, dhoka ana nèti ama di, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka nori si, ho ra tadhe mèu nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and, turning to the disciples, he said privately, happy are the eyes which see the things you see:
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na peka dènge rèngu mesa ra, aku nèngu na, miu se oto titu kèna, lula mèdhi le koasa lamatua.

source_text: for i say to you that numbers of prophets and kings have had a desire to see the things which you see, and have not seen them, and to have knowledge of the things which have come to your ears, and they had it not.
target_text: dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra, d'èi titu kèna neo rèdhi ngaa dhu miu limuri ne mèdhi, te ngaa rèdhi boe. rèngu d'èi kahèi neo tadèngi ngaa dhu miu nanene ne, te ngaa ra tadèngi rèdhi boe.

source_text: and a certain teacher of the law got up and put him to the test, saying, master, what have i to do so that i may have eternal life?
target_text: ca tèka, ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi, titu ho neo sèku pamanahu yesus. na karèi peka na, ama mese! mu peka ku laa! ja'a ad'u j'ara sèmi ngaa, sèna ka ja'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga?

source_text: and he said to him, what does the law say, in your reading of it?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, aku nèngu na, musa suri tasamia lula-nèti j'ara ne'e ne? aa madhutu mame'a èu, tasamia?

source_text: and he, answering, said, have love for the lord your god with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind; and for your neighbour as for yourself.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa peka na, na suri sèmi ne'e ka: ‘èu hud'i sue ku ama lamatua, risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu hud'i d'èi nèngu titu kèna, sab'a pa'èra ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa tadhe mèu ne. ' dhu suri kahèi, peka na, ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu èu, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu. '

source_text: and he said, you have given the right answer: do this and you will have life.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, dhu lèke kèna! ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi sèra, na, èu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but he, desiring to put himself in the right, said to jesus, and who is my neighbour?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ne, tao iisi na sèmi dhèu mola sa. ka na karèi hari yesus, aku nèngu na, te ngaa, ‘dhèu ja'a' èèna, ka cee?

source_text: and jesus, answering him, said, a certain man was going down from jerusalem to jericho, and he got into the hands of thieves, who took his clothing and gave him cruel blows, and when they went away, he was half dead.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo lolo dènge èu lii pakasame èci. pe èu mesa mu ka dhu peka, na, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu èu'. lii pakasame ne, sèmi ne'e ka: ca lod'o, abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu pakèd'i nèti kota yerusalem, puru la'e asa kota jeriko. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa parapo mai game paroe ne. ra game, aa parame rare aa'i doi-dhari dènge mèdha-papake dhèu ne. ka parapo se core ne asa sebhe j'ara la'e, aa ra rai tèke eele ne. dhèu ne, oe madhe.

source_text: and by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he went by on the other side.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe, ka ama agama yahudi ca dhèu puru mai re j'ara èèna. te ngaa ropa na ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne dhu diu raa, aa dhu tarenga ètu sebhe j'ara, ama agama ne titu boe sa hèi, ho uri dhèu ne. na kako paseli eele dhèu ne'e, la'e asa cabèka j'ara, ka na taruu.

source_text: and in the same way, a levite, when he came to the place and saw him, went by on the other side.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo hari èci kako re èèna. nèngu ne nèti suku lewi dhu tema sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. ropa nèdhi dhèu ne dhu baa-baa ètu sebhe j'ara, hèia la'e padètu-dètu ho ladhe, te ngaa na bara boe ne kahèi. na sigo eele j'ara, ka la'e taruu.

source_text: but a certain man of samaria, journeying that way, came where he was, and when he saw him, he was moved with pity for him, and came to him and put clean linen round his wounds, with oil and wine; and he put him on his beast and took him to a house and took care of him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci nèti rai samaria mai re j'ara èèna dènge badha keled'ei na. dhèu yahudi pahae boe dhèu samaria. te ngaa ropa dhèu samaria ne nèdhi dhèu dhu lèke rapo èèna, ka d'ara na mèke boe. na mai padètu-dètu ho neo sarad'e ne. ka pamèu nu'a dhèu ne dènge èi anggor, hèia na pana'i dènge èi mènyi. aa na parbaan nu'a na, èle ka na paca'e asa keled'ei na. hèia nèti ne la'e asa d'ara kota. na pamaso ne asa d'ara losmen, aa lalau pabe'a-be'a ne.

source_text: and the day after he took two pennies and gave them to the owner of the house and said, take care of him; and if this money is not enough, when i come again i will give you whatever more is needed.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu ne la'e b'ae uuru kètu, doi iia dua bua mi lamatua losmen ne, ka na peka, ‘pake uuru doi ne ho lalau dhèu ne toke èle. ladhe d'ai boe, pake uuru doi èu. pe ja'a lèpa, pula hari doi sèra. '

source_text: which of these three men, in your opinion, was neighbour to the man who came into the hands of thieves?
target_text: lii pakasame yesus ne d'ai sange ne'e ka. hèia yesus karèi mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu èu, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu nèngu, ' mi dhèu dhu lèke rapo ne?

source_text: and he said, the one who had mercy on him. and jesus said, go and do the same.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu lalau ne toke èle. hèia yesus lii, peka na, tare'a! de lamu ka, tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: now, while they were on their way, he came to a certain town; and a woman named martha took him into her house. and she had a sister, by name mary, who took her seat at the lord's feet and gave attention to his words. but martha had her hands full of the work of the house, and she came to him and said, lord, is it nothing to you that my sister has let me do all the work? say to her that she is to give me some help.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, lasi taruu asa yerusalem. hèia ra dhuli ètu rae èci. ètu era ne'e, dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari, ngara ra, marta dènge maria. marta manèngi ho yesus si manubha ètu èmu rèngu. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna. ropa yesus madhèdi ho aj'a si, marta bhute dènge pananasu. te ngaa ari na maria, madhèdi padètu-dètu haga yesus, ho nanene lii padhai na. nèbhu boe ka marta mai ka'ugu ètu madha yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! tasamia, ee? ja'a d'ai madhe lalau nganga'a-nganginu mesa-mesa ku, te ngaa ari ja'a madhèdi mau-mau. peka ku dènge ne laa, sèna ka mai bara ja'a ètu dapu ne.

source_text: but the lord, answering, said to her, martha, martha, you are full of care and troubled about such a number of things:
target_text: te ngaa lamatua yesus dhaa, na, marta. èu ne bhute dènge ngangee rupa-rupa.

source_text: little is needed, or even one thing only: for mary has taken that good part, which will not be taken away from her.
target_text: be'a kahèi do, te ngaa j'ara èci dhu be'a risi. maria pili nare dhu be'a risi le, nuka madhèdi ho nanene lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dhèu bisa boe parame rare nèti nèngu lii lolo be'a ne.

source_text: and it came about that he was in prayer in a certain place, and when he came to an end, one of his disciples said to him, lord, will you give us teaching about prayer, as john did to his disciples?
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia ana madhutu na ca dhèu mai, ka na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama! yohanis tuka sarani, aj'a ana madhutu na ka re'a sabaj'a. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama aj'a ji'i sabaj'a kahèi.

source_text: and he said to them, when you say your prayers, say, father, may your name be kept holy and your kingdom come.
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, be'a! sabaj'a pake conto sèmi ne'e: ama! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai na. hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: give us every day bread for our needs.
target_text: ama hia laa ji'i bèli-bèli, nganga'a dhu d'ai.

source_text: may we have forgiveness for our sins, as we make free all those who are in debt to us. and let us not be put to the test.
target_text: ji'i manèngi ama pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala-sasala dhèu dhu tao mi dedha ji'i. ama magee ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and he said to them, which of you, having a friend, would go to him in the middle of the night and say to him, friend, let me have three cakes of bread; because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and i have nothing to put before him;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nori hari si, j'ara-j'ara sabaj'a. na pake upama, peka na, sèmi d'ai talora mèda, angalai èu mai nèti kaj'èu, ho manubha ètu èmu èu. te ngaa èu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, sèna ka hia ne na'a. ka èu lamu asa èmu angalai dhu leo, ho pamako nèti li'u, peka na, ‘lai aae na, ee! hia taha ku ja'a roti d'ai tèlu bua sa! te ji'i abhu tamu ètu èmu, te ngaa ji'i dhu mola-mèu èi! de lai aae na, ee! dhoka tèlu bua di. pe ja'a g'ati hari! '

source_text: and he, from inside the house, would say in answer, do not be a trouble to me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; it is not possible for me to get up and give to you?
target_text: ladhe sèmi angalai èu dhaa, peka na, ‘te a'a, ee! dhèu bhèj'i luu, na, èu mai parèi! babèdho dhu patèke le! ana iiki se dhu bhèj'i aa'i le. de mage mu nasa kahèi! pe lod'o leo hari ku laa! '

source_text: i say to you, though he will not get up and give to him, because he is his friend, still, if he keeps on making his request, he will get up and give him as much as he has need of.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngee paie-iie. masi ka dhèu ne kèd'i boe lula èu angalai nèngu, te ngaa ladhe èu loe boe pamako, tatu na kèd'i, ho hia èu roti sèra.

source_text: and i say to you, make requests, and they will be answered; what you are searching for, you will get; when you give the sign, the door will be open to you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi taruu mi lamatua; pe na hia. tenge taruu; pe na paj'uj'u j'ara. paroa taruu; pe na bhoke hèb'a èmu.

source_text: for to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire; and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi taruu mi ama lamatua, èèna na rèngu sèmi. dhu loe boe tenge, èèna na abhu. dhu ma'ète boe paroa, pe na bhoke babèdho.

source_text: and which of you, being a father, will give a stone to his son, who makes request for bread? or for a fish, will give him a snake?
target_text: miu pangee ku laa. abhu ètu mia ladhe ama, dhu ana na manèngi i'a, na hia mege?

source_text: or for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi kanadhu manu, na hia karaka rai? tatu aad'o, si?

source_text: if, then, you who are evil are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your father in heaven give the holy spirit to those who make request to him?
target_text: dhèu rai-haha ne, mema bhelu. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga, nèngu ne mema be'a. de ladhe miu dhèu dhu bhelu, d'èi hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana-ana miu, ngaa hari ama! nèngu ne hia, mesa boe ngaa dhu miu parluu, te ngaa risi nèti èèna. na pala-bagi roh na dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu manèngi mi nèngu.

source_text: and he was sending an evil spirit out of a man who was without the power of talking. and it came about that when the spirit had gone the man had the power of talking; and the people were full of wonder.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus magèle eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu dhu lii aad'o. ka dhèu ne bisa padhai lii hari. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra malaa.

source_text: but some of them said, he sends out evil spirits by beelzebul, the ruler of evil spirits.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, mema, nèngu bisa magèle eele nidhu, lula nèngu abhu koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, nuka baalsebul.

source_text: and others, testing him, were looking for a sign from heaven from him.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo neo sèku yesus. ka ra manèngi ho yesus tao tadha malaa èci hari, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, koasa na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but he, having knowledge of their thoughts, said to them, every kingdom in which there is division is made waste; and a house in which there is division comes to destruction.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a nare le kahadhu kaj'alu rèngu sèra. ka na lii, peka na, ladhe ètu rai cue, kabarai na pamusu, tatu rai ne laho mae-mae. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe ètu d'ara èmu cue, isi èmu loe boe patao-palaha, tatu èmu ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci!

source_text: if, then, satan is at war with himself, how will he keep his kingdom? because you say that i send evil spirits out of men by the help of beelzebul.
target_text: de ladhe nidhu se pamusu aa pabata èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra bisa boe rèd'u paredha dènge nèbhu. de maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, ladhe miu peka, na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu ho bata eele hari nidhu.

source_text: and if i, by beelzebul, send out evil spirits, by whose help do your sons send them out? so let them be your judges.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu kahèi dhu re'a magèle eele nidhu. rèngu pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o, si! de miu baku sad'i padhai lii di, dhu peka na, ja'a ne pake koasa nidhu sèna ka bata eele si. pe dhèu miu ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe.

source_text: but if i, by the finger of god, send out evil spirits, then the kingdom of god has overtaken you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a bata nidhu pake koasa ama lamatua, èèna dhu peka na, paredha lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. paredha ne abhu le, te ngaa miu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa.

source_text: when the strong man armed keeps watch over his house, then his goods are safe:
target_text: ladhe dhèu èra èci dènge rèka, dhu bori tèke ètu keja g'ana-kariu madhenge èmu na, tatu mèdha-panyau na, dhèu bani boe lasi mana'u.

source_text: but when one who is stronger makes an attack on him and overcomes him, he takes away his instruments of war, in which he had put his faith, and makes division of his goods.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu èra risi nèti nèngu mai segi ne, aa parame nèti rèka na. hèia na parame nèti mèdha-panyau na kahèi, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu na. nèbhu nare sange ne'e lamatua èmu èèna maena dhoka mi rèka na. te ngaa limuri ne, na maena heka rèka na sèra.

source_text: he who is not with me is against me, and he who will not give me help in getting people together is driving them away.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu musu ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ètu d'ara sasab'a ja'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka ad'u-ue j'ara maruru di.

source_text: the unclean spirit, when he has gone out of a man, goes through dry places, looking for rest; and when he does not get it, he says, i will go back to my house from which i came.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe èdhi bata eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne rai la'e asa era kaliu, ho tenge era ae iisi. lula na abhu boe era dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi na, hèia na pangee na, ‘aah! abhu boe era ae iisi, be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. '

source_text: and when he comes, he sees that it has been made fair and clean.
target_text: ropa na lèpa, rage hari era uru èèna, dhu mèu le, aa dhu lalau pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then he goes and gets seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they go in, and take their places there: and the last condition of that man is worse than the first.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa angalai na pidhu dhu bhelu risi nèti nèngu. ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi pea ètu dhèu èèna, ka ra madahu ne. de lèpa limuri, mamuri dhèu ne asa aae ka ele iie.

source_text: and it came about that when he said these things, a certain woman among the people said in a loud voice, happy is the body which gave you birth, and the breasts from which you took milk.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhèu bhèni èci ètu èèna pa'oo, peka na, ina mu oto kapai, lula nara iisi èu, aa pasusu èu!

source_text: but he said, more happy are they who give hearing to the word of god and keep it.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, tare'a ina! te ngaa dhu oto risi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa tao madhutu!

source_text: and when a great number of people came together to him, he said, this generation is an evil generation: it is looking for a sign and no sign will be given to it but the sign of jonah.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era, dhèu oke rare ne, hèia na peka, dhèu limuri ne re'a dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. rèngu loe boe manèngi ho ja'a tao tadha malaa hia rèngu, sèna ka re'a, na, ja'a ne tare'a-re'a dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa uru èèna, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, nuka yunus. èèna na d'ai le!

source_text: for even as jonah became a sign to the ninevites, so will the son of man be to this generation.
target_text: ngaa dhu lèke mi dedha yunus èèna, j'aj'i tadha hia dhèu ètu kota niniwe, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu paleha ne mai. èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ngaa dhu lèke mi ja'a, èèna na j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu limuri ne, dhu peka na, mema ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: the queen of the south will come up on the day of judging and give her decision against the men of this generation: for she came from the ends of the earth to give ear to the wisdom of solomon; and now something greater than solomon is here.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua j'aj'i ka hakim, pe bhèni aae nèti balèu mamuri hari ho na j'aj'i sakasii. na paj'uj'u ho galaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri taa limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' te uru èèna, bhèni aae mai nèti j'ara kaj'èu, ho nèdhi dènge madha na, mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa miu pusi boe ne!

source_text: the men of nineveh will come up in the day of judging and give their decision against this generation: for they were turned away from their sins at the preaching of jonah; but now something greater than jonah is here.
target_text: mesa boe nèngu di! èèna na dhèu-dhèu nèti niniwe kèd'i titu ho paj'uj'u ai asa miu dhu mamuri limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' ra peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ropa yunus la'e peka dad'èi lamatua dènge rèngu, hèia ra ele-ho'a dènge. masi ka dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti yunus ètu talora aae miu, te ngaa mo'o boe ele-ho'a sa hèi.

source_text: no man, when the light has been lighted, puts it in a secret place, or under a vessel, but on its table, so that those who come in may see the light.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, dhèu suru labhu, na padhèdi ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka pasaraa d'ara kama hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu maso asa era èèna. abhu ètu mia dhèu suru labhu, ho saguru ne dènge soe, sèna ka pahuni ne! èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: the light of the body is the eye: when your eye is true, all your body is full of light; but when it is evil, your body is dark.
target_text: musi madha miu èci èèna ka dènge labhu. nèngu ka dhu pasaraa d'ara miu. ladhe musi madha maroga, dhèu ladhe ngaa aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara dhu maroga. te ngaa ladhe musi madha mèu, dhèu rèdhi dènge d'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: so take care that the light which is in you is not dark.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka saraa ètu d'ara miu, j'aj'i mèu aae sèmi saraa madha lod'o. saraa ètu d'ara miu, mage sèmi heo hèru, dhu pad'elo dhoka mamaho di.

source_text: if, then, all your body is light, with no part of it dark, it will be completely full of light, as when a flame with its bright shining gives you light.
target_text: ladhe d'ara miu saraa, abhu boe sasanga èci sa dhu maroga, tatu mamuri miu j'aj'i mèu, nuka sèmi labhu aae dhu d'elo mamuri miu.

source_text: now, while he was talking, a pharisee made a request that he would come to a meal with him; and he went in and took his seat at the meal.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu èci nèti partei agama parisi nèru ne, lasi ra'a asa èmu na. d'ai d'ara èmu èèna, ka yesus madhèdi ètu mei ra'a.

source_text: and when the pharisee saw it, he was surprised because he came to the meal without first washing himself.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua èmu ne malaa ladhe yesus madhèdi na'a, dhu j'amo uru boe ai, madhutu atora dhèu parisi.

source_text: and the lord said to him, you pharisees make the outside of the cup and the plate clean; but inside you are thieves and full of evil.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, eeh! miu dhèu parisi se seli-kolane! miu kèpe pa'èra atora agama miu! miu bhèlu boe rase pega dènge galaa re li'u toke kale'e, te ngaa sanèd'e boe ho pamèu d'ara miu dhu kaj'alu, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: o you foolish ones! did not he who made the outside in the same way make the inside?
target_text: goa, ee! baku bhèlu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i re li'u, aa tao re d'ara kahèi.

source_text: but if you give to the poor such things as you are able, then all things are clean to you.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, miu pala-bagi dhèu dènge boe unu sèra, nèti ngaa dhu miu unu, sèna ka miu mola ètu katanga madha lamatua.

source_text: but a curse is on you, pharisees! for you make men give a tenth of every sort of plant, and give no thought to right and the love of god; but it is right for you to do these things, and not let the others be undone.
target_text: miu dhèu parisi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! ca pala nèti canguru pala dhu miu hia mi lamatua, miu pa'iga taruu nèti dhu ana iiki toke kapai. toke bubhu-lara dhu ana iiki-iiki d'ara oka, miu pa'iga hèi! te ngaa miu pusi boe dènge j'ara dhu kapai risi. j'ara-j'ara sasue mi ama lamatua, aa dènge boe bia cabèka, miu pabhèlu eele! mema tare'a, èdhi hud'i hia ku pala lamatua, te ngaa baku bhèlu kahèi dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi sèra.

source_text: a curse is on you, pharisees! for your desires are for the most important seats in the synagogues and for words of respect said to you in the market-place.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu d'èi dhoka tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, aa d'èi dhèu pakab'ua miu ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: a curse is on you! for you are like the resting-places of dead men, which are not seen, and men go walking over them without knowledge of it.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu nuka sèmi ro'a dhèu madhe dhu pamera le dènge rai. dhèu kako re dedha, te ngaa re'a boe, na, ètu èèna na abhu ro'a dhèu madhe, lula ro'a èèna ètu dedha na tèdhi na mèu, te ngaa d'ara na laho kao-kao. masi ka madhutu ad'a èdhi, ladhe dhèu j'èli lèke ro'a dhèu madhe, pakaj'alu ngi'u na, de nèngu nia boe maso asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. miu dhèu parisi se, ca ropa dènge ro'a dhèu madhe èèna! re li'u, miu mèu titu kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara miu pènu dènge kaj'alu. dhèu dhu padètu dènge miu, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu kahèi.

source_text: and one of the teachers of the law, answering, said to him, master, in saying this, you give a bad name to us as to them.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi. ropa na tadèngi lii yesus, ka b'ala dènge, aku nèngu na, lii padhai ama deo na, lèke mi dedha ji'i!

source_text: and he said, a curse is on you, teachers of the law! for while other men are crushed under the weight of the rules you make for them, you yourselves do not put so much as one finger to them.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala lii na, peka na, tare'a! miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu agama yahudi, hud'i dui mamadhe-mamopo kahèi! miu soru boe dhèu ho pasamaa si, te ngaa miu asa pasusa si dènge j'ara pabia atora agama miu. ka miu pua dhèu sèra pasae rupa-rupa babia nèti atora miu sèra. te ngaa miu mesa mi, mo'o boe pasae babia ne dènge kacui-aai miu ca laa sa hèi!

source_text: a curse is on you! for you make resting-places for the bodies of the prophets, but your fathers put them to death.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu bhute dhoka pudhi hadhu tao tugu hia dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra, sèna ka pakab'ua si. te ngaa bèi-baki miu se'e ka dhu pamadhe si!

source_text: so you are witnesses and give approval to the work of your fathers; for they put them to death and you make their last resting-places.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi dènge bèi-baki miu sèra. rèngu tule eele dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, ka ra pamadhe si. hèia miu dame hadhu ro'a ho j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu se mo'o kahèi dènge tatao bèi-baki miu.

source_text: for this reason the wisdom of god has said, i will send them prophets and teachers, and to some of them they will give death and cruel pains;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i, peka nèdhi le, na, ‘pe ja'a pua dhèu rèti lii padhai ja'a, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo, sèna ka lasi asa dhèu sèra. hèia dhèu sèra kalabhe paj'èra cahag'e, aa cahag'e hari ra pamadhe si. '

source_text: so that punishment may come on this generation for the blood of all the prophets which was given from the earliest days; from the blood of abel to the blood of zachariah, who was put to death between the altar and the temple. yes, i say to you, it will come on this generation.
target_text: dhèu taa limuri ne, hud'i tago rare tatao nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. sèra sa, mulai ige nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, karèi nèti mamadhe habel, toke d'ai dhèu dhu limuri tèka, nuka sakaria. nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe ne ètu talora aae mei korban dènge kama mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. miu se kahèi pasae mere hahuku ra!

source_text: a curse is on you, teachers of the law! for you have taken away the key of knowledge: you did not go in yourselves, and you got in the way of those who were going in.
target_text: miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu dhu mèd'u gagoe ho bisa bhoke babèdho, sèna ka dhèu re'a mèu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mesa mi maso boe asa d'ara. dhu karehe risi hari, miu pahèb'e dhèu, ho baku ra lasi asa èèna!

source_text: and when he had come out of that place, the scribes and the pharisees came round him angrily, questioning him about more things; and watching him, for a chance to get something from his words which might be used against him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra jèke ne. karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, rèngu karèi rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka neo pamanahu ne. ra loe boe tenge j'ara ho pabèbhe ne.

source_text: at that time, when thousands of the people had come together, in such numbers that they were crushing one another, he said first to his disciples, have nothing to do with the leaven of the pharisees, which is deceit.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu pèri-pèri riho dhu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus. dhèu se mai pasuki, lingu rare ne. ka na peka uru dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, j'aga ngi'u ho baku madhutu j'ara mamuri dhèu parisi. te rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo.

source_text: but nothing is covered up, which will not come to light, or secret, which will not be made clear.
target_text: rèngu sangaja be'a, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu hui. te aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni ne, bèli-camèd'a sabhoka.

source_text: so, whatever you have said in the dark, will come to men's hearing in the light, and what you have said secretly inside the house, will be made public from the house-tops.
target_text: ngaa dhu deo ne'e miu padhai pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadèngi dènge mèu. ngaa dhu miu paholo ètu d'ara kama, èèna na dhèu peka paled'a ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: and i say to you, my friends, have no fear of those who may put the body to death, and are able to do no more than that.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ana-ana, ee! mage miu madha'u, ladhe dhèu neo pamadhe miu. te rèngu pamadhe dhoka ngi'u aae di, te ngaa ra bisa boe tao ngaa mi samanga miu.

source_text: but i will make clear to you of whom you are to be in fear: of him who after death has power to send you to hell; yes, truly i say, have fear of him.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka, na, miu hud'i madha'u mi cee ku. miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu ka dhu bisa pamadhe miu, aa pèci asa d'ara ai naraka. de miu hud'i madha'u tare'a-re'a mi nèngu.

source_text: are not five sparrows given in exchange for two farthings? and god has every one of them in mind.
target_text: miu pangee sèku, ana mangungu kab'ua ca ngaa? mura titu kèna! lèmi ngi'u, dua doi, si? masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua bhèlu boe ci'u sa hèi.

source_text: but even the hairs of your head are numbered. have no fear: you are of more value than a flock of sparrows.
target_text: aa sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi miu. lamatua ne'a mèu, abhu rèu kètu pèri loa ètu kaba kètu miu. de miu baku madha'u, te lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu ae-ae sèra.

source_text: and i say to you that to everyone who gives witness to me before men, the son of man will give witness before the angels of god.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pasa dhilu miu paie-iie! ladhe dhèu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a mangaku nèngu kahèi ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: but if anyone says before men that he has no knowledge of me, i will say that i have no knowledge of him before the angels of god.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, peka na, nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, ja'a tadhe boe nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and if anyone says a word against the son of man, he will have forgiveness: but for him who says evil words against the holy spirit, there will be no forgiveness.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu padhai pakarehe kolongara ja'a, ama lamatua sadia ho pabhèlu eele sasala na era. te ngaa ladhe na padhai pakarehe kolongara roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe sasala na.

source_text: and when they take you before the synagogues and the authorities and the rulers, take no thought about what answers you will give, or what you will say:
target_text: ladhe dhèu ère rèti miu asa era uri lii langu agama, do, rèti miu asa dhèu paredha, lula miu parcaya ja'a, mage miu pangee, na, tasamia miu bisa siri iisi.

source_text: for the holy spirit will make clear to you in that very hour what to say.
target_text: te ètu d'ara lai-lai èèna kahèi, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, peka dènge miu lii dhu pamèci ho b'ala dhèu sèra.

source_text: and one of the people said to him, master, give an order to my brother to make division of the heritage with me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ca dhèu nèti dhèu ae sèra, karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! peka ku dènge a'a ku, ho pabagi dènge ja'a pusaka ama ji'i.

source_text: but he said, man, who made me a judge or a maker of decisions for you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, waa! dhèu cee ka dhu ded'e ja'a j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu miu sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he said to them, take care to keep yourselves free from the desire for property; for a man's life is not made up of the number of things which he has.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! miu baku j'aj'i dhèu manga'a. te kakaja-sasu'i bisa boe nèti mamuri dhu mera-milu.

source_text: and he said to them, in a story, the land of a certain man of great wealth was very fertile:
target_text: èle ka, na padhai lii pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu, isi oka na ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he said to himself, what is to be done? for i have no place in which to put all my fruit.
target_text: ka èmu-èmu dhu tèka nganga'a na pènu tao cacèci, aa risi eele hèi, ka ne'a heka tao tasamia.

source_text: and he said, this i will do: i will take down my store-houses and make greater ones, and there i will put all my grain and my goods.
target_text: ka na pama'ète, peka na, ‘ja'a neo tao sèmi ne'e ka! èmu era tèka nganga'a dhu dhui se, ja'a sag'e eele ho patitu hari dhu kapai risi, sèna ka tèke nganga'a nèti d'ara oka dènge mèdha-panyau ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i will say to my soul, soul, you have a great amount of goods in store, enough for a number of years; be at rest, take food and wine and be happy.
target_text: ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, ja'a pama'ète kore, na, gud'a pènu le! nganga'a tesa le, ku'a d'ai tèu-tèu. de ku'a-kinu pakarej'e iisi dènge pacapa haga! '

source_text: but god said to him, you foolish one, tonight i will take your soul from you, and who then will be the owner of all the things which you have got together?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge ne, na, ‘heeh! dhèu goa! mèda ne'e kahèi, èu madhe. aa cee ka dhu abhu aa'i isi gud'a èu sèra? '

source_text: so that is what comes to the man who gets wealth for himself, and has not wealth in the eyes of god.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e! bisa kahèi, dhèu pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne hia ngi'u na, te ngaa ètu d'ara ngangee ama lamatua, nèngu ne, dhèu unu aad'o, lula pabe'a boe dènge lamatua.

source_text: and he said to his disciples, for this reason i say to you, take no thought for your life, about what food you will take, or for your body, how it may be clothed.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a tabha hari ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, miu mage dhoka pangee mamuri miu bèli-bèli, nèti nganga'a-nganginu, do mèdha-papake.

source_text: is not life more than food, and the body than its clothing?
target_text: te mamuri èdhi ne risi nèti ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, aa ngaa dhu èdhi pake.

source_text: give thought to the ravens; they do not put seeds into the earth, or get together grain; they have no store-houses or buildings; and god gives them their food: of how much greater value are you than the birds!
target_text: ladhe sèku lakaa! rèngu sèra sèla boe, puu-g'ètu boe, dènge boe gud'a ho tèke nganga'a, te ngaa ama lamatua kab'oi si. ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu piara miu kahèi. lula na pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and which of you by taking thought is able to make himself any taller?
target_text: sèmi dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho lalau iisi na, nèngu bisa pamadhera mamuri na, do? aad'o, sina ma!

source_text: if, then, you are not able to do even that which is least, why are you troubled about the rest?
target_text: de ladhe bhute dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu ana iiki sèra, dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, tasamia hari ka miu bhute dènge madha j'ara dhu kapai? a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: give thought to the flowers: they do no work, they make no thread; and still i say to you, even solomon, in all his glory, was not clothed like one of these.
target_text: ladhe sèku bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami. rèngu sab'a boe oka-tedhe, aa ra manènu boe sig'i-rabhi. te ngaa mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua aae, saraga risi boe hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami sèra.

source_text: but if god gives such clothing to the grass in the field, which today is living, and tomorrow will be burned in the oven, how much more will he give clothing to you, o men of little faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua piara j'u'u dhu ana iiki-iiki dhu kab'ua aad'o, dhu dhoka mamuri deo ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, nèngu bisa kab'oi miu dhu kab'ua risi eele nèti j'u'u sèra. de tasamia ka parcaya miu èra boe mi lamatua?

source_text: and do not give overmuch thought to your food and drink, and let not your mind be full of doubts.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku bhute dènge nganga'a-nganginu. te èèna na, lamatua uri hia miu.

source_text: for the nations of the world go in search of all these things: but your father has knowledge that you have need of them.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua, rèngu sèra sab'a toke madhe, sèna ka tao j'ara sèra. te ngaa miu baku sèmi rèngu, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: but let your chief care be for his kingdom, and these other things will be given to you in addition.
target_text: te ngaa pakako uuru ku sasab'a ama lamatua, pe na uri j'ara se'e hia miu kahèi.

source_text: have no fear, little flock, for it is your father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, miu nuka sèmi cakaboko iiki kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èra boe. te ngaa baku madha'u! te ama miu ètu sorga, dhèu aae kapai. ngaa dhu unu nèngu, na hia mi ana-ana na dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: give what property you have in exchange for money, and give the money to the poor; make for yourselves money-bags which will not get old, wealth stored up in heaven which will be yours for ever, where thieves will not come nor worms put it to destruction.
target_text: de lami pahie mèdha-panyau miu, ho kab'ua na pabagi dènge dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. dènge sèmi èèna, miu tèke le mèdha-panyau miu ètu sorga ètu era dhu ele iie boe taa-taa. dhèu mana'u bisa boe lasi mana'u rare. ana cangèpi bisa boe pa'ele iie.

source_text: for where your wealth is, there will your heart be.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! mèdha-panyau miu ètu mia, na, d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: be ready, dressed as for a journey, with your lights burning. and be like men who are looking for their lord, when he comes back from the bride-feast; so that when he comes to the door, it will be open to him quickly.
target_text: yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, mèda-mèu miu musti bori mema dhari ho lalau lamatua. nuka sèmi ènu dhu beke, mate lamatua èmu na lèpa nèti pesta kab'i. ropa lamatua na kad'eu babèdho èmu, nèngu bhoke dènge.

source_text: happy are those servants who are watching when the lord comes; truly i say to you, he will make himself their servant and, placing them at the table, he will come out and give them food.
target_text: ladhe lamatua mai nèdhi dhèu sab'a se dhu mate tae-tae, tatu rèngu oto. pe lamatua ra pad'elo d'ara be'a na mi rèngu. na pake mèdha-papake dhèu sab'a, ho la'e lalau nganga'a be'a, sèna ka hia dhèu sab'a se'e ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and if he comes in the second division of the night or in the third, and they are watching for him, happy are those servants.
target_text: dhèu sab'a se mema oto, lula rèngu ladhe-leru lamatua ra dènge be'a. masi ka lamatua ra lèpa èmu hake pèri èèna ka, d'ara talora mèda, do oe mèu, rèngu dhu bori mema dhari.

source_text: but be certain of this, that if the master of the house had had knowledge of the time when the thief was coming, he would have been watching, and would not have let his house be broken into.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe abhu lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema hake pèri dhèu mana'u mai mana'u, tatu na soro tèke boe ho dhèu mana'u huki èmu na.

source_text: so be ready: for the son of man is coming at a time when you are not looking for him.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema dhari, te ca dhèu sa dhu re'a boe pèri lod'o dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna mai hari.

source_text: and peter said to him, lord, are these words said to us only, or to all men?
target_text: hèia petrus karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! lii pakasame ama deo na, lèke dhoka mi ji'i do, lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i?

source_text: and the lord said, who then is the wise and responsible servant whom his lord will put in control of his family, to give them their food at the right time? happy is that servant who, when his lord comes, is doing so. truly i say to you, he will put him in control of all his goods.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, lii pakasame deo na lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sèmi kapala urusan dhu satia. nèngu d'èlu-mèu uri j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi lamatua na. te èèna na, lamatua na ded'e ne, sèna ka papala nganga'a hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra. ladhe nèngu maj'èni sab'e madhutu sasab'a na sèmi èèna, masi ka lamatua na mai sange mera mia èèna ka, te ngaa nèngu ne dhu loe boe tao j'ara dhu lèke. hèia na oto, lula lamatua na ded'e ne ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but if that servant says to himself, my lord is a long time coming; and goes about giving blows to the men-servants and the women-servants, feasting and taking overmuch wine;
target_text: te ngaa carui bagi kapala urusan dhu pangee, na, ‘ele boe nèbhu ku, heka lamatua ne lèpa kèna. ' hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, mone dènge bhèni. ka na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge kea rae-rae toke mahu.

source_text: the lord of that servant will come at a time when he is not looking for him, and at an hour when he is not ready for him, and he will have him cut in two and will give him his part in the fate of those who have no faith;
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka kapala urusan ne ne'a nare boe, cag'ag'a laa, lamatua na lèpa. ka lamatua na kalabhe ne, hèia babège eele ne, sèna ka sèmi nare pala na ètu li'u, palere-lere dènge dhèu dhu satia boe, tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua ra.

source_text: and the servant who had knowledge of his lord's desires and was not ready for him and did not do as he was ordered, will be given a great number of blows;
target_text: te dhèu sab'a dhu re'a dad'èi lamatua ra, te ngaa pa'èra boe tao madhutu, do, d'èi boe sab'e madhutu, bèli-camèd'a ra dui rare hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: but he who, without knowledge, did things for which punishment is given, will get only a small number of blows. the man to whom much is given, will have to give much; if much is given into his care, of him more will be requested.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu sab'e sale, lula re'a boe dad'èi lamatua ra, rèngu abhu boe hahuku dhu bia. te dhèu dhu abhu ae, ra manèngi ae nèti nèngu kahèi. dhèu dhu abhu sasab'a kapai, dhadhaa na kapai kahèi.

source_text: i came to send a fire on the earth, and it may even now have been lighted.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a ne ho cèri eele dhèu ja'a nèti dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai, ho tunu eele maruru. dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe ai ne mulai heo ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but there is a baptism which i have to undergo; and how am i kept back till it is complete!
target_text: te ngaa uru nèti èèna, ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra dhu bia. ja'a bèli-camèd'a j'èra ae, toke d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: is it your opinion that i have come to give peace on earth? i say to you, no, but division:
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a mai kèti dame ètu rai-haha, do? aad'o! ja'a mai sèna ka tao dhèu rai-haha ne patao-palaha dènge mae-manyèla, lula lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: for from this time, a family of five in one house will be on opposite sides, three against two and two against three.
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu pa'a'ari mae-manyèla. ètu d'ara èmu cue, dhèu tèlu lab'a dhèu dua, dua lab'a tèlu.

source_text: they will be at war, the father against his son, and the son against his father; mother against daughter, and daughter against mother; mother-in-law against daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.
target_text: ama lab'a ana, ana lab'a ama. ina lab'a ana; ana lab'a ina. teto lab'a ana mantu; ana mantu lab'a teto na.

source_text: then he said to the people, when you see a cloud coming up in the west, straight away you say, there will be rain; and so it is.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ra'i-liru mèdhi aae cèu nèti haa, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha èj'i oe mai kèna. ' mema lèke sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when you see a south wind blowing, you say, there will be heat; and so it is.
target_text: ladhe ngèlu balèu mai, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha lod'o pana titu kèna. ' mema tare'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: o false ones! the face of the earth and the heaven is clear to you; how is it that the signs of these times are not as clear to you?
target_text: weeh! miu dhèu leko-monya dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna me'a peka mia lod'o èj'i, aa mia lod'o pana aae. te ngaa tasamia ka mo'o boe me'a dènge dad'èi lamatua ètu taa limuri ne?

source_text: and why are you, in your hearts, unable to be judges of what is right? for if anyone has a cause at law against you, and you are going with him before the ruler, make an attempt, on the way, to come to an agreement with him, for if you do not, he may take you before the judge and the judge will give you up to the police, and they will put you in prison.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu tao lii langu, nga tao ka miu bisa boe pama'ète unu mi, mia dhu lèke! be'a risi uri uuru ku dame! mage dhoka miu d'ai katanga madha hakim, ho na pama'ète, na, miu maso asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: i say to you, you will not come out of it till you have made payment to the very last farthing.
target_text: te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu bisa boe kalua, ladhe miu b'ae mere mèka dedha dhu hakim pama'ète nare èèna.

source_text: now some people who were there at that time, gave him an account of how the blood of some galilaeans had been mixed by pilate with their offerings.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge yesus, na, gubernur pilatus pamadhe le dhèu yahudi pèri-pèri nèti galilea, lod'o dhu mai asa yerusalem, rèti korban asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and he, in answer, said to them, are you of the opinion that these galilaeans were worse than all other galilaeans, because these things were done to them?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus karèi si, madhutu miu, na, tasamia? dhèu dhu ra pamadhe sèra, sasala ra kapai risi nèti dhèu galilea dhu leo aa'i-aa'i ra, do? nèti èèna ka, ra huku pamadhe si, do?

source_text: i say to you, it is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to the same end.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, lod'o limuri miu laho nuka sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: or those eighteen men who were crushed by the fall of the tower of siloam, were they worse than all the other men living in jerusalem?
target_text: aa tasa mera mia hari dènge canguru aru dhèu dhu madhe ca hari ni, ropa ètu siloam manara guri, hèia kabhie nare si, èèna? sasala si ae risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: i say to you, it is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to an end in the same way.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola, miu èèna na laho sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and he made up this story for them: a certain man had a fig-tree in his garden, and he came to get fruit from it, and there was no fruit.
target_text: hèia yesus peka lii pakasame èci, na, abhu ca dhèu dhu dènge ana aaj'u ètu d'ara oka na. bèli-bèli, na la'e patigi, teko-teko ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ana aaj'u ne dhae hua mèka.

source_text: and he said to the gardener, see, for three years i have been looking for fruit from this tree, and i have not had any: let it be cut down; why is it taking up space?
target_text: ka na pua dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, aku nèngu na, ‘tèlu tèu kèna, ja'a laku-mai ho ladhe ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. de patue eele ne, te nèngu ne dhoka na'e era di. '

source_text: and he said, lord, let it be for this year, and i will have the earth turned up round it, and put animal waste on it, to make it fertile:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ama baku pasori ku. hud'i nèbhu hari ku ciki laa d'ai ca tèu sa. pe ja'a kakèi rai reo kapua na, sèna ka tao pupuk, ho na sega.

source_text: and if, after that, it has fruit, it is well; if not, let it be cut down.
target_text: ladhe d'ai tèu mai nèi, aj'u ne hua, na be'a. ladhe aad'o, la'a sina ma, patue eele ka laa. '

source_text: and he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi, yesus la'e aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and there was a woman who had had a disease for eighteen years; she was bent, and was not able to make herself straight.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu bhèni ca dhèu dhu kabodho kapo'o canguru aru tèu kèna, lula nidhu tao ne. bhèni ne bisa boe pamola kabodho na.

source_text: and when jesus saw her, he said to her, woman, you are made free from your disease.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi, hèia na paroa ne, aku nèngu na, ina! lamatua patalale le j'aj'èra nèti èu.

source_text: and he put his hands on her, and she was made straight, and gave praise to god.
target_text: ka yesus tao ai mi bhèni ne. kaca'a laa, kabodho bhèni ne mola dènge kahèi. hèia bhèni ne manèngi makasi, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and the ruler of the synagogue was angry because jesus had made her well on the sabbath, and he said to the people, there are six days in which men may do work: so come on those days to be made well, and not on the sabbath.
target_text: te ngaa kapala èmu sabaj'a ne nasa, lula yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. ka na peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ca migu, dhèu sab'a èna lod'o. de be'a risi dhèu pèd'a mai lèke dènge lod'o-lod'o sab'a sèra, sèna ka tenge dhèu puri-pa'èle si. baku mai lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a!

source_text: but the lord gave him an answer and said, o you false men! do you not, every one of you, on the sabbath, let loose his ox and his ass and take it to the water?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, heeh! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, miu sab'a kahèi, si? te miu lami patabuli sapi dènge keled'ei miu, sèna ka hia ra'a-rinu, si?

source_text: and is it not right for this daughter of abraham, who has been in the power of satan for eighteen years, to be made free on the sabbath?
target_text: bhèni ne, ana-èpu abraham sama sèmi èdhi. dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra ne canguru aru tèu kèna. ladhe ja'a patabuli ne nèti nidhu, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, na èèna sala, do?

source_text: and when he said these things, those who were against him were shamed, and all the people were full of joy because of the great things which were done by him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka musu yesus sèra makae. te ngaa dhèu ae dhu leo sèra karej'e, lula sasab'a na sèra be'a titu kèna.

source_text: then he said, what is the kingdom of god like? what comparison may i make of it?
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pasoro dhèu-dhèu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his garden, and it became a tree, and the birds of heaven made their resting-places in its branches.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna rèngu ciki di, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu sèmi aj'u dhu lamusi na ana iiki-iiki. dhèu sèle ne ètu d'ara oka. ka muri mai, hèia j'aj'i ana aaj'u dhu kapai aae. èèna ka manu-bhui mai tao rèd'a ètu dadana na sèra.

source_text: and again he said, what is the kingdom of god like?
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a pasoro dhèu unu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like leaven, which a woman put into three measures of meal, and it was all leavened.
target_text: nèngu ne nuka sèmi ragi dhu dhèu bhèni nare, ho na pab'ali dènge tarigu dua saku, sèna ka tao roti pa'ae. lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e èèna, pab'ali dènge tarigu ae-ae, hèia ca'e aa'i. dhèu unu lamatua pangaru ra asa tabha kapai sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and he went on his way, through towns and country places, teaching and journeying to jerusalem.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai kako lasi asa kota yerusalem. rèngu kako, lasi dhuli kota-kota dènge rae-rae, ho na aj'a dhèu.

source_text: and someone said to him, lord, will only a small number have salvation? and he said to them,
target_text: d'ai era èci, ka ca dhèu karèi ne, ama mese! ele boe dhèu ciki di, dhu abhu sod'a, do?

source_text: do your best to go in by the narrow door, for i say to you, a number will make the attempt to go in, but will not be able to do so.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hèb'a maso asa sorga èèna, kob'o. de tenge j'ara paie-iie, sèna ka miu bisa maso re èèna. te abhu dhèu ae dhu sèku neo maso, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: when the master of the house has got up, and the door has been shut, and you, still outside, give blows on the door, saying, lord, let us in; he will make answer and say, i have no knowledge of where you come from.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èmu patèke le babèdho, èèna na miu titu ètu li'u, ho kad'eu babèdho, dènge pa'oo manèngi, peka na, ‘ama! bhoke ku laa! ' te ngaa na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘miu sèra, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu! '

source_text: then you will say, we have taken food and drink with you, and you were teaching in our streets.
target_text: hèia miu peka hari, na, ‘nga tao ka ama tadhe boe ji'i? ji'i se ka dhu tema madhèdi nga'a-nginu dènge ama. aa ama kahèi dhu tema aj'a-nori ji'i ètu j'ara oka-hoo ji'i. '

source_text: but he will say, truly, i have no knowledge of you or where you come from; go away from me, you workers of evil.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘deo na ja'a dhu peka le, na, ja'a tadhe boe miu! miu se, dhèu dhu tema ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. de pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! '

source_text: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow when you see abraham, isaac, and jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of god, but you yourselves are shut outside.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, miu tangi roma iisi dènge kadhi ngutu lii kico-kico. te miu ladhe mèdhi baki abraham, isak dènge yakob, dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, madhèdi le ètu sorga. te ngaa miu lèke babège asa li'u.

source_text: and they will come from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south, and take their places in the kingdom of god.
target_text: pe dhèu mai nèti suu-suu rai-haha ne, nèti dhimu, nèti haa; nèti badae, nèti balèu, ho aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi pa'èci, ra'a-rinu rame-rame ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua.

source_text: and the last will be first, and the first will be last.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a j'ara ne'e: ladhe d'ai ka lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, pangee, na, nèngu ana iiki d'ai seli, aa te ngaa nèngu kab'ua titu kèna. aa abhu dhu uru èèna peka, na, nèngu dhèu kapai, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu dhoka ana iiki di.

source_text: at that time, certain pharisees came to him and said, go away from this place, because herod's purpose is to put you to death.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, na, hua iia ama mese pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e, te dhèu aae herodes neo pamadhe ama.

source_text: and he said, go and say to that fox, i send out evil spirits and do works of mercy today and tomorrow, and on the third day my work will be complete. but i have to go on my way today and tomorrow and the third day, for it is not right for a prophet to come to his death outside jerusalem.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, herodes ne, cakaraa badha dhu d'èlu-mèu kapod'e-kabèli. lami peka dènge nèngu, na, ja'a bata eele nidhu dènge pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra, deo ne'e ne dènge bèli. camèd'a ku, sasab'a ja'a ne heka èle kèna. masi ka tasa mera mia èèna ka, nèti kakako ja'a asa yerusalem ne, ja'a neo sab'a hari ku ciki. te dhèu yerusalem sèra, dhu d'èi pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: o jerusalem, jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who were sent to her! again and again would i have taken your children to myself, as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, but you would not!
target_text: waa, dhèu kabarai yerusalem, ee! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra dhu mai pad'elo j'ara hia miu. pèri-pèri hari le, ja'a neo kaboko miu ho bhiri mi nèti bhelu-katub'a, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu sarimu nare ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu mo'o boe.

source_text: now see, your house is waste, and i say to you, you will not see me again till you say, a blessing on him who comes in the name of the lord.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua pusi-pahae heka èmu manèngi-mangaj'i miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu j'aj'i èmu pa'ela. èèna na, miu mèdhi heka ja'a, toke miu dhaa, na, ‘ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu mai nèti kolongara ama lamatua, lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia na mai! '

source_text: and it came about that when he went into the house of one of the chief pharisees on the sabbath, to have a meal, they were watching him.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ca dhèu ama nèti partei agama parisi nèru yesus ho ra'a-sisi ètu èmu na. ropa yesus madhèdi na'a, abhu dhèu dhu ma'u, neo rèdhi ne tao ngaa lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and a certain man was there who had a disease.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a boho madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and jesus, answering, said to the scribes and pharisees, is it right to make people well on the sabbath or not?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora yahudi dènge dhèu parisi dhu madhèdi ra'a ètu sèra kahèi, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora nèti baki musa, bisa pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, do aad'o?

source_text: but they said nothing. and he made him well and sent him away.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci sa bhoka boe hèb'a. hèia yesus gai dhèu pèd'a ne, ka na èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ka yesus pua dhèu ne, sèna ka lèpa ka.

source_text: and he said to them, which of you, whose ox or ass has got into a water-hole, will not straight away get him out on the sabbath?
target_text: èle ka yesus karèi hari si, peka na, ladhe ana èci manahu asa d'ara èi lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu lami ère eele ana ne'e, do aad'o? ladhe sapi manahu asa d'ara èi la'e, miu soro tèke, do, lami kaso ne asa li'u? tatu miu kaso ne asa li'u. de èèna, sasoa na, miu sab'a le, sina ma?

source_text: and they had no answer to that question.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus ne, èci sa bisa boe dhaa.

source_text: and he gave teaching in the form of a story to the guests who came to the feast, when he saw how they took the best seats; saying to them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus taru kira mi dhèu mai ra'a-sisi ètu d'ara èmu ne. dhèu ae ka dhu d'èi era re madha, ho lasi madhèdi. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, yesus peka,

source_text: when you get a request to come to a feast, do not take the best seat, for a more important man than you may be coming,
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe dhèu nèru miu asa pesta kab'i, mage lami madhèdi ka asa era dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. mage dhoka lamatua pesta ne nèru tamu dhu kapai risi.

source_text: and then the giver of the feast will come to you and say, give your place to this man; and you, with shame, will have to take the lowest seat.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, lamatua pesta mai gai èu, peka na, ‘mage mu nasa kahèi, ama! ama pidha sa kabodho, ee. te ja'a tèke kadera ne hia dhèu kapai nèi. ' hèia èu kèd'i dènge makae, tèke eele kadera ne, ka lamu madhèdi asa kabodho.

source_text: but when you come, go and take the lowest seat, so that when the giver of the feast comes, he may say to you, friend, come up higher; and then you will have honour in the eyes of all the others who are there.
target_text: de ladhe èu abhu nèru, lamu madhèdi ètu kadera re kabodho tèka. ropa lamatua pesta ladhe nèdhi èu, na mai peka, ‘ama! mai madhèdi asa madha ne. ' dènge j'ara ne, miu abhu pakab'ua ètu madha tamu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for every man who gives himself a high place will be put down, but he who takes a low place will be lifted up.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, èèna na lamatua pahaha si. te ngaa dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu haha, èèna na lamatua ded'e padedha si.

source_text: and he said to the master of the house, when you give a feast, do not send for your friends and your brothers and your family or your neighbours who have wealth, for they may give a feast for you, and so you will get a reward.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, lod'o leo, ladhe ama neo tao tatao, mage nèru dhoka a'ari ama dènge dhèu kaja sèra mesa ra! te tatu rèngu bisa nèru hari ama.

source_text: but when you give a feast, send for the poor and the blind and those who are broken in body:
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama tao tatao, nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bèdhu sèra.

source_text: and you will have a blessing, because they will not be able to give you any payment, and you will get your reward when the upright come back from the dead.
target_text: tatu rèngu b'ala rare boe ama. te ngaa ladhe ama nèru si, ama lamatua ka dhu b'ala ama. ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe le, na bhèlu boe babe'a ama.

source_text: and, hearing these words, one of those who were at table with him said to him, happy is the man who will be a guest in the kingdom of god.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ca mei dènge yesus, padhai lii, peka na, dhu karej'e risi ka, rèngu dhu madhutu ra'a pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua!

source_text: and he said to them, a certain man gave a great feast, and sent word of it to a number of people.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a lolo sèmi ne'e: abhu ca dhèu dhu tao tatao kapai. hèia na nèru dhèu ae titu kèna.

source_text: and when the time had come, he sent his servants to say to them, come, for all things are now ready.
target_text: ropa d'ai tadha dhèu ra'a-rinu, ka na pua ènu na, la'e paroa dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, peka na, ‘mai lati ka, te neo mulai pesta kèna. '

source_text: and they all gave reasons why they were not able to come. the first said to him, i have got a new field, and it is necessary for me to go and see it: i am full of regret that i am unable to come.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e padhai lii rupa-rupa, sèna ka lasi boe asa d'ara pesta. ca dhèu peka sèmi ne'e, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore oka cue, de neo laku ladhe sèku. de mage nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe. '

source_text: and another said, i have got some cattle, and i am going to make a test of them: i am full of regret that i am unable to come.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore sapi maroo rai lèmi pasa. de ja'a neo laku cob'a si. baku nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe! '

source_text: and another said, i have been married, and so i am not able to come.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka kab'i kèna, de bisa boe dhiu. '

source_text: and the servant came back and gave his master an account of these things. then the master of the house was angry and said to the servant, go out quickly into the streets of the town and get the poor, the blind, and those who are broken in body.
target_text: ka ènu ne, lèpa peka dènge lamatua na. ropa tadèngi nare, ka nasa titu kèna. hèia na paredha ènu na, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, èu lamu lai-lai! lamu asa j'ara-j'ara, dènge asa sasanga j'ara ètu kota ne'e, sèna ka nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu kasia, dhu haga roe cabèka, dhu bèdhu, dènge dhèu-dhèu karuku sèra. '

source_text: and the servant said, lord, your orders have been done, and still there is room.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, la'e dènge ka nèru dhèu-dhèu sèra. ka na lèpa hari, hèia na peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! dhèu se, ka se'e le. te ngaa era madhèdi ae era. '

source_text: and the lord said to the servant, go out into the roads and the fields, and make them come in, so that my house may be full.
target_text: hèia lamatua na peka, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, lamu hari asa rae-rae ètu li'u kota, toke d'ai d'ara oka sèi. lamu pamako sad'i cee èèna ka, mèti si mai ho ra madhèdi papènu d'ara pesta ne.

source_text: for i say to you that not one of those who were requested to come will have a taste of my feast.
target_text: nanene, ee! dhèu dhu pahae boe dènge lii nèru ja'a ne, rèngu se re'a boe babe'a tatao ne ciki sa hèi! '

source_text: now a great number of people went with him.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa yerusalem. dhèu ae madhutu ne. hèia na kabib'a ladhe sa rèngu, ka na peka, na,

source_text: and turning round, he said to them, if any man comes to me, and has not hate for his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters, and even for his life, he may not be my disciple.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra; risi nèti ina-ama na, risi nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, risi nèti ana niki na, risi nèti a'ari na, aa risi-risi hari nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: whoever does not take up his cross and come after me may not be my disciple.
target_text: te dhèu dhu d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu pasae j'aj'èra na taruu.

source_text: for which of you, desiring to put up a tower, does not first give much thought to the price, if he will have enough to make it complete?
target_text: de ladhe neo madhutu ja'a, ngee pabe'a-be'a ku. nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao èmu dhu dènge tad'a-tad'a. nèngu hud'i ige uuru ku, ogo d'ai lutu sela. mage dhoka doi d'ai boe.

source_text: for fear that if he makes a start and is not able to go on with it to the end, all who see it will be laughing at him,
target_text: ladhe ige boe paie-iie, ele boe d'ai fanderen di, doi dhu aad'o heka le. ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu mari madhe aa pamakae ne hèi,

source_text: and saying, this man made a start at building and is not able to make it complete.
target_text: peka na, ‘miu ladhe ku dhèu ne'e laa! heka na sab'e fanderen kèna, te ngaa doi na saku aa'i le! '

source_text: or what king, going to war with another king, will not first take thought if he will be strong enough, with ten thousand men, to keep off him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
target_text: conto dhu leo, nuka sèmi dhèu lasi pamusu. dhèu aae dhu neo la'e pamusu hud'i madhèdi ku, sèna ka pare'a uuru ku dènge angalai na. ladhe sordad'u rèngu dhoka canguru riho dhèu di, bisa segi musu dua nguru riho dhèu, do aad'o?

source_text: or while the other is still a great distance away, he sends representatives requesting conditions of peace.
target_text: ladhe ige rare, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe segi, be'a risi lod'o musu dhu kaj'èu era, ra pua dhèu lasi peka sèna ka uri padame.

source_text: and so whoever is not ready to give up all he has may not be my disciple.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. nèngu hud'i kali bagi ku la'e-mai, dhu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èra le tèke eele aa'i ngaa-ngaa, do aad'o? te ladhe aad'o, na, dhèu ne'e nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: for salt is good, but if the taste goes from it, of what use is it? it is no good for the land or for the place of waste; no one has a use for it. he who has ears, let him give ear.
target_text: yesus tuhu lii padhai pake lii pakasame dhu leo hari, na, masi ne, be'a. èdhi pake ne ho pabe'a nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe na sèro heka, j'aj'i ngaa hari? bisa heka pake ne, ho pabe'a nganga'a. neo tao mi pupuk, bisa boe kahèi. dhodhoka core eele iia d'ara di. dhèu cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, nanene paie-iie!

source_text: now all the tax-farmers and sinners came near to give ear to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu roro bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe mai ae-ae asa yesus, sèna ka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa dhèu yahudi peka, na, rèngu sèra dhèu karehe.

source_text: and the pharisees and scribes were angry, saying, this man gives approval to sinners, and takes food with them.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu parisi dènge mese agama yahudi sèra ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, huuh! dhèu ne pa'angalai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu laku boe se. ngaa hari na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge si!

source_text: and he made a story for them, saying,
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus lolo dènge ra lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: what man of you, having a hundred sheep, if one of them gets loose and goes away, will not let the ninety-nine be in the waste land by themselves, and go after the wandering one, till he sees where it is?
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu unu kahib'i-kalèbho cangasu ngi'u. ka ci'u ele. na tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele dhu ceo nguru ceo se ètu era dhu be'a, aa la'e tenge dhu ele deo na, toke rage ne.

source_text: and when he has got it again, he takes it in his arms with joy.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari kahib'i-kalèbho ne, ka na pasae nèti, dènge karej'e-karae.

source_text: and when he gets back to his house, he sends for his neighbours and friends, saying to them, be glad with me, for i have got back my sheep which had gone away.
target_text: d'ai èmu, ka na paroa angalai na aa'i-aa'i, hèia na peka dènge si, ‘mai, sèna ka karej'e dènge ja'a! te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu ele èèna, kèdhi hari le. '

source_text: i say to you that even so there will be more joy in heaven when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing, than for ninety-nine good men, who have no need of a change of heart.
target_text: ètu sorga, sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ca dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia ele-ho'a, ka na lèpa hari asa lamatua, ana kabarai sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae. rèngu karej'e risi lula ca dhèu dhu lèpa hari asa lamatua, nèti ceo nguru ceo dhèu dhu mamuri mola, dhu sala boe j'ara.

source_text: or what woman, having ten bits of silver, if one bit has gone from her hands, will not get a light, and go through her house, searching with care till she sees it?
target_text: ka yesus lolo hari lii pakasame dhu leo èci, peka na, abhu ca dhèu ina, dhu doi iia na canguru bua. ne'a na, dhu ele ca doi. ka na tao tasamia? tatu la'e suru labhu ho d'elo palème era, aa saku èmu ne d'ai ro'a kakilu, sèna ka tenge doi cue dhu ele ne.

source_text: and when she has it again, she gets her friends and neighbours together, saying, be glad with me, for i have got back the bit of silver which had gone from me.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari doi ne, na paroa dènge dhèu dhu ètu baboa èmu na sèra, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘miu mai, ho karej'e sama-sama dènge ja'a. te doi ja'a cue dhu ele deo na, kèdhi hari le! '

source_text: even so, i say to you, there is joy among the angels of god, when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing.
target_text: ètu sorga sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu tao sala, ka na ele-ho'a, ho lèpa hari asa ama lamatua, tatu ana pajuu ètu sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae.

source_text: and he said, a certain man had two sons:
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na dènge lii pakasame kahèi, peka na, ama ca dhèu dènge ana mone na dhèu dua.

source_text: and the younger of them said to his father, father, give me that part of your property which will be mine. and he made division of his goods between them.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana limuri peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! hia ka pala ja'a nèti pusaka sèra, deo ne'e ne kahèi! ' hèia ama na bagi hia dua ra pusaka na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge pala ra.

source_text: and not long after, the younger son got together everything which was his and took a journey into a far-away country, and there all his money went in foolish living.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka ana limuri ne pahie unu na. hèia na lalau mèdha na, ka la'e asa rae kaj'èu. ètu era nèi, ana limuri ne pasaku aa'i-aa'i doi-dhari na, ho pakarej'e iisi.

source_text: and when everything was gone, there was no food to be had in that country, and he was in need.
target_text: ropa doi na èle aa'i mèu-mèu, rai ne dhu lèke manganga bia, ka mamuri ana ne j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: and he went and put himself into the hands of one of the people of that country, and he sent him into his fields to give the pigs their food.
target_text: ka la'e tenge sasab'a. hèia ca dhèu nèti kabarai èèna hia na panga'a hahi.

source_text: and so great was his need that he would have been glad to take the pigs' food, and no one gave him anything.
target_text: lula ana ne manganga d'ai seli, ka neo na'a nganga'a hahi se. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hia ne na'a.

source_text: but when he came to his senses, he said, what numbers of my father's servants have bread enough, and more, while i am near to death here through need of food!
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, ka na pangee la'e-mai, aku nèngu na, ‘anga ee! ja'a ètu ne'e, oe madhe manganga kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ama ku, dhèu sab'a ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: i will get up and go to my father, and will say to him, father, i have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes:
target_text: de be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku, ho peka dènge ne, ama! ja'a tao le sala dhu kapai titu kèna, mi lamatua dènge ama.

source_text: i am no longer good enough to be named your son: make me like one of your servants.
target_text: ja'a nia boe j'aj'i ana ama ku. hud'i laa ama sèmi more ja'a ne j'aj'i mi kuli ètu d'ara èmu ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: and he got up and went to his father. but while he was still far away, his father saw him and was moved with pity for him and went quickly and took him in his arms and gave him a kiss.
target_text: ropa pangee nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa la'e asa èmu ama na. nèti kaj'èu era, ama na ladhe nèdhi le nèngu, ka ama na rasa kasia. ka na puru nèti èmu, rai la'e soru nare ana dhu lèpa hari ne. hèia na liku nare, ka uu ne.

source_text: and his son said to him, father, i have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes: i am no longer good enough to be named your son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana ne peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ne tao le sala dhu kapai mi dedha lamatua dènge ama ku. ja'a nia heka j'aj'i hari ana ama. '

source_text: but the father said to his servants, get out the first robe quickly, and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and shoes on his feet:
target_text: te ngaa ama na paredha dènge ka dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, peka na, ‘karohe! lami mere kodho madhera dhu be'a risi, ho papake ne. mere kadheli, ho pasaluu mi kacui-aai na. aa papake salapa mi haga na.

source_text: and get the fat young ox and put it to death, and let us have a feast, and be glad.
target_text: lami ère mere sapi kab'oi èèna ho pare, te èdhi neo ta'a-tinu rame-rame.

source_text: for this, my son, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away from me, and has come back. and they were full of joy.
target_text: lula ana ja'a ne, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa ja'a abhu hari ne. ' na padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, ka mulai ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: now the older son was in the field: and when he came near the house, the sounds of music and dancing came to his ears.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana uuru dhu aad'o ètu èmu, te na sab'a ètu d'ara oka. ropa na lèpa, nèti kaj'èu era, na tadèngi le dhèu karihu musiik dènge roge-ledho.

source_text: and he sent for one of the servants, questioning him about what it might be.
target_text: ka na paroa nare dhèu sab'a ca dhèu, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ee! tao rarame ngaa ètu ne'e?

source_text: and he said to him, your brother has come; and your father has had the young ox put to death because he has come back safely.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ari mu lèpa hari le. de ama mu pua pare sapi, sèna ka tao pesta kapai, te ana na lèpa hari dènge sod'a. '

source_text: but he was angry and would not go in; and his father came out and made a request to him to come in.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia ana uuru ne pasaree. na no'o boe maso asa d'ara èmu. ka ama na la'e rarange ne.

source_text: but he made answer and said to his father, see, all these years i have been your servant, doing your orders in everything: and you never gave me even a young goat so that i might have a feast with my friends:
target_text: te ngaa na ka'ugu, peka na, ‘ama! pangee ku laa! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae, nuka sèmi kuli sa, hia mi ama. ja'a ne ke'a boe sisu dad'èi ama. masi ka sèmi èèna, abhu mèka ama hia ana kahib'i ci'u, sèna ka ja'a pakarej'e dènge mone aanga-angalai ja'a.

source_text: but when this your son came, who has been wasting your property with bad women, you put to death the fat young ox for him.
