target_text: te ngaa ropa ana ama dhu bhera-lelu doi-dhari ama, ho la'e karihu dènge bhèni karehe, lèpa hari mai, ka ama pare sapi kab'oi na, tao pesta aae hia ne. '

source_text: and he said to him, son, you are with me at all times, and all i have is yours.
target_text: te ngaa ama na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ana pasue, ee! nanene paie-iie. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, èu ne bera-bera dènge ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ja'a, sèra sa unu èu kahèi.

source_text: but it was right to be glad and to have a feast; for this your brother, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away and has come back.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i karej'e dènge karae ku, lula ari mu ca dhèu ne. uru èèna, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa limuri ne mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa abhu hari. '

source_text: and another time he said to the disciples, there was a certain man of great wealth who had a servant; and it was said to him that this servant was wasting his goods.
target_text: ka yesus hia lii upama èci mi ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu dhu ded'e dhèu sab'a na èci j'aj'i kapala urusan. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, na tadèngi dhèu palolo, peka na, kapala urusan ne mulai kapod'e-kabèli ka parugi nèngu.

source_text: and he sent for him and said, what is this which is said about you? give me an account of all you have done, for you will no longer be the manager of my property.
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne paroa kapala urusan na, ka peka dènge ne, ‘èu ne, tasamia? ja'a tadèngi, na, èu kapod'e mèdha-panyau ja'a. de lamu suri ku ngaa dhu èu ad'u-ue ètu d'ara sasab'a èu, ho ja'a parisa ku. ladhe parisa kore, ja'a kalua eele èu. '

source_text: and the servant said to himself, what am i to do now that my lord takes away my position? i have not enough strength for working in the fields, and i would be shamed if i made requests for money from people in the streets.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, hèia kapala urusan ne mulai pajiko, na, ‘ja'a ne j'èra kèna! ja'a neo sab'a ngaa hari? pare rai, ja'a èra boe. j'aj'i dhèu hèb'a mènyi, ja'a makae.

source_text: i have come to a decision what to do, so that when i am put out of my position they will take me into their houses.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a heka ètu ne'e, ja'a hud'i tenge j'ara ku, sèna ka dhèu leo bisa hari sèmi rare ja'a ho sab'a. '

source_text: and sending for every one who was in debt to his lord he said to the first, what is the amount of your debt to my lord?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na paroa nare aa'i dhèu dhu pakèlu lamatua na. na karèi dhèu uru, aku nèngu na, ‘ee! kèlu èu ca ngaa ètu lamatua ja'a? '

source_text: and he said, a hundred measures of oil. and he said, take your account straight away and put down fifty.
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ja'a dhu pakèlu èi lèngi saitun èpa riho liter. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘tare'a. sasuri pakèlu èu ka ne'e. ciu eele ka, madhèdi ho suri gati sasuri kèlu dhu hiu, peka na, kèlu èu dua riho liter di. '

source_text: then he said to another, what is the amount of your debt? and he said, a hundred measures of grain. and he said to him, take your account and put down eighty.
target_text: ka karèi dhèu pakèlu ka dua, peka na, ‘aa èu hari, kèlu ca ngaa? ' ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, ‘ja'a pakèlu are, cariho karo. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘ciu eele sasuri dhui èèna, ho suri dhu hiu hari, peka na, kèlu èu, aru ngasu karo di. '

source_text: and his lord was pleased with the false servant, because he had been wise; for the sons of this world are wiser in relation to their generation than the sons of light.
target_text: na tao sèmi ne'e ka, toke lamatua na ne'a tatao nèngu. te ngaa lamatua ne hud'i mangaku, na, dhèu kapala urusan dhu bhelu ne mema mèu kapod'e-kabèli. de ja'a lolo lii upama ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ladhe pasoro dènge dhèu parcaya, dhèu dhu parcaya boe d'èlu-mèu risi tenge j'ara ho pa'oto ngi'u ra ètu talora aae kabarai limuri ne.

source_text: and i say to you, make friends for yourselves through the wealth of this life, so that when it comes to an end, you may be taken into the eternal resting-places.
target_text: miu ngee sèku. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne karihu kaj'alu re mèdha-panyau ra, te ngaa be'a risi miu pake mèdha-panyau miu sèra, ho soru-bara dhèu. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu abhu angalai ae. masi ka mèdha se èle, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a lamatua tao tèke era hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: he who is true in a little, is true in much; he who is false in small things, is false in great.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mola ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na mola kahèi ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mèu kapod'e ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na kapod'e kahèi ètu j'ara dhu kapai.

source_text: if, then, you have not been true in your use of the wealth of this life, who will give into your care the true wealth?
target_text: ladhe dhèu parcaya heka miu, ho uri mèdha-panyau ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki ètu rai-haha ne, tasamia ka lamatua parcaya miu ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai?

source_text: and if you have not been true in your care of the property of other people, who will give you that which is yours?
target_text: ladhe miu bisa boe uri mèdha-panyau dhèu leo, na, dhèu cee ka dhu bani ho hia miu mèdha-panyau ra?

source_text: no man may be a servant to two masters: for he will have hate for the one and love for the other; or he will keep to the one and have no respect for the other. you may not be servants of god and of wealth.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èci bisa boe nanene dua lamatua. te aad'o na, nèngu d'èi boe èci, aa sue èci. nèngu d'ara kateme dènge ca dhèu, te ngaa pusi boe dènge èci. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. te dhèu bisa boe sue ama lamatua palere dènge sue doi-dhari.

source_text: and the pharisees, who had a great love of money, hearing these things, were making sport of him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri dhu nanene lii padhai yesus deo na. ka ra sasei ne, lula rèngu se dhèu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: and he said, you take care to seem right in the eyes of men, but god sees your hearts: and those things which are important in the opinion of men, are evil in the eyes of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge si, masi ka miu pamèu iisi ètu madha dhèu, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a d'ara bhelu miu. abhu j'ara ae dhu dhèu rai-haha ded'e padedha-dedha, te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, j'ara sèra karehe, aa dhu madenge dènge rèngu.

source_text: the law and the prophets were till john: but then came the preaching of the kingdom of god, and everyone makes his way into it by force.
target_text: toke mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi muri madhutu atora nèti baki musa aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia. dhèu ae dhu tenge le j'ara, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: but heaven and earth will come to an end before the smallest letter of the law may be dropped out.
target_text: masi ka dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa atora nèti ama lamatua ciki sa, ele boe. ca katèd'a sa ele boe hèi!

source_text: everyone who puts away his wife and takes another, is a false husband: and he who is married to a woman whose husband has put her away, is no true husband to her.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu na, aa na madhèdi hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu bersina. aa dhèu dhu leo dènge bhèni dhu pa'ia-pa'ela, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: now there was a certain man of great wealth, who was dressed in fair clothing of purple and delicate linen, and was shining and glad every day.
target_text: ka yesus lole tabha hari, peka na, abhu dhèu kaja ca dhèu. nèngu d'èi pake mèdha-papake dhu be'a-be'a, tao nèti bèla alus. mèu-mèda na'a-ninu nganga'a dhu be'a hua, aa karae taruu.

source_text: and a certain poor man, named lazarus, was stretched out at his door, full of wounds,
target_text: ètu kota ne'e, abhu kahèi ca dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ngara na, lasarus. ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge kamèu. bèli-bèli angalai na rèti pamadhèdi ne ètu hèb'a tedhe dhèu kaja èèna.

source_text: desiring the broken bits of food which came from the table of the man of wealth; and even the dogs came and put their tongues on his wounds.
target_text: na sanao teko-teko abhu kaha'i nganga'a nèti dhèu kaja ne, sèna ka bisa na'a, te ngaa na abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka busa di mai, ho j'ore nana kamèu na.

source_text: and in time the poor man came to his end, and angels took him to abraham's breast. and the man of wealth came to his end, and was put in the earth.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, lasarus madhe. hèia ana pajuu ama lamatua mai nèti sorga, ka rèti lasi pamadhèdi ne ètu baboa abraham. aa nèbhu boe ka, dhèu kaja ne madhe kahèi, ka dhèu ded'e lasi padhane.

source_text: and in hell, being in great pain, lifting up his eyes he saw abraham, far away, and lazarus on his breast.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne maso boe sorga. nèngu maso asa d'ara naraka, sama-sama dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhe le. ètu era nèi, dhèu kaja ne abhu j'aj'èra taa-taa. ca tèka na boti kètu, ka ladhe nèdhi lasarus madhèdi ètu baboa baki abraham.

source_text: and he gave a cry and said, father abraham, have mercy on me and send lazarus, so that he may put the end of his finger in water and put it on my tongue, for i am cruelly burning in this flame.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! sue ku ja'a laa! pua ku lasarus cèb'u kolo ai na asa d'ara èi, sèna ka mai pabasa ku kolo he'o ja'a ne. te ja'a j'èra titu kèna ètu d'ara ai naraka ne! '

source_text: but abraham said, keep in mind, my son, that when you were living, you had your good things, while lazarus had evil things: but now, he is comforted and you are in pain.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ana, ee! sanèd'e ku! uru èèna lod'o èu mamuri era ètu rai-haha nèi, èu abhu le aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. te ngaa lasarus ne, unu dhodhoka sasusa di. ka limuri ne, lamatua pakarej'e ne ètu ne'e, te ngaa èu pasae more j'aj'èra.

source_text: and in addition, there is a deep division fixed between us and you, so that those who might go from here to you are not able to do so, and no one may come from you to us.
target_text: risi-risi hari, ètu talora aae èu dènge ji'i, lamatua tao tèke loe aae èci dhu taleo dènge marèma. de dhèu nèti ne'e bisa boe dhiu asa era èèna, aa dhèu nèti èèna bisa boe pège sa ne'e mai. '

source_text: and he said, father, it is my request that you will send him to my father's house;
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, baki abraham pua lasarus la'e asa èmu ama ku.

source_text: for i have five brothers; and let him give them an account of these things, so that they may not come to this place of pain.
target_text: te ja'a ne dènge ari dhèu mone, dhèu lèmi era. sèna ka lasarus la'e pasanèd'e si, ho ra lèpa ka asa lamatua. masi ka lod'o d'ai ra madhe, rèngu maso ia ka asa era j'aj'èra ne. '

source_text: but abraham said, they have moses and the prophets; let them give ear to what they say.
target_text: te ngaa abraham b'ala ne, ‘ama lamatua hia le rèngu sasuri nèti baki musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na. ari mu si, bisa baca pahari-pahari ho re'a dad'èi lamatua. '

source_text: and he said, no, father abraham, but if someone went to them from the dead, their hearts would be changed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne pasisu, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! èèna dhae d'ai mèka. rèngu sèi pahae boe lii holo-nori ama lamatua! hud'i abhu ku ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu madhe la'e asa rèngu, heka rèngu ele-ho'a, aa neo nanene kèna. '

source_text: and he said to him, if they will not give attention to moses and the prophets, they will not be moved even if someone comes back from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ladhe rèngu sèi ro'o boe nanene lii holo-nori nèti musa dènge nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, na, masi ka dhèu madhe bhodho nèti d'ara ro'a ra, ho padhai lii dènge rèngu èèna ka, rèngu ro'o boe nanene. '

source_text: and he said to his disciples, it is necessary for causes of trouble to come about, but unhappy is he by whom they come.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ae ka dhèu manahu asa d'ara sasala, lula tatao dhèu leo. te ngaa dhèu dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala èèna, pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: it would be well for him if a great stone was put round his neck and he was dropped into the sea, before he made trouble for any of these little ones.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, toke ana iiki parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne bia. dhu samaa risi, ladhe èki ladha goro dhèu ne'e dènge hadhu aae cue, ho parèu eele asa d'ara dhasi ètu talora lèu.

source_text: give attention to yourselves: if your brother does wrong, say a sharp word to him; and if he has sorrow for his sin, let him have forgiveness.
target_text: de j'aga ngi'u pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu baku pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala! te ngaa ladhe a'ari mu tao sala, pasanèd'e ne. ladhe na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai manèngi abho, na pabhèlu eele sasala na.

source_text: and if he does you wrong seven times in a day, and seven times comes to you and says, i have regret for what i have done; let him have forgiveness.
target_text: ladhe a'ari èu tao sala pidhu hari d'ara ca lod'o, ka na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai pidhu hari ho manèngi abho, èu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na pidhu hari kahèi.

source_text: and the twelve said to the lord, make our faith greater.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu se mai asa yesus, ka ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! parcaya ji'i se èra boe. de ama pa'èra ku parcaya ji'i.

source_text: and the lord said, if your faith was only as great as a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this tree, be rooted up and planted in the sea; and it would be done.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe miu parcaya koasa nèti ama lamatua, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, te ngaa miu bisa paredha aj'u aae ne, ‘tahoi eele, ho pidha asa d'ara dhasi! ' ka aj'u ne madhutu lii paredha miu.

source_text: but which of you, having a servant who is ploughing or keeping sheep, will say to him, when he comes in from the field, come now and be seated and have a meal,
target_text: èle ka yesus lii, aku nèngu na, tare conto èci. nuka sèmi ènu dhu pare rai ètu d'ara oka, do, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. sab'a nare, ka lèpa sa èmu. tatu lamatua na peka boe dènge ne, ‘mai ho dua ti ta'a sama-sama! '

source_text: will he not say, get a meal for me, and make yourself ready and see to my needs till i have had my food and drink; and after that you may have yours?
target_text: aad'o, sina ma? dhu lèke ka, lamatua paredha ne, peka na, ‘lamu lalau mei hia ja'a. ku'a-kinu kore ku, pe èu mu'a-minu ètu kabodho nèi! '

source_text: does he give praise to the servant because he did what was ordered?
target_text: ladhe ènu ne lalau nare madhutu dad'èi lamatua na, miu ngee, na, lamatua ne manèngi makasi mi ènu ne, do? aad'o!

source_text: in the same way, when you have done all the things which are given you to do, say, there is no profit in us, for we have only done what we were ordered to do.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi. ladhe sab'a mere aa'i dhu lamatua paredha le, miu peka na, ‘ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri. ji'i dhoka pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i di. '

source_text: and it came about that when they were on the way to jerusalem he went through samaria and galilee.
target_text: lod'o yesus si lasi asa yerusalem, rèngu d'ai too propensi galilea dènge propensi samaria.

source_text: and when he went into a certain small town he came across ten men who were lepers, and they, keeping themselves at a distance,
target_text: ropa rèngu neo maso asa d'ara rae cue ètu èèna, dhèu canguru dhu pèd'a kusta mai, neo paraga dènge yesus. rèngu se titu nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: said, in loud voices, jesus, master, have mercy on us.
target_text: ka ra pa'oo palere-lere, peka na, yesus! mone kapai, ee! sue ku ji'i laa!

source_text: and when he saw them he said, go, and let the priests see you. and, while they were going, they were made clean.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii pa'oo ra, ka na ladhe si, hèia na pua, aku nèngu na, lami pad'elo uuru ku isi miu asa ama agama, sèna ka ra parisa papèd'a kusta miu sèra, èle le, do dhae! ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka lasi dènge. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa, rèngu dhu èle le nèti kusta.

source_text: and one of them, when he saw that he was clean, turning back, gave praise to god in a loud voice;
target_text: rèngu lasi taruu dènge karej'e-karae. te ngaa abhu ca dhèu di, dhu lèpa hari mai asa yesus. na pa'oo, peka na, koa-kio lamatua! te ja'a èle le nèti papèd'a!

source_text: and, falling down on his face at the feet of jesus, he gave the credit to him; and he was a man of samaria.
target_text: hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho manèngi makasi ae-ae mi yesus. te'a boe, te nèngu ne dhèu yahudi boe. nèngu ne ca dhèu samaria dhu loe boe tao lii langu dènge dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and jesus said, were there not ten men who were made clean? where are the nine?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu sèra dhu madhutu dènge ne, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? deo na ja'a pa'èle dhèu canguru si? dhu ceo, mia lasi?

source_text: have not any of them come back to give glory to god, but only this one from a strange land?
target_text: tasamia ka dhoka dhèu leo kara ne'e di, dhu lèpa mai ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, dènge koa-kio kolongara na?

source_text: and he said to him, get up, and go on your way; your faith has made you well.
target_text: hèia na peka mi dhèu ne, na, èu èle le, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. de kèd'i, lèpa ka dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: and when the pharisees put questions to him about when the kingdom of god would come, he gave them an answer and said, the kingdom of god will not come through observation: and men will not say, see, it is here! or, there! for the kingdom of god is among you.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! peka ku dènge ji'i, lod'o mia ama lamatua neo pakako paredha na? ka yesus dhaa, sèmi ne'e. mage mi pangee, na, lamatua pakako paredha na dènge rupa-rupa tadha ètu rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. dhèu abhu boe tadha dhu peka na, ‘ladhe ku asa ne'e mai! te ama lamatua pakako paredha na ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘na pakako paredha na ètu nèi! ' aad'o! te na pakako paredha na ètu talora aae miu, ètu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and he said to his disciples, the time will come when you will have a great desire to see one of the days of the son of man, but you will not see it.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, nèbhu boe, na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, pa'èci heka dènge miu. d'ai ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, miu d'èi titu kèna neo mèdhi mamai hari ja'a. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o mamai ja'a.

source_text: and if they say to you, see, it is there! or, it is here! do not go away, or go after them.
target_text: ladhe èèna na dhèu mai peka, na, ‘kristus ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘kristus ètu nèi! ' na, miu baku bhute ho patangi-tenge, te lii padhai rèngu sèra, kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: for as in a thunderstorm the bright light is seen from one end of the sky to the other, so will the son of man be when his time comes.

source_text: in the same way, in the days of lot; they were feasting and trading, they were planting and building;

source_text: so will it be in the day of the revelation of the son of man.

source_text: if anyone makes an attempt to keep his life, it will be taken from him, but if anyone gives up his life, he will keep it.

source_text: and there was a widow in that town, and she kept on coming to him and saying, give me my right against the man who has done me wrong.

source_text: and for a time he would not: but later, he said to himself, though i have no fear of god or respect for man,

source_text: because this widow is a trouble to me, i will give her her right; for if not, i will be completely tired out by her frequent coming.

source_text: and the lord said, give ear to the words of the evil judge.

source_text: and will not god do right in the cause of his saints, whose cries come day and night to his ears, though he is long in doing it?

source_text: the pharisee, taking up his position, said to himself these words: god, i give you praise because i am not like other men, who take more than their right, who are evil-doers, who are untrue to their wives, or even like this tax-farmer.

source_text: twice in the week i go without food; i give a tenth of all i have.
target_text: ja'a ne maj'èni puasa ca migu dua hari. aa ja'a d'èi hia ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a abhu. ' dhèu parisi ne, sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: the tax-farmer, on the other hand, keeping far away, and not lifting up even his eyes to heaven, made signs of grief and said, god, have mercy on me, a sinner.

source_text: i say to you, this man went back to his house with god's approval, and not the other: for everyone who makes himself high will be made low and whoever makes himself low will be made high.

target_text: ca tèka, dhèu sa'u rèti ana ra dhu rara iisi hiu asa yesus, sèna ka na tao ai na mi ana iiki se, aa padhai lii hia si mamèngi. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu se'e.

source_text: but jesus sent for them, saying, let the children come to me, and do not keep them away, for of such is the kingdom of heaven. truly i say to you, whoever does not put himself under the kingdom of god like a little child, will not come into it at all.

source_text: and a certain ruler put a question to him, saying, good master, what have i to do so that i may have eternal life?

source_text: and those who were present said, then who may have salvation?

source_text: and jesus said to him, today salvation has come to this house, for even he is a son of abraham.

source_text: for the son of man came to make search for those who are wandering from the way, and to be their saviour.

target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nanene lii padhai yesus. rèngu oe dètu dènge kota yerusalem. rèngu pangee, na, yesus neo pakako paredha ama lamatua ètu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu aae. hèia yesus lolo dènge si lii pakasame èci.

source_text: so he said, a certain man of high birth went into a far-away country to get a kingdom for himself, and to come back.
target_text: na peka na, abhu dhèu kapai èci. neo la'e asa rai kaj'èu, ho dhèu ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu nèi. ladhe èle, nèngu neo lèpa hari mai ho j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu d'ara kabarai na.

source_text: and he sent for ten of his servants and gave them ten pounds and said to them, do business with this till i come.
target_text: lod'o nèngu pa'èra neo pakèd'i, paroa nare dhèu sab'a na canguru dhèu, ka na bagi hia si ca dhèu, juru cue. na paredha si, peka na, ‘miu pake doi se j'aj'i mi poko. te lod'o d'ai ja'a lèpa, miu hud'i peka ku leto na ca ngaa. ' èle èèna ka, na pakèd'i.

source_text: but his people had no love for him, and sent representatives after him, saying, we will not have this man for our ruler.
target_text: te ngaa kabarai na d'èi boe ne. ka ra hia dhèu lasi peka, na, ‘ji'i ngo'o boe dhèu ne paredha ji'i. '

source_text: and when he came back again, having got his kingdom, he gave orders for those servants to whom he had given the money to come to him, so that he might have an account of what business they had done.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ra ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia na lèpa hari ka. d'ai èmu na, ka na paroa dhèu sab'a na, dhèu canguru sèra, ka karèi si, peka na, ‘miu se leto ca ngaa nèti juru dhu ja'a hia miu sèra? '

source_text: and the first came before him, saying, lord, your pound has made ten pounds.
target_text: dhèu sab'a dhu uru, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a leto juru canguru bua nèti poko dhu ja'a abhu! '

source_text: and he said to him, you have done well, o good servant: because you have done well in a small thing you will have authority over ten towns.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge ne, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu maj'èni. lula ja'a bisa lèka èu nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki, nèti èèna ka karèi nèti deo ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha canguru kota. '

source_text: and another came, saying, your pound has made five pounds.
target_text: èle ka dhèu sab'a ka dua, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a abhu leto juru lèmi bua nèti poko dhu ja'a sèmi. '

source_text: and he said, you will be ruler over five towns.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka, na, ‘be'a! ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha lèmi kota. '

source_text: and another came, saying, lord, here is your pound, which i put away in a cloth;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu nèti hari juru na. ka na peka, ‘doi ama ka ne'e! ja'a rapi ka pahuni ne, mage ele.

source_text: because i was in fear of you, for you are a hard man: you take up what you have not put down, and get in grain where you have not put seed.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, lula madha'u. ja'a ke'a ama, dhèu nasa. te ama d'èi more ngaa dhu unu boe ama, aa d'èi puu hua dhu ama sèle boe! '

source_text: he said to him, by the words of your mouth you will be judged, you bad servant. you had knowledge that i am a hard man, taking up what i have not put down and getting in grain where i have not put seed;
target_text: ropa dhèu aae tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka na jèke ne, ‘èu ne, dhèu goa d'ara! lii padhai èu ne pabia ngi'u èu mesa mu. èu me'a, na, ja'a dhèu nasa, ho kore ngaa dhu unu boe ja'a, aa puu ngaa dhu ja'a sèle boe.

source_text: why then did you not put my money in a bank, so that when i came i would get it back with interest?
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka lamu boe tèke ne asa bank? ho sèna ka lod'o ja'a lèpa, ja'a bisa abhu leto. masi ka ciki di. '

source_text: and he said to the others who were near, take the pound away from him, and give it to the man who has ten.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae ne pua dhèu leo ètu sèra, peka na, ‘mere doi nèngu ne, sèna ka hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto canguru deo na. '

source_text: and they say to him, lord, he has ten pounds.
target_text: te ngaa ra pasisu, peka na, ‘ama! dhèu ne abhu ae le. nga tao ka neo more nèti dhèu dhu unu ciki, ho patabha sa nèngu hari? '

source_text: and i say to you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aae b'ala, peka na, ‘pangee paie-iie ku! ladhe dhèu dhu mèu uri ngaa dhu dhèu hia ne, èèna na nèngu abhu tabha hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, èèna na rare aa'i ngaa dhu na unu.

source_text: and as for those who were against me, who would not have me for their ruler, let them come here, and be put to death before me.
target_text: de lami kèpe mere musu ja'a, dhu ro'o boe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae. mèti si mai sa ne'e, sèna ka pamadhe si ètu madha ja'a. lami ka! '

source_text: and when he had said this, he went on in front of them, going up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa yesus lolo èle, hèia lasi taruu ka asa yerusalem. yesus dhu kako uru.

source_text: and it came about that when he got near beth-phage and bethany by the mountain which is named the mountain of olives, he sent two of the disciples,
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge dua rae, nuka betfage dènge betania, dhu ètu karasa ledhe saitun, ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uru.

source_text: saying, go into the little town in front of you, and on going in you will see a young ass fixed with a cord, on which no man has ever been seated; let him loose and take him.
target_text: na pua si peka na, miu dua mi lami asa rae dhu ètu madha nèi. pe miu mèdhi keled'ei ngèru ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu èèna. keled'ei ne, dhèu manya'e rèdhi mèka. mi lècu dhari na, pakako mèti mai.

source_text: and if anyone says to you, why are you taking him? say, the lord has need of him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu karèi, ‘tasamia ka mi lècu eele dhari keled'ei èèna? ' mi peka dènge si, na, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. '

source_text: and those whom he sent went away, and it was as he said.
target_text: dua ra lasi ka, hèia ra rage keled'ei ngèru nuka sèmi dhu yesus peka.

source_text: and when they were getting the young ass, the owners of it said to them, why are you taking the young ass?
target_text: ropa ra lècu dhari keled'ei ne, ka lamatua badha ne karèi si, na, nga tao ka miu patabuli badha ne?

source_text: and they said, the lord has need of him.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne.

source_text: and they took him to jesus, and they put their clothing on the ass, and jesus got on to him.
target_text: lamatua badha ne d'èi kahèi, ka dua ra nuni rèti keled'ei asa yesus. ra hèle sig'i-kalolo ra mi dedha kabodho keled'ei ne. èle èèna ka, ra paca'e yesus asa dedha na.

source_text: and while he went on his way they put their clothing down on the road in front of him.
target_text: dhèu ae kahèi hèle sig'i-kalolo dènge salalu ra mi j'ara, ho soru yesus nuka sèmi soru dhèu kapai.

source_text: and when he came near the foot of the mountain of olives, all the disciples with loud voices gave praise to god with joy, because of all the great works which they had seen;
target_text: ropa na puru nèti ledhe saitun, ka dhèu se dènge ana-ana madhutu na, mulai pa'oo koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula rèngu rèdhi le tadha-tadha koasa.

source_text: saying, a blessing on the king who comes in the name of the lord; peace in heaven and glory in the highest.
target_text: ra pa'oo peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua pua mai! ama lamatua hia ne berkat! dhèu rai-haha limuri ne, bisa padame le dènge lamatua ètu sorga. koa-kio kolongara lamatua dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi.

source_text: and some of the pharisees among the people said to him, master, make your disciples be quiet.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu parisi ètu talora aae dhèu ae sèra. ka ra peka dènge yesus, ama mese! kai ku dhèu se, ho baku ra pakii-pakèce sèmi ne'e, te seli-kolane!

source_text: and he said in answer, i say to you, if these men keep quiet, the very stones will be crying out.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ladhe dhèu se'e kutu hèb'a ra, èèna na, hadhu se ka dhu koa-kio kolongara lamatua!

source_text: and when he got near and saw the town, he was overcome with weeping for it,
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu yerusalem, yesus ladhe nèdhi kota ne, hèia na tangi,

source_text: saying, if you, even you, had knowledge today, of the things which give peace! but you are not able to see them.
target_text: peka na, ira ii! dhèu yerusalem, ee! dad'èi ja'a deo ne'e, miu abhu dame dhu ja'a kèti mai. te ngaa lula miu pahae boe lamatua, ka miu unu heka. dame ne pakaj'èu le nèti miu.

source_text: for the time will come when your attackers will put a wall round you, and come all round you and keep you in on every side,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a musu miu mai udhu padedha rai palème li'u tedhe miu ne, hèia ra maso sa d'ara, musu dènge miu.

source_text: and will make you level with the earth, and your children with you; and there will not be one stone resting on another in you, because you did not see that it was your day of mercy.
target_text: ra dhedhe palaho kota miu, toke pamera dènge rai, hèia ra pamadhe aa'i miu dènge ana-ana mi. ra tèke eele boe hadhu cue sa dhu titu, lula miu mo'o boe tadhe lamatua lod'o na mai hia miu mamuri!

source_text: and he went into the temple and put out those who were trading there,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao sèmi pasa sa, ho ra pahia badha korban. ropa nèdhi, hèia yesus babège si nèti era èèna.

source_text: saying to them, it has been said, my house is to be a house of prayer, but you have made it a hole of thieves.
target_text: ka na jèke si, peka na, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu era ne'e. ' te ngaa mi tao ne nuka sèmi era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and every day he was teaching in the temple. but the chief priests and the scribes and the rulers of the people were attempting to put him to death;
target_text: èle èèna ka, bèli-bèli yesus la'e aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, patangi-tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but they were not able to do anything, because the people all kept near him, being greatly interested in his words.
target_text: te ngaa ra abhu boe j'ara, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi titu kèna, nanene lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and it came about on one of those days, when he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the good news,
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na aj'a-nori lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu èèna. hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai karèi ne.

source_text: that the chief priests and the scribes and the rulers of the people came to him and said, make clear to us by what authority you do these things and who gave you this authority.
target_text: ra peka na, mu peka ku laa! cee ka dhu hia èu hak sèna ka ad'u-ue maruru ètu ne'e med'a na?

source_text: and in answer he said to them, i will put a question to you, and do you give me an answer:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, ja'a neo karèi miu ca madha j'ara kahèi, heka ja'a dhaa lii karèi miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john, was it from heaven or of men?
target_text: sèmi ne'e: miu se tadhe yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, do? cee ka dhu hia ne koasa ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they said among themselves, if we say, from heaven; he will say, why did you not have faith in him?
target_text: hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, ira ee! èdhi sèmi tare le pala ti ngaa. ladhe èdhi peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka pua', èèna na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu lèka boe yohanis? '

source_text: but if we say, of men; we will be stoned by the people, for they are certain that john was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka pua', na dhèu ae sèra pèci pamadhe èdhi. te dhèu sèra parcaya, na, yohanis ne dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: and they made answer that they had no idea where it came from.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe.

source_text: and jesus said, and i will not make clear to you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ra, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he gave the people this story: a man made a vine-garden and gave the use of it to some field-workers and went into another country for a long time.
target_text: hèia yesus lolo dènge dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, peka na, abhu dhèu èci dhu sèle anggor ètu d'ara oka na. na hia dhèu seb'a oka anggor ne, sèna ka rèngu pabagi isi rai nèti oka-tedhe ne. ka na pidha la'e pea panèbhu asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: and at the right time he sent a servant to the workers to get part of the fruit from the vines; but the workmen gave him blows and sent him away with nothing.
target_text: d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, hèia lamatua oka anggor ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu, la'e nare pala nèngu. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se, game ana paleha ne, ka ra hia ne lèpa dènge ai hua.

source_text: and he sent another servant, and they gave blows to him in the same way, and put shame on him, and sent him away with nothing.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu hari. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka se game, ka ra pamakae ne. hèia ra babège ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and he sent a third, and they gave him wounds and put him out.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua hari ana paleha na ka tèlu, te ngaa ra game ne, toke diu raa, ka ra core ne asa li'u oka.

source_text: and the lord of the garden said, what am i to do? i will send my dearly loved son; they may give respect to him.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne pangee ka, ‘ja'a tao hari ku tasamia? be'a risi ja'a pua ana pasue ja'a ka la'e. ele boe ra pakab'ua ne, de ra sèmi ne dènge be'a. ' de na pua ana d'èlu na la'e.

source_text: but when the workmen saw him, they said to one another, this is he who will one day be the owner of the property: let us put him to death and the heritage will be ours.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se ladhe rèdhi ne, hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, ‘mi ladhe ku laa! te lamatua oka ne hia ana d'èlu na nuka mai nèi. nèngu ne ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu pusaka ama na aa'i-aa'i ra. de ta pamadhe ne! sèna ka èdhi ka dhu unu oka anggor ne. '

source_text: and driving him out of the garden they put him to death. now what will the lord do to these workmen?
target_text: ropa ana ne d'ai, hèia dhèu se nuni pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u oka, ka ra pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu pangee, na, lamatua oka ne tao dhèu sab'a oka sèra tasamia?

source_text: he will come and put them to destruction and give the garden to others. and when he said this, they said, may it not be so.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tatu na mai pamadhe aa'i si, ka na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne. ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu peka na, ladhe bisa, na, ji'i baku abhu huku nèti ama lamatua sèmi èèna!

source_text: but he, looking on them, said, is it not in the writings, the stone which the builders put on one side, the same has become the chief stone of the building?
target_text: hèia yesus laladhe patae si, ka na karèi, ladhe huku boe si sèmi èèna, nga tao ka dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua suri, na: ‘hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le era padhèdi agarii talora? '

source_text: everyone falling on that stone will be broken, but the man on whom the stone comes down will be crushed to dust.
target_text: dhèu dhu kadhunu lèke hadhu ne, nèngu tatu laho teb'o-teb'o, lula abhu huku. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu cee, nèngu laho kao-kao, lula lèke huku.

source_text: and the chief priests and the scribes made attempts to get their hands on him in that very hour; and they were in fear of the people, for they saw that he had made up this story against them.
target_text: ropa mese agama dènge kètu agama yahudi se tadèngi lii lolo ne, rèngu re'a, na, yesus padhai lii padhèto dènge rèngu pake lii pakasame. rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor deo sa. de ra nasa titu kèna. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhu d'èi nanene lii aj'a yesus. ka lasi tèke eele ne.

source_text: and they kept watch on him, and sent out secret representatives, who were acting the part of good men, in order that they might get something from his words, on account of which they might give him up to the government and into the power of the ruler.
target_text: èle ka, musu-musu yesus ma'u ne. rèngu tenge dhèu j'aj'i mata-mata dhu bisa tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu mola, sèna ka ra kèpe ne. rèngu sanao sèna ka yesus padhai lii dhu palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, ho èèna na lasi peka dènge gubernur, sèna ka ra pua dhèu lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: and they put a question to him, saying, master, we are certain that your teaching and your words are right, and that you have no respect for a man's position, but you are teaching the true way of god:
target_text: ka ra pua mata-mata, sèna ka pakarèi dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. ama me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa hag'e boe dhèu. ama aj'a-nori dhèu madhutu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dènge mola.

source_text: is it right for us to make payment of taxes to caesar or not?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ca j'ara: madhutu atora agama èdhi dhèu yahudi, hud'i ji'i b'ae ku doi bea mi dhèu aae kapai paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but he saw through their trick and said to them,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee kaj'alu rèngu ho neo pamanahu ne. ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na,

source_text: let me see a penny. whose image and name are on it? and they said, caesar's.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue. hèia ra pad'elo dènge ne doi èci. ka yesus karèi si, ne'e ne, rupa cee ka ne? aa ngara cee, ne? ra dhaa, peka na, èèna, dhèu aae kapai, keser.

source_text: and he said, then give to caesar the things which are caesar's, and to god the things which are god's.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, hia asa dhèu paredha, ngaa dhu unu rèngu. aa hia mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: and they were not able to get anything from these words before the people: but they were full of wonder at his answer, and said nothing.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu se malaa, lula rèngu bisa boe sii pamanahu rare ne ètu madha dhèu ae. ka hèb'a ra kutu mèno.

source_text: and some of the sadducees came to him, who say that there is no coming back from the dead; and they said to him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama saduki mai ho neo kèpe yesus. dhèu saduki aj'a, na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka ètu lod'o èle rai-haha ne. rèngu mai pakarèi dènge yesus, na,

source_text: master, moses said that if a man's brother comes to his end, having a wife, but no children, his brother is to take the wife, and get a family for his brother.
target_text: ama mese! atora musa dhu suri tèke hia èdhi, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone madhe, aa dhu dènge mèka kolo, na, ari nèti dhèu madhe ne madhèdi nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo hia a'a dhu madhe ne.

source_text: now there were seven brothers, and the first had a wife and came to his end, having no children;
target_text: mema uru èèna baki musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. dhu uru leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe ana.

source_text: and the second;
target_text: hèia ari na todhe nare hari bhèni balu ne. nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dhu dènge mèka kolo kahèi.

source_text: and the third took her; and in the same way, all the seven, without having any children, came to their end.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ana ka tèlu. na leo dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. toke ari ra limuri tèka, madhe kahèi dènge boe kolo.

source_text: and last of all, the woman came to her end.
target_text: hèia bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: when they come back from the dead, whose wife will she be? for all the seven had her.
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: bhèni ne leo nèdhi le dènge ana mone dhèu pidhu sèra. ladhe d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: and jesus said to them, the sons of this world are married and have wives;
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, dhèu dhodhoka paleo èmu ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: but those to whom is given the reward of the world to come, and to come back from the dead, have no wives, and are not married; and death has no more power over them, for they are equal to the angels, and are sons of god, being of those who will come back from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. aa ètu era nèi, dhèu madhe heka. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te, lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, na hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na.

source_text: but even moses made it clear that the dead come back to life, saying, in the story of the burning thorn-tree, the lord, the god of abraham, the god of isaac, and the god of jacob.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri baki musa, dhu lole aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. ètu èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti baki èu dhu uru-uru sèra. nuka baki abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu se mangaj'i taa-taa mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. '

source_text: now he is not the god of the dead but of the living: for all men are living to him.
target_text: masi ka baki mu se madhe karèi jahi ali. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, nèngu j'aj'i mi lamatua rèngu era, de èdhi te'a le, na, rèngu se mamuri era. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua; dhèu madhe, aad'o si!

source_text: and some of the scribes, in answer to this, said, master, you have said well.
target_text: tadèngi yesus dhaa sèmi èèna, ka mese agama padhai lii, peka na, lii dhaa ama mese èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: and they had fear of putting any more questions to him.
target_text: nèti lod'o èèna, abhu heka ca dhèu sa dhu bani karèi yesus, lula abhu boe j'ara dhu bisa pamanahu rare ne.

source_text: and he said to them, why do they say that the christ is the son of david?
target_text: yesus aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi dhèu sèra, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? mese agama sèra, aj'a peka na, kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. madhutu a'aj'a rèngu, nèngu ne dhodhoka ana-èpu dhèu aae daud di. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for david himself says in the book of psalms, the lord said to my lord, take your seat at my right hand,
target_text: lula uru èèna, dhèu aae daud mesa na dhu suri le, ètu d'ara lii sod'a koa-kio, na, ‘ama lamatua peka le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai madhèdi mi era dhu kab'ua ètu babo g'ana ja'a ne.

source_text: till i put under your feet all those who are against you.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: david then gives him the name of lord, so how is it possible for him to be his son?
target_text: de nèti sasuri ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. sasoa na, ladhe dhèu peka na kristus ne dhoka ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka! lula nèngu ne j'aj'i lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: and in the hearing of all the people he said to his disciples,
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i taru kira mi lii padhai yesus, hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: keep away from the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes, and to have words of respect said to them in the market-places, and to take the chief seats in the synagogues and the first places at feasts;
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge mese agama sèra. te rèngu d'èi kako pake kodho robho rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘rèngu se dhèu kapai! ' rèngu d'èi tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ètu d'ara pesta, aa ètu era-era dhèu ae pakaboko.

source_text: who take the property of widows and before the eyes of men make long prayers; they will get a greater punishment.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e, lula rèngu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra dènge titu ho sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu. rèngu d'èi dhèu koa ra, peka na, rèngu dhèu mola. te ngaa lamatua ne'a sasala ra, de èèna na nèngu huku si bia risi.

source_text: and looking up, he saw the men of wealth putting their offerings in the money-box.
target_text: lod'o yesus aj'a ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ladhe nèdhi dhèu kaja mai pamaso doi asa d'ara boaraka derma.

source_text: and he saw a certain poor widow putting in a farthing.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi kahèi bhèni balu ca dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa mai madhutu sabaj'a. na pamaso kahèi doi dua sen asa d'ara boaraka ne. doi na se'e, kab'ua ciki oo'e di.

source_text: and he said, truly i say to you, this poor widow has given more than all of them:
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, nanene pabe'a-be'a! bhèni balu ne, dhoka pamaso doi dua sen di, te ngaa na hia risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for they gave out of their wealth, having more than enough for themselves: but she, even out of her need, has put in all her living.
target_text: dhèu leo se pamaso doi kolete nèti doi karisi rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi na tao mi doi kolete. masi ka nèti doi ne'e, nèngu ako taha mamuri.

source_text: and some were talking about the temple, how it was made fair with beautiful stones and with offerings, but he said,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus dhu koa-kad'iri èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama! ladhe ku laa, èmu ne be'a titu kèna! ra pake hadhu cetak dhu kapai hua, ka ra paca'e mera titu kèna. aa dhèu hia kahèi mèdha ra dhu kab'ua, sèna ka pasaraga èmu lamatua ne! te ngaa yesus b'ala, na,

source_text: as for these things which you see, the days will come when not one stone will be resting on another, but all will be broken down.
target_text: èmu ne mema saraga. te ngaa nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eela hadhu se, toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: and they said to him, master, when will these things be? and what sign will there be when these events are to take place?
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yesus se karèi, peka na, ama mese! ngaa dhu ama peka-padhai deo na, j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? ladhe lod'o na dètu le, tadha-tadha na sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: and he said, take care that you are not tricked: for a number of people will come in my name, saying, i am he; and, the time is near: do not go after them.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu j'aga paie-iie, ho baku lèke tipu. te èèna na rupa-rupa dhèu mai tèb'a kakara ra, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus. ' abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ‘lod'o a'èle rai-haha dètu kèna! ' te ngaa baku mi parcaya kahèi!

source_text: and when news of wars and troubled times comes to your ears, have no fear; for these things have to be, but the end will not be now.
target_text: ladhe miu tadèngi ka dhèu palolo, peka na: dhèu patao-palaha, dènge papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, baku mi cag'ag'a. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uru ku. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: then he said to them, nation will be moved against nation and kingdom against kingdom:
target_text: bèli-camèd'a suku èci pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci papara-pakèj'i dènge negara leo.

source_text: there will be great earth-shocks and outbursts of disease in a number of places, and men will be without food; and there will be wonders and great signs from heaven.
target_text: èèna na, j'aj'i rai opo dhu kapai aae. ètu mia-mia, manganga-mad'èu dhu seli eele, aa èi papèd'a pad'ai cèu palème era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha dhu pamadha'u dhèu, aa tadha-tadha dhu kapai aae ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: but before all this, they will take you and be very cruel to you, giving you up to the synagogues and to prisons, taking you before kings and rulers, because of my name.
target_text: j'ara se'e se j'aj'i aa'i mèka, te ngaa èèna na dhèu mai kèpe rare miu, aa paj'èra miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a. hèia ra soro miu asa dhèu dhu uri lii langu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa ra taha miu ètu d'ara bèdho. ra rèti miu asa madha dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu paredha leo. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and it will be turned to a witness for you.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o ne'e, sèna ka peka dènge rèngu lii lolo be'a ja'a.

source_text: so take care not to be troubled before the time comes, about what answers you will give:
target_text: de mage pangee tasamia miu siri iisi.

source_text: for i will give you words and wisdom, so that not one of those who are against you will be able to get the better of you, or to put you in the wrong.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ja'a hia miu lii-lii dhu pamèci dènge lii dhaa. dènge sèmi èèna, musu miu sèra, re'a heka peka-padhai sèmi ngaa hari.

source_text: but you will be given up even by your fathers and mothers, your brothers and relations and friends; and some of you will be put to death. and you will be hated by all men, because of me.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a. abhu nèti a'ari miu unu mi, sèmi ina-ama, a'ari, kera ba'i, rae lesa dènge mone anga-aangalai. èèna na nèti rèngu se'e ka, tenge j'ara ho pahie eele miu, toke ra pamadhe miu cahag'e.

source_text: but not a hair of your head will come to destruction.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madha'u, te lamatua bhèlu boe miu. rèu kètu miu ca loa sa kabhui eele boe, ladhe dènge boe dad'èi na.

source_text: by going through all these things, you will keep your lives.
target_text: ladhe miu taha mere taruu, tatu ama lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia miu.

source_text: but when you see armies all round about jerusalem, then be certain that her destruction is near.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ka sordad'u mai pamusu reo rare yerusalem, miu me'a le, na, d'ai lod'o ele iie yerusalem kèna.

source_text: then let those who are in judaea go in flight to the mountains; and those who are in the middle of the town go out; and let not those who are in the country come in.
target_text: ropa ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea rai dènge ka asa ledhe-ledhe. dhèu ètu d'ara kota kèd'i kahèi, sèna ka rai. aa dhèu ètu rae, mai ia ka asa d'ara kota.

source_text: for these are the days of punishment, in which all the things in the writings will be put into effect.
target_text: te lamatua hia lod'o-lod'o sasusa sèra, ho huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene nèngu. se'e se lèke nuka sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: it will be hard for women who are with child, and for her with a baby at the breast, in those days. for great trouble will come on the land, and wrath on this people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu j'èra risi, nuka, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu dènge ana susu. lod'o èèna, abhu susa palème rai-haha, aa dhèu yahudi j'èra bia, lula ama lamatua nasa dènge rèngu sèra.

source_text: and they will be put to death with the sword, and will be taken as prisoners into all the nations; and jerusalem will be crushed under the feet of the gentiles, till the times of the gentiles are complete.
target_text: èèna na musu mai pamadhe si cahag'e, aa taha cahag'e ho j'aj'i ènu ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, mai j'aj'èli pakaj'alu kota yerusalem, aa koasa rare kabarai na, toke èle lod'o ra.

source_text: and there will be signs in the sun and moon and stars; and on the earth, fear among the nations and doubt because of the loud noise of the sea and the waves;
target_text: èle ka yesus lole mamai hari na, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari, abhu tadha ètu madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua hètu-hua hètu. ètu rai-haha ne abhu tadha kahèi, sèmi uli sea, dhasi ko'a dhu loe boe, aa naha aae lalulu mai. se'e se tao dhèu rai-haha ne, madha'u dènge ele ngangee, toke re'a heka tao ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: men's strength will go from them in fear and in waiting for the things which are coming on the earth; for the powers of the heavens will be moved.
target_text: koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru loe boe karèbha. ropa ladhe rèdhi aa'i-aa'i, hèia ra madha'u titu kèna, lula rai-haha ne oe ele iie kèna!

source_text: and then they will see the son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.
target_text: èle ku heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a kèna, ‘dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne puru mai ètu d'ara ra'i-liru'. ja'a mai dènge koasa, aa dènge dadedha dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: but when these things come about, let your heads be lifted up, because your salvation is near.
target_text: ladhe mulai j'aj'i ka tadha sèra, na, miu boti ka kètu miu, te lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua hia mamuri mi miu.

source_text: and he made a story for them: see the fig-tree, and all the trees;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lolo pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu taru kira pabe'a-be'a ku mi aj'u sèra.

source_text: when they put out their young leaves, you take note of it, and it is clear to you that summer is coming.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka hèru rèu ra karara, èèna tadha na hèru hadhu dètu le.

source_text: in the same way, when you see these things taking place you may be certain that the kingdom of god is near.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge lod'o-lod'o sasusa. ladhe cèu, èèna tadha na paredha ama lamatua dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: truly i say to you, this generation will not come to an end till all things are complete.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a cahag'e dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se mai le.

source_text: heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a taha taa-taa.

source_text: but give attention to yourselves, for fear that your hearts become over-full of the pleasures of food and wine, and the cares of this life, and that day may come on you suddenly, and take you as in a net:
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mi j'aga-j'aga, te cag'ag'a laa ja'a mai hari sahèka! mage dhoka miu taru kira heka, hèia miu mamuri dènge minu mahu, aa bhute dhoka tenge mamuri karej'e di. mage dhoka miu me'a boe tadha ne, lula miu bhute dènge j'ara dhu leo.

source_text: for so it will come on all those who are living on the face of all the earth.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pahuni iisi ra nèti madha ja'a.

source_text: but keep watch at all times with prayer, that you may be strong enough to come through all these things and take your place before the son of man.
target_text: de miu hud'i mate tatae ku. baku ma'ète manèngi-mangaj'i, sèna ka miu bisa taha ètu talora aae sasusa sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ropa ja'a lèpa hari mai, miu makae boe titu ètu madha dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: and every day he was teaching in the temple and every night he went out to the mountain which is named the mountain of olives to take his rest.
target_text: bèli-bèli, ladhe re mèu, yesus la'e aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ladhe re mèda, kalua nèti yerusalem ho la'e bhèj'i asa rae ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: and all the people came early in the morning to give ear to his words in the temple.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu ae-ae dhu mai le pakaboko ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho nanene lii aj'a-nori na.

source_text: now the feast of unleavened bread was near, which is called the passover.
target_text: lod'o èèna, oe d'ai lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, nuka pesta roti dhu dènge boe ragi. ètu d'ara lod'o hua iia se, ra roro kahib'i-kalèbho tao kalela paska kahèi. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka pasanèd'e uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki rèngu kalua nèti masir.

source_text: and the chief priests and the scribes were looking for a chance to put him to death, but they went in fear of the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus. te ngaa ra mage dhèu ae sèra maruru, lula dhèu se d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and satan came into judas iscariot, who was one of the twelve.
target_text: nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus, dhèu canguru dua sèra, èci ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o kètu agama yahudi sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus, dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas iskariot.

source_text: and he went away and had a discussion with the chief priests and the rulers, about how he might give him up to them.
target_text: hèia la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi se dènge kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. la'e neo pane'a dènge ra, sèna ka pahie yesus dènge rèngu.

source_text: and they were glad, and undertook to give him money.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yudas, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna. ra pamoa, peka na, la'a, ma! ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae.

source_text: and he made an agreement with them to give him up to them, if he got a chance, when the people were not present.
target_text: ka yudas d'èi, hèia na mulai tenge lod'o dhu lake nare, sèna ka dhèu ae baku re'a nèngu pahie eele yesus.

source_text: and the day of unleavened bread came, when the passover lamb is put to death.
target_text: hèia d'ai ka lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, dhu rèngu biasa roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao kalela paska.

source_text: and jesus sent peter and john, saying, go and make the passover ready for us, so that we may take it.
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus dènge yohanis, aku nèngu na, dua mi lami uuru, sèna ka sadia tèke nganga'a kalela paska ho ta'a sama-sama.

source_text: and they said to him, where are we to get it ready?
target_text: ka dua ra karèi, ama! ji'i la'a sadia nganga'a asa mia?

source_text: and he said to them, when you go into the town you will see a man coming to you with a vessel of water; go after him into the house into which he goes.
target_text: hèia na b'ala, ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem, pe miu paraga dènge dhèu mone ca dhèu dhu pasae g'ala èi cue. madhutu ne toke d'ai èmu na.

source_text: and say to the master of the house, the master says, where is the guest-room, where i may take the passover with my disciples?
target_text: peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi ca kama, ho neo pake tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. abhu, do? '

source_text: and he will take you up to a great room with a table and seats: there make ready.
target_text: èèna na lamatua èmu ne pad'elo dènge miu kama èci dhu taleo ètu èmu dedha. nèngu lalau pamèci nare aa'i le kama èèna. ate dhoka miu dua mi lami sadia nganga'a ètu èèna.

source_text: and they went, and it was as he had said: and they made the passover ready.
target_text: ka dua ra lasi. hèia ra paraga ka nuka sèmi ngaa dhu yesus peka le. ka dua ra sadia nganga'a-nganginu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when the time had come, he took his seat, and the apostles with him.
target_text: ropa lalau rare aa'i, yesus si mai. yesus madhèdi ètu mei, aa ana-ana pajuu-paleha na madhèdi kahèi ra'a pesta.

source_text: and he said, i have had a great desire to keep this passover with you before i come to my death;
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, ja'a d'èi titu kèna madhèdi ku'a kalela paska dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, uru nèti ja'a abhu j'aj'èra.

source_text: for i say to you, i will not take it till it is made complete in the kingdom of god.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a. te èle ne'e ne, ja'a madhèdi heka ku'a kalela paska dènge miu. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ku, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka ku'a hari kèna.

source_text: and he took a cup and, having given praise, he said, make division of this among yourselves;
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare galaa cue dhu isi èi anggor. ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, èle ka na soro galaa ne asa rèngu. hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi mere galaa ne, ho èci-èci minu.

source_text: for i say to you, i will not take of the fruit of the vine till the kingdom of god has come.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! karèi nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ka, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and he took bread and, having given praise, he gave it to them when it had been broken, saying, this is my body, which is given for you: do this in memory of me.

source_text: now this man was in prison because of an attack against the government in the town, in which there had been loss of life.
target_text: barabas ne maso bèdho, lula na kakèj'i dhèu lab'a paredha roma ètu kota yerusalem, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: and pilate again said to them that it was his desire to let jesus go free.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur neo patabuli yesus. ka na karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, tasamia ladhe ja'a patabuli yesus?

source_text: but crying out they said, to the cross with him!
target_text: te ngaa asa ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, aad'o! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and he said to them a third time, why, what evil has he done? i see no reason for putting him to death: i will give him punishment and let him go.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur ngee na j'ara ne lèke boe, ka na karèi d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, nga tao ka ja'a madhutu miu ho paku pamadhe ne? bhabhelu na ngaa? ja'a parisa le nèngu ne, te ngaa abhu boe j'ara èci sa kahèi, ho huku pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo dhoka kalabhe ne, èle ku, heka patabuli ne.

source_text: but they went on crying out loudly, let him be put to death on the cross. and they had their way.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha hari pamèdhu-mèdhu, sèna ka laka-seti ne ho paku pamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia gubernur taha nare heka,

source_text: and pilate gave his decision for their desire to be put into effect.
target_text: ka na pama'ète madhutu dad'èi dhèu sèra.

source_text: and in answer to their request, he let that man go free who had been in prison for acting against the government and causing death, and jesus he gave up to their pleasure.
target_text: hèia na patabuli barabas, ca dhèu dhu d'èi palab'a, dènge pamadhe dhèu. te ngaa na soro yesus la'e asa adhe-aai dhèu se'e, sèna ka ra tao ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: and while they were taking him away, they put their hands on simon of cyrene, who was coming from the country, and made him take the cross after jesus.
target_text: èle ka, sordad'u roma sèra nuni rèti yesus asa li'u kota yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara, ra paraga dènge dhèu èci nèti kota kirene, dhu ngara na simon, dhu neo maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem. ka ra laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha ne gati yesus. ka na kako re limuri madhutu yesus.

source_text: and a great band of people went after him, and of women making signs of grief and weeping for him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai laladhe yesus. abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu pasuti èi madha, lula d'ara pèd'a ropa rèdhi ne.

source_text: but jesus, turning to them, said, daughters of jerusalem, let not your weeping be for me, but for yourselves and for your children.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe bhèni se tangi, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ina-ina nèti yerusalem. baku tangi ja'a ne. tangi hiu ngi'u miu mesa mi, dènge ana niki miu.

source_text: for the days are coming in which they will say, happy are those who have had no children, whose bodies have never given birth, whose breasts have never given milk.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, sasusa dhu kapai risi mai, hèia dhèu peka na, ‘bhèni dhu kalua hua iia, nuka, bhèni dhu rara iisi rèdhi boe, aa dhu pasusu rèdhi boe ana. '

source_text: and they will say to the mountains, come down on us, and to the hills, be a cover over us.
target_text: lod'o sasusa aae na mai, dhèu j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi, peka na, ‘be'a risi, ledhe guri mai ho kabhie ka ji'i! ' aa ra peka kahèi, ‘dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne, be'a risi kabhuku dhènu eele ka ji'i. '

source_text: for if they do these things when the tree is green, what will they do when it is dry?
target_text: ladhe dhèu bisa paj'èra dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala, tasamia hari mi dhèu bhelu?

source_text: and two others, evil-doers, were taken with him to be put to death.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se rèti yesus, ra nuni rèti kahèi dhèu bhelu dhèu dua, ho huku pamadhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: and when they came to the place which is named golgotha, they put him on the cross, and the evil-doers, one on the right side, and the other on the left.
target_text: rèngu d'ai era èci, dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu. ' hèia ra paku yesus dènge dhèu bhelu dhèu dua se, mi aj'u palolo-palèbha ra èci-èci. ka ra sèle patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèra. ra hia dhèu bhelu èci ètu karasa g'ana yesus, aa èci hari ètu karasa kariu na.

source_text: and jesus said, father, let them have forgiveness, for they have no knowledge of what they are doing. and they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus sabaj'a peka na, ama! bhèlu eele sasala dhèu se, te rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue. èle ka sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka neo re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: and the people were looking on. and the rulers made sport of him, saying, he was a saviour of others; let him do something for himself, if he is the christ, the man of god's selection.
target_text: dhèu ae mai laladhe ètu era èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu kapai yahudi sèra, peka pa-aape yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu dhu patabuli nare le dhèu leo nèti mamadhe-mamopo, te ngaa bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu mesa na. ladhe nèngu ne, tare'a-re'a kristus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, hud'i laa na puru unu na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne.

source_text: and the men of the army made sport of him, coming to him and giving him bitter wine,
target_text: sordad'u se padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi. ra hia ne ninu èi anggor manyilu,

source_text: and saying, if you are the king of the jews, get yourself free.
target_text: aa ra parodha pahaha ne, peka na, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a dhèu aae yahudi, na, patabuli eele ka ngi'u mu nèti mamadhe!

source_text: and these words were put in writing over him, this is the king of the jews.
target_text: ra suri ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi. ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, ra huku ne lula j'ara ne'e ka.

source_text: and one of the evil-doers on the cross, with bitter feeling, said to him, are you not the christ? get yourself and us out of this.
target_text: ca dhèu bhelu dhu paku ètu karasa yesus padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu ne tare'a kristus, do? ladhe tare'a, na, patabuli eele ka èdhi!

source_text: but the other, protesting, said, have you no fear of god? for you have a part in the same punishment,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhelu èci hari kai ne, aku nèngu na, weh! èu ne me'a boe madha'u dènge ama lamatua, hèi? te èu ne abhu huku madhe èci èèna ka dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and with reason; for we have the right reward of our acts, but this man has done nothing wrong.
target_text: èdhi dua ti pasae tare huku madhe ne, lèke dènge tatao èdhi. te ngaa dhèu ne, tao boe sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and he said, jesus, keep me in mind when you come in your kingdom.
target_text: ka dhèu ne, peka hari, aku nèngu na, yesus! ladhe ama maso ka asa era paredha ama, na baku bhèlu ja'a.

source_text: and he said to him, truly i say to you, today you will be with me in paradise.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge èu kèna, na, lod'o deo ne'e kahèi, èu lamu asa sorga palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: and it was now about the sixth hour; and all the land was dark till the ninth hour; the light of the sun went out, and the curtain in the temple was parted in two.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhu lod'o nètu le. te ngaa madha lod'o saraa boe, aa maroga kiu-kiu abhe nare era èèna, toke d'ai hake tèlu lod'o nihia. ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla bhèla aae èci dhu ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, bèla ne mae bagi mi dua.

source_text: and jesus gave a loud cry and said, father, into your hands i give my spirit: and when he had said this, he gave up his spirit.
target_text: ètu era dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu' èèna, yesus pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a pangèd'u samanga ja'a mi d'ara adhe-aai ama. ropa padhai lii èle, hèia yesus ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: and when the captain saw what was done, he gave praise to god, saying, without doubt this was an upright man.
target_text: abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma titu ètu era èèna, dhu padètu dènge aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi yesus madhe, ka na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a re'a dhèu d'ara mola!

source_text: and all the people who had come together to see it, when they saw the things which were done, went back again making signs of grief.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra rèdhi mamadhe yesus, ra manyasa, dènge d'ara ra roe bhilu, ka ra lèpa dènge d'ara susa.

source_text: and all his friends and the women who came with him from galilee, were waiting at a distance, watching these things.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu yesus titu ètu kaj'èu, rèdhi na madhe. ina-ina dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea toke yerusalem, ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: now there was a man named joseph, a man of authority and a good and upright man he had not given his approval to their decision or their acts, of arimathaea, a town of the jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of god:
target_text: ropa yesus madhe, dhèu èci tenge j'ara, sèna ka papuru ngi'u aae na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu ne, ngara na yusuf nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne, dhèu d'ara mola, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. yusuf ne dhu tatae ama lamatua pad'elo, na, nèngu nèd'u paredha na. yusuf kahèi ca dhèu nèti dhèu dhu uri lii langu agama yahudi. te ngaa nèngu d'èi boe dènge lii pama'ète huku madhe mi yesus.

source_text: this man went to pilate and made a request for the body of jesus.
target_text: lula na neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi sèna ka nèngu uri ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and he took it down, and folding it in a linen cloth, he put it in a place cut in the rock for a dead body; and no one had ever been put in it.
target_text: ka pilatus d'èi, hèia yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus. èle ka na pahutu ngi'u aae dènge bèla alus. ka ded'e rèti asa d'ara ro'a hadhu èci, dhu heka pae rare kèna. ètu ro'a ne, padhane rèdhi mèka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: now it was the day of making ready and the sabbath was coming on.
target_text: mamadhe yesus lèke dènge hari jumat. lod'o yusuf si padhane rare ne, lod'o nihia le. ladhe lod'o cèna, d'ai lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and the women who had come with him from galilee went after him and saw the place and how his body had been put to rest;
target_text: ina-ina dhu mai palere dènge yesus nèti galilea, lasi madhutu yusuf nèti limuri, sèna ka neo re'a era padhane yesus ètu ro'a mia.

source_text: and they went back and got ready spices and perfumes; and on the sabbath they took their rest, in agreement with the law.
target_text: ropa rèdhi era ne, ka ina se lèpa lasi sadia bunga dènge èi hèu mèngi. d'ai lod'o cèna, rèngu ae nèti sasab'a ra, madhutu atora lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. rèngu mate èle ku lod'o sabaj'a, heka neo lasi tao bunga mi ngi'u aae yesus kèna.

source_text: but on the first day of the week, at dawn, they came to the place where his body had been put, taking the spices which they had got ready.
target_text: lod'o hari migu oe mèu sa, ina se rèti bunga dènge èi hèu mèngi, ho lasi ro'a yesus.

source_text: and they saw that the stone had been rolled away.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai nèi, ladhe rèdhi hadhu aae dhu yusuf pake katange ro'a yesus, dhu bhaloli le sa karasa na.

source_text: and they went in, but the body of the lord jesus was not there.
target_text: hèia lasi dènge ka asa d'ara, te ngaa abhu boe ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: and while they were in doubt about it, they saw two men in shining clothing by them:
target_text: ka rèngu ele ngangee. cag'ag'a laa dhèu dua dhu pake mèdha kale'e, mai titu ka ètu sebhe rèngu.

source_text: and while their faces were bent down to the earth in fear, these said to them, why are you looking for the living among the dead?
target_text: ina se madha'u bia, ka ra pacud'u d'ai rai. ka dhèu se karèi si, peka na, nga tao ka miu mai tenge dhèu mamuri ètu era dhèu madhe?

source_text: he is not here, he has come back to life: have in mind what he said to you when he was still in galilee, saying,
target_text: yesus aad'o heka ètu era ne'e! te na mamuri hari le. ele boe miu bhèlu eele le, ngaa dhu peka nare, lod'o na ètu galilea era, sina ma?

source_text: the son of man will be given up into the hands of evil-doers, and be put to death on the cross, and on the third day he will come back to life.
target_text: te nèngu peka mema le, na, bèli-camèd'a ra pahie eele dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu bhelu-katub'a. hèia ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: and his words came back into their minds,
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, heka rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai yesus uru èèna.

source_text: and they went away from that place and gave an account of all these things to the eleven disciples and all the others.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa dènge ka, lasi peka dènge ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci sèra, dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu ne.

source_text: now they were mary magdalene, and joanna, and mary, the mother of james: and the other women with them said these things to the apostles.
target_text: ina-ina dhu ètu ro'a èèna, nuka maria ina yakobis, dènge maria nèti rae magdala. abhu kahèi yohana dènge ina-ina dhèu pèri dhu leo. rèngu se'e ka dhu lasi peka aa'i-aa'i dènge ana-ana pajuu-paleha yesus sèra.

source_text: but these words seemed foolish to them, and they had no belief in them.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana madhutu sèra tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na ina se monya.

source_text: but peter got up and went to the place where the body had been put, and looking in he saw nothing but the linen cloths, and he went to his house full of wonder at what had taken place.
target_text: hèia petrus kèd'i dènge ka, rai la'e asa ro'a. d'ai nèi, na patigi sa d'ara ro'a, te ngaa nèdhi dhoka bèla hutu di. hèia na lèpa, ka na pangee, sa mia ka ne?

source_text: and then, two of them, on that very day, were going to a little town named emmaus, which was about seven miles from jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, ana madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae cue, ngara na emaus. kaj'èu na pe d'ai canguru ca kilo nèti kota yerusalem.

source_text: and they were talking together about all those things which had taken place.
target_text: ètu j'ara, ra palolo nèti mamadhe yesus.

source_text: and while they were talking and questioning together, jesus himself came near and went with them.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, yesus padètu-dètu le dènge rèngu dua ra, ka kako palere-lere dènge ra.

source_text: but their eyes were not open that they might have knowledge of him.
target_text: te ngaa dua ra tadhe boe, dhèu ne, yesus, te lamatua ka dhu tao si, sèna ka baku ra tadhe.

source_text: and he said to them, what are you talking about together while you go?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu dua mi se, padhue-padhai ngaa? ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka ra titu. rèhu ra sèmi dhèu susa titu kèna.

source_text: then stopping, and looking sadly at him, one of them, named cleopas, said to him, are you the only man living in jerusalem who has not had news of the things which have taken place there at this time?
target_text: ka dhu ngara na kleopas, karèi ne, ama ne sèmi dhèu hiu sa, dhu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lai-lai ne j'aj'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: and he said to them, what things? and they said, the things to do with jesus of nazareth, who was a prophet, great in his acts and his words, before god and all the people:
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, tasamia? ka ra b'ala, peka na, yesus nèti nasaret èèna! nèngu na tare'a dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa lamatua pangèd'u na koasa, ka na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa. nèngu d'èlu-mèu kahèi aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e dènge ne. aa lamatua karej'e dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: and how the chief priests and our rulers gave him up to be put to death on the cross.
target_text: te ngaa te'a boe, na, kètu agama èdhi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, kèpe rare ne. ka ra hia ne asa gubernur sèna ka huku pamadhe ne. de ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha toke madhe.

source_text: but we were hoping that he would be the saviour of israel. in addition to all this he has now let three days go by from the time when these things took place;
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i sanao nèngu ne'e ka kristus, dhu mai patabuli dhèu-dhèu èdhi nèti paredha roma, dhu paj'èra èdhi. te ngaa ètu d'ara hari jumat lai-lai ne, ra pamadhe ne.
