source_text: and certain women among us gave us cause for wonder, for they went early to the place where his body had been put,
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i asa ele ngangee. te deo na, ina-ina ji'i mai peka, na, mad'ae aae era rèngu lasi asa ro'a.

source_text: and it was not there; then they came saying that they had seen a vision of angels who said that he was living.
target_text: te ngaa ra palolo, peka na, ngi'u aae yesus ele le. hèia ladhe rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka dènge rèngu, na, yesus mamuri hari le!

source_text: and some of those who were with us went to the place, and saw that it was as the women had said, but him they did not see.
target_text: ropa tadèngi ngare, hèia angalai ji'i dhèu pèri-pèri, rai lasi asa ro'a. ka rèdhi sèmi dhu ina-ina sa peka. rèngu rèdhi boe ngi'u aae yesus hèi.

source_text: and he said, o foolish men! how slow you are to give belief to what the prophets have said.
target_text: ropa lolo rare, yesus lii dènge si, peka na, gagoa miu se! nga tao ka miu mo'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra peka tèke!

source_text: was it not necessary for the christ to go through these things, and to come into his glory?
target_text: te rèngu suri le, na, kristus ne hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, heka na abhu pakab'ua dènge dadedha kèna.

source_text: and he made clear to them all the things in the writings, from moses and from all the prophets, which had to do with himself.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a si, aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri tèke lula-nèti kristus ne. karèi nèti sasuri baki musa toke dhèu rèti lii padhai dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and they came near the town to which they were going, and he seemed as if he was going on;
target_text: ropa rèngu oe d'ai emaus, ka yesus pasabhe eele neo kako taruu.

source_text: but they kept him back, saying, do not go, for evening is near, the day is almost gone. and he went in with them.
target_text: te ngaa ra manèngi, peka na, ama! j'unu taha ku dènge ji'i mèda ne'e, te lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka yesus maso palere-lere dènge rèngu asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: and when he was seated with them at table, he took the bread, and said words of blessing and, making division of it, he gave it to them.
target_text: ropa rèngu madhèdi neo ra'a, hèia yesus nare roti ca balok. ka na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia na pamae roti ne. ropa na j'ole roti ne sa rèngu dua ra,

source_text: and then their eyes were open, and they had knowledge of him, but he went from their view.
target_text: heka ra tadhe, na, nèngu ne yesus. te ngaa kabèdhi laa, na ele nèti madha rèngu dua ra!

source_text: and they said to one another, were not our hearts burning in us while he was talking to us on the way, making clear to us the holy writings?
target_text: hèia dua ra padhue, peka na, waa! deo na ropa na peka paled'a lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, d'ara èdhi taleo moro-moro sange rai-haha.

source_text: and that very hour they got up and went back to jerusalem, where the eleven and the others had come together.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dua ra kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa asa yerusalem. lasi paraga dènge canguru ca dhèu ana madhutu yesus sèra, dènge dhèu leo dhu pakaboko ètu era èèna.

source_text: and they said to them, the lord has truly come back to life again, and simon has seen him.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu se peka dènge rèngu dua ra, na, mema tare'a! lamatua yesus mamuri hari le! deo na pad'elo iisi na dènge petrus.

source_text: and they gave an account of the things which had taken place on the way, and how, when he gave them bread, they had knowledge of him.
target_text: èle ka dhèu dua se lole aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i ètu j'ara, toke rèngu dua ra tadhe yesus ropa na pamae roti.

source_text: and while they were saying these things, he himself was among them, and said to them, peace be with you!
target_text: lod'o rèngu palolo era, kaca'a laa, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu. na hia maho'o mi rèngu, peka na, saloom!

source_text: but they were full of fear, being of the opinion that they were seeing a spirit.
target_text: ka ra cag'ag'a aa madha'u, lula ra ngee na nidhu.

source_text: and he said to them, why are you troubled, and why are your hearts full of doubt?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u? miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le, do?

source_text: see; my hands and my feet: it is i myself; put your hands on me and make certain; for a spirit has not flesh and bones as you see that i have.
target_text: miu ladhe sèku ai dènge haga ja'a ne. ja'a ka ne'e ne. j'ole ai miu ho g'ag'e unu mi! sèna ka mi lèka, na, ja'a ka ne'e ne, nidhu boe. te nidhu dènge boe ngi'u, te ngaa miu mèdhi ngi'u ja'a ne, si? !

source_text: and when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his feet.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii era, na pad'elo dènge si era nu'a dhu ètu adhe-aai dènge haga na.

source_text: and because, for joy and wonder, they were still in doubt, he said to them, have you any food here?
target_text: rèngu karej'e titu kèna, lula yesus mamuri hari le. dhoka ra bingu, te re'a boe tasamia ka bisa j'aj'i sèmi èèna. hèia yesus karèi si, miu mi'a ngaa?

source_text: and they gave him a bit of cooked fish.
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne i'a paga ca kadhèli.

source_text: and before their eyes he took a meal.
target_text: yesus sèmi nare i'a ne, hèia na'e dènge ka ètu madha rèngu.

source_text: and he said to them, these are the words which i said to you when i was still with you, how it was necessary for all the things which are in the writings of moses and the prophets and in the psalms about me, to be put into effect.
target_text: èle ka, na lii dènge rèngu, peka na, tasamia? miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a uru èèna dhu bera-bera dènge miu? ja'a peka dènge miu ca hari ni, hud'i j'aj'i ku aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra suri tèke lula-nèti ja'a ne. nuka nèti baki musa, aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo sèra, aa nèti sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio.

source_text: then he made the holy writings clear to their minds.
target_text: èle ka, na bhoke paled'a, sèna ka re'a mèu sasoa nèti isi sasuri lamatua.

source_text: and he said to them, so it is in the writings that the christ would undergo death, and come back to life again on the third day;
target_text: na peka tabha hari, na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua se dhu suri le, na, kristus dhu lamatua hia mai èèna, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa ladhe d'ai camèd'a, na mamuri hari. te dhu suri aa'i le j'ara se'e!

source_text: and that teaching about a change of heart and forgiveness of sins is to be given to jerusalem first and to all nations in his name.
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, ja'a hia miu koasa, ho lami mèti lii lolo be'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i, mulai nèti yerusalem ne. peka dènge rèngu, na, dhèu dhu mangaku sasala ra, aa lèpa hari asa lamatua, pe lamatua saku pamèu sasala ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: you are witnesses of these things.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sakasii, sèna ka miu lolo, peka na, ja'a dui j'aj'èra, ka madhe, hèia mamuri hari.

source_text: and now i will send to you what my father has undertaken to give you, but do not go from the town, till the power from heaven comes to you.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia roh dhu mola-mèci, dhu ama ku pajaji nare le. te ngaa miu hud'i tatae ku nèngu ètu kota yerusalem ne, toke abhu koasa nèti sorga.

source_text: and he took them out till they were near bethany, and lifting up his hands, he gave them a blessing.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus nèti si asa li'u kota. ropa rèngu dètu dènge rae betania, na baa ai sèna ka hia ra berkat.

source_text: and while he was doing so, he went from them and was taken up into heaven.
target_text: yesus padhai lii hia berkat era, hèia ded'e ne ca'e la'e asa sorga.

source_text: and they gave him worship and went back to jerusalem with great joy.
target_text: ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi mi yesus. ka ra lèpa asa yerusalem dènge d'ara dhu karej'e-karae.

source_text: and they were in the temple at all times, giving praise to god.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ho koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ama teofilus! lii lolo ja'a ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka. salam, lukas

source_text: from the first he was the word, and the word was in relation with god and was god.
target_text: dhu uru tèka, abhu mema le lii holo-nori ama lamatua. lii holo-nori ama lamatua ne'e, nuka dhèu èci. dhèu ne'e bera-bera dènge ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne, ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: this word was from the first in relation with god.
target_text: lod'o liru dènge rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, dhèu ne'e abhu mema le sama-sama dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: all things came into existence through him, and without him nothing was.
target_text: lamatua paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu, pake lii holo-nori nèngu ne'e ka. abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu j'aj'i, ladhe dhèu ne'e tao boe.

source_text: what came into existence in him was life, and the life was the light of men.
target_text: nèngu ne, kapua mamuri. de dhèu dhu abhu mamuri dhu lèke, rèngu mamuri nèti nèngu ka. nèngu èci èèna ka dènge saraa dhu pasaraa, sèna ka dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa ne'e, bisa rèdhi dènge mèu.

source_text: and the light goes on shining in the dark; it is not overcome by the dark.
target_text: saraa ne, heo madhore maroga; aa maroga bisa boe pa'abhe saraa ne. te saraa ne heo taruu.

source_text: there was a man sent from god, whose name was john.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo èci, ngara na yohanis. ama lamatua pua-paleha ne kahèi,

source_text: he came for witness, to give witness about the light, so that all men might have faith through him.
target_text: sèna ka j'aj'i sakasii ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti saraa ne. ho sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lamatua, lula lii padhai yohanis ne.

source_text: he himself was not the light: he was sent to give witness about the light.
target_text: yohanis ne, bukan saraa èèna. te ngaa lamatua pua ne ho la'e peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti saraa ne.

source_text: the true light, which gives light to every man, was then coming into the world.
target_text: te dhèu dhu j'aj'i saraa tare'a-re'a èèna, neo mai asa rai-haha ne. saraa ne'e ka dhu d'elo pamèu-mèu j'ara-j'ara hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he was in the world, the world which came into being through him, but the world had no knowledge of him.
target_text: masi ka nèngu tao nare aa'i mèu-mèu ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha tadhe boe ne, lod'o na pea ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: he came to the things which were his and his people did not take him to their hearts.
target_text: masi ka nèngu mai pea dènge dhèu unu na, te ngaa dhèu se'e ro'o boe sèmi rare ne.

source_text: to all those who did so take him, however, he gave the right of becoming children of god - that is, to those who had faith in his name:
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ladhe dhèu sèmi rare aa parcaya ne, nèngu hia si hak sèna ka j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: whose birth was from god and not from blood, or from an impulse of the flesh and man's desire.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi rara iisi hari rèngu. te ngaa rara iisi hiu ne, sama boe dènge bhèni rara iisi ana. aa nèti boe dad'èi dhèu mone dhu neo abhu kolo. te rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua, lula lamatua pangèd'u si mamuri hiu.

source_text: and so the word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory - such glory as is given to an only son by his father - saw it to be true and full of grace.
target_text: hèia, ‘lii holo-nori lamatua' ne, rara iisi ne j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. nèngu mamuri ètu talora aae èdhi. èdhi ladhe tèdhi dadedha na. dadedha na sèmi èèna, lula nèngu ne ana mesa ama lamatua. nèngu d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula d'ara na sèmi èèna ka. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu na peka-padhai lula-nèti ama lamatua, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: john gave witness about him, crying, this is he of whom i said, he who is coming after me is put over me because he was in existence before me.
target_text: yohanis ne, lole lula-nèti dhèu ne'e ka. na rodhe, peka na, nanene, ee! nèngu ne'e ka dhu ja'a lole èèna, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai. nèngu ne, kapai risi eele nèti ja'a. lod'o dhu dhae rara iisi mèka ja'a ne, nèngu dhu mema-mema le! '

source_text: from his full measure we have all been given grace on grace.
target_text: yohanis padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dhèu ne d'èi titu kèna pad'elo d'ara hua iia na. aa na tao taruu-taruu sèmi èèna hia mi èdhi.

source_text: for the law was given through moses; grace and the true way of life are ours through jesus christ.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, musa ka dhu papuru atora ama lamatua mi bèi-baki èdhi. te ngaa lod'o limuri ne, dhèu ne, nuka yesus kristus ka dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ama lamatua mi èdhi. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu na lole lula-nèti ama lamatua, lèke mola-mola.

source_text: no man has seen god at any time; the only son, who is on the breast of the father, he has made clear what god is.
target_text: abhu mèka ca dhèu sa hèi dhu rèdhi ama lamatua. te ngaa ana pasue mone mesa na èèna ka dhu pad'elo mi èdhi, d'ara ama lamatua. ana ne, ètu baboa ama na. te nèngu ne, nuka ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and this is the witness of john when the jews sent priests and levites from jerusalem to him with the question, who are you?
target_text: ca tèka, ama-ama dhèu yahudi ètu kota yerusalem pua pèri-pèri ama agama, dènge pèri-pèri dhèu nèti suku lewi dhu tema lalau-lalo'o ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia rèngu lasi asa cabèka loko yarden sèna ka karèi yohanis tuka sarani, na, èu ne'e ka, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai èèna, do? hèia na peka dènge dhèu se, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: he said quite openly and straightforwardly, i am not the christ.
target_text: yohanis peka mola-mola, aku nèngu na, aad'o. ja'a ne, kristus boe.

source_text: and they said to him, what then? are you elijah? and he said, i am not. are you the prophet? and his answer was, i am not.
target_text: ka ra karèi hari, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ne, cee? elia, do? na dhaa, peka na, aad'o kahèi. hèia ra tatu'i hari, aku rèngu na, tao-tao èu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu na padhadha tèka èèna, do? na dhaa, peka na, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: so they said to him, who are you then? we have to give some answer to those who sent us. what have you to say about yourself?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ne, cee? peka ku laa! te ji'i lèpa, aa hud'i peka ku dènge ama-ama dhu pua ji'i mai!

source_text: he said, i am the voice of one crying in the waste land, make straight the way of the lord, as said isaiah the prophet.
target_text: hèia na peka madhutu ngaa dhu yesaya suri tèke, na, ja'a ne, nuka dhèu dhu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, dhu peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i pa'èra mema, sèna ka pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru ne. '

source_text: those who had been sent came from the pharisees.
target_text: ètu talora aae dhèu dhu mai nèti yerusalem se'e, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi.

source_text: and they put this question to him, saying, why then are you giving baptism if you are not the christ, or elijah, or the prophet?
target_text: dhèu se karèi yohanis, na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu ne kristus boe, elia boe, aa dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èèna boe, nga tao ka èu sarani dhèu? èu abhu hak nèti mia?

source_text: john's answer was: i give baptism with water; but there is one among you of whom you have no knowledge;
target_text: ka yohanis b'ala, peka na, ja'a ne, sarani dhèu dhoka pake èi di. te ngaa abhu le ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu miu tadhe boe.

source_text: it is he who is coming after me; i am not good enough to undo his shoes.
target_text: nèngu èèna kapai risi nèti ja'a, masi ka ja'a aj'a-nori uuru dhèu. j'aj'i ènu na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi.

source_text: these things took place at bethany on the other side of the jordan, where john was giving baptism.
target_text: j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ètu betania, ètu cabèka loko yarden. yohanis dènge ana-ana madhutu na aa'i-aa'i, sarani dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: the day after, john sees jesus coming to him and says, see, here is the lamb of god who takes away the sin of the world!
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yohanis ladhe nèdhi yesus kako mai asa nèngu. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe ku dhèu nèi! nèngu èèna ka, ana kahib'i-kalèbho ama lamatua dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: this is he of whom i said, one is coming after me who is put over me because he was in existence before me.
target_text: dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu ja'a peka le dènge miu med'a, na, ‘bèli-camèd'a abhu ca dhèu dhu cèu mai. nèngu kapai risi nèti ja'a, lula nèngu karèi uru j'ara nèti ja'a. '

source_text: i myself had no knowledge of him, but i came giving baptism with water so that he might be seen openly by israel.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèka, na, nèngu ne, kristus. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a ke'a le, na, ja'a hud'i patadhe ne dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai ho sarani dhèu pake èi.

source_text: and john gave this witness, saying, i saw the spirit coming down from heaven like a dove and resting on him. i had no knowledge who he was, but he who sent me to give baptism with water said to me, the one on whom you see the spirit coming down and resting, it is he who gives baptism with the holy spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka sarani dhèu pake èi. na peka dènge ja'a kahèi, na, ‘èèna na dhèu èci mai asa èu. èle èèna, roh ja'a puru mai asa nèngu. dhèu èèna ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèti roh ja'a dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu ja'a. ' lod'o dhèu ne mai, ja'a tadhe mèka ne. te ngaa ropa ladhe kèdhi roh lamatua puru mai nèti sorga nuka sèmi koro j'aha, hèia pea ètu nèngu, ka ja'a heka tadhe nèngu, na, ‘nèngu èèna, kèna! '

source_text: this i saw myself and my witness is that he is the son of god.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi j'ara se dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ka ja'a lole dènge miu, na, ‘dhèu dhu mai èèna, ana ama lamatua! '

source_text: the day after, john was there again with two of his disciples;
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yohanis dhu titu dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu dua.

source_text: and looking at jesus while he was walking he said, see, there is the lamb of god!
target_text: ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi yesus kako re era èèna, ka na peka, ladhe ku laa! te nèngu ne ka ana kahib'i-kalèbho ama lamatua dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i korban!

source_text: hearing what he said, the two disciples went after jesus.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yohanis dhèu dua dhu tadèngi lii padhai na, tèke eele ne, ho lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and jesus, turning round, saw them coming after him and said to them, what are you looking for? they said to him, rabbi which is to say, master, where are you living?
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa kabodho, hèia ladhe nèdhi si, na, rèngu madhutu ne. hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, tasamia? parluu, do? te ngaa dua ra karèi ne, rabi pea ètu mia? ètu d'ara lii aram rèngu, ‘rabi' sasoa na, ‘ama mese'.

source_text: he said to them, come and see. they went with him then and saw where he was living; and they were with him all that day: it was then about the tenth hour of the day.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, mai sèna ka mèdhi unu mi. hèia lasi madhutu ne, ka rèdhi era pea na. rèngu d'ai nèi, pe d'ara hake èpa nihia sa. ka ra pea dènge ne toke d'ai lod'o cèna.

source_text: andrew, simon peter's brother, was one of the two men who, hearing what john said, went after jesus.
target_text: nèti rèngu dua ra dhu tadèngi lii padhai yohanis, ka lasi dènge madhutu yesus, èci ngara na anderias. nèngu ne, ari simon petrus.

source_text: early in the morning he came across his brother and said to him, we have made discovery! it is the messiah! which is to say, the christ.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu, ka anderias la'e dènge tenge a'a na simon, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, a'a, ee! ji'i paraga le dènge mesias! madhutu lii rèngu, ‘mesias' sasoa na, ‘kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua padhadha tèke karèi nèti uru ka, ho neo hia mai. '

source_text: and he took him to jesus. looking at him fixedly jesus said, you are simon, the son of john; your name will be cephas which is to say, peter.
target_text: ka anderias lere nèti a'a na asa yesus. hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne, simon. ama mu, ka yohanis. mulai nèti doe ne'e dhèu paroa èu, ‘kefas' ‘kefas', èci èèna ka dènge ‘petrus', sasoa na ‘hadhu'.

source_text: the day after this, jesus had a desire to go into galilee. he came across philip and said to him, come and be my disciple. now philip's town was beth-saida, where andrew and peter came from.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu leo èci, ngara na pelipus. rae èta-èsu na betsaida. petrus dènge anderias nèti rae èèna kahèi. asa bèli èèna, yesus neo la'e asa propensi galilea. hèia na la'e paraga dènge pelipus, ka na gale ne, aku nèngu na, mai madhutu ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: philip came across nathanael and said to him, we have made a discovery! it is he of whom moses, in the law, and the prophets were writing, jesus of nazareth, the son of joseph.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e tenge natanel, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, angalai, ee! ji'i paraga le dènge dhèu dhu musa suri tèke ètu d'ara atora lamatua. dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra suri kahèi lula-nèti dhèu ne'e ne. dhèu ne, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ama na, ngara na yusuf.

source_text: nazareth! said nathanael, is it possible for any good to come out of nazareth? philip said to him, come and see.
target_text: te ngaa natanel dhaa, na, dhèu nasaret! ? abhu boe j'ara hua iia èci sa dhu cèu nèti nèi, nga! ka pelipus lii, peka na, wee! baku sèmi èèna. lati ho mèdhi unu mu!

source_text: jesus saw nathanael coming to him and said of him, see, here is a true son of israel in whom there is nothing false.
target_text: ropa natanel kako mai, yesus ladhe nèdhi le, ka na peka, nèngu ne dhèu d'ara mola! te d'ara na dhu ne'a boe pakapod'e. nèngu ne, dhèu isra'el tare'a-re'a!

source_text: nathanael said to him, where did you get knowledge of me? in answer jesus said, before philip was talking with you, while you were still under the fig-tree, i saw you.
target_text: ka natanel karèi, tasamia ka ama tadhe ja'a? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a kèdhi le èu, ropa èu dhu ae ètu mamaho aj'u èèna. lod'o èèna, pelipus dhae dhiu mèka paroa èu.

source_text: nathanael said to him, rabbi, you are the son of god, you are king of israel!
target_text: hèia natanel dhaa, peka na, ama mese ne, tatu ana ama lamatua! aa tatu ama dhèu aae ji'i dhèu isra'el kahèi!

source_text: in answer jesus said to him, you have faith because i said to you, i saw you under the fig-tree. you will see greater things than these.
target_text: yesus karèi ne, peka na, tao-tao èu ne lèka ja'a, lula deo na ja'a peka na, ‘ja'a ladhe kèdhi èu, ropa èu dhu ae ètu mamaho aj'u èèna, ' si? sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a pe èu mèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele hari!

source_text: and he said to him, truly i say to you all, you will see heaven opening and god's angels going up and coming down on the son of man.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi liru bhoke tèke. hèia ana-ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga ca'e-puru re baboa ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: on the third day two people were going to be married at cana in galilee. the mother of jesus was there:
target_text: asa camèd'a èèna, dhèu tao pesta kab'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. aa ina yesus ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and jesus with his disciples came as guests.
target_text: ra nèru yesus dènge ana madhutu na kahèi, ka rèngu lasi.

source_text: when they had not enough wine, the mother of jesus said to him, they have no wine.
target_text: ètu d'ara pesta kab'i ne, nèbhu boe ka èi anggor èle. hèia ina yesus la'e peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, soru-bara si ku laa! te èi anggor rèngu èle le.

source_text: jesus said to her, woman, this is not your business; my time is still to come.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ina. nga tao ka ina ku neo sèna ka ja'a ka ator? te lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: his mother said to the servants, whatever he says to you, do it.
target_text: te ngaa ina na peka dènge dhèu sab'a ètu sèra, na, nanene! ladhe na pua miu tao ngaa, na, mi tao madhutu laa.

source_text: now six pots of stone, every one taking two or three firkins of water, were placed there for the purpose of washing, as is the way of the jews.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu g'ala èna bua dhu dhèu tao nèti hadhu. g'ala cue, isi na pe d'ai pidhu nguru lèmi toke cangasu canguru lèmi liter èi. dhèu yahudi tema dhui èi nèti g'ala se ho pamèu ngi'u ra madhutu atora agama ra.

source_text: jesus said to the servants, make the pots full of water. and they made them full to the top.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu sab'a se, peka na, lami mere èi, ho isi papènu g'ala se. ka ra isi toke pènu oe bua eele.

source_text: then he said to them, now take some, and give it to the master of the feast. so they took it to him.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, dhui mere ciki, ho mèti asa lamatua tatao. hèia dhèu sab'a se madhutu kahèi.

source_text: after tasting the water which had now become wine, the master of the feast having no idea where it came from, though it was clear to the servants who took the water out sent for the newly-married man,
target_text: ropa lamatua pesta sèmi nare, ka na ngao. te ngaa re'a rare boe, èi ne dhu j'aj'i le anggor! dhèu ne malaa, te ne'a boe, na, dhèu se abhu anggor ne nèti mia. te ngaa dhèu sab'a se re'a. ka na paroa nare pengantin dhèu mone.

source_text: and said to him, every man first puts out his best wine and when all have had enough he puts out what is not so good; but you have kept the good wine till now.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. dhu tema le, lamatua èmu hia uuru ku anggor dhu be'a risi. ladhe dhèu rinu ae ku, heka hia anggor dhu ako karehe kèna. te ngaa èu tao leo. èu hia uuru anggor dhu ako karehe, heka limuri dhu be'a risi!

source_text: this, the first of his signs, jesus did at cana in galilee and let his glory be seen openly; and his disciples put their faith in him.
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. ne'e ne heka hiu-hiu kèna yesus tao tadha malaa dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. na pad'elo dadedha na sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na parcaya ne.

source_text: after this he went down to capernaum, with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples, and they were there not more than two or three days.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus, ina na, ari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, puru lasi asa kota kapernaum. te ngaa rèngu pea dhoka pèri lod'o di ètu èèna.

source_text: the time of the passover of the jews was near and jesus went up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, yesus ca'e la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and there in the temple he saw men trading in oxen and sheep and doves, and he saw the changers of money in their seats:
target_text: ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu pahia sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho, dènge koro j'aha dhu dhèu hèli ho j'aj'i korban. ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei ho pasilu doi dhu ra pake hia mi ama lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èèna.

source_text: and he made a whip of small cords and put them all out of the temple, with the sheep and the oxen, sending in all directions the small money of the changers and overturning their tables;
target_text: hèia yesus nare dhari pèri-pèri loa ho na èpi j'aj'i sèmi gui sa. ka na babège-lalèta dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti madha èmu èèna. nèngu bhabhoo eele sapi, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra kahèi. na lege eele mei, aa na ceb'e eele doi sèra kahèi.

source_text: and to those who were trading in doves he said, take these things away; do not make my father's house a market.
target_text: hèia na pua dhèu pahia koro j'aha sèra, aku nèngu na, mèti sa li'u manu-bhui dènge karogo ra sèra nèti ne'e! ne'e, era pahia-pahèli boe! baku tao èmu ama ku, j'aj'i mi era d'aga!

source_text: and it came to the minds of the disciples that the writings say, i am on fire with passion for your house.
target_text: ka ana madhutu na ngee rèdhi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ja'a sue èmu ama ku titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a èra ho j'aga ngara be'a èmu èèna.

source_text: then the jews put this question to him: what sign of authority have you to give us, seeing that you do these things?
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu dènge hak ho babège-lalèta dhèu sèmi ne'e, na, mu pad'elo tadha malaa èci hia ji'i, sèna ka j'aj'i mi bukti!

source_text: and jesus said to them, send destruction on this temple and i will put it up again in three days.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, ladhe miu paguri era mola-mèci ne, pe camèd'a èèna, ja'a patitu kore hari le èèna.

source_text: the jews said, the building of this temple took forty-six years; and you will put it up in three days!
target_text: te ngaa ra pab'ala, peka na, abhu ètu mia? te dhèu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne èpa nguru èna tèu. tasamia ka, èu peka na, èu parluu dhoka tèlu lod'o di, sèna ka patitu more hari? !

source_text: but his words were about that holy building which was his body.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e re'a rare boe, yesus peka lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na, dhu nuka sèmi era mola-mèci.

source_text: so when he had come back again from the dead, the memory of these words came back to the disciples, and they had faith in the holy writings and in the word which jesus had said.
target_text: de d'ai lèpa lod'o limuri, ropa yesus madhe, hèia mamuri hari, heka ana-ana madhutu na sanèd'e kèna, ngaa dhu na peka tèke dènge rèngu. ka ra parcaya ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua karèi nèti uru-uru ka, dènge ngaa dhu yesus peka mema dènge rèngu.

source_text: now while he was in jerusalem at the feast of the passover, a great number of people came to have faith in his name, after seeing the signs which he did.
target_text: ka yesus pea taha ètu kota yerusalem, ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. hèia dhèu ae rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra parcaya ne.

source_text: but jesus did not have faith in them, because he had knowledge of them all. he had no need for any witness about man; for he himself had knowledge of what was in man.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lèka boe rèngu, lula ne'a mèu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèngu parluu boe dhèu ho peka dènge ne, lula na ne'a mema le mamuri dènge tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: now there was among the pharisees a man named nicodemus, who was one of the rulers of the jews.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne, mese aae nèti dhèu yahudi.

source_text: he came to jesus by night and said to him, rabbi, we are certain that you have come from god as a teacher, because no man would be able to do these signs which you do if god was not with him.
target_text: ca tèka, na mai paraga dènge yesus re mèda. hèia na padhai lii dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ama ho aj'a-nori ji'i. te tadha-tadha malaa dhu ama tao sèra, pad'elo, na, lamatua ka dhu pangèd'u koasa mi ama. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, tatu tadha malaa se'e bisa boe j'aj'i.

source_text: jesus said to him, truly, i say to you, without a new birth no man is able to see the kingdom of god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! aa ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e ku: ladhe dhèu rara iisi hari boe ne, nèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: nicodemus said to him, how is it possible for a man to be given birth when he is old? is he able to go into his mother's body a second time and come to birth again?
target_text: hèia nikodemus karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia dhèu dhu kapai le bisa rara iisi hari ne! ? nèngu tatu bisa boe maso hari asa d'ara kabake ina na, sèna ka ina na nara iisi hari ne. bisa boe, sina ma! ?

source_text: jesus said in answer, truly, i say to you, if a man's birth is not from water and from the spirit, it is not possible for him to go into the kingdom of god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te ngaa ja'a peka dènge èu sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i rara iisi ku re èi sèna ka j'aj'i mèu, aa re roh ho j'aj'i dhèu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu heka bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua kèna.

source_text: that which has birth from the flesh is flesh, and that which has birth from the spirit is spirit.
target_text: te dhèu rai-haha ne rara iisi nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa roh dhèu rara iisi hiu nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: do not be surprised that i say to you, it is necessary for you to have a second birth.
target_text: baku malaa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘miu hud'i rara iisi hiu ku, ho abhu mamuri hiu. '

source_text: the wind goes where its pleasure takes it, and the sound of it comes to your ears, but you are unable to say where it comes from and where it goes: so it is with everyone whose birth is from the spirit.
target_text: èdhi pasoro ku dènge lai ngèlu. te lai ngèlu g'oro madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi bisa tadèngi lii na, te ngaa te'a boe mai nèti mia, aa la'e asa mia. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rara iisi hiu nèti roh lamatua sama sèmi èèna kahèi. te èdhi bisa ladhe tèdhi roh lamatua tao dhèu j'aj'i hiu, masi ka te'a boe tasa mera mia j'ara èèna bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: and nicodemus said to him, how is it possible for these things to be?
target_text: ka nikodemus karèi, na, tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: and jesus, answering, said, are you the teacher of israel and have no knowledge of these things?
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, èu ne mese aae dhèu isra'el. tasamia ka èu me'a boe j'ara se'e?

source_text: truly, i say to you, we say that of which we have knowledge; we give witness of what we have seen; and you do not take our witness to be true.
target_text: ja'a peka j'ara dhu lèke mola-mola. ja'a dènge dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nge'a j'ara se'e. te ji'i j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu ngèdhi unu mi. te ngaa miu sèmi boe lii padhai ji'i.

source_text: if you have no belief when my words are about the things of earth, how will you have belief if my words are about the things of heaven?
target_text: miu mo'o boe lèka, ropa ja'a lole lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari ladhe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu dedha-liru nèi. tatu miu asa lèka boe!

source_text: and no one has ever gone up to heaven but he who came down from heaven, the son of man.
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ca'e la'e paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu dedha-liru nèi. dhodhoka ja'a di, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dhu puru mai nèti nèngu.

source_text: as the snake was lifted up by moses in the waste land, even so it is necessary for the son of man to be lifted up:
target_text: uru-uru sèra ètu d'ara mamoo, musa kadhoe mege tabaga ci'u ètu kolo aj'u, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu laladhe ne, rèngu abhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi èèna hud'i j'aj'i ku mi dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ra kadhoe ja'a ètu aj'u,

source_text: so that whoever has faith may have in him eternal life.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for god had such love for the world that he gave his only son, so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.
target_text: te ama lamatua sue seli dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, na pua ja'a, ana mesa na mai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, cèri eele boe nèti lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: god did not send his son into the world to be judge of the world; he sent him so that the world might have salvation through him.
target_text: lamatua pua boe ja'a, ana na, mai asa rai-haha ne ho pama'ète hahuku dhèu. te ngaa na hia ja'a mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: the man who has faith in him does not come up to be judged; but he who has no faith in him has been judged even now, because he has no faith in the name of the only son of god.
target_text: ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a. te ngaa nèngu dhu pama'ète nare le hahuku mi dedha dhèu dhu parcaya boe, lula rèngu parcaya boe ja'a, nuka ana mesa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and this is the test by which men are judged: the light has come into the world and men have more love for the dark than for the light, because their acts are evil.
target_text: nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le saraa ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhèu d'èi risi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. rèngu ro'o boe mamuri ètu d'ara saraa lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua neo huku si.

source_text: the light is hated by everyone whose acts are evil and he does not come to the light for fear that his acts will be seen.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatao ra lèke boe, d'èi boe saraa èèna. rèngu d'èi boe saraa ne d'elo rèngu, sèna ka saraa ne baku pasabhoka bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but he whose life is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that his acts have been done by the help of god.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao lèke, rèngu ara mai sèna ka saraa ne d'elo si. te saraa ne'e ka dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: after these things jesus and his disciples went into the land of judaea, and there he was with them for some time, giving baptism.
target_text: ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti kota yerusalem, te ngaa rèngu pea taha ètu rai yudea. ètu era ne'e rèngu sarani dhèu.

source_text: now john was then giving baptism at aenon near salim, because there was much water there; and people came and were given baptism. for at this time john had not been put into prison.
target_text: lod'o èèna, herodes si dhae pamaso mèka yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara bèdho. aa yohanis sarani dhèu ètu rae ainon, padètu dènge rae salim, lula abhu èi ae ètu era èèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai asa yohanis ho na sarani si.

source_text: then a question came up between john's disciples and a jew about washing.
target_text: madhutu ad'a agama yahudi, ladhe neo sabaj'a, hud'i pamèu uuru ku iisi. ètu era ne'e abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu dhu patao-palaha dènge ana-ana madhutu yohanis, lula j'ara èèna.

source_text: and they went to john and said to him, rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the jordan, the man to whom you gave witness, is now giving baptism, and everyone is going to him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mai asa yohanis, hèia ra peka na, ama mese! sanèd'e era, do aad'o? dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge ama ètu sebhe loko yarden, dhu ama peka na, nèngu èèna, kristus. nèngu sarani dhèu kahèi! nèti èèna ka, abhu heka dhèu dhu mai asa ji'i! te lasi aa'i asa nèngu!

source_text: and this was john's answer: a man is unable to have anything if it is not given to him from heaven.
target_text: hèia yohanis dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa, ladhe ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara hia ne.

source_text: you yourselves give witness that i said, i am not the christ. what i said was, i am sent before the christ.
target_text: miu tadèngi dhu ja'a peka le mola-mola dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus boe, dhu èdhi tatae. te ngaa lamatua pua uuru ja'a mai, ho oti j'ara hia kristus. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! '

source_text: he who has the bride is the husband: but the husband's friend, whose place is by his side and whose ears are open to him, is full of joy because of the husband's voice: such is my joy, and it is complete.
target_text: ladhe abhu pengantin dhèu mone, tatu abhu pengantin dhèu bhèni kahèi. te ngaa sakasii na, dhu titu dènge ne, d'ara na karej'e, ladhe tadèngi lii padhai lii pengantin dhèu mone. yesus ne, sama sèmi pengantin dhèu mone. aa ja'a ne, sama sèmi sakasii na. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: he has to become greater while i become less.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, nèngu hud'i asa tabha kapai, aa hud'i laa ja'a asa kura j'aj'i dhèu haha.

source_text: he who comes from heaven is greater than all others: he who comes from earth is of the earth, and of the earth are his words: he who comes from heaven is over all.
target_text: yohanis tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, nèti èèna ka nèngu kapai risi aa'i. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka mai nèti rai-haha, nèti èèna ka ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a padhai lii lula-nèti j'ara dhu biasa j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhu mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, tatu nèngu kapai risi nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he gives witness of what he has seen and of what has come to his ears; and no man takes his witness as true.
target_text: nèngu peka lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèdhi, dènge ngaa dhu na tadèngi le. te ngaa dhèu sèmi boe lii padhai na.

source_text: he who so takes his witness has made clear his faith that god is true.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sèmi rare ngaa dhu dhèu nèti dedha-liru ne peka, èèna pad'elo bukti kahèi, na, nèngu parcaya lii padhai ama lamatua èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: for he whom god has sent says god's words; and god does not give him the spirit by measure.
target_text: dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna, lole lii moa ama lamatua. te ama lamatua hia le nèngu roh na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: the father has love for the son and has put all things into his hands.
target_text: te ama ètu sorga sue ana na titu kèna. aa na pangèd'u aa'i mèu-mèu mi d'ara adhe-aai ana na.

source_text: he who has faith in the son has eternal life; but he who has not faith in the son will not see life; god's wrath is resting on him.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu parcaya ana ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne, aa tao boe madhutu lii moa na, rèngu abhu boe mamuri èèna. tatu ama lamatua nasa ka huku si.

source_text: now when it was clear to the lord that word had come to the ears of the pharisees that jesus was making more disciples than john and was giving them baptism though, in fact, it was his disciples who gave baptism, not jesus himself,
target_text: ladhe pasoro yohanis dènge yesus, ana-ana madhutu yesus mulai sarani dhèu dhu madhutu ne ae risi nèti yohanis. yesus sarani boe dhèu, dhodhoka ana madhutu na ka dhu sarani si. ka ropa yesus ne'a, na, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi re'a, na, yesus si sarani dhèu ae risi,

source_text: he went out of judaea into galilee again.
target_text: hèia nèngu dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele rai yudea, lèpa hari asa propensi galilea.

source_text: and it was necessary for him to go through samaria.
target_text: te ngaa kakako rèngu èèna re propensi samaria asa propensi galilea.

source_text: so he came to a town of samaria which was named sychar, near to the bit of land which jacob gave to his son joseph:
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako ra, rèngu d'ai kota èci ètu samaria, ngara na sikar, padètu dènge rai dhu yakob hia ana na yusuf.

source_text: now jacob's fountain was there. jesus, being tired after his journey, was resting by the fountain. it was about the sixth hour. a woman of samaria came to get water, and jesus said to her, give me some water. for his disciples had gone to the town to get food.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu madha èi èci, ngara na ‘madha èi yakob'. d'ai loo nètu ku, yesus si d'ai era ne'e. lula j'èra nèti kakako deo na, ka yesus madhèdi taha ètu madha èi ne'e. ka ana madhutu na sèra tèke eele mesa na, lasi hèli nganga'a ètu d'ara kota. hèia bhèni ca dhèu nèti kota èèna, mai usu èi. ka yesus manèngi ne èi, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa kinu èi ciki, do?

source_text: the woman of samaria said to him, why do you, a jew, make a request for water to me, a woman of samaria? she said this because jews have nothing to do with the people of samaria.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne cag'ag'a, lula dhèu yahudi tema boe padhai lii dènge dhèu samaria. ka bhèni ne karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, èu dhèu yahudi. ja'a ne dhèu samaria. sala boe ne, ladhe èu manèngi ja'a èi ho minu?

source_text: in answer jesus said, if you had knowledge of what god gives freely and who it is who says to you, give me water, you would make your prayer to him, and he would give you living water.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu me'a ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne cee, dhu manèngi èu èi ne, na, tatu èu manèngi hari èi nèti ja'a. pe ja'a hia èu èi dhu nèti mamuri.

source_text: the woman said to him, sir, you have no vessel and the fountain is deep; from where will you get the living water?
target_text: ka bhèni ne b'ala, peka na, èu dènge boe sabha uusu. aa madha èi ne marèma. nèti mia èu abhu èi dhu nèti mamuri èèna? èi èèna abhu ètu mia hari?

source_text: are you greater than our father jacob who gave us the fountain and took the water of it himself, with his children and his cattle?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èu kapai risi nèti baki èdhi yakob! nèngu ka dhu tèke eele madha èi ne hia ji'i. aa nèngu, ana-ana na, dènge badha-manu na rinu nèti èi ne'e kahèi.

source_text: jesus said to her, everyone who takes this water will be in need of it again:
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, sanèd'e, ee! dhèu dhu tema rinu nèti madha èi ne, èèna na koko-kamango hari.

source_text: but whoever takes the water i give him will never be in need of drink again; for the water i give him will become in him a fountain of eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu rinu èi dhu ja'a hia, èèna na koko-kamango heka. te èi dhu ja'a hia èèna, nuka sèmi èi madha dhu sabhoka asa li'u. èi ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: the woman said to him, sir, give me this water, so that i may not be in need again of drink and will not have to come all this way for it.
target_text: ka aku dhèu bhèni ne, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, èu hia ku ja'a èi èèna, sèna ka ja'a koko-kamango ia ka! dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a mai heka pahari-pahari asa ne'e ho usu èi.

source_text: jesus said to her, go, get your husband and come back here with him.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. èu lèpa, lamu paroa ku dhèu èmu mu, mai asa ne'e.

source_text: in answer, the woman said, i have no husband. jesus said to her, you have said rightly, i have no husband: you have had five husbands, and the man you have now is not your husband: that was truly said.
target_text: ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe dhèu èmu. hèia yesus peka na, tare'a. èu peka mola-mola èèna. te èu leo mèdhi le èmu lèmi hari. aa mone dhu limuri ne, dhèu èmu èu boe.

source_text: the woman said to him, sir, i see that you are a prophet.
target_text: ka bhèni ne lii, peka na, ira ii! ja'a heka ke'a kèna, ama ne ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: our fathers gave worship on this mountain, but you jews say that the right place for worship is in jerusalem.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi. bèi-baki ji'i dhèu samaria pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe gerisim. te ngaa miu dhèu yahudi peka na, ladhe neo sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa kota yerusalem. madhutu ama, mia ka dhu lèke?

source_text: jesus said to her, woman, take my word for this; the time is coming when you will not give worship to the father on this mountain or in jerusalem.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, èu parcaya ku lii ja'a ne, te dhu lèke sèmi ne'e ku. dhèu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe ne'e, do, ètu yerusalem, pe d'ai lod'o na, dua era se guna heka.

source_text: you give worship, but without knowledge of what you are worshipping: we give worship to what we have knowledge of: for salvation comes from the jews.
target_text: miu dhèu samaria me'a mèu boe, mi cee ka miu pahaha iisi. te ngaa ji'i dhèu yahudi nge'a mèu, lula-nèti ama lamatua dhu ji'i pahaha iisi mi nèngu. te nèngu neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa abhu mamuri nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: but the time is coming, and is even now here, when the true worshippers will give worship to the father in the true way of the spirit, for these are the worshippers desired by the father.
target_text: pe d'ai lod'o na, nuka mulai ne'e ne, dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a pahaha iisi mi ama èdhi ètu sorga, na, rèngu pahaha iisi mi nèngu madhutu roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. te ama ètu sorga d'èi dhèu sèmi sèra dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: god is spirit: then let his worshippers give him worship in the true way of the spirit.
target_text: te lamatua èèna, roh. de dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu hud'i pahaha iisi madhutu ku roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: the woman said to him, i am certain that the messiah, who is named christ, is coming; when he comes he will make all things clear to us.
target_text: ka dhèu bhèni ne lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a le mesias neo mai èèna, dhu dhèu peka na, ‘kristus'. ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai. ladhe na mai ka, tatu nèngu bhoke paled'a aa'i-aa'i mi ji'i.

source_text: jesus said to her, i, who am talking to you, am he.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, na, nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: at that point the disciples came back, and they were surprised to see him talking to a woman; but not one of them said to him, what is your purpose? or, why are you talking to her?
target_text: ropa nèngu padhai lii era, ana madhutu na sèra lèpa nèti d'ara kota. rèngu malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge bhèni samaria ca dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu sa bani boe karèi dhèu bhèni, na, èu parluu ngaa? aa èci sa bani boe karèi yesus kahèi, peka na, nga tao ka ama padhai lii dènge dhèu bhèni ne?

source_text: then the woman put down her water-pot and went into the town, and said to the people,
target_text: ka bhèni ne tèke eele g'ala na ètu era èèna, la'e asa d'ara kota. hèia na lolo dènge dhèu ètu sèra, peka na,

source_text: come and see a man who has been talking to me of everything i ever did! is it possible that this is the christ?
target_text: mai lati ladhe ku dhèu nèi laa! te na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi. tao-tao nèngu ne'e ka, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pamoa hia mai!

source_text: so they went out of the town and came to him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae kalua nèti d'ara kota, lasi laladhe ne.

source_text: while this was taking place, the disciples were saying to jesus, master, take some food.
target_text: lod'o bhèni ne la'e asa kota, hèia ana madhutu na peka dènge ne, ama mese! mai ka ta'a!

source_text: but he said to them, i have food of which you have no knowledge.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, peka na, ja'a abhu le nganga'a dhu miu me'a boe.

source_text: so the disciples said one to another, did anyone give him food?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, tasamia, ne? cee ka dhu rèti nganga'a hia ne?

source_text: jesus said, my food is to do the pleasure of him who sent me and to make his work complete.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, sèmi ne'e. ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na, aa pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke d'ai èle. ne'e ne, nuka sèmi nganga'a-nginu dhu ja'a abhu.

source_text: you would say, four months from now is the time of the grain-cutting. take a look, i say to you, at the fields; they are even now white for cutting.
target_text: miu ladhe ku asa d'ara oka-tedhe, aa mi kasere sèku, ele boe miu peka na, ‘di èpa hèru ka, heka bisa puru are kèna. ' nanene, ee! ja'a pasanèd'e miu. ladhe miu laladhe paie-iie, are ètu d'ara oka-tedhe d'ai le lod'o puu-g'ètu. oka-tedhe sèra nuka sèmi dhèu-dhèu dhu mai asa èdhi. te rèngu se'e ka dhu sadia le parcaya ja'a.

source_text: he who does the cutting now has his reward; he is getting together fruit for eternal life, so that he who did the planting and he who gets in the grain may have joy together.
target_text: mesa boe sèmi se'e di, te dhèu dhu puu-g'ètu sèra pakaboko hua-hela ètu d'ara gud'a, rèngu mulai sèmi rare rui-j'aj'èra ra. rèngu se'e, nuka sèmi dhèu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu parcaya mi ama lamatua, ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu sèle hini dènge dhèu puu-g'ètu, bisa sama-sama karej'e-karae.

source_text: in this the saying is a true one, one does the planting, and another gets in the grain.
target_text: dhèu peka na, ‘dhèu èci sèle hini; dhèu leo ka dhu kaboko isi rai. ' èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: i sent you to get in grain which you had no hand in planting: other men did that work, and you take the reward.
target_text: ja'a pua-paleha miu ho lami kaboko isi rai nèti sasab'a dhèu leo. mema sasab'a miu boe, te ngaa miu abhu leto nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu.

source_text: now a number of the people of that town had faith in him because of the woman's witness: he has been talking to me of everything i ever did.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu d'ara kota samaria ae ka dhu parcaya yesus, lula lii padhai bhèni ne, dhu peka na, na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi.

source_text: so when the people came to him they made request to him to be among them for a time, and he was there two days.
target_text: ka ropa dhèu se'e mai d'ai madha yesus, ra pamako ne, peka na, ama pea ku laa dènge ji'i mi ne'e! hèia yesus pea dènge dhèu se, dua lod'o.

source_text: and a great number more of them came to have faith in him because of what he himself said.
target_text: aa dhèu leo ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne, lula lii padhai na.

source_text: and they said to the woman, now we have faith, but not because of your story: we ourselves have given ear to his words, and we are certain that he is truly the saviour of the world.
target_text: hèia dhèu se peka dènge dhèu bhèni ne, aku rèngu na, med'a na, ji'i nanene dhoka lii èu di. te ngaa ne'e ne ji'i parcaya ne, lula ji'i nanene lii padhai na patoo madha dènge madha. ji'i nge'a tare'a, na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu bisa patalale èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: and after the two days he went on from there into galilee.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele era èèna, pakèd'i lasi asa propensi galilea.

source_text: for jesus himself said that a prophet has no honour in the country of his birth.
target_text: ca tèka yesus dhu peka nèdhi, na, dhèu d'èi boe pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae èta-èsu na.

source_text: so when he came into galilee, the galilaeans took him to their hearts because of the things which they had seen him do in jerusalem at the feast - they themselves having been there at the feast.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhèu dhae tao mèka kalela paska, dhèu galilea ae ka dhu lasi asa yerusalem, sèna ka tao lod'o hua iia ètu nèi. ka rèdhi aa'i-aa'i kahèi dhu yesus tao ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, lod'o na lèpa asa galilea, dhèu sèmi ne dènge be'a.

source_text: so he came to cana in galilee, where he had made the water wine. and there was a certain man of high position whose son was ill at capernaum.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi hari asa rae kana ètu propensi galilea. ètu era ne'e ka dhu yesus tao nèdhi èi j'aj'i anggor. lod'o èèna, abhu pegawi ca dhèu dhu pea ètu kota kapernaum. ana mone na dhu pèd'a.

source_text: when it came to his ears that jesus had come from judaea into galilee, he went to him and made a request that he would come down to his son, who was near to death, and make him well.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi, yesus lèpa le asa galilea nèti propensi yudea, hèia ca'e la'e asa rae kana ho tenge yesus. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako, sèna ka yesus puru la'e ho puri-pa'èle ana na nèti papèd'a-tarègu. te ana ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: then jesus said to him, you will not have faith if you do not see signs and wonders.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge pegawi ne, ladhe miu mèdhi boe tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao, na, miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a!

source_text: the man said, sir, come down before my boy is dead.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, lati ku laa. te aad'o, na, ana ja'a madhe.

source_text: and jesus said, go in peace; your son is living. the man had faith in the word which jesus said to him and went away.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, lèpa ka. te ana mu mamuri. ka na lèpa dènge ka, lula nèngu parcaya lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and while he was going down, his servants came to him and said, your boy is living.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu-dhèu sab'a na mai paraga dènge ne, ka ra peka na, ama susa ia ka, te ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: so he put a question to them as to the hour when he became better; and they said to him, the disease went from him yesterday at the seventh hour.
target_text: ka na karèi si, na èle, d'ara hake pèri sa? ka dhèu se dhaa, peka na, karèi med'a, lod'o titu mera d'ara hake èci sa, maringi-sagoro na èle dènge ka.

source_text: it was clear then to the father that this was the very time at which jesus said to him, your son is living. and he had faith in jesus, he and all his family.
target_text: hèia pegawi ne ngee nèdhi dènge, na, ana na be'a le, ropa yesus peka na, ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a. ka pegawi ne, dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i parcaya yesus.

source_text: now this is the second sign which jesus did after he had come out of judaea into galilee.
target_text: de ne'e ne, tadha malaa ka dua dhu yesus tao, lod'o na kalua nèti yudea la'e asa galilea.

source_text: after these things there was a feast of the jews, and jesus went up to jerusalem.
target_text: nèbhu boe nèti èèna, abhu lod'o hua iia agama yahudi. ka yesus si lasi asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: now in jerusalem near the sheep-market there is a public bath which in hebrew is named beth-zatha. it has five doorways.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu kolam cue dhu dènge lèmi teras dhu padètu dènge hèb'a babèdho èci, dhu dhèu peka na, babèdho kahib'i-kalèbho. dènge lii aram kolam ne, ngara na ‘batesda'.

source_text: in these doorways there were a great number of people with different diseases: some unable to see, some without the power of walking, some with wasted bodies.
target_text: dhèu pèd'a ae-ae dhu tema mate ètu teras se'e. dhèu pèd'a se nuka sèmi: dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bisa boe eso. rèngu se mate, ladhe pèri lod'o èi ne mulai dènge gagèb'o.
te ca tèka-tèka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga maso uru asa d'ara èi ne, ho na gagèb'o èi ne. ho ladhe cee dhu maso uru asa d'ara èi ne, papèd'a nèngu èle dènge.

source_text: one man was there who had been ill for thirty-eight years.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu pèd'a tèlu nguru aru tèu le.

source_text: when jesus saw him there on the floor it was clear to him that he had been now a long time in that condition, and so he said to the man, is it your desire to get well?
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne j'unu ètu èèna. nèngu ne'a dhèu ne dhu pèd'a nèbhu le, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu neo èle nèti papèd'a, do?

source_text: the ill man said in answer, sir, i have nobody to put me into the bath when the water is moving; and while i am on the way down some other person gets in before me.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa, na, ko'o, ama. te ngaa ako carui ka, ladhe èi ne mulai gagèb'o, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ded'e ja'a ho pamaso asa d'ara èi ne. ladhe ja'a sèku maso, na, abhu le dhèu leo dhu maso uuru nèti ja'a.

source_text: jesus said to him, get up, take your bed and go.
target_text: ka yesus pua ne, aku nèngu na, titu ka! lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka.

source_text: and the man became well straight away, and took up his bed and went. now that day was the sabbath.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu ne èle dènge ka nèti karuku na. ka na kèd'i, ded'e nèti dhèpi na, hèia la'e dènge ka. j'ara ne j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: so the jews said to the man who had been made well, it is the sabbath; and it is against the law for you to take up your bed.
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi jèke dhèu dhu heka èle nèti papèd'a ne, aku rèngu na, weh! èu me'a, do aad'o? doe ne'e ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa boe nedhe dhèpi na, te èèna ngara na, sasab'a!

source_text: he said to them, but he who made me well, said to me, take up your bed and go.
target_text: ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! baku nasa dènge ja'a. te dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a, dhu paredha ja'a peka na, ‘lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: then they put to him the question: who is the man who said to you, take it up and go?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi ne, cee ka dhu pua èu nedhe dhèpi èèna?

source_text: now he who had been made well had no knowledge who it was, jesus having gone away because of the number of people who were in that place.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu èle nèti pèd'a ne, tadhe boe, na, yesus ne, cee. te yesus dhu kalua le mau-mau, lula dhèu ae ètu èèna.

source_text: after a time jesus came across him in the temple and said to him, see, you are well and strong; do no more sin for fear a worse thing comes to you.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, nanene! èu èle le nèti papèd'a èu. baku ad'u-ue hari sasala, sèna ka èu baku abhu hari j'aj'èra dhu bia risi.

source_text: the man went away and said to the jews that it was jesus who had made him well.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne la'e asa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, ka na lolo, peka na, dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a nèti papèd'a èèna, ngara na yesus.

source_text: and for this reason the jews were turned against jesus, because he was doing these things on the sabbath.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra mulai paj'èra yesus, lula nèngu pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: but his answer was: my father is still working even now, and so i am working.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, sèmi ne'e. ama ku ae boe nèti sasab'a-la'a na. de ja'a sab'a taruu kahèi.

source_text: for this cause the jews had an even greater desire to put jesus to death, because not only did he not keep the sabbath but he said god was his father, so making himself equal with god.
target_text: lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi se cap le, peka na, yesus sisu atora lod'o ae sasab'a rèngu, nèti èèna ka ra tenge-tenge j'ara tasamia, ho pamadhe ne. risi-risi hari, na peka na, ama lamatua èèna, ama nèngu. dènge lii padhai sèmi ne'e, nèngu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua.

source_text: so jesus made answer and said, truly i say to you, the son is not able to do anything himself; he is able to do only what he sees the father doing; whatever the father does the son does it in the same way.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, tare'a! ja'a peka mema, na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu d'ara ja'a unu ku. te ja'a ne, ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa sab'a dhodhoka madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a kèdhi ama ku sab'a. ja'a kèdhi ama ku tao ngaa, na, ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for the father has love for the son and lets him see everything which he does: and he will let him see greater works than these so that you may be full of wonder.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a, nuka ana na. na pad'elo dènge ja'a kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tao. na neo pad'elo dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi hari, sèna ka miu mèdhi aa asa tabha malaa!

source_text: in the same way, as the father gives life to the dead, even so the son gives life to those to whom he is pleased to give it.
target_text: ama ku pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke mi cee èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: the father is not the judge of men, but he has given all decisions into the hands of the son;
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: ama ku mesa na pama'ète boe hahuku mi dhèu. te ngaa na pangèd'u aa'i hak èèna mi ja'a, te ja'a ne, ana na. hèia ja'a ka dhu pama'ète, na, tatao dhèu lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: so that all men may give honour to the son even as they give honour to the father. he who gives no honour to the son gives no honour to the father who sent him.
target_text: ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ja'a, sama sèmi rèngu pakab'ua nèngu kahèi. te dhèu dhu pakab'ua boe ja'a, ana nèngu ne, èci èèna ka rèngu pakab'ua boe ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: truly i say to you, the man whose ears are open to my word and who has faith in him who sent me, has eternal life; he will not be judged, but has come from death into life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lii padhai ja'a, aa parcaya ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai, na, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. lamatua huku heka nèngu. te dhèu èèna abhu heka hahuku madhe, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: truly i say to you, the time is coming, it has even now come, when the voice of the son of god will come to the ears of the dead, and those hearing it will have life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema dènge miu kèna. lod'o na dètu le, limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le, nuka dhèu-dhèu madhe nanene lii ja'a, ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu nanene dènge sèmi nare lii padhai ja'a, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for even as the father has life in himself, so he has given to the son to have life in himself.
target_text: mamuri aa'i-aa'i kapua na nèti ama ku. nèngu hia ja'a mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. te ja'a ne, ana na.

source_text: and he has given him authority to be judge because he is the son of man.
target_text: ama ku pangèd'u koasa dènge hak mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pama'ète hahuku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: do not be surprised at this: for the time is coming when his voice will come to all who are in the place of the dead,
target_text: miu baku malaa, te ciki oo'e hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra tadèngi lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: and they will come out; those who have done good, into the new life; and those who have done evil, to be judged.
target_text: hèia ra mamuri hari. ka rèngu kalua nèti d'ara ro'a ra. dhèu dhu uru sèra tao be'a, abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu uru sèra ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a, pasae hahuku taruu.

source_text: of myself i am unable to do anything: as the voice comes to me so i give a decision: and my decision is right because i have no desire to do what is pleasing to myself, but only what is pleasing to him who sent me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ladhe dhae tadèngi mèka nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a tadèngi kore ku, heka ja'a pama'ète lii langu dhèu kèna. nèti èèna ka, ngaa dhu ja'a pama'ète sèra, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku. lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai!

source_text: if i gave witness about myself, my witness would not be true.
target_text: lèke iia boe, ladhe ja'a mesa ku dhu padhue-padhai lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: there is another who gives witness about me and i am certain that the witness he gives about me is true.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ja'a. aa ja'a ke'a lii padhai nèngu lula-nèti ja'a, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: you sent to john and he gave true witness.
target_text: miu dhu pua mèdhi dhèu lasi pakarèi dènge yohanis tuka sarani. ka na peka lèke lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but i have no need of a man's witness: i only say these things so that you may have salvation.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a parluu boe lii sakasii nèti dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e lii se'e, sèna ka miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: he was a burning and shining light, and for a time you were ready to be happy in his light.
target_text: lii padhai yohanis ne, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu heo pasaraa miu. ropa heo na d'elo miu era, d'ara miu karej'e-karae.

source_text: but the witness which i have is greater than that of john: the work which the father has given me to do, the very work which i am now doing, is a witness that the father has sent me.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a abhu dhèu èci dhu kapai risi eele nèti yohanis dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a ne. nèngu, nuka ama ku ètu sorga, dhu pangèd'u mi ja'a sasab'a ae-ae, sèna ka sab'a toke pa'èle. sasab'a ae se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi tadha, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and the father himself who sent me has given witness about me. not one of you has ever given ear to his voice; his form you have not seen.
target_text: lula nèngu ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a, nèngu ka dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a kahèi. miu mesa mi tadèngi mèdhi mèka lii nèngu, do, patoo madha dènge madha, aa ladhe mèdhi mèka rèhu na.

source_text: and you have not kept his word in your hearts, because you have not faith in him whom he has sent.
target_text: lii holo-nori lamatua mamuri boe ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya boe ja'a dhu nèngu pua mai.

source_text: you make search in the holy writings, in the belief that through them you get eternal life; and it is those writings which give witness about me.
target_text: miu d'èi parisa toke lutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lula miu pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu j'ara ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. aa te ngaa sasuri sèra ka dhu lole lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and still you have no desire to come to me so that you may have life.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe ara mai asa ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i do not take honour from men;
target_text: ja'a parluu boe dhèu ded'e kolongara ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: but i have knowledge of you that you have no love for god in your hearts.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a mèu d'ara iiki miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, miu sue boe ama lamatua.

source_text: i have come in my father's name, and your hearts are not open to me. if another comes with no other authority but himself, you will give him your approval.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, lula ama ku dhu nèd'u koasa ka pua ja'a mai. te ngaa miu mo'o boe sèmi mere ja'a. aa te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo dhu mai pake koasa nèngu, miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: how is it possible for you to have faith while you take honour one from another and have no desire for the honour which comes from the only god?
target_text: miu èci dènge èci d'èi sèna ka abhu koa-kad'iri. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe, ladhe ama lamatua koa miu, do aad'o. aa te ngaa nèngu èèna, ama lamatua! abhu boe dhu leo. de ladhe miu pahae boe ne, na, tasamia miu bisa parcaya nèngu?

source_text: put out of your minds the thought that i will say things against you to the father: the one who says things against you is moses, on whom you put your hopes.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a pèci sasala mi dedha miu ètu katanga madha ama ku. aad'o. dhu pèci sasala sa dedha miu nuka musa. aa te ngaa, era maena miu ka nèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu hia miu atora ama lamatua.

source_text: if you had belief in moses you would have belief in me; for his writings are about me.
target_text: de ladhe miu lèka musa, tatu miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. te nèngu ka dhu suri lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: if you have no belief in his writings, how will you have belief in my words?
target_text: te ngaa lula miu parcaya èra boe mi ngaa dhu na suri, tasamia ka miu bisa lèka ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: after these things jesus went away to the other side of the sea of galilee - that is, the sea of tiberias. and a great number of people went after him because they saw the signs which he did on those who were ill. then jesus went up the mountain and was seated there with his disciples. now the passover, a feast of the jews, was near.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi oe dètu. hèia yesus si lasi asa cabèka dano galilea. ngara leo dano ne, ‘dano tiberias'. dhèu ae dhu madhutu ne, lula rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, lod'o puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a. d'ai cabèka dano, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na ca'e asa ledhe iiki èci. hèia ra madhèdi ètu era èèna.

source_text: lifting up his eyes, jesus saw a great number of people coming to where he was, and he said to philip, where may we get bread for all these people?
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae mai pakaboko, hèia na karèi ana madhutu na ca dhèu, ngara na pelipus, aku nèngu na, ètu era mia èdhi bisa hèli nganga'a, ho hia dhèu se ra'a?

source_text: this he said, testing him: for he had no doubt what he himself would do.
target_text: yesus ne'a le ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. te ngaa na peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka neo sèku pelipus.

source_text: philip made answer, bread to the value of two hundred pence would not be enough even to give everyone a little.
target_text: ka pelipus dhaa, na, waa! masi ka gaji tuka ca dhèu dua ngasu lod'o èèna ka, d'ai mèka hèli roti ho panga'a dhèu udhu sobhu-sobhu se! masi ka ca dhèu abhu roti ciki oo'e èèna ka, pad'ai boe hèi!

source_text: one of his disciples, andrew, the brother of simon peter, said to jesus,
target_text: hèia, ca dhèu hari nèti ana madhutu na, ngara na anderias, ari simon petrus, peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na,

source_text: there is a boy here with five barley cakes and two fishes: but what is that among such a number?
target_text: ama! ana iiki èci ètu ne'e nèti roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u. te ngaa d'ai dhèu ae-ae se ra'a, do aad'o?

source_text: jesus said, let the people be seated. now there was much grass in that place. and those seated on the grass were about five thousand.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, j'u'u muri ae-ae. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ator si madhèdi. hèia dhèu se madhèdi ka. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna. dhèu mone di, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: then jesus took the cakes and having given praise to god, he gave them to the people who were seated, and the fishes in the same way, as much as they had need of.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti se, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pangèd'u mi ana madhutu na sèra. sèna ka rèngu bagi hia dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra. na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge i'a sèra. dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and when they had had enough, jesus said to his disciples, take up the broken bits which are over, so that nothing may be wasted.
target_text: ropa ra'a toke bècu, hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pakaboko mere nganga'a dhu sisa se'e, sèna ka baku core eele iia d'ara.

source_text: so they took them up: twelve baskets full of broken bits of the five cakes which were over after the people had had enough.
target_text: ka ra pakaboko nganga'a dhu sisa nèti roti lèmi bua deo sa, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and when the people saw the sign which he had done, they said, truly, this is the prophet who is to come into the world.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae-ae se ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa dhu yesus tao ne, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! nèngu ne, tatu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na jaji le neo hia mai.

source_text: now when jesus saw that the people were about to come and take him by force to make him a king, he went away again up the mountain by himself.
target_text: yesus ne'a, na, dhèu se neo laka-seti ne sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia la'e tèke eele si, ka na ca'e asa era kaj'èu ètu ledhe iiki èci, sèna ka nèngu mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: when evening came the disciples went down to the sea;
target_text: ropa lod'o heka cèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus puru lasi asa sebhe dano.

source_text: and they took a boat and went across the sea in the direction of capernaum. by then it was dark and still jesus had not come to them.
target_text: yesus mai mèka pa'èci dènge rèngu. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia ra tuku lasi asa kota kapernaum ètu cabèka dano. ropa rèngu pakèd'i, lod'o dhu maroga le.

source_text: the sea was getting rough because of a strong wind which was blowing.
target_text: lula ngèlu aae, ka naha mulai kapai.

source_text: after they had gone three or four miles they saw jesus walking on the sea and coming near to the boat; and they had great fear.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yesus se'e tuku kaj'èu pe d'ai lèmi kilometer sa, hèia ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu kako re dedha èi. na mai padètu-dètu dènge koha rèngu, ka ra madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: but he said to them, it is i, have no fear.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, baku madha'u! te ja'a ne.

source_text: then they readily took him into the boat: and straight away the boat was at the land to which they were going.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu madha'u heka. aa ra neo sèna ka yesus ca'e sama-sama dènge rèngu. cag'ag'a laa, koha ne d'ai le dae dhu rèngu neo lasi.

source_text: the day after, the people who were on the other side of the sea saw that only one small boat had been there, that jesus had not gone in that boat with the disciples, but that the disciples had gone away by themselves. some other boats, however, came from tiberias near to the place where they had taken the bread after the lord had given praise. so when the people saw that jesus was not there, or his disciples, they got into those boats and went over to capernaum looking for jesus.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae sèra ètu cabèka dano era. rèngu padètu iiki dènge era dhu med'a na yesus manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, ropa hia si ra'a. hèia dhèu se re'a, na, med'a na koha dhoka cue di ètu era èèna. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus se pake koha ne, lasi tèke eele era ne'e, aa yesus dhu ca'e boe dènge rèngu. te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri koha leo nèti kota tiberias dhu lasi-mai ètu era èèna. hèia, ropa dhèu ae se re'a, na, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu aad'o heka, ka ra ca'e koha leo sèra lasi tenge yesus asa kapernaum, ètu cabèka dano.

source_text: and when they came across him on the other side of the sea they said, rabbi, when did you come here?
target_text: ka ra paraga dènge yesus ètu cabèka dano. hèia ra karèi yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ama d'ai era ne'e sange mera mia sa?

source_text: jesus, answering them, said, truly i say to you, you come after me, not because you saw signs, but because you were given the bread and had enough.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: miu se tenge ja'a lula boe miu mèdhi le tadha-tadha malaa, te ngaa lula ja'a panga'a miu toke bècu.

source_text: let your work not be for the food which comes to an end, but for the food which goes on for eternal life, which the son of man will give to you, for on him has god the father put his mark.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! baku sab'a tenge dhoka nganga'a di dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie d'ara. te ngaa be'a risi miu sab'a sèna ka abhu nganga'a dhu taha taruu, dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri èèna. te ama ètu sorga pangèd'u le hak mi ja'a ne.

source_text: then they said to him, how may we do the works of god?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ji'i hud'i tao tasamia, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus, answering, said to them, this is to do the work of god: to have faith in him whom god has sent.
target_text: yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sasab'a lamatua, sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a ne. te ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: so they said, what sign do you give us, so that we may see and have faith in you? what do you do?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ama neo pad'elo tadha malaa sèmi ngaa, ho ji'i ngèdhi aa parcaya ama? aa ama neo tao ngaa hari hia ji'i?
