target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu loli eele hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne. ka yesus ladhe asa dedha-liru, hèia na peka, ama! ja'a manèngi makasi, lula ama nanene ja'a.

source_text: i was certain that your ears are at all times open to me, but i said it because of these who are here, so that they may see that you sent me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a karèi nèti uru ka, na, ama nanene taruu ja'a. te ngaa doe ne ja'a peka sèmi ne'e, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu ne'e, bisa re'a, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: then he said in a loud voice, lazarus, come out!
target_text: ropa peka nare, hèia na paroa dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, lasarus! kalua ka!

source_text: and he who was dead came out, with linen bands folded tightly about his hands and feet, and a cloth about his face. jesus said to them, make him free and let him go.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe ne kalua nèti d'ara ro'a. kacui-aai dènge haga na pa'èki era dènge bèla hutu dhèu madhe. aa abhu bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na kahèi. yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, bhoke eele bèla hutu se, sèna ka na kako!

source_text: then a number of the jews who had come to mary and had seen the things which jesus did had belief in him.
target_text: ropa laladhe rèdhi tatao yesus ne, dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria, ae ka dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: but some of them went to the pharisees with the news of what jesus had done.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e kahèi dhu lasi paraga dènge dhèu nèti partei parisi, sèna ka peka tatao yesus ne dènge rèngu.

source_text: then the high priests and the pharisees had a meeting and said, what are we doing? this man is doing a number of signs.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi pakaboko ho padhue. ra pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa! de èdhi tao ne tasamia hari?

source_text: if we let him go on in this way, everybody will have belief in him and the romans will come and take away our place and our nation.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi soro tèke ne, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanao-maena nèngu j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èèna na sordad'u roma sèra mai paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi dènge palaho isi kabarai èdhi.

source_text: but one of them, caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, you have no knowledge of anything;
target_text: tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. na peka, na, goa, ee! miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: you do not see that it is in your interest for one man to be put to death for the people, so that all the nation may not come to destruction.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i, èèna be'a risi hia miu. te ladhe aad'o, na, sordad'u roma mai, pamadhe aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èdhi dhèu yahudi ne!

source_text: he did not say this of himself, but being the high priest that year he said, as a prophet, that jesus would be put to death for the nation;
target_text: lii kayafas ne mai boe nèti d'ara nèngu unu na. te ama lamatua pake hèb'a na, lula nèngu ka kètu kapai risi agama d'ara tèu èèna. nèti èèna ka, kayafas peka tèke, na, bèli-camèd'a yesus madhe pala dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and not for that nation only, but for the purpose of uniting in one body the children of god all over the world.
target_text: aa te ngaa, dhu lèke ka, yesus madhe boe hia dhèu yahudi mesa ra di, te ngaa pala dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i dhu pale-lème ètu rai-haha ne. nèngu èèna na oru nare si j'aj'i mi suku ca nau-ca nadha.

source_text: and from that day they took thought together how to put him to death.
target_text: lula lii padhai kayafas ne'e ka, karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ama-ama dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: so jesus no longer went about publicly among the jews, but went from there into the country near to the waste land, to a town named ephraim, where he was for some time with the disciples.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e heka asa madha dhèu ae ètu talora ama-ama dhèu yahudi. nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na lasi asa d'ara kota èci, ngara na efraim, padètu dènge d'ara mamoo. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna.

source_text: now the passover of the jews was near, and numbers of people went up from the country to jerusalem to make themselves clean before the passover.

source_text: the poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu bera-bera dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne bèli-camèd'a aad'o heka ètu talora miu.

source_text: the day after, a great number of people who were there for the feast, when they had the news that jesus was coming to jerusalem,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae dhu mai madhutu kalela paska ètu kota yerusalem, tadèngi, na, yesus neo mai asa era ne'e kahèi.

target_text: miu dhèu kota yerusalem, baku madha'u! miu dhèu kota ‘sion' se, ladhe ku asa nèi! te dhèu aae miu nuka mai nèi! nèngu mai manya'e keled'ei èni ci'u.

source_text: these things were not clear to his disciples at first: but when jesus had been lifted up into his glory, then it came to their minds that these things in the writings were about him and that they had been done to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus re'a mèka sasoa nèti j'ara se'e se. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ropa yesus mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na, aa ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha, rèngu heka sanèd'e j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti nèngu ne. rèngu sanèd'e kahèi tatao dhèu ae se mi dedha yesus.

source_text: now the people who were with him when his voice came to lazarus in the place of the dead, and gave him life again, had been talking about it.
target_text: lod'o yesus pamamuri hari lasarus nèti mamadhe, hèia na paroa ne kalua nèti ro'a dhèu madhe èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu sama-sama dènge yesus. de limuri ne rèngu lolo palème lula-nèti ngaa dhu uru èèna rèngu rèdhi dènge musi madha ra.

source_text: and that was the reason the people went out to him, because it had come to their ears that he had done this sign.

source_text: now there were some greeks among the people who had come up to give worship at the feast:
target_text: abhu dhèu yunani pèri-pèri dhu mai asa kota yerusalem palere-lere dènge dhèu leo, ho neo madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. ètu èèna, rèngu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: they came to philip, who was of beth-saida in galilee, and made a request, saying, sir, we have a desire to see jesus.

source_text: philip went and gave word of it to andrew; and andrew went with philip to jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e peka dènge anderias. hèia dua ra lasi peka dènge yesus.

source_text: and jesus said to them in answer, the hour of the glory of the son of man has come. truly i say to you, if a seed of grain does not go into the earth and come to an end, it is still a seed and no more; but through its death it gives much fruit.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, heka ama lamatua neo ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a kèna. tare'a sèmi èèna! èdhi pakasame ku dènge hini èci. ladhe èdhi sèle hini ca lamusi, na, hini ne ele iie uuru ku dènge j'ara boho ètu d'ara rai, heka na muri mai, hèia na hia hua-hela ae-ae kèna. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, hini èèna cue dhoo-dhoo di.

source_text: he who is in love with life will have it taken from him; and he who has no care for his life in this world will keep it for ever and ever.

source_text: if any man is my servant, let him come after me; and where i am, there will my servant be. if any man becomes my servant, my father will give him honour.

source_text: father, give glory to your name. then there came a voice out of heaven, saying, i have given it glory, and i will give it glory again.

target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, lii deo na, lii hia miu, hia boe ja'a.

source_text: now is this world to be judged: now will the ruler of this world be sent out.

source_text: and he who sees me, sees him who sent me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi ja'a, na, nèngu ladhe nèdhi kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i have come as a light into the world, so that no one who has faith in me will go on living in the dark.

source_text: and if any man gives ear to my words and does not keep them, i am not his judge: i did not come to be judge of the world but to give salvation to the world.

source_text: he who puts me on one side and does not take my words to heart, is not without a judge: the word which i have said will be his judge on the last day.

source_text: for i have not said it on my authority, but the father who sent me gave me orders what to say and how to say it.

source_text: and i have knowledge that his order is eternal life: so that the things which i say, i say them even as the father says them to me.

source_text: now before the feast of the passover, it was clear to jesus that the time had come for him to go away from this world to the father. having once had love for those in the world who were his, his love for them went on to the end.

source_text: so while a meal was going on, the evil one having now put it into the heart of judas iscariot, simon's son, to be false to him,

source_text: jesus, being conscious that the father had put everything into his hands, and that he came from god and was going to god,
target_text: yesus ne'a mema le, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, de nèbhu heka nèngu lèpa hari la'e asa ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ama na ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: got up from table, put off his robe and took a cloth and put it round him.

source_text: so he came to simon peter. peter said, lord, are my feet to be washed by you?
target_text: na rase haga si èci-èci. ropa d'ai simon petrus, ka simon petrus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo rase haga ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: and jesus, answering, said to him, what i do is not clear to you now, but it will be clear to you in time to come.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, deo ne'e ne, èu dhae me'a mèka ngaa dhu ja'a tao ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, èu heka me'a kèna.

source_text: peter said, i will never let my feet be washed by you, never. jesus said in answer, if i do not make you clean you have no part with me.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasisu, aku nèngu na, ama baku tao sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe ama rase haga ja'a. hèia yesus peka na, ladhe ja'a rase pamèu boe haga èu, na, èu bisa boe pa'èki dènge ja'a.

source_text: simon peter said to him, lord, not my feet only, but my hands and my head.
target_text: ka simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, mesa boe haga di. te ngaa ama rase kacui-aai dènge kètu ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus said to him, he who is bathed has need only to have his feet washed and then he is clean all over: and you, my disciples, are clean, but not all of you.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu diu le èi, parluu dhoka rase haga di. te ngi'u na mèu le. mema tare'a d'ara miu mèu le, te ngaa miu aa'i mi boe.

source_text: he had knowledge who was false to him; that is why he said, you are not all clean.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula ne'a le cee ka dhu neo pahie ne. nèti èèna ka, na peka na, miu aa'i mi boe dhu mèu.

source_text: then, after washing their feet and putting on his robe again, he took his seat and said to them, do you see what i have done to you?
target_text: ropa yesus pamèu nare haga si, hèia na silu hari kodho na, ka madhèdi hari asa mei. ka na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, tasamia? ropa ja'a rase haga miu, miu me'a sasoa nèti dhu ja'a tao ne, do aad'o?

source_text: you give me the name of master and lord: and you are right; that is what i am.
target_text: miu tema paroa ja'a ne, ‘ama mese' aa ‘lamatua'. èèna lèke kèna, lula mema hud'i sèmi èèna ku.

source_text: if then i, the lord and the master, have made your feet clean, it is right for you to make one another's feet clean.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mese dènge lamatua miu ne, rase le haga miu nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha sa, na, tasamia hari dènge miu? miu hud'i lalau-lalo'o isi-aanga mi èci dènge èci; conto nuka: miu hud'i èci dènge èci rase haga mi.

source_text: i have given you an example, so that you may do what i have done to you.
target_text: te ja'a tao le j'ara ne, sèna ka miu madhutu. ladhe ja'a tao tasamia, na, miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: truly i say to you, a servant is not greater than his lord; and he who is sent is not greater than the one who sent him.
target_text: ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge miu. ca dhèu ènu bisa boe risi nèti lamatua na. aa ca dhèu pajuu-paleha bisa boe risi nèti dhèu dhu pua nèngu.

source_text: if these things are clear to you, happy are you if you do them.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, miu oto ladhe miu tao madhutu.

source_text: i am not talking of you all: i have knowledge of my true disciples, but things are as they are, so that the writings may come true, the foot of him who takes bread with me is lifted up against me.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii boe lula-nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. ja'a tadhe mèu dhèu dhu ja'a hag'e kore. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa j'ara ne hud'i j'aj'i ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘dhèu dhu madhèdi na'a-ninu pa'èci dènge ja'a, soro kabodho mi ja'a le. '

source_text: from this time forward, i give you knowledge of things before they come about, so that when they come about you may have belief that i am he.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu, ho ladhe abhu dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele ja'a, na, miu bisa parcaya kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus.

source_text: truly i say to you, he who takes to his heart anyone whom i send, takes me to his heart; and he who so takes me, takes him who sent me.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu tare'a-re'a kèna, dhèu cee dhu bhoke d'ara na ho sèmi nare dhèu dhu ja'a pua, na, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ja'a. aa cee ka dhu sèmi nare ja'a dènge be'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: when jesus had said this he was troubled in spirit, and gave witness, saying, truly i say to you, that one of you will be false to me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia d'ara na mulai susa. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ca dhèu nèti miu, èèna na pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: then the eyes of the disciples were turned on one another, in doubt as to whom he had in mind.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ana-ana madhutu na palaladha èci dènge èci, te rèngu malaa. re'a boe na, cee ka dhu nèngu peka.

source_text: there was at table one of his disciples, the one dear to jesus, resting his head on jesus' breast.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu yesus sue nuka ja'a, yohanis dhu suri sasuri ne. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus.

source_text: making a sign to him, simon peter said, who is it he is talking about?
target_text: hèia simon petrus pangètu kètu, ho ja'a karèi yesus, cee ka dhu na peka èèna.

source_text: he, then, resting his head on jesus' breast, said to him, lord, who is it?
target_text: ka ja'a eso padètu dènge yesus, ho karèi ne, dhèu dhu ama peka ne, cee?

source_text: this was the answer jesus gave: it is the one to whom i will give this bit of bread after i have put it in the vessel. then he took the bit of bread, put it into the vessel, and gave it to judas, the son of simon iscariot.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo kore roti ca'èta, ho cèb'u asa d'ara mago ne. èèna na ja'a hia mi dhèu dhu ja'a peka deo na. ka yesus cèb'u nare roti ne asa d'ara mago, hèia na j'ole asa yudas, ana simon iskariot.

source_text: and when judas took the bread satan went into him. then jesus said to him, do quickly what you have to do.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare roti ne, hèia dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas. ka yesus peka dènge ne, èu neo tao ngaa, na, tao ka lai-lai. pamata ia ka.

source_text: now it was not clear to anyone at table why he said this to him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo dhu madhèdi ètu sèra re'a rare boe, nga tao ka yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: some were of the opinion that because judas kept the money-bag jesus said to him, get the things we have need of for the feast; or, that he was to give something to the poor.
target_text: lula yudas dhu tèke doi-dhari, ka abhu dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, peka na, lamu hèli ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka tao pesta paska. aa abhu kahèi dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, lamu hia doi d'ai ciki sa, mi dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèra.

source_text: so judas, having taken the bit of bread, straight away went out: and it was night.
target_text: ropa yudas sèmi nare roti ne, hèia la'e dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kalua èèna, dhu mèda le.

source_text: then when he had gone out, jesus said, now is glory given to the son of man, and god is given glory in him.
target_text: ropa yudas la'e, hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. d'ai lod'o kèna, ho ama lamatua ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. aa nèti j'ara ne'e, dhèu rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: if god is given glory in him, god will give him glory in himself, and will give him glory even now.
target_text: lula ja'a pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa pad'elo dadedha na, nèti èèna ka na ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a. na pamata heka.

source_text: my dear children, i am only to be with you a little longer. then you will be looking for me: and as i said to the jews, so now i say to you, where i am going you may not come.
target_text: ana aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ja'a sue miu titu kèna, te ngaa nèbhu heka ja'a pa'ana-lalu eele miu. èèna na miu patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe. lii dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, èci èèna ka dènge dhu ja'a lole dènge ama dhèu yahudi sèra, na, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa mèka madhutu. '

source_text: i give you a new law: have love one for another; even as i have had love for you, so are you to have love one for another.
target_text: ja'a hia miu lii paredha hiu èci, nuka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu. de miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: by this it will be clear to all men that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.
target_text: ladhe miu pasue sèmi èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, miu se, ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: simon peter said to him, lord, where are you going? jesus said in answer, where i am going you may not come with me now, but you will come later.
target_text: ka simon petrus karèi, peka na, te ama neo lamu mia? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku asa era èci dhu èu bisa mèka lamu. te ngaa lod'o limuri ku, heka èu lamu kèna.

source_text: peter said to him, why may i not come with you even now? i will give up my life for you.
target_text: petrus karèi hari, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ja'a bisa mèka laku hèi? te ja'a dhu pa'èra iisi le ho madhe pala ama!

source_text: jesus said in answer, will you give up your life for me? truly i say to you, before the cry of the cock you will have said three times that you are not my disciple.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, do? èu neo soro mamuri èu sèna ka madhe pala ja'a? dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e: manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te ngaa èu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: let not your heart be troubled: have faith in god and have faith in me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, d'ara miu baku susa. parcaya mi ama lamatua, aa parcaya mi ja'a kahèi.

source_text: in my father's house are rooms enough; if it was not so, would i have said that i am going to make ready a place for you?
target_text: ètu èmu ama ku abhu kama ae-ae. ladhe era d'ai boe, tatu ja'a peka le dènge miu. ne'e ne, ja'a neo laku sadia tèke era hia miu ètu nèi.

source_text: and if i go and make ready a place for you, i will come back again and will take you to be with me, so that you may be where i am.
target_text: ladhe ja'a laku aa sadia kore era pea hia miu, pe ja'a lèpa hari mai kore miu ho lati pea asa nèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe ja'a ètu mia, na, miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and you all have knowledge of where i am going, and of the way to it.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara asa era dhu ja'a neo laku.

source_text: thomas said, lord, we have no knowledge of where you are going; how may we have knowledge of the way?
target_text: te ngaa tomas karèi, peka na, ama! ji'i nge'a boe ama neo lamu mia. de tasamia ka ji'i nge'a j'ara ho la'a asa nèi?

source_text: jesus said to him, i am the true and living way: no one comes to the father but by me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, abhu boe j'ara leo dhu bisa nèti dhèu asa ama ètu sorga. dhodhoka re ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te ja'a ne ka j'ara asa ama lamatua. ja'a ne ka kapua mamola. aa ja'a ne'e ka dhu hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: if you had knowledge of me, you would have knowledge of my father: you have knowledge of him now and have seen him.
target_text: ladhe miu tadhe mèu ja'a, na, miu tadhe ama ku kahèi. de karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, miu tadhe nèngu le, dènge mèdhi ne kahèi.

source_text: philip said to him, lord, let us see the father, and we have need of nothing more.
target_text: pelipus manèngi, peka na, ama mese! pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i! te èèna d'ai le.

source_text: jesus said to him, philip, have i been with you all this time, and still you have no knowledge of me? he who has seen me has seen the father. why do you say, let us see the father?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pelipus. ja'a sama-sama dènge miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, te ngaa miu tadhe iia mèka ja'a, do? te dhèu dhu nèdhi le ja'a, èèna sama sèmi nèngu nèdhi le ama ku. de, nga tao ka deo na èu peka na, ‘pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i'?

source_text: have you not faith that i am in the father and the father is in me? the words which i say to you, i say not from myself: but the father who is in me all the time does his works.
target_text: tasamia kèna? lod'o ja'a peka na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama, aa ama pa'èki dènge ja'a, èu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o? lii padhai dhu ja'a peka dènge miu sèra, mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku. aa na pake ja'a sèna ka sab'a taruu sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: have faith that i am in the father and that the father is in me: at least, have faith in me because of what i do.
target_text: parcaya la mi ja'a ropa ja'a peka na, ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge ama ku, aa nèngu pa'èki dènge ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu bisa boe parcaya sèmi èèna, na, parcaya la ja'a, lula miu mèdhi le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: truly i say to you, he who puts his faith in me will do the very works which i do, and he will do greater things than these, because i am going to my father.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a se, lèke! te dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na nèngu bisa tao j'ara dhu ja'a tao kahèi. te ngaa, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku, ka ngaa dhu dhèu tao sèra, kapai risi nèti dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: and whatever request you make in my name, that i will do, so that the father may have glory in the son.
target_text: miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, unu hak pake kolongara ja'a. de ladhe miu sabaj'a sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake la kolongara ja'a, pe èèna na ja'a tao hia miu. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a ded'e ama ku padedha-dedha, sèna ka hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a.

source_text: if you make any request to me in my name, i will do it.
target_text: ja'a peka hari ca tèka: miu sabaj'a ho sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na ja'a tao hia miu.

source_text: if you have love for me, you will keep my laws.
target_text: yesus peka tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra.

source_text: and i will make prayer to the father and he will give you another helper to be with you for ever, even the spirit of true knowledge. that spirit the world is not able to take to its heart because it sees him not and has no knowledge of him: but you have knowledge of him, because he is ever with you and will be in you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama ku, sèna ka, lod'o ja'a dènge heka miu, na, nèngu hia miu ca dhèu era sarai-maena, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. nèngu ne, nuka roh lamatua, dhu aj'a-nori miu ngaa dhu lèke. dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha ne ro'o boe sèmi rare ne, lula rèngu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi nèngu, aa tadhe boe nèngu. te ngaa miu tadhe ne, lula na pa'èki dènge miu. aa na muri ètu d'ara miu. èèna na, nèngu dènge miu taa-taa.

source_text: i will not let you be without a friend: i am coming to you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele boe miu mesa mi, nuka sèmi ana lalu-eela. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari mai asa miu.

source_text: a little time longer, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me; and you will be living because i am living.
target_text: nèbhu heka, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne rèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa miu mèdhi ja'a. lula ja'a mamuri hari, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: at that time it will be clear to you that i am in my father, and you are in me, and i in you.
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, miu me'a mèu, na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama ku; miu pa'èki dènge ja'a; aa ja'a pa'èki dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: he who has my laws and keeps them, he it is who has love for me: and he who has love for me will be loved by my father, and i will have love for him and will let myself be seen clearly by him.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi rare, aa tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, nèngu ka dhu sue ja'a. aa ama ku sue kahèi dhèu dhu sue ja'a. ja'a sue dhèu èèna kahèi, aa pad'elo iisi ja'a dènge ne.

source_text: judas not iscariot said to him, how is it that you will let yourself be seen clearly by us and not by the world?
target_text: ètu era ne, abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. nèngu ne, yudas iskariot boe. ropa na tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo pad'elo iisi mi ji'i. te ngaa tasamia ka ama pad'elo boe iisi mi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne?

source_text: jesus said to him in answer, if anyone has love for me, he will keep my words: and he will be dear to my father; and we will come to him and make our living-place with him.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu dhu sue ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a. ama ku sue nèngu kahèi. ka ja'a dènge ama ku mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne.

source_text: he who has no love for me does not keep my words; and the word which you are hearing is not my word but the father's who sent me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sue boe ja'a, nèngu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ja'a kahèi. aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi nèti ja'a, mai boe nèti ja'a, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i have said all this to you while i am still with you.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka tèke j'ara se'e dènge miu.

source_text: but the helper, the holy spirit, whom the father will send in my name, will be your teacher in all things and will put you in mind of everything i have said to you.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, ama ku pua mai ca dhèu era sarai-maena, nuka roh mola-mèci na. roh ne'e ka dhu gati ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. sasab'a na, nuka: aj'a-nori miu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, dènge pasanèd'e miu j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a padhue-padhai le dènge miu.

source_text: may peace be with you; my peace i give to you: i give it not as the world gives. let not your heart be troubled; let it be without fear.
target_text: pe, ladhe d'ai lod'o ja'a laku, ja'a tao d'ara miu ho mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu bisa tao d'ara mera-milu sèmi èèna. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha ne bisa boe tao rare d'ara miu mera-milu sèmi èèna. de miu baku susa, aa baku madha'u.

source_text: keep in mind how i said to you, i go away and come to you again. if you had love for me you would be glad, because i am going to the father: for the father is greater than i.
target_text: miu tadèngi mèdhi le, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a tèke eele miu, te ngaa èèna na mai hari. ' d'ara miu baku susa. te ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, d'ara miu karej'e-karae, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku. ama ku kapai risi nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and now i have given you word of it before it comes, so that, when it comes, you may have faith.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ja'a dhu peka mema le dènge miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe j'ara se j'aj'i ku, na, miu bisa parcaya ja'a.

source_text: after this i will not say much to you, because the ruler of this world comes: and he has no power over me;
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a padhai lii heka dènge miu. te dhèu aae nidhu dhu mai le. nèngu nèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa koasa na lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: but he comes so that the world may see that i have love for the father, and that i am doing as i am ordered by the father. get up, and let us go.
target_text: masi ka nidhu ne mai, te ngaa ja'a sab'a taruu madhutu paredha ama ku. ne'e ne ka dhu pad'elo dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, na, ja'a sue ama ku titu kèna. de mai lati ka!

source_text: i am the true vine and my father is the gardener.
target_text: yesus padhai lii, peka na, nanene! miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. ja'a ne sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. te ngaa ja'a ne, aj'u anggor dhu lèke! aa ama ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka.

source_text: he takes away every branch in me which has no fruit, and every branch which has fruit he makes clean, so that it may have more fruit.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, te ngaa sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa, ama ku core eele ne, sama sèmi dhèu sab'a oka dhu pare eele aa'i dadana dhu hua boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge ja'a, ama ku pamèu kaj'alu ètu d'ara dhèu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka poro pabab'a dadana, sèna ka hua na asa ae.

source_text: you are clean, even now, through the teaching which i have given you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: be in me at all times as i am in you. as the branch is not able to give fruit of itself, if it is not still on the vine, so you are not able to do so if you are not in me.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki taruu ku dènge ja'a, sama sèmi ja'a pa'èki dènge miu. te dadana dhu pare eele le nèti laa na, bisa boe hua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa dhu be'a, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a.

source_text: i am the vine, you are the branches: he who is in me at all times as i am in him, gives much fruit, because without me you are able to do nothing.
target_text: ja'a sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. miu nuka sèmi dadana nèngu. de dhèu dhu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi, na, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge dadana dhu hua ae-ae. te, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a, miu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a.

source_text: if a man does not keep himself in me, he becomes dead and is cut off like a dry branch; such branches are taken up and put in the fire and burned.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki boe taruu dènge ja'a, nèngu cakaraa dadana èci dhu guna heka. dadana sèmi èèna, dhèu poro eele, sèna ka pamango eele ne. hèia pakaboko ho core asa d'ara ai, tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: if you are in me at all times, and my words are in you, then anything for which you make a request will be done for you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: here is my father's glory, in that you give much fruit and so are my true disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: even as the father has given me his love, so i have given my love to you: be ever in my love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if you keep my laws, you will be ever in my love, even as i have kept my father's laws, and am ever in his love.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: i have said these things to you so that i may have joy in you and so that your joy may be complete.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: this is the law i give you: have love one for another, even as i have love for you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: greater love has no man than this, that a man gives up his life for his friends.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: you are my friends, if you do what i give you orders to do.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: no longer do i give you the name of servants; because a servant is without knowledge of what his master is doing: i give you the name of friends, because i have given you knowledge of all the things which my father has said to me.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: you did not take me for yourselves, but i took you for myself; and i gave you the work of going about and producing fruit which will be for ever; so that whatever request you make to the father in my name he may give it to you.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: so this is my law for you: have love one for another.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: if you are hated by the world, keep in mind that i was hated by the world before you.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if you were of the world, you would be loved by the world: but because you are not of the world, but i have taken you out of the world, you are hated by the world.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: keep in mind the words i said to you, a servant is not greater than his lord. if they were cruel to me, they will be cruel to you; if they kept my words, they will keep yours.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: they will do all this to you because of my name - because they have no knowledge of him who sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i had not come and been their teacher they would have had no sin: but now they have no reason to give for their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: he who has hate for me has hate for my father.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i had not done among them the works which no other man ever did, they would have had no sin: but now they have seen, and they have had hate in their hearts for me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: this comes about so that the writing in their law may be made true, their hate for me was without cause.
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: when the helper comes, whom i will send to you from the father even the spirit of true knowledge who comes from the father - he will give witness about me;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: and you, in addition, will give witness because you have been with me from the first.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

source_text: i have said these things to you so that you may not be in doubt.
target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they will put you out of the synagogues: yes, the time is coming when whoever puts you to death will have the belief that he is doing god's pleasure.
target_text: èèna na dhèu yahudi sèra babège eele miu nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra. mesa boe j'ara ne'e di, te bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ladhe dhèu pamadhe miu, ra pangee, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke hia ama lamatua.

source_text: they will do these things to you because they have not had knowledge of the father or of me.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: i have said these things to you so that when the time comes, what i have said may come to your mind. i did not say them to you at the first, because then i was still with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: but now i am going to him who sent me; and not one of you says to me, where are you going?
target_text: yesus aj'a tabha hari, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. te ngaa abhu boe nèti miu ca dhèu sa dhu karèi, na, ‘ama neo lamu mia? '

source_text: but your hearts are full of sorrow because i have said these things.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: but what i am saying is true: my going is for your good: for if i do not go away, the helper will not come to you; but if i go, i will send him to you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: and he, when he comes, will make the world conscious of sin, and of righteousness, and of being judged:
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: of sin, because they have not faith in me;
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: of righteousness, because i go to the father and you will see me no more;
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: of being judged, because the ruler of this world has been judged.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have still much to say to you, but you are not strong enough for it now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: however, when he, the spirit of true knowledge, has come, he will be your guide into all true knowledge: for his words will not come from himself, but whatever has come to his hearing, that he will say: and he will make clear to you the things to come.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he will give me glory, because he will take of what is mine, and make it clear to you.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: everything which the father has is mine: that is why i say, he will take of what is mine and will make it clear to you.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: after a little time you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: so some of the disciples said one to another, what is this he is saying, after a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me? and, i am going to the father?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: so they said again and again, what is this he is saying, a little time? his words are not clear to us.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: jesus saw that they had a desire to put the question to him, so he said to them, is this what you are questioning one with another, why i said, after a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: truly i say to you, you will be weeping and sorrowing, but the world will be glad: you will be sad, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
target_text: be'a kahèi, ladhe miu neo me'a sèmi èèna. ja'a neo peka dènge miu kahèi sèmi ne'e: èèna na miu tangi dènge d'ara susa, te ngaa dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne karej'e-karae. masi ka d'ara miu susa, te ngaa èèna na d'ara miu karej'e-karae hari.

source_text: when a woman is about to give birth she has sorrow, because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the child, the pain is put out of her mind by the joy that a man has come into the world.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: so you have sorrow now: but i will see you again, and your hearts will be glad, and no one will take away your joy.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: and on that day you will put no questions to me. truly i say to you, whatever request you make to the father, he will give it to you in my name.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: up to now you have made no request in my name: do so, and it will be answered, so that your hearts may be full of joy.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: all this i have said to you in veiled language: but the time is coming when i will no longer say things in veiled language but will give you knowledge of the father clearly.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: in that day you will make requests in my name: and i do not say that i will make prayer to the father for you,
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: for the father himself gives his love to you, because you have given your love to me and have had faith that i came from god.
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i came out from the father and have come into the world: again, i go away from the world and go to the father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: his disciples said, now you are talking clearly and not in veiled language.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now we are certain that you have knowledge of all things and have no need for anyone to put questions to you: through this we have faith that you came from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus made answer, have you faith now?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: see, a time is coming, yes, it is now here, when you will go away in all directions, every man to his house, and i will be by myself: but i am not by myself, because the father is with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: i have said all these things to you so that in me you may have peace. in the world you have trouble: but take heart! i have overcome the world.
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: jesus said these things; then, lifting his eyes to heaven, he said, father, the time has now come; give glory to your son, so that the son may give glory to you: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, to give eternal life to all those whom you have given to him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: and this is eternal life: to have knowledge of you, the only true god, and of him whom you have sent, even jesus christ.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have given you glory on the earth, having done all the work which you gave me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: and now, father, let me have glory with you, even that glory which i had with you before the world was.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i have given knowledge of your name to the men whom you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your words.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: now it is clear to them that whatever you have given to me comes from you:
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: because i have given them the words which you gave to me; and they have taken them to heart, and have certain knowledge that i came from you, and they have faith that you sent me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: my prayer is for them: my prayer is not for the world, but for those whom you have given to me, because they are yours
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.

source_text: all mine are yours, and yours are mine and i have glory in them.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i unu ja'a, sèra sa unu ama kahèi. aa aa'i-aa'i unu ama, sèra sa unu ja'a kahèi. ka dhèu unu ja'a se, dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: and now i will be no longer in the world, but they are in the world and i come to you. holy father, keep them in your name which you have given to me, so that they may be one even as we are one.
target_text: ja'a pea boe taruu ètu rai-haha ne, lula nèbhu heka ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku. te ngaa dhèu se hud'i pea taruu ètu rai-haha ne. ama dhu mola-mèci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ladhe-leru si pake koasa dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a. ja'a manèngi kahèi ho rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ja'a pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci dènge ama.

source_text: while i was with them i kept them safe in your name which you have given to me: i took care of them and not one of them has come to destruction, but only the son of destruction, so that the writings might come true.
target_text: karèi nèti ja'a ètu rai-haha ne bera-bera dènge rèngu, ja'a leru si, lula rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu ama. ja'a j'aga aa sanoro si, sèna ka rèngu pa'èki taruu dènge ama. abhu boe dhu ele. dhodhoka yudas di dhu cèri eele, madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua karèi nèti uru èèna.

source_text: and now i come to you; and these things i say in the world so that they may have my joy complete in them.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. ja'a peka le j'ara se'e lod'o ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era. dènge sèmi ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a se d'ara rèngu bisa karej'e-karae taruu, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i have given your word to them; and they are hated by the world, because they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka-padhai le dènge rèngu lii holo-nori ama. dhèu leo ètu rai-haha tèka d'ara dènge dhèu unu ja'a, lula mamuri dhèu ja'a, sama boe dènge mamuri rèngu. ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi, te ja'a sama boe sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: my prayer is not that you will take them out of the world, but that you will keep them from the evil one.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sabaj'a, ja'a manèngi boe ho ama more si nèti rai-haha ne. aad'o! te ngaa ja'a manèngi, ho ama j'aga si, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu.

source_text: they are not of the world any more than i am of the world.
target_text: rèngu sama boe dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a dhu sama boe kahèi dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: make them holy by the true word: your word is the true word.
target_text: pake ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka pamèu d'ara ra. te dhu lèke ka, lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: even as you have sent me into the world, so i have sent them into the world.
target_text: ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pua-paleha rèngu kahèi sèmi èèna, sèna ka rèngu mamuri pale-lème ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and for them i make myself holy, so that they may be made truly holy.
target_text: ja'a j'aga ngi'u ja'a ho mola-mèci taruu hia mi ama. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a j'aga mamuri ra kahèi sèna ka mola-mèci hia mi ama. te lii holo-nori ama dhu lèke, dhu tao si ho ra saraka mamuri rèngu kateme mi ama.

source_text: my prayer is not for them only, but for all who will have faith in me through their word;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii manèngi-mangaj'i na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sabaj'a, mesa boe hia mi dhèu limuri ne'e di, te ngaa hia rèngu dhu lod'o limuri dhu parcaya ja'a kahèi, lula lii padhai dhèu se'e.

source_text: may they all be one! even as you, father, are in me and i am in you, so let them be in us, so that all men may come to have faith that you sent me.
target_text: ama, ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, sama sèmi èdhi pa'èki j'aj'i èci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i èci dènge èdhi, ho hud'i laa dhèu rai-haha ne bisa parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: and the glory which you have given to me i have given to them, so that they may be one even as we are one;
target_text: ama pad'elo le dadedha ja'a mi dhèu sèra. ka ja'a ded'e le rèngu padedha-dedha sama sèmi ja'a. dènge jara ne'e, rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i èci, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi j'aj'i èci.

source_text: i in them, and you in me, so that they may be made completely one, and so that it may become clear to all men that you have sent me and that they are loved by you as i am loved by you.
target_text: ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu. ama kahèi pa'èki dènge ja'a. rèngu hud'i pa'èki j'aj'i èci sèmi èèna ku, toke ra mamuri d'ara èci dènge be'a. te ladhe rèngu mamuri d'ara èci sèmi èèna, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne re'a, na, ama dhu sue si, nuka sèmi ama sue ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu re'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: father, it is my desire that these whom you have given to me may be by my side where i am, so that they may see my glory which you have given to me, because you had love for me before the world came into being.
target_text: ama, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo, sèna ka rèngu bisa ladhe rèdhi ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. te ama sue ja'a mema-mema le, lod'o èdhi dhae paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne.

source_text: father of righteousness, i have knowledge of you, though the world has not; and to these it is clear that you sent me;
target_text: ama pasue dhu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tadhe boe ama. ja'a tadhe ama. aa dhèu unu ja'a re'a kahèi, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i have given to them knowledge of your name, and will give it, so that the love which you have for me may be in them and i in them.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka le dènge rèngu, ama ne, cee. aa èèna na ja'a loe boe peka dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, lula ja'a d'èi ho rèngu re'a mèu sasue ama. te sasue dhu rèngu re'a rèdhi ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge sasue ama mi dedha ja'a, sèna ka hud'i laa ja'a pa'èki taruu dènge rèngu.

source_text: when jesus had said these words he went out with his disciples over the stream kedron to a garden, into which he went with his disciples.
target_text: ropa yesus manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia la'e palere-lere dènge ana madhutu na. lasi asa d'ara oka cue ètu sebhe loko kidron.

source_text: and judas, who was false to him, had knowledge of the place because jesus went there frequently with his disciples. so judas, getting a band of armed men and police from the chief priests and pharisees, went there with lights and with arms.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei agama parisi saraka mi yudas, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri. te nèngu neo pahie eele yesus. yudas ne'a oka ne kahèi, lula yesus pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na ètu era ne'e pèri-pèri hari le. ka yudas si lasi asa oka ne rèti dènge ob'o, labhu lantera dènge rèka.

source_text: then jesus, having knowledge of everything which was coming on him, went forward and said to them, who are you looking for?
target_text: aa te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a uru le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na j'aj'i. hèia ara la'e asa madha rèngu, ka na lii, peka na, miu tenge cee?

source_text: their answer was, jesus the nazarene. jesus said, i am he. and judas, who was false to him, was there at their side.
target_text: ka ra b'ala, na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka ne'e. lod'o èèna, yudas dhu titu dènge dhèu se'e. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pahie yesus.

source_text: and when he said to them, i am he, they went back, falling to the earth.
target_text: ropa yesus peka na, ja'a ka ne'e, hèia dhèu se hari kabodho, ka ra bèbha.

source_text: so again he put the question to them, who are you looking for? and they said, jesus the nazarene.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari, na, miu tenge cee? hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: jesus made answer, i have said that i am he; if you are looking for me, let these men go away.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, deo na ja'a peka kore le, na, nèngu ka ja'a ne. de ladhe miu tenge ja'a, na, baku kèpe dhèu leo. hud'i si lasi.

source_text: he said this so that his words might come true, i have kept safe all those whom you gave to me.
target_text: nèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, sèna ka pamèci dènge ngaa dhu nèngu peka nèdhi le, na, ama. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, abhu boe èci sa dhu ele.

source_text: then simon peter, who had a sword, took it out and gave the high priest's servant a blow, cutting off his right ear. the servant's name was malchus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus nèti dènge samala iiki èci. ka na bete ho neo pare dhèu. kabèdhi laa, na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne ngara na malkus. nèngu ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: then jesus said to peter, put back your sword: am i not to take the cup which my father has given to me?
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus, aku nèngu na, we, petrus! pasaluu hari samala èu èèna asa d'ara sope la'e. te ama ku dhu peka le, na, ja'a hud'i paraga ku dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. de hud'i laa! èèna nuka sèmi nèngu hia ja'a galaa èci dhu isi na pèd'u-èd'u. hud'i laa ja'a kinu toke èle.

source_text: then the band and the chief captain and the police took jesus and put cords round him.
target_text: hèia komedhaa, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe yesus, ka ra èki ne.

source_text: they took him first to annas, because annas was the father-in-law of caiaphas who was the high priest that year.
target_text: ka lere rèti uuru ne asa anas. anas ne, ama dhèu èmu kayafas. tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: it was caiaphas who had said to the jews that it was in their interest for one man to be put to death for the people.
target_text: kayafas ne'e ka dhu peka nèdhi le dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi, aku nèngu na, be'a risi hia miu, ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and simon peter went after jesus with another disciple. now that disciple was a friend of the high priest and he went in with jesus into the house of the high priest;
target_text: simon petrus dhu madhutu yesus re limuri palere-lere dènge ana madhutu yesus èci, nuka ja'a, yohanis ne. lula kètu kapai risi agama yahudi tadhe ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa maso kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus asa madha èmu na.

source_text: but peter was kept outside at the door. then this other disciple, who was a friend of the high priest, came out and had a word with the girl who kept the door, and took peter in.
target_text: te ngaa petrus titu ètu li'u, padètu dènge hèb'a tedhe. hèia ja'a laku asa li'u, ho peka dènge dhèu bhèni èci dhu j'aga hèb'a tedhe ne, sèna ka kèti petrus asa d'ara.

source_text: then the girl who was the door-keeper said to peter, are you not one of this man's disciples? in answer he said, i am not.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne karèi petrus, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne, ca dhèu ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o!

source_text: now the servants and the police had made a fire of coals because it was cold; they were warming themselves in front of it and peter was there with them, warming himself.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu madhenga dènge ana pua-paleha sèra dhu titu manyiru ai. ka petrus la'e manyiru ai sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: then the high priest put questions to jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu kapai risi dhui nèti agama yahudi parisa yesus lula-nèti a'aj'a na, aa lula-nèti ana madhutu na.

source_text: jesus made answer, i said things openly to the world at all times; i have given my teaching in the synagogues and in the temple to which all the jews come; and i have said nothing secretly.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge nèngu, aku nèngu na, ja'a peka paled'a, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa tadèngi. ja'a tema aj'a ètu era dhu biasa dhèu yahudi èdhi pakaboko, nuka ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi, dènge ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ja'a padhai lii pahuni kèdhi boe.

source_text: why are you questioning me? put questions to my hearers about what i have said to them: they have knowledge of what i said.
target_text: nga tao ka èu karèi ja'a? karèi la dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai ja'a. te, tatu re'a ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai.

source_text: when he said this, one of the police by his side gave him a blow with his open hand, saying, do you give such an answer to the high priest?
target_text: ropa na padhai lii sèmi èèna, dhèu j'aga èci dhu titu ètu èèna, tèb'e yesus, ka na peka na, èu baku padhai lii sèmi èèna dènge kètu kapai risi.

source_text: jesus said in answer, if i have said anything evil, give witness to the evil: but if i said what is true, why do you give me blows?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii sale, na, pad'elo mia dhu sale nèti lii padhai deo na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka èu tèb'e ja'a?

source_text: then annas sent him chained to caiaphas, the high priest.
target_text: èle ka, anas pua dhèu lere ne asa kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o lere rèti ne, yesus dhu ra èki era.

source_text: but simon peter was still there warming himself by the fire. they said to him, are you not one of his disciples? he said, no, i am not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus titu manyiru ai era. ka dhèu leo dhu ètu èèna, karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, peka na, aad'o!

source_text: one of the servants of the high priest, a relation of him whose ear had been cut off by peter, said, did i not see you with him in the garden?
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu sab'a èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. nèngu ne, pa'a'ari kahèi dènge dhèu dhu petrus pare pama'ète rèu dhilu na. hèia dhèu ne karèi petrus, peka na, waa! deo na, èu ne ètu d'ara oka nèi, si? te ja'a kèdhi èu ètu nèi!

source_text: then again peter said, no. and straight away a cock gave its cry.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: so they took jesus from the house of caiaphas to the praetorium. it was early. they themselves did not go into the praetorium, so that they might not become unclean, but might take the passover.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, lere rèti yesus nèti kayafas asa èmu jabatan gubernur ètu benteng sordad'u roma. dhèu yahudi se maso boe asa èmu dhèu roma, te èèna pakaj'alu rèngu. te ladhe ra maso, na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a pesta paska.

source_text: so pilate came out to them and put the question: what have you to say against this man?
target_text: hèia gubernur pilatus la'e asa li'u paraga dènge dhèu yahudi se. ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu pèci sasala ngaa mi dedha dhèu ne'e?

source_text: they said to him in answer, if the man was not a wrongdoer we would not have given him up to you.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a boe, na, tatu ji'i mai boe asa madha ama. ngaa hari ji'i mai saraka ne asa kacui-aai ama.

source_text: then pilate said to them, take him yourselves and let him be judged by your law. but the jews said to him, we have no right to put any man to death.
target_text: ka gubernur peka dènge dhèu se, na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa miu ka dhu uri lii langu na, madhutu atora miu dhèu yahudi. hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, peka na, bisa boe ama. ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge heka hak ho pama'ète hahuku madhe. dhoka miu dhèu paredha roma di dhu dènge hak èèna.

source_text: that the word of jesus might come true, pointing to the sort of death he would have.
target_text: lii padhai lii rèngu èèna, palèke dènge lii padhai dhu uru èèna yesus peka nèdhi le. te nèngu dhu peka le dènge dhèu unu na sèra, na, nèngu madhe madhutu j'ara paredha roma, nuka ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then pilate went back into the praetorium and sent for jesus and said to him, are you the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur maso hari asa d'ara benteng sordad'u. ka na paroa yesus, hèia na karèi, peka na, èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do?

source_text: jesus made answer, do you say this of yourself, or did others say it about me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama ka peka sèmi èèna, do abhu dhèu leo ka dhu peka dènge ama lula-nèti ja'a?

source_text: pilate said, am i a jew? your nation and the chief priests have given you into my hands: what have you done?
target_text: hèia gubernur dhaa, na, eee! ja'a ne dhèu yahudi boe. ana kabarai èu mesa mu ka dhu saraka èu. ngaa hari kètu agama yahudi sèra. èu ne, tao sala ngaa? èu peka sèku!

source_text: jesus said in answer, my kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom was of this world, my disciples would have made a good fight to keep me out of the hands of the jews: but my kingdom is not here.
target_text: ka yesus peka na, ja'a ne, dhèu aae boe nèti rai-haha ne. te ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae sama sèmi èèna, tatu dhèu-dhèu ja'a palab'a le, ka dhèu yahudi kèpe boe ja'a. tare'a, ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ca dhèu sa ètu rai-haha ne ded'e boe ja'a.

source_text: then pilate said to him, are you then a king? jesus made answer, you say that i am a king. for this purpose was i given birth, and for this purpose i came into the world, that i might give witness to what is true. every lover of what is true gives ear to my voice.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi hari, peka na, de èu ne, dhèu aae, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama unu mu ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ne dhèu aae. dhu lèke ka, rara iisi ja'a ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne ho j'aj'i dhèu aae, sèna ka ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe pa'èra j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, rèngu sèra ka dhu nanene ja'a.

source_text: pilate said to him, true? what is true? having said this he went out again to the jews and said to them, i see no wrong in him.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi, peka na, dhu lèke èèna, sèmi ngaa sa? ropa gubernur pilatus padhai lii nare, hèia kalua hari la'e asa dhèu yahudi sèra. ka na peka, ja'a parisa le nèngu, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: but every year you make a request to me to let a prisoner go free at the passover. is it your desire that i let the king of the jews go free?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lod'o d'ai pesta paska sèmi ne'e, ja'a patabuli ana bèdho ca dhèu hia miu. de tèu ne'e mo'o sèna ka ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do tasamia?

source_text: then again they gave a loud cry, not this man, but barabbas. now barabbas was an outlaw.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, baku patabuli dhèu èèna! patabuli barabas di! barabas ne, ca dhèu dhu bhelu titu kèna.

source_text: then pilate took jesus and had him whipped with cords.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus pua sordad'u na lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui.

source_text: and the men of the army made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they put a purple robe on him. and they kept coming and saying, long life to the king of the jews! and they gave him blows with their hands.
target_text: aa sordad'u se'e rare kalai aj'u padhudhu kahèi, ho ènyu tao solo. ka ra lalilu solo ne mi kètu yesus, nuka sèmi rèngu neo ded'e dhèu aae hiu dhu pake solo dhèu aae. aa te ngaa sasoa na, ra neo pahahe ne di. hèia ra papake yesus kodho madhera èci dhu mea sanama mangèru, nuka sèmi dhèu aae biasa pake. aa ra sasei ne, peka na, tabea, dhèu aae yahudi! sordad'u se tèb'e ne g'ana-kariu kahèi.

source_text: and pilate went out again and said to them, see, i let him come out to you to make it clear to you that i see no wrong in him.
target_text: ka gubernur la'e hari catèka peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a kèti ne asa li'u hia miu. te ngaa miu hud'i me'a ku, na, ja'a parisa kore le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: then jesus came out with the crown of thorns and the purple robe. and pilate said to them, here is the man!
target_text: ropa rèti yesus asa li'u, nèngu dhu pake era solo padhudhu dènge kodho madhera dhu mea sanama mangèru. hèia gubernur lii dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe ku, dhèu ne.

source_text: so when the chief priests and the police saw him they gave a loud cry, to the cross! to the cross! pilate said to them, take him yourselves and put him on the cross: i see no crime in him.
target_text: ropa kètu agama dènge dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! te ngaa gubernur peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa miu ka dhu mèti ne, lami pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu palèke dènge hahuku madhe.

source_text: and the jews made answer, we have a law, and by that law it is right for him to be put to death because he said he was the son of god.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when this saying came to pilate's ears his fear became greater;
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: and he went again into the praetorium and said to jesus, where do you come from? but jesus gave him no answer.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: then pilate said to him, you say nothing to me? is it not clear to you that i have power to let you go free and power to put you to death on the cross?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: jesus gave this answer: you would have no power at all over me if it was not given to you by god; so that he who gave me up to you has the greater sin.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: hearing this, pilate had a desire to let him go free, but the jews said in a loud voice, if you let this man go, you are not caesar's friend: everyone who makes himself a king goes against caesar.
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: so when these words came to pilate's ear, he took jesus out, seating himself in the judge's seat in a place named in hebrew, gabbatha, or the stone floor.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: it was the day when they made ready for the passover; and it was about the sixth hour. and he said to the jews, there is your king!
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: then they gave a loud cry, away with him! away with him! to the cross! pilate said to them, am i to put your king to death on the cross? the chief priests said in answer, we have no king but caesar.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu asa hoe pa'oo-parodha peka na, mèti ne, asa li'u mai! pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha! hèia gubernur papane si, peka na, de tasamia? miu d'èi, ladhe ja'a pamadhe dhèu aae miu ne, do? ka kètu agama yahudi se b'ala, peka na, dhèu aae ji'i dhodhoka ca dhèu di, nuka keser! dhèu leo aad'o!

source_text: so then he gave him up to them to be put to death on the cross. and they took jesus away;
target_text: hèia gubernur hia yesus asa sordad'u sèra, sèna ka ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se sèmi rare yesus.

source_text: and he went out with his cross on him to the place which is named dead man's head in hebrew, golgotha:
target_text: ka yesus pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na la'e asa li'u kota. lasi asa era èci dhu ngara na, era rui kètu. madhutu lii aram, era ne ngara na, golgota.

source_text: where they put him on the cross with two others, one on this side and one on that, and jesus in the middle.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra paku yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èci. dhèu se paku kahèi dhèu leo dhèu dua. èci re sebhe g'ana, aa ca dhèu hari re sebhe kariu yesus. ka yesus ètu talora rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and pilate put on the cross a statement in writing. the writing was: jesus the nazarene, the king of the jews.
target_text: ka gubernur paredha sordad'u na sèra, suri ètu papa èci, ho paku re dedha kètu yesus. ètu papa ne ra suri, peka na, yesus, dhèu nasaret. nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi

source_text: the writing was seen by a number of the jews, for the place where jesus was put to death on the cross was near the town; and the writing was in hebrew and latin and greek.
target_text: rèngu suri ètu papa ne pake tèlu lii, nuka: lii aram, lii yunani, dènge lii latin. dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu baca sasuri ne, lula era mamadhe yesus ne, padètu dènge kota yerusalem.

source_text: then the chief priests of the jews said to pilate, do not put, the king of the jews, but, he said, i am the king of the jews.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra ro'o boe. ka lasi peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, ama! baku suri ‘dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi'! be'a risi suri laa peka na, ‘dhèu ne peka na, nèngu dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi. '

source_text: but pilate made answer, what i have put in writing will not be changed.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu pua si suri sèmi èèna. de hud'i ka laa!

source_text: and when jesus was nailed to the cross, the men of the army took his clothing, and made a division of it into four parts, to every man a part, and they took his coat: now the coat was without a join, made out of one bit of cloth.
target_text: ropa sordad'u paku rare yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra pabagi mèdha-papake na mi èpa pala. ca dhèu sordad'u abhu ca pala. hèia rare kodho li'u na, dhu j'au boe, dhu manènu kateme nèti dedha.

source_text: so they said among themselves, let this not be cut up, but let us put it to the decision of chance and see who gets it. they did this so that the writings might come true, which say, they made a distribution of my clothing among them, and my coat they put to the decision of chance. this was what the men of the army did.
target_text: ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, èdhi baku ciu eele kodho na. be'a risi ère lot, sèna ka te'a, na, cee ka dhu abhu. èèna j'aj'i madhutu sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, rèngu pabagi mèdha-papake ja'a, ka ra ère lot ho abhu kodho ja'a. hèia sordad'u se tao madhutu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: now by the side of the cross of jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister mary, the wife of cleopas, and mary magdalene.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni pèri-pèri dhu titu. rèngu se, nuka: ina yesus, ina iiki yesus, maria dhèu èmu klopas, dènge maria nèti rae magdala.

source_text: so when jesus saw his mother and the disciple who was dear to him, he said to his mother, mother, there is your son!
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi ina na dhu titu ètu èèna, sama-sama dènge ja'a, yohanis, nuka ana madhutu dhu nèngu sue. ka yesus lii dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, ina. nèngu ne, ana mu.

source_text: then he said to the disciple, there is your mother! and from that hour the disciple took her to his house.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ja'a, peka na, yohanis. nèti deo ne'e, tao laa nèngu sèmi ina èu! ka karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ina yesus pea dènge ja'a.

source_text: after this, being conscious that all things had now been done so that the writings might come true, jesus said, give me water.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ne'a le, na, nèngu sab'a nare aa'i le sasab'a-la'a na. se'e se pamèci dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. hèia yesus peka, na, ja'a koko-kamango.
