target_text: uru èèna, mema lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, tasamia hari? dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra, sèmi ngaa sa? mese agama sèra, j'aj'i sèmi ngaa? aa tuka tao lii langu sèra, tasa mera mia? miu nanene sèku! lamatua tao si nuka sèmi dhèu goa! nèngu bete eele aa'i le mamèu dhu amo ètu d'ara kahadhu dhèu rai-haha ne, aa tao mamèu sèra nuka sèmi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for because, by the purpose of god, the world, with all its wisdom, had not the knowledge of god, it was god's pleasure, by so foolish a thing as preaching, to give salvation to those who had faith in him. seeing that the jews make request for signs, and the greeks are looking for knowledge:
target_text: mamèu ama lamatua lènge aa'i mèu-mèu. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa j'ara ngangee rèngu mesa ra d'ai mèka ho ra tadhe hua iia ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua pake le mamèu na ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu rai-haha. te uru èèna, lamatua pangee, peka na, masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a sèra goa, te ngaa tasamia èèna ka, hud'i ja'a pua ku dhèu lasi lole dènge ra j'ara dhu lèke nèti ja'a. te lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na ho lasi lole dènge dhèu. na pama'ète nare le neo pake lii moa èèna, sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya ne. nèngu pake j'ara ne, ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, j'ara ama lamatua ne, goa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pusi-pahae boe dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te dhèu yahudi neo manèngi dhoka tadha-tadha malaa di, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. aa dhèu yunani neo nanene dhoka j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu maso asa d'ara kahadhu ra, madhutu ngangee rèngu mesa ra.

source_text: but we give the good news of christ on the cross, a hard thing to the jews, and a foolish thing to the gentiles;
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa èdhi dhu j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua lati peka dènge dhèu, na, lamatua pua le kristus, nuka dhèu dhu nèngu pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, mai asa rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ropa dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo ne'e, rèngu sisu, te madhutu a'abhu ra, dhèu dhu lamatua neo pua mai èèna, bisa boe madhe sèmi èèna. ropa dhèu yunani tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na, lii lolo dhèu goa!

source_text: but to those of god's selection, jews and greeks, christ is the power and the wisdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. rèngu sèra cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, mamadhe kristus dhu pad'elo le mi rèngu, na, koasa ama lamatua dènge boe too-lane, aa mamèu na risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: because what seems foolish in god is wiser than men; and what seems feeble in god is stronger than men.
target_text: masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, j'ara lamatua ne unu dhèu goa, te ngaa nèngu mèu risi eele rèngu. aa masi ka ra pangee, na, lamatua dènge boe koasa, te ngaa koasa na dedha risi eele nèti rèngu.

source_text: for you see god's design for you, my brothers, that he has not taken a great number of the wise after the flesh, not the strong, not the noble:
target_text: a'ari pasue! sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu lii padhai ja'a ne, sanèd'e mamuri miu, lod'o lamatua hag'e nare miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha, ètu talora aae miu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu d'èlu-mèu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu dènge pangaru kapai, aa abhu boe dhèu ae dhu a'ari ra dhu dènge kolongara kapai.

source_text: but god made selection of the foolish things of this world so that he might put the wise to shame; and the feeble things that he might put to shame the strong;
target_text: te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, na, tabhènga ana liku, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu. aa na hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu dhèu rai-haha, dhèu dhu dènge boe koasa, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dènge koasa.

source_text: and the low things of the world, and the things without honour, did god make selection of, yes, even the things which are not, so that he might make as nothing the things which are:
target_text: hèia na hag'e nare dhèu haha dhu dènge boe kolongara, aa dhu biasa dhèu pahaha si. te lamatua neo pake si, sèna ka dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu kapai, j'aj'i sèmi dhèu dènge boe pangaru ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so that no flesh might have glory before god.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa tèb'a kakara ètu madha ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu dhèu kapai.

source_text: but god has given you a place in christ jesus, through whom god has given us wisdom and righteousness and salvation, and made us holy:
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu bhoke pataleo j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. lamatua ka pake yesus j'aj'i dhèu dhu pala-bagi mamèu na mi dedha èdhi. yesus èèna ka dhu oti j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua. yesus èèna ka dhu tao èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola dènge mèci. aa nèngu ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: so that, as it is said in the holy writings, whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the lord.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, cee ka dhu d'èi pakapai kolongara dhèu, be'a risi pakapai kolongara lamatua èdhi. baku pakapai iisi!

source_text: and when i came to you, my brothers, i did not come with wise words of knowledge, putting before you the secret of god.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a dhiu asa miu, ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna dhèu rai-haha ne re'a mèka. te ngaa ja'a kèti boe lii sèra ho padedha iisi. aa ja'a padhai boe pake lii dhu carui, sèna ka pad'elo mamèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: for i had made the decision to have knowledge of nothing among you but only of jesus christ on the cross.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a pad'elo dhoka ca j'ara di, nuka yesus kristus. nèngu ne, dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. te ngaa ropa yesus mai, dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhoka j'ara ne'e di, dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: and i was with you without strength, in fear and in doubt.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a rasa mamèu ja'a d'ai boe, aa ja'a madha'u ka isi karèbha.

source_text: and in my preaching there were no honeyed words of wisdom, but i was dependent on the power of the spirit to make it clear to you:
target_text: j'ara lii padhai ja'a, aa ngaa dhu ja'a lole, mud'a di. te ja'a ko'o boe pake lii dhu karisi sèna ka pamako miu. aad'o! te ngaa ropa ja'a peka-padhai, na, lii padhai ja'a j'aj'i led'a, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu ator ja'a, aa koasa na sab'a ètu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: so that your faith might be based not on man's wisdom but on the power of god.
target_text: te ja'a pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe miu parcaya ama lamatua, lula miu nanene lii padhai dhèu d'èlu-mèu di. dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu parcaya lamatua, lula na pad'elo koasa na mi dedha miu.

source_text: but still we have wisdom for those who are complete in knowledge, though not the wisdom of this world, and not of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing:
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe ji'i padhai lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya èra le, ji'i aj'a rèngu pake lii padhai dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu. te ngaa dhu re'a mèu èèna, madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, do, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu paredha sèra aj'a limuri ne. te sèra sa, bèli-camèd'a ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: but we give the news of the secret wisdom of god, which he had kept in store before the world came into existence, for our glory;
target_text: te ngaa ji'i aj'a dhoka j'ara mamèu dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. lula uru-uru sèra, lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, lamatua pahuni j'ara sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu pama'ète le, sèna ka neo bhoke patalele lii pahuni èèna hia èdhi, ho èdhi kahèi abhu pala ètu d'ara kolongara na dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: of which not one of the rulers of this world had knowledge: for if they had, they would not have put the lord of glory on the cross:
target_text: te ngaa dhèu paredha limuri ne, re'a mèu iia boe mamèu lamatua. te ladhe re'a tare'a, tatu ra paku pamadhe boe kètu èdhi dhu dedha risi èèna, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: but as it says in the holy writings, things which the eye saw not, and which had not come to the ears or into the heart of man, such things as god has made ready for those who have love for him.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri lula-nèti rahasia lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke, peka na, abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae rèdhi mèka dènge musi madha ra, aa abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae tadèngi rèdhi mèka dènge ro'a dhilu ra, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ngee rèdhi boe. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na lamatua sadia tèke le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: but god has given us the revelation of these things through his spirit, for the spirit makes search into all things, even the deep things of god.
target_text: uru èèna, mema dhèu re'a boe j'ara sèra, te ngaa limuri ne ama lamatua pake roh na ho bhoke paled'a hia èdhi. roh lamatua èèna ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. te nèngu parisa toke lutu d'ara iiki lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for who has knowledge of the things of a man but the spirit of the man which is in him? in the same way, no one has knowledge of the things of god but the spirit of god.
target_text: èdhi èci-èci ka dènge roh ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhèu rai-haha, èci-èci ka dènge ngangee aa tatao na. aa abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu ne'a mèu d'ara iiki èdhi, dhoka roh èdhi unu ti dhu ne'a. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a d'ara iiki lamatua. dhoka roh nèngu mesa na ka dhu ne'a mèu.

source_text: but we have not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which comes from god, so that we may have knowledge of the things which are freely given to us by god.
target_text: èdhi dhu sèmi tare le roh lamatua, ka nèngu ka dhu ator èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. lula roh lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi tadhe aa'i j'ara dhu be'a, dhu nèngu tao le hia èdhi.

source_text: and these are the things which we say, not in the language of man's wisdom, but in words given to us by the spirit, judging the things of the spirit by the help of the spirit.
target_text: j'ara sèra ka dhu èdhi tema padhue-padhai. te ji'i lole j'ara-j'ara dhu roh lamatua aj'a-nori ji'i. ka ji'i se aj'a boe pake lii dhu nèti mamèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori pake lii dhu mai nèti roh lamatua mi dhèu dhu tadhe nèngu.

source_text: for the natural man is not able to take in the things of the spirit of god: for they seem foolish to him, and he is not able to have knowledge of them, because such knowledge comes only through the spirit.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe roh lamatua, ropa na nanene lii padhai ji'i, nèngu d'èi boe sèmi. lula nèngu ngee, na, ngaa kèna? maso boe d'ara kahadhu! aa te ngaa, masi ka tasamia èèna ka, dhèu ne bisa boe ne'a j'ara sèra, te nèngu dhu mamuri pa'èki boe dènge roh lamatua.

source_text: but he who has the spirit, though judging all things, is himself judged by no one.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, heka re'a j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. te ngaa dhèu leo pajiko rare boe ngangee dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for who has knowledge of the mind of the lord, so as to be his teacher? but we have the mind of christ.
target_text: bisa tasamia? te abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na: cee ka dhu bisa re'a ngangee ama lamatua? do, cee ka dhu bisa ator lamatua, ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii holo-nori dhèu èèna? abhu boe ca dhèu sa! madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi te'a j'ara se'e, lula kristus ka dhu soru-bara sèna ka èdhi bisa pangee madhutu ngangee nèngu.

source_text: and the teaching i gave you, my brothers, was such as i was able to give, not to those who have the spirit, but to those who are still in the flesh, even to children in christ.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ja'a ètu èèna era, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dhae pa'èki èra mèka dènge roh lamatua. lula miu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu dhoo-dhoo di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha dhu leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe padhai lii dènge miu, nuka sèmi padhai lii dènge dhèu ee'a, te miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa.

source_text: i gave you milk and not meat, because you were, then, unable to take it, and even now you are not able;
target_text: ja'a hud'i aj'a miu j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe, lula miu bisa mèka sèmi mere j'ara dhu carui, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu bisa mèka ra'a sisi. miu hud'i kadhii ku, sama sèmi dhèu ee'a dhu tema ra'a sisi. te ngaa limuri ne, miu nuka sèmi ana rara iisi hiu era, dhu me'a dhoka minu susu di.

source_text: because you are still in the flesh: for when there is envy and division among you, are you not still walking after the way of the flesh, even as natural men?
target_text: lula ngangee miu cakaraa dhèu dhu neo dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu risi nèti miu, miu tèka d'ara aa patao-palaha leli! nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka na, miu me'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi miu dhoo-dhoo. de sèmi èèna na, miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for when one says, i am of paul; and another says, i am of apollos; are you not talking like natural men?
target_text: lula miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a ne, re paulus! aa cahag'e dhu peka na, ja'a ne, re apolos! lod'o-lod'o miu padhai lii sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo, na, miu èci èèna ka dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: what then is apollos? and what is paul? they are but servants who gave you the good news as god gave it to them.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, apolos èèna, cee? aa ja'a, paulus ne, cee? te ji'i dua mi se, dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i dhoka pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus. apolos pakako sasab'a madhutu paredha kètu èdhi. aa ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: i did the planting, apollos did the watering, but god gave the increase.
target_text: ja'a ka dhu uru tèka lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu sèle hini. hèia apolos mai aj'a-nori miu. èèna nuka sèmi nèngu ka dhu bui-tatee hini dhu ja'a sèle kore sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao hini sèra muri j'aj'i kapai aae.

source_text: so then the planter is nothing, and the waterer is nothing; but god who gives the increase.
target_text: de dhèu dhu sèle hini sèra dènge boe kab'ua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu bui. dhodhoka èci di dhu dènge kab'ua, nuka ama lamatua. lula nèngu ka tao hini sèra muri, ka sub'u dènge sega.

source_text: now the planter and the waterer are working for the same end: but they will have their separate rewards in the measure of their work.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèle, aa dhèu dhu bui-tatee, sab'a sama-sama, te sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakako sasab'a lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na b'ae rui-j'aj'èra ra.

source_text: for we are workers with god: you are god's planting, god's building.
target_text: te ji'i sama-sama dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. aa miu nuka sèmi oka lamatua, dhu nèngu neo uri. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu ama lamatua patitu.

source_text: in the measure of the grace given to me, i, as a wise master-builder, have put the base in position, and another goes on building on it. but let every man take care what he puts on it.
target_text: de lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèti èèna ka ja'a sama sèmi dholu. ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a ho ke'a mèu j'ara-j'ara nèti kapua, sèna ka ja'a tao era padhèdi dhu èra ètu d'ara mamuri miu. hèia dhèu leo aj'a-nori miu kahèi, ho rèngu patitu mi era padhèdi dhu ja'a tao kore èèna. te ngaa tuka èci-èci hud'i sab'a ku dènge d'ara kateme, ho rèngu patitu èmu dhu èra.

source_text: for there is no other base for the building but that which has been put down, which is jesus christ.
target_text: era padhèdi dhu èra èèna, abhu le. nuka yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo bisa boe tao era padhèdi leo ètu d'ara miu, te lamatua dhu tao tèke le era padhèdi dhu lèke.

source_text: but on the base a man may put gold, silver, stones of great price, wood, dry grass, cut stems;
target_text: tatu abhu dhèu dhu neo patitu kahèi ètu era padhèdi èèna pake rupa-rupa nèu. abhu dhu neo pake nèu dhu kab'ua, sèmi hualaa, doi pudhi do hadhu kale'e. abhu dhu pake nèu biasa, nuka sèmi aj'u, j'u'u do rèu hidhu.

source_text: every man's work will be made clear in that day, because it will be tested by fire; and the fire itself will make clear the quality of every man's work.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a tuka èci-èci ka bisa te'a, aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a sasab'a rèngu èèna, be'a do aad'o. te lod'o èle rai-haha, lamatua neo sèku ne, sama sèmi na pake ai ho pad'elo, na, sasab'a dhèu sèra, bisa taha do aad'o.

source_text: if any man's work comes through the test, he will have a reward.
target_text: ladhe uji nare sasab'a nèti ca dhèu pake ai, aa nèu dhu na pake bisa taha, bèli-camèd'a lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra na ètu sorga.

source_text: if the fire puts an end to any man's work, it will be his loss: but he will get salvation himself, though as by fire.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe uji nare sasab'a dhèu pake ai, aa ai na'e aa'i nèu dhu nèngu pake patitu ètu era padhèdi èèna, na, lamatua hia boe dhèu ne ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa tuka ne abhu mamuri era, masi ka sèmi dhèu dhu rai kalua nèti d'ara èmu ai na'e.

source_text: do you not see that you are god's holy house, and that the spirit of god has his place in you?
target_text: miu hud'i me'a ku, dhu peka na, miu sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a lamatua, aa roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara.

source_text: if anyone makes the house of god unclean, god will put an end to him; for the house of god is holy, and you are his house.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie èmu sabaj'a lamatua, nuka era pea na, na mage-mage! bèli-camèd'a lamatua pa'ele iie ne kahèi! te èmu sabaj'a lamatua èèna mola-mèci. de miu hud'i mola-mèci ku kahèi.

source_text: let no man have a false idea. if any man seems to himself to be wise among you, let him become foolish, so that he may be wise.
target_text: miu baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi! ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu aa ne'a aa'i madhutu mamèu dhèu ètu rai-haha lod'o limuri ne, èèna peka na, nèngu ne'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa. ladhe èu mase'a le, peka na, èu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa, heka èu mulai me'a kèna.

source_text: for the wisdom of this world is foolish before god. as it is said in the holy writings, he who takes the wise in their secret designs:
target_text: ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ama lamatua peka na, goa. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke, peka na: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa èèna na lamatua pake hari ngangee na dhu karehe sèra, j'aj'i mi sasii, ho sii pa'ele iie hari nèngu!

source_text: and again, the lord has knowledge of the reasonings of the wise, that they are nothing.
target_text: ètu era leo dhu suri kahèi, peka na, lamatua èdhi dhu ne'a le ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra pangee, aa dhèu dhu hud'i re'a ku neo tao ne tasa mere mia, nèngu dhu ne'a nare le, na, rèngu dhoka ngee iia d'ara di.

source_text: so let no one take pride in men. for all things are yours; paul, or apollos, or cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
target_text: de miu baku padedha dhèu èci sa, dhu peka na, nèngu èèna lènge aa'i dhèu. te lamatua ka dhu ded'e dhèu, ho ator miu. aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu miu. de dhèu dhu ator miu sèra, sama sèmi: ja'a, apolos, dènge petrus, ji'i se j'aj'i unu miu. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne unu miu kahèi, masi ka miu mamuri do miu madhe, masi ka deo ne'e do lod'o dhu mai, aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu miu kateme aae.

source_text: and you are christ's; and christ is god's.
target_text: aa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. aa kristus unu ama lamatua!

source_text: let us be judged as servants of christ, and as those who are responsible for the secret things of god.
target_text: de miu baku koa-kad'iri ji'i, te ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha kristus di. aa ama lamatua lèka ji'i, sèna ka j'aga paie-iie j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke.

source_text: and it is right for such servants to be safe persons.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhenga mèdha-panyau lamatua na, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: but it is a small thing to me that i am judged by you or by man's judging; i am not even a judge of myself.
target_text: tasamia dènge ja'a? ja'a sab'e madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, do aad'o? ja'a ko'o boe ke'a, miu nile ja'a tasa mera mia. aa ja'a pusi-pahae boe kahèi dhèu leo nile ja'a sèmi ngaa sa. ja'a ke'a boe nile ngi'u ja'a unu ku kahèi.

source_text: for i am not conscious of any wrong in myself; but this does not make me clear, for it is the lord who is my judge.
target_text: te masi ka d'ara iiki ja'a peka na, ja'a be'a le, tatu boe sasoa na, ja'a be'a. dhu mèci ka, lamatua ka dhu nile ja'a tasa mera mia.

source_text: for this reason let there be no judging before the time, till the lord comes, who will make clear the secret things of the dark, and the designs of the heart; and then will every man have his praise from god.
target_text: de miu baku tao ngi'u sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu ho nile dhèu leo sèra. mate mamai hari lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu. nèngu ka pasabhoka aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao pahuni ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu neo bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu ngee ètu d'ara ra. hèia ama lamatua neo peka aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu tao le.

source_text: my brothers, it is because of you that i have taken apollos and myself as examples of these things, so that in us you might see that it is not wise to go farther than what is in the holy writings, so that no one of you may be lifted up against his brother.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a dènge apolos, nuka sèmi ja'a j'aj'i mi conto ho miu bisa aj'a nèti ji'i, nuka: tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua. baku tao dhu leo. ladhe miu madhutu ka j'ara se'e, miu baku bia re èci sa, aa padedha iisi lula madhutu ca dhèu, aa pahahe dhèu leo.

source_text: for who made you better than your brother? or what have you that has not been given to you? but if it has been given to you, what cause have you for pride, as if it had not been given to you?
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, miu risi nèti dhèu leo, do? baku! te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu unu, miu abhu nèti ama lamatua. de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu nged'e ej'a ai, nuka sèmi miu ad'u-ue unu mi?

source_text: for even now you are full, even now you have wealth, you have been made kings without us: truly, i would be glad if you were kings, so that we might be kings with you.
target_text: nuka sèmi aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu, miu abhu le. nuka sèmi miu kaja le! miu tao ngi'u mi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu kapai sama sèmi dhèu aae sa, aa ji'i soru-bara boe ciki sa. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua ka dhu hia aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu. te ngaa ladhe miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu aae, ele boe ji'i ngèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge miu, si?

source_text: for it seems to me that god has put us the apostles last of all, as men whose fate is death: for we are put on view to the world, and to angels, and to men.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha ji'i, ho la'a asa mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka lole dènge dhèu j'ara-j'ara kristus. te ngaa ca tèka-ca tèka sa ja'a pangee, na, lamatua pua ji'i titu re limuri tèka, sama sèmi ana bèdho dhu tatae abhu huku madhe. hèia na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga mai laladhe ji'i.

source_text: we are made to seem foolish for christ, but you are wise in christ; we are feeble, but you are strong; you have glory, but we have shame.
target_text: miu kapai titu kèna, nga! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, miu d'èlu-mèu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus. te ngaa rèngu pangee, na, ji'i goa titu kèna, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. ele boe rèngu ngee, na, miu èra risi, aa ji'i se roe aala-aala. ele boe ra ded'e miu padedha-dedha, te ngaa ro'o boe pusi-pahae ji'i ciki sa hèi. seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: even to this hour we are without food, drink, and clothing, we are given blows and have no certain resting-place;
target_text: toke d'ai deo ne'e, ji'i manganga dènge koko-kamango. mèdha-papake ji'i kaha'i-kaheru. dhèu loe boe game ji'i. ji'i nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era pea.

source_text: and with our hands we do the hardest work: when they give us curses we give blessings, when we undergo punishment we take it quietly;
target_text: ji'i sab'a dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi toke d'ai èi kabhèsu hae. ladhe dhèu padhai-kakoli ji'i, ji'i dhoka b'ala, peka na, ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia miu. ladhe dhèu paj'èra ji'i, na, ji'i b'ala boe, dhoka mau-mau di.

source_text: when evil things are said about us we give gentle answers: we are made as the unclean things of the world, as that for which no one has any use, even till now.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i, ji'i dhoka dhaa dènge rèhu mare di. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ji'i se nuka sèmi kaj'alu do mamumu dhu core eele.

source_text: i am not saying these things to put you to shame, but so that, as my dear children, you may see what is right.
target_text: ja'a suri j'ara se'e, neo boe pamakae miu. te ngaa ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, lula ja'a sue miu nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a sa. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho lèpa asa j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: for even if you had ten thousand teachers in christ, you have not more than one father: for in christ jesus i have given birth to you through the good news.
target_text: masi ka dhèu riho-riho dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara hia miu lula-nèti kristus, te ngaa dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu j'aj'i ama miu. te ja'a ka dhèu uru j'ara dhu peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu parcaya ne. ja'a tao j'ara èèna, lula ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne.

source_text: so my desire is that you take me as your example.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka miu madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a ne.

source_text: for this cause i have sent timothy to you, who is my dear and true child in the lord; he will make clear to you my ways in christ, even as i am teaching everywhere in every church.
target_text: nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu soru-bara miu. ja'a sue ne, sama sèmi ana matana ja'a. ja'a lèka ne, te nèngu kahèi mamuri pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. èèna na nèngu soru-bara miu ho pasanèd'e miu nèti mamuri ja'a. j'ara mamuri ja'a sèmi èèna, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. èèna ka dhu ja'a aj'a-nori dènge dhèu sarani dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: now some are full of pride, as if i was not coming to you.
target_text: abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ja'a lake kore boe dhiu dènge miu. nèti èèna ka rèngu nged'e titu kèna.

source_text: but i will come to you in a short time, if it is pleasing to the lord, and i will take note, not of the word of those who are full of pride, but of the power.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua èdhi d'èi, nèbhu boe ja'a d'ai kota korintus. ho èèna na ja'a ke'a mèu, na, dhèu sèra padhai lii padedha iisi, do, rèngu tare'a dènge koasa!

source_text: for the kingdom of god is not in word but in power.
target_text: te ama lamatua èèna dhèu aae dhu unu koasa. ka dhèu nèngu hèb'a mènyi boe, ho pa'èra dhèu ètu d'ara lalèka ra, te ngaa rèngu pake koasa dhu lèke.

source_text: what is your desire? is my coming to be with punishment, or is it to be in love and a gentle spirit?
target_text: de dad'èi miu tasamia? ladhe ja'a dhiu, na, ja'a tao lii sakaa aa huku miu? do, ja'a dhiu pad'elo sasue dènge d'ara be'a?

source_text: it is said, in fact, that there is among you a sin of the flesh, such as is not seen even among the gentiles, that one of you has his father's wife.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, ca dhèu nèti juma'at miu dhu ad'u j'ara karehe dènge dhèu bhèni. ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue ne bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula nèngu j'unu pa'èci dènge ina bhala na!

source_text: and in place of feeling sorrow, you are pleased with yourselves, so that he who has done this thing has not been sent away from among you.
target_text: te ngaa miu pamone-pabhèni, sèmi juma'at miu mola-mèci le! te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, miu hud'i makae ku, aa d'ara pèd'a. dhèu sèmi èèna, babège eele ne pakaj'èu!

source_text: for i myself, being present in spirit though not in body, have come to a decision about him who has done this thing;
target_text: masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu èci dènge èci, te ngaa d'ara ja'a dhoka ètu miu di. de ja'a pama'ète kore le lii langu dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae èèna, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu ètu èèna le.

source_text: in the name of our lord jesus, when you have come together with my spirit, with the power of our lord jesus,
target_text: ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète sèmi èèna, lula yesus j'aj'i kètu èdhi, aa ja'a dhèu pajuu-paleha na. de miu hud'i madhèdi pa'èci ku ho pama'ète lii langu èèna pake kolongara kètu èdhi. aa d'ara ja'a sama-sama dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: that this man is to be handed over to satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may have forgiveness in the day of the lord jesus.
target_text: hèia miu hud'i saraka dhèu ne asa dhèu aae nidhu, sèna ka nèbhu-nèbhu na core eele j'ara bhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara na. sèna ka ladhe kètu èdhi mai hari, na, nèngu patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na.

source_text: this pride of yours is not good. do you not see that a little leaven makes a change in all the mass?
target_text: be'a boe ladhe miu nged'e! baku bhèlu, na, èdhi pakihu bibit roti ciki di ho bisa pakapai adonan aa'i-aa'i. bibit roti, nuka sèmi bhabhelu dhèu. de ladhe soro tèke dhèu ad'u-ue bhabhelu ètu talora aae miu, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani leo sèra madhutu tao bhelu kahèi!

source_text: take away, then, the old leaven, so that you may be a new mass, even as you are without leaven. for christ has been put to death as our passover.
target_text: babège eele dhèu bhelu èèna nèti juma'at miu, sèmi uru èèna dhèu yahudi sèra core eele ragi aa'i-aa'i nèti èmu rèngu sèra ho neo ra'a kalela paska. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa j'aj'i hari nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara na abhu heka bhelu-katub'a. miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sèmi èèna. uru èèna, dhèu roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao badha korban kalela paska. d'ai limuri ku, rèngu pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i korban dhu pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: let us then keep the feast, not with old leaven, and not with the leaven of evil thoughts and acts, but with the unleavened bread of true thoughts and right feelings.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu yahudi ra'a gee-j'ara nèti roti dhu pake boe ragi ètu d'ara lod'o kalela paska. limuri ne, èdhi nuka sèmi roti dhu pake boe ragi èèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i j'aga paie mamuri èdhi sèna ka baku tao ia ka j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, aa baku papèd'a d'ara dhèu leo. èdhi hud'i padhai lii dhu lèke taruu. hèia ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri èdhi, ra peka na, tatao èdhi madhutu d'ara mola.

source_text: in my letter i said to you that you were not to keep company with those who go after the desires of the flesh;
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a suri kèdhi le sasuri dhu peka na, baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: but i had not in mind the sinners who are outside the church, or those who have a desire for and take the property of others, or those who give worship to images; for it is not possible to keep away from such people without going out of the world completely:
target_text: a'abhu ja'a ne peka boe, na, miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, do dhèu manga'a, do dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu mana'u rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, do dènge dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu. te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i tao iisi mi pakaj'èu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but the sense of my letter was that if a brother had the name of being one who went after the desires of the flesh, or had the desire for other people's property, or was in the way of using violent language, or being the worse for drink, or took by force what was not his, you might not keep company with such a one, or take food with him.
target_text: te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne nuka: miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu sarani, aa te ngaa nèngu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, do dhu manga'a, do dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, do dhu pahahe kolongara dhèu, do dhu mahu, do dhu kapod'e mèdha-panyau dhèu. èdhi baku pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. aa loe eele ka madhèdi mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for it is no business of mine to be judging those who are outside; but it is yours to be judging those who are among you;
target_text: miu dènge hak ho lee mamuri dhèu sarani. te ngaa ja'a dènge boe hak, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua.

source_text: as for those who are outside, god is their judge. so put away the evil man from among you.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka bèli-camèd'a pama'ète hia dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne. de miu baku bhèlu, ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa loe boe tao bhabhelu, na, babège eele ne!

source_text: how is it, that if any one of you has a cause at law against another, he takes it before a gentile judge and not before the saints?
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu sarani pagalaa dènge a'ari na dhèu sarani, nga tao ka lami asa pengadilan ètu madha hakim dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua? tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna? be'a risi lami asa madha dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu uri lii langu miu!

source_text: is it not certain that the saints will be the judges of the world? if then the world will be judged by you, are you unable to give a decision about the smallest things?
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu dhae me'a mèka, peka na, dhèu-dhèu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a rèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. de tasamia ka miu mesa mi bisa boe uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki?

source_text: is it not certain that we are to be the judges of angels? how much more then of the things of this life?
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, ladhe bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu uri lii langu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. de tatu hud'i miu ku dhu uri lii langu dhu bèli-bèli j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: if then there are questions to be judged in connection with the things of this life, why do you put them in the hands of those who have no position in the church?
target_text: risi-risi hari, ladhe miu dhèu parcaya pagalaa lula-nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, nga tao ka miu pake dhèu pama'ète lii dhu dhèu-dhèu sarani pakab'ua boe si?

source_text: i say this to put you to shame. is there not among you one wise man who may be able to give a decision between his brothers?
target_text: de ja'a neo peka ca j'ara dhu pamakae miu. sèmi ngaa? nuka sèmi ètu talora aae miu abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu d'èlu-mèu uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, sèmi lii langu dhu cèu nèti a'ari èdhi.

source_text: but a brother who has a cause at law against another takes it before gentile judges.
target_text: te ngaa nèti talora miu abhu dhèu parcaya dhu ère nèti a'ari na dhèu parcaya asa madha dhèu pama'ète lii langu! aa te ngaa dhèu pama'ète lii langu ne dhu parcaya boe lamatua!

source_text: more than this, it is not to your credit to have causes at law with one another at all. why not put up with wrong? why not undergo loss?
target_text: lèke boe, sina ma? miu dhu segi boe le èèna, ladhe miu èci dènge èci lami pagalaa asa era pama'ète lii langu. be'a risi, a'ari èu èèna soro tèke ne, ladhe na tao sala mi dedha èu. aa ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya mana'u nare mèdha-panyau èu, be'a risi hud'i laa nare!

source_text: so far from doing this, you yourselves do wrong and take your brothers' property.
target_text: te ngaa miu dhèu parcaya èci tao sala mi a'ari miu. aa èci mana'u èci. aa te ngaa miu sama-sama dhèu parcaya!

source_text: have you not knowledge that evil-doers will have no part in the kingdom of god? have no false ideas about this: no one who goes after the desires of the flesh, or gives worship to images, or is untrue when married, or is less than a man, or makes a wrong use of men,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi me'a boe j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i! te dhèu dhu ro'o boe tao dhu lèke, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. mage soro tèke dhèu tipu miu, sèna ka miu ad'u-ue sasala! dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhu bersina, mone dhèu dua dhu pa'èci nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali,

source_text: or is a thief, or the worse for drink, or makes use of strong language, or takes by force what is not his, will have any part in the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhèu mana'u, dhèu manga'a, dhèu rinu mahu, dhu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu, dhu pakapod'e ho rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi se'e se, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua!

source_text: and such were some of you; but you have been washed, you have been made holy, you have been given righteousness in the name of the lord jesus christ and in the spirit of our god.
target_text: mema, uru èèna miu cahag'e sèmi èèna kahèi! te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia pamèu miu. aa nèngu bhoke le j'ara kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne. na tao j'ara se'e, lula miu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa lula miu pa'èki dènge roh lamatua kahèi.

source_text: i am free to do all things; but not all things are wise. i am free to do all things; but i will not let myself come under the power of any.
target_text: ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a neo tao sèra, tatu boe be'a hia ja'a. de masi ka ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe j'ara dhu karehe koasa nare ja'a.

source_text: food is for the stomach and the stomach for food, and god will put an end to them together. but the body is not for the desires of the flesh, but for the lord; and the lord for the body:
target_text: conto sèmi, dhèu peka na, nganga'a parluu kabake, aa kabake parluu nganga'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua palaho aa'i dua-dua ra. conto dhu leo hari, èdhi bisa boe soro ngi'u èdhi sèna ka bisa tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali èdhi boe. èdhi unu ngi'u ne, sèna ka sab'a hia lamatua èdhi. aa lamatua èdhi ladhe-leru ngi'u èdhi.

source_text: and god who made the lord jesus come back from the dead will do the same for us by his power.
target_text: ropa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus madhe, ama lamatua ka pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe èdhi madhe, nèngu dènge koasa kahèi ho pamamuri hari èdhi.

source_text: do you not see that your bodies are part of the body of christ? how then may i take what is a part of the body of christ and make it a part of the body of a loose woman? such a thing may not be.
target_text: ngi'u miu j'aj'i mi unu kristus, nuka sèmi miu bagian nèti ngi'u kristus. tatu j'ara ne, miu me'a le! de ladhe ja'a pake bagian nèti ngi'u kristus, ho laku pa'èci dènge ngi'u nèti bhèni kajeo, na tasamia? baku sèmi èèna! te èèna na lèke boe!

source_text: or do you not see that he who is joined to a loose woman is one body with her? for god has said, the two of them will become one flesh.
target_text: tatu miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao j'ara makae ho j'unu pa'èci dènge bhèni kajeo, na, dua-dua pakihu kee j'aj'i mi èci. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, rèngu dua ra pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but he who is united to the lord is one spirit.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i le èci dènge nèngu, sama sèmi dua ra dhu pa'èki ètu d'ara roh èci.

source_text: keep away from the desires of the flesh. every sin which a man does is outside of the body; but he who goes after the desires of the flesh does evil to his body.
target_text: ladhe èu abhu tebho tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu èu boe, na, rai pakaj'èu! dhèu ad'u-ue sasala rupa-rupa dhu pa'ele iie rèngu unu ra, aa pa'ele iie dhèu leo kahèi. te dhèu dhu karihu kaj'alu pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: or are you not conscious that your body is a house for the holy spirit which is in you, and which has been given to you by god? and you are not the owners of yourselves;
target_text: ngi'u èu èèna, nuka sèmi èmu sabaj'a roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. roh nèngu èèna ka, dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, te ama lamatua mesa na ka hia roh na mi dedha miu. nèti èèna ka, miu dènge boe hak ciki sa hèi, ho j'aj'i lamatua dhu ator ngi'u miu unu mi. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu mamuri sèmi pame'a boe sa dènge j'ara se'e?

source_text: for a payment has been made for you: let god be honoured in your body.
target_text: kristus sui nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. de miu hud'i mamuri ku dènge pakab'ua ngi'u miu unu mi, ho pad'elo, na, miu pakab'ua ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now, as to the things in your letter to me: it is good for a man to have nothing to do with a woman.
target_text: ja'a neo suri j'ara-j'ara dhu miu pakarèi ètu d'ara sasuri miu èèna, dhu peka na, tasamia? dhu be'a ka, dhèu mone baku leo-èmu, do?

source_text: but because of the desires of the flesh, let every man have his wife, and every woman her husband.
target_text: sèmi ne'e: lula abhu lod'o taleo ae, dhu dhèu bisa manahu asa d'ara tatao dhu sala ètu d'ara pa'èci mone dènge bhèni, nèti èèna ka be'a risi dhèu mone èci hud'i dènge ku dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu bhèni hud'i pa'èci ku dènge dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na.

source_text: let the husband give to the wife what is right; and let the wife do the same to the husband.
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu. aa dhèu bhèni dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu.

source_text: the wife has not power over her body, but the husband; and in the same way the husband has not power over his body, but the wife.
target_text: te bhèni dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na sèna ka j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na. aa mone dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na ho j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na.

source_text: do not keep back from one another what is right, but only for a short time, and by agreement, so that you may give yourselves to prayer, and come together again; so that satan may not get the better of you through your loss of self-control.
target_text: de miu baku patula-pajuku, lula dua-dua mi dhu dènge hak hua! te ngaa ladhe miu neo sabaj'a di, ho mo'o boe ngee j'ara dhu leo-leo, na, j'unu pa'èci boe d'ara ciki oo'e èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i dua mi mere lii èci ku. aa ladhe sabaj'a mere, na, be'a risi pakaboko hari dènge ka. te ladhe aad'o, na, bisa j'aj'i be'a boe! te dhèu aae nidhu bisa dadugu-rariu dhèu dhu taha rare boe d'ara.

source_text: but this i say as my opinion, and not as an order of the lord.
target_text: j'ara ne mai nèti a'abhu ja'a di, nèti boe atora lamatua.

source_text: it is my desire that all men might be even as i am. but every man has the power of his special way of life given him by god, one in this way and one in that.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, be'a risi dhèu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu dènge boe dhèu èmu. te ngaa ama lamatua hia dhèu karunya pamèci dènge nèngu. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hia si leo-èmu, aa abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si leo boe èmu.

source_text: but i say to the unmarried and to the widows, it is good for them to be even as i am.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni dhu leo mèka èmu, aa dènge bhèni balu, na, be'a risi miu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a ne.

source_text: but if they have not self-control let them get married; for married life is better than the burning of desire.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe taha mere boe, hua iia leo èmu ka. dhu hua iia risi ladhe dhèu leo-èmu, te aad'o na, dad'èi d'ara na pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: but to the married i give orders, though not i but the lord, that the wife may not go away from her husband
target_text: ne'e ne mai boe nèti ngangee ja'a mesa ku. te ja'a neo peka ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha le mi dhèu dhu leo le èmu, na, bhèni bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: or if she goes away from him, let her keep unmarried, or be united to her husband again; and that the husband may not go away from his wife.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèke eele dhèu èmu na, be'a risi leo ia ka èmu. hua iia nèngu la'e padame dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. sèmi èèna kahèi mone, bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but to the rest i say, and not the lord; if a brother has a wife who is not a christian, and it is her desire to go on living with him, let him not go away from her.
target_text: ne'e ne madhutu ngangee ja'a, mai boe nèti lamatua èdhi. aa mi dhèu leo, ja'a neo padhai lii sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu mone dhèu sarani dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe dhèu èmu na neo mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: and if a woman has a husband who is not a christian, and it is his desire to go on living with her, let her not go away from her husband.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe mone ne d'èi era sèna ka dua ra mamuri pa'èci taruu.

source_text: for the husband who has not faith is made holy through his christian wife, and the wife who is not a christian is made holy through the brother: if not, your children would be unholy, but now are they holy.
target_text: te mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa mola-mèci, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge bhèni dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. aa bhèni dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. te ladhe aad'o, na, ana-ana rèngu bisa boe mola-mèci. te ngaa dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: but if the one who is not a christian has a desire to go away, let it be so: the brother or the sister in such a position is not forced to do one thing or the other: but it is god's pleasure that we may be at peace with one another.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu bhèni do dhèu mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, dhu la'e tèke eele dhèu èmu-kamali na dhu parcaya, na hud'i nèngu sène. ka dhèu èmu dhu parcaya, pa'èki heka dènge ne. te ama lamatua paroa miu sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for how may you be certain, o wife, that you will not be the cause of salvation to your husband? or you, o husband, that you may not do the same for your wife?
target_text: dhèu bhèni dhu parcaya, dhu leo le èmu aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu mone dhu parcaya dhu leo le èmu sèra! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. miu me'a iia mèka.

source_text: only, as the lord has given to a man, and as is the purpose of god for him, so let him go on living. and these are my orders for all the churches.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa mamuri dhèu èci-èci tasa mera mia lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri taruu sèmi èèna. baku ub'a hari, te ama lamatua dhu ator nare le sèmi èèna. ja'a aj'a-nori atora ne ètu juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if any man who is a christian has had circumcision, let him keep so; and if any man who is a christian has not had circumcision, let him make no change.
target_text: conto, ladhe miu suna le sèna ka pad'elo, na, miu dhèu yahudi, hèia lod'o limuri miu tadèngi ama lamatua paroa nare miu, na, baku pasili, peka na, miu suna le. aa dhèu dhu dhae suna mèka ropa tadèngi ama lamatua paroa si, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, na, suna ia ka. lula rèngu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: circumcision is nothing, and its opposite is nothing, but only doing the orders of god is of value.
target_text: ladhe dhu suna le, èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. aa suna mèka èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. dhu dènge kab'ua ka, nuka èdhi madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: let every man keep the position in which he has been placed by god.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lamatua pua boe miu suna, do baku suna. de hud'i ka laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka.

source_text: if you were a servant when you became a christian, let it not be a grief to you; but if you have a chance to become free, make use of it.
target_text: ja'a hia hari conto èci. ladhe èu j'aj'i ènu lod'o ama lamatua paroa èu, na, hud'i laa sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa ladhe sèmi èu dhu ènu boe, na, hud'i laa! ladhe bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu bebas, ngaa-ngaa tao boe kahèi.

source_text: for he who was a servant when he became a christian is the lord's free man; and he who was free when he became a christian is the lord's servant.
target_text: te ropa lamatua paroa ca dhèu ènu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ènu ne j'aj'i le sèmi ca dhèu dhu bebas, dhu sab'a hia lamatua na ètu sorga. aa lod'o ama lamatua paroa ca dhèu bebas j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhèu ne j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus.

source_text: it is the lord who has made payment for you: be not servants of men.
target_text: kristus tihe pama'ète nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna! de miu baku j'aj'i ènu hia dhèu leo.

source_text: my brothers, let every man keep in that condition which is the purpose of god for him.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri miu tasamia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka. hud'i laa sèmi èèna ka, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: now about virgins i have no orders from the lord: but i give my opinion as one to whom the lord has given mercy to be true to him.
target_text: miu karèi ja'a lula-nèti dhèu kalora iisi dhu j'unu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa. ama lamatua peka boe ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a nèti j'ara èèna. te ngaa miu bisa sèmi ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai, lula ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia mi ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: in my opinion then, because of the present trouble, it is good for a man to keep as he is.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi abhu j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. de mamuri dhèu tasa mera mia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: if you are married to a wife, make no attempt to get free from her: if you are free from a wife, do not take a wife.
target_text: ladhe èu pa'èki dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, baku ia eele ne. ladhe èu dhu pa'èki heka dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, tenge ia ka bhèni leo, sèna ka leo ia ka èmu.

source_text: if you get married it is not a sin; and if an unmarried woman gets married it is not a sin. but those who do so will have trouble in the flesh. but i will not be hard on you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èu leo hari èmu, na, èu sala boe ngaa-ngaa. aa ladhe bhèni dhu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone leo-èmu, nèngu ad'u-ue boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa sanèd'e, dhèu dhu paleo èmu, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa ètu rai-haha ne. dad'èi ja'a sèna ka miu baku susa sèmi èèna.

source_text: but i say this, my brothers, the time is short; and from now it will be wise for those who have wives to be as if they had them not;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! madhutu ngangee ja'a, nuka: lod'o oe èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le. de mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu, mage ladhe dhoka dhèu èmu nèngu di, te ngaa laladhe kahèi asa lamatua.

source_text: and for those who are in sorrow, to give no signs of it; and for those who are glad, to give no signs of joy; and for those who are getting property, to be as if they had nothing;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhu tangi, be'a risi pa'èra d'ara ho baku tangi, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu karej'e-karae, be'a risi baku karej'e seli, te ngaa laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu hèli ngaa-ngaa, be'a risi tao mamuri na nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua.

source_text: and for those who make use of the world, not to be using it fully; for this world's way of life will quickly come to an end.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pake mèdha-panyau nèti rai-haha ne, be'a risi tao ngi'u na, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri na dhu maena boe mi mèdha-panyau rai-haha ne, sèna ka na laladhe dhoka asa ama lamatua di. lula j'ara mamuri rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele.

source_text: but it is my desire for you to be free from cares. the unmarried man gives his mind to the things of the lord, how he may give pleasure to the lord:
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu baku pangee ae-ae. te dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lod'o nèngu ae ho na tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. sèna ka nèngu bisa tenge j'ara ho sab'a pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: but the married man gives his attention to the things of this world, how he may give pleasure to his wife. and the wife is not the same as the virgin. the virgin gives her mind to the things of the lord, so that she may be holy in body and in spirit: but the married woman takes thought for the things of the world, how she may give pleasure to her husband.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu leo le èmu, hud'i taru kira dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèngu kahèi hud'i taru kira ku mi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu hud'i tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi. j'ara se'e se ka tao ngangee na j'aj'i mi kajari. sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge heka dhèu èmu, aa bhèni kalora iisi. rèngu taru kira dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka bisa mamuri mola-mèci ètu d'ara dènge ngi'u aae. te ngaa bhèni dhu leo le èmu, d'ara na kajari. nèngu taru kira ka mi dad'èi lamatua, te ngaa na tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi.

source_text: now i say this for your profit; not to make things hard for you, but because of what is right, and so that you may be able to give all your attention to the things of the lord.
target_text: ja'a lole j'ara se'e, sèna ka nèti babe'a hia miu. ja'a ko'o boe ho miu lèke sasii. dad'èi ja'a ka, miu tao dhu lèke, aa tangare asa dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: but if, in any man's opinion, he is not doing what is right for his virgin, if she is past her best years, and there is need for it, let him do what seems right to him; it is no sin; let them be married.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mone dhu lii d'ai le bhèni dhu d'ai umur paleo èmu, na, hud'i laa ra paleo, ladhe mone ne d'èi heka pamata. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu tao boe j'ara sala. te ladhe ra mate panèbhu, mage dhoka mone èèna taha nare boe d'ara, hèia nèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but the man who is strong in mind and purpose, who is not forced but has control over his desires, does well if he comes to the decision to keep her a virgin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mone ne bisa taha nare d'ara, nèngu baku laka-seti ho kab'i lai-lai. te ne'a ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. masi ka nare nèbhu, dènge boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so then, he who gets married to his virgin does well, and he who keeps her unmarried does better.
target_text: de dhèu mone dhu leo dènge bhèni na, èèna be'a. aa dhu leo boe èmu èèna, be'a risi hari.

source_text: it is right for a wife to be with her husband as long as he is living; but when her husband is dead, she is free to be married to another; but only to a christian.
target_text: bhèni dhu leo le èmu, pa'èki toke madhe dènge dhèu èmu na. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe, nèngu bisa leo hari dènge dhèu mone leo, sad'i mone ne dhèu dhu parcaya kristus kahèi.

source_text: but it will be better for her to keep as she is, in my opinion: and it seems to me that i have the spirit of god.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, be'a risi bhèni balu ne, leo ia ka èmu. ja'a pangee, na, lii holo ne cèu nèti roh lamatua dhu ètu d'ara ja'a kahèi.

source_text: now about things offered to images: we all seem to ourselves to have knowledge. knowledge gives pride, but love gives true strength.
target_text: ja'a neo lole lula-nèti sisi dhu dhèu pake sogo-tagu nidhu. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu te'a ae le j'ara se'e. dhu j'aj'i mi lii langu, ka ladhe dhèu ne'a ae, na, nèngu bisa nged'e, te na pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu risi nèti dhèu leo sèra. de be'a risi, èdhi mamuri dènge pasue di. te j'ara pasue ne'e ka tao dhèu aa'i-aa'i asa tabha èra ètu d'ara parcaya ra.

source_text: if anyone seems to himself to have knowledge, so far he has not the right sort of knowledge about anything;
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ne'a mèu, èèna peka na, mamèu nèngu dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: but if anyone has love for god, god has knowledge of him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sue ama lamatua, tatu lamatua tadhe ne. ne'e ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: so, then, as to the question of taking food offered to images, we are certain that an image is nothing in the world, and that there is no god but one.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu na'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu le mi nidhu, èdhi aa'i-aa'i te'a, na, nèngu dhoka pahaha iisi mi mèdha sogo-tagu ètu rai-haha di, te ngaa pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu lèke. te èdhi te'a, na, abhu dhoka ama lamatua èci di dhu lèke aa, mèdha sogo-tagu aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu, dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for though there are those who have the name of gods, in heaven or on earth, as there are a number of gods and a number of lords,
target_text: abhu mèdha ae-ae ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu peka, na, ‘lamatua rèngu' do aad'o na, ‘kètu rèngu'.

source_text: there is for us only one god, the father, of whom are all things, and we are for him; and one lord, jesus christ, through whom are all things, and we have our being through him.
target_text: te ngaa bagi èdhi, ama lamatua dhoka èci di. nèngu èèna, ama èdhi. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti nèngu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao hia mi nèngu. aa kètu èdhi dhoka èci di, nuka yesus kristus. ama lamatua pake yesus, lod'o na paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. aa èdhi mamuri, lula yesus ka dhu hia èdhi.

source_text: still, all men have not that knowledge: but some, being used till now to the image, are conscious that they are taking food which has been offered to the image; and because they are not strong in the faith, their minds are troubled.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara se'e. rèngu loe boe pangee mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, hèia ngangee rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ngangee rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, ropa ra'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, rèngu pangee, na, nganga'a ne j'aj'i le korban ho pake sogo-tagu nidhu! ladhe ja'a ku'a mèdha ne'e, na, ja'a pa'èki era dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu! de ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee rèngu, toke rèngu bisa heka unu ngangee madhera, lula d'ara rèngu èra boe.

source_text: but god's approval of us is not based on the food we take: if we do not take it we are no worse for it; and if we take it we are no better.
target_text: nga tao ka sèmi èèna? nganga'a bisa boe nèti èdhi asa madha ama lamatua, si? ladhe ta'a boe, èdhi asa boe bhelu, sina ma? aa ladhe ta'a, tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu be'a, si?

source_text: but take care that this power of yours does not give cause for trouble to the feeble.
target_text: te ngaa mage-mage! masi ka èu dènge hak sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èci, tatu boe j'ara ne nèti babe'a hia èu. ladhe sèmi abhu a'ari ca dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu tao j'ara èèna, hèia na manahu, na, èèna be'a boe!

source_text: for if a man sees you, who have knowledge, taking food as a guest in the house of an image, will it not give him, if he is feeble, the idea that he may take food offered to images?
target_text: èu dhu me'a le, j'ara ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. te ngaa ladhe a'ari dhèu parcaya dhu d'ara na èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu mu'a ètu d'ara èmu sogo-tagu, na pangee sèmi ngaa? tatu na pangee, na, ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a sogo-tagu èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, masi ka nganga'a èèna ra pae'a le nidhu.

source_text: and so, through your knowledge, you are the cause of destruction to your brother, for whom christ underwent death.
target_text: èu me'a le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu asa paroe d'ara dhèu dhu èra mèka. aa te ngaa dhèu èèna, a'ari èu dhèu parcaya. kristus madhe hia nèngu kahèi!

source_text: and in this way, doing evil to the brothers, and causing trouble to those whose faith is feeble, you are sinning against christ.
target_text: hua iia pangee sèmi ne'e: ladhe a'ari èu dhu d'ara èra mèka ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu ngangee rèngu sala lula tatao èu, na, èu tao le sasala hia rèngu. aa èu tao sasala mi kristus kahèi.

source_text: for this reason, if food is a cause of trouble to my brother, i will give up taking meat for ever, so that i may not be a cause of trouble to my brother.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a dhu tao a'ari ja'a dhèu parcaya manahu asa d'ara sasala, be'a risi ja'a baku ku'a sisi sèmi sèra, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. te ja'a ko'o boe rèngu manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: am i not free? am i not an apostle? have i not seen jesus our lord? are you not my work in the lord?
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge boe hak ho suri sèmi ne'e hia miu. te ama lamatua pua ja'a laku lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a dhu kèdhi le kètu èdhi, yesus èèna. ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne. hèia miu aa'i-aa'i parcaya nèngu kahèi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ne.

source_text: if to others i am not an apostle, at least i am one to you: for the fact that you are christians is the sign that i am an apostle.
target_text: masi ka dhèu leo ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, te ngaa tatu miu me'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a dhiu peka-padhai lii moa na asa miu. ladhe miu neo me'a mèu, na, lee mamuri miu di. te miu dhu pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus!

source_text: my answer to those who are judging me is this.
target_text: ja'a neo dhaa mi dhèu dhu pèci sasala mi dedha ja'a, sèmi ne'e:

source_text: have we no right to take food and drink?
target_text: miu ngee, na, ja'a dènge barnabas dènge boe hak ho abhu nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu dhu ji'i aj'a-nori si, do?

source_text: have we no right to take about with us a christian wife, like the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the lord, and cephas?
target_text: miu pangee, na, ji'i dènge boe hak ho leo dènge dhèu bhèni kristen, dhu la'a sama-sama pakako sasab'a lamatua ètu era leo, do? madhutu iia-iia na, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra, rèti kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. ari lamatua yesus sèra tao sèmi èèna. petrus mesa na sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: or i only and barnabas, have we no right to take a rest from work?
target_text: do, miu ngee na, dhoka ja'a dènge barnabas di dhu hud'i sab'a tenge doi-dhari, sèna ka bisa mamuri ho aj'a-nori dhèu?

source_text: who ever goes to war without looking to someone to be responsible for his payment? who puts in vines and does not take the fruit of them? or who takes care of sheep without drinking of their milk?
target_text: ngangee miu sèmi èèna, mai nèti mia? ladhe sèku sordad'u sèra. rèngu pusi boe hèli nganga'a-nganginu dènge mèdha-papake. ladhe sèku dhèu sab'a ètu oka anggor. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kai, peka na, èu baku mu'a hua anggor sèra! aa ladhe sèku dhèu madhenga badha. dhèu ne dènge hak ho nare susu nèti kahib'i-kalèbho dhu nèngu j'aga.

source_text: am i talking as a man? does not the law say the same?
target_text: ja'a padhai lii ne madhutu boe ngangee ja'a dhèu rai-haha ne. te atora sèra nèti ama lamatua dhu peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for it says in the law of moses, it is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. is it for the oxen that god is giving orders?
target_text: ètu atora musa, dhu suri peka na, ropa sapi j'èli are ho hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, baku kape hèb'a na, sèna ka bisa na'a. miu pangee, na, lamatua soro tèke sèna ka dhoka sapi di dhu bisa na'a, do?

source_text: or has he us in mind? yes, it was said for us; because it is right for the ploughman to do his ploughing in hope, and for him who is crushing the grain to do his work hoping for a part in the fruits of it. if we have been planting the things of the spirit for you, does it seem a great thing for you to give us a part in your things of this world?
target_text: aad'o! lamatua peka na, nèngu taru kira èdhi kahèi. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu dhu kabèli rai, aa dhèu dhu hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, ropa ra sab'a, rèngu re'a kahèi, èèna na abhu pala ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, be'a risi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhèu kristen sèra, bisa abhu pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra ra. te lod'o ji'i aj'a-nori miu j'ara-j'ara nèti roh lamatua èèna, ji'i nuka sèmi ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe dhu sèle hini. de lod'o ji'i aj'a ngare, ladhe ji'i abhu nganga'a-nganginu do ngaa hari nèti miu, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te j'ara na sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: if others have a part in this right over you, have we not even more? but we did not make use of our right, so that we might put nothing in the way of the good news of christ.
target_text: dhèu leo dhu aj'a-nori miu, dènge hak sèna ka abhu dhua-èi dènge mèdha-panyau nèti miu, si? aa ji'i tasamia? ji'i dènge hak risi eele nèti rèngu! te ngaa miu me'a le. ji'i se pake ngèdhi boe hak ho laka-seti miu. ji'i pa'èra ètu rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka baku magee miu. te, dènge j'ara ne'e, miu d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu.

source_text: do you not see that the servants of the holy things get their living from the temple, and the servants of the altar have their part in the food which is offered on the altar?
target_text: pangee ku laa! ama-ama agama dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, mamuri nèti persembahan dhu dhèu rèti. aa dhèu dhu sab'a ètu mei korban, ra'a sisi nèti badha dhu dhèu rèti.

source_text: even so did the lord give orders that the preachers of the good news might get their living from the good news.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua dhu moa, na, dhèu dhu sasab'a ra peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus, rèngu bisa mamuri nèti rui-j'aj'èra nèti sasab'a-la'a ra. dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: but i have not made use of any of these things: and i am not writing this in the hope that it may be so for me: for it would be better for me to undergo death, than for any man to make this pride of mine of no effect.
target_text: masi ka ja'a dènge hak ho mamuri sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a d'èi boe tao sèmi èèna. ja'a suri boe sasuri ne sèna ka miu hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pakako sasab'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. de hua iia risi ja'a madhe, ladhe dhèu pangee, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu.

source_text: for if i am a preacher of the good news, i have no cause for pride in this; because i am forced to do so, for a curse is on me if i do not.
target_text: masi ka ja'a lole taruu dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a lamatua, te ngaa èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci, dhu ja'a bisa padedha iisi. ja'a hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti lamatua, te lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a sèmi èèna. ladhe ja'a sab'a boe madhutu sasab'a ja'a, na dui kore j'aj'èra! te tatu pasae kore hahuku.

source_text: but if i do it gladly, i have a reward; and if not, i am under orders to do it.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne lula madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, na, ngaa dhu ja'a abhu sèra, nuka sèmi gaji dhu dhèu sab'a sèra abhu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne, lula lamatua pua ja'a, èèna leo. te lamatua lèka ja'a ho j'aga mèdha-panyau na dhu kab'ua.

source_text: what then is my reward? this, that when i am giving the good news, i may give it without payment, not making use of my rights as a preacher of the good news.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, upa ja'a ngaa? ja'a parluu boe gaji. ja'a padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa. ne'e ka dhu tao ja'a karae, nuka sèmi ja'a abhu le upa. de masi ka ja'a unu rupa-rupa hak, nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu sasab'a ra padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a èèna, te ngaa ja'a pake aa'i boe hak sèra.

source_text: for though i was free from all men, i made myself a servant to all, so that more might have salvation.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu bebas dhu sab'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a. dhèu dènge boe hak ho pua ja'a tao ne'e, do, tao èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a tao ngi'u nuka sèmi ènu, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i abhu hak ho paleha ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a bisa soru-bara dhèu ae, sèna ka ra madhutu ama lamatua taruu.

source_text: and to the jews i was as a jew, so that i might give the good news to them; to those under the law i was the same, not as being myself under the law, but so that i might give the good news to those under the law.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pa'èci dènge dhèu yahudi, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu yahudi, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu yahudi ho ra tadhe lamatua. ladhe ja'a pa'èci ka dènge dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra atora lamatua, ja'a tao madhutu atora lamatua, ho ja'a bisa soru-bara si, sèna ka ra tadhe mèu lamatua, masi ka ja'a ke'a, na, tao madhutu atora èèna, bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua.

source_text: to those without the law i was as one without the law, not as being without law to god, but as under law to christ, so that i might give the good news to those without the law.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pakaboko dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe atora lamatua, ja'a j'aj'i sèmi rèngu ho lere kèti si asa lamatua. ja'a patabuli boe atora lamatua dhu na hia mai re musa, te ngaa ja'a mamuri pake atora kristus

source_text: to the feeble, i was as one who is feeble, so that they might have salvation: i have been all things to all men, so that some at least might have salvation.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe kahèi, ho ja'a bisa pamako si sèna ka mai asa ama lamatua. dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a tao iisi sèmi rèngu, sèna ka, ladhe bisa, kèti cahag'e asa madha lamatua.

source_text: and i do all things for the cause of the good news, so that i may have a part in it.
target_text: ja'a tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa lèka lii lolo be'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa abhu pala dhu be'a nèti madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, dhu lamatua hia èdhi.

source_text: do you not see that in a running competition all take part, but only one gets the reward? so let your minds be fixed on the reward.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dènge pa'uji rai. dhèu ae-ae madhutu pa'uji rai, te ngaa dhu abhu juara dhoka dhèu èci di. de miu èci-èci mi hud'i rai pa'èra-èra ku ho j'aj'i juara hia lamatua.

source_text: and every man who takes part in the sports has self-control in all things. now they do it to get a crown which is of this world, but we for an eternal crown.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu pa'uji, hud'i madhutu ku paredha nèti dhèu dhu aj'a rèngu, si? dhèu se sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula neo abhu solo juara dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie. te ngaa èdhi sab'a sèna ka abhu upa dhu taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: so then i am running, not uncertainly; so i am fighting, not as one who gives blows in the air:
target_text: de ja'a rai leli boe. te ngaa ja'a tenge j'ara ho rai pa'èra-èra toke d'ai lane. ladhe pasoro ja'a sèmi dhèu tuka paj'ubhu, na, ja'a j'ubhu leli boe, te ngaa hud'i j'ubhu palèke ku.

source_text: but i give blows to my body, and keep it under control, for fear that, after having given the good news to others, i myself might not have god's approval.
target_text: ja'a pa'èra d'ara, aa aj'a ngi'u sèna ka bisa taha taruu. te be'a boe ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ama lamatua, aa te ngaa ja'a mesa ku sisu atora, hèia lamatua kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara pa'uji rai èèna.

source_text: for it is my desire, my brothers, that you may keep in mind how all our fathers were under the cloud, and they all went through the sea;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage miu bhèlu eele lii lolo dhu uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki èdhi ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe. ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ra'i-liru dhu kako uuru nèti rèngu. aa ama lamatua hag'e eele èi dhasi, hèia ra kako d'ai cabèka dhasi dènge sod'a.

source_text: and they all had baptism from moses in the cloud and in the sea;
target_text: dhasi dènge ra'i-liru se, nuka sèmi lii pakasame sa. te bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèka musa nuka sèmi ama ho lere si, ka ra madhutu ra'i-liru, aa maso asa d'ara dhasi palere-lere dènge ne. èèna sama sèmi èdhi dhu parcaya kristus hèia abhu sarani, dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa ti nanene ne.

source_text: and they all took the same holy food;
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi aa'i-aa'i ra, ra'a nganga'a dhu roh lamatua sadia tèke hia ra.

source_text: and the same holy drink: for they all took of the water from the holy rock which came after them: and the rock was christ.
target_text: aa rinu nèti èi dhu roh lamatua sadia hia ra kahèi. èi dhu rinu èèna kalua nèti hadhu aae dhu roh lamatua paj'uj'u tèke. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia èèna ka, hadhu èèna dhu ètu èèna le. madhutu iia-iia na, hadhu èèna, nuka kristus.

source_text: but with most of them god was not pleased: for they came to their end in the waste land.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge tatao dhèu ae sèra. ka ropa ra kako palème era mamoo dhu taleo èèna, dhèu ae madhe. ka ra padhane si palème era.

source_text: now these things were for an example to us, so that our hearts might not go after evil things, as they did.
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi baku d'èi tao j'ara bhelu sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: then do not go after false gods, as some of them did; as it is said in the holy writings, after resting and feasting, the people got up to take their pleasure.
target_text: baku pae'a nidhu sèmi rèngu cahag'e. ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu isra'el madhèdi ra'a-rinu pesta ètu madha patung sapi iiki ci'u. ka ra sogo-tagu ne.

source_text: again, let us not give way to the desires of the flesh, as some of them did, of whom twenty-three thousand came to their end in one day.
target_text: èdhi baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èdhi. te uru-uru sèra, rèngu tao j'ara makae sèmi sèra ka, hèia dua nguru tèlu riho dhèu madhe ètu d'ara ca lod'o doko èèna ka.

source_text: and let us not put the lord to the test, as some of them did, and came to their death by snakes.
target_text: èdhi baku ad'u-ue bhabhelu rupa-rupa, ho neo te'a, kristus huku èdhi, do aad'o. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e neo sèku ama lamatua sèmi èèna ka, ka na hia mege ae-ae dhu dènge raco sèna ka kadhi pamadhe si.

source_text: and do not say evil things against the lord, as some of them did, and destruction overtook them.
target_text: èdhi baku ka'uu-kamuki kahèi. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e re'a dhoka ka'uu-kamuki di, ka ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na èci nèti sorga mai pamadhe si.

source_text: now these things were done as an example; and were put down in writing for our teaching, on whom the last days have come.
target_text: j'ara ne lèke mi dhèu isra'el, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha hia mi èdhi. ra suri se'e se, ho èdhi bisa te'a, sèna ka baku tao madhutu sasala rèngu. te lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: so let him who seems to himself to be safe go in fear of a fall.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! limuri ne èu ngee, na, èu èra le. te ngaa baku pamud'e, sèna ka baku manahu.

source_text: you have been put to no test but such as is common to man: and god is true, who will not let any test come on you which you are not able to undergo; but he will make with the test a way out of it, so that you may be able to go through it.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ngee mèdhi neo tao bhabhelu, te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu leo dhu paraga rèdhi le kahèi, dadugu-rariu sèmi sèra. te ngaa èu bisa parcaya ama lamatua, sèna ka na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu peka. te lamatua soro tèke boe èu ho abhu dadugu-rariu risi nèti a'èra èu. ropa èu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, nèngu pad'elo j'ara kalua hia èu. nèngu neo pa'èra èu, ho baku manahu.

source_text: for this cause, my dear brothers, give no worship to false gods.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe dhèu neo laka-seti miu sèna ka sogo-tagu nidhu, na, pakeso nèti era èèna! baku pamata!

source_text: what i am saying is for wise men, do you be the judges of it.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a ngee madhera. hud'i laa miu mesa mi dadoo unu mi, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka-padhai èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: the cup of blessing which we take, does it not give us a part in the blood of christ? and is not the broken bread a taking part in the body of christ?
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe èdhi pakaboko sèna ka ta'a-tinu ètu mei ama lamatua, hèia tare galaa ho manèngi makasi mi lamatua, ka tinu nèti galaa èèna, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. ropa na pasuti raa na ka na madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhutu madhe kahèi. ladhe èdhi pamae roti èèna, hèia ta'e, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ropa kristus madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi kahèi madhe sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: because we, being a number of persons, are one bread, we are one body: for we all take part in the one bread.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ta'e nèti roti cue. de aa'i-aa'i dhu rare pala nèti roti cue ne, nuka sèmi èdhi dhu pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci, masi ka èdhi dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: see israel after the flesh: do not those who take as food the offerings of the altar take a part in the altar?
target_text: pangee sèku dhèu isra'el uru sèra. ropa rèngu roro badha ètu dedha mei korban sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, ama agama dhu roro ne ka dhu bisa na'e sisi èèna. sasoa na, rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, aa pa'èki kahèi dènge dhèu dhu rèti badha ho j'aj'i mi korban.

source_text: do i say, then, that what is offered to images is anything, or that the image is anything? what i say is that the things offered by the gentiles are offered to evil spirits and not to god; and it is not my desire for you to have any part with evil spirits.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tasamia? lod'o dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua neo hia mèdha-panyau rèngu j'aj'i mi mèdha sogo-tagu ra, èèna dènge boe kab'ua, do? te mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, dhoka patung dhu madhe di! aad'o! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhèu roro badha ho j'aj'i badha sogo-tagu, rèngu sogo-tagu nidhu bhelu. te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi ama lamatua dhu lèke. de ja'a ko'o boe ho miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèmi sèra.

source_text: it is not possible for you, at the same time, to take the cup of the lord and the cup of evil spirits; you may not take part in the table of the lord and the table of evil spirits.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki dènge lamatua, ka minu nèti galaa ètu mei lamatua, na, miu bisa boe pa'èci dènge nidhu bhelu sèra, aa baku minu nèti galaa dhu ra pake pae'a nidhu. te ladhe miu minu sèmi èèna, sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu bisa boe mi'a ètu mei nidhu. goa, ee! te sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèra!

source_text: or may we be the cause of envy to the lord? are we stronger than he?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu sèmi ngaa? neo papèd'a d'ara lamatua èdhi, do? èèna bahaya! ele boe miu ngee, na, miu èra risi lamatua, do?

source_text: we are free to do all things, but there are things which it is not wise to do. we are free to do all things, but not all things are for the common good.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a neo tao ngaa èèna ka, bisa. te èèna hak ja'a. tare'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra nèti babe'a hia èu. aa tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, bisa soru-bara èu ho pa'èra d'ara mu.

source_text: let a man give attention not only to what is good for himself, but equally to his neighbour's good.
