target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu neo pamanahu miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara ta'a-tinu, mage mi pusi-pahae si. aa ladhe dhèu neo tao lii dènge miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara lod'o be'a, do tao pesta hèru hiu, do atora lod'o ae sasab'a, na, baku pusi-pahae si.

source_text: for these are an image of the things which are to come; but the body is christ's.
target_text: j'ara sèmi sèra sa, guna boe! te sèra sa nuka sèmi mamaho di, dhu èèna na ele. te ngaa kristus ne ka dhu asli. nèngu ne ele boe aa taa-taa.

source_text: let no man take your reward from you by consciously making little of himself and giving worship to angels; having his thoughts fixed on the things which he has seen, being foolishly lifted up in his natural mind,
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo pamanahu miu, lula miu mo'o boe madhutu atora dhu rèngu tao unu ra, baku nanene si. te ladhe miu nanene si, miu bisa heka abhu j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. de mage-mage! te mema abhu dhèu dhu d'èi tenge j'ara ho pamanahu miu. dad'èi ra, ladhe miu pahaha iisi miu, aa sogo-tagu ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga, lula ra pangee, na, abhu tanila dhu peka sèmi èèna. rèngu tao iisi ra be'a risi nèti dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna. te ngangee ra sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha biasa di.

source_text: and not joined to the head, from whom all the body, being given strength and kept together through its joins and bands, has its growth with the increase of god.
target_text: kristus èèna kètu, te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe pa'èki dènge ne. aa dhèu unu kristus, nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu na ator si. na tao dhèu unu na asa tabha èra, pake koasa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalua dènge rui dhu pa'èki pa'èra-èra, sèna ka èci bara èci, toke ngi'u dhu kateme bisa sab'a dènge be'a.

source_text: if you were made free, by your death with christ, from the rules of the world, why do you put yourselves under the authority of orders
target_text: miu madhe le sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu pa'èki heka dènge koasa-koasa maroga ètu rai-haha ne. de nga tao ka miu loe boe madhutu rupa-rupa atora rai-haha? rèngu peka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: which say there may be no touching, tasting, or taking in your hands,
target_text: mage kèpe ne'e; baku mi'e èèna, mage goi ne'e.

source_text: rules which are all to come to an end with their use after the orders and teaching of men?
target_text: te ngaa atora sèra, dhoka pa'ue-ai nèti dhèu rai-haha, ho ra aj'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. madhutu iia-iia na, atora sèra dhodhoka uri j'ara-j'ara dhu èèna na ele iia d'ara di!

source_text: these things seem to have a sort of wisdom in self-ordered worship and making little of oneself, and being cruel to the body, not honouring it by giving it its natural use.
target_text: ladhe sèmi dhèu bisa tao madhutu atora sèra, ra pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakab'ua si, aa peka na, rèngu se d'èlu-mèu titu kèna; dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu kèpe pa'èra atora agama; dhèu dhu d'ara mako; dhèu dhu paj'èra ngi'u unu ra, dènge dhèu dhu maj'èni sogo-tagu. madhutu iia-iia na, aad'o! atora sèra bisa boe pamèu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhabhelu!

source_text: if then you have a new life with christ, give your attention to the things of heaven, where christ is seated at the right hand of god.
target_text: ama lamatua hia le miu mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi nèngu pamamuri hari miu sama-sama dènge kristus. limuri ne, kristus madhèdi le ètu era dhu kab'ua risi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: keep your mind on the higher things, not on the things of earth.
target_text: pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua d'èi. baku pusi-pahae dènge j'ara dhu dhodhoka pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: for your life on earth is done, and you have a secret life with christ in god.
target_text: te miu madhe kahèi, ropa kristus madhe. hèia mamuri hiu miu èèna kalau boe, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, dhu bera-bera dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: at the coming of christ who is our life, you will be seen with him in glory.
target_text: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, aa na pabe'a mamuri miu. bèli-camèd'a, ropa na lèpa hari mai, miu cèu palere-lere dènge ne kahèi ètu d'ara dadedha dènge kapai na!

source_text: then put to death your bodies which are of the earth; wrong use of the flesh, unclean things, passion, evil desires and envy, which is the worship of strange gods;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhabhelu-katub'a. nuka sèmi: d'ara d'èi tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu; d'ara d'èi tao j'ara-j'ara kaj'alu; d'ara d'èi dhu neo tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di; d'ara d'èi tao bhabhelu rupa-rupa, aa manga'a dhu d'èi dhoka aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu èu di madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa nuka sèmi èu sogo-tagu, lula èu ded'e padedha-dedha j'ara leo dhu seti eele lamatua.

source_text: because of which the wrath of god comes on those who go against his orders;
target_text: j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao ama lamatua nasa titu kèna, toke na neo huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: among whom you were living in the past, when you did such things.
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri sèmi èèna ka, lula d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara bhelu sèra.

source_text: but now it is right for you to put away all these things; wrath, passion, bad feeling, curses, unclean talk;
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo ad'u-ue bhabhelu aa'i-aa'i. nuka sèmi: d'èi nasa; d'ara pana-mag'oro; tèka d'ara dènge dhèu; padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu; dènge padhai lii kaj'alu.

source_text: do not make false statements to one another; because you have put away the old man with all his doings, and have put on the new man, which has become new in knowledge after the image of his maker;
target_text: aa miu èci dènge èci baku kapod'e-kabèli. lula miu core eele le dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhelu, aa tèke eele j'ara mamuri dhui sèra. aa limuri ne, miu gati dènge d'ara dhu hiu. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu core eele le mèdha-papake dhui dhu kaj'alu, sèna ka silu mèdha hiu dhu mèu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i miu. aa limuri ne, na tao miu asa tadhe pabe'a-be'a nèngu, aa tao miu j'aj'i ca ropa dènge ne.

source_text: where there is no greek or jew, no one with circumcision or without circumcision, no division between nations, no servant or free man: but christ is all and in all.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamuri hiu ne, èdhi hag'e boe, na, rèngu sèra dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe; dhèu dhu madhutu suna, do dhèu dhu suna boe; dhèu leo rai kara, do dhèu dhu ad'a aad'o; dhèu ènu, do ènu boe. se'e se kolo-karisi na, aad'o! te ngaa dhu lèke ka, ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge kristus, aa nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara ra.

source_text: as saints of god, then, holy and dearly loved, let your behaviour be marked by pity and mercy, kind feeling, a low opinion of yourselves, gentle ways, and a power of undergoing all things;
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na sue miu. dad'èi na sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci na dhu leko-leo nèti dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu d'ara hua iia, d'ara be'a, pahaha iisi, lii mako, dènge taha mere d'ara.

source_text: being gentle to one another and having forgiveness for one another, if anyone has done wrong to his brother, even as the lord had forgiveness for you:
target_text: miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa èci tadhe mèu èci. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne. te ngaa miu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na, aa abho ne, nuka sèmi lamatua dhu pabhèlu eele le sasala miu.

source_text: and more than all, have love; the only way in which you may be completely joined together.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee. te sasue èèna risi aa'i nèti ngaa-ngaa. de miu hud'i pake sasue ne ètu d'ara miu, nuka sèmi mèdha-papake ètu ua. te sasue èèna, nuka sèmi loa hèngu dhu èdhi manènu, sèna ka j'aj'i sig'i dhu saraga titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èki èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: and let the peace of christ be ruling in your hearts, as it was the purpose of god for you to be one body; and give praise to god at all times.
target_text: èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua, lula kristus. de miu hud'i soro tèke kahèi dadame kristus ne, uri d'ara miu. te lamatua d'èi ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci, lula miu pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci. aa d'ara miu hud'i me'a manèngi makasi, lula lamatua unu na ka hag'e nare miu.

source_text: let the word of christ be in you in all wealth of wisdom; teaching and helping one another with songs of praise and holy words, making melody to god with grace in your hearts.
target_text: hud'i laa lii holo-nori kristus uri d'ara miu dènge mamuri miu kahèi. lii holo-nori se'e, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua, dhu na pangèd'u mi miu. lii se'e pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa me'a madha j'ara ae-ae, madhutu ngangee lamatua. ka miu bisa pake lii se'e, sèna ka aj'a-nori, aa pasanèd'e miu èci dènge èci. ladhe nori dhèu-dhèu miu, mage dènge sakaa, te ngaa pake lii dènge d'ara dhu taleo moro-moro dhu pènu dènge rasa makasi. pake lii sod'a koa-kio, lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa lii sod'a dhu miu mesa mi suri ho koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: and whatever you do, in word or in act, do all in the name of the lord jesus, giving praise to god the father through him.
target_text: miu j'aj'i le ai g'ana nèti yesus kristus. de sanèd'e, te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu padhue-padhai sèra, mèti kolongara lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tao sèra mèti kolongara lamatua kahèi. de baku bhèlu tao aa'i-aa'i dènge kolongara kètu miu, yesus kristus. aa manèngi makasi taruu mi ama na, ama lamatua.

source_text: wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as is right in the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku dhèu èmu miu, lula èèna ka dhu lèke mi dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: husbands, have love for your wives, and be not bitter against them.
target_text: mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu miu, aa baku sakaa dènge ne, ka papèd'a d'ara na.

source_text: children, do the orders of your fathers and mothers in all things, for this is pleasing to the lord.
target_text: ana-ana aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i nanene ina-ama miu, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: fathers, do not be hard on your children, so that their spirit may not be broken.
target_text: ina-ama aa'i-aa'i! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli mi ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. mage-mage d'ara ra ta'u'a dènge miu.

source_text: servants, in all things do the orders of your natural masters; not only when their eyes are on you, as pleasers of men, but with all your heart, fearing the lord:
target_text: dhèu sab'a sèra! ètu rai-haha ne miu hud'i tao ku madhutu dad'èi lamatua miu ètu d'ara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i ra. mage dhoka mere d'ara di, lod'o dhu lamatua miu ètu madha miu. te ngaa tenge la j'ara, ho pakarej'e taruu d'ara ra. sab'a dènge be'a, lula miu dhu me'a, na, ama lamatua dhu ladhe patae miu.

source_text: whatever you do, do it readily, as to the lord and not to men; being certain that the lord will give you the reward of the heritage: for you are the servants of the lord christ.
target_text: miu sad'i sab'a ngaa èèna ka, na, sab'a la mola-mola. miu hud'i sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de miu lalau-lalo'o ne, te nèngu ka dhu b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu, dènge hia miu pusaka.

source_text: for the wrongdoer will have punishment for the wrong he has done, without respect for any man's position.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu sab'a lèke boe j'ara, bèli-camèd'a na huku miu. lula nèngu èèna dhu bia boe cabèka, aa ladhe boe rèhu dhèu.

source_text: masters, give your servants what is right and equal, conscious that you have a master in heaven.
target_text: miu lamatua sèra! miu hud'i uri ku dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra dènge mola, aa bia boe cabèka. sanèd'e ee, te miu dènge lamatua ètu sorga dhu uri miu kahèi.

source_text: give yourselves to prayer at all times, keeping watch with praise;
target_text: miu hud'i maj'èni sabaj'a. aa miu hud'i mase'a ku dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu miu padhai dènge ama lamatua, aa manèngi-mangaj'i dhu pènu dènge d'ara makasi.

source_text: and making prayer for us, that god may give us an open door for the preaching of the word, the secret of christ, for which i am now in chains;
target_text: baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i, aa manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka ji'i bisa lole dènge dhèu, j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni lula-nèti kristus. sanèd'e, te ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne, lula ja'a padhue-padhai kristus mi dhèu.

source_text: so that i may make it clear, as it is right for me to do.
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ja'a bisa lole paled'a lii lolo be'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: be wise in your behaviour to those who are outside, making good use of the time.
target_text: mamuri dènge mola ètu talora aae dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus. pake paie-iie lod'o dhu taleo dhu ama lamatua hia miu.

source_text: let your talk be with grace, mixed with salt, so that you may be able to give an answer to everyone.
target_text: ladhe miu padhai lii, padhai dènge lii mako, dhu palèke dènge d'ara dhèu. mage padhai dhu paroca dhèu. pake lii-lii dhu lèke, sèna ka miu bisa dhaa hari dènge be'a, ladhe abhu dhèu pakarèi dènge miu.

source_text: tychicus will give you news of all my business: he is a dear brother and true servant and helper in the word;
target_text: pe tikikus dhiu lole dènge miu, j'ara mamuri ja'a. nèngu ne a'ari pasue èdhi dhu ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu ne'a boe roca. uru èèna, nèngu pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a kahèi.

source_text: and i have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may have news of how we are, and so that he may give your hearts comfort;
target_text: ja'a pua na dhiu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, aa lole dènge miu j'ara mamuri ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: and with him i have sent onesimus, the true and well-loved brother, who is one of you. they will give you word of everything which is taking place here.
target_text: ja'a pua onesimus kahèi lèpa palere dènge ne. onesimus ne a'ari pasue dhu sab'a ne'a boe roca kahèi. nèngu ne, dhèu miu. dua ra, pe lole dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i le ètu ne'e.

source_text: aristarchus, my brother-prisoner, sends his love to you, and mark, a relation of barnabas about whom you have been given orders: if he comes to you, be kind to him,
target_text: aristarkus hia lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ra taha ne ètu d'ara bui sama-sama dènge ja'a. markus, a'ari nèti barnabas, hia lii maho'o kahèi. uru èèna, ja'a moa mema le dènge miu, na, ladhe markus dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, na, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: and jesus, whose other name is justus; these are of the circumcision: they are my only brother-workers for the kingdom of god, who have been a comfort to me.
target_text: yesus, dhu èdhi pangare ne, yustus hia lii maho'o kahèi mi miu. nèti angalai aa'i-aa'i dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ama lamatua, dhoka rèngu tèlu ra se'e ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu sarani nèti suku yahudi. aa rèngu se'e ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of christ jesus, sends you his love, ever taking thought for you in his prayers, that you may be complete and fully certain of all the purpose of god.
target_text: angalai miu epapras ètu ne'e, aa na hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. nèngu ne dhèu sab'a hia yesus kristus. nèngu ne ka dhu loe boe sabaj'a hia miu dènge a'èra na, aa na manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pa'èra dènge tao pamèci miu, aa tao miu j'aj'i me'a mèu dad'èi na.

source_text: for i give witness of him that he has undergone much trouble for you and for those in laodicea and in hierapolis.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, na, epapras ne, dhu sab'a bia hia miu dènge dhèu-dhèu kristen ètu kota laodikia dènge kota herapolis.

source_text: luke, our well-loved medical friend, and demas, send you their love.
target_text: abhu lii maho'o kahèi nèti demas dènge dote lukas dhu èdhi sue.

source_text: give my love to the brothers in laodicea and to nymphas and the church in their house.
target_text: ja'a hia lii maho'o mi a'ari dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia. baku bhèlu hia lii maho'o ja'a mi mama nimfa dènge dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu tema pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu na.

source_text: and when this letter has been made public among you, let the same be done in the church of laodicea; and see that you have the letter from laodicea.
target_text: pe, ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota kolose baca mere sasuri ne, na, mi pa'adhu hia dhèu-dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia, sèna ka rèngu baca kahèi. aa miu hud'i baca kahèi sasuri dhu ja'a pa'adhu kèdhi hia rèngu uru sèra.

source_text: say to archippus, see that you do the work which the lord has given you to do.
target_text: pasanèd'e arkipus, peka na, èu baku bhèlu pakako toke pa'èle, sasab'a dhu èu sèmi more nèti lamatua.

source_text: i, paul, give you this word of love in my handwriting. keep in memory that i am a prisoner. grace be with you.
target_text: baku bhèlu, peka na, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne era. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. sasuri ne, ja'a ènyi ai pake kacui-aai ja'a unu ku. salam nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul and silvanus and timothy, to the church of the thessalonians in god the father and the lord jesus christ: grace to you and peace.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, dènge angalai ja'a silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: we give praise to god at all times for you, keeping you in memory in our prayers;
target_text: ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula parcaya miu. mèu-mèda ji'i sabaj'a hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: having ever in mind your work of faith and acts of love and the strength of your hope in our lord jesus christ, before our god and father;
target_text: ji'i sanèd'e sasab'a dhu miu sab'a, lula miu parcaya ama lamatua, aa sue ne. miu loe boe nèti j'ara èèna, lula era sarai miu ka lamatua yesus. ji'i loe boe kahèi ngèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: being conscious, my brothers, dear to god, that you have been marked out by god's purpose;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue miu. nèti èèna ka, na hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu nèngu.

source_text: because our good news came to you, not in word only, but in power, and in the holy spirit, so that you were completely certain of it; even as you saw what our behaviour to you was like from our love to you.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa tesalonika, ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, miu pasa dhilu paie-iie ho nanene lii padhai lii ji'i. miu mesa boe dhoka nanene lii ji'i di, te ngaa miu mèdhi unu mi kahèi koasa ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci èèna. j'ara èèna ka dhu tao miu tare'a-re'a sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna. lod'o èèna, miu mèdhi unu mi j'ara mamuri ji'i dhu tasa mera mia, sèna ka me'a tare'a-re'a, j'ara-j'ara lamatua.

source_text: and you took us and the lord as your example, after the word had come to you in much trouble, with joy in the holy spirit;
target_text: lula miu pama'ète mere le ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mamuri madhutu tatao ji'i, aa madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi. te ngaa lod'o miu heka sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa miu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu kalau boe-karèto boe, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pakarej'e d'ara miu.

source_text: so that you became an example to all those who have faith in christ in macedonia and achaia.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya.

source_text: for not only was the word of the lord sounding out from you in macedonia and achaia, but in every place your faith in god is made clear; so that we have no need to say anything.
target_text: mesa boe ètu sèi di. te lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu pale-lème le tesalonika nèti miu se'e ka toke mia-mia. de ji'i peka ngaa hari, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadèngi le lalèka miu mi lamatua.

source_text: for they themselves give the news of how we came among you; and how you were turned from images to god, to the worship of a true and living god,
target_text: ètu mia-mia dhèu palolo, peka na, miu uru na sèmi mere ji'i dènge d'ara kateme. ka miu core eele mèdha-mèdha sogo-tagu mi, hèia mai madhutu lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a. te miu me'a le, na, lamatua èèna nuka ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti madhutu ne.

source_text: waiting for his son from heaven, who came back from the dead, even jesus, our saviour from the wrath to come.
target_text: rèngu palolo kahèi, na, miu tatae mamai ana ama lamatua nèti sorga, nuka yesus. uru èèna dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari ne. lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu rai-haha ne, na, lamatua yesus ka dhu pakaj'èu èdhi nèti nanasa ama lamatua.

source_text: for you yourselves, brothers, are conscious that our coming among you was not without effect:
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le lod'o ji'i dhiu sab'a ètu tesalonika, èi kabhèsu ji'i suti boe iia d'ara.

source_text: but after we had first undergone much pain and been cruelly attacked as you saw, at philippi, by the help of god we gave you the good news without fear, though everything was against us.
target_text: miu sanèd'e kahèi lod'o ji'i dhiu mèka asa tesalonika, dhèu nèti kota pilipi dhu tao le pasusa dènge paj'èra ji'i. te ngaa lula lamatua pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ka ji'i bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua dènge miu, masi ka dhèu ae dhu pamusu dènge ji'i.

source_text: for our witness does not come from error or from an unclean heart or from deceit:
target_text: lod'o èèna, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a hia miu asa tesalonika, ngèti boe lii aj'a-nori dhu koe-kapengo. te ji'i dhiu tao boe pagoa dènge pakapod'e-kabèli miu.

source_text: but even as the good news was given to us by the approval of god, so we give it out; not as pleasing men, but god by whom our hearts are tested.
target_text: aad'o! uru èèna ji'i dhiu dènge d'ara mola. ama lamatua mesa na dhu paj'uj'u ji'i, ho ngèti lii lolo be'a na asa miu. ji'i se neo boe pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu patigi nèdhi d'ara ji'i, sèna ka ne'a, mola do koe.

source_text: for it is common knowledge among you that we never made use of smooth-sounding false words, and god is witness that at no time were we secretly desiring profit for ourselves,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, na, ji'i se hèb'a mènyi boe, ngaa hari tenge leto ca doi sa nèti miu. ama lamatua dhu ne'a d'ara ji'i.

source_text: or looking for glory from men, from you or from others, when we might have made ourselves a care to you as apostles of christ.
target_text: sasab'a ji'i ne tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha, do nèti miu, aa nèti dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: but we were gentle among you, like a woman caring for her little ones:
target_text: ji'i se dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. ji'i dènge hak kahèi, tao ngi'u sama sèmi dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe padedha iisi sèmi èèna. lod'o sèra, ji'i tao ngi'u ji'i èci èèna ka dènge ana iiki ètu talora aae miu. ji'i pad'elo sasue mi dedha miu kahèi, nuka sèmi ina dhu pasusu ana na.

source_text: even so, being full of loving desire for you, we took delight in giving you not only god's good news, but even our lives, because you were dear to us.
target_text: ji'i dhiu ho mesa boe dhoka ngèti lii lolo be'a hia miu di, te ngaa ji'i soro iisi kateme aae kahèi, lula ji'i sue miu seli eele.

source_text: for you have the memory, my brothers, of our trouble and care; how, working night and day, so that we might not be a trouble to any of you, we gave you the good news of god.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu sanèd'e era, ji'i sab'a dhu nge'a boe j'èra mèu-mèda, ho abhu unu mi nganga'a-nganginu. te ji'i d'èi boe paj'èra miu lod'o ngèti lii lolo be'a asa miu.

source_text: you are witnesses, with god, how holy and upright and free from all evil was our way of life among you who have faith;
target_text: miu mèdhi unu mi, sèmi èèna kahèi ama lamatua, ropa dhu ji'i bera-bera dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya le, ji'i mamuri dènge d'ara mola, dhu tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: even as you saw how, like a father with his children, we were teaching and comforting you all, and giving witness,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, ji'i lalau-lalo'o miu, èci èèna ka dènge ama matana ladhe-leru ana-ana na,

source_text: so that your lives might be pleasing to god, who has given you a part in his kingdom and his glory.
target_text: nuka sèmi: pa'èra d'ara miu aa'i-aa'i mi, pasanèd'e dènge pamako miu sèna ka mamuri dhu mèci, ho pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu aae, dhu paroa le miu sèna ka j'aj'i ana kabarai na, aa abhu pakab'ua bera-bera dènge nèngu.

source_text: and for this cause we still give praise to god, that, when the word came to your ears through us, you took it, not as the word of man, but, as it truly is, the word of god, which has living power in you who have faith.
target_text: ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula lod'o miu tadèngi lii lolo nèti ji'i, miu sèmi mere boe lii holo-nori nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lii holo-nori èèna kapua na nèti ama lamatua. nèngu unu na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu dhèu parcaya.

source_text: for you, my brothers, took as your examples the churches of god which are in judaea in christ jesus; because you underwent the same things from your countrymen as they did from the jews;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu heka madhutu j'ara lamatua kèna, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu miu pasusa le miu. de miu se abhu j'aj'èra èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya ètu propensi yudea, dhu dhèu yahudi rèngu mesa ra paj'èra rèngu lula ra lèka yesus kristus.

source_text: who put to death the lord jesus and the prophets, violently driving us out; who are unpleasing to god and against all men;
target_text: abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ropa ama lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na mai asa rèngu, ka rèngu paj'èra dènge hake pamadhe si. ra pamadhe lamatua yesus dènge j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. limuri ne, ra tenge j'ara ho babèga eele ji'i kahèi. rèngu pamusu dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka ama lamatua d'èi boe rèngu.

source_text: who, to make the measure of their sins complete, kept us from giving the word of salvation to the gentiles: but the wrath of god is about to come on them in the fullest degree.
target_text: ngaa hari, ra tenge j'ara ae-ae sèna ka ji'i pakako ia ka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu leo. dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe ho lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia dhèu leo kara kahèi. dènge j'ara èèna ka, sasala rèngu sèmi tao udhu sa. hèia ama lamatua nasa, ka huku si.

source_text: but we, my brothers, being away from you for a short time, in body but not in heart, had all the more desire to see your face;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu, te ngaa pakaj'èu boe ètu d'ara. ji'i tenge-tenge j'ara, ho ladhe abhu lod'o dhu taleo, ji'i dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu, te d'ara ji'i neo ae le.

source_text: for which reason we made attempts to come to you, even i, paul, once and again; but satan kept us from coming.
target_text: ja'a mesa ku neo ae le kahèi dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu loe boe bhabhae ja'a.

source_text: for what is our hope or joy or crown of glory? are not even you, before our lord jesus, at his coming?
target_text: miu me'a, nga tao ka ji'i neo dhiu paraga dènge miu, sina ma? lula ji'i maena miu. miu ka dhu pakarej'e dènge pa'adhu d'ara ji'i. ladhe miu aad'o, cee hari ka dhu kèpe pa'èra kolongara lamatua yesus! ladhe lamatua lèpa hari mai, d'ara ji'i taleo, lula miu se'e ka.

source_text: for you are our glory and our joy.
target_text: mema tare'a! miu se'e se ka dhu pakab'ua sasab'a ji'i aa pataleo d'ara ji'i.

source_text: at last our desire to have news of you was so strong that, while we ourselves were waiting at athens, we sent timothy, our brother and god's servant in the good news of christ, to give you strength and comfort in your faith;
target_text: sèna ka miu me'a, ca hari ni ji'i kako tèke eele miu èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i. ji'i neo ae le dhiu paraga dènge miu, te ngaa bisa mèka. lula ji'i ngo'o heka mate panèbhu, hèia ji'i pama'ète le ho pua timotius dhiu. te ngaa ja'a dènge silas pea ètu kota atena. timotius ne a'ari ji'i. nèngu ne angalai ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a, dhu bera-bera pakako lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. ji'i pua na dhiu, ho na aj'a miu aa pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka miu asa parcaya èra ama lamatua.

source_text: so that no man might be moved by these troubles; because you see that these things are part of god's purpose for us.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe miu paraga dènge sasusa, d'ara miu roe boe. kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu. te miu me'a le, dhèu cee dhu parcaya kristus, tatu na paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and when we were with you, we said to you that trouble was before us; and so it came about, as you see.
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ji'i dènge miu era, ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge rupa-rupa sasusa. limuri ne j'aj'i le, si!

source_text: for this reason, when i was no longer able to keep quiet, i sent to get news of your faith, fearing that you might be tested by the evil one and that our work might come to nothing.
target_text: lula ja'a susa titu kèna nèti j'aj'èra miu se'e ka, nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu asa tesalonika, ho ji'i nge'a mèu kèna, miu parcaya era lamatua, do aad'o. te ja'a mage-mage, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu miu, ho miu soro kabodho mi lamatua. ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, sasab'a ji'i uru sèra, ele iie d'ara!

source_text: but now that timothy has come to us from you, and has given us good news of your faith and love, and that you have happy memories of us, desiring greatly to see us, even as we do to see you;
target_text: lai-lai ne, timotius lèpa hari mai nèti tesalonika. ka nèti lii dhu pakarej'e d'ara ji'i. na lolo, na, miu parcaya kristus era, aa miu èci pasue dènge èci. na peka kahèi, na, miu ngee ji'i sèmi mia dhu ji'i sanèd'e miu kahèi.

source_text: for this cause, brothers, in all our trouble and grief we were comforted about you because of your faith; for it is life to us if you keep your faith in the lord unchanged.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ètu ne'e ji'i ako rasa bia, lula abhu susa ae nèti mia-mia, te ngaa ropa tadèngi lii lolo timotius, ka d'ara ji'i tare'a-re'a abhu karej'e. lula limuri ne ji'i nge'a le miu parcaya lamatua era.

source_text: for how great is the praise which we give to god for you, and how great the joy with which we are glad because of you before our god;
target_text: de ji'i manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua dènge d'ara dhu karej'e titu kèna, lula miu madhutu ne taruu.

source_text: night and day requesting god again and again that we may see your face and make your faith complete.
target_text: mèu-mèda ji'i loe boe sabaj'a sèna ka catèka sa èdhi paraga hari. ji'i neo aj'a miu sèna ka pamèci d'ara miu ètu j'ara mamuri lamatua.

source_text: now may our god and father himself and our lord jesus make a way for us to come to you;
target_text: ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, bhoke j'ara sèna ka ji'i dhiu paraga hari dènge miu.

source_text: and the lord give you increase of love in fullest measure to one another and to all men, even as our love to you;
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia miu asa pasue risi eele hari. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi miu dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra asa pasue, sèmi dhu ji'i sue miu.

source_text: so that your hearts may be strong and free from all sin before our god and father, at the coming of our lord jesus with all his saints.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, ho mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, toke bèli-camèd'a lamatua yesus lèpa hari mai dènge dhèu unu na, miu bisa titu kahèi ètu katanga madha ama lamatua èdhi, dènge dui heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: and last of all, the prayer which we make to you from our heart and in the name of the lord jesus, is this: that as we made clear to you what sort of behaviour is pleasing to god, as in fact you are doing now, so you will go on in these ways, but more and more.
target_text: de a'ari, sèmi ne'e ka! ji'i pamako miu sèna ka miu mamuri pamaho'o d'ara ama lamatua, sèmi dhu ji'i aj'a le miu. mema mamuri miu madhutu le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, te ngaa lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua yesus, ka ji'i manèngi miu ho tenge j'ara dhu be'a risi hari.

source_text: because you have in mind the orders we gave you through the lord jesus.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a miu, pake koasa nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: for the purpose of god for you is this: that you may be holy, and may keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh;
target_text: dad'èi ama lamatua nuka: mamuri mola-mèci! baku mamuri kaj'alu ètu d'ara pa'èci bhèni-mone.

source_text: so that every one of you may keep his body holy and in honour;
target_text: miu hud'i me'a lalau ngi'u miu unu mi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci ho dhèu pakab'ua miu.

source_text: not in the passion of evil desires, like the gentiles, who have no knowledge of god;
target_text: baku mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, sèmi dhèu dhu dhae tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: and that no man may make attempts to get the better of his brother in business: for the lord is the judge in all these things, as we said to you before and gave witness.
target_text: mage abhu dhèu dhu neo tao karehe, aa neo tenge oto dhu risi nèti dhèu dhu sama-sama parcaya ama lamatua. te ama lamatua ka, kètu dhu èèna na b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i sèra. j'ara se'e, ji'i peka le dènge miu pèri-pèri hari, aa pasanèd'e le miu karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: because it is god's purpose that our way of life may be not unclean but holy.
target_text: te ama lamatua paroa nare le èdhi sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi hud'i mamuri dènge mola-mèci, baku dènge kaj'alu, sèmi dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: whoever, then, goes against this word, goes against not man but god, who gives his holy spirit to you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu cee ka dhu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ne, nèngu èèna sèmi boe ji'i, aa tule eele ama lamatua kahèi dhu hia le miu roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: but about loving the brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you in this letter: for you have the teaching of god that love for one another is right and necessary;
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, suri hari ia ka hia miu j'ara-j'ara pasue a'ari dènge a'ari, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka le, na, miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: and, truly, you are lovers of all the brothers in macedonia; but it is our desire that your love may be increased still more;
target_text: ji'i tadèngi le, miu sue a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi makedonia nèi. te ngaa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i manèngi sèna ka miu sue dhèu leo risi eele hari.

source_text: and that you may take pride in being quiet and doing your business, working with your hands as we gave you orders;
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka miu mamuri dènge mera-milu. baku soro iisi sa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, te ngaa èci-èci ka laladhe mamuri na. miu hud'i sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge kacui-aai miu mesa mi. baku maena dhèu leo. se'e se ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: that you may be respected by those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, miu pabia boe dhèu leo. ladhe dhèu dhu lèka boe kristus rèdhi miu mamuri sèmi èèna, tatu ra peka na, waa! dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus sèra, mamuri ra mola tare'a, nga!

source_text: but it is our desire, brothers, that you may be certain about those who are sleeping; so that you may have no need for sorrow, as others have who are without hope.
target_text: a'ari! limuri ne, ja'a neo peka ngaa èci, sèna ka miu me'a mèu, j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti dhèu madhe. èdhi te'a, na, dhèu dhu madhe le, bèli-camèd'a, na mamuri hari. de ladhe nèti dhèu unu lamatua èci madhe, miu baku tao ngi'u mi j'èra nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu re'a boe j'ara èèna.

source_text: for if we have faith that jesus underwent death and came back again, even so those who are sleeping will come again with him by god's power.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, yesus dhu madhe le, ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu ama lamatua pamamuri hari kahèi dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, aa oru nare si aa'i-aa'i ra bera-bera dènge lamatua yesus.

source_text: for this we say to you by the word of the lord, that we who are still living at the coming of the lord, will not go before those who are sleeping. because the lord himself will come down from heaven with a word of authority, with the voice of the chief angel, with the sound of a horn: and the dead in christ will come to life first; then we who are still living will be taken up together with them into the clouds to see the lord in the air: and so will we be for ever with the lord.
target_text: de ladhe lamatua yesus mai hari, na puru nèti sorga asa rai-haha ne, èèna na dènge paredha dhu lii mèdhu aae. ka kètu kapai nèti ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga hia paredha ho tiu tèbhe. hèia dhèu unu lamatua dhu madhe sèra, mamuri hari. ka rèngu dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era, lèke ded'e asa ra'i-liru, ho aa'i-aa'i ti soru mamai lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri pa'èci dènge ne taa-taa. mi nanene pabe'a-be'a, lula ngaa dhu ji'i peka ne, lamatua unu na ka dhu peka-padhai.

source_text: so then, give comfort to one another with these words.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i pa'èki lii aj'a-nori ne, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: but about the times and their order, my brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i suri ia ka laa, peka na, mamai lamatua lèke hake pèri, do tanggal pèri.

source_text: for you yourselves have the knowledge that the day of the lord will come like a thief in the night.
target_text: lula miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, mamai na dènge sahèka, sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re mèda.

source_text: when they say, there is peace and no danger, then sudden destruction will come on them, as birth-pains on a woman with child; and they will not be able to get away from it.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae dhu madhèdi mau-mau, te ngaa cag'ag'a laa paraga dènge j'aj'èra. mamai na sama kahèi dènge dhèu bhèni dhu cag'ag'a laa kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. ladhe paraga le j'ara ne'e, èdhi pakaj'èu iisi tasamia hari! èci èèna ka dènge mamai lamatua.

source_text: but you, my brothers, are not in the dark, for that day to overtake you like a thief: for you are all sons of light and of the day: we are not of the night or of the dark. so then, let us not take our rest as the others do, but let us be self-controlled and awake.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage dhoka mamai na nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re talora mèda, lèke dènge miu dhu bhèj'i luu. mage lèke miu sèmi èèna kahèi! èdhi mamuri heka ètu d'ara maroga, sèmi dhèu leo dhu bhèj'i luu era. de èdhi dhu lèka le lamatua yesus, mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa, ti pa'èra soru mamai ne, aa j'aga paie mamuri èdhi. j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i miu me'a le!

source_text: for those who are sleeping do so in the night; and those who are the worse for drink are so in the night;
target_text: te dhèu dhu bhèj'i, na, bhèj'i re mèda. aa dhèu dhu mahu, na, mahu re mèda.

source_text: but let us, who are of the day, be serious, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and on our heads, the hope of salvation.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna, lula èdhi dhu mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa. miu hud'i j'aga paie mamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya taruu lamatua aa mamuri pasue, èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu pake kodho bèsi dhu pa'abhe kakara. aa ladhe miu maena taruu mi lamatua yesus dhu hia miu pakaj'èu nèti nanasa ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge sordad'u dhu pa'abhe kètu na dènge solo bèsi.

source_text: for god's purpose for us is not wrath, but salvation through our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e boe èdhi ho na huku ti. te ngaa na hag'e èdhi sèna ka abhu mamuri, sad'i èdhi lèka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: who was put to death for us, so that, awake or sleeping, we may have a part in his life.
target_text: te na madhe le gati èdhi. de ladhe na lèpa hari mai, èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, masi ka èdhi madhe le, do mamuri era.

source_text: so then, go on comforting and building up one another, as you have been doing.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, pake lii-lii ja'a se'e, sèna ka hia karej'e dènge pa'èra èci dènge èci, sèmi dhu miu tao le karèi nèti uru èèna ka.

source_text: but we make this request to you, my brothers: give attention to those who are working among you, who are over you in the lord to keep order among you;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! sanèd'e ho pakab'ua ina-ama dhu j'aj'i kètu ètu juma'at. te rèngu sèra sab'a dhu re'a boe j'èra hia miu, aa pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: and have a high opinion of them in love because of their work. be at peace among yourselves.
target_text: pad'elo sasue miu dènge ra, sèna ka re'a, na, miu pakab'ua si, lula rèngu sab'a bia hia miu. mamuri dame èci dènge èci.

source_text: and our desire is that you will keep control over those whose lives are not well ordered, giving comfort to the feeble-hearted, supporting those with little strength, and putting up with much from all.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara era dhu ji'i neo pasanèd'e miu: dhèu dhu bai-eed'a sèra, peka si sèna ka ra sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni. dhu d'ara roe, pa'èra si. dhu haha, sarimu mere si. taha d'ara aa lii mako mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: let no one give evil for evil; but ever go after what is good, for one another and for all.
target_text: sanèd'e, bhabhelu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu. te ngaa tenge j'ara sèna ka tao be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. baku tao be'a dhoka dènge dhèu èdhi di, te ngaa dènge dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: have joy at all times.
target_text: pakarej'e d'ara taruu.

source_text: keep on with your prayers.
target_text: sabaj'a mèu-mèda.

source_text: in everything give praise: for this is the purpose of god in christ jesus for you.
target_text: sad'i paraga dènge ngaa èèna ka, j'aj'èra, do karej'e-karae, manèngi makasi mi lamatua. te ama lamatua d'èi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus kristus tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: do not put out the light of the spirit;
target_text: baku magee sasab'a roh lamatua.

source_text: do not make little of the words of the prophets;
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu parcaya dhu peka na, nèngu abhu le lii moa nèti ama lamatua, mage miu pusi-pahae boe lii padhai na!

source_text: let all things be tested; keep to what is good;
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i kanucu ku paie-iie lii èèna mai tare'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. ladhe tare'a, na, madhutu.

source_text: keep from every form of evil.
target_text: te ngaa pakaj'èu nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe.

source_text: and may the god of peace himself make you holy in every way; and may your spirit and soul and body be free from all sin at the coming of our lord jesus christ. god, by whom you have been marked out in his purpose, is unchanging and will make it complete.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ho pamèu d'ara dènge mamuri miu aa'i-aa'i mi. nèngu èèna ka dhu uri ho èdhi bisa mamuri dame èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ladhe d'ai lod'o mamai hari lamatua èdhi, yesus kristus, miu bisa titu ètu katanga madha na dènge ngi'u aae miu, d'ara miu, dènge samanga miu dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! te lamatua yesus dhu paroa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu monya boe. ngaa dhu na peka, na tao madhutu sama sèmi èèna ka. de èèna na, na lere nèti miu dènge mola-mèci asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: brothers, keep us in mind in your prayers.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu manèngi-mangaj'i hia ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: give all the brothers a holy kiss.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu hia lii maho'o ji'i kahèi mi dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra!

source_text: i give orders in the name of the lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.
target_text: ja'a manèngi dènge kolongara lamatua yesus, ho miu baca hia juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra isi sasuri ja'a ne.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul and silvanus and timothy, to the church of the thessalonians in god our father and the lord jesus christ:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, aa angalai ja'a, silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne'e, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god the father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: it is right for us to give praise to god at all times for you, brothers, because of the great increase of your faith, and the wealth of your love for one another;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu lèke, ladhe èdhi loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula miu asa parcaya ne, aa asa pasue èci dènge èci.

source_text: so that we ourselves take pride in you in the churches of god for your untroubled mind and your faith in all the troubles and sorrows which you are going through;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i palolo dènge dhèu sarani ètu mia-mia, lula-nèti mamuri miu. ji'i palolo, peka na, masi ka dhèu leo paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu rai boe nèti parcaya mi.

source_text: which is a clear sign of the decision which god in his righteousness has made; to give you a part in his kingdom, for which you have undergone this pain;
target_text: se'e se peka na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua j'ue lii langu miu dènge mola. te j'aj'èra dhu miu pasae èèna ka, hia miu nia j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. aa nèngu èèna, dhèu aae miu.

source_text: for it is an act of righteousness on god's part to give trouble as their reward to those who are troubling you,
target_text: baku madha'u, te lamatua pama'ète lii langu dènge boe bia cabèka. mi ladhe, ee! bèli-camèd'a na b'ala mi dhèu dhu paj'èra miu.

source_text: and to you who are troubled, rest with us, when the lord jesus comes from heaven with the angels of his power in flames of fire,
target_text: aa nèngu hia miu ae mere d'ara nèti j'aj'èra dhu mi pasae kahèi. sèmi èèna mi dedha ji'i kahèi. se'e se j'aj'i, lod'o lamatua yesus puru mai nèti sorga, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na sèra dhu èra titu kèna.

source_text: to give punishment to those who have no knowledge of god, and to those who do not give ear to the good news of our lord jesus:
target_text: rèngu puru mai dènge ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. hèia na b'ala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe tadhe ama lamatua, aa dhu madhutu boe lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: whose reward will be eternal destruction from the face of the lord and from the glory of his strength,
target_text: na hia huku dhu bia titu kèna mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka palaho si taa-taa. na babège si nèti katanga madha na, ka ra rasa heka koasa lamatua dhu kapai.

source_text: at his coming, when he will have glory in his saints, and will be a cause of wonder in all those who had faith because our witness among you had effect in that day.
target_text: lod'o na mai èèna, dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra paca'e padedha-dedha kolongara na, aa ra pakab'ua ne. bèli-camèd'a miu ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra kahèi, lula miu sèmi mere le lii lolo be'a dhu uru èèna ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: for this reason, you are ever in our prayers, that you may seem to our god such as may have a part in his purpose and that by his power he will make all his good purpose, and the work of faith, complete;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mèu-mèda ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi-mangaj'i hia miu, sèna ka madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua, na, miu nia j'aj'i dhèu unu na. ji'i manèngi sèna ka na hia koasa na mi miu kahèi, ho miu bisa tao madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a madhutu ngaa dhu miu parcaya, aa madhutu ngaa dhu miu neo tao.

source_text: so that glory may be given to the name of our lord jesus through you, and you may have glory in him, by the grace of our god and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua yesus. aa miu abhu koa-kad'iri kahèi, lula miu madhutu ne. se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, mai nèti babe'a d'ara ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: now as to the coming of the lord jesus christ, and our meeting with him, it is our desire, my brothers,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu pèri lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus puru mai, aa dènge j'ara tasamia èdhi bisa pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: that you may not be moved in mind or troubled by a spirit, or by a word, or by a letter as from us, with the suggestion that the day of the lord is even now come;
target_text: dhèu baku pagoa miu ho mi ele ngangee ropa tadèngi dhèu peka, na, lamatua dhu mai hari le. masi ka ra peka, na, rèngu tadèngi nèti roh lamatua, do nèti dhèu, do abhu sasuri nèti ji'i, mage miu lèka kahèi. te sèra sa ra leko-monya!

source_text: give no belief to false words: because there will first be a falling away from the faith, and the revelation of the man of sin, the son of destruction,
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu pagoa miu. te bèli-camèd'a ca dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a cèu uuru mai, heka lamatua yesus lèpa hari kèna. dhèu ne'e ne, palab'a dènge lamatua, toke dhèu ae madhutu ne ho palab'a dènge lamatua kahèi. dhèu ne'e ne mema seli-kolane! nèti èèna ka, nèngu hud'i maso ku asa d'ara naraka.

source_text: who puts himself against all authority, lifting himself up over all which is named god or is given worship; so that he takes his seat in the temple of god, putting himself forward as god.
target_text: na padedha iisi na risi nèti dewa aa'i-aa'i ra, aa palab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu. toke na maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka na padedha iisi, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, lamatua!

source_text: have you no memory of what i said when i was with you, giving you word of these things?
target_text: miu sanèd'e, do aad'o? uru èèna ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, lula dhèu èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era, si?

source_text: and now it is clear to you what is keeping back his revelation till the time comes for him to be seen.
target_text: limuri ne, d'ai mèka lod'o ho dhèu bhelu-katub'a èèna pacèu iisi na, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne era. aa miu me'a kahèi ngaa ka dhu pahèb'e ne!

source_text: for the secret of evil is even now at work: but there is one who is keeping back the evil till he is taken out of the way.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu bhelu èèna sab'a pahuni-pahuni era, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne. te ngaa ladhe bèli-camèd'a dhu pahèb'e na, patabuli ka ai na,

source_text: and then will come the revelation of that evil one, whom the lord jesus will put to death with the breath of his mouth, and give to destruction by the revelation of his coming;
target_text: hèia dhèu bhelu ne cèu mai dènge pahuni heka sasab'a na. te ngaa lèke dènge lod'o kapai mamai lamatua yesus, ka na palaho dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne dènge pake lii ca hèb'a doko di.

source_text: even the one whose coming is marked by the working of satan, with all power and signs and false wonders,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o lamatua yesus dhae d'ai mèka, dhèu aae nidhu hia koasa kapai hia mi dhèu bhelu ne, sèna ka bisa na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, hèia dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne pake koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and with every deceit of wrongdoing among those whose fate is destruction; because they were quite without that love of the true faith by which they might have salvation.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu lèke tipu nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne. rèngu se'e ka dhu d'èi palaho iisi ra. ama lamatua dhu bhoke j'ara hia si mamuri, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi dad'èi na dhu hua iia èèna, aa ro'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: and for this cause, god will give them up to the power of deceit and they will put their faith in what is false:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pabèdhu d'ara ra nèti ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka hud'i laa ra parcaya mi kapod'e-kabèli sèra.

source_text: so that they all may be judged, who had no faith in what is true, but took pleasure in evil.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ka, ama lamatua hia si huku dhu bia, lula rèngu lèka boe ngaa dhu tare'a. te rèngu d'èi risi tao dhu karehe.

source_text: but it is right for us to give praise to god at all times for you, brothers, loved by the lord, because it was the purpose of god from the first that you might have salvation, being made holy by the spirit and by faith in what is true:
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula na sue miu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le, sèna ka hia miu mamuri. ka na hia roh na ho pamèu miu, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu tare'a.

source_text: and in this purpose he gave you a part through the good news of which we were the preachers, even that you might have part in the glory of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: lod'o ji'i lole lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ama lamatua pake lii lolo be'a na ho ère miu, sèna ka miu me'a dadedha dènge kapai nèti lamatua yesus kristus.

source_text: so then, brothers, be strong in purpose, and keep the teaching which has been given to you by word or by letter from us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! taha d'ara dènge kèpe pa'ère-ère lii holo-nori dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu. sanèd'e kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ji'i.

source_text: now our lord jesus christ himself, and god our father who had love for us and has given us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, give you comfort and strength in every good work and word.
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i taruu mi ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pa'èra d'ara miu, ho miu bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. ji'i manèngi sèmi èèna, lula ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue titu kèna mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. lula d'ara na hua iia, nèti èèna ka nèngu loe boe pa'èra d'ara èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu.

source_text: for the rest, my brothers, let there be prayer for us that the word of the lord may go forward with increasing glory, even as it does with you;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i. sabaj'a sèna ka lii lolo be'a lamatua, pale-palème asa mia-mia dènge malai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pakab'ua lii lolo be'a èèna, sèmi dhu lod'o miu abhu lii lolo be'a ca hari ni.

source_text: and that we may be made free from foolish and evil men; for not all have faith.
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ji'i pakaj'èu nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu tao kaco, aa nèti dhèu bhelu leo sèra, te dhèu aa'i boe dhu parcaya lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: but the lord is true, who will give you strength and keep you safe from evil.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua kèpe pa'ère lii padhai na. nèngu tao pa'èra miu, aa na bhiri miu nèti dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and we have faith in the lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things about which we give you orders.
target_text: aa ji'i nge'a tare'a kahèi, na, lamatua yesus hia miu madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i lole le dènge miu. ka tatu miu tao madhutu le sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and may your hearts be guided by the lord into the love of god and quiet waiting for christ.
target_text: ji'i sanao ho lamatua yesus sanoro miu, sèna ka asa me'a, na, ama lamatua sue miu, ka miu èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi kristus uru èèna taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra na.

source_text: now we give you orders, brothers, in the name of our lord jesus christ, to keep away from all those whose behaviour is not well ordered and in harmony with the teaching which they had from us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka mema miu dènge ale ngara lamatua yesus kristus! baku lami pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu bai-eed'a dhu re'a dhoka rodha di. te rèngu sèra madhutu boe èdhi dhu maj'èni sab'a bia.

source_text: for you yourselves are used to taking us as your example, because our life among you was ruled by order,
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ji'i, lod'o ji'i pea ètu talora aae miu. miu mèdhi unu mi. ji'i ngo'o boe core eele lod'o iia d'ara.

source_text: and we did not take food from any man for nothing, but were working hard night and day not to be a trouble to any of you:
target_text: ji'i sab'a bia mèu-mèda, sèna ka ji'i baku pabia miu. ji'i sèmi boe iia d'ara, nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu.

source_text: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, so that you might do the same.
target_text: ji'i se dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. de ji'i dènge hak kahèi manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe tao sèmi èèna. ji'i neo pad'elo j'ara dhu be'a sèna ka miu madhutu.

source_text: for even when we were with you we gave you orders, saying, if any man does no work, let him not have food.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i hia le kahèi atora dhu peka na, dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe sab'a, baku hia ra'a-rinu.

source_text: for it has come to our ears that there are some among you whose behaviour is uncontrolled, who do no work at all, but are over-interested in the business of others.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi lii, peka na, nèti talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, ro'o boe sab'a. rèngu sèra re'a dhoka bhute dènge soro iisi ra asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo.

source_text: now to such we give orders and make request in the lord jesus, that, working quietly, they get their living.
target_text: ji'i pasanèd'e dhèu sèmi sèra, dènge kolongara lamatua yesus kristus, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a. be'a risi rèngu sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge èi kabhèsu unu ra.

source_text: and you, my brothers, do not get tired of well-doing.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a!

source_text: and if any man does not give attention to what we have said in this letter, take note of that man, and keep away from him, so that he may be shamed.
target_text: miu patadhe paie-iie dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne. hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ra'e makae.

source_text: have no feeling of hate for him, but take him in hand seriously as a brother.
target_text: sad'i miu baku tao si nuka sèmi musu miu. te ngaa kai si dènge be'a, sèmi miu kai a'ari miu mesa mi.

source_text: now the lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. may the lord be with you all.
target_text: lamatua èèna, dhèu aae mera-milu. ja'a manèngi ho na hia miu mera-milu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a maena, sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: these words of love to you at the end are in my writing, paul's writing, and this is the mark of every letter from me.
target_text: ja'a pa'èle sasuri ne dènge kacui-aai ja'a unu ku, sèna ka miu me'a, na, sasuri ne tare'a-re'a nèti ja'a. lii limuri tèka, oe pa'èle sasuri leo aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu suri kahèi.

source_text: may the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you all.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka d'ara hua iia lamatua yesus kristus rai eele boe nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. sasuri ne d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of jesus christ, by the order of god our saviour and christ jesus our hope; to timothy, my true child in the faith: grace, mercy, peace, from god the father and christ jesus our lord.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua ded'e le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. aa lamatua yesus, era sanao-maena dhu hia èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge nèngu, lula ama lamatua pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. timotius! èu ne, nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a, lula ja'a ka dhu pad'elo j'ara ka èu parcaya kristus. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia rèngu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: it was my desire, when i went on into macedonia, that you might make a stop at ephesus, to give orders to certain men not to put forward a different teaching,
target_text: uru èèna, dua ti ètu kota epesus. lod'o ja'a neo laku asa propensi makedonia, ja'a manèngi èu ho pea ètu epesus. te lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pab'ingu dhèu sarani sèra dènge aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu lamu kai si, ho ra loe eele ka.

source_text: or to give attention to stories and long lists of generations, from which come questionings and doubts, in place of god's ordered way of life which is in faith;
target_text: aa dhèu sèra core eele lod'o iia d'ara kahèi lasi palolo nanuku, pab'ala lii dènge kapod'e-kabèli nèti bèi-baki toke lai ana lai èpu. j'ara sèmi sèra, dhoka hia dhèu patao-palaha, aa hia boe ra mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua.

source_text: but the effect of the order is love coming from a clean heart, and a knowledge of what is right, and true faith:
target_text: ja'a holo èu, sèna ka èu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra ho mamuri pasue èci dènge èci kahèi. sasue ra hud'i mai nèti d'ara dhu mèu, nèti ngangee dhu mola, aa nèti parcaya dhu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: from which some have been turned away, giving themselves to foolish talking;
target_text: te ngaa abhu mese cahag'e dhu kako sala le j'ara, ra tèke eele lii holo-nori. hèia lasi core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge padhue-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they have no knowledge of what they say or of the statements which they make so certainly.
target_text: rèngu padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu mese dhu aj'a madhutu atora musa. ra tao iisi ra sèmi mese aae, te ngaa re'a boe ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a-nori èèna.

source_text: we are conscious that the law is good, if a man makes a right use of it,
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, huku musa èèna be'a, sad'i èdhi pake ne madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: with the knowledge that the law is made, not for the upright man, but for those who have no respect for law and order, for evil men and sinners, for the unholy and those who have no religion, for those who put their fathers or mothers to death, for takers of life,
target_text: atora sèra suri boe hia mi dhèu dhu mamuri mola le. te ngaa pala mi dhèu palab'a, dhu d'èi boe nanene paredha, dhu mamuri pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a, dhu pusi-pahae boe lamatua, dhu pamud'e j'ara-j'ara dhu hua iia, dhu tuka pamadhe dhèu, dènge dhu pamadhe ina dènge ama ra.

source_text: for those who go after loose women, for those with unnatural desires, for those who take men prisoners, who make false statements and false oaths, and those who do any other things against the right teaching,
target_text: atora sèra suri kahèi hia dhèu kajeo dènge bhèni do dènge mone, aa mone dhu tao j'ara makae dènge mone, dhu rai rèti dhèu ho sui dènge doi-dhari, dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu j'aj'i sakasii omo koso, aa hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu d'èi palab'a lii aj'a dhu lèke.

source_text: which may be seen in the good news of the glory of the great god, which was given into my care.
target_text: a'aj'a dhu lèke sèra, mai nèti lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ja'a. aa lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ded'e ne padedha-dedha.

source_text: i give praise to him who gave me power, christ jesus our lord, because he took me to be true, making me his servant,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na lèka ja'a, ka na hia ja'a bisa pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: though i had said violent words against god, and done cruel acts, causing great trouble: but i was given mercy, because i did it without knowledge, not having faith; and the grace of our lord was very great, with faith and love which is in christ jesus.
target_text: masi ka uru èèna, ja'a d'èi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara yesus, aa paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri na. ja'a d'èi ènyi raruri si. bhabhelu ja'a sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a tao, aa parcaya mèka yesus kristus. te ngaa ama lamatua core eele boe ja'a. ka na pad'elo sasue na mi ja'a. mia hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, loe boe pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a! nèngu hia mèngi-nale dhu ae hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne, aa ja'a bisa sue dhèu leo kahèi nuka sèmi nèngu sue ja'a.

source_text: it is a true saying, in which all may put their faith, that christ jesus came into the world to give salvation to sinners, of whom i am the chief:
target_text: èdhi biasa tadèngi le, peka na, yesus kristus mai le asa rai-haha, ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ad'u-ue sasala, ja'a ka dhu bhelu risi eele.

source_text: but for this reason i was given mercy, so that in me, the chief of sinners, jesus christ might make clear all his mercy, as an example to those who in the future would have faith in him to eternal life.
target_text: masi ka ja'a bhelu sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua huku boe ja'a. te nare ja'a j'aj'i mi tadha sena ka pad'elo sasue yesus kristus mi dhèu dhu bhelu risi eele, nuka sèmi ja'a ne'e ne. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, dhèu leo dhu tao sala sèra bisa parcaya ne kahèi, ka ra abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: now to the king eternal, ever-living, unseen, the only god, be honour and glory for ever and ever. so be it.
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lula dhoka nèngu di, ama lamatua; dhu leo aad'o! nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu paredha taa-taa. mamuri na dènge boe too-lane. mamadhe aad'o ètu nèngu. dhèu bisa boe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha. pakab'ua dènge koa-kio aa'i-aa'i hia mi nèngu di! tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: this order i give to you, timothy my son, in harmony with the words of the prophets about you, so that by them you may be strong, fighting the good fight,
target_text: ana timotius dhu be'a! ja'a neo peka dènge èu ngaa dhu hud'i èu tao ku ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a èu. aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka tèke le lula-nèti èu ne. ladhe èu madhutu lii se'e dènge mola-mola, èu sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu bisa pamusu dènge be'a, ho lab'a bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: keeping faith, and being conscious of well-doing; for some, by not doing these things, have gone wrong in relation to the faith:
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èu mi yesus kristus. aa j'aga paie, sèna ka d'ara èu mola taruu. te abhu kahèi dhèu leo dhu ro'o heka nanene d'ara iiki ra, dhu pa'ele iie parcaya rèngu, nuka sèmi kapa rage nare hadhu aae.

source_text: such are hymenaeus and alexander, whom i have given up to satan, so that they may say no more evil words against god.
target_text: himeneus dènge aleksander si, ra sèmi èèna ka! nèti èèna ka, ja'a soro le rèngu asa dhèu aae nidhu. ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka aj'a si loe eele pakarehe kolongara lamatua,

source_text: my desire is, first of all, that you will make requests and prayers and give praise for all men;
target_text: dhu uru tèka miu tao: ja'a manèngi miu sabaj'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ladhe miu mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, manèngi sèna ka na ladhe-leru dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa manèngi makasi, lula na tao le babe'a mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for kings and all those in authority; so that we may have a calm and quiet life in all fear of god and serious behaviour.
target_text: sabaj'a sèmi èèna kahèi hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. dènge j'ara ne'e èdhi bisa mamuri mera-milu, dènge dame, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, mamuri pamèci dènge dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi lamatua.

source_text: this is good and pleasing in the eyes of god our saviour;
target_text: manèngi-mangaj'i sèmi èèna ka dhu be'a. j'ara ne'e ne ka pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, dhu hia èdhi mamuri.

source_text: whose desire is that all men may have salvation and come to the knowledge of what is true.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu mamuri, aa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. nuka sèmi:

source_text: for there is one god and one peacemaker between god and men, the man christ jesus,
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, dhoka èci di. aa kalete dhoka èci di dhu padame èdhi dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, nuka, yesus kristus. aa yesus tare'a-re'a dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: who gave himself as an offering for all; witness of which was to be given at the right time;
target_text: na soro iisi na, ho sui èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi. lèke dènge lod'o na, ka ama lamatua bhoke le pasaraa lii lolo be'a èèna hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and of this i became a preacher and an apostle what i say is true, not false, and a teacher of the gentiles in the true faith.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, sèna ka laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe ètu mia-mia, aa nori si sèna ka ra parcaya lamatua yesus, dènge mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna. ja'a leko-monya boe.

source_text: it is my desire, then, that in every place men may give themselves to prayer, lifting up holy hands, without wrath or argument.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ètu mia-mia miu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i, hud'i dènge ku d'ara dhu mola-mèci. baku panasa. baku patao-palaha. ladhe sabaj'a, bisa ded'e kacui-aai asa ama lamatua, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, d'ara miu mola-mèci tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and that women may be dressed in simple clothing, with a quiet and serious air; not with twisted hair and gold or jewels or robes of great price; but clothed with good works, as is right for women who are living in the fear of god.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a kahèi ladhe dhèu-dhèu bhèni re'a lalau iisi ra pake mèdha-papake dhu pantas. dhu tao bhèni j'aj'i bhèni iia, lula boe nèti pasaraga rèu kètu, do pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu nèti makae, do pake risi eele mèdha hualaa, doi pudhi dènge mutiara. te dhu tao bhèni sèra j'aj'i bhèni iia, nuka d'ara dhu hua iia, aa rèngu tao dhoka j'ara dhu be'a. èèna ka pamèci dènge dhèu bhèni dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: let a woman quietly take the place of a learner and be under authority.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sarani pakaboko ho nanene lii holo-nori, na, bhèni sa kahèi madhutu atora, sèna ka pasa dhilu ra be'a-be'a ho nanene lii holo-nori dènge d'ara kateme. baku pagagai sèna ka tao maruru.

source_text: in my opinion it is right for a woman not to be a teacher, or to have rule over a man, but to be quiet.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, lèke boe ladhe dhèu bhèni ded'e ngi'u ra ho paredha aa aj'a dhèu mone. be'a risi bhèni sèra taha d'ara.

source_text: for adam was first formed, then eve;
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru adam, heka hawa kèna.

source_text: and adam was not taken by deceit, but the woman, being tricked, became a wrongdoer.
target_text: aa adam dhu uru boe lèke ag'o nèti dhèu aae nidhu, te ngaa dhèu bhèni. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu rai-haha mulai lab'a paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: but if they go on in faith and love and holy self-control, she will be kept safe at the time of childbirth.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu bhèni abhu mamuri lula rèngu rara iisi ana. sad'i rèngu parcaya tare'a-re'a mi kristus, mamuri pasue, mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, aa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: this is a true saying, a man desiring the position of a bishop has a desire for a good work.
target_text: mema tare'a sèmi lii dhèu, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hag'e nare le sasab'a èci dhu hua iia titu kèna.

source_text: the bishop, then, is to be a man of good name, the husband of one wife, self-controlled, serious-minded, having respect for order, opening his house freely to guests, a ready teacher;
target_text: kètu juma'at èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu kolongara be'a. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu hud'i taha nare d'ara na, dhèu dhu patao-palaha boe, dhu dhèu pakab'ua ne, dhu d'èi bhoke babèdho èmu ho dhèu lasi pangad'o dènge ne, aa bisa aj'a-nori dhèu leo.

source_text: not quickly moved to wrath or blows, but gentle; no fighter, no lover of money;
target_text: baku dhèu dhu tema mahu, baku dhèu dhu nasa dènge kacui-aai malai. dhu lèke ka, dhèu dhu d'ara hua iia, dhu d'èi tenge dame, aa dhu manga'a boe doi-dhari.

source_text: ruling his house well, having his children under control with all serious behaviour;
target_text: nèngu hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na dènge be'a. ana-ana na re'a pakab'ua dènge d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: for if a man has not the art of ruling his house, how will he take care of the church of god?
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èèna ne'a boe lalau-lalo'o d'ara èmu na, na, tasa mera mia nèngu bisa ladhe-leru juma'at lamatua.

source_text: not one newly taken into the church, for fear that, through his high opinion of himself, he may come into the same sin as the evil one.
target_text: be'a risi, pili dhèu dhu mamuri palèke dènge dad'èi kristus. de baku ded'e kètu juma'at nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu mèka mi yesus. te èèna na, rèngu sèra bisa padedha iisi malai. mage dhoka lamatua huku si, sama sèmi lamatua huku dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: and he is to have a good name among those outside the church, so that nothing may be said against him and he may not be taken by the designs of the evil one.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i dhèu dhu rai lesa re'a pakab'ua ne kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna nèngu makae boe. aa dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe pabèbhe ne kahèi.

source_text: deacons, in the same way, are to be serious in their behaviour, not false in word, not given to taking much wine or greatly desiring the wealth of this world;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at. rèngu sèra hud'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara be'a, dhèu dhu he'o kajari boe, dhu tema boe rinu mahu, aa dhu d'èi boe ra'e a'oto ae-ae.

source_text: keeping the secret of the faith in a heart free from sin.
target_text: d'ara rèngu hud'i mola-mèci, aa rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra ku lii holo-nori dhu lamatua bhoke pasaraa hia èdhi, dhèu parcaya se'e.

source_text: and let these first be put to the test; then let them become deacons if there is nothing against them.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie mamuri dènge sasab'a ra. ladhe abhu boe sasala si, heka ded'e si ho soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra.

source_text: women are to be serious in behaviour, saying no evil of others, controlling themselves, true in all things.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. rèngu sèra hud'i bhèni dhu mamuri madhutu madha j'ara dènge tatao dhu be'a. mage dhèu dhu tema padhai-kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo. rèngu hud'i dhèu dhu re'a taha rare d'ara, aa dhèu lèka si kahèi.

source_text: let deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their houses well.
target_text: aa dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra hud'i mone dhu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu èèna hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na, aa uri ana-ana na dènge be'a.

source_text: for those who have done good work as deacons get for themselves a good position and become free from fear in the faith which is in christ jesus.
target_text: rèngu dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani dènge be'a, tatu dhèu asa pakab'ua si. aa rèngu asa bani, dènge boe madha'u lole parcaya rèngu mi yesus kristus.

source_text: i am writing these things to you, though i am hoping to come to you before long; but if i am long in coming, this will make clear to you what behaviour is right for men in the house of god, which is the church of the living god, the pillar and base of what is true.
target_text: timotius! ja'a sanao sèna ka nèbhu boe ja'a dhiu ngad'o èu. ladhe ja'a pakai, do ako nena ciki, na, ele boe sasuri ne d'ai uuru èu. sasuri ne ja'a suri ho peka dènge èu, na, dhèu unu lamatua sèra hud'i ra mamuri tasa mera mia ku. baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. dhèu unu na nuka sèmi èmu dhu dènge era padhèdi, aa dènge agarii talora dhu èra. èmu sèmi èèna ka dhu titu èra, sama sèmi dhèu unu lamatua dhu kèpe pa'èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tare'a, aa rèngu bisa bara ho pakako dènge be'a.

source_text: and without argument, great is the secret of religion: he who was seen in the flesh, who was given god's approval in the spirit, was seen by the angels, of whom the good news was given among the nations, in whom the world had faith, who was taken up in glory.
target_text: lamatua pasabhoka le rahasia dhu kapai nèti lalèka èdhi. kapua na sèmi ne'e ka: kristus èèna, ca dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka. aa kristus èèna mai le asa rai-haha ne, pake rupa dhèu rai-haha sèmi èdhi. roh lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, yesus èèna, nuka kristus. aa ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra rèdhi na kahèi. ama lamatua dhu ded'e nèti le asa sorga, ka nedhe padedha-dedha ne. lii lolo na pale-lème le suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne. ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i parcaya le nèngu. kapua lalèka èdhi sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: but the spirit says clearly that in later times some will be turned away from the faith, giving their minds to spirits of deceit, and the teachings of evil spirits,
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, roh ama lamatua dhu peka paled'a le, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani cahag'e patalale eele ngaa dhu èdhi parcaya. ho lasi madhutu roh-roh dhu sala aa dhu leko-monya, aa lasi madhutu lii holo-nori nidhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: through the false ways of men whose words are untrue, whose hearts are burned as with a heated iron;
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nori sèmi sèra, padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèra mema dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli! dhèu sèra sa, d'ara iiki ra dhu bèdhu le.

source_text: who keep men from being married and from taking food which god made to be taken with praise by those who have faith and true knowledge.
target_text: ra aj'a dhèu, baku paleo èmu. aa ra aj'a dhèu luri rupa-rupa nganga'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao nganga'a-nganginu sèra, ho ladhe dhèu parcaya ra'a, rèngu manèngi makasi mi nèngu. te rèngu re'a mia dhu lèke.

source_text: because everything which god has made is good, and nothing is evil, if it is taken with praise:
target_text: ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao sèra, tare'a-re'a be'a. de baku luri rupa-rupa. dhèu hud'i sèmi rare aa'i-aa'i sèra dènge manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: for it is made holy by the word of god and by prayer.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi sèra ka pamèu si.

source_text: if you keep these things before the minds of the brothers, you will be a good servant of christ jesus, trained in the words of the faith and of the right teaching which has been your guide:
