source_text: and this is love, not that we had love for god, but that he had love for us, and sent his son to be an offering for our sins.
target_text: ladhe neo me'a sasue dhu lèke tare'a, baku pasoro sasue èdhi dènge sasue lamatua. te ngaa ladhe sasue lamatua mi dedha èdhi, lula ama lamatua pua ana na mai, ho j'aj'i korban sèna ka gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge nèngu.

source_text: my loved ones, if god had such love for us, it is right for us to have love for one another.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! lula ama lamatua sue èdhi seli eele, na, èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: no man has ever seen god: if we have love for one another, god is in us and his love is made complete in us:
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe nèdhi mèu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasue èci dènge èci, sasoa na, ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa sasue na asa tabha ètu d'ara mamuri èdhi, toke j'aj'i sasue dhu kateme.

source_text: and his spirit which he has given us is the witness that we are in him and he is in us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, te'a, na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne, aa nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge èdhi kahèi.

source_text: and we have seen and give witness that the father sent the son to be the saviour of the world.
target_text: ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ngèdhi le ana ama lamatua dènge musi madha ji'i. ka ji'i peka palème dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, ama lamatua hia le ana na mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: everyone who says openly that jesus is the son of god, has god in him and is in god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua, nèngu mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa ama lamatua pabe'a dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and we have seen and had faith in the love which god has for us. god is love, and everyone who has love is in god, and god is in him.
target_text: èdhi te'a kahèi, peka na, lamatua sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya, nèngu sue èdhi taruu. lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha ne titu kèna. de dhèu dhu mamuri pasue, nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua, aa lamatua mamuri d'ara èci dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: in this way love is made complete in us, so that we may be without fear on the day of judging, because as he is, so are we in this world.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi d'ara èci dènge lamatua, sasue èdhi j'aj'i kateme. hèia, ropa d'ai lod'o èle ka rai-haha ne, lamatua parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, èdhi madha'u boe ara lati asa madha na, lula èdhi dhu j'aj'i le sèmi kristus, lod'o dhu na mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: there is no fear in love: true love has no room for fear, because where fear is, there is pain; and he who is not free from fear is not complete in love.
target_text: ladhe èdhi mamuri pasue, na, èdhi dènge heka d'ara madha'u ciki sa. te ladhe èdhi pasue dènge mola, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi pakaj'èu eele aa'i le madha'u nèti d'ara èdhi. ladhe dhèu madha'u, d'ara na susa, lula nèngu madha'u lèke huku. dhèu ne, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a mèka sue dhèu dènge mola.

source_text: we have the power of loving, because he first had love for us.
target_text: èdhi pasue, lula ama lamatua dhu sue uuru le èdhi.

source_text: if a man says, i have love for god, and has hate for his brother, his words are false: for how is the man who has no love for his brother whom he has seen, able to have love for god whom he has not seen?
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, nèngu monya di. te ladhe dhèu sue boe a'ari na dhu ètu katanga madha nèngu, tasamia hari nèngu sue ama lamatua dhu nèdhi mèka? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: and this is the word which we have from him, that he who has love for god is to have the same love for his brother.
target_text: te ama lamatua unu na ka dhu papuru paredha, peka na, èdhi baku sue dhodhoka nèngu di, te ngaa sue ku a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: everyone who has faith that jesus is the christ is a child of god: and everyone who has love for the father has love for his child.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu peka na, yesus, tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu sue ca dhèu ama, tatu sue ana na kahèi.

source_text: in this way, we are certain that we have love for the children of god, when we have love for god and keep his laws.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sue lamatua, aa sab'a madhutu paredha na, èèna peka na, èdhi sue ana-ana lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for loving god is keeping his laws: and his laws are not hard.
target_text: de ladhe èdhi sue nèngu, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku paredha na sèra. aa paredha na bia boe.

source_text: anything which comes from god is able to overcome the world: and the power by which we have overcome the world is our faith.
target_text: èdhi dhu j'aj'i le ana-ana lamatua, bisa segi dad'èi rai-haha ne, lula èdhi parcaya ne.

source_text: who is able to overcome the world but the man who has faith that jesus is the son of god?
target_text: te dhèu dhu segi dad'èi rai-haha, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: this is he who came by water and by blood, jesus christ; not by water only but by water and by blood.
target_text: sad'i miu me'a, na, yesus, dhèu rai-haha kahèi, aa nèngu ne, kristus kahèi dhu ama lamatua hia mai asa rai-haha ne. lod'o nèngu neo pakako sasab'a-la'a na, yohanis sarani ne pake èi. èle èèna ka, nèngu madhe aa pasuti raa na kahèi. de dhu lèke ka, mesa boe èi di dhu yohanis pake sarani nèngu, te ngaa raa na dhu suti eele èèna dhu kab'ua risi. te roh ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna, aa dhu ne'a boe leko-monya.

source_text: and the spirit is the witness, because the spirit is true.
target_text: te abhu tèlu j'ara dhu j'aj'i sakasii:

source_text: there are three witnesses, the spirit, the water, and the blood: and all three are in agreement.
target_text: nuka roh lamatua, èi dhu yohanis pake sarani yesus, aa raa yesus unu na. tèlu j'ara se'e ka, pad'elo ca j'ara dhu sama lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: if we take the witness of men to be true, the witness of god is greater: because this is the witness which god has given about his son.
target_text: ladhe dhèu rai-haha ka j'aj'i sakasii, na, èdhi bisa parcaya ne. risi-risi hari ladhe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ana nèngu unu na. aa te ngaa tèlu j'ara se'e dhu ama lamatua pake, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, yesus mesa boe dhèu rai-haha biasa di, te ngaa nèngu ne kristus kahèi.

source_text: he who has faith in the son of god has the witness in himself: he who has not faith in god makes him false, because he has not faith in the witness which god has given about his son.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu ne sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, lula-nèti ana na. te ngaa dhèu dhu lèka boe lamatua, nèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua leko-monya! dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu sèmi boe lii holo-nori lamatua lula-nèti ana na.

source_text: and his witness is this, that god has given us eternal life, and this life is in his son.
target_text: isi nèti lii holo-nori lamatua nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, toke d'ai mia-mia. aa èdhi abhu mamuri ne, lula èdhi parcaya ana na.

source_text: he who has the son has the life; he who has not the son of god has not the life.
target_text: de dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ana ama lamatua abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ana ama lamatua, abhu boe mamuri sèmi èèna.

source_text: i have put these things in writing for you who have faith in the name of the son of god, so that you may be certain that you have eternal life.
target_text: ja'a suri madha j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i hia miu dhèu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sèna ka me'a mèu, na, miu unu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and we are certain that if we make any request to him which is right in his eyes, he will give ear to us:
target_text: ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, sad'i èdhi manèngi ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi bisa te'a tare'a-re'a, na, nèngu tadèngi lii manèngi èdhi sèra.

source_text: and if we are certain that he gives ear to all our requests, we are equally certain that we will get our requests.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi parcaya tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, èdhi abhu ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi manèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: if a man sees his brother doing a sin which is not bad enough for death, let him make a prayer to god, and god will give life to him whose sin was not bad enough for death. there is a sin whose punishment is death: i do not say that he may make such a request then.
target_text: ladhe èu mèdhi a'ari mu tao sala dhu nèti boe mamadhe, be'a risi èu sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua soru-bara a'ari èu èèna ho na abhu sod'a. a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: abhu sasala dhu nèti boe dhèu asa d'ara mamadhe. abhu kahèi sasala dhu nèti dhèu asa mamadhe. te ngaa ja'a pua boe miu ho sabaj'a ladhe abhu sasala sèmi èèna.

source_text: all evil-doing is sin: but death is not the punishment for every sort of sin.
target_text: tatao karehe aa'i-aa'i, sala ètu madha ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu kahèi sasala dhu nèti boe mamadhe.

source_text: we are certain that one who is a child of god will do no sin, but the son of god keeps him so that he is not touched by the evil one.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama lamatua, mamuri heka tao sala, te ana ama lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ne. aa dhu bhelu-katub'a bisa boe segi ne kahèi.

source_text: we are certain that we are of god, but all the world is in the power of the evil one.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, èdhi kapua ètu d'ara ama lamatua. te ngaa èdhi te'a kahèi, na, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge koasa ho ator dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and we are certain that the son of god has come, and has given us a clear vision, so that we may see him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his son jesus christ. he is the true god and eternal life.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua mai le, sèna ka hia èdhi te'a mèu j'ara se'e, ho èdhi bisa tadhe mèu ama lamatua dhu tare'a. limuri ne, èdhi bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ne, lula èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ana na, yesus kristus. te yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua kahèi. aa nèngu ka hia dhèu abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: my little children, keep yourselves from false gods.
target_text: ana-ana, ee! j'aga paie-iie mamuri miu. mage abhu dhu seti eele ho gati ama lamatua nèti d'ara miu. d'ai sange ne'e ka. nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: i, a ruler in the church, send word to the noble sister who is of god's selection, and to her children, for whom i have true love; and not only i, but all who have knowledge of what is true;
target_text: ina pasue! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yohanis, dhu j'aj'i ama gareja. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia mi ina, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa dènge ana-ana ina sèra. ja'a sue miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i, dhu re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, ra sue miu kahèi.

source_text: because of this true knowledge which is in us, and will be with us for ever:
target_text: ji'i sue miu, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèle ètu d'ara èdhi, aa èèna na muri taruu ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: may grace, mercy, and peace be with us from god the father, and from jesus christ, the son of the father, in all true love.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge ana na yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia dènge rasa kasia ra mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dame, mamuri pasue, aa pa'èki taruu dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: it gave me great joy to see some of your children walking in the true way, even as we were ordered to do by the father.
target_text: ja'a karej'e titu kèna, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge ana ina cahag'e, dhu ra mamuri dènge be'a, madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi dhu ama lamatua hia le paredha mi èdhi.

source_text: and now, my sister, i make a request to you, not sending you a new law, but the law which we had from the first, that we have love for one another.
target_text: ina pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri ètu d'ara pasue. dhu ja'a manèngi èèna, paredha hiu boe, te ngaa ja'a dhoka pasanèd'e di nèti paredha dhu èdhi unu le karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: and love is the keeping of his laws. this is the law which was given to you from the first, so that you might keep it.
target_text: èdhi bisa pad'elo sasue èdhi, ladhe èdhi tao madhutu paredha ama lamatua. karèi nèti uru ka, na paredha le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. ne'e ne j'ara hiu boe, te miu tadèngi le karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: because a number of false teachers have gone out into the world, who do not give witness that jesus christ came in the flesh. such a one is a false teacher and antichrist.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli ae kako palème le rai-haha ne. rèngu aj'a, na, yesus kristus mai asa rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a boe. dhèu se'e dhèu kapod'e-kabèli kahèi dhu lab'a kristus, aa ro'o boe sèmi rare, peka na, yesus, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: keep watch over yourselves, so that you do not make our work of no effect, but may get your full reward.
target_text: j'aga paie-iie, ho èi kabhèsu èdhi baku core eele iia d'ara. de miu hud'i maj'èni sab'a taruu, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua moa neo hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: anyone who goes on and does not keep to the teaching of christ, has not god: he who keeps to the teaching has the father and the son.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sigo eele nèti aj'a-nori kristus, nèngu pa'èki boe dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a na, nèngu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na, yesus kristus.

source_text: if anyone comes to you not having this teaching, do not take him into your house or give him words of love:
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu leko-leo lula-nèti kristus, na, baku sèmi mere ne asa d'ara èmu miu, aa baku soro-suu hia ne.

source_text: for he who gives him words of love has a part in his evil works.
target_text: te ladhe pusi-pahae ne, na, miu sèmi mere le sasab'a na dhu bhelu-katub'a èèna.

source_text: having much to say to you, it is not my purpose to put it all down with paper and ink: but i am hoping to come to you, and to have talk with you face to face, so that your joy may be full.
target_text: madha j'ara ae era, dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa be'a risi ja'a baku suri ètu d'ara sasuri. te nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu padhai lii dènge miu, sèna ka èdhi sama-sama bisa karej'e-karae tare'a-re'a.

source_text: the children of your noble sister, who is of god's selection, send you their love.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare kahèi a'a ina. ana-ana na hia lii maho'o mi ina si aa'i-aa'i ètu èèna. sange ne'e ka. salam nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: i, a ruler in the church, send word to the well loved gaius, for whom i have true love.
target_text: angalai gayus dhu ja'a sue tare'a-re'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yohanis, ama gareja!

source_text: my loved one, it is my prayer that you may do well in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does well.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua j'aga èu, ho èu baku isi-noso kètu-kabo'o, aa d'ara èu be'a-be'a.

source_text: for it gave me great joy when some of the brothers came and gave witness that you had the true faith and were walking in the true way.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri a'ari dhu mai lolo dènge ja'a, peka na, èu madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: i have no greater joy than to have news that my children are walking in the true way.
target_text: te ja'a karej'e risi eele, ladhe tadèngi ana-ana ja'a mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: my loved one, you are doing a good work in being kind to those brothers who come from other places;
target_text: angalai pasue! èu pakako le sasab'a ama lamatua dènge be'a, ropa èu sèmi more dènge hua iia a'ari dhu kako palème ho pakako sasab'a kristus. masi ka èu tadhe mèka si, te ngaa sèmi more si dènge be'a.

source_text: who have given witness to the church of your love for them: and you will do well to send them on their way well cared for, as is right for servants of god:
target_text: dhèu dhu lèpa hari mai, palolo hia juma'at ètu ne'e, peka na, èu sèmi more dènge be'a, aa sue si. limuri ne, ja'a manèngi ho èu soru-bara taruu dhèu sèmi sèra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: for they went out for love of the name, taking nothing from the gentiles.
target_text: rèngu loe boe kako palème sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu nèti j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. te ngaa rèngu sèmi boe bantuan ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu parcaya boe kristus.

source_text: so it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that we may take our part in the work of the true faith.
target_text: de mema dhu lèke kèna, ladhe èdhi ka dhu soru-bara si. te dènge j'ara ne, èdhi pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: i sent a letter to the church, but diotrephes, whose desire is ever to have the first place among them, will not have us there.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pa'adhu le sasuri hia juma'at ètu èèna, te ngaa diotrefes padedha iisi na nuka sèmi dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. aa na d'èi boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: so if i come, i will keep in mind the things he does, talking against us with evil words: and as if this was not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those who are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a dhiu, èèna na ja'a bhoke paled'a-led'a ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue. te na padhai lii pod'e-ed'o sèna ka neo pamanahu èdhi. risi-risi hari, na tule eele dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu dhiu asa èèna. hèia na kakèj'i a'ari ètu èèna kahèi, ho baku sèmi rare dhèu sèra.

source_text: my loved one, do not be copying what is evil, but what is good. he who does good is of god: he who does evil has not seen god.
target_text: angalai pasue! èu hud'i madhutu ku tatao dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. baku madhutu dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a. te dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a, rèngu sèra dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a, tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: demetrius has the approval of all men and of what is true: and we give the same witness, and you are certain that our witness is true.
target_text: ladhe sèku demetrius. dhèu aa'i-aa'i koa-kad'iri ne lula na madhutu mola-mola j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu lèke. ja'a koa ne kahèi, aa èu me'a, na, ja'a monya boe.

source_text: i had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all down with ink and pen:
target_text: abhu j'ara ae-ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge èu, te ngaa ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri.

source_text: but i am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk with you face to face. may you have peace. your friends here send you their love. give my love to our friends by name.
target_text: te ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka èdhi paraga, sèna ka èdhi dua ti bisa padhai lii patoo madha dènge madha.

source_text: jude, a servant of jesus christ and the brother of james, to those of god's selection who have been made holy by god the father and are kept safe for jesus christ:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yudas, ari yakobis. ja'a ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, dhu na sue, aa dhu yesus kristus loe boe j'aga si toke d'ai nèngu mai hari.

source_text: may mercy and peace and love be increased in you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: my loved ones, while my thoughts were full of a letter which i was going to send you about our common salvation, it was necessary for me to send you one requesting you with all my heart to go on fighting strongly for the faith which has been given to the saints once and for ever.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! uru èèna ja'a neo suri sasuri hia miu, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu lii langu, de ja'a hud'i suri hari j'ara dhu leo. ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èdhi j'ara mamuri dhu mola. nèngu hia j'ara mamuri ne ca tèka di, aa na ub'a boe. nèngu hia j'ara mamuri ne mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'èra-èra d'ara, ho dhèu baku pakapod'e j'ara mamuri nèti lamatua.

source_text: for certain men have come among you secretly, marked out before in the holy writings for this evil fate, men without the fear of god, turning his grace into an unclean thing, and false to our only master and lord, jesus christ.
target_text: te ngaa abhu le pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mai pahuni-pahuni ètu talora aae miu. dhèu sèra madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola, te ngaa ra madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ra. rèngu peka na, d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho rèngu bisa tao leli. èèna na omo koso! rèngu se dhèu dhu peka leo, tao leo! dad'èi rèngu ka, ho èdhi nanene ia ka dhèu aae èdhi dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, lamatua unu na ka dhu tao tèke le hahuku dhu j'èra karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: now it is my purpose to put you in mind, though you once had knowledge of all these things, of how the lord, having taken a people safely out of egypt, later sent destruction on those who had no faith;
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu miu me'a le, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e hari, ho miu baku pamud'e. sanèd'e ku lii lolo uru-uru sèra, lod'o dhèu isra'el kalua nèti masir. masi ka ama lamatua hia mamuri le dhèu ca nau kateme, te ngaa d'ai loo-limuri, na palaho eele aa'i dhu ro'o boe parcaya ne.

source_text: and the angels who did not keep to their kingdom but went out from the place which was theirs, he has put in eternal chains and in dark night till the great day of the judging.
target_text: conto leo, nuka ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, te ngaa dènge lane kahèi. te ngaa rèngu cahag'e roca boe, hèia ra tao risi nèti hak rèngu. hèia lamatua èki si, pake rate dhu bisa boe ma'ète, aa taha si ètu era maroga sèna ka mate d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua neo pama'ète sasala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: even as sodom and gomorrah, and the towns near them, having like these, given themselves up to unclean desires and gone after strange flesh, have been made an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, dènge rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu sèra. dhèu-dhèu ra d'èi dhoka ad'u-ue rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu rèngu boe. rèngu d'èi titu kèna pa'èci dhu lèke-lèke boe kahèi. te ngaa lamatua pakèpu aa'i si pake ai. lii lolo ne pasanèd'e èdhi, peka na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua pake ai naraka dhu madhe boe èèna, sèna ka huku aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: in the same way these dreamers make the flesh unclean, having no respect for authorities, and say evil of rulers.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu dhu maso asa talora aae miu sèra, mamuri ad'u-ue sasala taruu. aa te ngaa, lii nii ra, ka rèngu pake j'aj'i mi alasan ho pakaj'alu iisi ra, ho lab'a leli dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa, aa pahahe koasa-koasa dhu hua iia ètu sorga.

source_text: now when michael, one of the chief angels, was fighting against the evil one for the body of moses, fearing to make use of violent words against him, he only said, may the lord be your judge.
target_text: te ngaa mikael tao boe sèmi rèngu. nèngu èèna, madho nèti ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. lod'o musa heka madhe èèna, mikael dhu pab'ala dènge dhèu aae nidhu lula-nèti ngi'u aae musa. te ngaa mikael pasala boe ne, do pahahe boe ne kahèi. dhoka na peka na, pe lamatua ka ator èu, heka èu sèmi more pala mu kèna!

source_text: but these men say evil about such things as they have no knowledge of; and the things of which they have natural knowledge, like beasts without reason, are the cause of their destruction.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu maso asa talora aae miu, sama boe sèmi èèna. dhèu se pahahe aa pusi-pahae boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu re'a boe. rèngu dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di, nuka sèmi badha sa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pa'ele iie ngi'u unu ra.

source_text: a curse on them! they have gone in the way of cain, running uncontrolled into the error of balaam for reward, and have come to destruction by saying evil against the lord, like korah.
target_text: mata unu ra! pe sèmi rare pala ra. te tatao rèngu nuka sèmi kaen, dhu hake pamadhe ari d'èlu na. ra tao nuka sèmi balaam, dhu sab'a ngaa èèna ka, sad'i abhu doi. rèngu tao kahèi sama sèmi kora, dhu unu mamadhe-mamopo lula palab'a dènge lamatua. lula bhabhelu-katub'a ra, èèna na rèngu pakaj'èu nèti lamatua kahèi.

source_text: these men are unseen rocks at your love-feasts, when they take part in them with you, keepers of sheep who without fear take the food of the sheep; clouds without water rushing before the wind, wasted trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,
target_text: ladhe rèngu pakaboko dènge miu ho sanèd'e sasue lamatua, lod'o miu mi'a sama-sama, na, rèngu re'a boe makae, aa manga'a dèu ngara. de miu baku pamud'e. te rèngu nuka sèmi hadhu aae ètu d'ara dhasi dhu bisa pamae kapa. rèngu cakaraa liru mèdhi ètu dedha rai mango dhu papuru boe èj'i ca pasuti sa. rèngu dhoka lii padhai di dhu kapai, te ngaa tao rare boe ngaa èci sa dhu be'a. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana aaj'u dhu guna boe ngaa-ngaa. ladhe d'ai hèru hua, hua boe cue sa hèi; te'a boe, na, dhu bete eele le toke d'ai amo-èsu kateme.

source_text: violent waves of the sea, streaming with their shame, wandering stars for whom the darkest night is kept in store for ever.
target_text: sasab'a ra dhoka pamakae èdhi di. te rèngu nuka sèmi naha dhasi dhu tèke eele horo dhu pènu dènge kaj'alu dhutu-dhutu ètu sebhe dhasi. rèngu sama sèmi hua-hètu kahèi dhu la'e-mai ètu dedha-liru dhu abhu huku, ka lamatua tèke si ètu era èci dhu maroga aatu-aatu, hèia ele aa'i si.

source_text: the prophet enoch, who was the seventh after adam, said of these men, the lord came with tens of thousands of his saints,
target_text: henok, ana-èpu ka pidhu, ige mulai nèti adam. nèngu peka mema le, lula-nèti dhèu sèmi se'e se. te na peka na, miu ladhe sèku. lamatua èdhi mai dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga dhu mola-mèci. rèngu sèra, ae titu kèna toke ige tare boe.

source_text: to be the judge of all, and to give a decision against all those whose lives are unpleasing to him, because of the evil acts which they have done, and because of all the hard things which sinners without fear of god have said against him.
target_text: nèngu mai ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. èèna na nèngu pad'elo sasala nèti ca dhèu-ca dhèu, dènge bhoke paled'a-led'a tatao-tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. na pabèbhe hahuku mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sèra, lula padhai lii rèngu dhu lèke boe mi lamatua.

source_text: these are the men who make trouble, ever desiring change, going after evil pleasures, using high-sounding words, respecting men's position in the hope of reward.
target_text: dhèu se'e se re'a dhoka loe boe ka'ugu di. rèngu muri dhoka pasasei di. ra pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, aa madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara rèngu di. rèngu dhoka padhai lii padedha iisi ra. ra d'èi pahie rèhu dènge mangojo d'ara dhèu, sèna ka hud'i laa rèngu abhu pala madhutu dad'èi ra.

source_text: but you, my loved ones, keep in memory the words which were said before by the apostles of our lord jesus christ, how they said to you, in the last days there will be men who, guided by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu lii padhadha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu dhèu pajuu-paleha na peka-padhai mema mi miu, na, ladhe oe èle rai-haha, dhèu dhu tema pa-aape dhèu, èèna na, cèu mai. rèngu d'èi pahahe dad'èi lamatua, ho madhutu dad'èi rèngu unu ra dhu koe-kapengo.

source_text: these are the men who make divisions, natural men, not having the spirit.
target_text: limuri ne, abhu le dhèu sèra. rèngu ka dhu kakèj'i dhèu ètu mia-mia, sèna ka pamae-pamanyèla miu. mamuri ra dhoka madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci abhu boe ètu d'ara rèngu.

source_text: but you, my loved ones, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, and making prayers in the holy spirit,
target_text: te ngaa a'ari pasue! miu hud'i padhèdi ku mamuri miu mi dedha fanderen nèti lalèka miu dhu mola-mèci. aa ladhe miu sabaj'a, madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci peka dènge miu.

source_text: keep yourselves in the love of god, looking for life eternal through the mercy of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: sanèd'e, ama lamatua sue miu titu kèna. de j'aga ngi'u miu, aa sanèd'e sasue na. aa miu hud'i tatae taruu, sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo rasa kasia mi miu, aa hia miu mamuri dènge ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and have pity on those who are in doubt;
target_text: miu hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia mi dhèu dhu d'ara kajari.

source_text: and to some give salvation, pulling them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear, hating even the clothing which is made unclean by the flesh.
target_text: miu hud'i bantu dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parluu abhu mamuri, sama sèmi miu ère dhèu nèti d'ara ai karoo. abhu dhèu leo hari dhu miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara be'a miu dènge rèngu. te ngaa, mage-mage! masi ka miu rasa kasia mi rèngu, te ngaa miu kahèi hud'i madenge ku dènge kaj'alu ra, nuka sèmi dhèu madenge dènge kodho dhu kaj'alu.

source_text: now to him who is able to keep you from falling, and to give you a place in his glory, free from all evil, with great joy,
target_text: mai ti koa-kio padedha-dedha ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu bisa madhenga miu, sèna ka baku manahu. aa nèngu ka dhu bisa lere miu, sèna ka miu titu ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pamèu miu, toke hahera abhu boe ciki sa hèi. miu mai dènge d'ara karae, te dadedha na kapai titu kèna!

source_text: to the only god our saviour, through jesus christ our lord, let us give glory and honour and authority and power, before all time and now and for ever. so be it.
target_text: dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa-mesa na, dhu j'aj'i lamatua dhu lèke, dhodhoka nèngu di dhu bisa pamamuri èdhi! hèia na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho pala-bagi èdhi mamuri. de lii koa-kad'iri hia aa'i mi nèngu. dadedha dènge kapai aa'i-aa'i unu nèngu. koasa na kapai titu kèna. aa hak paredha nèngu, karèi nèti uru ka, deo ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. tare'a-re'a! nèngu èèna kèna! nèti ja'a, yudas

source_text: the revelation of jesus christ which god gave him so that his servants might have knowledge of the things which will quickly take place: and he sent and made it clear by his angel to his servant john; who gave witness of the word of god, and of the witness of jesus christ, even of all the things which he saw.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yohanis, ana pua-paleha nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a. ja'a ke'a j'ara se'e se, sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka tèke mi yesus kristus. hèia ama lamatua pua yesus ho lole mi dhèu unu na sèra. èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai bhoke pad'elo j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a suri mema. te nèbhu heka j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, tatu j'aj'i. de nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu yesus peka ne.

source_text: a blessing be on the reader, and on those who give ear to the prophet's words, and keep the things which he has put in the book: for the time is near.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu baca sasuri ne'e toke dhèu bisa nanene, na, rèngu oto titu kèna. aa dhèu dhu nanene isi na, aa tao madhutu sèmi dhu na moa, rèngu oto kahèi. te lod'o mamai na dètu ae le.

source_text: john to the seven churches which are in asia: grace to you and peace, from him who is and was and is to come; and from the seven spirits which are before his high seat;
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, hia mi pidhu juma'at ètu propensi asia. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. te ama lamatua abhu mema le, karèi nèti uru ka. nèngu dhu deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a, toke d'ai mia-mia. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh na dhu mola-mèci pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. ja'a ladhe kèdhi roh mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi abhu pidhu roh sa dhu patangara dènge kadera paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and from jesus christ, the true witness, the first to come back from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. to him who had love for us and has made us clean from our sins by his blood;
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi ho yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ne loe boe padhai lii paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ama lamatua peka dènge ne. uru èèna na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne, ka na j'aj'i dhèu uru tèka, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe. pe nèngu ka dhu paredha dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. lula yesus sue èdhi, nèti èèna ka na pasuti raa na hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, na bhoke j'ara sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to his god and father; to him let glory and power be given for ever and ever. so be it.
target_text: ka na ded'e nare èdhi, j'aj'i ana kabarai na, sèna ka èdhi sab'a hia ama na, ama lamatua. yesus kristus ne, kapai titu kèna, lula koasa na èle boe. lèke sèmi èèna!

source_text: see, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, and those by whom he was wounded; and all the tribes of the earth will be sorrowing because of him. yes, so be it.
target_text: de bhoke musi madha ho ladhe paie-iie! yesus dènge ama na, limuri ne ètu sorga nèi. te ngaa nèbhu heka na puru mai d'ara ra'i-liru. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na ladhe rèdhi ne, sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu uru na kèj'i ne. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne manyasa, aa tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula tadhe ne. se'e se, mema tare'a-re'a j'aj'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: i am the first and the last, says the lord god who is and was and is to come, the ruler of all.
target_text: ama lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, alpa toke d'ai omega. ja'a ne, a toke d'ai z. aa'i-aa'i ra kapua nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru tèka toke d'ai èle. ja'a ne dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka mai. ja'a dhu deo ne'e. aa ja'a dhu bèli-camèd'a, toke d'ai mia-mia. ka ja'a mesa-mesa ku dhu dènge koasa kapai risi eele!

source_text: i, john, your brother, who have a part with you in the trouble and the kingdom and the quiet strength of jesus, was in the island which is named patmos, for the word of god and the witness of jesus.
target_text: lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya, na, yesus ne dhèu aae èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi pa'a'ari. abhu dhèu leo dhu nasa kahèi lula èdhi madhutu yesus, ka rèngu paj'èra èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. te ngaa yesus pa'èra d'ara èdhi, ka bisa taha taruu. lula ja'a aj'a-nori le dhèu lula-nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus, ka abhu dhèu dhu tèka d'ara. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne ra kèpe rare ja'a, ka hue eele asa pulu patmos ne'e.

source_text: i was in the spirit on the lord's day, and a great voice at my back, as of a horn, came to my ears,
target_text: ka d'ara ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a abhu roh ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, ja'a tadèngi lii rodhe nèti kabodho. lii èèna nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe sa.

source_text: saying, what you see, put in a book, and send it to the seven churches; to ephesus and to smyrna and to pergamos and to thyatira and to sardis and to philadelphia and to laodicea.
target_text: lii ne, pua ja'a, peka na, yohanis! ja'a neo bhoke j'ara èci, ho pad'elo dènge èu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi se, èu hud'i suri more ku. èle èèna, èu hud'i pa'adhu hia pidhu juma'at, nuka ètu kota epesus, kota smirna, kota pergamus, kota tiatira, kota sardis, kota piladelfia, dènge kota laodikia.

source_text: and turning to see the voice which said these words to me, i saw seven gold vessels with lights burning in them;
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kabib'a asa kabodho, neo ke'a cee ka dhu lii deo na. te ngaa ja'a kèdhi labhu èi mènyi pidhu bua dhu pamadhèdi ètu dedha tatèka labhu, dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: and in the middle of them one like a son of man, clothed with a robe down to his feet, and with a band of gold round his breasts.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci dhu titu ètu talora aae labhu se'e. rèhu na nuka sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake kodho èci dhu robho d'ai rai, aa dhu cape dènge saledha hualaa ca bèla ètu kakara na.

source_text: and his head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
target_text: rèu kètu na pudhi lao-lao nuka sèmi rèu kahib'i-kalèbho pudhi. musi madha na heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai.

source_text: and his feet like polished brass, as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice was as the sound of great waters.
target_text: haga na mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga dhu tunu ètu d'ara ai karoo. lii na kadèru sèmi lii bèbhe naha dhasi kapai.

source_text: and he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword: and his face was like the sun shining in its strength.
target_text: ètu ai g'ana, na kèpe dènge hua-hètu pidhu bua. nèti hèb'a na, bhodho samala èci dhu dua rèka dhu madèka. rèhu na cèb'a-cèb'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o dhu re mèu rai.

source_text: and when i saw him, i went down on my face at his feet as one dead. and he put his right hand on me, saying, have no fear; i am the first and the last and the living one;
target_text: ropa ja'a ladhe kèdhi dhèu ne'e, hèia ja'a bèbhe dènge ka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe ètu haga na. te ngaa na gai ja'a dènge ai g'ana na, hèia na lii peka na, ana, ee! baku madha'u! te aa'i-aa'i se kapua ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru toke d'ai èle.

source_text: and i was dead, and see, i am living for ever, and i have the keys of death and of hell.
target_text: uru èèna, mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, èu ladhe ku laa! ja'a mamuri hari le, aa èèna na mamuri taa-taa. aa ja'a ka dhu kèd'u gagoe dhu bisa bhoke era pea dhèu madhe, sèna ka pamamuri hari si.

source_text: put in writing, then, the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will be after these;
target_text: èu hud'i suri more aa'i ku dhu ladhe mèdhi se, aa suri kahèi ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: the secret of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and of the seven gold vessels with burning lights. the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lights are the seven churches.
target_text: ja'a peka uuru ku sasoa na: labhu hualaa pidhu bua se, nuka pidhu juma'at. aa pidhu hua-hètu dhu èu mèdhi ètu ai g'ana ja'a ne, nuka ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti lii ama lamatua hia mi pidhu juma'at sèra.

source_text: to the angel of the church in ephesus say: these things says he who has the seven stars in his right hand, who is walking in the middle of the seven gold lights:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna paredha ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more ku sasuri èci. isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota epesus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u pidhu hua-hètu ètu ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a dhu kako palème kahèi laladhe pidhu labhu hualaa se cue-cue. nanene paie lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i have knowledge of your doings, and of your hard work and long waiting, and that you will not put up with evil men, and have put to the test those who say they are apostles and are not, and have seen that they are false;
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le, j'ara mamuri miu ètu kota epesus, peka na, miu sab'a bia hia lamatua. ladhe abhu dhèu bhelu ètu talora aae miu, miu soro tèke boe ne. ladhe dhèu mai dadugu, peka na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, miu parisa paie-iie mamuri na, sèna ka me'a na, nèngu ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. hèia miu tule eele, aa nanene boe ne.

source_text: and you have the power of waiting, and have undergone trouble because of my name, without weariness.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu lula miu parcaya ja'a, te ngaa miu taha taruu aa hari boe ciki sa.

source_text: but i have this against you, that you are turned away from your first love.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca madha j'ara. lula uru èèna, lod'o miu hiu-hiu parcaya ja'a, miu mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi heka èèna.

source_text: so keep in mind where you were at first, and be changed in heart and do the first works; or i will come to you, and will take away your light from its place, if your hearts are not changed.
target_text: de miu hud'i sanèd'e hari ku j'ara uru èèna! te limuri ne, miu pakaj'èu ae nèti j'ara uru èèna. de miu ae eele ka nèti sasala miu se'e, sèna ka mi pasue hari sèmi uru èèna. te aad'o na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai kore hari labhu hualaa èèna nèti miu.

source_text: but at least you have the credit of hating the works of the nicolaitans, as i do.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ja'a ako karej'e, lula miu tule eele lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai, dhu ana madhutu na sèra tao madhutu. ja'a tule eele kahèi tatao kapod'e-kabèli ra sèra.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches. to him who overcomes i will give of the fruit of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of god.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu taha pa'èra madhutu ja'a toke na madhe, pe ja'a soro tèke na'a hua aj'u ètu d'ara talora oka ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu na'a hua aj'u èèna, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in smyrna say: these things says the first and the last, who was dead and is living:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota smirna: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka toke d'ai èle. uru èèna mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a mamuri hari le. de miu nanene lii padhai ja'a ne.

source_text: i have knowledge of your troubles and how poor you are but you have true wealth, and the evil words of those who say they are jews, and are not, but are a synagogue of satan.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le j'aj'èra mamuri miu ètu kota smirna. masi ka ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, miu unu aad'o, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua miu kaja. abhu dhèu dhu mangaku, na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa padhai lii pakarehe kolongara miu. te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu se unu boe lamatua. rèngu madhutu dhoka dhèu aae nidhu di.

source_text: have no fear of the things which you will have to undergo: see, the evil one will send some of you into prison, so that you may be put to the test; and you will have great trouble for ten days. be true till death, and i will give you the crown of life.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie. miu baku madha'u, ladhe abhu j'aj'èra era. sad'i miu me'a, na, dhèu aae nidhu neo tenge dhèu ho kèpe miu cahag'e, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara bèdho d'ai canguru lod'o. dad'èi na, sèna ka miu rai tèke eele ja'a. masi ka nidhu neo pamadhe miu èèna ka, te ngaa miu baku bhèlu ja'a kahèi. te dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pala-bagi ne mamuri, sèna ka na mamuri taa-taa dènge ja'a.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches. he who overcomes will not come under the power of the second death.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu madhutu ja'a toke madhe, èèna na nèngu abhu boe j'aj'èra ètu d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo robhe-robhe kura boe ciki sa èèna. dènge sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu boe mamadhe ka dua hari. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in pergamos say: these things says he who has the sharp two-edged sword:
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota pergamus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u samala rèka dua dhu madèka. nanene lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i have knowledge that your living-place is where satan has his seat: and you are true to my name, and were not turned away from your faith in me, even in the days of antipas, my true witness, who was put to death among you, where satan has his place.
target_text: ja'a ke'a mèu le kota pergamus miu èèna. te, dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu kèpe pa'èra kolongara ja'a, aa parcaya taruu ja'a. uru èèna abhu dhèu ja'a èci ètu èèna, ngara na antipas. nèngu aj'a lèke mola-mola j'ara mamuri ja'a, te ngaa ra pamadhe ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu pasili boe ja'a.

source_text: but i have some things against you, because you have with you those who keep the teaching of balaam, by whose suggestion balak made the children of israel go out of the right way, taking food which was offered to false gods, and going after the desires of the flesh.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca j'ara dua j'ara. abhu nèti miu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti balaam. uru èèna balaam aj'a balak ho kakèj'i dhèu isra'el, toke ra sisu dad'èi lamatua. balak kakèj'i dhèu isra'el sèra, ho pae'a dènge ra'a-rinu mèdha sogo-tagu, aa ra tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra.

source_text: and you have those who keep the teaching of the nicolaitans.
target_text: abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti miu dhu madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai.

source_text: see, then, that you have a change of heart; or i will come to you quickly, and will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
target_text: de miu hud'i loe ku nèti sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, nèbhu heka ja'a dhiu pad'ui miu dènge lii sakaa dhu nuka sèmi pare dènge samala.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches. to him who overcomes i will give of the secret manna, and i will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name, of which no one has knowledge but he to whom it is given.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na. dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne na'a roti manna nèti sorga dhu tèke paie iie ne. pe ja'a pangèd'u ne hèi, hadhu pudhi cue dhu suri tèke ngara hiu na. dhodhoka nèngu mesa na di dhu ne'a ngara na; dhèu leo re'a boe. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in thyatira say: these things says the son of god, whose eyes are like a flame of fire, and his feet like polished brass:
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota tiatira: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, nuka ana ama lamatua. musi madha ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai, aa haga ja'a mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga ètu d'ara ai. nanene ku lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i have knowledge of your works, and your love and faith and help and strength in trouble, and that your last works are more than the first.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi le mamuri miu. miu sue ja'a tare'a, aa parcaya èra ja'a kahèi. miu madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu. masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu taha taruu. ja'a ke'a kahèi, limuri ne miu sab'a bia risi hari hia ja'a.

source_text: but i have this against you, that you let the woman jezebel say she is a prophet and give false teaching, making my servants go after the desires of the flesh and take food offered to false gods.
target_text: te ngaa miu manahu ètu ca j'ara: miu sèmi mere dènge be'a, bhèni dhu ngara na isabel, dhu padedha iisi peka na, nèngu èèna dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. ka miu hud'i na sène, aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe mi dhèu ja'a. lula lii a'aj'a na dhu kapod'e-kabèli èèna ka, dhèu ja'a tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa ra'a nganga'a sogo-tagu.

source_text: and i gave her time for a change of heart, but she has no mind to give up her unclean ways.
target_text: ja'a dhu kai le bhèni èèna pèri-pèri hari le, sèna ka ele-ho'a nèti sasala na, te ngaa na d'èi boe.

source_text: see, i will put her into a bed, and those who make themselves unclean with her, into great trouble, if they go on with her works.
target_text: de ladhe paie-iie. te ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho hia ne lèke papèd'a èci, toke na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu j'unu pa'èci dènge ne. ladhe rèngu tèke eele boe bhèni aapa ne, nèbhu boe ja'a huku si kahèi.

source_text: and i will put her children to death; and all the churches will see that i am he who makes search into the secret thoughts and hearts of men: and i will give to every one of you the reward of your works.
target_text: èèna na ja'a pamadhe aa'i ana-ana nèti bhèni aapa ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra re'a, na, ja'a ne ke'a aa'i d'ara dhèu. pe ja'a b'ala miu madhutu tatao dhu miu ad'u-ue.

source_text: but to you i say, to the rest in thyatira, even to those who have not this teaching, and have no knowledge of the secrets of satan, as they say; i put on you no other weight.
target_text: te ngaa miu cahag'e ètu tiatira sèra, dhu madhutu boe lii a'aj'a bhèni aapa ne. miu tule eele le a'aj'a dhu pahuni èèna, dhu ra peka na, ‘ilmu maroga nèti dhèu aae nidhu'. nèti èèna ka, ja'a parluu heka kai miu,

source_text: but what you have, keep safe till i come.
target_text: sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu mi dedha ja'a, toke ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: he who overcomes, and keeps my works to the end, to him i will give rule over the nations, and he will be ruling them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of the potter they will be broken, even as i have power from my father: and i will give him the morning star.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne koasa. koasa èèna kapai, nuka sèmi koasa dhu ja'a abhu nèti ama ku, ho paredha dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dènge tatea bèsi. ladhe abhu dhu lab'a ne, pe na ab'o palaho si, nuka sèmi dhèu pamae èru rai. èèna na, ja'a hia miu hua-hètu dhimu kahèi.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in sardis say: these things says he who has the seven spirits of god and the seven stars: i have knowledge of your works, that you seem to be living but are dead.
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota sardis: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. roh ama lamatua ètu ja'a. aa roh ne, pidhu rupa. ja'a dhu kèpe kahèi pidhu hua-hètu ètu d'ara ai ja'a. nanene lii padhai ja'a. ja'a ke'a le tatao miu ètu sardis. dhèu peka, na, miu se mamuri madhutu dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa miu nuka sèmi samanga aad'o ètu kètu.

source_text: be on the watch, and make strong the rest of the things which are near to death; because as judged by me your works have not come up to god's measure.
target_text: de kèd'i ka! pa'èra parcaya miu dhu oe èle na. te ja'a dhu parisa le ngaa dhu miu sab'a, abhu boe dhu mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: keep in mind, then, the teaching which was given to you, and be ruled by it and have a change of heart. if then you do not keep watch, i will come like a thief, and you will have no knowledge of the hour when i will come on you.
target_text: de baku bhèlu lii aj'a-nori dhu mola, dhu miu nanene aa abhu nèti uru èèna. madhutu paie-iie dad'èi ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe miu kèd'i malai boe, ho mi tao madhutu j'ara sèra, cag'ag'a laa ja'a dhiu nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu miu me'a mere boe.

source_text: but you have some names in sardis who have kept clean their robes; and as a reward they will go in white with me.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e era nèti miu ètu sardis dhu mamuri mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pakaj'alu boe mèdha-papake ra. lula miu mamuri mola, ka miu nia kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, pake mèdha-papake pudhi.

source_text: he who overcomes will be dressed in white, and i will not take his name from the book of life, and i will give witness to his name before my father, and before his angels.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pake mèdha-papake pudhi kahèi. bèli-camèd'a ja'a roso eele boe ngara na nèti d'ara sasuri dhu suri ngara dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. èèna na ja'a mangaku ne ètu madha ama ku, dènge ètu madha ana pajuu ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in philadelphia say: these things says he who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of david, opening the door so that it may be shut by no one, and shutting it so that it may be open to no one.
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu lii na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota piladelfia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a dhu mola-mèci dènge dhu lèke tare'a. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u gagoe dhèu aae daud. ladhe ja'a bhoke kore babèdho, abhu boe ca dhèu sa bisa bèdho hari. ladhe ja'a bèdho kore, abhu boe ca dhèu sa bisa bhoke.

source_text: i have knowledge of your works see, i have put before you an open door which may be shut by no one, and that you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have been true to my name.
target_text: ja'a ke'a aa'i ngaa dhu miu tao. ja'a ke'a kahèi, pangaru miu kapai boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, miu pasili boe ja'a, aa madhutu taruu lii a'aj'a ja'a. sanèd'e paie, te ja'a dhu conge le babèdho hia miu, de dhèu èci sa bisa boe bèdho hari.

source_text: see, i will make those of the synagogue of satan who say they are jews, and are not, but say what is false; i will make them come and give worship before your feet, and see my love for you.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te abhu dhèu leko-monya dhu peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa rèngu sèra, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu madhutu dhèu aae nidhu. pe me'a unu mi! ja'a tao si, sèna ka ra dhiu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha miu, aa ra mangaku na, ja'a tare'a-re'a sue miu.

source_text: because you have kept my word in quiet strength, i will keep you from the hour of testing which is coming on all the world, to put to the test those who are on earth.
target_text: lula miu madhutu le paredha ja'a, ka miu taha madhutu ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a bhabhae miu nèti j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo hia mai, ho sèku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i come quickly: keep that which you have, so that no one may take your crown.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. de miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lii aj'a-nori ja'a, dhu miu abhu le karèi nèti uru ka. te mage dhoka abhu dhu parame rare rui-j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo b'ala hia miu.

source_text: him who overcomes i will make a pillar in the house of my god, and he will go out no more: and i will put on him the name of my god, and the name of the town of my god, the new jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my god, and my new name.
target_text: dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pea taruu dènge lamatua, sama sèmi agarii aae dhu titu mèno ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua. pe ja'a suri ngara lamatua ja'a, dènge ngara kota lamatua ètu ngi'u dhèu ne. kota èèna ra pangare, na, ‘yerusalem hiu', dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua papuru mai nèti sorga. aa èèna na, ja'a suri kahèi ngara hiu ja'a mi ngi'u dhèu ne.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua peka mi juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church in laodicea say: these things says the true and certain witness, the head of god's new order:
target_text: èle ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more ku sasuri dhu limuri tèka, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota laodikia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, dhu dhèu paroa na, ‘tare'a sèmi èèna'. ja'a ne loe boe padhai lii dènge mola lii holo-nori ama lamatua. dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua ad'u-ue sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: i have knowledge of your works, that you are not cold or warm: it would be better if you were cold or warm.
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le tatao miu ètu laodikia. te ngaa miu sèmi ngaa mèro? ! pana aad'o, aa pacuhi aad'o kahèi. ladhe pana, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pana! aa ladhe pacuhi, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pacuhi!

source_text: so because you are not one thing or the other, i will have no more to do with you.
target_text: te ngaa, lula d'ara miu kajari, bèli-camèd'a ja'a sabhuu eele miu nèti d'ara hèb'a ja'a, sama sèmi dhèu sabhuu ilu.

source_text: for you say, i have wealth, and have got together goods and land, and have need of nothing; and you are not conscious of your sad and unhappy condition, that you are poor and blind and without clothing.
target_text: miu padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ‘ji'i se, kaja-su'i. ji'i mamuri be'a, kura boe ngaa-ngaa! ' te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, d'ara miu dhu bèdhu le, ka me'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dhu dènge boe mèdha ètu ua mi.

source_text: if you are wise you will get from me gold tested by fire, so that you may have true wealth; and white robes to put on, so that your shame may not be seen; and oil for your eyes, so that you may see.
target_text: de hua iia mai ho hèli mere poe-pai nèti ja'a, sèna ka miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. aa hèli mere mèdha-papake pudhi, ho pahutu era makae mi. aa hèli mere kahèi èi na'i musi madha, sèna ka roso mi musi madha miu, ho mèdhi mèu hari.

source_text: to all those who are dear to me, i give sharp words and punishment: then with all your heart have sorrow for your evil ways.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pasue ja'a tao sala, ja'a kai aa huku si, sèna ka ra j'aj'i be'a. de miu hud'i pamola d'ara mi, ho madhutu ja'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: see, i am waiting at the door and giving the sign; if my voice comes to any man's ears and he makes the door open, i will come in to him, and will take food with him and he with me.
target_text: nanene paie-iie. te ja'a nuka titu ètu hèb'a èmu ne, aa ja'a paroa taruu ho neo maso asa d'ara èmu. ladhe dhèu cee dhu tadèngi lii ja'a, ho na conge èmu, ja'a dhiu asa d'ara, sèna ka madhèdi ta'a-tinu pa'èci.

source_text: to him who overcomes i will give a place with me on my high seat, even as i overcame, and am seated with my father on his high seat.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u ne hak, ho nèd'u paredha bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a taha le madhutu ama ku kahèi, nèti èèna ka limuri ne ja'a kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: he who has ears, let him give ear to what the spirit says to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka mi juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: after these things i saw a door open in heaven, and the first voice came to my ears, like the sound of a horn, saying, come up here, and i will make clear to you the things which are to come.
target_text: ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, peka nare lii moa na mi pidhu juma'at sèra, hèia lamatua bhoke pad'elo dènge ja'a, ngaa-ngaa dhu leo hari. ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna kahèi, ja'a kèdhi babèdho èci dhu bhoke le tangare la'e asa sorga. ka ja'a tadèngi hari lii dhu mèdhu nèti dhèu deo na, nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe, peka na, mai ku! ca'e asa ne'e, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo dènge èu ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: straight away i was in the spirit: and i saw a high seat in heaven, and one was seated on it;
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, roh lamatua ded'e nèti ja'a asa sorga. cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi kadera paredha èci, aa abhu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha.

source_text: and to my eyes he was like a jasper and a sardius stone: and there was an arch of light round the high seat, like an emerald.
target_text: dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna heo mangèru dènge mea, èci èèna ka dènge hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dhu ra peka na, yaspis dènge sardius. abhu kahèi saroo èci dhu reo nare kadera paredha na. saroo ne heo na mangèru sama sèmi hadhu kale'e samrud.

source_text: and round about the high seat were four and twenty seats: and on them i saw four and twenty rulers seated, clothed in white robes; and on their heads crowns of gold.
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu dua nguru èpa kadera paredha iiki, dhu reo rare kadera paredha dhu ètu talora aae èèna. ètu dedha kadera paredha iiki se'e, madhèdi katua dua nguru èpa dhèu. aa'i-aa'i ra pake mèdha-papake pudhi, dènge solo paredha dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: and out of the high seat came flames and voices and thunders. and seven lights of fire were burning before the high seat, which are the seven spirits of god;
target_text: nèti kadera paredha ètu talora aae èèna, abhu bela dhu kacèb'a, dènge d'oro dhu lii mèdhu patuu ma'èta boe. abhu kahèi ob'o pidhu bua dhu heo ètu madha kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se, nuka sèmi roh ama lamatua dhu pidhu rupa.

source_text: and before the high seat there was, as it seemed, a clear sea of glass; and in the middle of the high seat, and round about it, four beasts full of eyes round about.
target_text: ètu madha kadera paredha ne, ja'a kèdhi èi, oe sèmi dhasi dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. hèia ja'a kèdhi badha èpa ngi'u dhu dhae kèdhi mèka ciki sa rai-reo kadera èèna. ngi'u ra nèti madha toke kabodho, pènu dènge musi madha. badha se'e ka dhu lalau-lalo'o lamatua.

source_text: and the first beast was like a lion, and the second like an ox, and the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
target_text: badha ka èci, rèhu na sèmi singa. ka dua, rèhu na sèmi sapi mone. ka tèlu, rèhu na sèmi dhèu. aa ka èpa, rèhu na nuka sèmi manea luji dhu lela.

source_text: and the four beasts, having every one of them six wings, are full of eyes round about and inside: and without resting day and night, they say, holy, holy, holy, lord god, ruler of all, who was and is and is to come.
target_text: badha èpa ngi'u se, ci'u-ci'u ka dhu dènge èla ra, èna. re li'u dènge re d'ara èla se, pènu dènge musi madha kahèi. mèu-mèda, badha se loe boe sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua! lamatua èèna, dhu mola-mèci risi eele! koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. lamatua èèna karèi nèti uru ka mai. lamatua dhu deo ne'e ne. aa lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: and when the beasts give glory and honour to him who is seated on the high seat, to him who is living for ever and ever,
target_text: dènge ra sod'a sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio dènge pakab'ua ama lamatua, aa ra manèngi makasi mi nèngu kahèi, lula nèngu ka dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna, aa nèngu ka dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. ropa rèngu sod'a,

source_text: the four and twenty rulers go down on their faces before him who is seated on the high seat, and give worship to him who is living for ever and ever, and take off their crowns before the high seat, saying,
target_text: hèia dua nguru èpa katua sèra pabèbha iisi ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna. katua se bhoke eele solo paredha ra, ka ra tèke mi madha kadera paredha èèna, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge boe too-lane. èle ka, ra koa-kio ne, peka na,

source_text: it is right, our lord and our god, for you to have glory and honour and power: because by you were all things made, and by your desire they came into being.
target_text: ooo, ama lamatua! ji'i koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua. lamatua ne, kètu ji'i. lamatua ne, ama lamatua ji'i! lamatua ka dhu nia sèmi more koa-kio ji'i. lamatua ka dhu pantas sèmi lii pakab'ua ji'i. lula lamatua ka dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa lamatua ka dhu dedha risi eele. lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri aa'i-aa'i. aa'i-aa'i dhu tesa, j'aj'i, lula lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue. aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, dènge a'ae, lula lamatua ka dhu hia.

source_text: and i saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat, a book with writing inside it and on the back, shut with seven stamps of wax.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe hari nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna. na kèpe dènge sasuri ca lulu ètu ai g'ana na. ètu lalulu sasuri ne, dhu suri le re li'u dènge d'ara. ra segel le ètu pidhu era.

source_text: and i saw a strong angel saying in a loud voice, who is able to make the book open, and to undo its stamps?
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga ca dhèu dhu kapai aae. dènge lii aae, na karèi, dhèu cee ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel aa baca sasuri ne?

source_text: and no one in heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to get the book open, or to see what was in it.
target_text: na karèi sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa ra abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak, ho bisa bhoke dènge baca isi sasuri ne. masi ka ètu sorga, do ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe èci sa hèi dhu dènge hak. ètu era dhèu madhe, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and i was very sad, because there was no one able to get the book open or to see what was in it.
target_text: ropa kèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke sasuri aa baca isi na.

source_text: and one of the rulers said to me, do not be sad: see, the lion of the tribe of judah, the root of david, has overcome, and has power to undo the book and its seven stamps.
target_text: èle ka, ca dhèu nèti dua nguru èpa katua se'e, lii dènge ja'a, peka na, baku tangi, we. te ana-èpu dhèu aae daud ca dhèu dhu kapai risi eele, dhu ra haji ngara na, ‘singa nèti udhu-rasa yahuda'. nèngu ka dhu ab'o palaho le aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a. de nèngu ka dhu dènge hak, sèna ka bisa bhoke segel aa baca isi sasuri ne.

source_text: and i saw in the middle of the high seat and of the four beasts, and in the middle of the rulers, a lamb in his place, which seemed as if it had been put to death, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of god, sent out into all the earth.
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kèdhi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu titu ètu talora aae badha èpa ngi'u sèra, dènge dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi reo rare kadera paredha èèna. ana kahib'i-kalèbho ne, oe sèmi dhu ra pamadhe le. nèngu ne dènge tadhu pidhu, aa musi madha na pidhu kahèi. musi madha pidhu sèra, nuka sèmi roh na dhu dènge pidhu rupa, dhu na papuru mai palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he came and took it out of the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho ne, kako la'e asa madha nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, sèna ka sèmi nare lalulu sasuri nèti ai g'ana na.

source_text: and when he had taken the book, the four beasts and the four and twenty rulers went down on their faces before the lamb, having every one an instrument of music, and gold vessels full of perfumes, which are the prayers of the saints.
target_text: ropa ana kalèbho ne sèmi nare sasuri, cag'ag'a laa badha èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua sèra, pabèbha iisi ra, ka ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. rèngu se èci-èci ka kèpe mèdha lii sod'a oe sèmi sasadhu sa, dènge mago hualaa dhu isi dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi, sèna ka ra pasèbu ho pahèu mèngi. raa aj'u hèu mèngi se'e ka, nuka lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and their voices are sounding in a new song, saying, it is right for you to take the book and to make it open: for you were put to death and have made an offering to god of your blood for men of every tribe, and language, and people, and nation,
target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci, peka na: ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu nia sèmi nare sasuri ne. ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel sèra. te nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe le. hèia ama lamatua pake raa na, ho sui nare dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu cahag'e bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu rai-haha nèti lii aa'i-aa'i dènge rai aa'i-aa'i, bisa j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: and have made them a kingdom and priests to our god, and they are ruling on the earth.
target_text: ana kalèbho ne'e ka, oru nare si aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ca rae-ca nadha. ana kalèbho ne'e ka, hag'e nare si, j'aj'i dhèu sab'a lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha. pe rèngu sab'a hia lamatua ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and i saw, and there came to my ears the sound of a great number of angels round about the high seat and the beasts and the rulers; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
target_text: èle ka, ja'a boti kètu, hèia tadèngi lii mèdhu aae èci. hèia ja'a ladhe badha aae èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua se, tabha hari dènge ana pajuu nèti sorga ae titu kèna. ana pajuu se d'ai juta-kehi.

source_text: saying with a great voice, it is right to give to the lamb who was put to death, power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho dhu ra pamadhe le, lula nèngu ka dhu nia sèmi nare lii koa-kio ji'i! koasa na, kapai risi eele. kakaja na, lale-kabèle. ngangee lii padhai na, lèke mola-mola. a'èra na, èci sa risi boe. ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. ji'i pakab'ua ne. ji'i koa-kio ne.

source_text: and to my ears came the voice of everything in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and of all things which are in them, saying, to him who is seated on the high seat, and to the lamb, may blessing and honour and glory and power be given for ever and ever.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a tadèngi hari lii sod'a dhu leo èci. lii sod'a ne, mai nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu: sorga, dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhasi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a. nèti era dhèu madhe kahèi, ra madhutu sod'a. aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha. ji'i nedhe padedha-dedha kahèi ana kalèbho ne. ji'i pakab'ua rèngu. ji'i pahaha iisi mi rèngu. lula rèngu ka dhu rèd'u paredha taa-taa! aa koasa ra dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: and the four beasts said, so be it. and the rulers went down on their faces and gave worship.
target_text: hèia èpa badha aae se, loe boe dènge lii dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a! lèke kèna! ka dua nguru èpa katua se'e pabèbha hari iisi ra, hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, ho ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dènge ana kalèbho èèna.

source_text: and i saw when the lamb undid one of the stamps, and the voice of one of the four beasts came to my ears, saying as with a voice of thunder, come and see.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka èci nèti lalulu sasuri èèna. hèia ja'a tadèngi, na, èci nèti èpa badha aae sèra parodha dènge lii mèdhu, nuka sèmi lii d'oro. na paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and i saw a white horse, and he who was seated on it had a bow; and there was given to him a crown: and he went out with power to overcome.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u. dhèu èci dhu manya'e pake dènge solo kapala musu, lula nèngu ka dhu segi taruu ètu d'ara pamusu. limuri ne na kèpe le kataki-hahusu, la'e ho segi hari musu na ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when the second stamp was undone, the voice of the second beast came to my ears, saying, come and see.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka dua. ka ja'a tadèngi badha aae ka dua paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and another horse came out, a red horse; and it was given to him who was seated on it to take peace from the earth, so that people might put one another to death: and there was given to him a great sword.
target_text: ka jara ci'u dhu mea gèu-gèu kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne sèmi nare samala aae èci. ra hia ne koasa ho la'e pamaruru ètu rai-haha, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha èci pamadhe èci.

source_text: and when the third stamp was undone, the voice of the third beast came to my ears, saying, come and see. and i saw a black horse; and he who was seated on it had scales in his hand.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka tèlu. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii paredha nèti badha aae ka tèlu, peka na, lamu dènge ka! kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara mèdhi ci'u. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne nèd'u dènge kabatai cue, sèna ka tai nganga'a dhu oe kura kèna.

source_text: and a voice came to my ears, from the middle of the four beasts, saying, a measure of grain for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny: and see that you do no damage to the oil and the wine.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari, nuka sèmi lii èci mai nèti talora aae badha èpa ngi'u se, peka na, bèli-camèd'a, abhu manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna ètu rai-haha. gaji dhèu ca lod'o nia dhoka hèli laludhu tèlu moo di; te ngaa neo laludhu be'a, abhu dhoka ca moo di. masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pa'ele iie aj'u saitun dènge aj'u anggor ètu d'ara oka ra.

source_text: and when the fourth stamp was undone, the voice of the fourth beast came to my ears, saying, come and see.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èpa. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii nèti badha aae ka èpa hia paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and i saw a grey horse, and the name of him who was seated on it was death; and hell came after him. and there was given to them authority over the fourth part of the earth, to put to destruction by the sword, and by taking away their food, and by death, and by the beasts of the earth.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi jara ci'u dhu rèu na sanama karara. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne, ngara na ‘mamadhe'. aa abhu dhu madhutu ne re limuri, ngara na ‘era pea samanga dhèu madhe'. rèngu dua ra abhu koasa ho lasi pamadhe dhèu ètu rai-haha pake samala, tèu manganga-madèu, papèd'a-tarègu, dènge pasoku badha hui dhu bhelu. ladhe ige aa'i dhèu dhu madhe, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kaboko nèti èpa kaboko nèti dhèu dhu pea ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when the fifth stamp was undone, i saw under the altar the souls of those who had been put to death for the word of god, and for the witness which they kept.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka lèmi. ka ja'a kèdhi samanga dhèu dhu ra pamadhe uru sèra ètu ro'a mei korban. ra pamadhe rèngu lula parcaya ama lamatua, aa aj'a-nori dhèu taruu lula-nèti lii holo-nori na.

source_text: and they gave a great cry, saying, how long will it be, o ruler, holy and true, before you take your place as judge and give punishment for our blood to those on the earth?
target_text: ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, oo lamatua, ama dhu kapai risi! ama dhu mola-mèci! ji'i parcaya ngaa dhu lamatua peka-padhai. te ngaa ji'i hud'i tatae d'ai pèri lod'o hari, heka lamatua pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu pamadhe ji'i ètu rai-haha nèi?

source_text: and there was given to every one a white robe, and they were ordered to take their rest for a little time, till the number was complete of the other servants, their brothers, who would be put to death, even as they had been.
target_text: ropa rèngu karèi rare sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu èci-èci ka abhu kodho pudhi robho d'ai rai. abhu dhu peka dènge ra, tatae hari ku ciki oo'e, toke miu tesa aa'i. te abhu anga miu era dhu ra pamadhe sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and i saw when the sixth stamp was undone, and there was a great earth-shock; and the sun became black as haircloth, and all the moon became as blood;
target_text: ka ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èna. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi rai-haha ne opo kapai titu kèna. hèia madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, nuka sèmi bèla mèdhi, aa hèru mea sama sèmi raa.

source_text: and the stars of heaven were falling to the earth, like green fruit from a tree before the force of a great wind.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu nèti dedha-liru bèbhe mai asa rai-haha, nuka sèmi hua aj'u hoa dhu kabhui, lula lèke ngèlu aae.

source_text: and the heaven was taken away like the roll of a book when it is rolled up; and all the mountains and islands were moved out of their places.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe, na, liru mae bagi mi dua, ka lulu nuka sèmi dhèpi, toke ele. aa ledhe-ledhe dènge pulu aa'i-aa'i ra gaged'o, toke ele nèti era ra.

source_text: and the kings of the earth, and the rulers, and the chief captains, and the men of wealth, and the strong, and every servant and free man, took cover in the holes and the rocks of the mountains;
target_text: ropa j'ara se j'aj'i, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, mulai nèti dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, komedhaa sordad'u, dhèu kaja-su'i, toke d'ai ènu sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi lu'u ètu ro'a-ro'a loe, dènge sasanga-sasanga hadhu ètu ledhe.

source_text: and they say to the mountains and to the rocks, come down on us, covering us from the face of him who is seated on the high seat, and from the wrath of the lamb:
target_text: dhèu sèra pua ledhe-ledhe aa hadhu aae sèra, peka na, saguru mere ka ji'i laa! pahuni ji'i sèna ka nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna, baku nèdhi ji'i. aa ana kalèbho èèna huku ia ka ji'i.

source_text: for the great day of their wrath is come, and who may keep his place?
target_text: ira ii! ji'i laho mae-mae le, te lod'o d'ai mamadhe-mamopo kèna! ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho èèna, neo dutu nanasa rèngu mi dedha ji'i. te ngaa èci sa bisa boe sili rare, hèia tatu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: after this i saw four angels in their places at the four points of the earth, keeping back the four winds in their hands, so that there might be no moving of the wind on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhèu èpa puru mai nèti sorga, titu ètu èpa madha ngèlu ètu rai-haha ne, ho taha ngèlu. ka ngèlu bisa boe tiu asa d'ara dhasi, rai-dedha, dènge aj'u-aj'u.

source_text: and i saw another angel coming up from the east, having the mark of the living god: and he said with a great voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to do damage to the earth and the sea,
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa, ho ra pa'ele iie rai-dedha dènge d'ara dhasi. ka ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai nèti dhimu. na mai nèti dènge cap ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa. hèia na rodhe mi ana pajuu dhèu èpa sèra, peka na,

source_text: do no damage to the earth, or the sea, or the trees, till we have put a mark on the servants of our god.
target_text: mate ku! baku pa'ele iie ku rai-dedha, do d'ara dhasi, do aj'u sèra. mate toke ji'i tao ngare ku cap mi katangarèi dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and there came to my ears the number of those who had the mark on their brows, a hundred and forty-four thousand, who were marked out of every tribe of the people of israel.
